optionExplanations_en: A deeper network doesn't address feature selection or interpretability, and adds overfitting risk.
Correct — L1 pushes unimportant weights to 0, giving built-in feature selection and interpretability.
Removing validation makes it impossible to tune regularization strength and invites overfitting.
A model that never trains can't learn any useful weights at all.
q_en: Which regularization choice fits better here?
scenario_en: A linear model has thousands of sparse features, most may be useless, and you want to explain which features matter.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对权重绝对值加惩罚，能把不重要特征的权重压到 0。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: L1, or Lasso, penalizes absolute weights and can drive unimportant feature weights to 0.

termDefinitions.meaning: 大多数样本上取值为 0 或缺失的特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sparse feature is zero or missing for most examples.

q: Early stopping 的规则是什么？
why: 过拟合常在训练继续时出现，early stopping 用验证集当刹车：若干轮不再改善就停止，并保留最佳 checkpoint。
why_en: Early stopping halts training once validation performance stops improving for a set number of rounds, and keeps the best checkpoint.
diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Train
  Train --> Validate
  Validate --> Train: improves
  Validate --> Stop: no improvement
  Stop --> BestCheckpoint
options: 一直训练、把 loss 数值硬训练到负数为止
训练全程完全不参考任何验证集的表现变化
验证表现连续若干轮不再改善就停止，并使用最佳 checkpoint
只有等模型已经正式上线之后才会触发停止
options_en: Keep training until the loss value forces its way negative.
Never look at validation performance throughout training.
Stop once validation stops improving for several rounds, and keep the best checkpoint.
Only trigger stopping after the model is already live in production.
optionExplanations: 常见 loss 函数不会变成负数，这不是判断停止的依据。
早停恰恰靠验证集表现来判断是否该停，这条把机制说反了。
对；过拟合常在训练继续时出现，早停用验证集当刹车，保留表现最好的那一轮。
早停是训练阶段的机制，跟模型是否已经上线无关。
optionExplanations_en: Common loss functions don't go negative; that isn't the stopping criterion.
Early stopping is defined by watching validation performance — this reverses the mechanism.
Correct — since overfitting often shows up as training continues, early stopping uses validation as a brake and keeps the best round.
Early stopping happens during training, unrelated to whether the model is already deployed.
q_en: What is the rule for early stopping?

termDefinitions.meaning: 验证表现连续若干轮不再改善时停止训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Early stopping stops training after validation performance fails to improve for several rounds.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练过程中保存的一份模型参数快照。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A checkpoint is a saved snapshot of model weights during training.

scenario: 深度模型训练中，training loss 持续下降，但 validation loss 开始上升。
q: 首批应该尝试的措施是？
why: training loss 降、validation loss 升是典型过拟合信号，应限制模型自由度或增加有效数据，而不是继续优化训练集。
why_en: Falling training loss with rising validation loss is a classic overfitting signal, so the fix is to constrain the model or add data, not keep optimizing on the training set.
whenOtherWins: 如果训练和验证表现都很差，那是欠拟合，应该增加容量、特征或改善优化过程。
tradeoff: 过拟合减容量/加正则 vs 欠拟合加容量/加特征
options: early stopping、L2/dropout、减少容量或增加数据
继续把训练一直做到训练集 loss 降到接近 0
干脆把验证集直接并入训练集后重新报告指标
直接删掉现在已经配置好的所有正则化设置
options_en: Early stopping, L2/dropout, reducing capacity, or adding more data.
Keep training all the way until training loss drops to nearly 0.
Just merge the validation set straight into training and re-report the metric.
Simply remove every regularization setting that's already configured.
optionExplanations: 对；这套组合拳都在收紧模型的自由度或补充有效信号。
继续训练到 loss 为 0 只会让模型更贴近训练噪声，验证表现只会更差。
并入验证集会让评估指标失去意义，看不出真实泛化能力。
过拟合信号出现时删正则化，方向完全相反，会让问题更严重。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — this is a classic overfitting signal, so limit model freedom (early stop, regularize, cut capacity) or add data.
Training loss to 0 just fits more training noise, making validation performance worse.
Merging validation into training makes the metric meaningless for judging real generalization.
Removing regularization when overfitting appears goes the wrong direction and makes it worse.
q_en: What fixes should you try first?
scenario_en: During deep-model training, training loss keeps falling while validation loss starts rising.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型在训练集上的误差，下降说明更贴合训练样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training loss is the error on the training set; falling loss means tighter fit to training examples.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型在留出验证集上的误差，用来观察泛化趋势。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Validation loss is the error on held-out validation data, used to watch generalization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时随机关闭神经元，降低过拟合风险的正则化方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dropout randomly disables neurons during training to reduce overfitting risk.

q: 按正确顺序排查一个模型上线前是否泛化。
why: 先保证验证集代表真实未来，再看曲线和切片，最后设计上线后的漂移闭环；否则离线好看也可能无意义。
why_en: Generalization assessment starts with the right validation split, then curves and slices, then production drift monitoring.
steps: 检查训练/验证曲线
确认验证切分是否符合部署时间和实体边界
对关键切片做评估
制定漂移监控和重训计划

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数据按关键维度分组分别评估模型表现，而不只看整体平均值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Slice evaluation checks model performance separately across key data segments instead of only the overall average.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持续跟踪预测、特征和真实表现，及时发现数据分布变化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Drift monitoring continuously tracks predictions, features, and real performance to catch distribution changes early.

q_en: Put the pre-launch generalization checks in the right order.
tradeoff: 先做可信离线评估 vs 上线后才发现分布不匹配
whenOtherWins: 如果模型已经上线并出现事故，应先止血和回滚，再补完整离线排查链。

q: 小数据高容量任务的合理建模顺序是什么？
why: 先有便宜基线，再用迁移学习提升上限，增强数据覆盖，并明确避免容量远超数据的方案。
why_en: For small data, start with a simple baseline, use transfer learning, add valid augmentation, and avoid huge from-scratch models.
steps: 从简单 baseline 建尺子
从预训练模型迁移或冻结部分层
必要时做 label-preserving augmentation
避免从零训练巨大模型

termDefinitions.meaning: 简单、容量低、用来当比较基准的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A baseline is a simple, low-capacity model used as a comparison point.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对样本做变换但不改变其真实标签的数据增强方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Label-preserving augmentation transforms a sample without changing its true label.

q_en: What is a reasonable modeling order for a small-data, high-capacity task?
tradeoff: 先建低容量基线和迁移学习 vs 直接从零训练大模型
whenOtherWins: 如果你有海量高质量标注数据和算力，从零训练大模型才可能值得讨论。

scenario: 你要向面试官说明如何用验证集防止模型继续过拟合。
q: 这段伪代码实现的是什么策略？
why: 验证集不再改善时停止训练，并保留最佳 checkpoint，避免后续 epoch 只是在记训练噪声。
why_en: The code implements early stopping: it halts training once validation loss fails to improve for N checks and keeps the best checkpoint.
codeSample:
if val_loss < best:
    best = val_loss
    save_checkpoint()   # keep best-performing weights
    patience = 0
else:
    patience += 1        # no improvement this round
if patience >= N:       # N = allowed rounds without improving
    stop_training()
whenOtherWins: 如果训练还没收敛且验证集也在同步改善，就不该提前停止。
tradeoff: 验证不再改善就停 vs 继续训练可能只是拟合训练噪声
options: 数据泄漏检测
哈希 trick 特征编码
矩阵分解降维
Early stopping
options_en: Data-leakage detection.
The hashing-trick feature encoding.
Matrix-factorization dimensionality reduction.
Early stopping.
optionExplanations: 泄漏检测要查特征和标签的时间/信息穿越问题，跟这段监控 val_loss 的代码无关。
哈希 trick 是把类别特征映射进固定维度，代码里完全没有特征编码逻辑。
矩阵分解用于降维或推荐，跟这里监控验证 loss 停止训练无关。
对；代码里的 patience 计数器和 checkpoint 保存正是这套机制的标志。
optionExplanations_en: Leakage detection checks for time or information leakage between features and labels — unrelated to this val_loss loop.
The hashing trick maps categorical features into a fixed size; there's no feature encoding here.
Matrix factorization is for dimensionality reduction or recommendations, unrelated to halting on validation loss.
Correct — training stops once validation loss fails to improve for `patience` rounds, keeping the best checkpoint.
q_en: What strategy does this pseudocode implement?
scenario_en: You need to explain to an interviewer how to use a validation set to stop a model from overfitting further.

termDefinitions.meaning: 验证 loss 不再改善时停止训练，避免继续记训练噪声。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Early stopping halts training when validation loss stops improving to avoid memorizing training noise.

termDefinitions.meaning: 允许验证表现连续多少轮不改善后再停止的阈值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Patience is the number of validation checks allowed without improvement before stopping.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练中保存的最佳模型参数快照。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A checkpoint is a saved snapshot of the best model weights during training.

q: 以下哪些是常见的泛化 / 防过拟合技术？（多选）
why: 前三者都在训练阶段限制或监控模型；把测试集用于调参会让最终评估失去意义。
why_en: The first three techniques constrain or monitor training, while tuning on the test set contaminates the one set meant to measure true generalization.
options: L2/weight decay
Dropout
Early stopping
把测试集直接用于调参
options_en: L2 / weight decay.
Dropout.
Early stopping.
Tuning hyperparameters directly on the test set.
optionExplanations: 对；L2 惩罚大权重，限制模型自由度，是最常用的默认正则化。
对；dropout 训练时随机关闭神经元，迫使模型学冗余稳健表示。
对；验证表现不再改善就停止训练，防止继续记忆训练噪声。
错；这样会让测试集失去评估真实泛化能力的作用，污染最终结果。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — L2 penalizes large weights, constraining the model; it's the most common default regularizer.
Correct — dropout randomly disables neurons during training, forcing redundant robust representations.
Correct — training stops once validation performance stops improving, preventing further memorization.
Incorrect — tuning on the test set contaminates it, so it no longer measures true generalization.
q_en: Which are common generalization or anti-overfitting techniques? Select all that apply.

termDefinitions.meaning: 惩罚大权重，让模型更难依赖单一特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: L2, or weight decay, penalizes large weights so the model relies less on any single feature.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时随机关闭神经元，迫使表示更冗余。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dropout randomly disables neurons during training, forcing more redundant representations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 验证表现不再改善时停止训练，避免继续过拟合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Early stopping halts training when validation performance stops improving to avoid further overfitting.

q: 模型在 notebook 里表现很好，上线却严重掉线，除了过拟合还该怀疑什么？
why: 现实泛化失败不只看曲线，常见是离线评估没有模拟线上可用信息和未来分布，需要从数据管道和评估设计排查。
why_en: A large offline-to-online gap often means the offline evaluation didn't simulate what's actually available and the future distribution in production.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Offline[Good offline] --> Online[Bad online]
  Online --> Leakage[Check leakage]
  Online --> Skew[Check train serve skew]
  Online --> Drift[Check drift]
  Online --> Split[Check split]
options: 这一定是前端 CSS 样式出了问题
数据泄漏、train/serve skew、漂移或验证切分错误
模型参数太少导致训练集表现意外太好
线上真实用户的行为完全不影响模型
options_en: It must be a front-end CSS styling bug.
Data leakage, train/serve skew, drift, or an invalid validation split.
Too few parameters made training performance surprisingly good.
Real online user behavior has no effect on the model at all.
optionExplanations: 离线线上差距是数据和评估层面的问题，跟前端样式无关。
对；这些都会让离线评估看起来很好，却没有真实反映线上会遇到的情况。
参数太少通常导致欠拟合，训练集表现本身就不会太好，这条不成立。
线上用户行为正是模型要预测和服务的对象，怎么会毫无影响。
optionExplanations_en: The offline-online gap is a data and evaluation problem, unrelated to front-end styling.
Correct — these can all make offline evaluation look good while failing to reflect what production actually sees.
Too few parameters usually causes underfitting, so training performance wouldn't look great in the first place.
Online user behavior is exactly what the model predicts and serves, so it can't be irrelevant.
q_en: If a model works in a notebook but fails online, what else should you suspect besides overfitting?

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练或验证时用到了真实上线时不可用的信息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data leakage means training or validation uses information that would not be available at serving time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时的特征生成或数据处理逻辑和线上服务时不一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Train/serve skew means feature generation or data processing differs between training and production serving.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上输入、标签比例或特征到标签关系随时间变化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Drift means production inputs, label rates, or the feature-to-label relationship change over time.

scenario: 高风险模型遇到明显 drift，且模型置信度低，一旦出错代价很大。
q: 可以加入的补救路径是什么？
why: 人工审核能控制高风险错误，并把当前分布的标签反馈进训练；代价是增加成本和延迟。
why_en: Human-in-the-loop review can handle uncertain, high-risk cases while producing fresh labels that reflect the current distribution.
whenOtherWins: 低风险、高吞吐、错误成本低的场景可以更多依赖自动阈值和监控。
tradeoff: 人工审核保证准确 vs 自动化保证吞吐和速度
options: 系统强制让所有样本都自动通过检查
干脆把所有相关的监控都直接关掉
引入 human-in-the-loop 审核，产出新鲜标签
只盯着训练 loss，不看其他任何信号
options_en: Force the system to auto-approve every single sample.
Just turn off every piece of related monitoring.
Add human-in-the-loop review to produce fresh labels.
Only watch training loss and ignore every other signal.
optionExplanations: 自动全部通过恰恰放大了高代价错误的风险，方向反了。
关闭监控会让漂移和错误更难被发现，风险更大。
对；人工审核能兜住低置信度的高风险样本，还能产出反映当前分布的新标签。
训练 loss 只反映历史数据，看不出线上置信度低、代价大的实时问题。
optionExplanations_en: Auto-approving everything actually amplifies the risk of costly errors — the wrong direction.
Turning off monitoring makes drift and errors harder to catch, increasing risk.
Correct — human review catches low-confidence, high-risk cases and produces fresh labels reflecting the current distribution.
Training loss only reflects historical data and can't reveal today's low-confidence, high-cost cases.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让人工审核参与到模型决策或标注流程中的机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Human-in-the-loop is a workflow where a person reviews or labels cases alongside the model's predictions.

q_en: What remediation path can you add?
scenario_en: A high-risk model sees clear drift, has low confidence, and mistakes are expensive.

scenario: 面试官只说了一句“设计一个 ML 系统”，45 分钟内你要展示解决问题的能力。
scenario_en: The interviewer only says, "design an ML system," and you have 45 minutes to show structured problem solving.
q: 为什么要按 framing→data→model→eval→deep dive 顺序推进，而不是先讲模型架构？
q_en: Why follow framing, data, model, evaluation, and deep dives instead of starting with model architecture?
options: 先定业务/ML 目标和数据，模型选择才有依据
顺序不重要，模型细节最能得分
应该跳过数据讨论直接调超参
应该把全部时间留给一个深挖话题
options_en: Nail the objective and data first so model choices are grounded.
Order does not matter; model details earn the most credit.
Skip the data discussion and go straight to tuning hyperparameters.
Spend all your time on a single deep dive.
why: 模型选择依赖数据和目标先确定，倒着讲会让评审觉得你在猜测而不是推导。
why_en: Framing and data must come before modeling because model choices should be derived from the objective, not guessed first.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Frame[Frame] --> Data[Data]
  Data --> Model[Model]
  Model --> Eval[Eval]
  Eval --> DeepDive[Deep dive]
optionMeanings: 把目标和数据放在模型前面讨论
认为讨论顺序无关紧要
跳过数据环节直接调参
把全部时间给单个深挖话题
optionScenarioImpacts: 后续模型选择有理有据，推导链条完整
会让评审觉得设计是拍脑袋的
看不出你如何处理训练数据和标签
framing、数据、模型讨论时间被挤没
optionDirectness: 当目标和数据还没确定时，应先建立推导前提
只有纯模型架构面试才适合把模型细节放在开头
只有数据已明确且题目只考训练细节时，调参才会提前
深挖适合放在主链路讲完、剩余时间聚焦难点时
optionMeanings_en: Discuss the objective and data before model choice.
Treat the order as unimportant.
Skip data and go straight to tuning.
Spend the whole interview on one deep dive.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Model choices have a clear reasoning chain.
The design looks guessed instead of derived.
Training data and labels never get examined.
Framing, data, and model discussion get crowded out.
optionDirectness_en: When objective and data are unclear, establish the premise first.
Model details belong first only in a pure architecture prompt.
Tuning comes early only when the data problem is already fixed.
Deep dives fit after the main design chain is complete.

termDefinitions.meaning: 面试后段针对某个具体技术难点做的深入讨论环节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A deep dive is the later interview segment focused on one specific hard part of the design.

scenario: 面试题是“设计电商推荐系统”，没有给候选池规模、展示位置、延迟这些约束。
scenario_en: The prompt is "design an e-commerce recommender," but candidate pool size, placement, and latency are not specified.
q: 开场该先做什么，才不会设计错方向？
q_en: What should you do first so you do not design in the wrong direction?
options: 直接开始画 Transformer 架构图
问清候选池规模、展示位置和延迟要求
只承诺“我们用 Redis 做缓存”
拒绝做任何假设，等面试官喂条件
options_en: Jump straight into drawing a Transformer architecture.
Ask about candidate pool size, placement, and latency requirements.
Commit only to "we'll use Redis for caching."
Refuse to make any assumption and wait to be spoon-fed constraints.
why: 候选池规模和展示位置决定召回和 serving 架构；没澄清就容易设计错问题。
why_en: Targeted clarification questions define the actual ML problem and prevent solving the wrong scope.
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官说“你自己假设”，就明确列出假设并继续推进。
tradeoff: 澄清关键约束 vs 假设默认值快速推进
optionMeanings: 跳过约束直接给出架构方案
把规模、位置、延迟三个约束问清楚
把方案过早锁死在单一技术选型上
完全不做任何假设就推进
optionScenarioImpacts: 可能设计出与真实规模不匹配的模型
后续架构选择才有明确依据
没有约束支撑就下结论，显得武断
面试会卡住，没法继续往前推进
optionDirectness: 当约束已经给全时，才适合开始画具体架构
缺候选池、展示位置和延迟时，先澄清这些变量
缓存只适合在读压力或重复请求成为瓶颈后讨论
面试官要求自设假设时，可以声明假设后继续推进
optionMeanings_en: Skip constraints and start with architecture.
Clarify scale, placement, and latency.
Lock the answer onto one technology too early.
Refuse to move without supplied constraints.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The model may not match the real scale.
Later architecture choices have a basis.
The answer sounds premature and unsupported.
The interview stalls instead of progressing.
optionDirectness_en: Architecture comes after the key constraints are known.
Missing pool size, placement, and latency should be clarified first.
Caching matters later when read pressure or repeated requests dominate.
If asked to assume, state assumptions and keep moving.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种基于自注意力机制的神经网络架构，常用于序列建模。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Transformer is a neural network architecture built on self-attention, commonly used for sequence modeling.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的内存型缓存/键值存储服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis is an in-memory key-value store commonly used as a cache.

scenario: 某内容审核系统的 KPI 是“减少违规曝光”，训练时模型只优化一个分类 loss。
scenario_en: A content moderation system's KPI is reducing harmful exposure, but training only optimizes a classification loss.
q: 业务目标和 ML loss 之间是什么关系？
q_en: How should you relate the business objective to the ML loss?
options: 两者永远完全等价
业务目标只写给产品经理看，不影响建模
业务目标是最终价值，ML loss 只是训练用的代理指标
ML loss 的取值不会反过来影响业务结果
options_en: The two are always exactly equivalent.
The business objective is only for product managers and doesn't shape modeling.
The business objective is the real value; ML loss is only a training proxy.
The ML loss value never feeds back into business outcomes.
why: 真实系统优化的是留存、收入或风险，loss 只是训练模型的近似目标。
why_en: The business objective is the real value to optimize, while the ML loss is only a training proxy.
tradeoff: 业务目标（留存/收入/风险） vs ML loss（训练可优化的近似指标）
optionMeanings: 假设两者可以互相替代
把业务目标当成与建模无关的文档
区分最终价值和训练代理
否认 loss 与业务结果之间的因果链
optionScenarioImpacts: 会把 loss 下降误当成业务变好
建模时会失去优化方向
能看穿指标提升但业务变差的陷阱
忽视 loss 设计对业务的实际影响
optionDirectness: 只有目标刚好被 loss 完整表达时，两者才近似等价
业务目标必须进入建模取舍，否则模型会优化错方向
当训练指标只是可优化近似值时，要保留这层区分
loss 会通过模型决策影响业务结果，不能当成无关数值
optionMeanings_en: Assume the two are interchangeable.
Treat the business goal as irrelevant documentation.
Separate final value from the training proxy.
Deny the link between loss and business outcomes.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: A lower loss may be mistaken for business success.
Modeling loses its optimization direction.
You can catch metric gains that hurt the business.
You miss how loss design changes product behavior.
optionDirectness_en: They are equivalent only when the loss fully captures the goal.
Business goals must shape modeling tradeoffs.
Keep the distinction when the training metric is only a proxy.
Loss affects model decisions, so it is not isolated from business impact.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时用来衡量模型预测与目标差距、并据此更新参数的函数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A loss function measures how far predictions are from the target and drives parameter updates during training.

scenario: 有害内容系统把“删除内容总量最大化”定为唯一业务目标。
scenario_en: A harmful-content system defines its only business goal as maximizing the total number of removed items.
q: 这个目标设计有什么问题？
q_en: What is wrong with this objective design?
options: 会自动把误删率降到零
会自动提升用户满意度
会让人工审核完全消失
会鼓励过度删除，伤害合法用户和表达自由
options_en: It automatically drives false positives to zero.
It automatically raises user satisfaction.
It makes human review disappear entirely.
It rewards over-removal and harms legitimate users' expression.
why: 只追求删除量会忽略误删成本，和用户表达自由、留存相冲突。
why_en: Maximizing removals alone creates perverse incentives by ignoring false positives and legitimate-user harm.
whenOtherWins: 若内容明确非法且已人工确认，删除量可作为执行指标，而非唯一目标。
tradeoff: 删除量（执行效率） vs 误删代价（合法用户体验）
optionMeanings: 误以为目标越极端误删越少
误以为删除量和满意度天然正相关

optionDirectness_en: For structured, latency-sensitive features, LR or GBDT is a cheap starting point.
Large models fit when semantic inputs and budget are strong enough.
Random ranking is only a sanity check, not a learnable baseline.
Manual rules fit a few clear patterns, not long-tail coverage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 梯度提升决策树，一种在表格数据上常用且训练快的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GBDT, gradient boosted decision trees, is a model family that trains quickly and works well on tabular data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种输出概率的线性分类模型，可解释性强。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Logistic regression is a linear classifier that outputs probabilities and is easy to interpret.

scenario: 你要在结构化特征上比较“经典模型”和“深度学习模型”两条路线。
scenario_en: You need to compare classic models and deep learning models on structured features.
q: Model Selection 讨论应该覆盖哪些维度？
q_en: Which dimensions should the model selection discussion cover?
options: 只报出最新一篇论文的名字
比较模型家族的质量成本延迟权衡
只说一句用深度学习就行
只讨论数据库该选哪种类型
options_en: Just name-drop the newest paper you read.
Compare model families on quality, cost, and latency trade-offs.
Just say "use deep learning" and stop there.
Just discuss which database to pick.
why: 面试官要看你能在约束下选模型，而不是盲目追求复杂。
why_en: Model selection should compare families on quality, cost, latency, interpretability, and operational complexity.
tradeoff: 质量/复杂度 vs 成本/延迟/可解释性
optionMeanings: 把选型简化成追新
系统比较模型家族的多个维度
把选型简化成一句口号
把讨论转移到存储层
optionScenarioImpacts: 不能证明方案适配约束
能说明为什么选某一家族而非另一个
没有给出可验证的取舍依据
偏离了模型选择这个问题本身
optionDirectness: 新论文只在约束和数据形态匹配时才有说服力
模型选型应按质量、成本、延迟和可解释性比较
深度学习可作为候选，但需要说明为什么值得
数据库选择只在服务路径约束模型形态时才相关
optionMeanings_en: Reduce selection to name-dropping a new paper.
Compare model families across real tradeoff dimensions.
Reduce selection to a slogan.
Move the discussion to storage.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It does not prove fit to the constraints.
It explains why one family beats another here.
It gives no verifiable tradeoff reasoning.
It leaves the model-selection question unanswered.
optionDirectness_en: A new paper helps only when it matches the constraints and data shape.
Model selection should compare quality, cost, latency, and interpretability.
Deep learning can be a candidate, but it needs justification.
Database choice matters only if the serving path constrains model shape.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户塔和物品塔分别编码，再计算相似度的推荐模型架构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A two-tower model encodes users and items in separate towers and scores them by similarity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在向量空间快速查找最相似候选的近似算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN, approximate nearest neighbor search, quickly finds the most similar candidates in vector space.

scenario: 你直接提出训练一个超大模型，但数据少、延迟预算紧。
scenario_en: You propose training a very large model, but data is limited and the latency budget is tight.
q: 面试官最可能担心什么？
q_en: What is the interviewer most likely worried about?
options: 模型太可解释
baseline 太强，没必要建模
过拟合、训练/serving 成本不可行
标签成本太低
options_en: The model is too interpretable.
The baseline is too strong to bother modeling.
Overfitting and infeasible training/serving cost.
Labels are too cheap to obtain.
why: 复杂模型必须用数据量、质量收益和推理预算支撑，否则显得没有生产经验。
why_en: A large model needs justification through data scale, quality gain, and serving budget.
tradeoff: 模型容量/质量上限 vs 数据量、训练成本、serving 可行性
optionMeanings: 把可解释性错当成一个风险
把基线强度错当成拒绝理由
指出容量与数据/预算不匹配的风险
把标签成本低错当成问题
optionScenarioImpacts: 可解释性从不是这里的风险来源
baseline 强弱和当前风险无关
点出这套方案在当前约束下不可行
标签成本高低不是本题焦点
optionDirectness: 可解释性高通常降低排查成本，不是这里的主要风险
baseline 强只说明门槛高，不解释大模型为何危险
数据少且延迟紧时，大模型最容易卡在泛化和 serving 上
标签成本低通常是优势，且场景没有给这个约束
optionMeanings_en: Mistake interpretability for the risk.
Mistake baseline strength for the concern.
Point to capacity, data, and budget mismatch.
Mistake cheap labels for a problem.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Interpretability is not the source of risk here.
Baseline strength does not explain the current risk.
The proposed model is not feasible under the constraints.
Label cost is not the focus of this prompt.
optionDirectness_en: High interpretability usually lowers debugging cost here.
A strong baseline raises the bar but does not explain large-model risk.
With little data and tight latency, large models strain generalization and serving.
Cheap labels are usually helpful, and the prompt does not mention them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型记住训练数据细节，泛化到新数据时表现变差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Overfitting is when a model memorizes training data details and generalizes poorly to new data.

scenario: 你提出一个双塔排序模型，面试官追问架构细节。
scenario_en: You propose a two-tower ranking model, and the interviewer asks for architecture details.
q: “穿针引线”式回答架构细节是什么意思？
q_en: What does a balanced architecture-detail answer look like?
options: 直接断言“4 层 1024 维一定最优”
完全跳过 loss 设计不谈
只画云基础设施部署架构图
给出输入、层结构、loss、正则，但不编精确超参
options_en: Flatly claim "4 layers of 1024 is always optimal."
Skip explaining the loss design entirely.
Only draw the cloud deployment infrastructure diagram.
Describe the input, layers, loss, and regularization without inventing exact hyperparameters.
why: 要说明结构关键点，但不假装已知只有实验能定的精确宽度。
why_en: Architecture discussion should be detailed enough to show understanding without pretending empirical hyperparameters are known.
optionMeanings: 把未经验证的超参说成必然最优
跳过 loss 这个关键设计点
把讨论换成基础设施图
给结构细节但承认超参需要实验
optionScenarioImpacts: 会被追问细节时露出破绽
面试官无法判断你是否懂模型
答非所问，没有回应架构问题
既显示理解又保持诚实
optionDirectness: 精确层数和维度需要实验验证，不能提前断言最优
loss 连接训练目标和模型行为，架构回答里要交代
云部署图适合 serving 讨论，不回答模型内部结构
被追问架构时，应讲关键结构并承认超参需实验
optionMeanings_en: Claim untested hyperparameters are optimal.
Skip the loss design.
Switch the topic to cloud infrastructure.
Give structure details without inventing exact hyperparameters.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The claim breaks under follow-up questions.
The interviewer cannot tell if you understand the model.
It does not answer the architecture question.
It shows understanding while staying honest.
optionDirectness_en: Exact layers and widths need experiments, not early certainty.
Loss connects the training goal to behavior, so include it.
Cloud diagrams fit serving discussions, not model internals.
When asked for architecture, cover key structure and flag hyperparameters as empirical.

termDefinitions.meaning: 限制模型复杂度以降低过拟合风险的技术，如 dropout、L2。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Regularization limits model complexity to reduce overfitting risk, such as dropout or an L2 penalty.

scenario: 模型训练完成，你要说明如何上线和评估它。
scenario_en: The model is trained, and you need to explain how to serve and evaluate it.
q: Inference and Evaluation 阶段要覆盖哪两类内容？
q_en: What two kinds of topics should inference and evaluation cover?
options: 离线/在线指标，加延迟成本扩展约束
只反复检查训练阶段的代码
只讨论候选人的简历背景
只关心前端界面的视觉设计
options_en: Offline/online metrics plus latency, cost, and scale constraints.
Only re-check the training-stage code.
Only discuss the candidate's resume background.
Only care about frontend visual design.
why: 应用 ML 成功不仅看模型分数，还要能在 SLA 内服务并改善业务。
why_en: Inference and evaluation cover both metrics and the practical serving constraints such as latency, cost, and scale.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Offline[Offline metrics] --> Gate[Launch gate]
  Online[Online metrics] --> Gate
  Serving[Latency cost scale] --> Gate
  Gate --> Iterate[Iterate]
optionMeanings: 同时覆盖评估指标和推理约束
只关心训练阶段的代码
把话题转到无关的招聘环节
把话题转到界面设计
optionScenarioImpacts: 能判断模型是否真的可以上线
看不出模型能否满足 SLA
候选人简历和上线评估无关
界面视觉和上线评估无关
optionDirectness: 上线前要同时看指标效果和 serving 约束
训练代码检查适合研发流程，不等于上线评估
简历背景和模型是否可上线无关
前端视觉只在实验目标涉及 UI 时才相关
optionMeanings_en: Cover metrics and serving constraints together.
Only inspect training code again.
Move to an unrelated hiring topic.
Move to frontend visual design.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: You can decide whether the model is launchable.
You cannot tell whether serving meets the SLA.
The resume has no bearing on launch evaluation.
Visual design is unrelated to launch evaluation.
optionDirectness_en: Before launch, check both metric impact and serving constraints.
Training-code review is an engineering process, not launch evaluation.
Resume background is unrelated to whether the model can ship.
Frontend visuals matter only when the experiment target involves UI.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过 A/B 实验衡量模型对真实用户业务指标的影响。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Online evaluation measures a model's real impact on business metrics through an A/B experiment.

scenario: 推荐模型离线 NDCG 提升了，但线上用户留存下降。
scenario_en: A recommender improves offline NDCG, but online user retention drops.
q: 这组结果说明了什么问题？
q_en: What problem do these results reveal?
options: NDCG 的计算方式一定算错了
离线 ML 指标和业务目标没有完全对齐
留存下降不重要，可以忽略
模型完全不需要调整
options_en: The NDCG calculation must be wrong.
The offline ML metric and the business objective are not fully aligned.
The retention drop doesn't matter and can be ignored.
The model needs no adjustment at all.
why: 离线排序指标只是代理，可能鼓励短期点击而伤害长期满意度。
why_en: A metric gain with worse retention indicates offline ML metrics are not fully aligned with business objectives.
whenOtherWins: 如果留存下降来自无关的外部事件，需要用实验切片排除混杂因素。
tradeoff: 离线代理指标（NDCG） vs 线上业务目标（留存）
optionMeanings: 把结果归咎于计算错误
把两个指标的错位当成信号
把业务信号当成可忽略项
认为当前结果不需要任何行动
optionScenarioImpacts: 掩盖了指标错位这个真正问题
会推动你回去检查目标设计
会让业务持续受损而不自知
错过了修正模型或指标的机会
optionDirectness: 只有复现发现公式或日志有误时，才先归因计算错误
离线指标上涨但业务下跌时，应怀疑目标未对齐
留存是业务目标信号，不能因离线分数好就忽略
指标互相矛盾时，至少要切片分析或调整目标
optionMeanings_en: Blame the result on a metric bug.
Treat the metric mismatch as the signal.
Ignore the business signal.
Assume no model change is needed.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It hides the real alignment problem.
It pushes you to inspect the objective design.
The business can keep getting worse.
You miss a chance to fix the model or metric.
optionDirectness_en: Blame calculation only after reproduction shows a formula or logging bug.
When offline goes up and business goes down, suspect objective mismatch.
Retention is a business signal and cannot be ignored for a better offline score.
Contradictory metrics call for slicing or objective changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量排序结果质量、并对靠后位置做折扣的离线指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG is an offline ranking metric that discounts the value of correct results appearing lower in the list.

scenario: 推理阶段的延迟和成本约束很紧，你要挑选优化手段。
scenario_en: Inference latency and cost constraints are tight, and you need to choose optimization techniques.
q: 推理约束紧时可以讨论哪些优化？（多选）
q_en: Which optimizations are worth discussing when inference constraints are tight? (Select all that apply.)
options: 缓存
量化
蒸馏
剪枝
options_en: Caching
Quantization
Distillation
Pruning
why: 这些方法用不同方式降低成本或延迟，但都要以质量回归监控为前提。
why_en: Caching, quantization, distillation, and pruning are common inference optimizations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把模型权重用更低精度表示以降低计算和内存开销。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Quantization represents model weights with lower precision to cut compute and memory cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一个大模型（teacher）的输出训练一个更小的模型（student）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distillation trains a smaller student model to mimic a larger teacher model's outputs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 删除模型中冗余的权重或连接以减少计算量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pruning removes redundant weights or connections from a model to reduce computation.

scenario: 你想给一个低 QPS 的离线批处理任务做复杂量化和蒸馏。
scenario_en: You want to apply complex quantization and distillation to a low-QPS offline batch job.
q: 面试里更合理的取舍是什么？
q_en: What is the more reasonable tradeoff in the interview?
options: 默认所有模型都必须量化
直接忽略质量回归评估
先确认是否真受推理成本或延迟约束
把批处理硬改成实时服务
options_en: Assume every model must be quantized by default.
Skip quality-regression evaluation entirely.
Confirm whether cost or latency is actually the constraint.
Force the batch job into a real-time service.
why: 优化应服务约束，离线低频任务可能更该保质量和可维护性。
why_en: Inference optimizations should be justified by actual latency, cost, or throughput constraints.
whenOtherWins: 若批处理成本巨大或时间窗口很短，量化/蒸馏仍然值得做。
tradeoff: 推理优化收益 vs 额外复杂度和维护成本
optionMeanings: 把优化当成不看约束的默认动作
把优化的质量代价视而不见
先验证约束是否存在再决定优化
把架构形态和约束需求搞反
optionScenarioImpacts: 低 QPS 场景白白付出维护成本
可能悄悄引入质量回归
避免为不存在的约束增加复杂度
实时化和场景本身的批处理性质冲突
optionDirectness: 量化适合成本或延迟真是瓶颈的模型
任何有损优化上线前都要检查质量回归
低 QPS 离线任务应先确认优化收益是否大于复杂度
实时化只在产品需要低延迟响应时才成立
optionMeanings_en: Make optimization the default action.
Ignore the quality cost of optimization.
Check whether the constraint actually exists.
Force the architecture into a real-time shape.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The low-QPS job pays needless maintenance cost.
A quality regression can slip in silently.
You avoid complexity for a nonexistent constraint.
The design conflicts with the batch nature of the task.
optionDirectness_en: Quantization fits when cost or latency is truly the bottleneck.
Any lossy optimization needs quality-regression checks before launch.
For low-QPS batch jobs, verify the benefit beats the complexity.
Real-time serving only fits when the product needs low-latency responses.

scenario: 设计进入 Deep Dives 阶段，系统里有冷启动、反馈循环、扩展性等潜在难点。
scenario_en: The design reaches deep dives, and the system has hard parts such as cold start, feedback loops, and scaling.
q: 这一阶段该如何选择要讲的内容？
q_en: How should you choose what to cover in this stage?
options: 不管问题是什么都讲自己最熟的强化学习
退回问题澄清阶段重新开始
回避承认设计里任何潜在风险
跟随面试官，或主动列出系统真正的技术难点供选择
options_en: Talk about your favorite reinforcement-learning topic regardless of fit.
Go back and restart the problem-clarification stage.
Avoid admitting any potential risk in the design.
Follow the interviewer, or proactively list the design's real hard parts to choose from.
why: 深挖用于展示特定领域深度，要聚焦系统真正的技术难点。
why_en: Deep dives should focus on the most relevant hard parts, either interviewer-driven or clearly offered as options.
optionMeanings: 把话题硬拉回自己偏好的领域
把已完成的阶段重新推倒
对设计里的风险避而不谈
把难点列成菜单交给面试官选
optionScenarioImpacts: 可能完全偏离这道题的核心难点
浪费本该用于深挖的剩余时间
让面试官怀疑你没意识到风险
深挖内容始终贴合这个系统
optionDirectness: 熟悉话题只有贴合本系统难点时才值得展开
澄清已完成后，应把时间用于具体难点
承认风险并给缓解方案，比回避风险更有说服力
深挖阶段适合围绕冷启动、反馈循环或扩展性展开
optionMeanings_en: Drag the discussion to your favorite area.
Restart the already-finished framing stage.
Avoid naming risks in the design.
Offer the system's real hard parts as a menu.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The topic may miss the system's core difficulty.
It wastes the remaining deep-dive time.
The interviewer may think you missed the risks.
The deep dive stays tied to this system.
optionDirectness_en: A familiar topic is worth time only if it fits this system.
After framing is done, spend time on concrete hard parts.
Naming risks and mitigations is stronger than hiding them.
Deep dives fit cold start, feedback loops, or scaling in this prompt.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新用户或新物品缺乏历史数据，模型难以给出可靠预测的问题。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold start is the problem of making reliable predictions for new users or items that lack historical data.

scenario: 你在为一个推荐系统列出可深挖的方向。
scenario_en: You are listing possible deep-dive areas for a recommender system.
q: 常见 deep dive 主题包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: What are common deep-dive topics? (Select all that apply.)
options: 冷启动/边界案例
规模与 serving
监控和重训
无关 UI 动画
options_en: Cold start and edge cases
Scaling and serving
Monitoring and retraining
Unrelated UI animations
why: 这些主题直接影响生产可用性和长期质量。
why_en: Common ML design deep dives include cold start, scaling, monitoring, and retraining.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  DeepDive[Deep dive menu] --> Cold[Cold start]
  DeepDive --> Scale[Serving scale]
  DeepDive --> Monitor[Monitor retrain]

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上数据分布随时间变化，导致模型效果衰减。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Model drift is when the live data distribution shifts over time and model performance decays.

scenario: 面试官给你一个模糊的系统设计问题，你正要开场。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives you a vague system design prompt, and you are about to start.
q: Problem Framing 阶段的绿旗包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: What are green flags in the problem framing stage? (Select all that apply.)
options: 问到核心约束
建立清晰业务目标
给出可指导后续设计的 ML objective
跳过目标直接报模型
options_en: Asking about the core constraints
Establishing a clear business objective
Giving an ML objective that guides the rest of the design
Skipping the objective and jumping straight to a model
why: 开场要让后续所有选择有依据，跳过目标会暴露约束没对齐。
why_en: Good problem framing clarifies constraints, business objective, and ML objective before modeling.

scenario: 你在评估一段 Modeling 阶段的面试表现。
scenario_en: You are evaluating someone's performance in the modeling stage of an interview.
q: Modeling 阶段的红旗包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: What are red flags in the modeling stage? (Select all that apply.)
options: 不考虑 baseline 直接上复杂模型
模型架构完全手挥
不讨论 tradeoff
说明简单基线的作用
options_en: Jumping to a complex model without considering a baseline
Hand-waving the model architecture entirely
Never discussing trade-offs
Explaining what the simple baseline is for
why: 模型讨论要体现实践取舍和理解深度，baseline 本身不是红旗。
why_en: Modeling red flags include skipping baselines, hand-waving architecture, and ignoring tradeoffs.

q: 按推荐顺序排列 ML system design delivery framework。
q_en: Put the ML system design delivery framework in the recommended order.
why: 这个顺序先定义问题边界，再讨论数据、模型、上线评估，最后深挖，保证关键评估点都被覆盖。
why_en: The delivery framework moves from framing to high-level design, data, modeling, inference and evaluation, then deep dives.
tradeoff: 覆盖全部关键阶段 vs 在某一阶段停留过久
steps: Data and Features
Problem Framing
Inference and Evaluation
High-level Design
Modeling
Deep Dives

termDefinitions.meaning: 针对某个具体技术难点进行更细致讨论的阶段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A deep dive is a focused, detailed discussion of one specific hard part of the design.

q: 按正确顺序完成 Problem Framing。
q_en: Put the problem framing steps in the correct order.
why: 先知道问题边界，再定义业务价值，最后把它转成可建模任务。
why_en: Problem framing clarifies scope, establishes the business objective, and then defines the ML objective.
tradeoff: 先约束后目标 vs 先目标后约束
steps: 决定 ML objective
澄清范围和约束
建立业务目标

q: 按合理顺序展开 Modeling 讨论。
q_en: Put the modeling discussion steps in a reasonable order.

why_en: Model design weighs accuracy against cost, latency, and interpretability, and complexity is not automatically better.
optionMeanings: 综合多个约束做架构选择和取舍说明。
只看参数量，参数越大越好。
只写训练脚本，不讨论架构选择。
只关心模型的版本号。
optionScenarioImpacts: 能在多组件系统里说清楚各部分怎么配合。
更大模型不一定匹配延迟和成本约束。
跳过了面试真正想看的架构判断力。
版本号和设计能力无关。
optionDirectness: 适合模型设计；要同时说效果、成本、延迟和解释性。
只适合离线效果唯一目标的题；生产场景不能只看参数量。
适合实现任务；没有回答架构取舍。
适合发布管理事实题；不是模型设计核心。
optionMeanings_en: Balances multiple constraints when choosing architecture.
Only looks at parameter count, bigger is assumed better.
Only writes training scripts, skipping architecture talk.
Only cares about the model's version number.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Lets you explain how components fit together in a multi-part system.
A bigger model may not fit latency and cost constraints.
Skips the architecture judgment the interview wants to see.
Version numbers have nothing to do with design ability.
optionDirectness_en: Fits model design: discuss quality, cost, latency, and explainability together.
Only fits offline-quality-only tasks; production cannot optimize just size.
Fits implementation tasks, not architecture tradeoffs.
Fits release-management trivia, not the core of model design.

scenario: 你只做过推荐系统，现在被问到一个 fraud detection 的题目。
scenario_en: You have only worked on recommendation systems, and now the interviewer asks about fraud detection.
q: 为什么不应该用「我只做过推荐」自我设限？
q_en: Why should you not limit yourself by saying you only worked on recommendations?
options: 因为推荐经验在新领域完全不重要
因为面试官不会追问任何细节
因为面试看重能否把通用原则迁移到新场景
因为所有 ML 问题的解法其实都一样
options_en: Recommendation experience is completely irrelevant in a new domain.
Interviewers will not probe for any details.
Interviewers value whether you can transfer general principles to a new scenario.
Every ML problem actually has the same solution.
why: 强候选人会把数据、特征、评估、反馈循环等通用原则迁移到 fraud、moderation 等新场景，而不是止步于熟悉领域。
why_en: Strong candidates transfer general principles — data, features, evaluation, feedback loops — to unfamiliar domains instead of stopping at what they know.
optionMeanings: 认为推荐经验完全不重要。
认为面试官不会追问细节。
承认经验可以迁移到新场景。
认为所有 ML 问题解法一样。
optionScenarioImpacts: 过度否定经验，反而丢掉了可迁移的部分。
面试官通常会追问细节来判断理解深度。
能把数据、特征、评估等原则用到 fraud 场景。
忽略了不同问题在数据和风险上的差异。
optionDirectness: 只有经验完全不可迁移时才成立；ML 原则通常可迁移。
只在无追问面试中成立；真实面试会继续 probe。
适合陌生领域；用通用 ML 原则继续拆题。
只适合玩笑式概括；不同 ML 问题约束不同。
optionMeanings_en: Claims recommendation experience is entirely irrelevant.
Claims interviewers will not dig into details.
Acknowledges principles can transfer to new scenarios.
Claims every ML problem has the same solution.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Overcorrects and discards the transferable parts of your experience.
Interviewers usually do probe to gauge depth of understanding.
Lets you apply data, feature, and evaluation principles to fraud.
Ignores real differences in data and risk across problems.
optionDirectness_en: Only works if experience cannot transfer at all; ML principles usually do.
Only fits an interview with no probing; real interviews keep probing.
Fits unfamiliar domains: continue with transferable ML principles.
Only fits a joke-level simplification; ML problems have different constraints.

scenario: 你做过分类系统，但题目换成了推荐系统设计。
scenario_en: You have built classification systems, but the prompt is now a recommendation-system design.
q: 更好的开场表达是？
q_en: What is a better opening response?
options: 说明自己对细节不熟悉，但用已知原则继续推理
说自己完全不会，然后停止作答
把推荐问题强行当二分类处理，不解释理由
只反复讲过去做过的分类项目
options_en: State that you're unfamiliar with the details, then keep reasoning from transferable principles.
Say you don't know it at all and stop answering.
Force the recommendation problem into a binary classifier without explaining why.
Keep repeating the classification project you've already done.
why: 诚实说明边界、再用可迁移原则推理，能给面试官清楚的信号；不要让陌生领域打断结构化思考。
why_en: State your boundary honestly, then reason forward with transferable principles like supervision signals and serving constraints, instead of stalling.
whenOtherWins: 如果岗位明确要求推荐系统专家，还是要补齐排序、召回这类核心 recsys 概念。
tradeoff: 承认边界+通用原则推理 vs 假装熟悉却讲不出细节
optionMeanings: 先说明边界，再用可迁移原则继续推理。
说完全不会就停止推进。
不解释理由，硬套一个熟悉的框架。
只反复讲旧项目，不回应新题目。
optionScenarioImpacts: 既诚实又展示了结构化思考能力。
面试官拿不到任何推理过程可评估。
推荐和分类目标不同，硬套会漏掉关键约束。
没有回答题目真正要求的推荐设计。
optionDirectness: 适合陌生领域开场；承认边界后继续结构化推理。
只适合明确无法作答时；这里还可以迁移原则。
只有类比成立且能解释时才用；不能强行套。
适合经验复盘；没有回答当前推荐题。
optionMeanings_en: States the boundary, then keeps reasoning with transferable principles.
Says you don't know it and stops.
Forces a familiar framework without explaining why.
Keeps repeating an old project instead of addressing the new one.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Honest and still demonstrates structured reasoning.
Gives the interviewer no reasoning process to evaluate.
Recommendation and classification goals differ, so this misses key constraints.
Never actually answers what the recommendation prompt asks.
optionDirectness_en: Fits unfamiliar domains: state the boundary and keep reasoning.
Only fits when you truly cannot proceed; here you can transfer principles.
Use an analogy only when it holds and you can explain it.
Fits experience review, but does not answer the recommender prompt.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量排序结果质量的指标，例如 NDCG、precision@k。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A ranking metric measures the quality of an ordered list, such as NDCG or precision at k.

q: Integration and Evaluation 这个维度评估什么？
q_en: What does the Integration and Evaluation dimension assess?
options: 只看离线 notebook 里的评估分数
模型如何部署、监控、迭代，并设计合适评估
只看训练集上的准确率数字
只看数据表的数量和字段
options_en: Only the score shown in an offline notebook run.
How the model is deployed, monitored, iterated on, with a fitting evaluation design.
Only the accuracy number on the training set.
Only the number of columns in a data table.
why: 生产和 notebook 之间有很大差距：延迟、成本、漂移、实验设计、监控和回滚都要考虑。
why_en: There is a real gap between a notebook result and production, so this dimension covers deployment, monitoring, iteration, and evaluation design.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Train[Train] --> Deploy[Deploy]
  Deploy --> Monitor[Monitor]
  Monitor --> Evaluate[Evaluate]
  Evaluate --> Retrain[Retrain]
optionMeanings: 把评估重点放在离线 notebook 分数上。
把评估重点放在部署、监控、迭代和评估设计上。
把评估重点放在训练集准确率上。
把评估重点放在数据表数量上。
optionScenarioImpacts: notebook 分数不能证明生产价值。
正好覆盖从上线到迭代的完整闭环。
训练集准确率容易过拟合，不代表线上效果。
表数量和部署/监控能力无关。
optionDirectness: 适合离线研究验证；生产评估还要上线闭环。
适合生产 ML；要覆盖部署、监控、实验和迭代。
适合训练集 sanity check；不能代表线上效果。
适合 schema 讨论；不是集成评估主线。
optionMeanings_en: Focuses on an offline notebook score.
Focuses on deployment, monitoring, iteration, and evaluation design.
Focuses on training-set accuracy.
Focuses on the number of data tables.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: A notebook score cannot prove production value.
Covers the full loop from shipping to iterating.
Training accuracy can overfit and misrepresent live performance.
Table count is unrelated to deployment or monitoring.
optionDirectness_en: Fits offline research validation; production evaluation needs the launch loop too.
Fits production ML: deploy, monitor, experiment, and iterate.
Fits a training-set sanity check, not live impact.
Fits schema discussion, not integration and evaluation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上数据分布随时间偏离训练时的分布，导致模型效果下降。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Drift is when live data distribution shifts away from training data over time, degrading model performance.

scenario: 模型在 notebook 里的指标很好，但还没有上线、监控和 A/B 实验设计。
scenario_en: The model has strong notebook metrics, but there is no launch plan, monitoring, or A/B test design yet.
q: 面试官会认为这暴露了什么风险？
q_en: What risk would the interviewer see here?
options: 指标一定比上线后更可信
这个模型已经算完成了
完全不需要再做评估
无法证明它能在生产中真正产生业务价值
options_en: The metric is more trustworthy than it would be after launch.
The model is already considered done.
No further evaluation is needed.
It cannot prove the model will create real business value in production.
why: 应用型 ML 不是实验结束就算成功，还要服务、度量和迭代；缺这些会让方案停在 notebook 阶段。
why_en: Applied ML is not done when the experiment ends — without serving, monitoring, and evaluation design, you cannot prove production business value.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目明确只考研究验证，生产闭环这块的权重会降低。
tradeoff: notebook 里的离线指标 vs 生产环境的真实业务价值
optionMeanings: 假设离线指标比线上更可信。
假设完成实验就等于完成模型。
假设不需要额外的评估设计。
指出这暴露了生产价值无法验证的风险。
optionScenarioImpacts: 离线指标常常无法反映真实分布和延迟。
距离能上线服务真实用户还差一大截。
忽略评估会让业务方无法判断是否该上线。
没有监控和实验，业务价值无从验证。
optionDirectness: 只有线上数据同分布且无反馈偏差时才可能成立。
只适合研究原型完成；应用型系统还没完成。
只适合一次性离线比较；生产方案仍要评估。
适合应用型面试；缺上线闭环就无法证明业务价值。
optionMeanings_en: Assumes the offline metric is more trustworthy than a live one.
Assumes finishing the experiment means the model is done.
Assumes no extra evaluation design is needed.
Names the risk that production value is unproven.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Offline metrics often fail to reflect real distribution and latency.
There is still a big gap before it serves real users.
Skipping evaluation leaves the business unable to judge launch readiness.
Without monitoring or experiments, business value stays unverified.
optionDirectness_en: Only might hold if live data matches offline data with no feedback bias.
Fits a research prototype, not a finished applied system.
Fits one-off offline comparisons; production still needs evaluation.
Fits applied interviews: without a launch loop, business value is unproven.

q: 沟通能力为什么是所有 ML 面试的隐含评估项？
q_en: Why is communication an implicit evaluation in every ML interview?
options: 因为沟通只影响回答的语速快慢
因为答案本身是固定的，不需要交流
因为系统设计要协作解决模糊问题，需对齐假设取舍
因为完全不需要听面试官的追问
options_en: Communication only affects how fast you talk.
The answer itself is fixed, so no real exchange is needed.
System design is collaborative work on ambiguous problems that requires aligning assumptions and tradeoffs.
You don't need to listen to the interviewer's follow-ups at all.
why: 面试官会观察你如何回应 probe、调整方向、承认假设和解释 tradeoff，这些都是沟通信号。
why_en: Interviewers implicitly watch how you respond to probes, adjust direction, and explain tradeoffs, all of which are communication signals.
optionMeanings: 认为沟通只是语速快慢的问题。
认为答案固定，不需要交流。
认为设计是协作解决模糊问题的过程。
认为不需要听面试官的追问。
optionScenarioImpacts: 语速和能否讲清假设、取舍无关。
系统设计本身就没有唯一固定答案。
能解释为什么沟通贯穿所有类型的面试。
忽略追问会让方向偏离面试官真正关心的点。
optionDirectness: 只适合表达训练；沟通评估不只是语速。
只有答案封闭固定时成立；系统设计需要协作对齐。
适合开放题；要边沟通边校准假设和取舍。
只适合单向笔试；面试会持续追问。
optionMeanings_en: Assumes communication is only about talking speed.
Assumes the answer is fixed, so no exchange is needed.
Sees design as a collaborative process for ambiguous problems.
Assumes follow-up questions don't need to be heard.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Talking speed has nothing to do with explaining assumptions or tradeoffs.
System design has no single fixed answer to begin with.
Explains why communication is assessed across every interview type.
Ignoring follow-ups drifts away from what the interviewer cares about.
optionDirectness_en: Fits delivery drills, but communication is more than speed.
Only works for closed-form answers; system design needs alignment.
Fits open-ended design: communicate to calibrate assumptions and tradeoffs.
Fits one-way written tests; interviews keep probing.

q: 按文章建议的准备路径排序。
q_en: Order the prep path recommended by the article.
why: 先确认考什么，再用框架组织表达，补核心知识，最后通过互动练习应对 probe。
why_en: Preparation should start with the interview type, then the framework, core concepts, and interactive practice.
tradeoff: 先诊断面试类型 vs 直接套用统一模板
steps: 学习 delivery framework
阅读核心概念和常见模式
练习 problem breakdown 并与朋友/mentor 互动
根据岗位确认面试类型

termDefinitions.meaning: 面试作答时用来组织表达顺序的结构化框架。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A delivery framework is a structured way to organize how you talk through your answer in the interview.

q: 按一次应用型 ML 方案的自然评估链排序。
q_en: Order the natural evaluation chain for an applied ML solution.
why: 这对应从模糊问题到生产系统的完整路径。每一步都影响下一步质量。
why_en: An applied ML solution flows from problem framing to data, model design, and production evaluation.
tradeoff: 先定义目标 vs 先选模型架构
steps: 集成上线并评估
定义问题和目标
设计数据、特征和标签
选择和解释模型

scenario: 你想在面试里表达「先判断任务类型，再选模型」这个思路。
scenario_en: You want to show the interviewer that you choose the ML task type before choosing a model.
q: 这段伪代码体现什么面试思路？
q_en: What interview habit does this pseudocode show?
options: 从模型名字反推出业务目标
随机选择一个任务类型
从产品动作推导 ML 任务类型
只优化参数量而不管任务类型
options_en: Infer the business goal backward from the model's name.
Pick a task type at random.
Derive the ML task type from the product action.
Only optimize parameter count, ignoring task type.
why: ML 任务类型应由产品动作和目标决定：排序列表、二元动作、数值预测分别对应 ranking、classification、regression。
why_en: The ML task type should be derived from the product action — ranking a list, a binary decision, or predicting a number map to ranking, classification, or regression.
whenOtherWins: 如果系统有多阶段组件，可能同时包含分类、召回、排序和回归。
tradeoff: 从产品动作反推 formulation vs 从模型名字或参数量反推目标
optionMeanings: 从模型名字反推目标，顺序反了。
随机选任务类型，没有依据。
从产品动作推导出该用的 ML 任务类型。
只盯着参数量，不看任务类型。
optionScenarioImpacts: 模型名字是结果，不该是推导的起点。
随机选择会导致 formulation 和产品目标脱节。
排序、拦截、金额预测能对应 ranking/classification/regression。
参数量和任务类型选择是两件事。
optionDirectness: 只有业务目标已由模型名定义时才会这样；现实通常相反。
只适合无约束玩具例子；面试需要目标依据。
适合结构化作答；先由产品动作确定 formulation。
适合模型压缩题；不回答任务类型选择。
optionMeanings_en: Infers the goal backward from a model's name.
Picks a task type with no justification.
Derives the right ML task type from the product action.
Only stares at parameter count, ignoring task type.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The model name is a downstream result, not a starting point.
Random choice disconnects the formulation from the product goal.
Ranking, blocking, and amount prediction map to ranking, classification, and regression.
Parameter count and task-type choice are separate decisions.
optionDirectness_en: Only works if the model name already defines the business goal; usually it does not.
Fits unconstrained toy examples; interviews need a reason.
Fits structured answers: derive the formulation from product actions.
Fits model-compression prompts, not task-type selection.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把业务问题表述成具体的 ML 任务类型，例如分类、排序或回归。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Formulation is expressing a business problem as a concrete ML task type, such as classification, ranking, or regression.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测一个连续数值的建模任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Regression is a modeling task that predicts a continuous numeric value.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把输入判给一个或多个离散类别的建模任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Classification is a modeling task that assigns input to one or more discrete categories.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一组候选按相关性或质量排序的建模任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ranking is a modeling task that orders a set of candidates by relevance or quality.

q: Applied ML 面试通常会考哪些能力？（多选）
q_en: Which skills are usually tested in an Applied ML interview? (Select all)
options: 业务问题到 ML 方案
数据、预处理和特征
模型选择、训练和评估
部署和监控
options_en: Translating a business problem into an ML solution.
Data, preprocessing, and feature engineering.
Model selection, training, and evaluation.
Deployment and monitoring.
why: 这四项能力构成生产 ML 闭环，只擅长其中一块通常撑不起完整的系统设计面试。
why_en: These four skills form the full production ML loop, and being strong in only one rarely carries a system design interview.
optionMeanings: 能否把业务问题转成 ML 方案。
能否处理数据、做特征工程。
能否选模型、训练并做评估。
能否部署模型并持续监控。
optionDirectness: 覆盖把业务目标转成 ML 问题的能力。
覆盖数据管线、预处理和特征表达能力。
覆盖模型选择、训练和评估取舍。
覆盖上线服务、监控和反馈迭代。
optionMeanings_en: Whether you can translate a business problem into ML.
Whether you can handle data and feature engineering.
Whether you can select, train, and evaluate a model.
Whether you can deploy and continuously monitor a model.
optionDirectness_en: Covers turning business goals into ML problems.
Covers data pipelines, preprocessing, and feature representation.
Covers model choice, training, and evaluation tradeoffs.
Covers serving, monitoring, and feedback iteration.

scenario: 你在用一份专注生产落地技能、不讲理论证明的 ML 面试指南备考。
scenario_en: You are using an ML interview guide focused on production skills, not theory proofs.
q: 这类指南通常不适合作为哪类面试组合的主要准备材料？
q_en: For which interview mix is this guide usually not enough as the main prep material?
options: Applied ML System Design
AI/ML Research 和 Research Engineering
ML Infra Design
Applied ML System Design 和 ML Infra Design
options_en: Applied ML System Design.
AI/ML Research and Research Engineering.
ML Infra Design.
Applied ML System Design and ML Infra Design.
why: 指南对研究和研究工程不是主线，因为它不深入理论创新、论文实现或性能优化。

tradeoff: 应用型生产设计深度 vs 理论研究/论文实现深度
optionMeanings: 认为只有应用型面试不适用。
认为研究和研究工程两类都不适用。
认为只有 infra 面试不适用。
认为应用型和 infra 两类都不适用。

这正是文章两次点名「不适用」的类型。
指南对 infra 面试仍部分适用，不是完全不适用。
这两类恰恰是指南覆盖最多的部分。
optionDirectness: 适合作为应用型主线材料；这正是指南覆盖重点。
适合判断材料边界；研究和研究工程需要额外资料。
只在公司强调 infra 时部分适用；不是完全不相关。
适合指南最覆盖的组合；不是排除项。
optionMeanings_en: Claims only the applied type doesn't apply.
Claims both research types don't apply.
Claims only the infra type doesn't apply.
Claims both applied and infra types don't apply.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Contradicts the guide's stated focus on applied interviews.
This is exactly what the article names as 'not useful,' twice.
The guide is still partly useful for infra, not fully unusable.
These two are actually the guide's strongest coverage areas.
optionDirectness_en: Fits as main applied-prep material; this is the guide's focus.
Fits judging the guide's boundary; research tracks need extra material.
Partly fits when the company emphasizes infra; it is not fully irrelevant.
Fits the guide's best-covered mix, so it is not the excluded case.

scenario: 你一进面试就说「我只做过实现，可能不适合这个系统设计」。

朋友可以代替你去参加真正的面试
这样就不用自己再学习基础知识

A friend can attend the real interview for you.
Practicing with someone removes the need to learn fundamentals.

why_en: A real interview is not a monologue — interviewers keep probing and shifting scope, so practicing interactively trains you to respond and adjust.

假设朋友能代替你上场面试。

把陪练价值简化成计时工具。

计时只是陪练的附带作用，不是主因。

The real interview still requires you to respond yourself.
Fundamentals still need to be learned on your own first.
Timing is a side benefit, not the main reason.
optionDirectness_en: Fits real interview practice: respond, collaborate, and adjust.
Only works if someone could interview for you, which they cannot.
Only works if a partner replaces learning; fundamentals still require study.

scenario: 同一道模糊的业务问题分别抛给 mid-level 和 senior 候选人。
scenario_en: The same vague business problem is given to a mid-level candidate and a senior candidate.
q: 两者被期待的表现有什么不同？
q_en: How are the expected performances different?
options: 两者被期待的表现完全一样
senior 需要更独立地导航模糊性并提出假设
mid-level 反而要承担更多模糊性
两者都可以完全依赖面试官给细节
options_en: Both levels are expected to perform identically.
Senior candidates must navigate ambiguity more independently and propose their own assumptions.
Mid-level candidates carry more ambiguity instead.
Both levels can fully rely on the interviewer for details.
why: 越资深，越要能在不完整信息下自己定目标、约束和风险；模板只是支架，不是终点。
why_en: The more senior you are, the more you're expected to navigate ambiguity yourself and land on a high-leverage formulation.
tradeoff: senior 自主导航模糊性 vs mid-level 依赖更清晰的问题设定
optionMeanings: 认为两个级别被期待的表现一样。
指出 senior 需要更独立地导航模糊性。
把模糊性负担放反了。
假设两级都能完全依赖面试官给细节。

能解释为什么同样的问题对 senior 要求更高。

等待细节和资深候选人的期待方向相反。
optionDirectness: 只在同级别面试中成立；这里职级不同。
适合 senior 场景；要主动定目标、假设和风险。
只有 mid-level 题更模糊时才成立；通常不是这样。
只适合高度引导的轮次；senior 不能等细节喂到位。

Names senior candidates' need to navigate ambiguity independently.
Reverses which level carries more ambiguity.
Assumes both levels can lean entirely on the interviewer for detail.

Explains why the same problem demands more from senior candidates.
Usually senior candidates face more ambiguity, not mid-level.

optionDirectness_en: Only works for same-level interviews; the scenario compares different levels.

scenario: 你备考时间有限，只能强化最能提升 ML system design 表现的基础。
scenario_en: Your prep time is limited, so you can only strengthen the foundations that most improve ML system design performance.
q: 根据文章建议，你应该优先打磨什么组合？
q_en: Based on the article, which combination should you prioritize?

只刷算法与数据结构题目
只学界面设计的规范
框架 + 核心概念 + 实战演练
options_en: Only memorize citations from classic papers.
Only drill algorithm and data-structure problems.
Only study UI design guidelines.
A delivery framework, core concepts, and hands-on rehearsal.
why: 面试需要结构、知识和表达练习共同作用：框架给流程，概念给取舍词汇，walkthrough 给迁移能力。
why_en: Interview performance needs structure, vocabulary, and rehearsed practice together — a delivery framework, core concepts, and problem walkthroughs.
whenOtherWins: 如果目标公司明确侧重研究论文，理论和论文阅读的权重要相应提高。
tradeoff: 结构化框架+核心概念+实战演练 vs 单点技能（论文/算法题/UI规范）
optionMeanings: 把精力全押在论文引用上。
把精力全押在算法题上。

算法题考察和系统设计能力是两回事。
界面规范不是 ML system design 的考点。
三者组合直接对应面试实际考察的能力。

q: 社交平台的 bot detection 系统，要解决的核心问题是什么？
options: 区分真实用户活动和自动化或恶意的 bot 活动
给用户上传的视频自动生成字幕
压缩用户上传的图片来节省存储
训练一个通用聊天机器人
why: Bot 会伪造账号、刷互动、发重复或有害内容，直接伤害真实用户体验和平台信任；系统目标是降低这些影响。
why_en: Bot detection exists to separate genuine user activity from automated or malicious behavior that erodes trust and experience on the platform.
options_en: Separate genuine user activity from automated or malicious bot activity.
Automatically generate captions for user-uploaded videos.
Compress user-uploaded images to save storage.
Train a general-purpose chatbot.
optionMeanings: 把任务定义为区分真人和自动化恶意行为
把任务当成多媒体处理里的字幕生成
把任务当成存储优化问题
把任务当成开放域对话生成
optionDirectness: 这正是 bot detection 要解决的问题
字幕生成和账号真伪无关
图片压缩不涉及行为判别
生成对话不等于识别恶意账号
optionMeanings_en: Frames the task as telling real humans apart from automated malicious behavior.
Frames the task as a media-processing captioning problem.
Frames the task as a storage-optimization problem.
Frames the task as open-domain dialogue generation.
optionDirectness_en: This is exactly the bot-detection problem.
Captioning has nothing to do with account authenticity.
Image compression doesn't involve behavioral judgment.
Generating dialogue doesn't identify malicious accounts.
q_en: What core problem should a social-platform bot detection system solve?

q: 澄清 bot detection 需求时应主动问哪些问题？（多选）
why: 这四类答案共同决定阈值、模型复杂度和评估方式；这是对抗且标签稀缺的问题，问清楚才能定设计边界。
why_en: Clarifying prevalence, false-positive cost, latency/scale, and label capacity sets the thresholds, model complexity, and evaluation plan for an adversarial, label-scarce problem.
options: bot prevalence 和现有 heuristics 挡了多少
误判真实用户会有什么后果
检测时延要求和平台规模
人工真值标签能力
options_en: The base bot prevalence and how much existing heuristics already filter.
The consequences of wrongly flagging a real user as a bot.
The detection-latency requirement and the platform's scale.
How many verified ground-truth labels investigators can produce.
optionMeanings: 问清基线 bot 占比，以及现有规则式方法挡掉多少
问清误伤真实用户要付出的代价
问清要多快检测到，以及平台规模有多大
问清人工调查员每周能确认多少条真值标签

决定误伤 guardrail 该设多严
决定 serving 架构和响应速度要求
决定训练和评估能拿到多少高质量标签

Establishes the cost of wrongly flagging a legitimate user.
Establishes the latency bar and the overall platform scale.
Establishes how many trusted labels investigators can produce per week.
optionDirectness_en: Sets the bar the new model must improve on.
Sets how strict the false-positive guardrail must be.
Sets the serving architecture and response-speed requirements.
Sets how much high-quality label budget training and evaluation get.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于经验规则的简单判断，不是学出来的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A heuristic is a hand-written rule of thumb rather than a learned model.

q_en: What should you clarify when scoping bot detection? (Select all that apply.)

scenario: 平台约有 500M DAU，人工调查员每周只能确认约数百个账号的真值标签。
q: 这组规模和标注数字，对系统设计意味着什么？
why: 决定性约束是高流量和标签稀缺并存：计算必须省着花，训练和评估都要为少量高质量标签专门设计流程。
why_en: At this scale, compute is a hard budget and the whole pipeline—training, active labeling, evaluation—has to be designed around only a few hundred trusted labels a week.
options: 计算必须是硬约束，训练和评估要为标签稀缺专门设计（级联、主动标注、弱监督）
标签充足，可以直接用监督学习解决全部问题
规模足够小，可以对每个账号跑最贵的模型
标注慢没关系，反正 bot 数量可以忽略不计
options_en: Compute has to be a hard constraint, and training/evaluation must be designed around scarce labels (cascades, active labeling, weak supervision).
Labels are abundant, so pure supervised learning can solve everything directly.
Scale is small enough to run the most expensive model on every account.
Slow labeling doesn't matter because bot volume is negligible anyway.

termDefinitions.meaning: 日活跃用户数，一天内至少活跃一次的用户数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DAU stands for Daily Active Users, the number of unique users active on the platform in a day.

q_en: What does this scale and labeling budget imply for the design?
scenario_en: The platform has about 500M DAU, and investigators can verify only a few hundred accounts per week.

q: 为什么说 bot detection 是一个对抗性（adversarial）问题？
why: 今天有效的频率/内容/IP 信号，明天可能被绕过；设计要偏向更难伪造的行为、图和时间模式。
why_en: Bot detection is adversarial because whatever signal catches bots today gets studied and evaded tomorrow, so design should lean on harder-to-fake behavioral and graph patterns.
options: bot 作者会持续观察系统并调整行为来逃避检测
真实用户的行为模式永远不会变化
获取新标签总是免费且即时的
检测系统上线不会引发任何博弈
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Pool[Candidate accounts] --> Boundary[Boundary cases]
  Pool --> New[New patterns]
  Boundary --> Review[Investigator review]
  New --> Review
  Review --> Eval[Gold eval set]
  Review --> Cal[Threshold calibration]
options_en: Bot authors continuously observe the system and adapt their behavior to evade detection.
Real users' behavior patterns never change.
New labels are always free and instantly available.
Launching a detection system never triggers a reaction from attackers.

假设正常用户行为一成不变
假设标签获取没有成本和延迟
假设检测系统上线不会引发博弈
optionDirectness: 这就是对抗性的定义
用户行为本来就会自然变化
标签依赖昂贵的人工调查
上线检测会触发攻击者反制
optionMeanings_en: Points out attackers actively adapt to the defense.
Assumes normal user behavior is static.
Assumes labels cost nothing and arrive instantly.
Assumes shipping a detector never provokes a reaction.
optionDirectness_en: This is the definition of adversarial.
Real user behavior naturally shifts too.
Labels depend on expensive manual investigation.
Launching detection triggers attacker countermeasures.
q_en: Why is bot detection an adversarial problem?

scenario: 你要给 bot detection 定业务目标，不能只追求抓最多账号。
q: 更合理的业务目标是什么？
why: 决定性问题是谁承担代价：只追封禁数或 accuracy 都会激励误伤真实用户；guardrail 把体验伤害设成硬上限。
why_en: The objective should minimize bot impact on real users with a hard false-positive guardrail, because optimizing raw ban counts or accuracy alone rewards over-flagging legitimate accounts.
options: 最小化 bot 影响，设误伤上限
最大化封禁账号数量
最大化模型 accuracy
最小化人工审核数量，不管质量
whenOtherWins: 如果是已人工确认的 bot 批量清理，封禁数量可以作为执行指标而非设计主目标。
tradeoff: 抓 bot 的力度 vs 误伤真实用户的代价
options_en: Minimize bot impact, with a hard cap on false positives.
Maximize the number of banned accounts.
Maximize model accuracy.
Minimize how much manual review is needed, regardless of quality.
optionMeanings: 把目标定义成降低伤害，同时设误伤上限
把目标定义成纯粹的封禁数量
把目标定义成模型整体正确率
把目标定义成减少审核工作量本身
optionScenarioImpacts: 既能持续打击 bot，又不牺牲真实用户体验
会激励系统宁可错杀，误伤真实用户
类别严重不平衡时，高 accuracy 也可能藏着大量误判
为了少审核，可能放过大量真实 bot
optionDirectness: 同时兼顾伤害与误伤两端
制造宁可错杀的激励
accuracy 在偏斜分布下会失真
只优化审核量会牺牲检测质量
optionMeanings_en: Defines the goal as reducing harm with a hard cap on false positives.
Defines the goal as raw ban count.
Defines the goal as overall model correctness.
Defines the goal as cutting review workload itself.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Keeps fighting bots without sacrificing legitimate user experience.
Rewards over-flagging, harming real users.
Under severe class skew, high accuracy can still hide many misclassifications.
May let many real bots through to save review effort.
optionDirectness_en: Balances harm reduction against false positives.
Creates an incentive to over-ban.
Accuracy is misleading under skewed classes.
Sacrifices detection quality for less review.
q_en: What is a better business objective for bot detection?
scenario_en: You are setting the business goal for bot detection, and raw account bans are not enough.

q: 为什么“最大化模型 accuracy”不适合作为 bot detection 的业务目标？
why: bot prevalence 和真实用户体量都很大时，高 accuracy 仍可能对应大量误判，用户感受到的是垃圾内容和误封。
why_en: Accuracy is a poor objective here because with skewed class distribution, a high accuracy score can still hide millions of real misclassifications that users feel as spam or wrongful bans.
options: 类别分布严重偏斜，用户感受到的是垃圾内容和误封，不是 accuracy 数字
accuracy 根本无法计算
accuracy 在数学上总是等于 precision
accuracy 能自动防住对抗性攻击
options_en: Class distribution is heavily skewed, and users feel spam and wrongful bans, not the accuracy number.
Accuracy simply cannot be computed here.
Accuracy is mathematically always equal to precision.
Accuracy automatically defends against adversarial attacks.
optionMeanings: 指出 accuracy 在偏斜分布下会掩盖大量误判
声称 accuracy 是不可计算的指标
把 accuracy 和 precision 混为一谈
假设一个统计指标能自动抵御攻击者适应
optionDirectness: 这正是 accuracy 失真的原因
accuracy 是可以直接算出来的
两者定义和计算方式都不同
指标本身不会改变攻击者行为
optionMeanings_en: Points out accuracy hides misclassifications under skew.
Claims accuracy can't be computed.
Conflates accuracy with precision.
Assumes a statistic can auto-resist attacker adaptation.
optionDirectness_en: This is exactly why accuracy is misleading.
Accuracy is trivially computable.
The two metrics are defined differently.
A metric doesn't change attacker behavior.
q_en: Why is maximizing model accuracy a poor bot-detection business goal?

q: 在这个方案里，bot detection 的核心 ML objective 是什么？
why: 主任务是预测账号是 bot 的概率（校准后的风险分数），动作层再按置信度和影响决定封禁、降权还是限流。
why_en: The core ML objective is binary classification that outputs a calibrated bot-risk score, which the action layer then turns into a ban, demotion, or rate limit.
options: 二分类：判断一个账号是不是 bot
回归预测视频播放时长
无监督聚类商品类别
生成式模型输出自然语言回复
options_en: Binary classification: decide whether an account is a bot.

Unsupervised clustering of product categories.
A generative model that produces natural-language replies.
optionMeanings: 把任务定义成账号级别的二分类
把任务定义成数值回归
把任务定义成无监督聚类
把任务定义成文本生成
optionDirectness: 后续动作层都基于这个 bot 概率分数
和账号真伪无关
bot detection 需要标签监督，不只是分组
生成对话不是判别账号身份

Frames the task as numeric regression.
Frames the task as unsupervised clustering.

optionDirectness_en: The action layer runs on this bot-probability score.

q: 动作层更合理的选择是什么？
why: 决定性约束是不确定性和误封代价都高；软动作降低 collateral damage，只有高置信证据才升级到封禁。
why_en: When confidence is medium but the cost of wrongly banning a real user is high, demote or rate-limit first and reserve permanent bans for high-confidence evidence.

q: 为什么高层设计要同时用 supervised/non-parametric 方法和 unsupervised 方法？
why: 已见过的 bot 签名可用监督/近邻高精度覆盖；不断出现的新模式需要异常检测去找 unknown unknowns。
why_en: Known bot signatures get high-precision supervised and nearest-neighbor coverage, while unsupervised anomaly detection is there to catch new patterns nobody has labeled yet.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Known[Known bot labels] --> Sup[Supervised model]
  Known --> KNN[Nearest neighbor]
  New[New behavior] --> Anom[Anomaly detection]
  Sup --> Merge[Risk queue]
  KNN --> Merge
  Anom --> Merge

只用内容 LLM 处理每条帖子就足够

q: 系统必须怎么处理这两类标签？
why: 模型生成的标签带反馈循环和错误传播风险；调查员标签更可信，训练、索引和评估都要分开记录来源。
why_en: Model-generated labels can create a feedback loop that amplifies the model's own mistakes, so investigator ground truth must be tracked separately and trusted more.
scenario: 近邻索引里既有调查员真值标签，也有模型自己生成的标签。

whenOtherWins: 如果自动标签来自审计过的确定性强规则，可以提高权重，但仍要标注来源。
tradeoff: 隔离错误传播 vs 索引里标签的总覆盖量

Treat every label as equally trustworthy.
Keep only the model's own generated labels.
Delete all the human-verified labels.

假设两种标签质量相同
只信任模型自产的标签

optionMeanings_en: Distinguishes label source and tiers trust accordingly.
Assumes both label sources are equally reliable.
Trusts only the model's self-generated labels.
Discards the scarcest, most reliable human labels.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Cuts the risk of a feedback loop amplifying the model's own errors.

q: 调查员的人工标签最适合怎么用？
why: 人工标签稀缺，应投向最能降低不确定性的样本：决策边界、代表新模式的账号，以及支撑可信评估的测试集。
why_en: Scarce investigator labels are best spent on boundary cases and emerging patterns, then reused to build trustworthy test sets and calibrate action thresholds.

随机分配到明显负例上
完全弃用，因为数量太少
只用来给前端界面提示做微调
options_en: Validate boundary cases, build high-quality test sets, and calibrate thresholds.
Spend them randomly on obviously negative cases.
Discard them entirely because the volume is too small.
Use them only to tweak front-end UI hints.

把稀缺标签浪费在信息量最低的样本上

把标签用途限定在无关的界面工作上

q: 应优先把哪些账号送去人工审？
why: 边界样本最能改善阈值和模型误差，新模式样本能帮助捕捉对抗漂移；标签预算稀缺就要花在刀刃上。

q: 用户生成信号（举报、申诉结果等）在 bot detection 里的特点是什么？

q: 验证集应该如何设计？
why: 对抗漂移意味着未来 bot 和过去不同；按时间分层留出未来行为，能让验证集更接近线上真实会遇到的新策略。
why_en: Because adversarial drift means future bot behavior differs from the past, time-stratified validation holds out future behavior so the test set better reflects unseen attack patterns.
scenario: bot 攻击策略随时间变化，你担心验证集过于容易。
options: 按时间分层，留出未来行为测试未见过的攻击模式

只用最早期的历史样本做验证
只在训练集上看效果
whenOtherWins: 如果只验证稳定的元数据 pipeline，随机抽样也可作为辅助。
tradeoff: 按时间切分更贴近真实漂移 vs 随机切分的方差更小、更容易

q: 更合理的异常检测组合方式是什么？
why: 级联利用 isolation forest 的效率做第一道筛查，再用 autoencoder 深查复杂模式，融合分数按置信度组合两者结果。
why_en: A cascaded setup uses isolation forests for cheap first-pass screening and autoencoders for deeper checks on complex sequential patterns, then combines their scores.
scenario: 你既要便宜筛查，又要捕捉复杂的协调行为。
options: isolation forest 先筛，再深入复核
只用最贵的模型跑全量账号
只依赖随机抽样筛查异常
彻底放弃异常检测环节
whenOtherWins: 如果流量很小且序列异常是唯一目标，可以直接用 autoencoder。
tradeoff: 级联组合的成本效率 vs 单一方法各自的局限
options_en: Isolation forest screens first, then a deeper recheck.
Run only the most expensive model on every account.
Rely only on random sampling to screen anomalies.
Drop the anomaly-detection step entirely.

把最贵的方法当成唯一阶段跑在全量上
用随机抽样代替系统性的异常筛查
放弃发现「unknown unknowns」的手段
optionScenarioImpacts: 既控制了成本，又保留了捕捉复杂模式的能力
计算成本在全量账号规模下不可持续
随机抽样无法针对性发现异常
会失去发现新型未知 bot 模式的能力
optionDirectness: 同时满足「便宜」和「捕捉复杂协调」两条约束
成本和「便宜筛查」的要求矛盾
没有针对异常做筛选

optionMeanings_en: Combines the efficiency and expressive power of both via a cascade.
Runs the most expensive method as the only stage at full volume.
Substitutes random sampling for systematic anomaly screening.
Gives up the channel for discovering unknown unknowns.

Compute cost is unsustainable at full account volume.

Cost contradicts the 'cheap screening' requirement.
Not targeted toward anomalies at all.

scenario_en: You need cheap first-pass screening and still want to catch complex coordinated behavior.

q: 为什么不能把所有「行为异常」的账号都当成 bot？
why: 异常只是调查信号，还要结合 bot 造成的实际伤害和人工验证，否则会误伤行为独特但合法的边缘真实用户。
why_en: Anomaly scores are just a signal for investigation, not proof of harm, so they must be combined with evidence of actual bot impact before any action is taken.
options: 业务关心造成 harm 的异常，而非单纯「奇怪」
异常一定都代表恶意行为
异常检测完全没有误报
奇怪的账号不需要任何保护
options_en: The business cares about harmful anomalies, not just weirdness.
Anomalies always represent malicious behavior.
Anomaly detection never produces false positives.
Unusual accounts deserve no protection at all.
optionMeanings: 把「异常」和「有害」两件事分开看待
把统计异常直接等同于恶意
假设无监督方法不会有误报
假设异常账号可以被随意处置
optionDirectness: 异常只是线索，判断还得看伤害证据
很多合法用户行为也会显得统计上异常
isolation forest/autoencoder 都会有误报
这会误伤只是行为独特的正常边缘用户
optionMeanings_en: Treats unusual and harmful as two separate things.
Equates statistical anomaly directly with malice.
Assumes unsupervised methods produce no false positives.
Assumes unusual accounts can be handled without care.
optionDirectness_en: Anomaly is just a lead, judgment still needs harm evidence.
Plenty of legitimate behavior also looks statistically unusual.
Both isolation forests and autoencoders do produce false positives.
This would harm legitimate users who simply behave unusually.
q_en: Why not treat every behaviorally unusual account as a bot?

q: 按合理顺序排列 bot 检测系统主流程。
why: 先构造多源特征，再用轻模型省计算，重模型处理高风险集合，最后由动作层按置信度执行。
why_en: The bot pipeline gathers multi-source features, filters cheaply with a light model, scores the suspicious subset deeply, then applies calibrated actions.
steps: 根据校准风险采取封禁/降权/限流
轻量模型筛出可疑账号

q: 按正确顺序排列 bot 主模型训练策略。
why: 预训练先学平台结构，融合后再定义监督目标，最后用稀缺高质量标签微调与校准。
why_en: The training path pretrains graph and sequence encoders, aligns them, applies an impact-weighted objective, and fine-tunes with trusted labels.

图侧和序列侧自监督预训练
