q_en: Put the main bot-model training strategy in the right order.

scenario: 面试官说帖子可以包含文字、图片、视频，但为了控制这轮面试的范围，先只处理文字和图片。
q: 这轮 harmful content 系统设计的输入范围是什么？
options: 只处理文本，图片和视频完全忽略
处理所有模态包括视频，范围不能缩小
处理文本和图片，视频先搁置为后续扩展
只处理图片，文本交给关键词过滤
options_en: Only process text; ignore images and video entirely.
Process every modality including video; the scope cannot shrink.
Process text and images; defer video to a future extension.
Only process images; hand text off to keyword filtering.
why: 面试官已经明确把范围收窄到文本+图片，视频留作未来扩展；把这层约束原样带进设计比自行扩大范围更准确。
why_en: The interviewer explicitly scoped this design to text and images, with video deferred, so the system should match that stated boundary.
optionExplanations: 文本仍是一等输入，不能被忽略。
题目已经明确表态先不做视频。
match，这是面试官给定的范围。
文本同样是主信号，不能只靠关键词。
optionExplanations_en: Text is still a first-class input and cannot be dropped.
The interviewer already scoped video out for this round.
This matches the boundary the interviewer stated.
Text is a primary signal too, not just keyword filtering.
q_en: What input modalities are in scope for this harmful-content design?
scenario_en: The interviewer says posts may contain text, images, and video, but this round should only handle text and images to keep scope controlled.

q: 设计 harmful content 系统前，应向面试官确认哪些关键约束？（多选）
options: 帖子涉及哪些模态、政策覆盖哪些违规类型
命中后能做的动作：删除、降权还是送人工审核
误删和漏判各自的代价，以及多大 precision 才能自动删除
每天发帖量和 harmful 内容的大致占比
options_en: Which modalities posts include and which violation types the policy covers.
What actions are available on a hit: removal, demotion, or human review.
The cost of false positives versus false negatives, and what precision unlocks auto-removal.
Daily post volume and roughly how prevalent harmful content is.
why: 这四类问题决定模型阈值、标注策略、serving 方式和评估口径，缺一个都会让设计假设站不住。
why_en: These four clarifying questions fix the modality scope, available actions, error costs, and scale that the rest of the design depends on.
optionExplanations: 决定模型输入形状和政策标签体系。
决定动作系统要支持哪几种响应。
决定自动删除的 precision guardrail 怎么定。
决定推理成本和类别不平衡的严重程度。
optionExplanations_en: It fixes the model's input modalities and policy taxonomy.
It fixes which actions the system must support.
It sets the precision guardrail for automated removal.
It sets inference cost and how severe the class imbalance is.

termDefinitions.meaning: 删除的内容里，真正有害的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision is the fraction of removed content that is actually harmful.

q_en: Which constraints should you clarify before designing a harmful-content system? (Select all that apply.)

scenario: 面试官说自动删除前，删除的内容里至少 95% 必须真的有害；模型置信度本身不能直接当作这个百分比。
q: 这个 95% precision guardrail 对自动删除路径意味着什么？
options: 只要模型置信度分数达标就能上线自动删除
阈值要用验证集实测校准，别把 confidence 当 precision
precision 只影响人工审核队列，和自动删除无关
达到 95% 后可以不再监控误删率
options_en: Ship auto-removal once the model confidence score crosses the threshold.
Calibrate the threshold on a validation set instead of trusting raw confidence.
Precision only affects the human-review queue, not auto-removal.
Once precision hits 95%, stop monitoring the false-removal rate.
why: confidence 是模型自己给的分数，precision 是拿验证/回放数据测出来的比例，两者必须分开校准。
why_en: Model confidence and empirical precision are different things, so the removal threshold must be calibrated against held-out labeled data, not just trusted confidence scores.

termDefinitions.meaning: 自动执行某个动作前必须达到的最低精确率门槛。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A precision guardrail is the minimum precision an automated action must meet before it is allowed to fire.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型对自己预测结果的打分，不等于实测精确率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Confidence is the model's own score for a prediction, which is not the same as measured precision.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被自动删除的内容里，真正违规或有害的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision is the share of automatically removed content that is truly violating or harmful.

q_en: What does the 95% precision guardrail imply for auto-removal?
scenario_en: Before auto-removal, at least 95% of removed content must truly be harmful; raw model confidence cannot be treated as that percentage.

scenario: 面试官说平台每天大约有 1B 条新帖子，harmful 内容占比不到 1%。
q: 这个日发帖规模对系统设计最直接的影响是什么？
options: 可以对所有帖子跑最贵的模型，不用考虑成本
harmful 内容占比低，绝对数量也可以忽略
可以把审核放到每月批处理一次
推理成本、级联过滤和缓存必须成为核心设计
options_en: Run the most expensive model on every post since cost doesn't matter.
Since the harmful rate is low, the absolute volume can be ignored.
Batch moderation once a month is sufficient.
Inference cost, cascading filters, and caching must be core design pieces.
why: 1B/day 让单帖推理成本被放大到十亿级别，即使 harmful 占比 <1%，绝对数量依然很大，必须靠级联和缓存控制成本。
why_en: At roughly a billion posts a day, per-post inference cost is multiplied at massive scale, so cascading filters and caching become central even though harmful content is under one percent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先用便宜的轻量模型过滤大部分内容，只把可疑的送进昂贵的重模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cascading filter uses a cheap model to screen most content and only escalates suspicious cases to an expensive model.

q_en: What is the main design impact of this daily post volume?
scenario_en: The platform receives roughly 1B new posts per day, and harmful content is under 1% of posts.

scenario: 你要给 harmful content 系统定义一个业务目标，而不是直接用模型 accuracy。
q: 最终应该选哪个业务目标？
options: 最大化删除的帖子数量，完全不管这些帖子是否真的违规政策
最大化分类 accuracy 这个整体指标，而不看伤害本身
在满足误删 precision guardrail 前提下，最小化 harmful 内容的观看量
只减少人工审核的工作量，不管用户实际受到的曝光伤害有多大
options_en: Maximize the number of posts removed, regardless of whether they actually violate policy.
Maximize the aggregate classification accuracy metric instead of looking at harm itself.
Minimize views of harmful content, subject to a precision guardrail.
Only reduce the human-review workload, regardless of how much exposure harm users actually experience.
why: 用户受到的伤害是有害内容被看到的次数，不是模型分数；按 views 加权还能优先拦住可能爆红的内容。
why_en: The real harm is exposure, not model score, so weighting by views prioritizes catching content before it goes viral, subject to a precision guardrail.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务是纯人工队列排序场景，目标可能更偏向人工审核效率和 SLA。
tradeoff: 曝光量最小化 vs 误删率上限
optionExplanations: 会鼓励过度 flag，牺牲正常用户体验。
accuracy 在类别不平衡下会失真。
对齐真实伤害，且有精确率兜底。
忽略了用户实际受到的曝光伤害。
optionExplanations_en: It rewards over-flagging and hurts legitimate users.
Accuracy is distorted under heavy class imbalance.
It aligns with real user harm and keeps a precision floor.
It ignores the exposure harm users actually experience.

termDefinitions.meaning: 业务目标之外附加的硬性约束，防止优化跑偏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A guardrail is a hard constraint layered on top of the main objective to keep optimization from going too far.

q_en: Which business objective should this harmful-content system optimize?
scenario_en: You need to define a business objective for a harmful-content system, not just optimize model accuracy.

q: 为什么“删除最多内容”是坏目标？
options: 会让人工审核队伍立刻消失
会鼓励过度 flag，产生大量误删正常内容
会自动满足 precision guardrail
会让 harmful 曝光量降到 0 且没有代价
options_en: It would make the human review team disappear immediately.
It rewards over-flagging and produces heavy false removal of benign content.
It automatically satisfies the precision guardrail.
It would drop harmful exposure to zero at no cost.
why: 分类问题天然有 FP/FN 权衡；只看删除数量的目标会鼓励模型宁可错杀，伤害正常表达。
why_en: Classification always trades off false positives and negatives, so optimizing for raw removal count rewards over-flagging benign content.
optionExplanations: 目标本身不影响人力配置。
删除量目标没有精确率约束。
删得越多，precision 通常越低不是越高。
现实中删除必然伴随误删代价。
optionExplanations_en: This objective does not touch staffing directly.
Raw removal count has no precision constraint attached.
More removals usually push precision down, not up.
Removal always carries some cost of over-flagging in practice.
q_en: Why is “remove as much content as possible” a bad objective?

q: 为什么用 harmful views 而不只是 harmful posts 数量？
options: 曝光越多伤害越大，能优先抓传播广的内容
views 比 posts 更容易做到 100% 标注
posts 数量在业务上无法统计
views 和用户体验完全无关
options_en: More views mean more harm, so it prioritizes widely-spread content.
Views are easier to label completely than posts.
The business cannot count the number of posts.
Views have nothing to do with user experience.
why: 同一条 harmful 帖子，被看 100 万次比被看 0 次伤害大得多，用曝光量能优先处理正在扩散的内容。
why_en: A harmful post seen a million times causes far more harm than one seen zero times, so weighting by views prioritizes content that is actively spreading.
optionExplanations: 直接对齐真实伤害的大小。
标注成本和曝光量无关，说法夸大。
posts 数量本身是可统计的日志量。
views 正是伤害规模的代理指标。
optionExplanations_en: It directly tracks the real magnitude of harm.
Labeling cost is unrelated to view count; this overstates the benefit.
Post counts are simple loggable numbers, not unknowable.
Views are exactly the proxy for how much harm occurred.
q_en: Why optimize harmful views instead of just harmful post count?

q: harmful content 为什么会随时间更容易判断？
options: 帖子内容会随时间自动变得更清晰
模型参数会随时间自动更新到更准
曝光后用户的举报、隐藏、评论等行为提供了额外信号
图片分辨率会随时间提升
options_en: Post content automatically becomes clearer over time.
Model parameters automatically improve over time.
User reports, hides, and comments after exposure add extra signal.
Image resolution automatically increases over time.
why: 刚发布时只有内容和作者特征；曝光后用户的负面反应会提供新的行为信号，让判断变容易，这也是要支持 re-trigger 的原因。
why_en: At publish time only content and author features exist, but user reactions after exposure add behavioral signal that makes classification easier over time.
optionExplanations: 内容本身不会随时间改变。
模型不会自动重训，需要显式触发。
这正是行为信号带来的额外证据。
分辨率是固定的，不会随时间提升。
optionExplanations_en: The content itself does not change over time.
Models do not silently retrain; retraining must be triggered.
This is exactly the extra evidence behavioral signals add.
Image resolution is fixed and does not improve over time.
q_en: Why does harmful content become easier to judge over time?

q: harmful content 的核心 ML 建模目标是什么？
options: 多分类：判断具体违规类型
回归：预测帖子会被举报几次
排序：给帖子按有害程度排名返回列表
二分类：判断帖子是否 harmful
options_en: Multi-class: identify the specific violation type.
Regression: predict how many reports a post will get.
Ranking: return a list of posts sorted by harm level.
Binary classification: decide whether a post is harmful.
why: 主分类器先输出一个二元 harmful 风险分数，类型细分和排序都是后续的辅助任务，不是核心 ML 目标。
why_en: The core ML task is a binary harmful-or-not classification; type breakdown and ranking are auxiliary, not the primary objective.
optionExplanations: 类型细分是辅助 head，不是核心目标。
举报次数是特征来源，不是主任务。
没有需要返回排序列表的产品需求。
校准层和动作系统都建在这个二分类之上。
optionExplanations_en: Type breakdown is an auxiliary head, not the core objective.
Report counts are a feature source, not the primary task.
There is no product need for a ranked list here.
The calibration and action layers are built on top of this binary task.
q_en: What is the core ML modeling objective for harmful content?

q: 按正确顺序排列 harmful content 高层流程。
why: 先触发模型评分，再校准到可执行概率，最后按阈值采取不同风险动作。
why_en: The moderation pipeline triggers classification, calibrates the harmfulness score, and then applies removal, demotion, or review actions.
steps: 校准分数以满足 precision guardrail
帖子创建或行为更新触发分类
动作系统删除、降权或送人工审核
多模态分类器输出 harmful 分数
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Trigger[Post or update] --> Model[Multimodal score]
  Model --> Cal[Calibrate]
  Cal --> Action[Remove demote review]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把模型原始分数调整成可信赖的概率，使其对应实际精确率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Calibration adjusts a model's raw score into a trustworthy probability that matches real-world precision.

q_en: Put the high-level harmful-content pipeline in the correct order.

q: 初始 50k 标注集（约 50% harmful / 50% benign）对训练意味着什么？
options: 可以直接当线上真实分布来训练和评估
适合初始训练，但评估和阈值仍要按线上 <1% 的真实占比来标定
数据太少，完全没有训练价值
只能用来训练图片编码器，不能训练分类器
options_en: Treat it directly as the true online distribution for training and evaluation.
Good for initial training, but evaluation and thresholds must still match the true under-1% online rate.
Too small to have any training value.
Only useful for training an image encoder, not the classifier.
why: 50/50 的平衡集比线上分布更适合起步训练，但线上 harmful 远低于 1%，评估和阈值必须按真实占比校准，不能直接套用。
why_en: The fifty-fifty balanced set is good for bootstrapping training, but evaluation and thresholds must still be calibrated to the true under-one-percent online prevalence.
optionExplanations: 50/50 平衡集和线上 <1% 分布差很远。
平衡集适合起步，评估仍需按真实占比校准。
5万条标注对起步训练已经足够有用。
标注集覆盖文本和图片，不止图片。
optionExplanations_en: A fifty-fifty set is far from the real under-one-percent online mix.
It is fine for bootstrapping, but evaluation still needs true-prevalence calibration.
Fifty thousand labeled examples are plenty for bootstrapping.
The labels cover text and images, not only images.

scenario: 你想用公开 NSFW 数据集增强训练。
q: 使用公开 NSFW 数据集扩充训练集时，必须注意什么？

它一定和平台政策完全一致
它可以完全替代线上标注
引入它不需要额外评估
options_en: It lacks platform-specific features and may introduce distribution or policy bias.
It is guaranteed to match the platform's policy exactly.
It can fully replace online labeling.
Adding it requires no additional evaluation.

whenOtherWins: 如果公开数据和平台政策高度一致，且只用于预训练内容 encoder，风险会小很多。
tradeoff: 扩大内容覆盖 vs 引入分布/政策偏差
optionExplanations: 外部标签体系和平台政策未必对齐。
不同平台的违规定义通常不完全一致。
它替代不了平台特有的行为/作者信号。
混入偏差数据必须先验证再上线。
optionExplanations_en: External label taxonomies rarely match the platform's policy exactly.
Violation definitions differ across platforms.
It cannot replace platform-specific behavior and author signals.
Biased external data must be validated before use.

termDefinitions.meaning: Not Safe For Work，指不适合工作场合公开查看的敏感内容标签。

scenario: 有害内容模式随时间变化，初始 50k 标签逐渐过时。
q: 为应对数据漂移，应优先收集什么样的新标签？
options: 永远只用最初那批 50k 数据
持续收集新鲜的 hard case 和边界样本
只标注明显 harmful 的样本
只标注明显 benign 的样本
options_en: Keep using only the original fifty-thousand-example batch forever.
Continuously collect fresh hard and boundary-case examples.
Only label obviously harmful examples.
Only label obviously benign examples.

难例最能改善模型的判断边界。

Hard cases teach the model where its decision boundary is weak.

q: 用户举报在训练中最适合扮演什么角色？
options: 完全等价于人工标注的真值
可以直接当作模型参数使用
高量但有噪声的 proxy label，适合辅助任务
和分类任务完全无关的前端事件

Use it directly as model parameters.
A high-volume but noisy proxy label suited for an auxiliary task.

why_en: Reports vastly outnumber human labels but can be mistaken or adversarial, so they work best as an auxiliary weak-supervision signal, not ground truth.
optionExplanations: 举报会被恶意或误解使用，不等于真值。
举报是数据信号，不是模型内部参数。
量大但噪声高，正是 proxy label 的定义。
举报直接和帖子是否有害相关。
optionExplanations_en: Reports can be adversarial or mistaken, so they are not ground truth.
Reports are a data signal, not internal model parameters.
High volume but noisy is exactly the definition of a proxy label.
Reports are directly related to whether a post is harmful.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不是真实标签，但和真实标签相关、可以用来近似监督信号的替代标签。

评论内容永远是准确的 harmful 标签

Comment content is always an accurate harmful label.
Comments can only be shown in the UI, never fed into the model.
Predicting comments would replace image feature extraction.

why_en: Comments are not always reliable labels, but training a model to predict comments from posts self-supervises richer semantic representations than label prediction alone.
optionExplanations: 这是自监督表示学习的核心价值。
同一句评论可能出现在无害语境里。
评论文本可以作为训练信号进模型。
预测评论是补充信号，不是替代图片特征。
optionExplanations_en: This is the core value of self-supervised representation learning.
The same comment can appear in a harmless context too.
Comment text can be used as a training signal inside the model.
Predicting comments supplements image features, it does not replace them.
q_en: Why can user comments be useful for self-supervision?

q: 线上 harmful 占比 <1% 时，直接按原始分布训练的最大风险是什么？
options: precision 会自动变成 100%
标注数据会自动变多
阈值调优会变得不再必要
模型学会几乎全判 benign，accuracy 虚高
options_en: Precision automatically becomes 100%.
Labeled data automatically increases.
Threshold tuning becomes unnecessary.
The model learns to predict almost always benign while accuracy looks high.
why: 类别极度不平衡时，全判 benign 也能拿到 99% accuracy，这个假象掩盖了模型其实没学到 harmful 的判别能力。
why_en: With extreme class imbalance, always predicting benign still yields near-99% accuracy, hiding the fact the model never learned to discriminate harmful content.
optionExplanations: 全判 benign 时 precision 反而没有意义。
训练策略不会凭空增加标注数据。
阈值调优在不平衡场景下更关键。
这正是类别不平衡制造的准确率假象。
optionExplanations_en: Precision is meaningless when the model always predicts benign.
A training strategy does not conjure more labeled data.
Threshold tuning becomes more critical under imbalance, not less.
This is exactly the accuracy illusion class imbalance creates.

q: harmful content 的一等内容输入包括哪些？（多选）
options: 帖子正文和 hashtags 等文本
附加图片集合
可从图片/文本学到的多模态语义
数据库主键自增值
options_en: Post body text and hashtags.
The collection of attached images.
Multimodal semantics learned jointly from image and text.
The database auto-increment primary key.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Post[Post] --> Text[Text and hashtags]
  Post --> Images[Attached images]
  Text --> Semantic[Multimodal semantics]
  Images --> Semantic
  Semantic --> Classifier[Harm classifier]
why: 政策判断主要依赖内容本身：文本和图片是一等输入，模型再从两者学习跨模态语义；数据库自增 ID 不携带任何语义信号。
why_en: Policy judgments mostly depend on the content itself, so text and images are first-class inputs and the model also learns cross-modal semantics from them, while a database auto-increment ID carries no semantic signal.
optionExplanations: 文本承载政策相关的直接语义信号。
图片同样是判断违规的一等信号。
跨模态语义补足单一模态漏掉的组合违规。
自增主键只是存储标识，无语义信息。
optionExplanations_en: Text carries direct semantic signal relevant to policy.
Images are equally a first-class signal for violations.
Cross-modal semantics catch combined violations either modality misses alone.
An auto-increment key is just a storage id with no semantics.
q_en: Which first-class content inputs belong in a harmful-content model? (Select all that apply.)

q: 为什么这是多模态分类问题？
options: 只需要读取用户 ID 就能判断
标签可能取决于文本、图片，以及二者的组合
只需要一张数值表格就能判断
模型只需要输出一个排序列表
options_en: Only the user ID needs to be read to decide.
The label can depend on text, images, or their combination.
Only one numeric feature table is needed to decide.
The model only needs to output a ranked list.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Text[Text meaning] --> Fuse[Joint reasoning]
  Image[Image meaning] --> Fuse
  Fuse --> Harm[Harm label]
  Text -. alone may miss .-> Harm
  Image -. alone may miss .-> Harm
why: 单看图片可能无害，配上特定文字才违规，反之亦然；模型必须能学习跨模态交互，而不只是各模态独立判断。
why_en: An image can be benign alone but harmful paired with certain text, and vice versa, so the model must learn cross-modal interaction rather than judging each modality separately.
optionExplanations: 用户 ID 只是作者先验，不含内容语义。
这正是多模态问题的定义。
数值表格丢失了文本和图片本身的语义。
任务是二分类，不是排序输出。
optionExplanations_en: A user ID is only an author prior with no content semantics.
This is exactly the definition of a multimodal problem.
A numeric table loses the actual text and image semantics.
The task is binary classification, not producing a ranked list.

scenario: 帖子刚发时内容模型分数低，但快速收到大量 hides 和负面评论。
q: 系统应该如何利用这类快速变化的行为信号？
options: 把行为特征当 fast-moving signals，并在关键事件后 re-trigger 分类
忽略发布后的所有行为，只信任发布那一刻的初始内容分数不再更新
不管初始内容分数多低，都统一排队等人工审核一个月后再处理
只反复用最初上传的原始图片重新打分，完全不看任何行为新证据
options_en: Treat behavior as fast-moving signals and retrigger classification on key events.
Ignore all post-publish behavior and trust only the frozen initial content score.
Queue everything uniformly for a month of human review regardless of initial score.
Keep rescoring only the original uploaded image, ignoring any behavioral evidence.
why: 行为反馈能补足内容模型的盲点，尤其是曝光后才显现的用户反应，因此需要在关键事件后重新触发分类。
why_en: Behavioral feedback fills gaps that content alone misses, especially reactions that only appear after exposure, so classification should retrigger on important behavioral events.
whenOtherWins: 如果帖子几乎没有曝光，缺少行为信号时仍要主要依赖内容和作者特征判断。
tradeoff: 更快发现晚熟违规 vs re-trigger 带来的额外计算和训练对齐成本
optionExplanations: 这正是行为信号存在的意义。
忽略行为会漏掉曝光后才显现的违规。
人工队列容量有限，不能作为主路径。
只看原图会漏掉行为透露的新证据。
optionExplanations_en: This is exactly what behavioral signals are for.
Ignoring behavior misses violations that only surface after exposure.
Human review capacity is limited and cannot be the primary path.
Only looking at the original image misses evidence behavior reveals.
q_en: How should the system use these fast-changing behavioral signals?
scenario_en: A post has a low content-model score at publish time, but quickly receives many hides and negative comments.

q: negative_reactions_per_view 这类比例，为什么在低曝光时需要平滑？
options: 曝光少时这个比例根本无法计算
平滑会把所有信号都删掉
曝光少时比例会因为分母小而极不稳定，容易误判
views 在这个特征里不重要
options_en: The ratio simply cannot be computed with few views.
Smoothing would erase all the signal.
With few views the ratio is unstable because the denominator is small.
Views do not matter for this feature.
why: 一个帖子刚发布时分母（views）很小，一两次负反馈就能把比例推到极端；Bayesian averaging 用先验把小分母拉回合理范围。
why_en: When a post has very few views, one or two negative reactions can swing the ratio to an extreme, so Bayesian averaging pulls low-denominator ratios back toward a sane prior.
optionExplanations: 分子分母都在，是能算的，只是不稳定。
平滑是压低极端值，不是清空信号。
小分母下少量事件就能左右比例。
views 正是这个比例的分母来源。
optionExplanations_en: Numerator and denominator both exist; it is unstable, not incomputable.
Smoothing tempers extreme values, it does not erase the signal.
With a tiny denominator, a few events can swing the ratio wildly.
Views are exactly the denominator this ratio is built on.
q_en: Why should ratios like negative reactions per view be smoothed at low exposure?

termDefinitions.meaning: 用先验值和真实观测混合，避免小分母比例被一两个事件推到极端。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bayesian averaging blends a prior with observed data so a tiny denominator cannot swing a rate to an extreme.

scenario: 你要为 harmful content 构造稳定的负反馈率特征。
q: 这段平滑公式的设计目的是什么？
codeSample: smoothed_rate = (negative_events + prior_rate * C) / (views + C)
options: 训练一个 ViT 图像编码器
用先验把小分母的行为比例拉向稳定值
对模型输出分数做后校准
给线上流量做 A/B 分流
options_en: Train a ViT image encoder.
Pull low-denominator behavioral ratios toward a stable prior.
Post-calibrate the model's output score.
Split online traffic for an A/B test.
why: 分子加先验、分母加常数 C，让曝光少的帖子比例被拉向全局先验，曝光变多后数据自然主导。
why_en: Adding a prior to the numerator and a constant C to the denominator pulls low-view ratios toward a global prior, letting real data dominate once views accumulate.
whenOtherWins: 当帖子已经积累大量曝光时，加不加平滑结果都很接近，直接用原始比例也可以。
tradeoff: 小样本稳定性 vs 曝光量增多后数据主导的灵敏度
optionExplanations: 公式和图像编码结构完全无关。
prior_rate 和常数 C 正是这个作用。
这是特征工程，不是分数校准层。
公式里没有流量分桶逻辑。
optionExplanations_en: The formula has nothing to do with an image encoder.
The prior_rate and constant C do exactly this.
This is feature engineering, not a score-calibration layer.
There is no traffic-bucketing logic in the formula.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一个先验信念把小样本估计拉向更合理的值，避免极端分母失真。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bayesian averaging blends a small-sample estimate with a prior belief so a tiny denominator cannot distort the result.

q_en: What is this smoothing formula designed to do?
scenario_en: You need a stable negative-feedback-rate feature for harmful-content ranking.

q: 作者特征为什么有用？

有了作者特征就可以完全丢弃内容特征
作者特征不需要按活跃度归一化

Creator features always matter more than content features.
Once you have creator features, content features can be dropped entirely.
Creator features do not need to be normalized by activity level.

optionExplanations: 历史信誉正是先验的来源。
内容特征仍是最直接的判断信号。
丢弃内容特征会漏掉大多数违规证据。
不归一化会让活跃用户的统计量失真。
optionExplanations_en: History and reputation are exactly where the prior comes from.
Content features remain the most direct evidence.
Dropping content features would miss most violation evidence.
Without normalization, active users' stats get distorted.

scenario: 你要向面试官解释作者 embedding 和实时行为特征这两类信号为什么要一起用。
q: 作者 embedding 与实时行为特征在互补关系上，核心区别维度是什么？
options: 两者完全等价，训练好一个就可以互相替代另一个
embedding 只能表达一次孤立事件，不能沉淀长期历史
实时特征只能离线批量更新，无法做到近实时
embedding 表达慢而丰富的历史画像，实时特征表达快而噪的近期变化
options_en: The two are fully equivalent; training one makes the other redundant.
An embedding can only express a single isolated event, not accumulated history.
Real-time features can only be updated in offline batches, never near-real-time.
Embeddings express a slow, rich historical profile, while real-time features express fast, noisy recent change.
why: embedding 是长期平均画像，捕捉不到突变；举报数、登录国家等实时 tally 更新快但噪声也更大，两者互补才完整。

tradeoff: 历史画像的丰富度 vs 近期突变的响应速度
optionMeanings: 主张二者等价的误解
把 embedding 能力想窄了
把实时特征更新方式想反了
准确描述两者的速度和噪声差异
optionExplanations: 二者速度和噪声特性完全不同。
embedding 聚合的是长期平均行为。
实时 tally 的意义正是能快速更新。
这正是二者互补关系的核心。
optionExplanations_en: The two differ sharply in update speed and noise.
An embedding aggregates long-term average behavior.
The whole point of real-time tallies is fast updates.
This is exactly the core of their complementary relationship.

termDefinitions.term: contextual features / 实时上下文特征
termDefinitions.meaning: 围绕当前时刻统计的快速变化信号，如近期登录国家数、举报数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Contextual features are fast-changing signals tallied around the current moment, such as recent login-country count or report count.

q_en: What core dimension separates creator embeddings from real-time behavior features?

A mistaken view that real-time features only update offline.

只适合描述一次性事件日志，不适合 embedding。
只适合离线特征表，不能描述实时 tally。
需要同时覆盖历史画像和近期突变时最合适。

This fits event logs, not embeddings.
This fits offline feature tables, not real-time tallies.

scenario: 老账号历史 embedding 很正常，但突然从多个国家登录并发布异常内容。
q: 哪些特征能补住 embedding 的盲点，及时发现账号异常？
options: 只用长期 embedding 就够了
只看账号注册年龄
实时账号上下文，如登录国家数、近期举报量、发帖突增
完全不看任何行为信号
options_en: Rely on the long-term embedding alone.
Only look at account registration age.
Real-time account context, such as login-country count, recent reports, and posting bursts.
Ignore behavioral signals entirely.

why_en: Long-term embeddings lag behind sudden shifts like account compromise, so real-time tallies of login countries, reports, and posting bursts expose the anomaly quickly.
whenOtherWins: 如果没有近期异常且内容本身清晰违规，长期 embedding 加内容模型仍是主信号。

optionMeanings: 只信任长期画像的方案
只看单一静态属性的方案
组合多个实时信号的方案
完全放弃行为信号的方案
optionExplanations: embedding 更新慢，跟不上突变。
账号年龄不反映近期是否被盗。
这些实时信号正好捕捉突发异常。
完全不看行为会错过所有突变线索。
optionExplanations_en: Embeddings update slowly and lag behind sudden change.
Account age says nothing about a recent compromise.
These real-time signals are exactly what catches a sudden anomaly.
Ignoring behavior entirely misses every compromise clue.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把用户历史行为压缩成的一个稠密向量表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding is a dense vector representation that compresses a user's historical behavior.

q_en: Which features fill the blind spot of embeddings and catch account anomalies quickly?
scenario_en: An older account has a normal historical embedding, but suddenly logs in from multiple countries and posts unusual content.
optionMeanings_en: Rely only on the long-term profile.
Use one static account attribute.
Combine several real-time account signals.
Drop behavioral evidence entirely.
optionDirectness: 历史稳定且无突发异常时才更合适。
只做粗筛或冷启动兜底时有用。
账号可能被盗或突然异常时最合适。
只有行为信号完全不可用时才被迫这么做。
optionDirectness_en: This fits only when the account is stable and has no recent anomaly.
This is useful only as a coarse cold-start fallback.
This fits account compromise or sudden anomalous behavior.
This is a forced fallback only when behavior data is unavailable.

scenario: 你要给 harmful content 建一个简单 baseline。
q: 给 harmful content 建一个简单基线模型，合理选择是？
options: 直接上全量多模态 Transformer 作为第一版基线
对数值和 embedding 特征跑 Logistic Regression
只按帖子 ID 是奇数还是偶数来分类
把所有内容都送人工审核，不训练任何模型
options_en: Ship a full multimodal Transformer straight away as the first baseline.
Run logistic regression over numeric and embedding features.
Classify purely by whether the post ID happens to be odd or even.
Send everything to human review and skip training a model at all.
optionMeanings: 直接上重模型的方案
轻量可解释的线性模型方案
和内容无关的伪随机方案
完全依赖人力的方案

q: 为什么不能简单用原始 views 直接作为 loss 权重？

views 是可以直接从日志记录的。
幂律分布正是不稳定的根源。
views 差异巨大，远非相同。

q: 这段伪代码体现的是什么设计？
codeSample:
view_weight = min(log(1 + views), c)
L_primary = BCE(y_true, y_pred) * view_weight
options: InfoNCE 对比学习
Platt scaling 后校准
Isolation forest 异常检测
截断的 log view-weighted BCE

Platt scaling for post-hoc calibration.

whenOtherWins: 如果业务不按曝光加权，而是每条内容同等处理，普通 BCE 更直接。
tradeoff: 让高曝光样本更重要 vs 避免单个爆款样本支配训练
optionExplanations: 代码里没有正负样本对比结构。
Platt scaling 是校准分数，不是加权 loss。
代码和异常检测算法结构不同。
log 加 cap 正是这段代码的两个操作。
optionExplanations_en: There is no positive/negative pair contrastive structure here.
Platt scaling calibrates scores, it does not weight a loss.
The code does not match an anomaly-detection algorithm.
The log term and the cap are exactly the two operations in this code.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种对比学习损失，用正负样本对训练表示。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种后校准方法，用简单模型把原始分数映射成概率。

options: 每条帖子都完整跑一遍最贵的重模型，且完全不做任何缓存
把所有审核都改成每月批处理一次，放弃实时响应
量化 + encoder 缓存 + 轻量蒸馏模型做两阶段过滤
放弃自动化，把所有内容都送进人工审核队列
options_en: Run the full expensive model on every post with absolutely no caching.
Switch all moderation to a once-a-month batch job, giving up real-time response.
Combine quantization, encoder caching, and a distilled two-stage filter.
Give up automation entirely and route everything to human review.
why: 规模要求先用蒸馏出的轻模型过滤明显安全的内容，缓存重复的文本/图片编码，再用量化压缩重模型的计算，三者组合才能撑住十亿级日流量。
why_en: At this scale, a distilled light model filters obviously safe content first, encoder outputs get cached for repeats, and quantization shrinks the heavy model's compute, and combining all three is what makes billion-scale serving affordable.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有小流量的高风险队列，直接用重模型加人工审核也可能可行。
tradeoff: 组合优化换来的吞吐 vs 引入的额外工程复杂度
diagram:
flowchart LR
  All[1B posts] --> Light[Distilled filter]
  Light --> Safe[Likely safe]
  Light --> Hard[Hard cases]
  Hard --> Heavy[Heavy model]
  Heavy --> Action[Action]
optionExplanations: 全量跑重模型且不缓存在这个规模下不可行。
月度批处理无法满足及时干预的需求。
三种手段组合正好覆盖不同的成本来源。
全人工在这个规模下完全不现实。
optionExplanations_en: Running the heavy model on everything with no cache is infeasible at this scale.
Monthly batching cannot support timely intervention.
The three techniques together cover different sources of cost.
All-human review is completely unrealistic at this scale.
q_en: How should serving reduce cost with 1B posts/day and a heavy multimodal Transformer?
scenario_en: The platform handles 1B posts per day, and the main model is an expensive multimodal Transformer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把模型权重或激活用更低精度表示，降低推理成本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Quantization stores weights or activations at lower precision to reduce inference cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用大模型训练小模型，让小模型学到接近大模型的行为。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distillation trains a smaller model to mimic a larger model.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存文本或图片 encoder 输出，重复内容不再重新编码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An encoder cache stores text or image encoder outputs so repeated content does not need to be encoded again.

q: 为什么 harmful content 可以缓存 encoder 输出？
options: 缓存能直接提高人工标注的准确率和质量
相同图片、文本或内容未变时，可以复用之前算过的昂贵编码
缓存可以完全替代模型的训练过程本身
缓存只能用在关系型数据库这一层，跟模型推理无关
options_en: Caching directly improves the accuracy and quality of human labeling.
When an image, text, or post is unchanged, its expensive encoding can be reused.
Caching can completely replace the model's training process itself.
Caching can only be used at the relational database layer, unrelated to inference.
why: 病毒式转发的图片、重复的短语、或者同一帖子被重触发时，直接复用之前的 encoder 输出能显著减少重复计算。
why_en: Viral reposted images, repeated phrases, or the same post being retriggered can all reuse a previous encoder output, cutting redundant computation significantly.
optionExplanations: 缓存和标注质量是两回事。
复用重复内容的编码正是缓存的价值。
缓存作用在推理阶段，不涉及训练。
这里缓存的是模型的中间输出。
optionExplanations_en: Caching and labeling quality are unrelated.
Reusing the encoding of repeated content is exactly the benefit.
Caching applies at inference time, not to training.
What is cached here is the model's intermediate output.
q_en: Why can this harmful-content system cache encoder outputs?

scenario: 帖子创建时轻模型低分，但后来收到大量举报。
q: inference 系统应该支持什么样的重新评分机制？
options: 基于关键行为事件 re-trigger，并复用缓存的内容 embedding
只在帖子创建那一刻评分一次，之后无论发生什么都不再变化
不管初始分数多低，永远都等人工审核给出最终结果
每次 re-trigger 时都把所有举报特征清空重置
options_en: Retrigger on key behavioral events, reusing the cached content embedding.
Score only once at creation and never change it no matter what happens next.
Always wait for a final human verdict regardless of how low the initial score is.
Reset and wipe all report features clean on every single retrigger.
optionMeanings: 事件驱动的重触发方案
只评一次的静态方案
完全依赖人力的方案
错误地丢弃举报特征的方案
why: 行为特征会随时间变化，系统必须在举报、异常曝光等关键事件后重新评分；缓存内容 embedding 能让重触发的成本可控。
why_en: Behavioral features change over time, so the system must rescore after key events like reports or unusual view spikes, and caching the content embedding keeps that retriggering affordable.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务只要求发布前审核，后续行为 re-trigger 就不是主路径。
tradeoff: 及时捕捉晚熟违规 vs re-trigger 带来的额外调度和计算
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Create[Post created] --> Score[Initial score]
  Score --> Cache[Cache content emb]
  Reports[New reports] --> Update[Update features]
  Cache --> Update
  Update --> Rescore[Fast rescore]
optionExplanations: 缓存 embedding 让重触发成本可控。
只评一次会错过发布后才出现的证据。
人工队列容量有限，不能是主路径。
举报特征正是 re-trigger 最重要的输入。
optionExplanations_en: Caching the embedding keeps retriggering affordable.
Scoring only once misses evidence that appears after publishing.
Human review capacity is limited and cannot be the primary path.
Report features are exactly the most important retrigger input.
q_en: What rescoring mechanism should the inference system support?
scenario_en: A post scores low under the light model at creation time, but later receives many reports.
optionMeanings_en: Event-driven rescoring.
A static score-only-once design.
A fully human-review path.
A design that incorrectly wipes report features.
optionDirectness: 行为事件会改变风险时最合适。
只适合发布后没有新信号的系统。
只适合低流量高风险队列。
没有信任任何报告信号时才可能这么做。
optionDirectness_en: This fits when behavior events can change risk.
This fits only systems with no meaningful post-publish signals.
This fits low-volume, high-risk queues.
This is only plausible when report signals are completely untrusted.

q: harmful 内容被系统早早删除，会给训练带来什么问题？
options: 训练集里可用的人工标签数量会因此自动变多变全
线上真实的误删率会因此机制自动变得更低
带行为数据的 positive 样本变少，模型可能误学「有行为=benign」
校准层因此从此彻底不再需要，可以直接从流水线删掉
options_en: The number of usable human labels in training automatically grows because of this.
The real online false-removal rate automatically drops because of this mechanism.
Positive examples with behavioral data shrink, so the model may learn that behavior implies benign.
The calibration layer becomes completely unnecessary and can be dropped from the pipeline.
why: 系统提前删除了 harmful 内容，这些帖子就没机会积累行为数据；训练集里带行为特征的正例变少，模型可能反过来学到「有行为反馈=benign」的错误结论。
why_en: Because the system removes harmful content early, those posts never accumulate behavioral data, so positive examples with behavioral features shrink and the model can wrongly learn that having behavioral signal implies benign.
optionExplanations: 早删不会凭空产生更多标签。
误删率不会因为这个机制自动下降。
这正是 positive suppression 的机制。
校准层反而因为重复触发更需要小心。
optionExplanations_en: Early removal does not conjure more labels.
The false-removal rate does not automatically drop from this.
This is exactly the positive-suppression mechanism.
The calibration layer needs more care here, not less, due to repeated retriggers.
q_en: What training problem appears when harmful content is removed very early?

scenario: 候选和控制模型会删除不同帖子，且 harmful prevalence <1%。
q: 候选模型和控制模型并行上线时，线上评估需要什么？
options: 并行打分、只按一个模型动作，并对分数区间做 importance sampling 补标注
不管 harmful 内容有多稀有，都只随机抽取 100 条内容来对比效果
直接把线上流量全量切换到候选模型，完全不额外补充任何标注
只用训练集里那批已经过时的旧标签，来横向比较两个新模型
options_en: Score in parallel, act on one model, and importance-sample labels across score bands.
Randomly sample just 100 pieces of content regardless of how rare harmful content is.
Fully switch all production traffic to the candidate model with no extra labeling at all.
Compare the two new models using only that same stale batch of old training labels.
optionExplanations: 按分数分层抽样正好针对稀有正例降方差。
harmful 占比太低时，随机抽样方差太大估计不准。
不额外打标就无法比较两个模型的分歧区域。
旧标签覆盖不到两个模型的新分歧区域。
why: 两个模型会标记不同区域的内容，必须额外标注才能比较；用分数做 importance sampling 能在 harmful <1% 的情况下用更少标签降低方差。
why_en: The two models flag different regions of content, so comparing them needs fresh labels, and score-based importance sampling reduces the variance of that rare-class estimate with fewer labels.
whenOtherWins: 如果动作风险很低，可以先用 shadow mode 收集样本，再进入正式动作实验。
tradeoff: 标注成本 vs 稀有正例的估计方差
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Control[Control model acts] --> Logs[Online logs]
  Candidate[Candidate scores] --> Logs
  Logs --> Strata[Score strata]
  Strata --> Labels[Human labels]
  Labels --> Reweight[Reweighted comparison]
optionExplanations_en: Importance sampling is exactly built to reduce rare-class variance.
With under 1% prevalence, a random 100 samples has too much variance.
Without fresh labels there is no way to compare the two models.
Old labels do not cover the new disagreement region between models.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按更有信息量的分布抽样，再用权重修正估计，减少稀有事件标注量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Importance sampling draws from a more informative distribution and reweights the result to estimate rare events with fewer labels.

q_en: What does online evaluation need when candidate and control models run in parallel?
scenario_en: The candidate and control models will remove different posts, and harmful prevalence is below 1%.

q: harmful content 离线主指标应包括什么？
options: 只看总体 accuracy 这一个笼统数字就够，不用拆分
PR-AUC 和 Recall@Precision95，可选加权版本
只看训练过程中的 loss 曲线是否持续下降
只看服务器集群的 GPU 利用率是否足够高
options_en: Just look at the single overall accuracy number, no need to break it down.
PR-AUC and Recall at the precision-95 guardrail, optionally weighted.
Only look at whether the training loss curve keeps decreasing.
Only look at whether the server cluster's GPU utilization is high enough.
why: PR-AUC 反映整体判别力，Recall@Precision95 对齐自动删除的 guardrail，impression-weighted 版本再对齐到真实曝光伤害。
why_en: PR-AUC reflects overall discriminative power, Recall at the precision guardrail aligns with the auto-removal threshold, and an impression-weighted variant aligns with actual exposure harm.
optionExplanations: accuracy 在类别不平衡下会失真。
这两个指标正好对齐质量和 guardrail。
训练 loss 不能反映线上判别效果。
GPU 利用率是成本指标，不是模型质量。
optionExplanations_en: Accuracy is distorted under heavy class imbalance.
These two metrics align with quality and the guardrail respectively.
Training loss does not reflect online discriminative performance.
GPU utilization is a cost metric, not model quality.
q_en: Which offline primary metrics should a harmful-content system use?

termDefinitions.meaning: Precision-Recall 曲线下面积，适合衡量稀有正例任务的整体判别力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PR-AUC stands for precision-recall area under the curve, a useful ranking metric for rare-positive tasks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 precision 至少 95% 的阈值下，能找回多少真实有害内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall at Precision 95 measures how much harmful content is caught while precision stays at least 95%.

scenario: 某些用户群体误删率明显高于其他群体。
q: 发现某些用户群体误删率明显更高时，评估应该怎么做？
options: 只看总体 PR-AUC 这一个汇总数字，不拆分任何群体
直接把误删率高的那个群体的样本从数据里删掉
不做任何分析，直接把所有阈值统一降低
按用户群/语言/地区切片，分别评估 precision 和 recall
options_en: Only look at the single aggregate PR-AUC number without slicing by any group.
Simply delete the samples belonging to the group with the higher removal rate.
Skip analysis entirely and just uniformly lower every threshold.
Slice evaluation by user group, language, or region to check precision and recall separately.
why: 总体指标会把不同群体的伤害平均掉；按群体/语言/地区切片评估 precision 和 recall 才能发现被掩盖的显著差异。
why_en: Aggregate metrics average away harm to specific groups, so slicing precision and recall by user group, language, or region is what surfaces hidden disparities.
whenOtherWins: 如果没有可靠的群体属性，仍可以按语言、地区、内容类型等代理维度切片。
tradeoff: 切片评估的额外工作量 vs 发现被总体指标掩盖的群体伤害
optionExplanations: 总体指标正是掩盖差异的原因。
删样本不能解决模型本身的偏差。
统一降阈值会让误删和漏判都变差。
切片评估正好能定位到具体群体的差异。
optionExplanations_en: The aggregate metric is exactly what hides the disparity.
Deleting samples does not fix the model's underlying bias.
Uniformly lowering thresholds worsens both precision and recall.
Slicing is exactly what pinpoints the disparity by group.
q_en: How should evaluation handle a much higher false-removal rate for some user groups?
scenario_en: Some user groups have a much higher false-removal rate than other groups.

scenario: 你打算给每个 user_id 直接学一个监督 embedding，作为作者特征输入模型。
q: 只给每个 user_id 学监督 embedding 有哪些问题？
options: 这种按 user_id 学的 embedding 永远是泛化能力最强的方案
冷启动、数据稀疏，且参数量大容易记住个别坏用户而非学到规律
这种训练方式完全不需要任何监督标签
它能自然、免费地处理从没发过帖的全新用户
options_en: An embedding learned per user_id is always the most generalizable option.
It suffers cold start, data sparsity, and memorizing specific bad users instead of general patterns.
This training approach needs no supervised labels at all.
It naturally and freely handles brand-new users who have never posted.
why: 只按 user_id 学监督 embedding，新用户没有向量（冷启动）、活跃低的用户向量不稳定（稀疏），而且庞大的参数量让模型更容易记住个别违规用户而不是学到可泛化的规律。
why_en: A supervised embedding keyed only on user_id has no vector for new users (cold start), unstable vectors for low-activity users (sparsity), and its huge parameter count makes it easy to memorize specific bad users instead of learning generalizable patterns.
optionMeanings: 夸大泛化能力的误解
准确描述三个结构性问题
忽略监督训练需要标签的误解
忽略冷启动问题的误解
optionExplanations: 记忆化恰恰是泛化能力差的表现。
冷启动、稀疏、记忆化正是它的三个问题。
监督 embedding 依然需要标签来训练。
新用户恰恰没有已训练好的向量。
optionExplanations_en: Memorization is exactly a sign of poor generalization.
Cold start, sparsity, and memorization are its three problems.
A supervised embedding still needs labels to train on.
New users are exactly the case with no trained vector yet.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把用户 ID 映射成的一个可训练稠密向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding here is a trainable dense vector that a user ID maps to.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新用户或新物品还没有足够历史数据时表示质量差的问题。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold start is the problem of poor representation quality for new users or items that lack historical data.

q_en: What problems come from learning a supervised embedding for each user_id?
scenario_en: You plan to learn one supervised embedding per user_id and feed it as a creator feature.
optionMeanings_en: An overclaim about generalization.
The real set of structural problems.
A claim that ignores supervised labels.
A claim that ignores cold start.

新用户和长尾用户很多时最该担心。
只适合无监督 ID 表示，不适合监督 embedding。
只有新用户能继承可靠邻居特征时才可能缓解。
optionDirectness_en: This is close only when the user set is fixed and each user has lots of data.
This matters most with many new or long-tail users.
This fits unsupervised ID features, not supervised embeddings.
This is mitigated only if new users inherit reliable neighbor features.

scenario: 要用社交图为作者生成 embedding，且需要处理新用户。
q: 要生成作者 embedding、且必须处理新用户，更适合的方案是？
options: 只训练一次 transductive GCN 查表，之后新用户都不再更新
GraphSAGE 这类 inductive graph embedding
对所有新用户，统一用全体用户的平均 embedding 兜底
完全不使用社交图信息，只靠内容特征做判断
options_en: Train a transductive GCN lookup table once and never update it for new users.
An inductive graph embedding approach such as GraphSAGE.
Fall back to the average embedding across all users for every new user.
Do not use social-graph information at all, relying only on content features.
optionMeanings: 固定查表、不覆盖新节点的方案
为新节点直接生成向量的方案
用平均值兜底、丢失个体信息的方案
放弃关系信号的方案
why: GraphSAGE 这类 inductive 方法能用用户和邻居子图直接生成新用户的 embedding，不需要等重训；这些 embedding 还能复用到平台其他任务。
why_en: An inductive method like GraphSAGE generates a new user's embedding directly from their neighborhood subgraph without waiting for retraining, and the resulting embeddings can be reused elsewhere on the platform.
whenOtherWins: 如果新用户很少、且能接受频繁重训，transductive graph embedding 更简单。
tradeoff: 覆盖新用户的能力 vs 训练/推理的额外复杂度
optionExplanations: transductive 查表天然没有新节点的向量。
inductive 正是为覆盖新用户设计的。
平均值会稀释掉个体差异信息。
放弃社交图会丢掉重要的关系信号。
optionExplanations_en: A transductive lookup table has no vector for new nodes by design.
Inductive methods are exactly designed to cover new users.
An average dilutes away individual differences.
Dropping the social graph loses an important relational signal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种归纳式图神经网络，能为训练时没见过的新节点直接生成 embedding。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GraphSAGE is an inductive graph neural network that can generate embeddings directly for new nodes not seen during training.

termDefinitions.meaning: transductive 只能表示训练图里见过的节点；inductive 能为新节点生成表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Transductive methods only represent nodes seen during training, while inductive methods can generate representations for new nodes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把作者表示成一个稠密向量，供模型作为特征使用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding represents a creator as a dense vector that the model can use as a feature.

q_en: Which author-embedding approach fits when new users must be supported?
scenario_en: You want to generate creator embeddings from the social graph and must support new users.
optionMeanings_en: A fixed lookup approach that does not cover new nodes.
An approach that directly generates vectors for new nodes.
An average fallback that loses individual information.
A design that drops relational signal.
optionDirectness: 图几乎不增长且能频繁重训时适合。
新用户必须立即覆盖时最合适。
只适合临时兜底，质量通常很弱。
社交关系弱或不可用时才适合。
optionDirectness_en: This fits if the graph barely grows and retraining is cheap.
This fits when new users need immediate coverage.
This is only a temporary fallback and usually weak.
This fits when social-graph signal is weak or unavailable.

scenario: 你已经用 transductive 方法在当前社交图上训练好了作者 embedding，图还在持续增长。
q: transductive graph embedding 相比 inductive 方法，最大的局限是什么？
options: 它完全不能用于任何图结构数据，从设计上就不支持
不管图多大，它的训练和推理成本都一定比 GraphSAGE 更贵
新用户没有训练好的向量，需要重训或插补平均值
它这种方法从架构上就无法做离线批量训练
options_en: It cannot be used on any graph-structured data at all by design.
Regardless of graph size, it always costs more to train and serve than GraphSAGE.
New users have no trained vector and need retraining or averaged imputation.
This approach cannot be trained offline in batches by its very architecture.
why: transductive 方法学的是训练图里固定节点的向量表；图增长后新节点没有向量，只能靠重训或插补平均值兜底，且插补质量会随时间累积变差。
why_en: Transductive methods learn a fixed lookup table for the nodes seen during training, so as the graph grows, new nodes have no vector and must fall back to retraining or averaged imputation, which degrades in quality over time.
tradeoff: 训练简单性 vs 覆盖新节点的能力
optionMeanings: 夸大到完全不可用的误解
把成本绝对化的误解
准确描述新节点覆盖问题
误以为它不能离线训练
optionExplanations: 它能用，只是不能泛化到新节点。
成本高低取决于图规模，不是绝对更贵。
这确实是它在覆盖新节点上的结构性局限。
它照样可以离线批量训练。
optionExplanations_en: It works fine on the training graph; it just cannot generalize to new nodes.
Cost depends on graph size, it is not always more expensive.
This is exactly the structural limitation of transductive methods.
It can still be trained offline in batches.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种归纳式图神经网络，能为新节点直接生成 embedding，无需重训整张图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GraphSAGE is an inductive graph neural network that generates embeddings for new nodes without retraining on the whole graph.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只能表示训练时图里已经存在的节点，无法直接处理新节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transductive method can only represent nodes that already existed in the training graph, not new ones.

q_en: What is the biggest limitation of transductive graph embeddings versus inductive methods?
scenario_en: You trained creator embeddings with a transductive method on the current social graph, but the graph keeps growing.
optionMeanings_en: An overclaim that the method is unusable.
An absolute cost claim.
The real new-node coverage limitation.
A mistaken claim that it cannot batch train offline.
optionDirectness: 只有题目问“是否支持图数据”时才相关。
只有具体算过训练/推理成本时才可讨论。
图持续增长且新用户重要时最关键。

why_en: The primary task is driven by high-quality harmful labels weighted by views, while report prediction supplies extra weak supervision as an auxiliary task, with alpha and beta controlling their relative weight.

why_en: Different confidence and risk levels map to different actions — remove, demote, or route to review — while letting everything through defeats the purpose of an action layer.

options: 需要持续标注抽样内容或曝光，才能估计有害曝光量

precision guardrail 从此不再重要

Views cannot be logged at all.

The precision guardrail stops mattering.

why_en: Knowing how many views were harmful requires ongoing sampled labeling of content or impressions, and that labeling cost is exactly why proxy metrics and importance sampling get used.
optionExplanations: 持续标注正是曝光估计所需要的成本。
views 本身是可以直接记日志的。
标注曝光量恰恰需要持续人工参与。
guardrail 依然是自动删除的硬约束。

Views themselves can be logged directly.
Estimating harmful views needs continued human labeling.
The guardrail is still a hard constraint on auto-removal.

scenario: 用户报告既可能是真实有害，也可能是观点不合的恶意举报。
q: 训练和评估中应如何对待用户报告这个信号？
options: 当作和人工标注完全等价的真值
作为噪声代理信号，结合人工标签做校准和去偏
完全丢弃所有报告数据
直接用报告率替代 precision 指标
options_en: Treat it as exactly equivalent to human-labeled ground truth.
Use it as a noisy proxy signal, calibrated and debiased against human labels.
Discard all report data entirely.
Use report rate directly in place of the precision metric.
why: 报告有规模价值，但可能是恶意举报或用户误解政策产生的噪声，合理做法是当辅助信号，用高质量标签做校准和去偏。
why_en: Reports offer scale but can be noisy from adversarial or mistaken reporters, so the right approach is to treat them as an auxiliary signal calibrated and debiased against trusted labels.
whenOtherWins: 如果某类报告来自高可信的专业审核队列，可以适当提高它的权重。
tradeoff: 利用报告的规模优势 vs 报告本身的噪声和对抗性
optionExplanations: 报告可能是恶意或误解政策产生的。
校准去偏正是处理噪声代理信号的方法。
丢弃会浪费一个规模很大的信号来源。
报告率本身有偏，不能直接顶替 precision。
optionExplanations_en: Reports can be adversarial or based on a misunderstanding of policy.
Calibrating and debiasing is exactly how to handle a noisy proxy signal.
Discarding it wastes a large-scale signal source.
Report rate is itself biased and cannot directly stand in for precision.
q_en: How should training and evaluation treat user reports?
scenario_en: User reports may indicate real harm, but they may also be malicious reports from people who simply disagree.

scenario: YouTube 式视频平台的 Up Next 推荐：用户正在看一个视频时，系统要在旁边实时展示接下来推荐播放的视频列表。
q: 为什么当前正在观看的视频要作为 Up Next 排序的核心特征，而不能只依赖用户的长期兴趣画像？
options: 长期画像存储成本太高，系统负担不起
当前视频最直接反映用户此刻的意图，长期画像更新慢、跟不上会话内的兴趣切换
当前视频的画质参数决定了排序结果
长期画像只对新用户有效，老用户必须完全换成当前视频特征
why: Up Next 是强上下文场景：用户刚表现出的兴趣比几周前积累的长期画像更能预测下一步。两者应结合，当前视频权重更高。
why_en: The video someone is watching right now signals their immediate intent far more directly than a slow-moving long-term profile.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Current[Current video] --> Rank[Up Next ranker]
  Session[Session history] --> Rank
  Profile[Long-term profile] --> Rank

把当前视频当核心特征，长期画像作为补充信号
把视频编码参数当成排序依据
认为特征选择应按用户新旧二选一

Long-term profiles only work for new users; returning users must switch entirely to current-video features

scenario: 面试官给出约束：视频库约 1B 条、日活约 1B 用户、每次只展示约 5 个推荐位、从用户打开视频到展示 Up Next 列表只有约 250ms。
q: 这组规模和延迟约束最直接排除了哪种架构？
options: 先用候选生成把 1B 条缩小到几万，再逐级排序到 5 个
对每次请求都用一个重排序模型给全部 1B 条视频打分，再取分最高的 5 个
把候选生成结果和视频 embedding 提前离线算好、在线只做少量计算
用便宜的树模型先把候选量级从万级压到百级
why: 哪怕每条视频只花 1 微秒打分，1B 条也要 1 秒，远超 250ms 预算；必须先分阶段缩小候选，而不是对全库跑重模型。
why_en: Even at one microsecond per video, scoring one billion videos would take about a second, far more than the 250-millisecond budget, so a single full-catalog pass is impossible.
options_en: Shrink one billion candidates down to a few tens of thousands first, then rank down to five in stages
Score all one billion videos with a single heavy ranker on every request, then keep the top five
Precompute candidate-generation results and video embeddings offline, and do little compute online
Use a cheap tree model to shrink candidates from ten-thousands down to hundreds first

termDefinitions.meaning: 把实体映射成一个稠密向量，向量距离反映相似度。

1B 条逐个打分的下限约 1 秒，已经超过 250ms 服务预算。
离线预计算适合慢变化数据，但在线仍要继续分阶段排序。
树模型适合轻排压缩候选，不适合替代前面的召回层。

scenario: 你要为 Up Next 推荐定义业务目标；如果单纯优化点击率，标题党和夸张缩略图会被算法鼓励。

optionScenarioImpacts: 会系统性奖励标题党，点击后用户很快离开

短期收入不等于长期平台健康

时长本身不是质量信号

q: 为什么视频的 engagement 特征（如累计观看量）要做年龄归一化，而不能直接比较原始计数？

新视频观看量天然少，直接比较会偏向老视频
归一化会把所有信号都清零

tradeoff: 对早期动量的敏感度 vs 原始计数的简单直接

标题长度不能反映内容质量或受欢迎程度

scenario: 轻 ranker 要在毫秒级处理海量候选，重 ranker 则可以承担更贵的计算来追求质量。两者都要用到用户最近观看历史。
q: 轻 ranker 和重 ranker 分别应该如何编码这份观看历史？

注册年龄和当前会话兴趣关联很弱，不能替代观看历史。

scenario_en: The light ranker has to process a huge candidate set at millisecond-level latency, while the heavy ranker can afford more expensive computation for quality. Both stages need the user's recent watch history.

q: 为什么推荐训练要专门处理 position bias（位置偏差）？
options: 所有未被展示的视频都应该被当作明确的负反馈
用户只反馈被展示且靠前的视频，日志受旧系统影响
展示位置对点击行为完全没有影响

why_en: Position bias exists because users only react to items that were shown, and higher-ranked items get more attention.
optionMeanings: 把未展示等同于明确的负反馈
指出日志被旧系统曝光模式污染
否认位置对点击的影响
误以为训练数据天然无偏

展示位置越靠前越容易被点击，位置本身会污染点击日志。
训练日志正是被旧系统的排序方式影响的，并不是天然反事实、无偏的。
options_en: Every video that was never shown should be treated as a definite negative

q: 推荐系统常见的反馈循环（feedback loop）问题包括什么？

标注员的标注速度会持续变慢
数据库索引会随时间自动失效

flowchart LR

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户长期只被展示越来越窄的一类内容的现象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A filter bubble is when a user is shown an increasingly narrow slice of content over time.

单纯调高训练学习率，寄望模型自己学会去偏

why: 只做 exploit 会让推荐变窄和无聊，只做 explore 会显得随机、打扰用户，需要按位置和用户阶段分配探索预算。
why_en: Explore-exploit balances safe known-good recommendations against exploratory items that might reveal new interests.
tradeoff: 利用已知偏好的确定收益 vs 探索新兴趣的长期发现价值

termDefinitions.meaning: 在利用已知的好选项和尝试未知的新选项之间做平衡的经典问题。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Explore/exploit is the classic tradeoff between using known-good options and trying unknown ones that might be better.

termDefinitions.meaning: 适合并行矩阵运算的加速硬件，是工程资源分配问题，不是 explore/exploit 概念。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A GPU, Graphics Processing Unit, is accelerator hardware for parallel math — an engineering resource question, not the explore/exploit concept.

optionMeanings: 指出这是已知偏好和新兴趣之间的平衡
把概念错误映射到硬件资源分配
把概念错误映射到数据集划分
把概念错误映射到内容治理决策
optionDirectness: 本题选择它，因为这是 explore/exploit 的标准定义
CPU/GPU 分配是工程资源问题，不是这个概念
训练/测试集划分是数据处理规范，不是这个概念
内容治理是信任与安全问题，不是这个概念
options_en: Balancing content the user is known to like against content that might reveal a new interest
Balancing CPU and GPU resources
Mixing labels between the training set and the test set
Choosing between deleting content and banning an account
q_en: What does the explore/exploit tradeoff mean in a recommendation system?

scenario: 推荐列表第 1 位对用户体验影响很大，需要保持稳定；第 5 位风险较低，可以用来试探用户的新兴趣。
q: 应该如何为不同推荐位置分配探索预算？
options: 按位置分配探索预算（contextual bandit）
对所有推荐位置都用完全相同的随机探索比例
全部位置都不做任何探索，只做利用不冒险
只针对新上传视频做探索，其余位置全部固定
whenOtherWins: 如果产品场景要求完全确定性或有强合规约束，整体探索比例应该更保守。
why: 高位对体验影响大应该更保守，低位可以更多探索；bandit 类方法能在短期损失和长期学习之间取舍。
why_en: Different recommendation slots can carry different exploration budgets, often implemented with contextual bandits or Thompson sampling.
tradeoff: 顶部位置的体验稳定性 vs 底部位置的探索学习收益
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Exploit[Known good] --> Mix[Slot policy]
  Explore[New interests] --> Mix
  Mix --> User[User slate]
  User --> Feedback[Feedback]
  Feedback --> Learn[Better policy]

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据上下文特征动态调整探索和利用决策的强盗算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A contextual bandit adjusts explore/exploit decisions using contextual features.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种贝叶斯强盗算法，按后验概率采样来决定探索哪个选项。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Thompson sampling is a Bayesian bandit algorithm that samples from a posterior belief to decide what to explore.

optionMeanings: 指出按位置分配不同探索预算
对所有位置一视同仁地随机探索
完全放弃探索，只做利用
把探索局限在新视频这一维度
optionDirectness: 本题选择它，因为这是场景描述的按位置分配风险预算的思路
顶部位置对体验影响大，不应和底部同等随机
完全不探索会让系统无法发现用户的新兴趣
探索维度不只是新旧视频，也包括位置和用户阶段
options_en: Give each slot a different exploration budget (contextual bandit)
Apply the exact same random exploration ratio to every single slot
Do no exploration anywhere and only exploit known-good picks
Only explore on brand-new uploads and keep every other slot fixed
q_en: How should exploration budget be allocated across different recommendation slots?
scenario_en: Slot 1 in the recommendation list has a big impact on user experience and needs to stay stable; slot 5 is lower-risk and can be used to probe for new interests.

q: Upper Confidence Bound（UCB）这类强盗算法在做选择时大致利用了什么原理？
options: 均值奖励加不确定性上界，偏好高潜力选项
只选择历史上曾经最热门的选项
只做完全随机的选择，不看历史
只根据视频长度做选择
why: UCB 用置信区间把探索价值显式加入选择分数；规模化实现时要处理海量 item 置信估计的成本。
why_en: UCB methods add an uncertainty bonus to the estimated reward, biasing selection toward promising but less-certain items.

termDefinitions.meaning: 强盗算法的一种，用置信区间上界给不确定的选项额外的探索加分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: UCB is a bandit algorithm that adds an uncertainty bonus to the estimated reward of less-certain options.

optionMeanings: 指出均值加置信上界的核心机制
把 UCB 简化为纯历史热门排序
把 UCB 误解为纯随机策略
把 UCB 和内容特征混淆
optionDirectness: 本题选择它，因为这是 UCB 算法的核心机制
纯选历史最热门等价于只做 exploit，没有探索
纯随机没有利用已积累的奖励估计
UCB 是基于奖励估计的策略，不是内容属性规则
options_en: Adding an uncertainty bonus on top of the mean estimated reward, favoring high-potential options
Always picking whatever has historically been most popular
Choosing completely at random, ignoring history
Choosing based only on video length
q_en: Roughly what principle do bandit algorithms like Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) use when making a selection?

q: 为什么探索策略应该按用户或兴趣领域分别调整，而不是对所有用户用同一个探索比例？
options: 同一用户在不同兴趣领域的不确定性不同，个性化探索更高效
所有用户理论上都应该被同样随机地对待
探索策略只对新用户有意义，对老用户完全没用
按分段调整探索会导致所有反馈信号丢失
why: 同一用户在不同兴趣域的不确定性也不同，个性化的探索预算能减少不必要的打扰、提高发现的价值。
why_en: Exploration should adapt by segment because uncertainty and tolerance for novelty differ across users and interest areas.
optionMeanings: 指出不确定性因兴趣领域而异
主张统一探索比例
把探索价值局限在新用户
夸大分段调整的破坏性
optionDirectness: 用户在烹饪内容上可能喜欢新鲜感，但在猫视频上只想看稳定偏好，探索预算应分开调
统一比例会在稳定兴趣上过度打扰、在不确定兴趣上探索不足
老用户的兴趣同样会随时间漂移，也需要适度探索
分段调整只是改变探索比例，不影响反馈信号本身
options_en: The same user has different amounts of uncertainty across interest areas, so personalized exploration is more efficient
In theory every user should be treated with the same randomness
Exploration strategy only matters for new users, not returning ones
Adjusting exploration by segment would cause all feedback signal to be lost
q_en: Why should exploration be tuned separately by user or interest area, instead of using the same exploration ratio for every user?

q: 按正确顺序排列大规模视频推荐的在线请求处理流程。
steps: 重 ranker 用完整特征精排
多个 candidate generator 并行召回
reranker 组装最终 slate
轻 ranker 高召回缩小候选
why: 先广泛召回，再用便宜模型保留潜在好候选，重模型精排，最后在 slate 层处理多样性和业务约束。
why_en: The online recommender retrieves candidates, filters them with a light ranker, scores them with a heavy ranker, and reranks the slate.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Gen[Candidate generators] --> Light[Light ranker]
  Light --> Heavy[Heavy ranker]
  Heavy --> Slate[Reranker slate]
  Slate --> Logs[Feedback logs]
  Logs --> Train[Next training]
q_en: Put the online request-processing pipeline for a large-scale video recommender in the correct order.

q: 按合理顺序排列视频推荐系统的训练流程。
steps: 收集显式/隐式/上下文数据
训练两塔或其他召回模型
训练轻 ranker 和重多任务 ranker
用线上 A/B 和长期指标校验 value model
why: 数据定义监督信号，召回先保证候选覆盖，ranker 优化排序，最终由线上指标验证业务权重是否合理。
why_en: Video recommendation training starts with feedback data, then retrieval models, ranking models, and finally online validation of the value model.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Data[Feedback and context] --> Retrieve[Train retrieval]
  Retrieve --> Rank[Train rankers]
  Rank --> Value[Calibrate value model]
  Value --> AB[Online AB]
  AB --> Data
q_en: Put the training pipeline for a video recommendation system in a reasonable order.

scenario: 你要向面试官说明向量召回 candidate generator 的在线核心逻辑。
q: 下面这段伪代码表达的是什么？
codeSample:
user_vec = user_tower(user_context)
candidates = video_ann.search(user_vec, k=1000)
options: 重 ranker 对候选做最终精确打分
用用户向量在视频 ANN 索引中检索候选
对预测分数做 Platt calibration
对稀有事件做 Bayesian smoothing
whenOtherWins: 如果需要对少量候选做精确重排，cross-encoder 或重 ranker 会更合适，而不是继续用 ANN 检索。
why: 在线只需要用用户塔算出向量，再去离线建好的视频 ANN 索引里做近邻检索，适合大规模候选生成。
why_en: The code retrieves video candidates by searching an ANN index with the online user embedding.
tradeoff: ANN 检索的低延迟规模化 vs 检索结果的近似性（不保证严格最优）

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索，在海量向量里快速找出最相似的几个，不保证绝对精确。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN, approximate nearest neighbor search, quickly retrieves the closest vectors from a huge index without scanning everything.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在样本量很小时用先验信息平滑估计值的技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bayesian smoothing uses prior information to stabilize estimates when the sample size is small.

optionMeanings: 把这段代码误解为重 ranker 打分逻辑
指出这是用户向量在 ANN 索引中检索
把代码误解为分数校准步骤
把代码误解为稀疏事件平滑
optionDirectness: 重 ranker 需要完整特征交互，这段代码里没有
本题选择它，因为两行代码正是“算用户向量、去索引检索”
代码里没有出现概率校准逻辑
代码里没有出现平滑估计逻辑
options_en: The heavy ranker giving candidates a final precise score
Searching a video ANN index with the user embedding to retrieve candidates
Applying Platt calibration to prediction scores
Applying Bayesian smoothing to rare events
q_en: What does this pseudocode express?
scenario_en: You need to explain to the interviewer the core online logic of a vector-retrieval candidate generator.

q: staff-level 候选人在视频推荐系统设计中应主动覆盖哪些系统性风险？（多选）
options: 反馈循环和 popularity bias
cold start（新用户/新内容）
position bias 和数据质量问题
创作者生态健康和推荐多样性
why: 高级别的答案不只谈模型结构，还要主动谈数据、评估方法和生态副作用。
why_en: Staff-level recommender answers should proactively cover feedback loops, cold start, position bias and data quality, and ecosystem health.
optionMeanings: 热门内容自我强化的风险
新用户/新内容缺少数据的风险
曝光位置偏差和数据质量风险
创作者可持续性和内容多样性风险
options_en: Feedback loops and popularity bias
Cold start for new users and new content
Position bias and data-quality issues
Creator ecosystem health and recommendation diversity
q_en: Which systemic risks should a staff-level candidate proactively cover when designing a video recommendation system? (select all)

termDefinitions.meaning: 展示位置越靠前的内容越容易被点击，导致训练日志系统性偏向旧系统的排序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Position bias is the tendency for higher-ranked items to get more clicks, which skews training logs toward the old ranking system.

termDefinitions.meaning: 热门内容因为已经热门而获得更多曝光，形成马太效应。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Popularity bias is the rich-get-richer effect where already-popular items receive disproportionately more exposure.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新用户或新内容缺少历史行为数据、难以个性化的阶段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold start is the period when a new user or new item lacks the behavioral data needed for personalization.

q: 为什么说现代视频推荐系统的瓶颈往往不只是模型架构本身？
options: 数据质量、评估方法、反馈循环和整体系统设计同样决定推荐系统的成败
模型架构完全不重要，可以随意选择
只要模型参数足够多，其他环节都不需要关心
线上 A/B 实验对推荐系统没有实际意义
why: 再强的模型也只能学习日志给它的偏差和候选池；推荐系统的成功需要数据、召回、实验和生态共同健康。
why_en: Modern recommendation success depends on data quality, evaluation, feedback loops, and overall system design, not just model architecture.
optionMeanings: 指出多个环节共同决定成败
夸大架构无关紧要的程度
误以为参数规模能替代其他环节
否认线上实验的价值
optionDirectness: 本题选择它，因为这是本题对高级候选人期望的总结
架构仍然重要，只是不是唯一决定因素
参数规模无法弥补数据质量和评估方法的缺陷
A/B 实验正是验证推荐系统真实价值的核心手段
options_en: Data quality, evaluation methodology, feedback loops, and overall system design equally determine success
Model architecture is completely unimportant and can be chosen arbitrarily
As long as the model has enough parameters, nothing else needs attention
Online A/B experiments have no real value for recommendation systems
q_en: Why is the bottleneck in modern video recommendation systems often not just the model architecture itself?

termDefinitions.meaning: 把用户随机分组，对比不同版本真实效果的线上实验方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A/B testing randomly splits users into groups to compare the real-world effect of different versions.

q: 并发协调问题关注的核心是什么？
q_en: What is the core concern in a concurrency coordination problem?
options: 线程如何通信、等待和交接工作
如何让每个字段都 public
如何选择继承层级
如何复制数据库到多区域
why: 协调不是主要防止某个字段写坏，而是让生产者、消费者或独立执行路径按正确节奏配合。等待、唤醒、反压是关键词。
why_en: Coordination is about how threads communicate, wait, wake, and hand off work safely.
options_en: How threads communicate, wait, and hand off work to each other.
How to make every field public.
How to choose an inheritance hierarchy.
How to replicate a database across multiple regions.
optionExplanations: 协调的核心正是线程间如何通信、等待和交接工作，这是生产消费者模式的基础。
让字段 public 是对象设计问题，不是并发协调的重点。
继承层级属于 OOP 设计，与协调机制无关。
数据库复制是分布式系统问题，不是线程级并发协调的范畴。
optionExplanations_en: Coordination is exactly about how threads communicate, wait, and hand off work safely.
Making fields public is an object design concern, not concurrency coordination.
Inheritance hierarchy is an OOP design choice, not a coordination mechanism.
Database replication is a distributed system concern, not thread-level coordination.

scenario: 注册请求需要发欢迎邮件，发邮件要 500ms，但用户不需要等邮件真的发完才看到成功。
scenario_en: A registration request needs to send a welcome email that takes 500ms, but the user should not wait for it to finish before seeing success.
q: 最适合的设计方向是什么？
q_en: Which design direction fits best?
options: 请求线程内同步发送邮件
把邮件任务入队，后台 worker 异步处理
让数据库连接池变大
把 Email 类做成 Singleton 就结束
why: 这是“请求路径不该做慢工作”的典型协调场景。API 线程生产任务，后台消费者慢慢处理。
why_en: A background queue decouples the request path from slow email sending, letting workers process the task asynchronously.
whenOtherWins: 如果邮件发送结果必须决定本次请求是否成功，就不能简单异步返回，需要同步处理或补偿流程。
options_en: Send the welcome email synchronously inside the request thread.
Enqueue the email task and let a background worker process it asynchronously.
Just make the database connection pool bigger.
Just turn the Email class into a Singleton.
tradeoff: 请求路径同步等待 vs 后台异步处理
optionExplanations: 同步发邮件让用户等待，不符合题意中的需求。
把邮件任务异步入队，API 快速返回，Worker 在后台处理，这正是生产者消费者模式。
数据库连接池大小与邮件发送延迟无关。
Email Singleton 只是对象创建方式，不解决发送延迟问题。
optionExplanations_en: Synchronous mail sending blocks the user, which conflicts with the requirement.
Enqueueing the email task lets the API return quickly while workers process it asynchronously.
Increasing the connection pool does not address the email sending latency.
Making Email a Singleton is a creation pattern, not a solution to sending delay.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保证一个类在整个进程里只有一个实例的创建型设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton is a creational pattern that guarantees a class has only one instance in the process.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预先建立好、可反复借用的一组数据库连接，避免每次请求都新建连接的开销。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A connection pool is a set of pre-established database connections an application reuses instead of opening a new one for every request.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从队列取任务并执行的后台线程，通常成组存在（worker pool）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A worker is a background thread that pulls tasks from a queue and executes them, usually running as part of a worker pool.

q: worker 在空队列上 `while True` 不断检查的主要后果是什么？
q_en: What is the main consequence of a worker repeatedly checking an empty queue in `while True`?
options: 空闲时也持续消耗 CPU
任务会自动批处理
队列容量会变大
所有任务都会按优先级排序
why: 忙等让线程没有工作也占用核心。worker 多时，系统可能把 CPU 都花在检查“没有任务”上。
why_en: Busy-waiting burns CPU while doing no useful work, especially when many workers spin on an empty queue.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  W["worker"] --> C{"queue empty?"}
  C -- yes --> W
  C -- no --> T["take task"]
  W --> CPU["CPU burned while idle"]
options_en: It keeps burning CPU even while idle.
Tasks get automatically batch-processed.
The queue capacity grows automatically.
All tasks get automatically sorted by priority.
optionExplanations: 忙等让线程不断检查队列但无任务处理，持续消耗 CPU 核心，特别在多 worker 时问题严重。
任务不会因为忙等而自动批处理。
队列容量与忙等无关。
任务优先级排序是队列实现问题，不是忙等的结果。
optionExplanations_en: Busy-waiting burns CPU cycles checking for work that is not there, especially with many idle workers.
Busy-waiting does not automatically batch-process tasks.
Queue capacity is not affected by busy-waiting.
Task prioritization is a queue implementation feature, not a result of busy-waiting.

termDefinitions.meaning: 执行程序指令的处理器核心，被空转检查占满时就没有余力做真正的工作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The CPU, or Central Processing Unit, executes instructions, and keeping it busy with idle checks leaves less capacity for real work.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程不停轮询条件却不真正休眠，一直占用 CPU 却没做有用的事。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Busy-waiting is a loop that keeps checking a condition without sleeping, so it keeps burning CPU doing no useful work.

q: sleep 轮询相比忙等改善了什么，又引入了什么？
q_en: Compared with busy-waiting, what does sleep polling improve and what does it add?
options: 减少 CPU 浪费，但增加任务到达后的等待延迟
消除所有队列容量问题
让任务处理变成原子操作
保证每个任务 1ms 内处理
why: 睡眠时间短会浪费 CPU，睡眠时间长会让刚到的任务等下一轮。它是在浪费和延迟之间折中，不是根本解。
why_en: Sleep polling reduces CPU waste but adds latency because a task may arrive just after a worker goes to sleep.
options_en: It reduces CPU waste but adds latency after a task arrives.
It eliminates all queue-capacity problems.
It makes task processing atomic.
It guarantees every task is processed within one millisecond.
tradeoff: 更低 CPU 占用 vs 更低任务等待延迟
optionExplanations: Sleep 轮询用睡眠减少 CPU 浪费，但引入了任务延迟——任务刚到达时可能线程刚睡眠。
Sleep 轮询不能消除队列容量问题。
Sleep 轮询不让任务成为原子操作。
Sleep 轮询无法保证 1ms 内处理。
optionExplanations_en: Sleep polling reduces CPU waste but adds latency when tasks arrive just after the worker sleeps.
Sleep polling does not eliminate queue capacity issues.
Sleep polling does not make task processing atomic.
Sleep polling cannot guarantee one-millisecond processing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程不停轮询条件却不真正休眠，一直占用 CPU 却没做有用的事。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Busy-waiting is a loop that keeps checking a condition without sleeping, so it keeps burning CPU doing no useful work.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每次检查条件后固定睡眠一段时间再重试，用睡眠换取更少 CPU 占用，但会增加任务到达后的等待延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sleep polling makes a thread sleep a fixed interval between checks, trading CPU usage for added latency after a task arrives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 要么完整执行、要么完全不执行的一步操作，其他线程不会看到它执行到一半的中间状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An atomic operation completes as one indivisible step, so no other thread can observe it partially done.

q: 生产者远快于消费者且队列无界时，最危险的结果是什么？
q_en: If producers are much faster than consumers and the queue is unbounded, what is the biggest risk?
options: 队列无限增长直到内存耗尽
消费者自动变快
任务自动丢弃且无影响
系统永远只慢不崩
why: 每个排队任务都是堆上的对象。无界队列在突发流量下会把内存吃光，导致整个服务不可用。
why_en: An unbounded queue can grow until it exhausts memory when producers outpace consumers.
options_en: The queue grows without bound until it exhausts memory.
Consumers automatically get faster.
Tasks get dropped automatically with no consequences.
The system stays slow forever but never crashes.
optionExplanations: 无界队列在生产快于消费时会持续增长，最终耗尽堆内存导致 OOM 和服务不可用。
消费者不会因为队列积压而自动变快。
任务不会自动丢弃，它们堆积在内存中。
系统会逐渐变慢然后崩溃，不是永远只慢。
optionExplanations_en: An unbounded queue keeps growing when producers outpace consumers until it exhausts memory.
Consumers do not automatically speed up due to queue backlog.
Tasks do not automatically drop; they accumulate in memory.
The system will slow down and eventually crash, not stay slow forever.

termDefinitions.meaning: 没有容量上限的队列，会一直接受新任务直到耗尽内存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An unbounded queue has no capacity limit and keeps accepting new items until it runs out of memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 进程内存耗尽引发的崩溃，是无界队列长期积压任务的典型后果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: OOM, an Out-Of-Memory error, is a crash caused by exhausting available memory, a typical result of a queue that grows without bound.

q: 协调机制通常要同时解决哪些事？（多选）
q_en: What does a coordination mechanism usually need to solve? (Select all that apply.)
options: 空时消费者高效等待
满时给生产者反压
并发访问队列本身不损坏数据
让所有业务状态不需要建模
why: 协调工具本身要线程安全，还要处理两端速度不匹配。它不会替你消除所有业务模型。
why_en: A coordination mechanism needs efficient waiting, backpressure, and thread-safe access to the handoff structure.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[Producer] --> B{queue full?}
  B -->|no| C[enqueue]
  B -->|yes| D[block/drop/reject]
  C --> E[Worker takes]
  E --> F[process]
options_en: Consumers wait efficiently when the queue is empty.
Producers get backpressure when the queue is full.
Concurrent access to the queue itself does not corrupt data.
All business state no longer needs to be modeled.
optionExplanations: 消费者需要高效等待空队列，否则就是忙等浪费 CPU，这是协调的基本要求。
满时生产者反压，防止无界积压和 OOM，这是容量保护的关键。
队列自身要线程安全，否则并发访问会损坏数据结构。
协调工具不会替你消除业务状态建模需求。
optionExplanations_en: Consumers must efficiently wait on empty queues to avoid burning CPU, a core coordination requirement.
Backpressure when full prevents unbounded buildup and OOM, essential for capacity protection.
Queue internals must be thread-safe to prevent concurrent access from corrupting the structure.
A coordination mechanism does not eliminate the need to model your business state.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游处理不过来时向上游施加的压力，让生产者放慢速度或被拒绝，防止无限积压。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure is pressure applied back to producers so they slow down or get rejected instead of overwhelming downstream consumers.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个线程同时操作同一个结构，也不会破坏它的正确性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Thread-safe means multiple threads can operate on the same structure at once without corrupting its correctness.

q: 共享状态协调和消息传递协调的核心区别是什么？
q_en: What is the key difference between shared-state coordination and message-passing coordination?
options: 共享状态里线程共读共写同一个结构；消息传递里组件各自持有私有状态、只靠消息通信
共享状态协调只能用在单线程程序里，消息传递只能靠数据库落地
两种协调方式都要求把整个系统代码锁成一段临界区
消息传递协调的实现里不允许出现任何形式的队列或邮箱
why: 阻塞队列是共享结构，生产者消费者都访问它。Actor 则把状态封在各自实体里，外部只能发消息。
why_en: Shared-state coordination uses common data structures, while message passing keeps state owned by components and communicates through messages.
options_en: In shared-state coordination, threads read and write one common structure; in message passing, components hold private state and talk only through messages.
Shared-state coordination only works in single-threaded programs, and message passing can only be done through a database.
Both styles require locking the entire system's code into one critical section.
A message-passing implementation is not allowed to use any kind of queue or mailbox.
tradeoff: 共享结构 + 锁协调 vs 私有状态 + 消息通信
optionExplanations: 共享状态协调让线程共同读写一个结构（如阻塞队列）；消息传递协调把状态封装在组件内部，只靠消息交互。
共享状态协调本身可以支持多线程；消息传递也不要求必须落到数据库。
并不是所有协调方式都需要把整个系统锁成一段临界区，那样并发度太低。
消息传递的常见实现（如 actor 邮箱）本身就是一种队列，只是把它封装在组件内部。
optionExplanations_en: Shared-state coordination has threads read and write one structure together; message passing keeps state inside each component and only talks through messages.
Shared-state coordination can still support many threads, and message passing does not require a database.
Not every coordination style needs to lock the whole system into one critical section; that would kill concurrency.
A common message-passing implementation, the actor mailbox, is itself a queue hidden inside the component.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个线程直接读写同一个数据结构（如队列）来完成协调，需要锁或条件变量保护。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Shared-state coordination has multiple threads read and write the same data structure, such as a queue, protected by locks or condition variables.

termDefinitions.meaning: 组件各自持有私有状态，只通过发送消息来交互，不直接共享内存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Message-passing coordination keeps each component's state private and lets components interact only by sending messages, not by sharing memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 空/满时自动让消费者/生产者阻塞等待的线程安全队列，内部封装了锁和条件变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A blocking queue is a thread-safe queue that automatically blocks consumers when empty and producers when full.

termDefinitions.meaning: 锁住整个系统或很大一段代码路径的粗粒度锁，并发度很低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A global lock serializes a large code path or the whole system, which severely limits how much work can run concurrently.

termDefinitions.meaning: actor 接收消息的队列，多个发送者可以并发写入，但 actor 自己顺序地一条条读取处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A mailbox is the message queue an actor reads from sequentially, even though multiple senders can write to it concurrently.

q: 条件变量为什么要和锁一起使用？
q_en: Why should a condition variable be used together with a lock?
options: 条件检查和 wait/notify 都要在同一把锁保护的共享状态上进行
条件变量会自动帮你创建并提交一个数据库事务
锁存在的唯一目的就是让代码执行变得更慢
对象如果没有锁保护，就完全无法被创建出来
why: 等待的是某个共享条件，例如队列非空或非满。锁保证检查条件、睡眠、修改条件、通知之间的状态一致。
why_en: A condition variable is tied to a lock because the condition being waited on is shared state that must be checked and changed consistently.
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Consumer
  participant L as Lock
  participant P as Producer
  C->>L: lock and check
  C->>L: wait releases lock
  P->>L: lock, add item
  P->>C: notify
  C->>L: re-lock and recheck
options_en: Condition checks and wait/notify must happen on shared state protected by the same lock.
A condition variable automatically creates and commits a database transaction for you.
The only purpose of a lock is to make code run more slowly.
An object cannot be created at all without lock protection.
tradeoff: 各自检查条件的竞态风险 vs 锁统一保护共享状态
optionExplanations: 条件检查、wait、notify 都在读写共享状态，必须由同一把锁保护，否则检查和睡眠之间状态可能被别的线程改掉。
条件变量是线程同步原语，和数据库事务毫无关系。
锁的目的是保护共享状态的一致性，不是故意拖慢代码。
对象创建不依赖锁；锁只在多线程访问共享状态时才需要。
optionExplanations_en: Condition checks, wait, and notify all touch shared state, so they must be protected by the same lock or the state could change between checking and sleeping.
A condition variable is a thread-synchronization primitive and has nothing to do with database transactions.
A lock exists to keep shared state consistent, not to deliberately slow code down.
Object creation does not depend on a lock; locks are only needed when multiple threads touch shared state.

termDefinitions.meaning: 和锁绑定的等待/通知原语，让线程在条件不满足时释放锁并休眠，条件变化后被唤醒重新检查。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A condition variable lets a thread release its lock and sleep until another thread signals that the condition may have changed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保护共享状态、同一时刻只允许一个线程持有的同步原语。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lock is a synchronization primitive that only one thread can hold at a time, used to protect shared state.

termDefinitions.meaning: 条件变量的核心方法：wait 释放锁并休眠，notify/notify_all 唤醒等待线程重新检查条件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Wait and notify are the core condition-variable calls: wait releases the lock and sleeps, while notify wakes waiters to recheck the condition.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一组要么全部成功提交、要么全部回滚的数据库操作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A database transaction is a group of database operations that either all commit successfully or all roll back together.

scenario: 消费者要等待 ready 变成 true；被唤醒后可能还有其他线程抢先改变了条件。
scenario_en: A consumer waits for ready to become true; after it wakes up, another thread may have changed the condition first.
q: 为什么这里必须用 while 而不是 if？
q_en: Why must this use `while` instead of `if`?
codeSample:
with condition:
    while not ready:
        condition.wait()
    do_work()
options: 唤醒后必须重新检查条件，防止虚假唤醒或条件被别人消费
while 会让线程忙等不睡眠
if 在 Python 中不能配合 wait
do_work 必须执行多次
why: wait 返回只代表“被叫醒了”，不代表条件仍成立。while 重新验证共享状态，是条件变量的标准写法。
why_en: The loop rechecks the condition after wakeup because notifications and spurious wakeups do not guarantee the condition still holds.
whenOtherWins: 如果使用高级 BlockingQueue，队列内部已经封装了这段 while/wait 逻辑。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["wait returns"] --> B{"condition true?"}
  B -- no --> C["wait again"]
  C --> A
  B -- yes --> D["continue safely"]
options_en: After waking up you must recheck the condition, because of spurious wakeups or another thread already consuming it.
The while loop makes the thread busy-wait instead of sleeping.
if cannot be used together with wait() in Python.
do_work must run more than once.
tradeoff: 唤醒后只查一次条件(if) vs 唤醒后重新验证(while)
optionExplanations: while 重新检查条件是标准做法，防止虚假唤醒或其他线程消费了条件后当前线程继续错误执行。
while 不会让线程忙等不睡眠——条件不满足时 wait() 仍会睡眠。
if 在 Python 中可以配合 wait()，但只检查一次，容易踩虚假唤醒坑。
do_work 正常情况只执行一次，while 不决定执行次数。
optionExplanations_en: The while loop rechecks the condition after waking to prevent spurious wakeups or other threads consuming the condition.
While does not prevent the thread from sleeping; wait() still sleeps when the condition is false.
If works with wait() in Python but only checks once, risking spurious wakeup bugs.
Do_work executes once normally; the while loop does not determine execution count.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程在没有收到真正通知的情况下也可能被唤醒，因此醒来后必须重新检查条件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A spurious wakeup can wake a thread even without a real notify, so the thread must recheck the condition after waking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 和锁绑定的等待/通知原语，让线程在条件不满足时释放锁并休眠，条件变化后被唤醒重新检查。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A condition variable lets a thread release its lock and sleep until another thread signals that the condition may have changed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程不停轮询条件却不真正休眠，一直占用 CPU 却没做有用的事。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Busy-waiting is a loop that keeps checking a condition without sleeping, so it keeps burning CPU doing no useful work.

termDefinitions.meaning: 条件变量的核心方法：wait 释放锁并休眠，notify/notify_all 唤醒等待线程重新检查条件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Wait and notify are the core condition-variable calls: wait releases the lock and sleeps, while notify wakes waiters to recheck the condition.

termDefinitions.meaning: 空/满时自动让消费者/生产者阻塞等待的线程安全队列，内部封装了锁和条件变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A blocking queue is a thread-safe queue that automatically blocks consumers when empty and producers when full.

q: 在同一个条件变量上同时有生产者和消费者等待时，notify_one 的问题是什么？
q_en: What is the issue with `notify_one` when producers and consumers wait on the same condition variable?
options: 可能唤醒了不能前进的那类线程
一定会唤醒所有线程
会删除队列里的任务
会跳过锁检查
why: 比如消费者释放空间后，真正该醒的是生产者；如果随机叫醒另一个消费者，它发现仍没任务又睡回去。
why_en: Notify-one can wake the wrong kind of waiter when producers and consumers share one condition variable.
