options_en: It might wake the type of thread that still cannot make progress.
It always wakes every waiting thread.
It deletes tasks that are sitting in the queue.
It skips the lock check entirely.
tradeoff: 唤醒一个省开销 vs 唤醒全部保正确
optionExplanations: notify_one 会随机唤醒一个等待线程，如果唤醒了无关的线程类型，它发现条件不满足就重新睡眠，浪费唤醒。
notify_one 只唤醒一个线程，不是所有线程。
notify 不删除队列中的任务。
notify 不涉及锁检查跳过。
optionExplanations_en: Notify-one wakes an arbitrary waiter; if it wakes the wrong type, it goes back to sleep, wasting the notification.
Notify-one wakes exactly one thread, not all of them.
Notification does not delete tasks from the queue.
Notification does not bypass lock checking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 和锁绑定的等待/通知原语，让线程在条件不满足时释放锁并休眠，条件变化后被唤醒重新检查。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A condition variable lets a thread release its lock and sleep until another thread signals that the condition may have changed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只随机唤醒一个等待线程，可能唤醒了当前用不上的那类线程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Notify-one wakes a single arbitrary waiter, which might be the wrong kind of thread for the change that just happened.

termDefinitions.meaning: 唤醒该条件变量上所有等待线程，安全但可能造成大量线程被无谓叫醒。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Notify-all wakes every thread waiting on the condition variable, which is safe but can wake many threads unnecessarily.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保护共享状态、同一时刻只允许一个线程持有的同步原语。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lock is a synchronization primitive that only one thread can hold at a time, used to protect shared state.

scenario: 有界队列同时需要等待“非空”和“非满”，并且希望避免 notify_all 唤醒大量无关线程。
scenario_en: A bounded queue needs to wait for both not-empty and not-full, while avoiding `notify_all` waking many unrelated threads.
q: 更精确的实现通常怎么做？
q_en: What is the more precise implementation?
options: 拆成两个条件变量：not_empty 唤醒消费者，not_full 唤醒生产者
只维护一个全局布尔标志位表示队列非空非满
让所有等待线程固定 sleep 100ms 后再重新检查
生产者永远不等待，直接丢弃满队列时的新任务
why: 分开条件变量能把通知发给真正能继续的一类线程。它减少无谓唤醒和锁竞争。
why_en: Separate not-empty and not-full conditions wake the right side of a bounded queue and avoid unnecessary wakeups.
whenOtherWins: 面试中通常不需要手写它，直接使用语言自带 BlockingQueue 更简洁。
options_en: Split it into two condition variables: not-empty wakes consumers, not-full wakes producers.
Just keep one global boolean flag for whether the queue is non-empty and non-full.
Have every waiting thread sleep a fixed 100ms then recheck.
Never let producers wait; just drop new items when the queue is full.
tradeoff: 单一条件变量简单 vs 拆分条件变量精准唤醒
optionExplanations: 拆分成 not_empty/not_full 两个条件变量，能精准只唤醒真正能继续的那一类线程，减少无谓唤醒。
单个布尔标志位无法配合 wait/notify 实现真正的阻塞等待，还是需要条件变量。
固定 sleep 100ms 又回到了轮询的老问题：浪费 CPU 或增加延迟。
生产者永不等待、直接丢弃任务违反了满时反压的要求，会丢数据。
optionExplanations_en: Splitting into not-empty and not-full conditions wakes exactly the type of thread that can proceed, cutting wasted wakeups.
A single boolean flag cannot support real blocking wait/notify; you still need a condition variable.
Fixed 100ms sleeping brings back the polling problem: wasted CPU or added latency.
A producer that never waits and just drops tasks breaks the backpressure requirement and loses data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 和锁绑定的等待/通知原语，让线程在条件不满足时释放锁并休眠，条件变化后被唤醒重新检查。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A condition variable lets a thread release its lock and sleep until another thread signals that the condition may have changed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 唤醒该条件变量上所有等待线程，安全但可能造成大量线程被无谓叫醒。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Notify-all wakes every thread waiting on the condition variable, which is safe but can wake many threads unnecessarily.

termDefinitions.meaning: 设置了最大容量的队列，满了之后新元素必须等待、超时或被拒绝。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bounded queue has a maximum capacity, so once full, new items must wait, time out, or be rejected.

scenario: 你要实现后台任务调度器，多个 API handler submit，多个 worker get，空和满都要自动阻塞。
scenario_en: You are building a background task scheduler where many API handlers submit tasks and many workers get tasks; empty and full states should block automatically.
q: 默认应选哪种结构？
q_en: Which structure should you choose by default?
options: 用普通 ArrayList 加一把手写的 synchronized 锁自己控制
有界 BlockingQueue，比如 queue.Queue(maxsize=1000)
来一个任务就 new 一个新线程，完全不设线程数上限
用 ReadWriteLock 包一个 int 当作队列长度计数器
why: 阻塞队列已经把锁、条件变量、线程安全和阻塞语义封装好。面试里直接用它比手写 wait/notify 更稳。
why_en: A bounded blocking queue is the default because it packages the synchronization and blocking behavior needed for producer-consumer handoff.
whenOtherWins: 如果每个实体有独立状态和生命周期，Actor 可能更能表达所有权。
diagram:
flowchart LR
  P1["producer"] --> Q[(bounded queue)]
  P2["producer"] --> Q
  Q --> W1["worker"]
  Q --> W2["worker"]
  Q --> B["backpressure when full"]
options_en: Use a plain ArrayList with a hand-written synchronized lock.
A bounded BlockingQueue, such as queue.Queue(maxsize=1000).
Spawn a new thread per task with no limit on thread count.
Wrap an int in a ReadWriteLock to track the queue length.
tradeoff: 手写同步原语 vs 复用标准阻塞队列
optionExplanations: 手写锁能实现，但要自己正确处理 wait/notify、虚假唤醒等细节，容易出错。
有界 BlockingQueue 已经封装好锁、条件变量、阻塞语义，是面试首选。
不设上限的每任务新线程会导致线程数爆炸，耗尽系统资源。
读写锁只优化并发读，不能实现队列的入队出队和阻塞等待。
optionExplanations_en: A hand-rolled lock can work, but you must correctly handle wait/notify and spurious wakeups yourself, which is error-prone.
A bounded BlockingQueue already packages the lock, condition variables, and blocking semantics, the default interview answer.
Spinning up a new unbounded thread per task causes thread explosion and exhausts system resources.
A read-write lock only optimizes concurrent reads; it cannot implement enqueue, dequeue, and blocking waits.

termDefinitions.meaning: 空/满时自动让消费者/生产者阻塞等待的线程安全队列，内部封装了锁和条件变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A blocking queue is a thread-safe queue that automatically blocks consumers when empty and producers when full.

termDefinitions.meaning: Python 标准库提供的阻塞队列实现，put/get 默认会阻塞，可用 maxsize 设置容量上限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Queue.Queue is Python's standard-library blocking queue, where put and get block by default and maxsize bounds capacity.

termDefinitions.meaning: Java 里给方法或代码块加互斥锁的关键字，同一时刻只允许一个线程进入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Synchronized is a Java keyword that puts a mutual-exclusion lock on a method or block, letting only one thread enter at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保护共享状态、同一时刻只允许一个线程持有的同步原语。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lock is a synchronization primitive that only one thread can hold at a time, used to protect shared state.

termDefinitions.meaning: 允许多个读者并发读取、但写者独占访问的锁，适合读多写少的场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read-write lock lets many readers proceed concurrently while a writer needs exclusive access, useful when reads far outnumber writes.

scenario: 任务调度器要让 submit 在队列满时停住，worker 在队列空时停住。
scenario_en: The task scheduler should make submit stop when the queue is full and workers stop when the queue is empty.
q: 下面代码中 `put` 和 `get` 的并发含义是什么？
q_en: What do `put` and `get` mean for concurrency in this code?
options: put 满时阻塞，get 空时阻塞，队列内部负责同步
put 会丢弃旧任务，get 忙等
maxsize 只影响日志
每个 task 都自动运行在新进程
why: 这正是生产者消费者的基本形状。队列是同步边界，worker 不需要自己轮询。
why_en: The queue blocks producers when full and consumers when empty while handling synchronization internally.
whenOtherWins: 请求路径不能长时间阻塞时，改用带 timeout 的 put/offer，并在满时返回错误。
options_en: Put blocks when full, get blocks when empty, and the queue handles synchronization internally.
Put drops old tasks and get busy-waits.
maxsize only affects logging.
Every task automatically runs in a brand-new process.
tradeoff: 无界始终不阻塞 vs 有界阻塞换内存安全
optionExplanations: put 在队列满时阻塞生产者，get 在空时阻塞消费者，这是阻塞队列的标准协调语义。
put 不会丢弃旧任务，get 不会忙等，这正是阻塞队列相比忙等的优势。
maxsize 直接影响队列行为，不仅仅是日志。
任务在当前线程或 worker 线程内执行，不自动新建进程。
optionExplanations_en: Put blocks when full and get blocks when empty; the queue handles synchronization.
Put does not drop tasks and get does not busy-wait; that is the advantage of blocking.
Maxsize directly controls queue behavior, not just logging.
Tasks run in the worker thread, not in a new process.

termDefinitions.meaning: 阻塞队列的出入队方法：put/take 会阻塞等待，offer 可以带超时或立即返回而不阻塞。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Put and take block when the queue is full or empty, while offer can time out or return immediately instead of blocking.

termDefinitions.meaning: Python 标准库提供的阻塞队列实现，put/get 默认会阻塞，可用 maxsize 设置容量上限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Queue.Queue is Python's standard-library blocking queue, where put and get block by default and maxsize bounds capacity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程不停轮询条件却不真正休眠，一直占用 CPU 却没做有用的事。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Busy-waiting is a loop that keeps checking a condition without sleeping, so it keeps burning CPU doing no useful work.

termDefinitions.meaning: 操作系统级别的独立执行单元，通常不与其他进程共享内存，和线程不同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A process is an OS-level unit of execution that, unlike a thread, typically does not share memory with other processes.

scenario: worker 稳定吞吐是每秒 100 个任务；团队希望缓冲区能扛住约 10 秒的突发而不丢请求。
scenario_en: Workers sustain 100 tasks per second, and the team wants the buffer to absorb about 10 seconds of burst without dropping requests.
q: “积压时长 × 处理速率”这条估算公式，主要支持哪条队列容量设计判断？
q_en: What queue-capacity decision is supported by the estimate backlog time times processing rate?
options: 容量该按可容忍积压时长和消费速率一起估，而不是随手设一个数
只要设置了 maxsize，请求就永远不会被拒绝
worker 数量该按瞬时峰值并发设置，不用管平均速率
队列容量越大，端到端延迟就一定越低
why: 容量估算公式是容量 ≈ 可承受积压时长 × 消费速率，这里 10 秒 × 100 个/秒 ≈ 1,000。这个数字用来定内存预算和满队列策略的基线，不是让你死记 1,000 本身。
why_en: Size the queue as tolerated backlog time times throughput, about ten seconds times one hundred giving roughly a thousand, which sets your memory budget and full-queue policy rather than being a number to memorize.
options_en: Size capacity from the tolerable backlog duration together with the consumption rate, not an arbitrary number.
As long as maxsize is set, requests will never be rejected.
Worker count should be sized for the instantaneous peak, ignoring the average rate.
A bigger queue capacity always means lower end-to-end latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 设置了最大容量的队列，满了之后新元素必须等待、超时或被拒绝。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bounded queue has a maximum capacity, so once full, new items must wait, time out, or be rejected.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游处理不过来时向上游施加的压力，让生产者放慢速度或被拒绝，防止无限积压。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure is pressure applied back to producers so they slow down or get rejected instead of overwhelming downstream consumers.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单位时间内系统能处理完成的任务数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Throughput is the number of tasks a system can complete per unit of time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个任务在重叠的时间段内同时进行，不一定同一时刻执行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Concurrency means multiple tasks progress during overlapping time periods, not necessarily executing at the exact same instant.

q: 队列满时，哪些处理策略是合理的？（多选）
q_en: When a queue is full, which handling policies are reasonable? (Select all that apply.)
options: 内部流水线可阻塞生产者
请求路径可带超时后返回 503
可丢弃并记录无关紧要的分析事件
永远使用无界队列避免思考
why: 满队列策略取决于业务：能等就阻塞，不能等就限时失败，允许损失就丢弃。无界队列只是把问题推到 OOM。
why_en: Full-queue behavior should match the workload: block, timeout and reject, or drop lossy work instead of using an unbounded queue.
options_en: An internal pipeline can block producers.
A request path can use a timeout and return a 503.
You can drop and log lossy analytics events.
Always use an unbounded queue so you never have to think about it.
tradeoff: 队列满时阻塞等待 vs 超时拒绝 vs 丢弃数据（按业务选）
optionExplanations: 内部流水线可以选择阻塞生产者，给下游反压，这是合理的设计。
请求路径超时失败比永久挂起更好，给用户可预知的延迟。
分析事件允许丢失，满时丢弃比拖垮主业务更合理。
无界队列只是把问题推到 OOM，这不是合理策略。
optionExplanations_en: An internal pipeline can block producers to provide backpressure, a valid strategy.
Request-path timeout and rejection is better than hanging indefinitely.
Analytics events are lossy, so dropping at capacity is better than blocking the main request.
Using an unbounded queue just pushes the problem to memory exhaustion.

termDefinitions.meaning: 表示服务暂时不可用的 HTTP 状态码，用于告诉调用方过载了，可以稍后重试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable is a status code telling the caller the service is temporarily overloaded and it should retry later.

termDefinitions.meaning: 没有容量上限的队列，会一直接受新任务直到耗尽内存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An unbounded queue has no capacity limit and keeps accepting new items until it runs out of memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游处理不过来时向上游施加的压力，让生产者放慢速度或被拒绝，防止无限积压。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure is pressure applied back to producers so they slow down or get rejected instead of overwhelming downstream consumers.

scenario: HTTP 请求线程想入队购买请求，但不能无限等；如果 100ms 内没有队列空间，应让用户稍后重试。
scenario_en: An HTTP request thread wants to enqueue a purchase request but cannot wait forever; if no space opens within 100ms, the user should retry later.
q: 应使用哪类队列操作？
q_en: Which kind of queue operation should you use?
options: put/offer 加 timeout=0.1，超时就返回 503 一类的过载错误
调用不带超时的 put()，请求线程可能永远卡在这里
换成完全无界的队列，put() 永远立刻成功
busy-wait 忙等，一直重试直到队列腾出空位
why: 请求路径需要可控延迟。带超时的入队既提供反压，又避免线程无限挂住。
why_en: A timeout-based enqueue gives backpressure while keeping the request path from blocking indefinitely.
whenOtherWins: 纯内部批处理管线没有用户等待时，阻塞生产者可能更简单。
options_en: Use put/offer with timeout=0.1, and return a 503-style overload error on timeout.
Call put() with no timeout, so the request thread might block forever.
Switch to a fully unbounded queue so put() always succeeds instantly.
Busy-wait, retrying continuously until the queue has space.
tradeoff: 无限期阻塞请求线程 vs 限时入队快速失败
optionExplanations: 带超时的 put/offer 既给瞬时空位一个机会，又能在超时后快速返回过载错误，符合请求路径的可控延迟要求。
不带超时的 put() 会无限期阻塞请求线程，违反不能无限等的要求。
无界队列虽然让 put() 总是立刻成功，但把问题换成了内存耗尽风险。
busy-wait 会浪费 CPU，而且仍然可能超过用户能接受的等待时间。
optionExplanations_en: A timed put/offer gives a brief chance for space to free up, then fails fast with an overload error, matching the request path's need for bounded delay.
An untimed put() can block the request thread forever, breaking the requirement of not waiting indefinitely.
An unbounded queue makes put() always succeed immediately, but trades the problem for a memory-exhaustion risk.
Busy-waiting wastes CPU and can still exceed how long a user is willing to wait.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次阻塞操作最多愿意等待的时长，超过就放弃并返回失败，而不是无限期等下去。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A timeout is the maximum time a blocking call waits before giving up and returning failure instead of waiting forever.

termDefinitions.meaning: 表示服务暂时不可用的 HTTP 状态码，用于告诉调用方过载了，可以稍后重试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable is a status code telling the caller the service is temporarily overloaded and it should retry later.

termDefinitions.meaning: 没有容量上限的队列，会一直接受新任务直到耗尽内存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An unbounded queue has no capacity limit and keeps accepting new items until it runs out of memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程不停轮询条件却不真正休眠，一直占用 CPU 却没做有用的事。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Busy-waiting is a loop that keeps checking a condition without sleeping, so it keeps burning CPU doing no useful work.

termDefinitions.meaning: 阻塞队列的出入队方法：put/take 会阻塞等待，offer 可以带超时或立即返回而不阻塞。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Put and take block when the queue is full or empty, while offer can time out or return immediately instead of blocking.

q: 阻塞队列的 put/take 被中断时，最糟糕的处理是什么？
q_en: What is the worst way to handle an interrupted blocking-queue put or take?
options: 捕获 InterruptedException 后什么也不做，继续处理下一个任务
捕获后直接把这个异常重新向上层方法抛出
捕获后调用 interrupt() 恢复线程的中断标志位
捕获后 break 跳出循环，结束这个 worker 线程
why: 中断通常是上层要求线程停止。吞掉它会让关闭流程失效，线程继续卡在后台。
why_en: Swallowing interruption loses the shutdown signal and can leave blocked workers running when they should stop.
options_en: Catch InterruptedException, do nothing, and keep processing the next task.
Catch it and immediately rethrow the exception to the caller.
Catch it and call interrupt() to restore the thread's interrupt flag.
Catch it and break out of the loop to end this worker thread.
tradeoff: 吞掉中断信号继续跑 vs 传播/恢复中断以配合关闭
optionExplanations: 吞掉中断异常且继续运行，等于无视了停止这个线程的信号，关闭流程会失效。
把异常继续往上抛，让调用者有机会正确处理关闭逻辑，是安全的做法之一。
捕获后恢复中断标志位，能让上层代码之后还能感知到这个线程曾被中断过。
捕获后直接退出循环结束 worker，是常见的优雅关闭实现方式。
optionExplanations_en: Swallowing the interrupt and continuing ignores the signal to stop this thread, so shutdown logic silently fails.
Re-throwing the exception upward lets the caller handle shutdown correctly, a safe response.
Restoring the interrupt flag after catching lets later code still detect that this thread was interrupted.
Breaking out of the loop to end the worker is a common graceful-shutdown implementation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程在阻塞调用中被其他线程中断时抛出的异常，代表上层要求这个线程停止。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: InterruptedException is thrown when a thread blocked in a call like put or take is interrupted by another thread asking it to stop.

termDefinitions.meaning: 空/满时自动让消费者/生产者阻塞等待的线程安全队列，内部封装了锁和条件变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A blocking queue is a thread-safe queue that automatically blocks consumers when empty and producers when full.

termDefinitions.meaning: 阻塞队列的出入队方法：put/take 会阻塞等待，offer 可以带超时或立即返回而不阻塞。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Put and take block when the queue is full or empty, while offer can time out or return immediately instead of blocking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从队列取任务并执行的后台线程，通常成组存在（worker pool）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A worker is a background thread that pulls tasks from a queue and executes them, usually running as part of a worker pool.

q: worker 永久阻塞在 take() 时，哪些优雅关闭方式合理？（多选）
q_en: If workers can block forever in take(), which graceful shutdown approaches are reasonable? (Select all that apply.)
options: interrupt worker，让 take 抛中断异常
poll(timeout) 周期性检查 shutdown flag
给每个 worker 放一个 poison pill sentinel
直接让线程忙等空队列
why: 三种方式都能让阻塞中的 worker 有机会醒来并退出。忙等不是优雅关闭策略。
why_en: Interrupts, timeout polling, and poison pills are common ways to wake blocked workers for graceful shutdown.
options_en: Interrupt the worker so take() throws an interrupt exception.
Use poll(timeout) to periodically check a shutdown flag.
Give each worker one poison-pill sentinel.
Just let the thread busy-wait on an empty queue.
optionExplanations: 中断打断 take() 的阻塞，worker 可以捕获异常并退出，这是标准 Java/Python 关闭方式。
Poll 带 timeout 周期检查 shutdown flag，虽然开销高但也可行。
毒丸 poison pill 是同一队列路径上的 sentinel，每个 worker 消费一个后退出。
忙等浪费 CPU，不是优雅关闭方式。
optionExplanations_en: Interrupting breaks the take() blocking so workers can catch the exception and exit.
Poll with timeout checks a shutdown flag periodically, though less efficient.
Poison pills are sentinels in the same queue, one per worker to signal exit.
Busy-waiting wastes CPU and is not graceful.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程在阻塞调用中被其他线程中断时抛出的异常，代表上层要求这个线程停止。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: InterruptedException is thrown when a thread blocked in a call like put or take is interrupted by another thread asking it to stop.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次阻塞操作最多愿意等待的时长，超过就放弃并返回失败，而不是无限期等下去。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A timeout is the maximum time a blocking call waits before giving up and returning failure instead of waiting forever.

termDefinitions.term: poison pill（毒丸 / 哨兵任务）
termDefinitions.meaning: 放进队列里的特殊哨兵任务，worker 取到它就知道该退出循环而不是继续等下一个真实任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A poison pill is a special sentinel task placed on the queue that tells a worker to exit its loop instead of waiting for more real work.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程不停轮询条件却不真正休眠，一直占用 CPU 却没做有用的事。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Busy-waiting is a loop that keeps checking a condition without sleeping, so it keeps burning CPU doing no useful work.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个共享的布尔变量，被设为 true 后线程在下一次检查时得知该退出了。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shutdown flag is a shared boolean that, once set to true, tells a thread to exit the next time it checks.

q: 把 poison pill 关闭 worker 的步骤排好：
q_en: Put the poison-pill worker shutdown steps in order:
steps: 每个 worker 从队列取任务并检查是否是 sentinel
请求关闭时，向队列放入与 worker 数量相同的 sentinel
普通任务继续按原逻辑处理
worker 取到 sentinel 后退出循环
why: 毒丸模式依赖 sentinel 走同一条队列路径。每个 worker 都需要一个退出信号，否则可能有 worker 永久等待。
why_en: Poison-pill shutdown sends one sentinel per worker through the same queue so each worker can consume a stop signal.

termDefinitions.term: poison pill（毒丸 / 哨兵任务）
termDefinitions.meaning: 放进队列里的特殊哨兵任务，worker 取到它就知道该退出循环而不是继续等下一个真实任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A poison pill is a special sentinel task placed on the queue that tells a worker to exit its loop instead of waiting for more real work.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从队列取任务并执行的后台线程，通常成组存在（worker pool）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A worker is a background thread that pulls tasks from a queue and executes them, usually running as part of a worker pool.

q: Actor 模型的三个核心特征是什么？
q_en: What are the three core traits of the Actor model?
options: 邮箱、一次处理一条消息、可以给其他 actor 发消息
共享内存状态、多线程同时读写、显式加锁保护
每次调用都同步阻塞等待返回结果，类似远程函数调用
所有 actor 共用同一个邮箱，顺序竞争同一把锁
why: Actor 通过邮箱接收消息，内部顺序处理，因此 actor 自己的状态不会被多个线程同时访问。
why_en: An actor has a mailbox, processes one message at a time, and communicates by sending messages to other actors.
options_en: A mailbox, processing one message at a time, and the ability to send messages to other actors.
Shared memory state, multiple threads reading and writing it, and explicit lock protection.
Every call synchronously blocks and waits for a return value, like a remote procedure call.
All actors share the exact same mailbox and take turns on one lock.
optionExplanations: 消息按顺序进邮箱、再一条条被取出执行，同一时刻只跑一条，所以天然不会有并发访问冲突。
这描述的是共享状态协调（如普通多线程+锁），正是 actor 想避免的模型，不是 actor 的特征。
Actor 默认异步、发完消息立刻返回，不是同步阻塞等待结果，除非显式实现 ask 模式。
每个 actor 有自己独立的邮箱，不会和其他 actor 共用同一个邮箱或锁。
optionExplanations_en: An actor receives messages through its mailbox and processes one at a time without interruption, so its internal state is naturally serialized.
This describes shared-state coordination with locks, exactly what actors are designed to avoid, not an actor trait.
Actors are asynchronous by default and return right after sending; they don't block for a result unless you build an explicit ask pattern.
Each actor owns its own private mailbox; actors do not share one mailbox or lock with each other.

termDefinitions.meaning: actor 接收消息的队列，多个发送者可以并发写入，但 actor 自己顺序地一条条读取处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A mailbox is the message queue an actor reads from sequentially, even though multiple senders can write to it concurrently.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 actor 拥有私有状态和邮箱，一次只处理一条消息，只能通过发消息和外界交互。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The actor model gives each actor private state and a mailbox, processes one message at a time, and interacts with others only by sending messages.

termDefinitions.meaning: 部分 Actor 框架提供的 request-response 封装：发消息后立刻拿到一个未来会有结果的句柄。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The ask pattern is a request-response helper some actor frameworks provide, returning a future that resolves once the reply message arrives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保护共享状态、同一时刻只允许一个线程持有的同步原语。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lock is a synchronization primitive that only one thread can hold at a time, used to protect shared state.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个线程直接读写同一个数据结构（如队列）来完成协调，需要锁或条件变量保护。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Shared-state coordination has multiple threads read and write the same data structure, such as a queue, protected by locks or condition variables.

q: Actor 与“共享阻塞队列 + 多 worker”在状态所有权上的差别是？
q_en: How do Actors differ from a shared blocking queue plus multiple workers in state ownership?
options: Actor 状态私有、顺序处理消息；多 worker 共享的业务对象仍可能要加锁
Actor 必须把自己所有字段都设成公开、共享给其他 actor 读写
阻塞队列这种结构内部完全没有做任何线程安全保证
Actor 和多 worker 两种模型都完全不支持异步处理任务
why: 阻塞队列只解决任务交接，不自动保护任务处理时访问的共享业务对象。Actor 把状态绑定到单个消息处理者。
why_en: Actors own and serialize access to their state, whereas queue workers may still need locks around shared business data.
options_en: Actors keep private state and process sequentially; workers sharing business objects may still need locks.
An actor must make all of its fields public and shared with other actors.
A blocking queue provides no thread-safety guarantees at all internally.
Neither actors nor multiple workers support asynchronous processing.
tradeoff: 共享队列仍需锁保护业务对象 vs actor 独占状态无需内部锁
optionExplanations: Actor 拥有私有状态、顺序处理消息，内部不需要锁；多 worker 共享阻塞队列以外的业务对象时仍可能需要锁。
Actor 的核心正是状态私有封装，不会把字段公开给其他 actor 直接读写。
阻塞队列本身是线程安全的，内部已经用锁/条件变量保护了自己的数据结构。
Actor 和阻塞队列 + worker 都是支持异步处理的协调方式。
optionExplanations_en: Actors own private state and process sequentially with no internal lock needed; workers sharing business objects outside the queue may still need locks.
An actor's core idea is private, encapsulated state, not exposing fields for other actors to read and write directly.
A blocking queue is itself thread-safe; it already uses locks or condition variables to protect its own structure.
Both actors and blocking-queue-plus-workers are asynchronous coordination styles.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 actor 拥有私有状态和邮箱，一次只处理一条消息，只能通过发消息和外界交互。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The actor model gives each actor private state and a mailbox, processes one message at a time, and interacts with others only by sending messages.

termDefinitions.meaning: 空/满时自动让消费者/生产者阻塞等待的线程安全队列，内部封装了锁和条件变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A blocking queue is a thread-safe queue that automatically blocks consumers when empty and producers when full.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保护共享状态、同一时刻只允许一个线程持有的同步原语。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lock is a synchronization primitive that only one thread can hold at a time, used to protect shared state.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个线程同时操作同一个结构，也不会破坏它的正确性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Thread-safe means multiple threads can operate on the same structure at once without corrupting its correctness.

scenario: 聊天系统、游戏房间或交易 order book 有许多独立实体，每个实体有自己的状态，偶尔互相通信。
scenario_en: A chat system, game room system, or trading order book has many independent entities, each with its own state, that occasionally communicate.
q: 除了阻塞队列，哪种模型值得提？
q_en: Besides a blocking queue, which model is worth mentioning?
options: Actor 模型
Singleton for every entity
全局静态 map 任意线程可写
只用 Builder 模式
why: Actor 适合大量独立、有状态、事件驱动的实体。每个实体顺序处理自己的消息，减少内部锁。
why_en: Actors fit many independent stateful entities because each one processes its own messages sequentially.
whenOtherWins: 如果问题只是“后台处理这些任务”，一个有界阻塞队列和 worker pool 更简单。
options_en: The actor model.
A Singleton for every entity.
A global static map any thread can write to.
Just the Builder pattern.
tradeoff: 简单流水线用阻塞队列 vs 多独立有状态实体用 Actor
optionExplanations: 每个实体独立状态和邮箱，Actor 模型特别适合这类场景，减少内部锁竞争。
为每个实体创建 Singleton 既麻烦又容易出错。
全局 map 任意线程可写会导致并发问题。
Builder 模式只是对象创建方式，解决不了多实体协调问题。
optionExplanations_en: Actors fit well when each entity has independent state and events; they reduce internal lock contention.
Creating a Singleton for each entity is cumbersome and error-prone.
A global map writable by any thread invites concurrency bugs.
Builder pattern is a creation pattern and does not solve entity coordination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 actor 拥有私有状态和邮箱，一次只处理一条消息，只能通过发消息和外界交互。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The actor model gives each actor private state and a mailbox, processes one message at a time, and interacts with others only by sending messages.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保证一个类在整个进程里只有一个实例的创建型设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton is a creational pattern that guarantees a class has only one instance in the process.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过链式步骤逐步组装出一个复杂对象的创建型设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Builder is a creational pattern that assembles a complex object through a chain of construction steps.

termDefinitions.meaning: 记录某个交易品种当前所有买卖挂单价格和数量的核心数据结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An order book is the core data structure recording the current buy and sell orders for a trading instrument.

q: Actor 模型会带来哪些新问题？（多选）
q_en: What new issues does the Actor model introduce? (Select all that apply.)
options: 邮箱可能溢出
不同发送者到同一 actor 的全局顺序不一定可控
异步消息链更难调试
actor 内部必须手写每个字段锁
why: Actor 消除了很多共享状态锁，但不是免费午餐。邮箱容量、消息顺序、追踪和 request-response 都要设计。
why_en: Actors trade lock races for concerns like mailbox overflow, message ordering, tracing, and asynchronous request-response patterns.
options_en: The mailbox can overflow.
The global order of messages from different senders to the same actor is not guaranteed.
Asynchronous message chains are harder to debug.
Inside an actor you must hand-write a lock for every field.
optionExplanations: 邮箱无界时可能在突发消息下内存耗尽，这是 Actor 系统需要考虑的。
多个发送者到同一 actor 的消息全局顺序不一定一致，取决于网络和线程调度。
异步消息链需要追踪 request ID、回复地址等，比同步调用复杂。
actor 内部状态顺序化，不需要每个字段单独加锁。
optionExplanations_en: Unbounded mailboxes can exhaust memory under message bursts.
Global message order from multiple senders to one actor is not guaranteed without explicit ordering.
Asynchronous message chains need request IDs and reply addresses, harder to debug than sync calls.
Actor state is serialized; fields do not need individual locks.

termDefinitions.meaning: actor 接收消息的队列，多个发送者可以并发写入，但 actor 自己顺序地一条条读取处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A mailbox is the message queue an actor reads from sequentially, even though multiple senders can write to it concurrently.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 actor 拥有私有状态和邮箱，一次只处理一条消息，只能通过发消息和外界交互。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The actor model gives each actor private state and a mailbox, processes one message at a time, and interacts with others only by sending messages.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保护共享状态、同一时刻只允许一个线程持有的同步原语。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lock is a synchronization primitive that only one thread can hold at a time, used to protect shared state.

scenario: 图片上传后需要压缩、生成缩略图并上传存储；这些操作耗时几秒，但上传接口应快速返回。
scenario_en: After an image upload, the system must compress it, generate thumbnails, and upload to storage; this takes seconds, but the upload API should return quickly.
q: 识别到的并发模式是什么？
q_en: Which concurrency pattern does this point to?
options: 生产者消费者异步处理
读写锁优化读取
CAS 更新单个计数器
装饰器叠加功能
why: API handler 生产处理任务，后台 worker 消费任务。核心是把慢流程从请求路径移走。
why_en: This is producer-consumer async processing because the API enqueues slow image work for background workers.
whenOtherWins: 如果接口必须等缩略图 URL 才能返回，就需要同步处理或返回 pending 状态并让客户端轮询。
options_en: Producer-consumer asynchronous processing.
Read-write locks to optimize reads.
CAS to update a single counter.
Stacking behavior with the decorator pattern.
tradeoff: 同步等待处理完成 vs 异步入队立即返回
optionExplanations: API 入队任务，后台 worker 处理压缩和上传，这正是生产者消费者异步处理模式。
读写锁优化读取，但这里主要是处理延迟问题。
CAS 更新计数器是原子操作，无法解决处理耗时问题。
装饰器只是设计模式，不能异步化处理。
optionExplanations_en: The API enqueues image work and workers compress and upload, which is producer-consumer async processing.
Read-write locks optimize reads but do not address processing delay.
CAS on a counter is atomic but does not defer slow processing.
Decorator is a pattern and cannot make work asynchronous.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生产者生成任务放入队列，消费者从队列取出任务处理，两端速度不必相同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In producer-consumer, producers generate tasks into a queue while consumers pull tasks out and process them, even at different speeds.

termDefinitions.meaning: 允许多个读者并发读取、但写者独占访问的锁，适合读多写少的场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read-write lock lets many readers proceed concurrently while a writer needs exclusive access, useful when reads far outnumber writes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种无锁原子操作，只有当内存里的值仍等于期望值时才写入新值，否则失败重试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CAS, Compare-And-Swap, is a lock-free atomic operation that writes a new value only if the current value still matches an expected value.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在不修改原对象代码的前提下，给对象动态附加新行为的结构型设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Decorator is a structural pattern that attaches new behavior to an object without modifying its original code.

scenario: 平时 100 rps，演唱会开票瞬间 10,000 rps，worker 按稳定速率处理购买请求。
scenario_en: Traffic is usually 100 rps, but a concert ticket launch spikes to 10,000 rps while workers process purchase requests at a steady rate.
q: 队列在这里的主要价值是什么？
q_en: What is the main value of a queue here?
options: 吸收突发流量，把瞬时尖峰平滑成 worker 能承受的处理速率
保证购票请求从进队列到处理完全没有任何排队延迟
彻底替代掉扣减库存时需要的那把锁
让后端数据库的写入吞吐跟着无限扩容
why: 队列是缓冲层，让短时间尖峰不直接打到下游。容量必须有界，满时要反压或拒绝。
why_en: A bounded queue buffers bursty traffic and smooths it into the sustained processing rate of workers.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务必须立即完成且不能排队，就需要同步容量保护、限流或直接拒绝。
options_en: Absorb the burst, smoothing the spike into a rate workers can sustain.
Guarantee there is zero queueing delay from enqueue to processing.
Completely replace the lock needed for decrementing inventory.
Let the backend database's write throughput scale without limit.
tradeoff: 尖峰直接打到下游 vs 队列缓冲平滑成稳定速率
optionExplanations: 队列缓冲突发请求，worker 仍按自己能承受的稳定速率处理，这是队列在这里的核心价值。
队列不能消除排队延迟，只是把不可控的尖峰变成可控、有界的等待。
队列解决的是任务交接问题，不替代扣减库存这类业务操作本身需要的锁。
队列本身不会提升下游数据库的写入吞吐，只是让请求到达下游的速率更平稳。
optionExplanations_en: The queue buffers bursty requests so workers keep processing at a rate they can sustain, which is its core value here.
The queue does not eliminate queueing delay; it turns an uncontrolled spike into a bounded, predictable wait.
The queue solves handoff, not the lock still needed for the inventory-decrement business operation itself.
The queue does not raise the downstream database's write throughput; it only smooths the rate at which requests arrive.

termDefinitions.meaning: 设置了最大容量的队列，满了之后新元素必须等待、超时或被拒绝。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bounded queue has a maximum capacity, so once full, new items must wait, time out, or be rejected.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游处理不过来时向上游施加的压力，让生产者放慢速度或被拒绝，防止无限积压。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure is pressure applied back to producers so they slow down or get rejected instead of overwhelming downstream consumers.

scenario: 购票 API 需要在队列暂时满时快速失败，而不是把请求线程永久挂住。
scenario_en: The ticketing API should fail fast when the queue is temporarily full instead of keeping the request thread blocked forever.
q: 这段 `timeout=0.1` 的作用是什么？
q_en: What is the purpose of `timeout=0.1` in this code?
options: 最多等 100ms 入队，失败则显式返回过载错误
让任务正好 100ms 后执行
让队列变成无界
让 worker 数量变成 0.1
why: 请求线程需要受控等待。短超时给瞬时空位一个机会，同时避免用户请求无限卡住。
why_en: The short enqueue timeout gives brief backpressure but fails fast with an overload error if the queue stays full.
whenOtherWins: 内部离线管线可以选择长期阻塞生产者，而不是向用户返回错误。
options_en: Wait at most 100ms to enqueue, then explicitly return an overload error on failure.
Make the task execute exactly 100ms later.
Turn the queue unbounded.
Make the worker count become 0.1.
tradeoff: 长期阻塞等待空位 vs 短超时快速失败
optionExplanations: 超时 0.1 秒给瞬时空位一个机会，但快速失败并返回过载错误，保护请求线程不无限等。
100ms 不是任务执行时间，而是入队等待时间。
短超时不会让队列变无界。
超时时间与 worker 数量无关。
optionExplanations_en: The one-hundred millisecond timeout tries briefly then fails fast with overload, protecting the request thread.
100ms is enqueue wait time, not task execution time.
A short timeout does not make the queue unbounded.
Timeout duration does not determine worker count.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次阻塞操作最多愿意等待的时长，超过就放弃并返回失败，而不是无限期等下去。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A timeout is the maximum time a blocking call waits before giving up and returning failure instead of waiting forever.

termDefinitions.meaning: Python 队列在 put 超时仍无法入队时抛出的异常，表示队列此刻已满。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Queue.Full is the exception Python's queue raises when a timed put still cannot find space, meaning the queue is currently full.

termDefinitions.meaning: 表示服务暂时不可用的 HTTP 状态码，用于告诉调用方过载了，可以稍后重试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable is a status code telling the caller the service is temporarily overloaded and it should retry later.

termDefinitions.meaning: 没有容量上限的队列，会一直接受新任务直到耗尽内存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An unbounded queue has no capacity limit and keeps accepting new items until it runs out of memory.

q: 哪些场景通常适合“入队 + worker 异步处理”？（多选）
q_en: Which scenarios usually fit enqueue plus worker-based asynchronous processing? (Select all that apply.)
options: 报表生成需要 10 分钟
支付后发送收据和创建运单涉及慢外部服务
用户点击事件写分析库可稍后处理
一次内存里的余额加法必须立刻原子完成
why: 前三个都能把慢或可重试的工作从请求路径拆出去。余额更新是正确性问题，不能靠排队随意延后除非整体架构就是单线程处理它。
why_en: Long reports, slow fulfillment, and analytics events are natural queue-backed background workloads.
options_en: Report generation that takes 10 minutes.
Sending a receipt and creating a shipping label after payment, which involves slow external services.
Writing a user click event to analytics, which can happen later.
A single in-memory balance addition that must complete atomically right now.
optionExplanations: 10 分钟报表生成是典型的可延后工作，用户不必等。
支付后的外部服务调用通常可异步，即使最后需要重试或人工处理。
分析事件可丢失，完全适合离线异步处理。
余额加法是正确性问题，必须同步原子完成，不能排队随意延后。
optionExplanations_en: Report generation in 10 minutes is deferrable; users should not wait.
Post-payment external services can be async even if retry or manual reconciliation is needed.
Analytics events are lossy and fit asynchronous background processing.
Balance updates are correctness-critical and must be synchronous and atomic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 要么完整执行、要么完全不执行的一步操作，其他线程不会看到它执行到一半的中间状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An atomic operation completes as one indivisible step, so no other thread can observe it partially done.

q: 把设计有界后台队列的步骤排好：
q_en: Put the steps for designing a bounded background queue in order:
steps: 决定满队列策略：阻塞、超时拒绝或丢弃
识别哪些工作可以离开请求路径
按突发量和消费速率估算容量
让 worker 从队列阻塞获取并处理任务
why: 先确认任务可异步，再设计容量和反压。worker 的阻塞消费是实现细节，但要说明它避免忙等。
why_en: Design the async queue by identifying deferrable work, sizing the buffer, choosing backpressure behavior, and running blocking consumers.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游处理不过来时向上游施加的压力，让生产者放慢速度或被拒绝，防止无限积压。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure is pressure applied back to producers so they slow down or get rejected instead of overwhelming downstream consumers.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从队列取任务并执行的后台线程，通常成组存在（worker pool）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A worker is a background thread that pulls tasks from a queue and executes them, usually running as part of a worker pool.

termDefinitions.meaning: 设置了最大容量的队列，满了之后新元素必须等待、超时或被拒绝。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bounded queue has a maximum capacity, so once full, new items must wait, time out, or be rejected.

q: 补全阻塞队列的默认面试表述：
q_en: Complete the default interview explanation for a blocking queue:
text: 生产者调用 {{put}} 入队，消费者调用 {{take/get}} 出队；队列为空时消费者睡眠，队列满时生产者被{{反压}}。
why: 这句话覆盖了协调题最重要的三个点：交接、等待和容量保护。
why_en: The standard blocking-queue answer is put by producers, take by consumers, and bounded backpressure when the queue is full.

termDefinitions.meaning: 阻塞队列的出入队方法：put/take 会阻塞等待，offer 可以带超时或立即返回而不阻塞。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Put and take block when the queue is full or empty, while offer can time out or return immediately instead of blocking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游处理不过来时向上游施加的压力，让生产者放慢速度或被拒绝，防止无限积压。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure is pressure applied back to producers so they slow down or get rejected instead of overwhelming downstream consumers.

q: “处理这些任务”与“协调很多有状态实体”分别更偏向什么？
q_en: What do "process these tasks" and "coordinate many stateful entities" usually point to?
options: 前者阻塞队列，后者 Actor
前者 Singleton，后者 Builder
前者读写锁，后者原子计数器
两者都必须手写 condition variable
why: 简单任务流水线用队列最直接；有状态实体之间互发事件时，Actor 的所有权模型更清楚。
why_en: Use a blocking queue for a simple task pipeline and consider actors for many communicating stateful entities.
options_en: The former is a blocking queue, the latter is Actor.
The former is Singleton, the latter is Builder.
The former is a read-write lock, the latter is an atomic counter.
Both must be hand-written with a condition variable.
tradeoff: 简单任务流水线用队列 vs 多有状态实体用 Actor
optionExplanations: 简单任务流水线用阻塞队列最直接；有状态实体互发消息时 Actor 所有权更清楚。
Singleton 和 Builder 是对象创建模式，不是协调方案。
读写锁和原子计数器是低级同步原语，不是高级协调范式。
不是所有协调都需要手写条件变量。
optionExplanations_en: A blocking queue is simplest for a task pipeline; actors clarify ownership when stateful entities exchange messages.
Singleton and Builder are creation patterns, not coordination strategies.
Read-write locks and atomic counters are low-level synchronization, not high-level coordination.
Not all coordination requires manual condition variables.

termDefinitions.meaning: 空/满时自动让消费者/生产者阻塞等待的线程安全队列，内部封装了锁和条件变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A blocking queue is a thread-safe queue that automatically blocks consumers when empty and producers when full.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 actor 拥有私有状态和邮箱，一次只处理一条消息，只能通过发消息和外界交互。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The actor model gives each actor private state and a mailbox, processes one message at a time, and interacts with others only by sending messages.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保证一个类在整个进程里只有一个实例的创建型设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton is a creational pattern that guarantees a class has only one instance in the process.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过链式步骤逐步组装出一个复杂对象的创建型设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Builder is a creational pattern that assembles a complex object through a chain of construction steps.

termDefinitions.meaning: 允许多个读者并发读取、但写者独占访问的锁，适合读多写少的场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read-write lock lets many readers proceed concurrently while a writer needs exclusive access, useful when reads far outnumber writes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用原子操作递增/递减的计数器，多线程同时更新也不会算错。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An atomic counter increments or decrements using atomic operations, so concurrent updates from multiple threads never produce a wrong count.

termDefinitions.meaning: 和锁绑定的等待/通知原语，让线程在条件不满足时释放锁并休眠，条件变化后被唤醒重新检查。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A condition variable lets a thread release its lock and sleep until another thread signals that the condition may have changed.

q: 把慢外部服务调用放进后台 worker 后，失败处理通常还要补什么？
q_en: After moving slow external-service calls into background workers, what failure handling do you usually need?
options: 重试、死信或状态标记，而不是假设永远成功
删除所有日志
把队列改成无界
让用户请求永久等待
why: 异步处理让用户请求先返回，但后台任务仍可能失败。生产系统需要可观察的失败状态、重试或补偿。
why_en: Asynchronous work still needs retry, dead-letter, or status handling because the background task can fail after the request returns.
options_en: Retry, dead-letter, or status marking, instead of assuming it always succeeds.
Delete all the logs.
Turn the queue unbounded.
Make the user's request wait forever.
optionExplanations: 异步处理让用户先返回，但后台任务仍可失败，需要重试、死信队列或补偿流程。
删除日志会隐藏问题。
无界队列不解决失败处理问题。
让请求永久等待违反异步初衷。
optionExplanations_en: Async work still needs retry, dead-letter, or compensation because the background task can fail after returning.
Deleting logs hides problems.
An unbounded queue does not address failure handling.
Permanent request waiting defeats the purpose of async.

termDefinitions.meaning: 存放处理失败任务的专用队列，供人工或后续流程排查和重试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dead-letter queue holds tasks that failed processing so they can be inspected or retried later instead of being silently lost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 没有容量上限的队列，会一直接受新任务直到耗尽内存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An unbounded queue has no capacity limit and keeps accepting new items until it runs out of memory.

scenario: 分析事件量突增时，丢少量事件可以接受，但不能拖垮主请求。
scenario_en: When analytics event volume spikes, dropping a small number of events is acceptable, but the main request path must not be dragged down.
q: 队列满时更合理的策略是什么？
q_en: What is the more reasonable policy when the queue is full?
options: 非阻塞 offer 失败则丢弃并记录指标
永久阻塞用户请求
创建无限内存缓冲
暂停整个服务
why: 分析事件是典型 lossy 工作负载。满时丢弃比让主业务请求超时更符合优先级。
why_en: For lossy analytics events, dropping and logging when the queue is full is often better than blocking the main request path.
whenOtherWins: 订单、支付等不可丢任务应超时返回错误或持久化后异步处理，不能静默丢弃。
options_en: Use non-blocking offer, and drop with a logged metric on failure.
Permanently block the user's request.
Create an unlimited in-memory buffer.
Pause the entire service.
tradeoff: 阻塞保护数据不丢 vs 丢弃保护主请求路径
optionExplanations: 非阻塞 offer 满时丢弃，结合指标记录，既避免拖垮主请求，又保持可观察性。
永久阻塞会让主请求超时，违反优先级。
无限内存缓冲无法工作。
暂停整个服务影响其他功能。
optionExplanations_en: Non-blocking offer with drop and logging avoids blocking the main request while keeping observability.
Permanent blocking times out the main request, violating priorities.
Unlimited memory buffering is impossible.
Pausing the service impacts all functions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 阻塞队列的出入队方法：put/take 会阻塞等待，offer 可以带超时或立即返回而不阻塞。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Put and take block when the queue is full or empty, while offer can time out or return immediately instead of blocking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 没有容量上限的队列，会一直接受新任务直到耗尽内存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An unbounded queue has no capacity limit and keeps accepting new items until it runs out of memory.

scenario: 面试官要求你解释 BlockingQueue 底层大概怎么做到空时等待、满时等待。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to explain roughly how a BlockingQueue waits when empty and waits when full.
q: 你应该提到哪组原语？
q_en: Which primitives should you mention?
options: 锁 + 条件变量
只用原子变量 + 忙等轮询
只用 synchronized 方法但不做真正的等待/唤醒
用信号量替代锁，但不处理容量计数
why: 队列内部通常用锁保护缓冲区，用条件变量让生产者/消费者在非满/非空条件上睡眠和唤醒；有些实现也会用 semaphore + mutex 组合表达容量和元素计数。
why_en: A blocking queue is often built from a lock plus not-empty and not-full conditions; some implementations use semaphores plus a mutex for capacity and item counts.
whenOtherWins: 实际面试实现中优先使用标准库队列，只有被要求手写时才下探到这些原语。
options_en: A lock plus a condition variable.
Just an atomic variable plus busy-wait polling.
Just synchronized methods with no real wait/notify.
A semaphore instead of a lock, without tracking capacity.
tradeoff: 手写锁 + 条件变量 vs 直接用现成阻塞队列
optionExplanations: 缓冲区的读写用锁互斥，生产者等消费者、消费者等生产者这两件事则交给条件变量的 wait/notify 处理。
光靠原子变量转圈检查能跑，但线程会不停占用 CPU，这属于忙等，不是标准做法。
只加 synchronized 方法只解决了互斥，没让线程真正睡眠等待，空/满时只能不断重试。
信号量能限制同时访问的数量，但不额外记录已用/剩余容量，就分不清队列到底满没满。
optionExplanations_en: The buffer itself is protected by a lock, while producers waiting on consumers and consumers waiting on producers is handled through the condition variable's wait and notify.
Spinning on an atomic variable can technically run, but the thread keeps burning CPU, which is busy-waiting, not the standard approach.
Adding only synchronized gives mutual exclusion but never puts a thread to real sleep, so it just retries forever when empty or full.
A semaphore can cap how many callers are in flight, but without also tracking used and remaining capacity it cannot tell whether the queue is actually full.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保护共享状态、同一时刻只允许一个线程持有的同步原语。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lock is a synchronization primitive that only one thread can hold at a time, used to protect shared state.

termDefinitions.meaning: 和锁绑定的等待/通知原语，让线程在条件不满足时释放锁并休眠，条件变化后被唤醒重新检查。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A condition variable lets a thread release its lock and sleep until another thread signals that the condition may have changed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程不停轮询条件却不真正休眠，一直占用 CPU 却没做有用的事。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Busy-waiting is a loop that keeps checking a condition without sleeping, so it keeps burning CPU doing no useful work.

termDefinitions.meaning: Java 里给方法或代码块加互斥锁的关键字，同一时刻只允许一个线程进入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Synchronized is a Java keyword that puts a mutual-exclusion lock on a method or block, letting only one thread enter at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 维护一个许可计数的同步原语，线程获取许可后才能继续，用完释放许可。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A semaphore is a synchronization primitive that tracks a permit count; a thread must acquire a permit to proceed and releases it when done.

termDefinitions.meaning: 空/满时自动让消费者/生产者阻塞等待的线程安全队列，内部封装了锁和条件变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A blocking queue is a thread-safe queue that automatically blocks consumers when empty and producers when full.

q: 关于队列吸收突发流量，哪些说法正确？（多选）
q_en: Which statements are true about using a queue to absorb bursty traffic? (Select all that apply.)
options: worker 可以按可持续速率处理
队列容量必须按可接受延迟和内存权衡
队列满时需要明确反压策略
队列能无限提高下游数据库吞吐
why: 队列只是平滑尖峰，不会让下游变快。容量越大，越能缓冲，也越占内存并增加等待。
why_en: A queue smooths bursts but does not increase downstream throughput, so capacity and backpressure still need explicit design.
options_en: Workers can process at a sustainable rate.
Queue capacity must trade off tolerable delay against memory.
A full queue needs an explicit backpressure policy.
A queue can boost downstream database throughput without limit.
optionExplanations: 队列只是缓冲，worker 仍按可持续速率处理任务，这是队列的主要价值。
容量和延迟、内存使用必须权衡，不能无限扩大。
满队列需要明确的反压策略，如阻塞、拒绝或丢弃。
队列不能提高下游绝对吞吐，只能平滑突发。
optionExplanations_en: Workers still process at a sustainable rate; the queue just buffers.
Capacity must balance latency and memory; it cannot be infinite.
Full queues need explicit backpressure: block, reject, or drop.
Queues do not increase downstream throughput, only smooth bursts.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游处理不过来时向上游施加的压力，让生产者放慢速度或被拒绝，防止无限积压。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure is pressure applied back to producers so they slow down or get rejected instead of overwhelming downstream consumers.

q: 补全 Actor 模型的所有权表达：
q_en: Complete the Actor model ownership statement:
text: Actor 内部一次只处理{{一条消息}}，因此它自己的状态不会被多个线程同时访问；并发边界集中在{{邮箱}}。
why: Actor 把锁从业务逻辑里移到消息入口处。邮箱仍要线程安全，但 actor 内部状态顺序化。
why_en: Actors serialize their own state by processing one message at a time, with concurrency concentrated at the mailbox.

termDefinitions.meaning: actor 接收消息的队列，多个发送者可以并发写入，但 actor 自己顺序地一条条读取处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A mailbox is the message queue an actor reads from sequentially, even though multiple senders can write to it concurrently.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 actor 拥有私有状态和邮箱，一次只处理一条消息，只能通过发消息和外界交互。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The actor model gives each actor private state and a mailbox, processes one message at a time, and interacts with others only by sending messages.

scenario: Actor 系统中，调用方发送消息后还需要等待结果。
scenario_en: In an Actor system, the caller sends a message but still needs to wait for a result.
q: 这会比普通同步调用多出什么设计点？
q_en: What extra design point does this add compared with a normal synchronous call?
options: 需要 ask/callback/回复地址这类显式应答机制
异步消息处理完全不需要任何错误处理逻辑
得把这个 actor 改写成一个全局共享的可变变量
发到它这里的消息顺序全都会变得完全乱序
why: Actor 默认是异步消息。要等待回应，就要设计回复消息、future、callback 或框架提供的 ask 模式。
why_en: Request-response over actors requires an explicit reply mechanism such as ask, futures, callbacks, or a response address.
whenOtherWins: 简单同步调用链没有独立状态或异步需求时，普通方法调用更容易理解。
options_en: You need an explicit reply mechanism like ask, callback, or a reply address.
Asynchronous message handling needs no error handling at all.
You have to rewrite this actor into a globally shared mutable variable.
Every message sent to it becomes completely out of order.
tradeoff: 同步调用直接拿返回值 vs 异步消息需要显式应答机制
optionExplanations: Actor 默认异步、send 后立刻返回，要等回复就得自己加 ask、callback 或回复地址这类机制。
异步处理同样会失败，仍然需要错误处理，只是处理的时机和方式不同。
actor 应该保持私有状态、自包含，不需要也不应该改成全局变量。
同一发送者到同一接收者路径的消息顺序通常是有保证的，不会全都乱序。
optionExplanations_en: Actors are async by default and return right after send, so waiting for a reply needs an explicit ask, callback, or reply address.
Async work can still fail and still needs error handling, just at a different point in time.
An actor should stay private and self-contained; it should not be turned into a global variable.
Message order on a single sender-to-receiver path is normally preserved, not fully scrambled.

termDefinitions.meaning: 部分 Actor 框架提供的 request-response 封装：发消息后立刻拿到一个未来会有结果的句柄。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The ask pattern is a request-response helper some actor frameworks provide, returning a future that resolves once the reply message arrives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 调用方发出请求后还要等待并拿到对方的回复，而不是发完就不管。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Request-response means the caller sends a request and still needs to wait for and receive a reply, unlike fire-and-forget messaging.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一个函数或地址传给对方，让对方处理完后主动调用它来通知结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A callback is a function or address passed to the receiver so it can call back once it has finished processing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 actor 拥有私有状态和邮箱，一次只处理一条消息，只能通过发消息和外界交互。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The actor model gives each actor private state and a mailbox, processes one message at a time, and interacts with others only by sending messages.

q: 把注册后异步发邮件的执行顺序排好：
q_en: Put the steps for sending a registration email asynchronously in order:
steps: 后台 worker 从队列取 EmailTask 并调用邮件服务
API 保存用户的必要状态
API 构造 EmailTask 放入有界队列
API 向用户返回成功，不等待邮件发送完成
why: 请求路径只做必须的同步工作和入队。慢邮件发送由 worker 在请求结束后处理。
why_en: The API saves required state, enqueues the email task, returns to the user, and lets workers send the email later.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生产者生成任务放入队列，消费者从队列取出任务处理，两端速度不必相同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In producer-consumer, producers generate tasks into a queue while consumers pull tasks out and process them, even at different speeds.

termDefinitions.meaning: 设置了最大容量的队列，满了之后新元素必须等待、超时或被拒绝。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bounded queue has a maximum capacity, so once full, new items must wait, time out, or be rejected.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从队列取任务并执行的后台线程，通常成组存在（worker pool）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A worker is a background thread that pulls tasks from a queue and executes them, usually running as part of a worker pool.

q: 为什么 `new LinkedBlockingQueue<>()` 不传容量会被面试官追问？
q_en: Why will an interviewer question `new LinkedBlockingQueue<>()` with no capacity?
options: 它默认无界，生产者过快时可能 OOM
它无法保存对象
它只能单线程使用
它会自动丢弃所有任务
why: 无界队列看似避免阻塞，实际是在高峰时把压力换成内存风险。面试里应主动给容量。
why_en: An unbounded blocking queue hides overload until it becomes memory exhaustion, so interview answers should specify capacity.
options_en: It is unbounded by default, and producers outpacing consumers can cause OOM.
It cannot store objects.
It can only be used from a single thread.
It automatically drops all tasks.
optionExplanations: 不传容量的 LinkedBlockingQueue 默认无界，生产快于消费时会一直增长直到 OOM，这正是面试官想追问的风险点。
这个队列结构可以正常保存任意对象，不存在无法保存对象的问题。
这种队列实现天然支持多线程并发访问，不是只能单线程用。
队列不会替你自动丢弃任务，元素会一直堆积在内存里直到被处理或耗尽内存。
optionExplanations_en: A LinkedBlockingQueue built without a capacity is unbounded by default, so it keeps growing toward OOM when producers outpace consumers, exactly what interviewers probe for.
This queue type can store any object just fine; storing objects is not the issue.
This queue implementation is built for concurrent multi-threaded access, not limited to one thread.
The queue does not auto-drop tasks for you; items keep piling up in memory until processed or until memory runs out.

termDefinitions.meaning: Java 提供的一种阻塞队列实现，构造时不传容量参数就默认无界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LinkedBlockingQueue is a Java blocking queue implementation that is unbounded by default unless a capacity is passed to its constructor.

termDefinitions.meaning: 进程内存耗尽引发的崩溃，是无界队列长期积压任务的典型后果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: OOM, an Out-Of-Memory error, is a crash caused by exhausting available memory, a typical result of a queue that grows without bound.

scenario: 题目中出现“工作需要稍后处理、消费者空时等待、生产者满时变慢”。
scenario_en: The prompt says work can be processed later, consumers should wait when empty, and producers should slow down when full.
q: 你应优先说出的方案关键词是什么？
q_en: What solution keywords should you say first?
options: 有界阻塞队列 + worker pool
读写锁 + public 字段
Builder + Singleton
无锁更新所有对象
why: 这些信号几乎直接指向生产者消费者协调。bounded 是防 OOM，worker pool 是消费端。
why_en: Those cues point directly to a bounded blocking queue with workers as the producer-consumer coordination pattern.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务不是简单流水线，而是一堆互相通信的有状态实体，再考虑 Actor。
options_en: A bounded blocking queue plus a worker pool.
A read-write lock plus public fields.
Builder plus Singleton.
Lock-free updates to every object.
tradeoff: 有状态实体互相通信用 Actor vs 简单任务流水线用阻塞队列
optionExplanations: 这些信号直接指向有界阻塞队列和 worker pool，是生产者消费者协调的标准方案。
读写锁和 public 字段解决的是完全不同的问题。
Builder 和 Singleton 是对象创建方式。
无锁更新不提供反压或阻塞语义。
optionExplanations_en: Those cues directly point to bounded blocking queues and worker pools, the standard producer-consumer solution.
Read-write locks and public fields address different problems.
Builder and Singleton are creation patterns.
Lock-free updates do not provide backpressure or blocking semantics.

termDefinitions.meaning: 设置了最大容量的队列，满了之后新元素必须等待、超时或被拒绝。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bounded queue has a maximum capacity, so once full, new items must wait, time out, or be rejected.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从队列取任务并执行的后台线程，通常成组存在（worker pool）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A worker is a background thread that pulls tasks from a queue and executes them, usually running as part of a worker pool.

termDefinitions.meaning: 允许多个读者并发读取、但写者独占访问的锁，适合读多写少的场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read-write lock lets many readers proceed concurrently while a writer needs exclusive access, useful when reads far outnumber writes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过链式步骤逐步组装出一个复杂对象的创建型设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Builder is a creational pattern that assembles a complex object through a chain of construction steps.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保证一个类在整个进程里只有一个实例的创建型设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton is a creational pattern that guarantees a class has only one instance in the process.

q: 补全协调总结：
q_en: Complete the coordination summary:
text: 协调题的主线是：生产者产生工作，消费者处理工作，中间用{{有界阻塞队列}}或{{Actor 邮箱}}安全交接，并通过容量限制提供{{反压}}。
why: 这句话覆盖了文章结论的两种范式：共享队列和消息传递。
why_en: Coordination is producers, consumers, and a bounded handoff mechanism such as a blocking queue or actor mailbox.

termDefinitions.meaning: 设置了最大容量的队列，满了之后新元素必须等待、超时或被拒绝。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bounded queue has a maximum capacity, so once full, new items must wait, time out, or be rejected.

termDefinitions.meaning: actor 接收消息的队列，多个发送者可以并发写入，但 actor 自己顺序地一条条读取处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A mailbox is the message queue an actor reads from sequentially, even though multiple senders can write to it concurrently.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游处理不过来时向上游施加的压力，让生产者放慢速度或被拒绝，防止无限积压。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure is pressure applied back to producers so they slow down or get rejected instead of overwhelming downstream consumers.

q: 并发正确性问题关注的核心风险是什么？
options: 线程太多导致 CPU 不够
多个线程访问共享状态后产生错误业务结果
日志输出顺序不好看
对象创建语法太复杂
why: 正确性的危险不是慢，而是悄悄把状态写坏：重复订座、丢失计数、余额不对。只要共享可变状态被并发读写，就要先问不变量会不会破。
why_en: Correctness problems are about shared state producing wrong business results, not primarily about speed.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["shared mutable state"] --> B["threads interleave"]
  B --> C["invariant broken"]
  C --> D["wrong business result"]
optionExplanations: 线程太多导致性能问题，但正确性问题是指状态被写坏而不是慢。
正确性的核心风险是多线程访问共享状态产生错误业务结果，如双订或数据不一致。
日志输出顺序是可观测性问题，不是并发正确性的核心。
对象创建语法是代码风格问题，与并发无关。
optionExplanations_en: Too many threads causes performance issues, not state corruption.
Correctness failures are about concurrent access producing wrong business results, not speed.
Log ordering is observability, not correctness.
Object creation syntax is style, not concurrency.
q_en: What core risk does a concurrency correctness problem test?
options_en: Too many threads means not enough CPU.
Multiple threads access shared state and produce a wrong business result.
Log output order looks messy.
Object-creation syntax is too complex.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个线程都能读写的同一份可变数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Shared mutable state is data that more than one thread can read and write.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统必须始终保持为真的业务规则，比如一个座位只能有一个 owner。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An invariant is a rule that must always stay true, like a seat having exactly one owner.

scenario: Alice 和 Bob 同时订 7A；代码先检查 seat_owners 是否包含 7A，再写入 owner。
q: 这里真正需要原子化的是哪一段？
options: 只原子化网络请求
只原子化错误消息生成
检查座位可用和写入 owner 两步一起
只原子化类构造函数
why: 错误发生在检查和行动之间的窗口。必须让“看到可用”和“标记为已占用”作为一个不可插入的临界区。
why_en: The availability check and owner write must be atomic together because another thread can invalidate the check before the action.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是读取已订座列表供展示，可能不需要同样的写锁粒度，但展示数据要接受短暂陈旧。
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant T1
  participant State
  participant T2
  T1->>State: check free
  T2->>State: check free
  T1->>State: mark used
  T2->>State: mark used
optionExplanations: 只原子化网络请求无法解决座位订购的竞争问题。
错误消息生成不是关键路径。
检查座位可用和写入 owner 两步必须原子化，否则中间窗口会导致双订。
类构造函数与解决双订问题无关。
optionExplanations_en: Atomizing just the network request does not fix the booking race.
Error message generation is not on the critical path.
Checking availability and writing the owner must be atomic together to close the race window.
Class constructor atomicity does not address the booking issue.
scenario_en: Alice and Bob both try to book seat 7A at the same time; the code first checks whether seat_owners contains 7A, then writes the owner.
q_en: Which part actually needs to be atomic here?
options_en: Only make the network request atomic.
Only make error-message generation atomic.
Make the availability check and the owner write atomic together.
Only make the class constructor atomic.
tradeoff: 检查和写入合并成一个临界区 vs 缩短持锁时间分开执行

termDefinitions.meaning: 必须被同步保护、不能被其他线程打断的代码段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A critical section is code that must run without another thread interrupting it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一组操作要么全部完成、要么都不发生，中间不会被其他线程看到中间状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An atomic operation completes as one indivisible step that no other thread can partially observe.

scenario: 单个 TicketBooking 对象维护所有座位的 owner；订座临界区很短，面试先求正确。
q: 这段实现的关键正确性点是什么？
options: 同一把锁覆盖检查和写入
每个座位自动有一把独立锁
写入发生在锁外提升吞吐
只有读取被保护
why: 粗粒度锁把所有相关状态放进一个临界区，先保证不会双订。对大多数人触发的 LLD 操作，它足够简单且性能足够。
why_en: The coarse lock protects the whole check-and-write sequence with one critical section, preventing double booking.
whenOtherWins: 如果请求量极高且不同资源互不冲突，才考虑细粒度锁按座位拆分。
optionExplanations: 同一把锁覆盖检查和写入是粗粒度锁的关键，保证检查和行动不被中断。
座位的独立锁需要死锁防线和多锁管理，不是最初的关键点。
在锁外写入会重新打开竞争窗口。

q: Check-then-act bug 的判定标准是什么？

错误。构造函数里的读取通常发生在对象还未共享之前，不构成并发窗口。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the test is whether another thread can slip in between the check and the action; if it can, that is check-then-act.
Incorrect — two ifs do not automatically create check-then-act; what matters is whether the later action depends on the earlier check.
Incorrect — returning a boolean is just an interface shape, not evidence of a check-then-act window.
Incorrect — reads inside a constructor usually happen before the object is shared, so there is no concurrency window.

q: 在低层设计并发题里，“多个线程在同一进程内”最关键的共享点是什么？
q_en: In an LLD concurrency question, what's the key thing multiple threads inside one process actually share?
options: 每个线程都有独立堆内存
线程共享堆、全局变量和打开的资源
线程只能通过网络通信
线程之间默认没有任何交错
options_en: Each thread has its own private heap.
Threads share the heap, globals, and open resources.
Threads can only talk to each other over the network.
Threads never interleave by default.
why: 同一进程里的线程各有栈和执行位置，但共享堆和资源。只要共享可变状态存在，就要考虑并发交错。
why_en: Threads in one process have their own stacks but share heap state and resources, which is why shared mutable state creates concurrency risk.

termDefinitions.meaning: 程序内一条独立的执行路径，有自己的栈和程序计数器，但与同进程其他线程共享堆内存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A thread is an independent execution path with its own stack, but it shares heap memory with other threads in the same process.

termDefinitions.meaning: 操作系统级别的隔离容器，拥有独立地址空间和资源，可以包含一个或多个线程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A process is an OS-level isolated container with its own address space that can hold one or more threads.

termDefinitions.meaning: 进程内所有线程共享的动态内存区域，是并发读写冲突最常发生的地方。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The heap is the shared memory region that all threads in a process can read and write, which is where concurrency conflicts usually happen.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个线程都能读写、且值会变化的内存或对象，是并发 bug 的根源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Shared mutable state is memory that multiple threads can read and modify, and it is the root cause of concurrency bugs.

q: “并发”和“并行”在面试推理里的关键区别是？
q_en: What's the key interview distinction between "concurrency" and "parallelism"?
options: 并发关注操作可交错，并行关注同一时刻真的同时执行
并发只发生在分布式系统，并行只发生在单机
并发要求多核，并行不要求多核
两者完全等价，没有推理差异
options_en: Concurrency is about interleaving, parallelism is about truly running at the same instant.
Concurrency only happens in distributed systems, parallelism only on one machine.
Concurrency requires multiple cores, parallelism does not.
The two terms are identical with no real distinction.
why: 单核时间片切换也会让指令交错，所以并发 bug 不依赖多核。对程序来说，只要执行能被不可预测地交错，就要保护共享状态。
why_en: Concurrency is about interleaving progress, while parallelism is about simultaneous execution, and both can expose the same shared-state bugs.
tradeoff: 并发（交错执行，单核也会发生）vs 并行（真正同时执行，需要多核）

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个操作的进度可以交错推进，不要求真正同时发生。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Concurrency means multiple operations can make interleaved progress, without requiring them to happen at the exact same instant.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个操作在物理上真正同一时刻执行，通常需要多核 CPU。

termDefinitions.meaning: 不同线程的指令在时间线上交替穿插执行的方式，由调度器决定。

q: 哪些现象是典型并发 bug 的信号？（多选）
q_en: Which symptoms are typical signs of a concurrency bug? (multi-select)
options: 本地测试偶尔通过但线上出现“不可能”的结果
结果依赖线程调度和时间点
源代码一行操作实际拆成多步读写
所有 bug 都稳定复现且只和输入有关
options_en: Local tests usually pass but production shows an "impossible" result.
The result depends on thread scheduling and timing.
A one-line source statement is actually multiple read/write steps.
All bugs reproduce reliably and depend only on input.
why: 并发错误常常由交错顺序触发，所以表现为偶发、难复现、和时序有关。看起来像一行的更新，也可能是读、改、写三步。
why_en: Concurrency bugs are often nondeterministic because source-level operations may break into multiple steps whose interleaving depends on timing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个线程无协调地读写共享状态，导致结果依赖执行顺序的错误模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A race condition happens when multiple threads access shared state without coordination, so the result depends on execution order.

q_en: Fill in the core cause of concurrency bugs:

text_en: What looks like one operation in source code may be several machine steps; if multiple threads read and write {{shared mutable state}} without coordination, the result can depend on {{interleaving order}}.
why: 并发正确性不是看代码行数，而是看状态变化能否被其他线程插入。保护共享可变状态是后续所有工具的共同目标。
why_en: The core issue is that shared mutable state can be observed or changed between the hidden steps of what looks like one operation.

q: JavaScript/TypeScript 与 Java/C++/Go 等语言在本文并发模型上的主要差别是？
q_en: What's the main concurrency-model difference between JavaScript/TypeScript and languages like Java, C++, or Go?
options: JavaScript 主线程用户代码通常不是共享内存多线程
JavaScript 没有异步执行
JavaScript 的每个对象自动加锁
JavaScript 只能用于分布式系统设计
options_en: JavaScript's main-thread user code is usually not shared-memory multithreading.
JavaScript has no asynchronous execution at all.
Every JavaScript object is automatically locked.
JavaScript can only be used for distributed system design.
why: JS/TS 常见用户代码运行在单主线程，通过事件循环和异步回调表达并发。它仍有顺序和异步问题，但不是本文重点的共享内存线程模型。
why_en: JavaScript usually exposes concurrency through an event loop rather than shared-memory user threads, so the classic locking model is less central.
tradeoff: JavaScript 单线程事件循环 vs Java/C++/Go 共享内存多线程

termDefinitions.meaning: 单线程运行时用来轮询和派发异步回调的调度机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An event loop is the single-threaded mechanism that polls for events and dispatches asynchronous callbacks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 程序内一条独立的执行路径，有自己的栈和程序计数器，但与同进程其他线程共享堆内存。

q: 最轻量的同步工具通常是什么？
q_en: What's usually the lightest-weight synchronization tool for this?
options: 条件变量
原子变量
每个请求一个阻塞队列
读写锁
options_en: A condition variable.
An atomic variable.
A blocking queue per request.
A read-write lock.
why: 原子变量适合单变量计数、标志和简单统计，CPU 原子指令能把更新做成不可分割步骤。它不适合同时维护多个字段的业务不变量。
why_en: Atomic variables fit single counters or flags because the update can be performed as one indivisible CPU-level operation.
whenOtherWins: 如果一次操作必须同时更新多个对象或字段，就用锁把整个不变量保护起来。
tradeoff: 原子变量的单变量轻量更新 vs 锁的多字段不变量保护

termDefinitions.meaning: 由 CPU 指令保证不可被打断、一步完成读改写的变量，如 compare-and-swap。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An atomic variable is updated with CPU instructions such as compare-and-swap that complete as a single indivisible step.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让线程在条件不满足时释放锁并睡眠，被通知后重新获取锁检查条件的同步工具。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A condition variable lets a thread release its lock and sleep until notified, then reacquire the lock and recheck the condition.

termDefinitions.meaning: 满时让生产者等待、空时让消费者等待的线程安全队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A blocking queue is a thread-safe queue that makes producers wait when full and consumers wait when empty.

termDefinitions.meaning: 允许多个读者同时持有、但写者必须独占的锁，也叫 RW 锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read-write lock allows many concurrent readers, but a writer must hold it exclusively.

termDefinitions.meaning: Java 等语言提供的、支持无锁原子自增和读写的整数类型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AtomicInteger is a type provided by languages such as Java that supports lock-free atomic increment and read or write.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让 CPU 判断内存值是否等于期望值、相等才写入新值的原子指令。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CAS is a CPU instruction that atomically writes a new value only if the current value still matches the expected one.

scenario: Python 代码里多个线程要安全递增共享计数器，但标准库没有原生 AtomicInteger。
scenario_en: Multiple threads need to safely increment a shared counter in Python, but the standard library has no native AtomicInteger.
q: 这段代码想表达的正确做法是什么？
q_en: What correct practice is this snippet demonstrating?
codeSample:
import threading

lock = threading.Lock()
counter = 0

with lock:
    counter += 1
options: 用锁保护递增，因为 Python 没有内建原子整数
删除锁，GIL 已保证所有 += 都安全
把 counter 放到局部变量即可
改用条件变量等待 counter 变化
options_en: Wrap the increment in a lock because Python has no built-in atomic integer.
Drop the lock; the GIL already makes every += safe.
Just move counter into a local variable.
Switch to a condition variable that waits for counter to change.
why: Python 的 GIL 不等于业务操作原子化，标准库也没有像 AtomicInteger 这样的通用原子整数。用 Lock 包住递增是面试里最直接的安全表达。
why_en: In Python, use a lock to protect a shared increment because the GIL is not a general atomic-integer primitive.
whenOtherWins: 在 Java、C++、Go 或 C# 里，如果只是单个计数器，可以直接使用对应的原子整数 API。
tradeoff: 显式加锁保护递增 vs 误以为 GIL 让 += 天然原子

termDefinitions.meaning: 让同一时刻只有一个线程能进入临界区的同步原语，也叫互斥锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A mutex is a synchronization primitive that lets only one thread enter a critical section at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: CPython 解释器内部的全局锁，同一时刻只允许一个线程执行 Python 字节码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The GIL is CPython's internal lock that allows only one thread to execute Python bytecode at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: Java 等语言提供的、支持无锁原子自增和读写的整数类型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AtomicInteger is a type provided by languages such as Java that supports lock-free atomic increment and read or write.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让线程在条件不满足时释放锁并睡眠，被通知后重新获取锁检查条件的同步工具。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A condition variable lets a thread release its lock and sleep until notified, then reacquire the lock and recheck the condition.

scenario: 订票操作要先检查座位是否空闲，再把座位 owner 写成当前用户。两个步骤必须一起成立。
scenario_en: A booking operation first checks whether a seat is free, then writes the current user as the owner; the two steps must succeed as one unit.
q: 默认应该使用什么工具保护这段逻辑？
q_en: What tool should you default to for protecting this logic?
options: 互斥锁包住检查和写入
只给检查加锁，写入放到锁外
条件变量，不需要共享锁
无界阻塞队列
options_en: A mutex wrapping both the check and the write.
Lock only the check, and leave the write outside the lock.
A condition variable, with no shared lock needed.
An unbounded blocking queue.
why: 锁创建临界区，让检查和更新之间不能被其他线程插入。LLD 面试里，短小共享状态更新的默认答案就是同一把锁保护完整不变量。
why_en: A mutex is the default because it keeps the check and the update in one critical section that no other thread can interleave.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是在更新单个独立计数器，原子变量更轻；如果是跨线程交接任务，阻塞队列更合适。
tradeoff: 整段临界区加锁 vs 只锁检查步骤留下竞态窗口

# check + write happen as one atomic unit

termDefinitions.meaning: 一段必须在同一时刻只被一个线程执行的代码，用锁包起来保护。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A critical section is a block of code that must run in only one thread at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先读取状态判断条件、再据此写入的两步操作，若不原子就可能被其他线程插入。

termDefinitions.meaning: 让线程在条件不满足时释放锁并睡眠，被通知后重新获取锁检查条件的同步工具。

termDefinitions.meaning: 满时让生产者等待、空时让消费者等待的线程安全队列。

q: 关于锁的常见变体，哪些对应关系正确？（多选）
q_en: Which of these lock-variant pairings are correct? (multi-select)
options: 粗粒度锁：一把锁保护一组相关状态
细粒度锁：按资源拆多把锁以提升并行度
读写锁：允许多个写者同时修改
读写锁：多个读者或一个写者
options_en: Coarse-grained lock: one lock protects a group of related state.
Fine-grained lock: split into multiple locks per resource to raise parallelism.
Read-write lock: allows multiple writers to modify at once.
Read-write lock: many readers or one writer.
why: 粗锁好理解但串行化多，细锁提升吞吐但更复杂。读写锁适合读多写少，因为读之间不会破坏状态，写必须独占。
why_en: Coarse locks favor simplicity, fine-grained locks increase parallelism, and read-write locks allow many readers or one exclusive writer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一把锁保护一大块相关状态，实现简单但并行度低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A coarse-grained lock protects a large chunk of related state with one lock, which is simple but limits parallelism.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按资源拆分成多把锁，提高并行度但增加复杂度和死锁风险。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fine-grained locking splits state into multiple locks per resource to increase parallelism at the cost of complexity and deadlock risk.

termDefinitions.meaning: 允许多个读者同时持有、但写者必须独占的锁，也叫 RW 锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read-write lock allows many concurrent readers, but a writer must hold it exclusively.

scenario: 配置存储每个请求都会读，但一天只更新几次；普通互斥锁让读者之间也互相等待。
scenario_en: A config store is read on every request but only updated a few times a day; a plain mutex would make readers wait on each other too.
q: 哪种锁最贴合这个读多写少场景？
q_en: Which lock best fits this read-heavy, write-rare scenario?
options: 信号量
读写锁
单个原子布尔值
毒丸任务
options_en: A semaphore.
A read-write lock.
A single atomic boolean.
A poison-pill task.
why: 读写锁让多个读者并行，只在写入时独占。读远多于写时，它减少了不必要的读读阻塞。
why_en: A read-write lock fits read-heavy data because many readers can proceed together while writers still get exclusive access.
whenOtherWins: 如果读写比例接近，读写锁的额外开销可能不值，简单互斥锁反而更清楚。
tradeoff: 读写锁读者并行 vs 互斥锁让读者也互相阻塞

termDefinitions.meaning: 允许多个读者同时持有、但写者必须独占的锁，也叫 RW 锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read-write lock allows many concurrent readers, but a writer must hold it exclusively.

termDefinitions.meaning: 带有 N 个许可的计数锁，最多允许 N 个线程同时持有许可继续执行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A semaphore is a counting lock with N permits that allows at most N threads to proceed concurrently.

termDefinitions.meaning: 放入队列中的一个特殊哨兵任务，消费者读到它就知道该停止工作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A poison pill is a special sentinel task put on a queue so a consumer knows to stop when it reads it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让同一时刻只有一个线程能进入临界区的同步原语，也叫互斥锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A mutex is a synchronization primitive that lets only one thread enter a critical section at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: Java 提供的可重入互斥锁，同一线程可以重复获取而不死锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ReentrantLock is a Java mutex that the same thread can reacquire without deadlocking itself.

scenario: 上传服务允许任意线程发起任务，但最多只能同时处理 5 个图片转换，超过的线程要等待。
scenario_en: An upload service lets any thread start a task, but at most 5 image conversions can run at once; extra threads must wait.
q: 最直接的并发原语是什么？
q_en: What's the most direct concurrency primitive here?
options: 条件变量
每任务一把互斥锁
5 个许可的信号量
Actor 邮箱
options_en: A condition variable.
One mutex per task.
A semaphore with 5 permits.
An actor mailbox.
why: 信号量是计数锁，许可数量等于允许并发执行的上限。它管的是“同时有几个操作在跑”，不是保护某个数据结构。
why_en: A semaphore with five permits directly enforces that at most five operations run at the same time.
whenOtherWins: 如果线程需要拿到具体连接对象或 GPU 对象，就用装着对象的阻塞队列，而不是只有许可的信号量。
tradeoff: 信号量限制同时运行的数量 vs 互斥锁保护单一临界区

termDefinitions.meaning: 带有 N 个许可的计数锁，最多允许 N 个线程同时持有许可继续执行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A semaphore is a counting lock with N permits that allows at most N threads to proceed concurrently.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让线程在条件不满足时释放锁并睡眠，被通知后重新获取锁检查条件的同步工具。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A condition variable lets a thread release its lock and sleep until notified, then reacquire the lock and recheck the condition.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让同一时刻只有一个线程能进入临界区的同步原语，也叫互斥锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A mutex is a synchronization primitive that lets only one thread enter a critical section at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: Actor 模型里只处理自己邮箱消息、不共享内存的并发执行单元，靠消息通信。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In the actor model, an actor only processes messages from its own mailbox and communicates by message passing instead of shared memory.

scenario: 一个外部 API 最多允许 5 个并发调用，调用失败或抛异常时也必须释放名额。
scenario_en: An external API allows at most 5 concurrent calls, and the permit must be released even when the call fails or throws.
q: 这段结构最重要的并发保证是什么？
q_en: What's the most important concurrency guarantee in this structure?
codeSample:
permits = threading.Semaphore(5)

permits.acquire()
try:
    do_work()
finally:
    permits.release()
options: 异常时也归还许可，避免容量永久泄漏
让所有请求永久串行执行
把 do_work 变成 CPU 原子指令
让等待线程忙等而不是睡眠
options_en: The permit is returned even on exception, so capacity is never leaked.
It makes every request run fully serially forever.
It turns do_work into a single CPU atomic instruction.
It makes waiting threads busy-wait instead of sleep.
why: 若 do_work 抛异常又没有 finally，许可永远不还，5 个名额被逐渐吃光，后续线程在 acquire 上永久阻塞。finally 强制两条路径都归还许可，代价是 do_work 仍要能安全重试。
why_en: The finally block prevents leaked semaphore permits when the protected operation fails or throws, so capacity is always returned on both the success and failure path.
whenOtherWins: 如果语言提供可靠的上下文管理或 try-with-resources，可以用它表达同样的获取和释放语义。
tradeoff: finally 中释放许可 vs 只在正常路径手动释放留下泄漏窗口

termDefinitions.meaning: 带有 N 个许可的计数锁，最多允许 N 个线程同时持有许可继续执行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A semaphore is a counting lock with N permits that allows at most N threads to proceed concurrently.

diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["acquire permit"] --> W["do_work()"]
  W -->|success| R["release in finally"]
  W -->|exception| R
  R --> P["permit returned to pool"]
  P -.no finally.-> L["permit leaked, capacity shrinks"]

q: 条件变量 wait() 的关键语义是什么？
q_en: What's the key semantic of a condition variable's wait() call?
options: 持有锁并不断循环检查条件
原子地释放相关锁并让线程睡眠，唤醒后再重新获得锁
创建一个新线程处理条件
把共享变量改成不可变对象
options_en: Hold the lock and keep looping to check the condition.
Atomically release the associated lock and sleep, then reacquire the lock on wakeup.
Spawn a new thread to handle the condition.
Turn the shared variable into an immutable object.
why: 条件变量让线程在条件不满足时真正睡眠，不占 CPU；等待时释放锁，避免生产者无法改变条件。被唤醒后必须重新拿锁检查。
why_en: A condition-variable wait releases the lock and parks the thread, then reacquires the lock before the thread continues.
codeSample:
with condition:
    while not ready:
        condition.wait()  # release lock, sleep
    # lock re-acquired; ready is now true

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A condition variable lets a thread release its lock and sleep until notified, then reacquire the lock and recheck the condition.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让同一时刻只有一个线程能进入临界区的同步原语，也叫互斥锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A mutex is a synchronization primitive that lets only one thread enter a critical section at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程在没有被真正 notify 的情况下从 wait() 中醒来，必须重新检查条件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A spurious wakeup is when a thread returns from wait() without a real notify, so it must recheck the condition.

sequenceDiagram

  participant L as Lock
  participant C as Condition
  T->>L: hold lock
  T->>C: wait releases lock
  C-->>T: notified
  T->>L: reacquire before return

q: 与 sleep 轮询相比，wait/notify 的主要优势是什么？
q_en: Compared to sleep-polling, what's the main advantage of wait/notify?
options: 睡眠等待，被通知后才重新检查条件
让所有任务按照严格全局时间戳排队执行
完全不需要用到任何共享状态
只能应用在单线程程序里，不能用于多线程
options_en: The thread sleeps and only rechecks the condition after being notified.
It forces all tasks to queue by a strict global timestamp.
It needs no shared state at all.
It only applies to single-threaded programs, never multithreaded ones.
why: sleep 轮询在 CPU 浪费和响应延迟之间二选一。wait/notify 让线程真正睡眠，收到信号后重新拿锁检查条件；实际代码仍要用 while 循环处理虚假唤醒。
why_en: Wait-notify avoids the CPU-waste-versus-latency tradeoff of sleep polling, but code should still recheck the condition in a loop after wakeup because of spurious wakeups.
tradeoff: wait/notify 睡眠等待零 CPU 消耗 vs sleep 轮询浪费 CPU 换取实现简单
