q: Amazon Locker 系统最终确定要实现的核心能力有哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which core capabilities are in scope for the Amazon Locker system? (Select all that apply.)
options: 司机按包裹尺寸投递并获得取件码
用户用取件码打开对应格口
取件码 7 天后过期，过期后拒绝取件
系统负责短信或邮件通知用户
why: 系统边界只覆盖 locker 内部的投递、取件和过期判断；通知渠道被明确交给下游系统处理。过期码会被拒绝，但包裹仍占用格口直到工作人员处理。
why_en: The locker system owns deposit, pickup, and expiry handling, but notification delivery is explicitly a downstream system's job.
options_en: The driver deposits by package size and receives a pickup code.
The user opens the matching compartment using the pickup code.
The pickup code expires after seven days and is rejected once expired.
The system is responsible for sending SMS or email notifications.

scenario: 面试官问“包裹实体要不要建模”，但系统只根据 small/medium/large 做格口分配。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks whether Package should be modeled, but the system only uses small, medium, and large for slot allocation.
q: 最合适的建模选择是什么？
q_en: What is the best modeling choice?
options: 把 Package 作为完整实体，包含收件人、物流和订单字段
不建 Package 类，把 size 当作 depositPackage 的输入
把 Package 作为 AccessToken 的子类
把 Package 存在每个 Compartment 里并让它生成 token
why: 包裹的物流和客户信息属于外部履约系统，本系统只需要尺寸。没有行为的实体会增加耦合而不提高设计表达力。
why_en: Package does not earn an entity because the locker only needs package size, while shipping details live outside the system.
whenOtherWins: 如果后续要支持同一格口多包裹、包裹 ID 查询、退回流程追踪，Package 才会变成有行为和生命周期的实体。
diagram:
classDiagram
  class Locker
  class Compartment
  class AccessToken
  class Package
  Locker --> Compartment
  Locker --> AccessToken
  Compartment --> Package
options_en: Model Package as a full entity with recipient, shipping, and order fields.
Skip a Package class and pass size as an input parameter to depositPackage.
Make Package a subclass of AccessToken.
Store Package inside every Compartment and let it generate the token.
tradeoff: 把 Package 建成完整实体 vs 把 size 当作方法输入参数

termDefinitions.meaning: 本系统里代表打开某个格口权限的凭证对象，带过期时间和格口引用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An AccessToken is the credential object in this system that represents permission to open one compartment and carries an expiration time.

termDefinitions.meaning: locker 里的一个物理格口，用于存放包裹。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Compartment is one physical storage slot inside the locker that holds a package.

q: AccessToken 为什么值得建模成独立实体，而不是普通字符串？
q_en: Why should AccessToken be modeled as its own entity instead of a plain string?
options: 它只用于生成随机数，和业务无关
它代表打开某个格口的权限，并带有过期时间和格口引用
它需要保存短信发送状态
它用来表示包裹尺寸
why: 取件码不是裸字符串，而是一个有期限的 bearer token。把过期判断放在 AccessToken 上，能让职责和数据对齐。
why_en: AccessToken deserves its own type because it couples the code, expiration, and compartment access right.
options_en: It's only used to generate a random number and has nothing to do with the business logic.
It represents the right to open one compartment, and carries an expiration time and a compartment reference.
It needs to store SMS delivery status.
It is used to represent package size.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持有即可使用的凭证，谁拿到这个码就能开对应的门，不再额外验证身份。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bearer token is a credential that grants access to whoever holds it, without further identity checks.

q: 补全取件码和包裹占用的语义：
q_en: Complete the meaning of pickup-code validity versus package occupancy:
text: 取件码过期后应被{{拒绝取件}}，但包裹仍然{{物理占用格口}}，直到工作人员取走并清理状态。
why: token 有效性和格口物理占用不是同一个状态。过期只说明用户不能再开门，不说明格口可重新分配。
why_en: Token validity and physical occupancy can diverge, so an expired code does not make the compartment available.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本系统里代表打开某个格口权限的凭证对象，带过期时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An AccessToken represents permission to open one compartment and carries an expiration time.

q: 判断一个状态该建在哪个类上的核心区分依据是什么？
q_en: What is the key rule for deciding which class should own a piece of state?
options: 状态是不是整数
状态是物理属性还是系统管理的关系
状态会不会出现在 API 返回值里
状态是不是可以缓存
why: 格口是否装着包裹是 Compartment 的物理属性，因此放在 Compartment 上；token 到格口的映射是 Locker 管理的系统关系，因此放在 Locker 上。
why_en: State that is intrinsic to an object, like whether a compartment physically holds a package, belongs on that object, while system-managed relationships belong on the orchestrator.
scenario: 设计 Locker 系统时，你要决定「格口是否被占用」这类状态该建在 Compartment 类自己身上，还是集中放进 Locker 维护的一个 Set/Map 里管理。
scenario_en: When designing the Locker system, you must decide whether occupancy lives on Compartment itself or in a Set/Map owned by Locker.
options_en: Whether the state happens to be an integer.
Whether the state is an intrinsic physical property or a relationship the system manages.
Whether the state shows up in an API response.
Whether the state can be cached.
tradeoff: 内在物理属性放在实体自身 vs 系统管理的关系放在 orchestrator

termDefinitions.meaning: 负责编排整体业务流程、协调多个实体的顶层对象，这里指 Locker。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An orchestrator is the top-level object that coordinates the overall workflow across multiple entities, here the Locker.

scenario: 你要选择如何表示格口是否可用，且 expired token 仍要保留用于给用户返回“已过期”。
scenario_en: You need to represent compartment availability while still keeping expired tokens so the user can get an expired-code error.
q: 最适合本文范围的可用性状态放在哪里？
q_en: Where should availability state live in this design scope?
options: 完全从 accessTokenMapping 推导，不存 occupied
在 Compartment 上存 occupied/status
在 AccessToken 上存 isCompartmentFree
在 Package 上存 openedDoor
why: 包裹是否还在格口里是物理状态，和 token 是否有效不同步。让 Compartment 管理 occupied 可以避免把过期 token 错当成可用性来源。
why_en: Keeping occupancy on Compartment avoids conflating token lifetime with physical package presence.
whenOtherWins: 如果格口数量巨大且投递极高频，可以维护按尺寸分组的可用队列作为索引，但要承担同步复杂度。
options_en: Derive availability entirely from accessTokenMapping, without storing an occupied field.
Store an occupied or status field on Compartment.
Store an isCompartmentFree flag on AccessToken.
Store an openedDoor flag on Package.
tradeoff: 占用放在 Compartment（物理状态） vs 从 token map 推导（关系状态）

termDefinitions.meaning: Locker 内部维护的 token code 到 AccessToken 对象的查找表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: accessTokenMapping is the lookup table the Locker keeps from a token code to its AccessToken object.

q: 按正确顺序排列：为什么不能只从 token map 推导格口占用？
q_en: Put the reasoning in order: why can't occupancy be derived only from the token map?
steps: 如果把过期 token 当作无效并忽略，系统会以为格口空闲。
取件码 7 天后过期，但包裹仍在格口内。
因此 token 有效性不能等价于物理占用。
工作人员清理前，格口不应被重新分配。
why: 这个推理链是本文状态建模的关键。过期 token 仍然需要留在 map 中用于返回正确错误，但格口仍被包裹占着。
why_en: The key reasoning is that expiration changes access rights but not physical occupancy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据或凭证的存活时长，过期后应被拒绝或清理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL, or Time To Live, is how long a piece of data or a credential stays valid before it must be rejected or cleaned up.

scenario: locker 只有 20-50 个格口，投递量普通，面试要求代码清晰。
scenario_en: The locker has only 20 to 50 compartments, normal deposit volume, and the interview values clear code.
q: getAvailableCompartment 的默认实现应该怎么做？
q_en: What should the default getAvailableCompartment implementation do?
options: 每次扫描 compartments，找同尺寸且未占用的格口
维护三棵平衡树按尺寸和最近使用排序
把所有格口放进一个全局随机池
让 AccessToken 反向扫描寻找空格口
why: 小规模格口下 O(n) 扫描足够，代码简单且单一来源清楚。用队列索引虽可 O(1)，但同步成本不值得。
why_en: For 20 to 50 compartments, a simple scan is clearer and the performance difference is negligible.
whenOtherWins: 当一个站点有成百上千格口且投递极高频时，按尺寸维护可用队列能把查找降到 O(1)。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["need size"] --> B["scan compartments"]
  B --> C{"size matches and free?"}
  C -- yes --> D["return compartment"]
  C -- no --> B
  B --> E["none available"]
options_en: Scan compartments each time and return the first matching, unoccupied slot of that size.
Maintain three balanced trees sorted by size and recency.
Put all compartments into one global random pool.
Have AccessToken scan backward to find an empty compartment.
tradeoff: 简单线性扫描 vs 额外索引结构换取更快查找

termDefinitions.meaning: 线性时间复杂度，成本随格口数量等比增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(n) means linear time complexity: the cost grows proportionally with the number of compartments.

scenario: 实现投递流程时，司机只提供尺寸，系统要开门并返回取件码。
scenario_en: In the deposit flow, the driver provides only the package size, and the system must open a door and return a pickup code.
q: 这段伪代码最主要表达哪条业务流程？
q_en: Which business flow does this pseudocode primarily express?
codeSample:
depositPackage(size)
    compartment = getAvailableCompartment(size)
    if compartment == null
        throw NoSpace
    compartment.open()
    compartment.markOccupied()
    token = generateAccessToken(compartment)
    accessTokenMapping[token.code] = token
    return token.code
options: 先生成 token，再等用户取件时分配格口
把过期格口直接释放给司机
先分配同尺寸空格口，再开门、占用、生成并保存 token
用一个 token 打开多个格口
why: 投递流程把格口分配、物理开门、占用标记和 token 映射串起来。返回的是 token code，不需要返回格口号。
why_en: Deposit allocates a matching free compartment, opens it, marks it occupied, stores the token, and returns only the code.
whenOtherWins: 如果生产系统必须确认司机真的放入包裹，应拆成 reserve 和 confirm 两阶段，而不是立即生成 token。
options_en: Generate the token first, and only allocate a compartment when the user later picks up.
Release an expired compartment directly to the driver.
Allocate a matching free compartment first, then open the door, mark it occupied, generate the token, and store it.
Let one token open multiple compartments.
tradeoff: 先分配格口再生成 token vs 先生成 token 再找格口

termDefinitions.meaning: 这里指 AccessToken 的取件码字符串。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Here, token refers to the AccessToken's pickup code string.

scenario: depositPackage 成功后格口门已经自动打开，司机站在 locker 前。
scenario_en: After depositPackage succeeds, the compartment door has already opened and the driver is standing at the locker.
q: 返回值为什么只需要 token code？
q_en: Why does the return value only need the token code?
options: 因为 token code 不能被通知系统使用
因为系统不需要保存 token
因为司机不需要知道哪个门，打开的门就是目标格口
因为用户必须自己猜格口号
why: 硬件开门是主要反馈，司机看到开门格口即可放包。token code 被返回给上游或通知系统转交给用户。
why_en: The opened door identifies the compartment physically, so deposit only needs to return the access code.
whenOtherWins: 如果投递不是面对实体柜机完成，而是远程预约格口，返回 compartmentId 或 reservationId 会更合理。
options_en: Because the token code can't be used by the notification system.
Because the system doesn't need to store the token.
Because the driver doesn't need to know which door — the door that opened is the target compartment.
Because the user has to guess the compartment number.
tradeoff: 只返回 token code vs 同时返回格口号

scenario: 用户输入取件码，系统需要区分空值、未找到、过期和有效取件。
scenario_en: The user enters a pickup code, and the system must distinguish empty, missing, expired, and valid codes.
q: pickup 的核心顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the core order of the pickup flow?
options: 直接打开所有格口，再检查 token
校验 code 非空 -> 查 token -> 检查过期 -> 开门并清理状态
只检查格口是否 occupied，不需要 token map
先删除 token，再判断是否过期
why: pickup 是访问控制流程，先拒绝无效或过期 token，再对有效 token 开门并释放格口。顺序错误会产生安全或状态一致性问题。
why_en: Pickup must validate the token before opening the compartment and clearing state.
whenOtherWins: 如果是工作人员维护流程，可以不走用户 token 校验，而通过后台权限打开过期格口。
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant L as Locker
  participant M as tokenMap
  participant C as Compartment
  U->>L: pickup(code)
  L->>M: find token
  L->>C: open
  L->>C: clear package
  L->>M: remove token
options_en: Open every compartment first, then check the token.
Validate the code is non-empty, look up the token, check expiry, then open the door and clear state.
Only check whether the compartment is occupied, without needing the token map.
Delete the token first, then check whether it was expired.
tradeoff: 先校验 token 再开门 vs 先开门再校验

scenario: 成功取件后需要防止同一取件码再次开门。
scenario_en: After a successful pickup, the same pickup code must not be able to open the door again.
q: 这段 clearDeposit 代码维护了哪两个状态？
q_en: Which two states does this clearDeposit code maintain?
codeSample:
clearDeposit(accessToken)
    compartment = accessToken.getCompartment()
    compartment.markFree()
    accessTokenMapping.remove(accessToken.getCode())
options: 只把 token 标记为过期，不释放格口
只关闭门，不改变任何内存状态
释放物理格口，并删除 token 映射
把 token 移到 usedTokens 以支持精确错误
why: 成功取件后格口可再分配，token 也不应继续有效。漏掉任一步都会造成可用性或安全状态不一致。
why_en: Successful pickup must free the compartment and remove the token mapping together.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品明确要求区分“已使用”和“从未存在”，可以保留 usedTokens 或在 token 上加使用状态。
options_en: Only mark the token as expired without freeing the compartment.
Only close the door without changing any in-memory state.
Free the physical compartment and remove the token mapping.
Move the token into a usedTokens set to support precise error messages.
tradeoff: 同时释放格口并删除 token vs 只做其中一步

q: 补全过期时间规则：
q_en: Complete the expiration-time rule:
text: AccessToken 的 expiration 应设置为生成时刻加 {{7 天}}；isExpired 通常比较 {{now >= expiration}}。
why: 7 天是产品给定的固定 TTL 目标，不是估算公式的结果；它决定 AccessToken 必须自带 expiration 字段并提供 isExpired 判断，而不是把过期逻辑散落在调用方。
why_en: The seven-day window is a given product target rather than a calculated figure, so AccessToken must own an expiration timestamp and expose an isExpired check.
scenario: AccessToken 的过期时间是产品给定的固定目标（7 天），不是从流量或容量推导出来的公式结果；pickup 时必须用它做 isExpired 判断。
scenario_en: AccessToken expiration is a fixed product target of seven days, not a formula derived from traffic or capacity; pickup must use it for isExpired checks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据或凭证的存活时长，过期后应被拒绝或清理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL, or Time To Live, is how long a piece of data or a credential stays valid before it must be rejected or cleaned up.

scenario: 用户在第 8 天输入原取件码，包裹还没有被工作人员取走。
scenario_en: On day eight, the user enters the original pickup code, and staff has not removed the package yet.
q: 系统应该如何处理？
q_en: How should the system handle this?
options: 直接打开格口，把状态标记为已释放
把错误当成普通无效码，不提示已过期
自动把包裹转移到其它可用格口
返回过期错误，但保留 token 与占用状态
why: 过期码不能开门，但包裹仍占用格口。保留 token 让系统能给出“已过期”的可解释错误。
why_en: An expired pickup should be rejected while keeping the compartment occupied until staff removes the package.
whenOtherWins: 如果安全策略要求不暴露码是否曾经存在，可以把过期和无效都显示为通用错误，但内部仍要保留清理状态。
options_en: Open the compartment directly and mark its state as released.
Treat it as a generic invalid code without mentioning expiry.
Automatically move the package to another available compartment.
Return an expired error, but keep the token and the occupied state.
tradeoff: 保留 token 便于诊断 vs 立即释放格口提高可用性

scenario: 工作人员要处理所有过期未取包裹，并把它们退回寄件方。
scenario_en: Staff needs to handle all expired, unclaimed packages and return them to the sender.
q: openExpiredCompartments 为什么不应该直接调用 clearDeposit？
q_en: Why shouldn't openExpiredCompartments call clearDeposit directly?
options: clearDeposit 只能删除未过期 token
过期包裹应立即被客户领取
工作人员打开门后仍需实际取走包裹，系统不应提前释放格口
工作人员流程不需要访问 token map
why: 开门只是让工作人员能取包，清理应发生在确认包裹已被物理移除之后。否则系统可能把仍有包裹的格口重新分配。
why_en: Staff opening expired compartments is not the same as confirming the packages were physically removed.
whenOtherWins: 如果 locker 有可靠传感器或工作人员确认 API，可以在确认移除后调用单独的 cleanupExpiredDeposit。
options_en: clearDeposit can only remove tokens that have not expired.
An expired package should be picked up by the customer immediately.
Opening the door still leaves staff to physically remove the package, so the system shouldn't free the slot early.
The staff workflow doesn't need to access the token map.
tradeoff: 开门后立即清理 vs 确认物理移除后再清理

q: Locker 在本文设计中直接持有哪些状态？（多选）
q_en: Which state does Locker directly hold in this design? (Select all that apply.)
options: 所有 compartments
access token code 到 AccessToken 的映射
每个包裹的配送路线
短信发送队列
why: Locker 是 orchestrator，负责分配格口和 token 查找。配送路线和通知都被排除在系统边界外。
why_en: Locker stores compartments and token lookup state, while delivery routing and notification are out of scope.
diagram:
classDiagram
  class Locker
  class Compartment
  class AccessToken
  class Package
  Locker --> Compartment
  Locker --> AccessToken
  Compartment --> Package
options_en: All compartments.
A mapping from access token code to AccessToken.
Each package's delivery route.
The SMS notification queue.

q: Compartment 适合承担哪些职责？（多选）
q_en: Which responsibilities fit Compartment? (Select all that apply.)
options: 保存尺寸
保存是否物理占用
执行 open 动作
决定 access token 是否过期
why: Compartment 管理物理格口的属性和状态。token 过期属于 AccessToken，整体流程编排属于 Locker。
why_en: Compartment owns physical slot properties and actions, not token lifetime decisions.
options_en: Store its size.
Store whether it's physically occupied.
Perform the open action.
Decide whether an access token has expired.

q: 为什么“已使用 token”和“从未存在 token”可以都返回 invalid？
q_en: Why can an already-used token and a never-existing token both return invalid?
options: 因为系统从不删除 token
因为已使用 token 应该能再次打开门
因为 invalid 只用于过期 token
因为取件成功后 token 已从 map 删除，两者都不可用了
why: 用户需要知道码不能用，不一定需要知道历史原因。要区分这两种状态，需要额外 usedTokens 或 token 状态，当前范围不值得。
why_en: After successful pickup the token is removed, so reused and never-seen codes can both be treated as invalid.
options_en: Because the system never removes tokens.
Because an already-used token should be able to open the door again.
Because invalid is only used for expired tokens.
Because a successful pickup already removes the token from the map, so both cases are equally unusable now.
tradeoff: 统一返回 invalid 换实现简单 vs 拆分历史原因换更精确诊断

scenario: 实现 generateAccessToken 时，面试官追问“code 怎么生成”。
scenario_en: While implementing generateAccessToken, the interviewer asks how the code is generated.
q: 合理回答是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable answer?
options: 用 compartmentId 作为 code，方便猜测
所有 medium 包裹共享一个 code
使用安全随机生成短码或 UUID，并设置过期时间
用当前日期作为 code，不保存映射
why: token 是 bearer credential，真实系统应避免可预测。本文重点不是随机算法，但要明确 code 唯一、不可轻易猜到，并映射到格口。
why_en: Access codes should be generated with secure randomness and tied to an expiration and compartment mapping.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是白板伪代码，可以暂时用 generateRandomCode() 占位，但要说明真实实现需要碰撞处理和安全随机。
options_en: Use the compartmentId as the code, so it's easy to guess.
Share a single code across all medium packages.
Generate a short code or UUID with a secure random generator, and set an expiration.
Use the current date as the code, without storing a mapping.
tradeoff: 安全随机生成 vs 简单可预测方案换开发速度
codeSample:
generateAccessToken(compartment)
    code = secureRandom()      // 6-digit code or UUID
    expiration = now() + 7.days()
    return AccessToken(code, expiration, compartment)

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种几乎不会重复的唯一标识符，常用于生成不可预测的凭证码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A UUID, or Universally Unique Identifier, is an identifier that is extremely unlikely to collide, often used to generate unpredictable credential codes.

q: 补全清理状态的不变量：
q_en: Complete the cleanup-state invariant:
text: 一次有效 pickup 完成后，必须同时让 compartment {{markFree}}，并从 accessTokenMapping 中 {{remove token code}}。
why: 这两个状态一起表达“格口可再次分配且旧码不可再用”。只做其中一个会导致双重分配或重复开门风险。
why_en: Valid pickup must update both occupancy and token lookup to preserve availability and access-control invariants.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把格口标记为空闲、可再分配的方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: markFree is the method that marks a compartment as empty and available for reassignment.

scenario: 现在 locker 规模扩大到数千格口，每秒大量投递，线性扫描成为瓶颈。
scenario_en: The locker now scales to thousands of compartments with many deposits per second, so linear scan becomes a bottleneck.
q: 哪个优化最符合文章里的替代方案？
q_en: Which optimization best matches the alternative design?
options: 给每个 token 复制一份格口对象
把所有格口随机排序后永不更新
删除 occupied 状态只看 token 是否未过期
按 Size 维护可用 Compartment 队列
why: 按尺寸分组的队列可把查找和归还都做成 O(1)。代价是必须严格维护队列和真实占用状态一致。
why_en: A queue of available compartments per size gives O(1) allocation at the cost of maintaining an extra index.
whenOtherWins: 小型 locker 用线性扫描更清晰；优化索引只有在规模或频率证明需要时才值得。
options_en: Copy a compartment object for every token.
Randomly sort all compartments once and never update it.
Remove the occupied field and only check whether the token hasn't expired.
Maintain a queue of available compartments grouped by size.
tradeoff: O(1) 索引查找 vs 维护两份状态的同步复杂度

q: 用 Queue 存可用格口相比 Set 的一个额外好处是什么？
q_en: What extra benefit does a Queue have over a Set for available compartments?
options: Queue 自动判断 token 是否过期
Queue 可以防止所有并发 bug
Set 不能存储 Compartment
FIFO 分配可以更均匀地分摊格口磨损
why: 队列让被释放的格口排到后面，避免总是使用同一个格口。这个好处仍然要和额外索引复杂度权衡。
why_en: A queue can distribute wear more evenly by allocating compartments in FIFO order.
options_en: A queue automatically checks whether a token has expired.
A queue prevents all concurrency bugs.
A Set cannot store Compartment objects.
FIFO allocation spreads compartment wear more evenly.
tradeoff: FIFO 磨损均衡 vs 额外索引维护成本

termDefinitions.meaning: 先进先出的处理顺序，最先放回的元素最先被取用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIFO, First In First Out, processes items in the order they were added, so the earliest one returned is the next one used.

scenario: 基础需求说 small、medium、large 必须 exact match，medium 满了但 large 还有空。
scenario_en: The base requirement says small, medium, and large must be exact matches; medium is full but large still has space.
q: depositPackage(MEDIUM) 应该怎么做？
q_en: What should depositPackage(MEDIUM) do?
options: 拒绝投递并返回无可用 medium 格口
自动放入 large 格口
把包裹拆成 small
生成 token 但不分配格口
why: 题目当前范围明确要求精确尺寸匹配，不做 fallback。按范围实现比提前扩展更重要。
why_en: The base requirement uses exact size matching, so a medium package is rejected if no medium compartment is available.
whenOtherWins: 如果追问 size fallback，再按 SMALL->MEDIUM->LARGE 的顺序寻找不小于包裹的格口。
options_en: Reject the deposit and report no available medium compartment.
Automatically place it in a large compartment.
Split the package into smaller pieces.
Generate a token without allocating a compartment.
tradeoff: 严格精确匹配 vs 向上尺寸 fallback

q: 如果要支持小包裹使用更大格口，正确分配链路是什么？
q_en: If small packages can use larger compartments, what is the correct allocation path?
steps: 若所有候选尺寸都没有空格口，返回 no space。
从请求尺寸开始，在有序尺寸列表中向更大尺寸扫描。
找到第一个同尺寸空格口后返回，不再继续找更大的。
绝不向更小尺寸 fallback，因为包裹可能放不下。
why: fallback 的规则是单向向上，不是任意匹配。把尺寸顺序封装在分配逻辑里，其他流程不需要改变。
why_en: Size fallback searches from the requested size upward and never assigns a smaller compartment.

termDefinitions.meaning: 首选方案不可用时，退而求其次采用的替代方案。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A fallback is the alternative approach used when the preferred option is unavailable.

scenario: 后续要求格口门可能坏掉，维护中格口不能被分配。
scenario_en: A later requirement says compartment doors can break, and compartments under maintenance cannot be assigned.
q: 最自然的模型变化是什么？
q_en: What is the most natural model change?
options: 把坏掉的格口从 accessTokenMapping 里直接删掉
让 AccessToken 多存一个维修人员电话字段
引入 CompartmentStatus 状态枚举，替换 occupied 布尔值
把 Size 这个枚举类型整个删掉
why: available、occupied、out_of_service 不再是二元状态，用 status enum 表达更准确。分配逻辑只需要检查 isAvailable。
why_en: A status enum models available, occupied, and out-of-service states better than a boolean.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需要临时忽略少数格口，也可以在 Locker 维护 disabledCompartmentIds，但状态 enum 更贴合实体状态。
options_en: Delete the broken compartment directly from accessTokenMapping.
Have AccessToken also store a maintenance contact phone number.
Introduce a CompartmentStatus enum to replace the occupied boolean.
Delete the Size enum entirely.
tradeoff: 布尔值简单 vs 枚举表达三态更准确
codeSample:
enum CompartmentStatus:
    AVAILABLE
    OCCUPIED
    OUT_OF_SERVICE

isAvailable()
    return status == AVAILABLE

termDefinitions.meaning: 限定取值范围的类型，这里用来表达格口的三种互斥状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An enum is a type restricted to a fixed set of values, used here to express the compartment's three mutually exclusive states.

q: 加入维护状态后，CompartmentStatus 可能包含哪些值？（多选）
q_en: After adding maintenance state, which values might CompartmentStatus include? (Select all that apply.)
options: AVAILABLE
OCCUPIED
OUT_OF_SERVICE
TOKEN_EXPIRED
why: 维护状态描述格口本身能否分配。TOKEN_EXPIRED 是访问凭证状态，不应混进格口物理状态。
why_en: Compartment status should describe the slot's availability, not the token's lifecycle.
options_en: AVAILABLE
OCCUPIED
OUT_OF_SERVICE
TOKEN_EXPIRED

scenario: 生产系统必须保证司机确实把包裹放进格口，不能只开门后假设成功。
scenario_en: A production system must confirm the driver actually put the package inside, not just assume success after opening the door.
q: 比单阶段 deposit 更合适的流程是什么？
q_en: What flow is better than a single-phase deposit?
options: 先给用户 token，再让司机随便找一个格口
把包裹是否存在的检查留到 pickup 时才做
所有投递都改成工作人员手工登记处理
reserve 先占位开门，确认放入后 confirm 才生成 token
why: 两阶段流程先保留并开门，确认放入后才标记 occupied 并生成 token。它解决了“开门但司机离开”的空格口发码问题。
why_en: A two-phase reserve and confirm flow prevents issuing a pickup token for an empty compartment.
whenOtherWins: 在面试基础范围里，单阶段 deposit 更简单；两阶段适合需要传感器、人工确认或严格物理验证的生产系统。
options_en: Give the user a token first, then let the driver find any compartment afterward.
Defer the check for whether the package exists until pickup time.
Route every deposit through manual staff registration instead.
Reserve opens the door first; only after confirm does it issue the token.
tradeoff: 单阶段简单 vs 两阶段确认换取物理存在保证
codeSample:
reserveCompartment(size) -> reservationId   // opens door, status=RESERVED
confirmDeposit(reservationId) -> tokenCode   // status=OCCUPIED, token issued

q: 两阶段投递的正确状态变化顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct state-change order for a two-phase deposit?
steps: confirmDeposit 根据 reservationId 找到格口。
reserveCompartment 找可用格口并标记 RESERVED。
生成 token，标记 OCCUPIED，并删除 reservation 记录。
如果超时未确认，取消 reservation 并释放格口。
why: 核心是 token 只在确认之后产生，RESERVED 状态需要超时清理。这样避免长期占用或空格口发码。
why_en: The two-phase flow reserves first, confirms before issuing the token, and times out abandoned reservations.
diagram:
stateDiagram
  [*] --> Reserved
  Reserved --> Occupied: driver confirms
  Reserved --> Available: timeout
  Occupied --> Available: pickup

termDefinitions.meaning: 预留后若超过设定时间未确认，系统自动取消预留并释放格口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A reservation timeout automatically cancels an unconfirmed reservation and frees the compartment after a set time window.

q: invalid token 和 expired token 为什么要给不同错误？
q_en: Why should invalid token and expired token return different errors?
options: invalid 一定说明包裹被盗
expired 可以继续开门
二者必须完全一样，否则无法清理
expired 说明码曾有效但窗口已过，用户应联系支持
why: 过期错误告诉用户码曾有效但窗口已过，包裹仍可能需要人工处理。随机错误或已使用码则只说明当前不可用。
why_en: An expired-token error is actionable because the package may still be in the locker awaiting staff handling.
options_en: Invalid always means the package was stolen.
An expired token can still open the door.
The two must be identical, or cleanup becomes impossible.
Expired means the code was once valid but the window passed, so the user should contact support.
tradeoff: 统一 invalid 错误换简单 vs 单独 expired 错误换可操作性

scenario: 产品经理问是否要实现失败多次后锁定取件码。
scenario_en: The product manager asks whether pickup codes should be locked after repeated failures.
q: 根据本文基础范围应该怎么处理？
q_en: How should this be handled in the base scope?
options: 先不实现，只校验错误码并返回错误
必须记录每个失败尝试和时间窗口
把失败次数写入 Compartment
失败一次就永久删除 token
why: 失败锁定会引入额外状态和时间窗口，已被澄清为 out of scope。识别但不实现它，是控制范围的表现。
why_en: Failed-attempt lockout is a scoped-out security feature that would add extra state and timing rules.
whenOtherWins: 如果安全要求明确包括防暴力破解，再为 token 或用户维护失败计数、窗口和锁定状态。
options_en: Don't implement it yet — just validate the error code and return an error.
Must log every failed attempt and its time window.
Write the failure count onto Compartment.
Permanently delete the token after a single failure.
tradeoff: 先不做换保持简单 vs 提前实现锁定换安全性

scenario: pickup(tokenCode) 是高频路径，输入 code 后要快速找到对应权限对象。
scenario_en: pickup(tokenCode) is a high-frequency path, so the system must quickly find the matching access object from the code.
q: Locker 应该维护哪种结构？
q_en: What structure should Locker maintain?
options: List<Compartment> 并逐个比较 code
Map<Size, Package>
Map<string, AccessToken>
单个全局 currentToken
why: code 到 AccessToken 的 map 让取件查找是 O(1)。AccessToken 再持有对应 Compartment 引用，能直接开门。
why_en: A map from token code to AccessToken gives direct lookup for pickup.
whenOtherWins: 如果存储在数据库中，map 会变成 token code 上的索引，但抽象关系仍相同。
options_en: A List<Compartment> compared one by one against the code.
A Map<Size, Package>.
A Map<string, AccessToken>.
A single global currentToken.
tradeoff: 哈希表 O(1) 查找 vs 线性列表逐个比较
codeSample:
accessTokenMapping: Map<string, AccessToken>

pickup(code):
    token = accessTokenMapping.get(code)   // O(1) lookup
    if token == null: throw InvalidCode

termDefinitions.meaning: 按 key 直接定位值的数据结构，平均查找是 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash map locates a value directly by key, giving average O(1) lookup.

q: 补全 Information Expert 的职责划分：
q_en: Complete the Information Expert responsibility split:
text: Locker 管理{{分配和 token 映射}}；AccessToken 管理{{过期判断}}；Compartment 管理{{物理占用状态}}。
why: 哪个对象拥有数据，哪个对象就应该最懂如何使用那份数据。这个原则让方法短小且职责稳定。
why_en: Information Expert assigns allocation to Locker, expiration to AccessToken, and physical occupancy to Compartment.

termDefinitions.meaning: GRASP 设计原则之一：谁拥有数据，谁就该实现使用这份数据的行为。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Information Expert is a GRASP design principle stating that the object owning the data should implement the behavior that uses it.

scenario: 开发者提议 token 一过期就从 accessTokenMapping 删除。
scenario_en: A developer suggests deleting a token from accessTokenMapping as soon as it expires.
q: 为什么这会破坏需求？
q_en: Why would this break the requirement?
options: 系统无法区分过期码，且工作人员仍需找到过期格口
删除 map 会让所有格口变大
token 删除后包裹会自动消失
过期码应继续允许用户取件
why: 过期后仍要返回具体过期错误，并让工作人员找到要处理的格口。提前删除会丢掉访问和清理上下文。
why_en: Deleting expired tokens immediately loses both the ability to report expiry and the mapping needed for staff handling.
whenOtherWins: 在工作人员确认移除包裹后，可以删除 expired token 并释放格口。
options_en: The system can no longer distinguish expired codes, and staff can't find the compartment to handle.
Deleting the map makes every compartment bigger.
The package disappears automatically once the token is deleted.
Expired codes should still be allowed to open the door.
tradeoff: 立即删除 token 简化 map vs 保留 token 支持过期诊断与清理

q: pickup 为什么可以返回 void，而不是返回 Package 或 Compartment？
q_en: Why can pickup return void instead of returning Package or Compartment?
options: 因为 pickup 不需要检查 token
因为返回 void 可以跳过清理
因为用户必须自己打开门
因为开门就是用户可见的成功反馈，不必暴露格口对象
why: locker 是与硬件联动的系统，开门就是用户可见结果。业务上不需要把格口对象暴露给调用方。
why_en: Pickup can return void because the hardware door opening is the observable success result.
options_en: Because pickup doesn't need to check the token.
Because returning void lets you skip cleanup.
Because the user has to open the door themselves.
Because the door opening is the visible success signal, so there's no need to expose the compartment object.
tradeoff: void 返回值更简洁 vs 返回对象换调用方可编程性

q: pickup 应显式处理哪些边界情况？（多选）
q_en: Which edge cases should pickup handle explicitly? (Select all that apply.)
options: tokenCode 为空
token 不存在
token 已过期
格口尺寸比包裹大
why: pickup 路径围绕取件码有效性和期限判断。格口尺寸是投递分配时的问题，不是取件时的主要边界。
why_en: Pickup edge cases focus on token presence and expiry, while size matching belongs to deposit.
options_en: tokenCode is empty.
The token doesn't exist.
The token has expired.
The compartment is bigger than the package.

scenario: 有人想把 isExpired(token) 写成 Locker 的工具函数，而 AccessToken 只存字段。
scenario_en: Someone wants to make isExpired(token) a Locker helper while AccessToken only stores fields.
q: 更好的职责放置是什么？
q_en: Where is the better place for this responsibility?
options: AccessToken.isExpired()
Locker.isExpired(token)
Compartment.isExpired()
Size.isExpired()
why: 过期时间是 AccessToken 自己的数据，过期判断也应放在它身上。Locker 只负责调用判断并编排流程。
why_en: Expiration logic belongs on AccessToken because it owns the expiration timestamp.
whenOtherWins: 如果过期策略变成可配置业务策略，也可以抽出 ExpirationPolicy，但基础题不需要。
options_en: AccessToken.isExpired()
Locker.isExpired(token)
Compartment.isExpired()
Size.isExpired()
tradeoff: 把判断放在拥有数据的 AccessToken vs 放在编排者 Locker

q: 补全与 Parking Lot 的状态归属对比：
q_en: Complete the state-ownership contrast with Parking Lot:
text: Amazon Locker 把占用看作{{物理状态}}，因此放在 Compartment；Parking Lot 把占用看作{{ticket 赋值关系}}，因此可放在 orchestrator 的 Set。
why: 两题都能用多种方案，关键是说清楚领域语义。不要机械套用一个固定模式。
why_en: The article contrasts physical occupancy in lockers with assignment-style occupancy in parking lots.
scenario: 在另一道经典 LLD 题 Parking Lot 中，车位是否被占用通常由 orchestrator 维护的一个 ticket→spot 关系（比如 Set）表示，而不是车位自身的字段。
scenario_en: In the classic Parking Lot LLD problem, spot occupancy is often represented by a ticket-to-spot relationship owned by the orchestrator, such as a Set, rather than a field on the spot.

termDefinitions.meaning: Parking Lot 系统里代表一次占用关系的凭证对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In the Parking Lot system, a ticket is the object representing one occupancy assignment.

scenario: 你担心司机打开门后没放包，用户却收到了取件码。
scenario_en: You are worried that the driver opens the door but does not place the package, while the user still receives a pickup code.
q: 这是哪种当前设计的代价？
q_en: Which current design tradeoff causes this risk?
options: 单阶段 deposit 的假设成本
token map O(1) 查找的成本
Size enum 的成本
Compartment.getSize 的成本
why: 单阶段流程假设司机在开门后完成投递。若要消除这个假设，需要确认步骤、传感器或 reservation timeout。
why_en: The risk comes from a single-phase deposit flow that assumes the driver actually deposits the package.
whenOtherWins: 基础面试题可以接受这个假设以保持设计简洁；生产安全性更高时才引入两阶段。
options_en: The assumption cost of a single-phase deposit.
The cost of O(1) token-map lookup.
The cost of the Size enum.
The cost of Compartment.getSize.
tradeoff: 单阶段简单 vs 两阶段确认换取物理存在保证

q: 为什么线性扫描 compartments 在这种规模的 locker 里是可接受的设计？
q_en: Why is a linear scan over compartments acceptable at this locker scale?
options: locker 一定只有 1 个格口
所有语言扫描数组都是 O(1)
token 过期后就不需要扫描
几十个格口的规模下，O(n) 和 O(1) 差异可忽略
why: 格口数量级只有几十个，O(n) 扫描和 O(1) 索引的实际耗时差异小到可以忽略；这个量级判断决定了要不要为几十个元素引入按尺寸分组的队列索引。
why_en: At the scale of a few dozen compartments, the real cost difference between an O(n) scan and an O(1) indexed lookup is negligible, so it decides whether the extra size-grouped queue index is worth building.
scenario: 一个典型 Amazon Locker 站点只有 20-50 个格口；depositPackage 每次调用 getAvailableCompartment 做一次线性扫描。
scenario_en: A typical Amazon Locker site has only 20 to 50 compartments; each depositPackage call does one linear scan in getAvailableCompartment.
options_en: A locker is assumed to always have exactly one compartment.
Array scans are O(1) in every language.
Scanning becomes unnecessary once a token expires.
At a scale of a few dozen compartments, the O(n) versus O(1) difference is negligible.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线性时间复杂度，成本随元素数量等比增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(n) is linear time complexity, where cost grows proportionally with the number of elements.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常数时间复杂度，成本几乎不随元素数量变化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(1) is constant time complexity, where cost barely changes with the number of elements.

scenario: 你要实现本文选择的可用格口查找方式。
scenario_en: You are implementing the available-compartment lookup chosen for this design.
q: 这段伪代码体现了哪个设计取舍？
q_en: Which design tradeoff does this pseudocode show?
codeSample:
getAvailableCompartment(size)
    for c in compartments
        if c.getSize() == size && !c.isOccupied()
            return c
    return null
options: 用 Compartment 上的物理状态作为单一可用性来源
用 accessTokenMapping 推导占用
用每个 Size 的队列做 O(1) 分配
允许任何尺寸互相替代
why: 查找逻辑直接读取格口尺寸和 occupied 状态，保持简单。它故意不从 token 生命周期推导物理占用。
why_en: This scan uses the compartment's physical occupancy as the source of availability.
whenOtherWins: 极大规模或高频投递时，按尺寸维护可用队列会更快。
options_en: Use the compartment's own physical state as the single source of availability.
Derive occupancy from accessTokenMapping instead.
Maintain an O(1) queue of available compartments per size.
Allow any size to substitute for any other.
tradeoff: 单一物理状态来源简单 vs 从 token 生命周期推导更省内存但更复杂

scenario: openExpiredCompartments 扫描到多个过期 token。
scenario_en: openExpiredCompartments scans and finds multiple expired tokens.
q: 它应该对每个过期 token 做什么？
q_en: What should it do for each expired token?
options: 立刻把 compartment markFree
重新生成新 token 给客户
打开对应 compartment，让工作人员物理取包
把 token 当作无效直接删除
why: 工作人员流程的第一步是打开过期包裹所在格口。释放和删除应在确认包裹被移除后发生。
why_en: openExpiredCompartments should open the compartments tied to expired tokens for staff handling, not free them prematurely.
whenOtherWins: 如果系统有 staffConfirmRemoved(tokenCode)，那个确认方法可以再清理 token 和 occupied 状态。
options_en: Immediately mark the compartment free.
Generate a brand-new token for the customer.
Open the matching compartment so staff can physically retrieve the package.
Treat the token as invalid and delete it right away.
tradeoff: 先开门给工作人员看 vs 立即清理状态

q: Senior 级回答应该主动讨论哪些 Amazon Locker 取舍？（多选）
q_en: Which Amazon Locker tradeoffs should a senior-level answer proactively discuss? (Select all that apply.)
options: Package 是否需要成为实体，或只作为 token/metadata 保留
occupied 放 Compartment 还是 orchestrator/index
过期 token 的 lazy cleanup
尺寸 fallback 和坏格口扩展
无论范围如何，都应该先实现失败次数锁定安全机制
why: 高级信号是能解释范围、状态语义和演进路径，不是不顾澄清结果强行实现被排除的功能。Package 需要追踪重量、承运商或赔付时才值得建实体；范围只围绕 token 和 compartment 时，metadata 就够。
why_en: Senior answers explain entity pruning, state ownership, lazy cleanup, and extension tradeoffs, without forcing in a feature the interviewer already scoped out, like lockout.
options_en: Whether Package needs to be a real entity, or can stay as token/metadata.
Whether occupancy lives on Compartment or in an orchestrator index.
Lazy cleanup of expired tokens.
Size fallback and handling broken compartments.
Failed-attempt lockout should always be implemented regardless of scope.

q: 按正确顺序排列 Amazon Locker 的主设计决策链：
q_en: Put the main Amazon Locker design-decision chain in the correct order:
steps: 让 Locker 作为入口，持有 compartments 和 token map。
需求只覆盖 locker 内操作，排除物流和通知。
把 AccessToken 建成带 expiration 和 compartment 引用的实体。
把 physical occupied 放在 Compartment，并在 pickup 清理。
用简单扫描查找同尺寸空格口，扩展时再考虑索引。
why: 这个链路从范围收敛开始，再落到实体、状态和性能选择。面试表达时按这个顺序更容易防止过早优化。
why_en: The design chain moves from scope to orchestrator, token entity, physical occupancy, and then allocation performance.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[scope pickup/deposit] --> B[Compartment owns physical state]
  B --> C[Token maps code to compartment]
  C --> D[pickup clears both]
  D --> E[handle expiry]

scenario: 面试最后问“这个设计的核心不变量是什么？”
scenario_en: At the end of the interview, you are asked: what is the core invariant of this design?
q: 最重要的不变量是哪一个？
q_en: What is the most important invariant?
options: 一个有效 token 只对应一个被占用格口，取件成功后两者一起清理
所有包裹都必须建成独立的 Package 对象
所有格口必须按随机顺序被分配
过期 token 自动等价于格口空闲可用
why: token 映射和格口占用必须一致，且 token 生命周期不能和物理占用混淆。这个不变量支撑投递、取件和过期处理。
why_en: The central invariant is that a valid token maps to one occupied compartment and successful pickup clears both states together.
whenOtherWins: 如果采用 reservation/confirm 两阶段，还需要增加 RESERVED 不变量和 reservation timeout 清理规则。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["active token"] --> B["points to occupied compartment"]
  B --> C["contains package"]
  D["pickup or expire"] --> E["remove token"]
  E --> F["clear compartment"]
options_en: A valid token maps to exactly one occupied compartment, and a successful pickup clears both together.
Every package must have its own Package object.
Every compartment must be assigned in random order.
An expired token automatically means the compartment is free.
tradeoff: 统一清理不变量 vs 允许 token/占用状态短暂不同步

q: BookMyShow 基础需求包含哪些能力？（多选）
q_en: Which capabilities belong in the base BookMyShow design? (select all that apply)
options: 按标题搜索电影
浏览某个影院的未来场次
用户选择具体座位并一次预订多个座位
支付处理和座位差异定价
why: 基础系统覆盖搜索、浏览、查看座位、预订、并发防重和取消。支付、座位类型、价格和改签被排除。
why_en: The base movie-booking design covers search, browsing, seat selection, booking, concurrency, and cancellation, but not payment or pricing.
options_en: Search movies by title.
Browse a theater's upcoming showtimes.
Let a user pick specific seats and book several in one reservation.
Payment processing and per-seat differential pricing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本设计案例中的电影订票系统，用户可搜索电影、选座并预订。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BookMyShow is the movie-ticket booking system this design case is built around, where users search, pick seats, and book.

q: 补全标准座位布局：
q_en: Fill in the standard seat layout.
text: 每个 screen 使用相同座位布局：行 {{A-Z}}，每行座位号 {{0-20}}，所以每个 showtime 有 {{546}} 个座位。
why: 这是产品给定的规格，不是公式推导出来的：行范围和列范围决定了 546 这个每场座位总数，它是 getAvailableSeats 全量扫描的规模上限。
why_en: This is a given layout spec rather than a derived formula, and the resulting 546-seat count sets the scan size for getAvailableSeats.
scenario: 所有 screen 统一座位布局，前端要用这个规格预渲染整张座位图，并算出每场次的座位总数。
scenario_en: Every screen uses the same seat layout, so the client pre-renders the seating chart and computes the seat count per showtime.

scenario: 面试官同意所有 screen 都采用同一座位布局，只需要告诉用户在哪个厅看。
scenario_en: The interviewer agrees every screen uses the same seat layout, and users only need to know which hall they are in.
q: Screen 应该如何建模？
q_en: How should Screen be modeled?
options: 独立类，拥有 seat map 和 booking logic
Showtime 上的 screenLabel 字符串字段
Reservation 的子类
Movie 上的全局常量
why: Screen 不维护差异化状态，也不执行业务规则，只是“Screen 3”这类导航标签。降级为字段能减少无意义实体。
why_en: Screen can be a label because standardized layouts remove its state and behavior.
whenOtherWins: 如果不同厅有不同座位布局、无障碍座、屏幕属性或维护状态，Screen 才值得成为实体。
options_en: A standalone class with its own seat map and booking logic.
A screenLabel string field on Showtime.
A subclass of Reservation.
A global constant on Movie.
tradeoff: 轻量字符串字段 vs 承载状态和逻辑的独立实体类

scenario: 用户选择 A5、A6 这类座位；当前系统不需要座位价格、状态机或锁对象。
scenario_en: Users choose seats like A5 and A6; the base system does not need seat prices, state machines, or lock objects.
q: Seat 最适合怎么表示？
q_en: What is the best representation for Seat?
options: 含有价格、锁和 bookedBy 的实体
字符串 ID，例如 A5
Movie 的字段
Theater 的枚举
why: 座位在基础范围内只是稳定标识，不拥有行为。字符串自带相等和哈希，足够作为预订列表元素。
why_en: A seat can be a string identifier when it has no behavior beyond equality and hashing.
whenOtherWins: 如果采用 per-seat locking、座位等级、无障碍属性或独立生命周期，就应把 Seat 升级为类。
options_en: An entity carrying price, a lock, and bookedBy.
A plain string ID, like A5.
A field on Movie.
An enum on Theater.
tradeoff: 轻量字符串标识 vs 携带锁和状态的实体类

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程互斥访问共享状态时使用的同步原语，一次只允许一个线程持有。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lock is a synchronization primitive that lets only one thread mutate shared state at a time.

q: 哪个类拥有某一场具体电影的座位状态和预订并发控制？
q_en: Which class owns the seat state and booking concurrency for one movie screening?
options: Movie
Theater
Showtime
BookingSystem
why: 每个 showtime 是真正可预订单位：同一电影在不同时间或影院有不同座位状态。把状态放在 Showtime 可以把并发锁粒度控制在单场。
why_en: Showtime owns booking state because each screening has its own seat availability and concurrency boundary.
diagram:
classDiagram
  class BookingSystem
  class Showtime
  class Reservation
  class Movie
  BookingSystem --> Showtime
  Showtime --> Movie
  Showtime --> Reservation
  Showtime : reservedSeats
  Showtime : bookingLock
options_en: Movie
Theater
Showtime
BookingSystem

termDefinitions.meaning: 协调多个并发操作访问共享状态，避免出现冲突结果的机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Concurrency control coordinates simultaneous operations on shared state so they don't produce conflicting results.

q: 最终实体设计中哪些是类？（多选）
q_en: Which objects are classes in the final entity model? (select all that apply)
options: BookingSystem（编排者，管理索引与流程）
Movie（可搜索实体，串联多场放映）
Theater（拥有 showtime 列表的容器）
Showtime（拥有座位状态与并发控制）
Reservation（预订记录，回指 Showtime）
Seat（含 lock 和 bookedBy 的完整实体类）
Screen（拥有座位布局的独立实体类）
why: 这五个对象都有查询、连接或状态职责，被建成类；Seat 在基础范围内是字符串标识，Screen 只是 Showtime 上的字符串字段，都不需要额外的类。
why_en: BookingSystem, Movie, Theater, Showtime, and Reservation are classes because each owns queries, connections, or state, while Seat and Screen stay lightweight strings.
diagram:
classDiagram
  class BookingSystem
  class Movie
  class Theater
  class Showtime
  class Reservation
  BookingSystem --> Showtime
  Showtime --> Movie
  Showtime --> Reservation
options_en: BookingSystem (orchestrator managing indexes and flow).
Movie (searchable entity linking showtimes together).
Theater (container that owns a list of showtimes).
Showtime (owns seat state and concurrency control).
Reservation (booking record that references Showtime back).
Seat (a full entity class with lock and bookedBy).
Screen (a standalone entity class owning a seat layout).

scenario: Showtime 需要判断哪些座位已被订，并支持取消后释放座位。
scenario_en: Showtime must know which seats are booked and free them after cancellation.
q: 本文默认选择的单一事实来源是什么？
q_en: What is the default single source of truth in this design?
options: 每个 Seat 对象的 booked flag
BookingSystem 的全局 bookedSeats map
Showtime.reservations 列表
Theater 的 occupiedRows 数组
why: Reservation 本身包含 seatIds，因此所有 reservation 的集合就能推导已订座位。减少第二份 bookedSeats 状态能降低同步错误。
why_en: The reservations list is the source of truth because booked seats are exactly the seats inside active reservations.
whenOtherWins: 如果 availability 检查成为瓶颈，可以维护 bookedSeats Set，但每次 book/cancel 必须和 reservations 同步。
options_en: A booked flag on every Seat object.
A global bookedSeats map on BookingSystem.
The Showtime.reservations list.
An occupiedRows array on Theater.
tradeoff: 单一事实来源（reservations）vs 额外维护的第二份状态

termDefinitions.term: source of truth / 事实来源
termDefinitions.meaning: 系统里被认定为权威、其余状态都从它派生的那份数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The source of truth is the authoritative data that every other derived state must agree with.

q: 补全核心关系：
q_en: Fill in the core object relationships.
text: BookingSystem 持有 {{List<Theater>}}；Theater 持有 {{List<Showtime>}}；Showtime 引用 {{Movie}} 并保存 {{List<Reservation>}}；Reservation 反向引用 {{Showtime}}。
why: 反向引用让取消时能从 reservation 找回所属场次，不必全系统扫描。关系清晰比把所有数据塞进 orchestrator 更易维护。
why_en: Reservation keeps a Showtime back-reference so cancellation can route directly to the state owner.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  M["Movie"] --> S["Showtime"]
  T["Theater"] --> S
  S --> R["Reservation"]
  R --> Seats["seat ids"]
  S --> State["reserved seat set"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 子对象反过来持有指向父对象的引用，用于快速回溯归属关系。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A back-reference lets a child object point back to its owner so code can route directly to it.

scenario: 用户只提供 confirmationId 要取消预订，系统需要释放该预订的座位。
scenario_en: A user provides only a confirmationId to cancel, and the system must release that reservation's seats.
q: Reservation 为什么要保存 showtime 反向引用？
q_en: Why should Reservation keep a Showtime back-reference?
options: 让 Reservation 自己修改所有影院数据
为了搜索电影标题
为了替代 confirmationId
取消时能直接路由到拥有座位状态的 Showtime
why: 取消需要修改 Showtime 的 reservations 列表。反向引用避免从所有 theater/showtime/reservation 中做 O(n) 查找。
why_en: The Showtime back-reference lets cancellation reach the object that owns the seat state.
whenOtherWins: 如果使用数据库或全局 reservationId 索引，也仍可通过外键或索引找到 showtime；核心是取消要路由到状态拥有者。
options_en: It lets Reservation modify all theater data itself.
It exists to search movie titles.
It exists to replace confirmationId.
It lets cancellation route directly to the Showtime that owns the seat state.
tradeoff: back-reference 直接路由 vs 全局扫描查找归属 Showtime

termDefinitions.meaning: 子对象反过来持有指向父对象的引用，用于快速回溯归属关系。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A back-reference lets a child object point back to its owner so code can route directly to it.

scenario: 用户搜索“Inception”，需要返回可预订的影院和时间，而不只是电影对象。
scenario_en: A user searches for "Inception" and needs bookable theaters and times, not just the movie object.
q: searchMovies(title) 应返回什么更有用？
q_en: What should searchMovies(title) return to be useful?
options: 匹配电影的未来 Showtime 列表
只返回 Movie.title 字符串
所有 Theater 对象不筛选
一个布尔值
why: 用户下一步是选场次和座位，因此返回可行动 showtime 更直接。只返回电影名会导致客户端再做一轮查询。
why_en: Search should return actionable future showtimes rather than just movie titles.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品只是电影目录浏览而非订票入口，返回 Movie 列表会更合适。
options_en: The matching movie's future showtimes.
Just the Movie.title string.
Every Theater object, unfiltered.
A single boolean.
tradeoff: 返回可直接预订的 showtime 列表 vs 只返回电影名逼前端二次查询

q: 为什么 BookingSystem 构造时会建立 showtimesById 和 reservationsById？
q_en: Why does BookingSystem build showtimesById and reservationsById in its constructor?
options: 让所有 Movie 变成可变对象
避免订票和取消时反复扫描所有影院和场次
替代 Showtime 的锁
强制所有场次按时间排序
why: showtimeId 和 confirmationId 是外部 API 输入，索引能直接路由请求。它们是读路径优化，也表达 lookup 意图。
why_en: Lookup indexes route booking and cancellation requests directly instead of scanning the whole object graph.
options_en: It turns every Movie into a mutable object.
It avoids repeatedly scanning every theater and showtime on booking and cancellation.
It replaces Showtime's lock.
It forces every showtime to sort by time.
tradeoff: 构造期建索引换 O(1) 路由 vs 每次操作都要 O(t×s) 扫描

termDefinitions.meaning: 复杂度记号，t 是 theater 数、s 是每个 theater 的 showtime 数，代表嵌套扫描的规模。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(t×s) is complexity notation meaning cost scales with theaters times showtimes per theater, i.e. a nested scan.

q: BookingSystem 构造阶段可建立哪些索引？（多选）
q_en: Which indexes can BookingSystem build during construction? (select all that apply)
options: moviesById
showtimesByMovieId
showtimesById
reservationsById 初始为空
why: 前三个从已有 theater/showtime 数据构建，reservationsById 随成功 booking 增长。索引越多，动态更新时越要小心同步。
why_en: The constructor can build movie and showtime indexes, while the reservation index starts empty and grows on bookings.
options_en: moviesById
showtimesByMovieId
showtimesById
reservationsById, which starts empty

termDefinitions.meaning: 为加速查找而维护的辅助映射结构，通常用 key 直接定位数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An index is an auxiliary lookup structure maintained purely to speed up finding data by key.

scenario: 用户打开某个影院页面，想知道今天有哪些电影和时间。
scenario_en: A user opens a theater page and wants to see today's movies and showtimes.
q: getShowtimesAtTheater 应返回什么？
q_en: What should getShowtimesAtTheater return?
options: 每部电影单独发一次查询换时间表
包含所有已过期 showtime 一并返回
该影院未来 showtime 列表
只返回影院名称，不含任何场次
why: 一次返回所有未来场次避免先取电影再逐个取时间的 N+1 形状。UI 可以用 showtime.movie 自行分组。
why_en: Returning future showtimes gives the client everything needed to group by movie without N+1 queries.
whenOtherWins: 如果后端直接负责页面聚合，也可以返回按电影分组的 DTO，但领域模型仍可保持 showtime 列表。
options_en: One separate query per movie to fetch its schedule.
All showtimes including already-expired ones.
The theater's future showtimes as one list.
Just the theater name, no showtimes at all.
tradeoff: 一次返回全部 showtime 避免 N+1 vs 逐电影分别查询

termDefinitions.meaning: 先查一次列表，再对列表里每一项各发一次查询，导致请求数随列表长度线性增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An N+1 query pattern issues one query for a list plus one more query per item, so request count grows with the list size.

scenario: BookingSystem.book 收到 showtimeId 和 seatIds，需要创建预订并委托状态拥有者。
scenario_en: BookingSystem.book receives showtimeId and seatIds, then creates a reservation and delegates to the state owner.
q: 这段伪代码体现了哪种职责分配？
q_en: What responsibility split does this pseudocode show?
codeSample:
book(showtimeId, seatIds)
    showtime = showtimesById[showtimeId]
    reservation = Reservation(generateId(), showtime, seatIds)
    showtime.book(reservation)
    reservationsById[reservation.id] = reservation
    return reservation
options: BookingSystem 跳过 Showtime 直接改座位状态
Reservation 自己调用取消并释放座位
Theater 统一持有所有 showtime 的锁
BookingSystem 编排和索引，Showtime 原子校验并保存
why: BookingSystem 只负责路由和创建记录；真正的可用性检查和写入在 Showtime 内完成。失败时 reservation 不会注册到全局索引。
why_en: BookingSystem orchestrates while Showtime performs atomic validation and storage.
whenOtherWins: 如果使用持久化数据库，showtime.book 的原子性可能由事务或唯一约束承载。
options_en: BookingSystem skips Showtime and mutates seat state directly.
Reservation calls its own cancel and frees the seats itself.
Theater holds a single lock for every showtime under it.
BookingSystem orchestrates and indexes; Showtime does the atomic check-and-store.
tradeoff: 编排者路由与索引 vs 状态拥有者做原子校验和写入

termDefinitions.meaning: 负责协调其他对象、驱动主流程但不直接持有核心状态的组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An orchestrator coordinates other objects and drives the main flow without owning the core state itself.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一组操作要么全部生效要么完全不生效，中途不会被其他线程看到中间状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Atomic means a set of operations either all take effect or none do, with no other thread observing a half-done state.

scenario: 用户同时选择 A5、A6、A7，但 A6 已被别人预订。
scenario_en: A user selects A5, A6, and A7, but A6 has already been booked by someone else.
q: 正确行为是什么？
q_en: What is the correct behavior?
options: 整个预订失败，A5 和 A7 也不能被部分占用
先订 A5 和 A7，跳过 A6
为 A6 生成候补票
把 A6 从别人的 reservation 移过来
why: 多座位预订必须 all-or-nothing。先验证所有座位，再做任何状态修改，才能避免部分成功。
why_en: Multi-seat booking must be all-or-nothing, with all seats validated before storing the reservation.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品支持拆单或推荐替代座位，应显式设计新的用户确认流程，而不是静默部分成功。
options_en: The whole booking fails; A5 and A7 stay unclaimed too.
Book A5 and A7 first and just skip A6.
Generate a waitlist ticket for A6.
Move A6 out of the other user's reservation.
tradeoff: all-or-nothing 原子校验 vs 允许部分成功的静默拆单

termDefinitions.meaning: 多项操作要么全部成功要么全部不生效，不留下部分完成的状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: All-or-nothing means a multi-step operation either fully succeeds or leaves no partial state behind.

q: 按正确顺序排列双订座位的竞态链路：
q_en: Put the double-booking race condition in the correct order.
steps: 线程 A 和线程 B 都看到 A5 可用。
两个线程都把包含 A5 的 reservation 加入列表。
check availability 和 add reservation 没有在同一个临界区。
结果两个用户拿到同一座位。
why: 这是典型 check-then-act 竞态。修复方式是把“检查所有座位”和“保存 reservation”放进同一个 Showtime 锁内。
why_en: The double-booking bug is a check-then-act race between availability checking and reservation storage.
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U1
  participant S as Showtime
  participant U2
  U1->>S: check A5 free
  U2->>S: check A5 free
  U1->>S: reserve A5
  U2->>S: reserve A5

termDefinitions.meaning: 先检查条件再执行动作，中间没有加锁保护，可能被其他线程插入导致竞态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Check-then-act means checking a condition and then acting on it without holding a lock across both steps, letting another thread interleave and cause a race.

termDefinitions.meaning: 必须互斥执行的代码区间，一次只能有一个线程进入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A critical section is a code region that only one thread may execute at a time.

scenario: 两个用户可能同时预订同一场电影的同一座位。
scenario_en: Two users may book the same seat for the same movie showtime at the same time.
q: 这段 Showtime.book 伪代码的关键保证是什么？
q_en: What guarantee does this Showtime.book pseudocode provide?
codeSample:
book(reservation)
    synchronized(this)
        for seatId in reservation.seatIds
            if !isValidSeatId(seatId) throw InvalidSeat
        for seatId in reservation.seatIds
            if !isAvailable(seatId) throw Unavailable
        reservations.add(reservation)
options: 所有场次共用同一把全局锁串行化
可用性检查和保存 reservation 是原子的
座位 ID 永远不需要做合法性验证
取消操作不需要拿任何锁
why: 锁的粒度是单个 Showtime，避免同一场次内双订。不同 showtime 可以并行预订，不受这个锁影响。
why_en: The synchronized block makes the check-and-store sequence atomic for one showtime.
whenOtherWins: 如果单场超高并发成为瓶颈，可以升级为 per-seat locking，但需要排序加锁避免死锁。
options_en: Every showtime shares one single global lock.
The availability check and reservation storage are atomic together.
Seat IDs never need validity checking.
Cancellation never needs to hold a lock.
tradeoff: check-and-store 在同一临界区 vs 检查和写入分离产生竞态窗口

termDefinitions.meaning: 一段代码用锁包裹，保证同一时刻只有一个线程执行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A synchronized block wraps code with a lock so only one thread executes it at a time.

q: per-showtime 锁相比 per-seat 锁的主要优点是什么？
q_en: What is the main benefit of per-showtime locking over per-seat locking?
options: 允许同一座位同时被多个用户预订成功
在任何并发场景下吞吐量都必然最高
实现简单、无死锁风险、Seat 保持字符串
座位 ID 的合法性校验可以直接省略
why: per-showtime 锁把同一场次所有预订串行化，牺牲一些并行度换清晰正确性。基础面试范围内临界区短，通常足够。
why_en: Per-showtime locking is simple and avoids multi-lock deadlock while keeping Seat as a string.
options_en: Lets the same seat be booked by multiple users at once.
Guarantees the highest throughput in any concurrency scenario.
Simple to implement, no multi-lock deadlock risk, Seat stays a string.
Seat ID validity checks can be skipped entirely.
tradeoff: 单锁实现简单 vs 多锁高吞吐但要处理死锁

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个线程互相等待对方持有的锁，谁都无法继续执行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A deadlock happens when threads each wait for a lock the other is holding, so none can proceed.

scenario: 热门首映场同一 showtime 每秒上百人抢不同座位，per-showtime 锁成为瓶颈。
scenario_en: For a hot premiere, hundreds of users per second book different seats in the same showtime, and the per-showtime lock bottlenecks.
q: 更高吞吐的替代设计是什么？
q_en: What alternative design gives higher throughput?
options: 给所有入场请求加上随机延迟来分散压力
直接删除 reservation 列表来减少扫描
把锁的粒度提升到整个 Theater 级别
把 Seat 升级为带锁的类，按 seatId 排序加锁
why: per-seat locking 只阻塞争抢相同座位的预订。多座位预订必须按稳定顺序加锁，否则可能死锁。
why_en: Per-seat locking improves throughput but requires sorted lock acquisition to avoid deadlock.
whenOtherWins: 普通场次或面试基础范围用 per-showtime 锁更稳，除非明确需要优化同场并发。
options_en: Add random delay to every incoming request to spread out load.
Delete the reservations list to cut scan cost.
Raise the lock's granularity all the way up to the whole Theater.
Promote Seat to a class with a lock, acquiring locks in sorted seatId order.
tradeoff: per-seat 锁提高吞吐 vs 排序加锁与双份状态的复杂度代价

termDefinitions.meaning: 给每个座位单独一把锁，只有争抢同一座位的请求才会互相阻塞。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Per-seat locking gives every seat its own lock, so only requests contending for the same seat block each other.

q: 补全 per-seat locking 的死锁规避规则：
q_en: Fill in the deadlock-avoidance rule for per-seat locking.
text: 多座位预订要先对 seatIds 做{{排序}}，所有线程都按同一顺序获取锁，避免 A 锁 A5 等 A6、B 锁 A6 等 A5 的{{循环等待}}。
why: 一旦一次操作需要拿多把锁，稳定加锁顺序就是最基本的死锁预防。这个复杂度是 per-seat 方案的主要代价。
why_en: Sorted lock acquisition prevents circular waits when a booking needs multiple seat locks.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["selected seats"] --> B["sort seat ids"]
  B --> C["lock A5"]
  C --> D["lock A6"]
  D --> E["check and reserve"]
  E --> F["release reverse order"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个线程互相持有对方需要的锁，形成等待环，谁都无法前进。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A circular wait is when each thread holds a lock another thread needs, forming a cycle where nobody can proceed.

q: Showtime 的核心方法通常包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which core methods does Showtime usually expose? (select all that apply)
options: isAvailable(seatId)
getAvailableSeats()
book(reservation)
cancel(reservation)
why: 这四个方法都围绕单场次座位状态展开。查询和修改都集中在 Showtime，有助于维持不变量。
why_en: Showtime centers the seat-state operations: availability, listing, booking, and cancellation.
options_en: isAvailable(seatId) — checks one seat.
getAvailableSeats() — lists every open seat.
book(reservation) — validates and stores a booking.
cancel(reservation) — removes a booking and frees seats.

scenario: 前端座位图需要知道哪些座位可选，基础布局固定。
scenario_en: The client seat map needs to know which seats are selectable, and the base layout is fixed.
q: getAvailableSeats 的合理做法是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable getAvailableSeats implementation?
options: 从 reservations 收集 booked set 再过滤布局
返回全部座位，完全不检查任何 reservation
只返回第一排 A 排的座位列表
调用支付系统的状态来判断座位是否可用
why: reservations 是事实来源，booked set 是局部派生结构。固定布局扫描成本是常数级，足够清晰。
why_en: Available seats can be derived by subtracting booked seats from the fixed layout.
whenOtherWins: 如果布局可变，应让 Screen 或 SeatLayout 提供完整座位集合，而不是硬编码 A-Z/0-20。
options_en: Collect a booked set from reservations, then filter the fixed 546-seat layout.
Return every seat without checking any reservation at all.
Return only the seats in row A.
Ask the payment system's state to decide seat availability.
tradeoff: 从 reservations 派生可用座位 vs 维护第二份 bookedSeats 状态

termDefinitions.meaning: 不单独存储，而是每次从权威数据现算出来的状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Derived state is not stored on its own; it is computed on demand from the authoritative data.

scenario: 用户提交 seatId='AA99' 或 'Z21'。
scenario_en: The user submits seatId='AA99' or 'Z21'.
q: Showtime.book 应如何处理？
q_en: How should Showtime.book handle it?
options: 先保存 reservation，出问题再异步清理
在锁内校验 seatId 属于 A-Z/0-20
把不合法的座位当成已售罄处理
把校验逻辑交给 Movie 类来做
why: 座位合法性和可用性都要在同一原子 booking 流程里检查。无效输入不能创建 reservation。
why_en: Seat IDs should be validated inside the atomic booking flow before any reservation is stored.
whenOtherWins: 如果座位布局由外部配置提供，校验应委托给 SeatLayout，但仍要在写入前完成。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["book(seats)"] --> L["showtime lock"]
  L --> B{"all seats free?"}
  B -- no --> R["reject"]
  B -- yes --> C["mark seats reserved"]
  C --> D["create reservation"]
options_en: Store the reservation first and clean up asynchronously later.
Validate every seatId is within A-Z / 0-20 inside the lock.
Treat an invalid seat as already sold out.
Delegate seat validation to the Movie class.
tradeoff: 写入前原子校验合法性 vs 先写后清理留下脏状态窗口
codeSample:
isValidSeatId(seatId)
    row = seatId[0]
    num = parseInt(seatId.substring(1))
    return row >= 'A' && row <= 'Z'
        && num >= 0 && num <= 20

scenario: 用户取消 confirmationId，系统已经通过 reservationsById 找到 reservation。
scenario_en: A user cancels by confirmationId, and the system has found the reservation through reservationsById.
q: 这段取消流程为什么能释放座位？
q_en: Why does this cancellation flow free the seats?
codeSample:
cancelReservation(id)
    reservation = reservationsById[id]
    showtime = reservation.getShowtime()
    showtime.cancel(reservation)
    reservationsById.remove(id)

Showtime.cancel(reservation)
    synchronized(this)
        reservations.remove(reservation)
options: 必须对每个座位调用 Seat.markFree 才能真正释放
取消操作只删除全局索引，座位状态完全不受影响
座位可用性由 reservations 推导，删除即释放
取消这件事应该交给 Movie 类来完成
why: 因为没有第二份 bookedSeats 状态，取消只需从 Showtime 的 reservations 中删除。全局索引也要删除，防止重复取消。
why_en: Removing the reservation from Showtime frees its seats because availability is derived from the reservation list.
whenOtherWins: 如果维护 bookedSeats Set，取消必须同时从 reservations 和 bookedSeats 中删除。
options_en: Every seat needs its own Seat.markFree call to actually free it.
Cancellation only deletes the global index and leaves seat state untouched.
Availability is derived from reservations, so removing one frees its seats.
Cancellation should be handled by the Movie class.
tradeoff: 删除即释放的派生状态 vs 需要额外一步同步第二份座位状态

termDefinitions.term: source of truth / 事实来源
termDefinitions.meaning: 系统里被认定为权威、其余状态都从它派生的那份数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The source of truth is the authoritative data that every other derived state must agree with.

q: Movie 为什么要有 id 而不只存 title？
q_en: Why does Movie need an id instead of only a title?
options: title 不能用于搜索
id 用来表示座位号
Movie 不该被引用
重映或翻拍可能同名，id 才是稳定身份
why: 用户按标题搜索，但系统内部需要稳定唯一身份连接 showtime。两个 Dune 或同名电影不应被混为一谈。
why_en: Movie needs an ID because titles are searchable but not guaranteed unique.
options_en: Title strings cannot be used for search matching at all.
The ID represents a specific seat number.
Movie objects should never be referenced by anything.
A remake or re-release can share a title, so the ID is the stable identity.
tradeoff: id 作稳定内部身份 vs title 作用户可搜索但不唯一的标签

scenario: Reservation 构造时收到 seatIds 列表，调用方之后可能修改原列表。
scenario_en: Reservation receives a seatIds list in the constructor, and the caller may later mutate that list.
q: Reservation 应该怎么保护自身状态？
q_en: How should Reservation protect its own state?
options: 构造和 getSeatIds 做 defensive copy
直接保存外部传入的列表引用，不做任何拷贝
让调用方自己保证不会修改这份列表
把 seatIds 存成用逗号拼接的字符串
why: Reservation 是预订记录，创建后不应被外部列表修改。防御性拷贝能保护不可变语义。
why_en: Defensive copies keep a reservation's seat list immutable from external mutation.
whenOtherWins: 在不可变集合默认的语言中，可以直接存不可变列表。
options_en: Defensive-copy in the constructor and in getSeatIds.
Store a direct reference to the caller's list with no copying at all.
Trust the caller to promise it won't mutate the list.
Store seatIds as a comma-joined string.
tradeoff: 构造时防御性拷贝 vs 直接持有外部引用带来的隐式修改风险

termDefinitions.meaning: 构造或返回集合时复制一份，避免外部引用修改内部状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A defensive copy duplicates a collection on the way in or out so external code can't mutate internal state.

q: BookingSystem.book 应处理哪些失败情况？（多选）
q_en: Which failure cases should BookingSystem.book handle? (select all that apply)
options: showtimeId 为空或不存在
seatIds 为空
任一 seatId 无效
任一座位已不可用
why: 路由输入、座位合法性和可用性都可能失败。任何失败都不应留下 reservation 或索引记录。
why_en: Booking failures must leave no reservation behind, whether the issue is routing, input, invalid seats, or unavailable seats.
options_en: showtimeId is null or does not exist.
seatIds is empty.
Any seatId is invalid.
Any seat is already unavailable.

scenario: 用户搜索电影时，系统里还保留了昨天的 showtime 对象。
scenario_en: A user searches for a movie while yesterday's showtime objects still exist in memory.
q: searchMovies 和 getShowtimesAtTheater 应如何处理？
q_en: How should searchMovies and getShowtimesAtTheater handle them?
options: 返回所有过去和未来场次
只返回 future showtimes
删除 Movie 对象
把过去场次当作免费票
why: 过去场次不可预订，返回它们会给用户不可操作结果。内存中是否保留旧场次是另一个清理问题。
why_en: Search and browsing should return future showtimes because past showtimes are not bookable.
whenOtherWins: 如果是历史订单或排片管理后台，过去场次才可能需要返回。
options_en: Return every past and future showtime.
Return only future showtimes.
Delete the Movie object.
Treat past showtimes as free tickets.
tradeoff: 只暴露可操作的未来场次 vs 把不可预订的历史场次也返回给用户

termDefinitions.meaning: 开场时间晚于当前时间、仍可预订的放映场次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A future showtime is a screening whose start time is still ahead of now and therefore still bookable.

q: 成功预订 A5/A6 的正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct order for successfully booking A5 and A6?
steps: Showtime 在锁内校验 A5/A6 合法且可用。
BookingSystem 通过 showtimesById 找到对应 Showtime。
Showtime 把 reservation 加入自己的 reservations。
BookingSystem 把 confirmationId -> reservation 写入 reservationsById。
why: 状态写入顺序确保 Showtime 先接受预订，全局取消索引后注册。若 Showtime 抛错，索引不会污染。
why_en: The booking flow routes first, atomically stores in Showtime, then registers the confirmation index.
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant B as BookingSystem
  participant S as Showtime
  participant R as Reservation
  U->>B: book A5,A6
  B->>S: book seats
  S->>S: check and reserve
  S->>R: create reservation
  S-->>B: reservation id

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 id 直接定位对象的映射表，避免逐个遍历查找。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A routing index maps an ID straight to its object, avoiding a linear search.

scenario: 后续要求运行时添加新的 showtime，而不是只在构造时加载。
scenario_en: A later requirement allows adding new showtimes at runtime instead of only loading them in the constructor.
q: addShowtime 必须同步更新哪些结构？
q_en: Which structures must addShowtime update in sync?
options: 只把 Theater 的名字字段改一下就完事
只需要把新记录写进 reservationsById 索引里
Theater.showtimes 和三张 By 索引都要更新
什么索引都不需要碰，下次查询会自动全部重建
why: 构造时建立过的所有派生索引，在动态写入时都要同步维护。否则搜索或订票会漏掉新场次。
why_en: Dynamic additions must update every index that the constructor would have populated.
whenOtherWins: 如果索引改为查询时实时扫描，则动态更新更简单但读路径更慢。
options_en: Just tweak the Theater's name field and call it done.
Only write the new record into reservationsById.
Theater.showtimes plus all three By-indexes need updating.
Touch no index at all; the next query rebuilds everything.
tradeoff: 同步更新全部派生索引 vs 只更新部分导致搜索/订票漏掉新场次

termDefinitions.term: denormalized index / 反规范化索引
termDefinitions.meaning: 为加速查询而额外维护的冗余结构，写入时必须和主数据保持同步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A denormalized index is a redundant lookup structure kept only for speed, and every write must keep it in sync with the source data.

scenario: 运营要删除某个 showtime，但已有 active reservations。
scenario_en: Operations wants to delete a showtime that already has active reservations.
q: 最安全的基础处理是什么？
q_en: What is the safest base-design behavior?
options: 直接删除并保留无主 reservation
只从 movie index 删除
把票自动挪到任意其他场次
拒绝删除，先取消并通知所有 reservation
why: 删除有票场次会让 confirmationId 和 reservation 指向悬空对象。基础设计应拒绝，等取消和通知完成后再删。
why_en: Removing a showtime with active reservations should be rejected until reservations are handled.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务支持场次取消流程，可发事件给通知监听器并批量退款/取消后再清理索引。
options_en: Delete it immediately and leave the orphaned reservations behind.
Only remove it from the movie index.
Automatically move the tickets to some other showtime.
Reject the deletion; cancel and notify every reservation first.
tradeoff: 拒绝删除保护引用完整性 vs 直接删除留下悬空 reservation

termDefinitions.meaning: 指向已经被删除对象的引用，访问它会得到无效或空结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dangling reference points at an object that no longer exists, so following it yields nothing valid.

scenario: 真实购票中用户选座后要花 30-60 秒支付，不能让别人抢走同一座位。
scenario_en: In real ticket checkout, a user may spend 30-60 seconds entering payment details after choosing seats, and no one else should take those seats.
q: 应加入哪种机制？
q_en: What mechanism should be added?
options: 临时 SeatHold，过期释放，支付成功转 Reservation
支付前就永久创建 Reservation，失败也不释放
等支付成功那一刻才去检查座位是否还空
让用户截图证明自己先选中了这个座位
why: hold 把座位状态从二元变成 available/held/booked。它改善结账体验，但需要超时清理和确认流程。
why_en: Temporary holds protect selected seats during checkout and then either convert to reservations or expire.
whenOtherWins: 如果支付被明确排除且 booking 是瞬时操作，基础 book() 不需要 hold。
options_en: A temporary SeatHold that expires or confirms into a Reservation on payment.
Create a permanent Reservation upfront, never releasing it even if payment fails.
Check seat availability only at the moment payment succeeds.
Have the user screenshot proof they selected first.
tradeoff: 三态 hold 生命周期 vs 二元 available/booked 的结账体验风险

termDefinitions.meaning: 支付窗口内临时锁定座位的凭证，超时未确认会自动释放。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A SeatHold is a temporary claim on a seat during checkout that auto-releases if it is never confirmed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户从选座到完成支付的整个流程窗口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Checkout is the window from selecting seats to completing payment.

q: 加入 temporary holds 后，isAvailable 应检查哪些状态？（多选）
q_en: After adding temporary holds, what states should isAvailable check? (select all that apply)
options: 是否被现有 Reservation 预订
是否被未过期 SeatHold 持有
是否被已过期 hold 持有
是否电影标题匹配
why: 已过期 hold 应清理或视为无效，不应继续占座。电影标题不参与单个座位的可用性判断。
why_en: Availability with holds must exclude booked seats and seats held by non-expired holds.
options_en: Whether an existing Reservation already booked it.
Whether a non-expired SeatHold is holding it.
Whether an expired hold is holding it.
Whether the movie title matches.

termDefinitions.meaning: 超过 expiresAt 时间仍未被确认或清理的临时占位记录。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An expired hold is a temporary seat claim whose timeout has passed without being confirmed or cleaned up.

q: 临时 hold 转正式预订的正确流程是什么？
q_en: What is the correct flow from temporary hold to confirmed reservation?
steps: holdSeats 在同一 Showtime 锁内确认座位可用并记录 expiresAt。
用户完成支付后提交 holdId。
confirmHold 检查 hold 存在且未过期。
删除 hold 并把 reservation 加入 reservations。
后台任务清理无人确认的过期 hold。
why: hold 和 booking 使用同一把 showtime 锁，可以防止 hold 与 reservation 互相穿插。过期清理防止座位永久锁住。
why_en: Seat holds share the showtime lock, confirm into reservations, and need cleanup for abandoned holds.
diagram:
stateDiagram
  [*] --> Available
  Available --> Held
  Held --> Booked: pay
  Held --> Available: timeout
  Booked --> Available: cancel

termDefinitions.meaning: 支付成功后把 hold 转换成正式 reservation 的方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: confirmHold is the method that converts a valid hold into a confirmed reservation after payment succeeds.

q: 文章为什么说 seat hold 引入的是小型状态生命周期？
q_en: Why does a seat hold introduce a small state lifecycle?
options: Movie 会经历从上映中变成已下映的状态转换
座位有 available/held/booked/released 四态转换规则
Theater 会在系统运行期间变成 Reservation 对象
Search 查询过程会直接变成支付流程的一部分
why: 一旦状态转换带规则，就要小心非法转换。三态时简单字段足够，状态继续增多时可以考虑 State pattern。
why_en: Seat holds introduce a lifecycle with available, held, booked, and released transitions.
options_en: A Movie transitions from currently showing to no longer showing.
A seat has explicit available/held/booked/released state transitions.
A Theater turns into a Reservation object at runtime.
A Search query directly becomes part of the payment flow.
tradeoff: 小型状态生命周期用简单字段 vs 状态继续增多时改用 State pattern

termDefinitions.meaning: 把每个状态建成独立对象、显式定义合法转换的设计模式，用于状态数增多变复杂时。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The State pattern models each state as its own object with explicit legal transitions, useful once a lifecycle grows more states.

scenario: 为 SeatHold 选择过期时间，用户需要输入支付信息。
scenario_en: You need to choose the expiration time for a SeatHold while users enter payment details.
q: 合理的设计判断是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable design judgment?
options: 所有场次固定写死 1 秒超时
hold 一旦创建就永不过期
5-10 分钟常见，业务可调，过短伤用户过长占座
必须等到电影正式开场才过期
why: timeout 是业务权衡，不是固定算法常量。可用 Strategy 封装不同场景的超时策略，但基础设计可先用配置值。
why_en: Hold timeout is a business tradeoff between checkout usability and seat availability.
whenOtherWins: 高需求首映场可能使用更短 hold，低峰场次可以更宽松。
options_en: Hard-code a fixed 1-second timeout for every showtime.
Once created, a hold should never expire.
5-10 minutes is typical and tunable, too short hurts users and too long locks seats.
A hold must wait until the movie actually starts to expire.
tradeoff: 结账可用时间 vs 座位被无谓锁住的时长

termDefinitions.meaning: 一段状态被允许维持的最长时间，超过就自动失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A timeout is the maximum duration a state is allowed to persist before it automatically expires.

q: 为什么不把 Reservation.cancel() 做成直接修改 Showtime？
q_en: Why shouldn't Reservation.cancel() directly modify Showtime?
options: Reservation 对象其实根本没有 confirmationId 字段
Showtime 设计上不应该知道任何 seatIds 信息
取消操作从设计上就不需要释放任何座位
Reservation 是记录，不该有权改 Showtime 的 list
why: 修改座位状态的权力留在 Showtime，能把并发控制集中在一个对象。Reservation 只携带取消所需数据。
why_en: Reservation is a record, while Showtime owns the mutable booking state and synchronization.
options_en: Reservation objects don't actually have a confirmationId field.
Showtime shouldn't know about any seatIds by design.
Cancellation doesn't need to free any seats by design.
Reservation is a record and shouldn't have write access to Showtime's list.
tradeoff: 状态修改权集中在 Showtime vs 分散到 Reservation 造成双写风险

termDefinitions.term: mutable state owner / 可变状态拥有者
termDefinitions.meaning: 唯一被允许修改某份状态的对象，其余对象只能通过它间接操作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The mutable-state owner is the one object allowed to change a piece of state directly; everyone else must go through it.

q: 补全索引维护代价：
q_en: Fill in the cost of maintaining lookup indexes.
text: showtimesById、moviesById、showtimesByMovieId 让读路径更快，但动态 add/remove 时必须保持这些{{派生索引}}和 theater.showtimes 的{{同步}}。
why: 这是所有 denormalized data 的共同代价。读性能提升换来写路径更容易出错。
why_en: Indexes speed reads but make writes responsible for keeping denormalized structures in sync.

termDefinitions.term: denormalized data / 反规范化数据
termDefinitions.meaning: 为读性能而额外保存的冗余数据副本，需要在写路径里手动保持同步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Denormalized data is a redundant copy kept purely for read speed, and the write path must manually keep it in sync.

scenario: 用户取消 reservation 的同时，另一个用户试图预订同一批座位。
scenario_en: One user cancels a reservation while another user tries to book the same seats.
q: 为什么 Showtime.cancel 也应该同步？
q_en: Why should Showtime.cancel also be synchronized?
options: 避免预订扫描到并发修改中的列表
因为每次取消都要重新搜索一遍电影
因为 synchronized 关键字会自动帮你退款
因为 Seat 是字符串，天生不支持删除操作
why: book 和 cancel 都读写同一 reservations 列表，必须使用同一并发边界。否则可能出现迭代和修改交错。
why_en: Cancel must synchronize with booking because both mutate the same reservations list.
options_en: It stops a booking from scanning the list mid-modification.
Because every cancellation has to re-search for the movie.
Because the synchronized keyword automatically issues a refund.
Because Seat is a string and strings can't be deleted.
tradeoff: book 和 cancel 共用同一把锁 vs 各自加锁导致读到中间状态

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个线程的操作步骤在时间上穿插执行，可能看到中间不一致的状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Interleaving is when two threads' steps get mixed together in time, potentially exposing an inconsistent in-between state.

scenario: 有人提议新增 Payment、SeatPrice、SeatType、RescheduleService。
scenario_en: Someone proposes adding Payment, SeatPrice, SeatType, and RescheduleService to the base model.
q: 基础需求下应该怎么回应？
q_en: How should you respond under the base requirements?
options: 把它们全部实现出来，显得设计很完整
指出它们被排除，先保持核心模型
不管职责边界，把它们都塞进 BookingSystem
干脆让 Movie 类顺便负责支付逻辑
why: LLD 面试要展示范围控制。超出需求的功能会分散注意力并增加不必要状态。
why_en: Scope control keeps the design focused on booking and cancellation rather than excluded features.
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官明确加入支付、座位等级或改签，再扩展相应实体和状态机。
options_en: Implement all of them so the design looks complete.
Point out they're excluded and keep the core model as-is.
Ignore responsibility boundaries and cram them into BookingSystem.
Just make the Movie class handle payment on the side.
tradeoff: 守住需求边界 vs 抢答范围外功能分散设计精力

termDefinitions.meaning: 在没有被要求的情况下不断加功能，导致核心设计被稀释。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scope creep is adding unrequested features until the core design gets diluted.

codeSample:
makeMove(player, column)
    if state != IN_PROGRESS return false  # reject if game already ended
    if player != currentPlayer return false  # reject out-of-turn
    row = board.placeDisc(column, player.color)
    if row == -1 return false  # column full or invalid
    if board.checkWin(row, column, player.color): state = WON; winner = player
    elif board.isFull(): state = DRAW
    else: currentPlayer = other(player)
    return true

codeSample:
placeDisc(column, color)
    if column < 0 || column >= cols return -1  # out of bounds
    if !canPlace(column) return -1  # column already full

    return -1

q: 这段 helper 的作用是什么？
q_en: What does this helper check?
codeSample:
hasRequestsAtOrBeyond(floor, dir)
    for request in requests
        if dir == UP && request.floor >= floor
            if request.type == PICKUP_UP || request.type == DESTINATION
                return true
        if dir == DOWN && request.floor <= floor
            if request.type == PICKUP_DOWN || request.type == DESTINATION
                return true
    return false

steps: 如果当前楼层应停靠，移除匹配请求，必要时设 IDLE，并且本 tick 不移动。

scenario: 电梯在某楼层检查是否停靠。

q: 这段逻辑为什么只移除匹配方向的 pickup？
q_en: Why does this logic remove only matching-direction pickups?
codeSample:
pickupType = direction == UP ? PICKUP_UP : PICKUP_DOWN
pickupRequest = Request(currentFloor, pickupType)
destinationRequest = Request(currentFloor, DESTINATION)
if requests.contains(pickupRequest) || requests.contains(destinationRequest)
    requests.remove(pickupRequest)
    requests.remove(destinationRequest)
    return
options: 所有类型的 pickup 都该立刻移除
同向 pickup 才停，destination 任意方向都停
destination 请求不该被服务
停靠这一 tick 还应再移动一层
why: 乘客按 DOWN 不应上行时被接走。destination 是轿厢内请求，到达该楼层就应停。
why_en: An elevator stops for pickups matching its direction and for destinations regardless of direction.
whenOtherWins: 如果简化规则允许任何 hall call 都停靠，这段可以删除方向区分，但乘客体验会变差。
options_en: Every pickup type should be removed immediately.
Only same-direction pickups cause a stop; a destination stops regardless of direction.
Destination requests should never be served.
The elevator should still move one floor on the same stopping tick.
tradeoff: 方向匹配停靠 vs 目的地任意方向停靠

options: next 会删除请求
iterator 永远为空
HashSet 顺序不稳定，会导致仿真不可复现
IDLE 不能变成 UP

options_en: Calling next() would delete the request.
The iterator would always be empty.
HashSet iteration order is not stable, which would make the simulation non-reproducible.
IDLE cannot transition into UP.

why: travel 和 stop 的条件不同。电梯要朝任何前方请求移动，但只在匹配方向或 destination 停靠。

It does not count, so the elevator should just stay idle.

options: 无前方请求时 hasRequestsAhead 自然触发反向

The elevator can physically travel past floor 9.
Every request is assumed to happen at floor 0.
Boundary checks are handled automatically by RequestType.

why: 请求集合是电梯状态的事实来源，removeRequest 是 addRequest 的逆操作。step 算法无需大改。

q: 最简单正确的并发方案是什么？
q_en: What is the simplest correct concurrency approach?
options: 只给 getCurrentFloor 这个读方法加锁
允许两个线程同时修改同一个 HashSet
同一把锁包住 requestElevator 和 step

why: select+add 和 step 遍历/删除都接触共享状态，必须互斥。简单全局锁正确但并发度低。

whenOtherWins: 更高并发可用线程安全队列收集请求，在每个 tick 开始时由 step drain 到 active set。

flowchart LR
  A["requestElevator"] --> L["controller lock"]
  B["step"] --> L
  L --> C["assign or mutate requests"]
  C --> D["consistent elevator state"]

Let two threads mutate the same HashSet concurrently.
Wrap requestElevator and step with the same lock.
Just make Request an immutable class and stop there.
tradeoff: 全局锁简单正确 vs 并发度低

termDefinitions.meaning: 互斥锁，保证同一时刻只有一个线程能进入被保护的代码段。

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于哈希表实现的集合，元素遍历顺序不保证稳定。

q: 这段 resolvePath 伪代码体现了什么？
codeSample:
resolvePath(path)
    if path == null || !path.startsWith('/') throw InvalidPath
    if path == '/' return root
    parts = path.substring(1).split('/')
    current = root
    for part in parts
        if part == '' throw InvalidPath
        if !current.isDirectory() throw NotADirectory
        current = current.getChild(part)
        if current == null throw NotFound
    return current

q: 这段伪代码的关键不变量是什么？
codeSample:
rename(path, newName)
    parent = resolveParent(path)
    oldName = extractName(path)
    if parent.hasChild(newName) throw AlreadyExists
    entry = parent.removeChild(oldName)
    if entry == null throw NotFound
    entry.setName(newName)
    parent.addChild(entry)

    a = resolveParent(srcPath)
    b = resolveParent(destPath)
    first  = a.getPath() < b.getPath() ? a : b
    second = a.getPath() < b.getPath() ? b : a

// 无论谁是 src/dest，都按路径字典序先锁 first
