q: 最终设计中的核心类型有哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which core types belong in the final inventory design?
options: InventoryManager
Warehouse
AlertConfig
AlertListener
options_en: InventoryManager, the multi-warehouse orchestrator.
Warehouse, a single storage location.
AlertConfig, pairing a threshold with a listener.
AlertListener, the notification callback interface.
why: Manager 负责编排多仓库操作，Warehouse 管单仓库存量和告警，AlertConfig/AlertListener 解耦阈值和通知动作。
why_en: The design uses an InventoryManager, per-location Warehouses, AlertConfig value objects, and an AlertListener interface.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统唯一入口，持有全部 Warehouse 并负责跨仓库协调（transfer、availability）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: InventoryManager is the single entry point that owns every Warehouse and coordinates cross-warehouse work like transfer and availability.

termDefinitions.meaning: 代表一个物理仓储地点，持有自己的库存 map 和告警配置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Warehouse represents one physical storage location and owns its own inventory map and alert configs.

q: InventoryManager 为什么保存 Map<string, Warehouse>？
q_en: Why does InventoryManager keep a Map<string, Warehouse>?
options: 为了替代每个 Warehouse 自己的 inventory map
按 warehouseId 做 O(1) 路由到 Warehouse
为了触发所有告警监听器
为了按产品名给仓库排序
options_en: To replace each Warehouse's own inventory map.
To route by warehouseId in O(1) time to the right Warehouse.
To fire every alert listener at once.
To sort warehouses by product name.
why: 外部调用用 warehouseId 指定目标仓库，map 给出 O(1) 查找；list 扫描也能做，但意图和效率都不如 map。
why_en: InventoryManager keeps a warehouse map so it can route by warehouseId in constant time instead of scanning a list.

termDefinitions.meaning: 复杂度记号，表示操作耗时不随数据量增长，例如 map 按 key 查找。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(1) means constant time: the operation's cost does not grow as the data set gets bigger, like a map lookup by key.

scenario: 一个 Warehouse 要保存每个 productId 的当前库存，并支持产品不存在时视为 0。
scenario_en: One Warehouse must track the current quantity for each productId, with missing products treated as zero.
q: Warehouse 记录库存该用什么数据结构？
q_en: What data structure should Warehouse use for stock counts?
options: 单个 totalQuantity 整数
List<InventoryManager>
Map<productId,int> inventory
Map<Warehouse,AlertListener>
options_en: A single totalQuantity integer.
A List<InventoryManager>.
A Map<productId,int> called inventory.
A Map<Warehouse,AlertListener>.
why: 每个产品数量独立变化，需要按 productId 查找和更新；未出现过的产品默认按 0 处理。
why_en: Warehouse needs a productId-to-quantity map because each product's stock changes independently and missing products default to zero.
whenOtherWins: 如果这个仓库真的只卖一种产品，单个整数就够；多产品库存必须用 map。
tradeoff: 按产品建 map vs 单一总量整数

q: Warehouse 需要直接持有哪些字段？（多选）
q_en: Which fields should Warehouse directly own?
options: id
inventory: Map<string,int>
alertConfigs: Map<string,List<AlertConfig>>
其他仓库列表
options_en: id, the warehouse's own identifier.
inventory: Map<string,int> for per-product quantity.
alertConfigs: Map<string,List<AlertConfig>> for alert rules.
A list of every other warehouse.
why: Warehouse 管理一个地点自己的库存和告警配置；跨仓库视角属于 InventoryManager，不属于 Warehouse。
why_en: Warehouse owns its ID, product quantities, and product-specific alert configs, not the whole fleet of warehouses.

scenario: 同一产品可能有 50 件预警和 10 件紧急告警，并通知不同渠道。
scenario_en: The same product may have a warning at 50 units and an urgent alert at 10 units, each notifying a different channel.
q: alertConfigs 为什么设计成 productId -> List<AlertConfig>？
q_en: Why is alertConfigs modeled as productId to List<AlertConfig>?
options: 因为每个产品只能有一个告警
为了替代库存数量本身
为了把仓库 ID 存成 list
支持同一产品配置多个阈值和 listener
options_en: Because each product can only have one alert.
To replace the stock quantity itself.
To store warehouse IDs as a list.
To support multiple thresholds and listeners per product.
why: 多个阈值可对应不同通知渠道；AlertConfig 把 threshold 和 listener 成对保存，避免用并行数组表达。
why_en: alertConfigs maps to a list because one product can have several thresholds, each paired with its own listener.
whenOtherWins: 如果这个产品从不需要区分预警和紧急两级，单一阈值字段就够，不必用 list。
tradeoff: list 支持多阈值 vs 单一阈值字段更简单

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 threshold 和 listener 绑定在一起的轻量值对象，一个产品可以有多个。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AlertConfig is a small value object pairing a threshold with the listener to notify, and one product can have several.

scenario: Warehouse 触发低库存通知时，只调用一个抽象接口的方法，不关心具体实现是邮件还是 webhook。
scenario_en: When Warehouse fires a low-stock notification, it calls an abstract interface and does not know whether the implementation sends email or a webhook.
q: AlertListener 接口体现了什么设计原则？
q_en: Which design principle does the AlertListener interface show?
options: Observer + DIP：只依赖通知抽象，不依赖具体实现
Singleton：全局唯一监听器实例
Composite：监听器组合仓库树
Factory：监听器创建库存对象
options_en: Observer plus DIP: depend only on the notification abstraction, not a concrete implementation.
Singleton: a single global listener instance.
Composite: listeners compose a tree of warehouses.
Factory: listeners construct inventory objects.
why: Warehouse 只调用 onLowStock，具体邮件、webhook、日志由实现决定，这是 Observer 模式，也满足依赖倒置。
why_en: AlertListener is the Observer pattern applying dependency inversion: Warehouse depends only on the callback interface, not a concrete notifier.
tradeoff: 依赖抽象接口 vs 依赖具体通知实现

termDefinitions.meaning: 对象状态变化时通知一组监听者，被通知方自己决定如何响应。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Observer pattern notifies a set of listeners when state changes, and each listener decides how to react.

termDefinitions.meaning: 高层模块依赖抽象接口而不是具体实现，方便替换底层实现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DIP, the Dependency Inversion Principle, means high-level modules depend on an abstraction instead of a concrete implementation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保证一个类在系统里全局只有一个实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Singleton pattern guarantees a class has only one instance globally.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把对象组合成树形结构，单个对象和组合对象用同一接口处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Composite pattern combines objects into tree structures so individual and composite objects share the same interface.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把对象创建逻辑封装起来，调用方不需要知道具体构造细节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Factory pattern encapsulates object creation so callers do not need to know construction details.

q: 补全 AlertConfig 的职责：
q_en: Complete the responsibility of AlertConfig:
text: AlertConfig 是把 {{threshold}} 和 {{AlertListener}} 绑定在一起的轻量值对象。
why: 它让配置关系显式化。看到 List<AlertConfig> 就知道这是多个低库存告警规则。
why_en: AlertConfig pairs a low-stock threshold with the listener that should be notified.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只承载数据、没有独立身份或生命周期管理的轻量对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A value object is a lightweight object that just carries data without its own identity or lifecycle.

scenario: 调用 getWarehousesWithAvailability('WIDGET', 100)，需要知道哪些仓库各自能凑够 100 件。
scenario_en: A call to getWarehousesWithAvailability('WIDGET', 100) asks which individual warehouses can each supply 100 units.
q: InventoryManager 应如何实现该方法？
q_en: How should InventoryManager implement this availability lookup?
options: 只检查列表中的第一个仓库就返回
遍历每个 Warehouse，收集能满足数量的 ID
把所有仓库库存相加后返回单个 ID
先扣减库存，再统计剩余数量
options_en: Check only the first warehouse in the list and return.
Iterate every Warehouse and collect the IDs that can fulfill the quantity.
Sum stock across all warehouses and return one ID.
Deduct stock first, then count what is left.
why: 需求问的是“哪些仓库各自能满足数量”，不是系统总量；Manager 负责跨仓库聚合结果。
why_en: Availability checks each warehouse independently and returns the IDs that can fulfill the quantity on their own.
whenOtherWins: 如果需求变成跨仓拆单 fulfill，则要返回一个组合方案而不只是单仓库列表。
tradeoff: 逐仓库独立判断 vs 系统总量聚合

scenario: Warehouse 当前只有 2 个 WIDGET，请求 removeStock('WIDGET', 10)。
scenario_en: The Warehouse currently has only 2 WIDGET units, and removeStock('WIDGET', 10) is called.
q: removeStock 的正确行为是什么？
q_en: What should removeStock do in this case?
options: 把库存设为 -8
先扣再异步补偿差额
返回 false 且库存不变
改为触发 addStock
options_en: Set the quantity to -8.
Deduct first, then compensate the gap asynchronously.
Return false and leave the quantity unchanged.
Silently call addStock instead.
why: 不允许负库存是不变量；removeStock 必须在写入前检查 currentQty >= quantity，不够就直接拒绝。
why_en: removeStock must reject insufficient stock and leave the quantity unchanged instead of ever going negative.
whenOtherWins: 如果系统支持 backorder，可以单独建 reserved/backordered 状态，但不能偷偷让 physical inventory 变负。
tradeoff: 拒绝并保持不变 vs 允许透支后补偿

scenario: 实现 Warehouse.removeStock，要求线程安全且不能出现负库存。
scenario_en: Warehouse.removeStock must be thread-safe and must never create negative stock.
q: 这段实现的关键并发保证是什么？
q_en: What concurrency guarantee does this implementation provide?
options: 允许负库存以换取吞吐
先触发告警再扣减库存
每个产品都用全局锁
检查和扣减在同一把锁内完成，告警在锁外触发
options_en: Allow negative stock in exchange for throughput.
Fire the alert before deducting stock.
Take a global lock per product.
Check and deduct inside one lock; fire alerts after releasing it.
why: 同一把锁保护 read-modify-write，防止并发扣减穿插；回调放锁外，避免慢 I/O 阻塞库存操作。
why_en: The method keeps validation and mutation atomic under one lock while firing alert callbacks only after releasing it.
whenOtherWins: 如果高吞吐下同仓库不同产品并发很多，可考虑 per-product locks，但复杂度更高。
tradeoff: 仓库级单锁简单 vs per-product 锁并发更高但更复杂
diagram:
flowchart TD
A["lock warehouse"] --> B{"qty valid and enough stock?"}
B -- no --> C["return false"]
B -- yes --> D["update inventory"]
D --> E["collect alerts"]
E --> F["unlock warehouse"]
F --> G["fire listeners outside lock"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 先读取当前值、再计算新值、最后写回的操作序列；不加保护会被并发穿插。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Read-modify-write is reading a value, computing a new one, and writing it back, which needs protection under concurrency.

scenario: 阈值是 10，库存持续在 9、8、7 之间波动。
scenario_en: The threshold is 10, and stock keeps moving among 9, 8, and 7.
q: 低库存告警为什么不应“每次 newQty < threshold 都触发”？
q_en: Why should a low-stock alert not fire on every newQty < threshold update?
options: 库存已低于阈值时每次扣减都会重复报警，造成噪音
因为低库存根本不需要通知
因为这样 addStock 就不能改变数量
因为 listener 只能被调用一次
options_en: Once stock is already below threshold, every further deduction re-fires, creating noise.
Because low stock never needs a notification at all.
Because this would stop addStock from changing quantity.
Because a listener can only ever be called once.
why: 持续低库存不是每次变化都值得重复通知；只在从阈值以上跌到阈值以下时报警更可操作。
why_en: Alerting on every below-threshold update spams notifications while the stock remains continuously low.
tradeoff: 每次低于阈值都报警 vs 只在下穿阈值那一刻报警

q: 补全阈值穿越条件：
q_en: Complete the threshold-crossing condition:
text: 只有当 previousQty {{>= threshold}} 且 newQty {{< threshold}} 时，才触发低库存告警。
why: 这个条件天然防重复，也天然重置：库存补回阈值以上后，下次跌破会再次触发。
why_en: The downward-crossing condition prevents duplicate alerts and naturally resets after stock recovers.

q: 按顺序排列阈值告警的 reset 行为：
q_en: Put the threshold alert reset behavior in order:
steps: 库存从 15 降到 9，阈值 10，触发告警。
库存从 9 降到 7，不再触发。
库存从 7 补到 22，不触发。
库存从 22 降到 9，再次触发。
why: 没有额外 hasFired 状态，previous/new 的比较就表达了恢复后可再次报警。
why_en: Comparing previous and new quantities gives duplicate prevention and reset behavior without extra state.

scenario: AlertListener 可能发送邮件或调用 webhook，这些都是慢 I/O。
scenario_en: AlertListener may send email or call a webhook, both of which are slow I/O.
q: 为什么不能在 synchronized(this) 内直接调用 listener.onLowStock？
q_en: Why should listener.onLowStock not run inside synchronized(this)?
options: listener 无法接收参数
慢 I/O 会长时间占用仓库锁，甚至回调仓库导致死锁
告警必须先于库存写入执行
Java 不允许接口回调
options_en: A listener cannot accept parameters.
Slow I/O holds the warehouse lock too long, and a callback into the warehouse can even deadlock.
The alert must run before the inventory write.
Java does not allow interface callbacks.
why: 锁内只应做快速内存操作；先收集 alertsToFire，释放锁后再执行外部回调。
why_en: Alert callbacks should run outside the warehouse lock to avoid blocking or deadlocking inventory operations.
whenOtherWins: 如果 listener 保证纯内存、可靠且不会回调仓库，锁内调用也能工作，但生产上不稳。
tradeoff: 锁外触发保吞吐 vs 锁内触发更简单但可能阻塞

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个或多个线程互相等待对方持有的锁，谁都无法继续执行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A deadlock is when two or more threads wait forever for locks that each other already holds.

q: Warehouse 中哪些 public 方法应同步访问共享状态？（多选）
q_en: Which public Warehouse methods should synchronize access to shared state?
options: addStock
removeStock
getStock
checkAvailability
setLowStockAlert
options_en: addStock
removeStock
getStock
checkAvailability
setLowStockAlert
why: 写方法需要互斥，读方法也要看到一致且最新的库存/配置；统一用仓库锁最容易证明正确。
why_en: All public methods touching warehouse state should synchronize to provide atomicity and consistent, visible reads.

scenario: 基础实现给每个 Warehouse 用同一把 synchronized(this) 锁保护所有产品。
scenario_en: The base implementation protects all products in one Warehouse with the same synchronized(this) lock.
q: Warehouse 级粗粒度锁的主要取舍是什么？
q_en: What is the main tradeoff of a coarse Warehouse-level lock?
options: 吞吐最高但难以证明正确
会让 removeStock 不再检查库存
简单正确，但同一仓库不同产品的操作不能并行
只适用于单线程程序
options_en: Highest throughput but hard to prove correct.
It stops removeStock from checking stock at all.
Simple and correct, but different products in the same warehouse cannot run in parallel.
Only works in a single-threaded program.
why: 每次操作只是少量 map 访问和告警收集，锁持有时间短；基础范围下清晰性比 per-product 锁的复杂度更重要。
why_en: A warehouse-level lock is simple and correct, though it serializes operations on different products in the same warehouse.
tradeoff: 正确性和简单性 vs 同仓库跨产品并发度

scenario: 同一仓库里不同产品的并发操作极多，warehouse 级锁成为瓶颈。
scenario_en: Different products in the same Warehouse see heavy concurrent operations, and the warehouse-level lock becomes the bottleneck.
q: 更细粒度的优化方案是什么？
q_en: What is the finer-grained locking optimization?
options: 彻底去掉锁，靠调用方自己保证操作顺序
只给 AlertListener 对象本身加锁
把每个产品拆分成独立的 Warehouse
为每个 productId 配独立锁，配合 ConcurrentHashMap
options_en: Remove locking entirely and trust callers to order operations themselves.
Only lock the AlertListener object.
Split every product into its own Warehouse.
Keep a per-productId lock plus a ConcurrentHashMap for the shared state.
why: per-product lock 允许不同产品并行操作，但需要线程安全 map、锁生命周期管理和多产品操作的锁顺序。
why_en: Per-product locking improves cross-product concurrency but adds lock lifecycle management and lock-ordering complexity.
whenOtherWins: 如果竞争低或实现时间有限，warehouse 级锁仍是更好的默认选择。
tradeoff: 并发度更高 vs 锁管理和排序复杂度更高

termDefinitions.meaning: 支持多线程并发读写而不破坏内部结构的哈希表实现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ConcurrentHashMap is a hash table implementation that supports concurrent reads and writes without corrupting its internal structure.

q: 按顺序排列 naive transfer 的 TOCTOU bug：
q_en: Put the naive transfer TOCTOU bug in order:
steps: 线程 A checkAvailability 看到源仓库有 50 件。
线程 B 在 A remove 前先扣走这 50 件。
线程 A 继续 remove 或忽略失败结果。
线程 A 仍向目标仓库 add 50 件，产生幻影库存或中间状态错误。
why: check 和 use 分属不同临界区，另一个线程可以插入；跨仓库操作需要更强的原子性。
why_en: The naive transfer has a time-of-check-to-time-of-use race between checking and removing stock.
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
participant A as Thread A
participant B as Thread B
participant S as Source Warehouse
participant T as Target Warehouse
A->>S: checkAvailability = true
B->>S: remove 50
A->>S: remove or ignore failure
A->>T: add 50
Note over A,T: check and use were not atomic

termDefinitions.meaning: 先检查条件、再据此操作，两步之间状态被别的线程改变，导致检查结果失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TOCTOU, Time-Of-Check-To-Time-Of-Use, is a race where the state changes between checking a condition and acting on it.

scenario: transfer(productId, EAST, WEST, 5) 要求对外表现为原子操作。
scenario_en: transfer(productId, EAST, WEST, 5) must appear atomic to outside callers.
q: 最正确的基础方案是什么？
q_en: What is the best base implementation for atomic transfer?
options: 按稳定顺序同时锁两个 Warehouse，再 remove/add
先 remove，晚点再 add，不锁目标仓库
只检查 availability，不真正扣减库存
先加库存到目标，再回头检查源仓库
options_en: Lock both warehouses in a stable order, then remove from source and add to destination.
Remove first and add later without locking the destination.
Only check availability without actually deducting.
Add to the destination first, then check the source.
why: 同时持有两把仓库锁能避免外部观察到库存从两个仓库都消失；稳定顺序防止双向 transfer 死锁。
why_en: Atomic transfer locks both warehouses in a consistent order before removing and adding stock.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务接受在途中间状态，应把 Transfer 建成一等实体，而不是假装瞬移。
tradeoff: 双锁强原子性 vs 单锁弱原子性换取更高并发
diagram:
flowchart TD
A["sort warehouse ids"] --> B["lock first warehouse"]
B --> C["lock second warehouse"]
C --> D{"source has enough stock?"}
D -- no --> E["unlock and return false"]
D -- yes --> F["remove from source"]
F --> G["add to target"]
G --> H["unlock and return true"]

scenario: 两个线程可能同时 EAST->WEST 和 WEST->EAST 转移。
scenario_en: Two threads may concurrently transfer EAST->WEST and WEST->EAST.
q: 这段实现为什么按 ID 排序后再加锁？
q_en: Why does this implementation sort IDs before locking?
options: 让字典序更好看
防止两个相反方向的 transfer 形成循环等待死锁
保证 EAST 永远是源仓库
让 removeStock 可以忽略库存不足
options_en: To make the lexical order look nicer.
To prevent two opposite-direction transfers from forming a circular-wait deadlock.
To guarantee EAST is always the source warehouse.
To let removeStock ignore insufficient stock.
why: 所有线程都按同一全局顺序获取锁，就不会出现 A 持有 EAST 等 WEST、B 持有 WEST 等 EAST 的循环等待。
why_en: Consistent lock ordering prevents deadlock when two threads transfer stock between the same pair of warehouses.
whenOtherWins: 如果只用数据库事务，锁顺序交给数据库和隔离级别处理，但应用层仍要理解死锁风险。
tradeoff: 全局锁顺序防死锁 vs 各自随意加锁更简单但会死锁

scenario: InventoryManager.transfer 在持有仓库锁期间，又调用了同样加锁的 Warehouse.removeStock/addStock。
scenario_en: InventoryManager.transfer holds warehouse locks and then calls Warehouse.removeStock/addStock, which also synchronize on the same Warehouse.
q: 为什么这个 atomic transfer 方案要求 reentrant locks？
q_en: Why does this atomic transfer design require reentrant locks?
options: reentrant locks 会自动创建库存
非重入锁更快所以必须用
已经持有 Warehouse 锁时再调用同锁的方法会再次获取同一把锁
只有 reentrant locks 能比较字符串
options_en: Reentrant locks automatically create inventory.
Non-reentrant locks are faster, so they must be used.
While already holding the Warehouse lock, calling its own synchronized method acquires that same lock again.
Only reentrant locks can compare strings.
why: 如果锁不可重入，线程持有仓库锁后调用内部同步方法会自我死锁；无重入语言需要暴露 non-locking 内部 helper。
why_en: Calling synchronized warehouse methods while already holding their locks requires reentrant locks or non-locking internal helpers.
tradeoff: 可重入锁简化嵌套调用 vs 不可重入锁需要额外的无锁 helper

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一线程可以对已持有的锁再次加锁而不会自我阻塞，如 Java 的 synchronized。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A reentrant lock lets the same thread acquire a lock it already holds without blocking itself, like Java's synchronized.

scenario: transfer 的 fromWarehouseId 和 toWarehouseId 相同。
scenario_en: A transfer call has the same fromWarehouseId and toWarehouseId.
q: 合理的处理方式是什么？
q_en: How should same-warehouse transfer be handled?
options: 执行 remove 再 add 同一仓库，并触发两次告警
直接删除这个仓库对象
随机挑一个目标仓库替代
返回 false 或视为 no-op，基础实现通常拒绝
options_en: Remove then add on the same warehouse and fire alerts twice.
Delete that warehouse object outright.
Pick a random destination warehouse instead.
Return false or treat it as a no-op; the base implementation usually rejects it.
why: 同仓库转移没有业务意义，且可能制造多余告警或锁问题；明确拒绝最简单。
why_en: A transfer from a warehouse to itself should be rejected or treated as a no-op by explicit design.
whenOtherWins: 如果 API 语义需要幂等 no-op，可以返回 true 且不改变任何状态。
tradeoff: 直接拒绝更简单 vs 幂等 no-op 对调用方更友好

q: InventoryManager 的主要 API 包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which methods belong in the main InventoryManager API?
options: addStock(warehouseId,productId,quantity)
removeStock(warehouseId,productId,quantity)
transfer(productId,from,to,quantity)
getWarehousesWithAvailability(productId,quantity)
setLowStockAlert(warehouseId,productId,threshold,listener)
options_en: addStock(warehouseId, productId, quantity)
removeStock(warehouseId, productId, quantity)
transfer(productId, from, to, quantity)
getWarehousesWithAvailability(productId, quantity)
setLowStockAlert(warehouseId, productId, threshold, listener)
why: 这些方法对应最终需求，Manager 只负责查仓库和跨仓协调；实际库存状态仍由 Warehouse 拥有。
why_en: InventoryManager exposes add, remove, transfer, availability lookup, and alert configuration as its public API.

scenario: 调用 addStock 或 removeStock 时 quantity <= 0。
scenario_en: addStock or removeStock is called with quantity <= 0.
q: 应如何处理非法的 quantity？
q_en: How should invalid stock quantities be handled?
options: addStock 拒绝或抛错，removeStock 返回 false
把负数当成 removeStock，正数当 addStock 处理
把 0 当成信号，强制触发一次低库存告警
允许库存直接变负，之后再想办法修正差额
options_en: addStock rejects or throws, removeStock returns false; the quantity never changes.
Treat a negative addStock as a removeStock and a positive removeStock as an addStock.
Treat zero as a signal to force a low-stock alert.
Let the quantity go negative and fix the gap later.
why: 数量必须是正数才能表达库存变化；负数操作会绕过不变量并混淆 API 语义。
why_en: Stock mutation quantities should be positive, and invalid quantities should never change inventory.
whenOtherWins: 如果需要把库存直接调整到某个目标数，应设计单独的 setStock/adjustment API 并记录审计原因。
tradeoff: 早失败拒绝非法输入 vs 兼容负数换语义复杂

scenario: checkAvailability 和 removeStock 被不同线程同时调用同一个 Warehouse。
scenario_en: Different threads call checkAvailability and removeStock on the same Warehouse at the same time.
q: 为什么 checkAvailability 也要同步？
q_en: Why should checkAvailability be synchronized too?
options: 让查询变慢才算正确
保证读到一致的库存并具有正确的内存可见性
因为它会修改库存
因为 listener 要求同步
options_en: Slowing the query down is what makes it correct.
It guarantees a consistent read with correct memory visibility.
Because it mutates the inventory.
Because the listener requires synchronization.
why: 未同步的读可能看到陈旧或中间状态；对共享 map，读写都应遵守同一同步规则。
why_en: Synchronized reads ensure consistent and visible inventory state under concurrent access.
whenOtherWins: 读多写少的场景可以用读写锁优化，但仍要有明确的同步策略。
tradeoff: 全部同步保证一致性 vs 读写锁换更高读并发

scenario: 调用 setLowStockAlert(productId, threshold, listener)，threshold=0 或 listener=null。
scenario_en: setLowStockAlert(productId, threshold, listener) is called with threshold=0 or listener=null.
q: 应该怎么处理无效的告警配置？
q_en: How should invalid alert configuration be handled?
options: 创建一个永远触发的告警
忽略 listener，只保存 threshold
拒绝这次配置
把 threshold 强制改成 1
options_en: Create an alert that always fires.
Ignore the listener and only save the threshold.
Reject the configuration.
Force the threshold to 1.
why: 低库存阈值必须为正，listener 不能为空，否则触发时无可执行的动作；配置错误应早失败。
why_en: Invalid alert thresholds or null listeners should be rejected when configuring alerts.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务允许 0 库存也报警，条件可以改成 threshold >= 0，但必须显式声明。
tradeoff: 早失败拒绝非法配置 vs 静默容错换来隐藏 bug

q: 补全库存操作的返回语义：
q_en: Complete the return semantics for stock operations:
text: addStock 通常返回 {{void}}，因为加库存总可成功；removeStock 返回 {{boolean}}，因为库存不足时可能失败。
why: API 返回值应反映操作是否有可预期失败；加库存失败一般是无效仓库或参数错误，用异常更清晰。
why_en: addStock can be void while removeStock returns success because only removal can fail from insufficient stock.

scenario: 电商结账需要 5 分钟，不能让两个用户都看到“最后 1 件可买”并在付款时才失败。
scenario_en: Checkout can take 5 minutes, and two users should not both see the last unit as buyable and only fail after payment.
q: 应加入哪种机制解决这个问题？
q_en: What mechanism should be added to prevent this oversell window?
options: 只在支付成功之后才真正检查库存是否够
把库存扣成负数，事后再异步补偿差额
把这件商品永久锁死，谁都不能再买
加入 reservation 机制：先预占再确认或释放
options_en: Only check inventory after payment already succeeds.
Let stock go negative and compensate asynchronously afterward.
Lock the product permanently so nobody can buy it.
Add a reservation mechanism: hold stock first, then confirm or release it.
why: reservation 把 physical stock 与 reserved stock 分开，结账开始时占用可售数量，付款成功再真正扣减。
why_en: A reservation system holds available inventory during checkout and confirms or releases it later.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务采用乐观售卖并接受缺货退款，可以不做 reservation，在订单确认后再补救。
tradeoff: reservation 保证结账不落空 vs 乐观售卖更简单但可能超卖
diagram:
flowchart TD
A["checkout starts"] --> B{"available = inventory - reserved"}
B -->|enough| C["create Reservation"]
C --> D["increase reserved"]
D --> E{"payment result"}
E -->|success| F["confirm: reduce inventory and reserved"]
E -->|timeout/cancel| G["release: reduce reserved"]

q: 引入库存 reservation 后 Warehouse 需要新增哪些状态？（多选）
q_en: Which new state does Warehouse need after adding reservations?
options: reserved: Map<productId,int>
reservations: Map<reservationId,Reservation>
Reservation(productId,quantity,expiresAt)
每个产品的图片 URL
options_en: reserved: Map<productId,int>
reservations: Map<reservationId,Reservation>
A Reservation(productId, quantity, expiresAt) record.
An image URL for every product.
why: available = inventory - reserved；reservation 记录过期时间，支持后续确认或释放。
why_en: Inventory reservations require reserved counts, reservation records, and expiration timestamps.

q: 库存 reservation 的正确流程是什么？
q_en: What is the correct reservation flow for inventory?
steps: reserveStock 检查 inventory - reserved 是否足够。
创建 Reservation(productId, quantity, expiresAt)。
增加 reserved[productId]。
支付成功时 confirmReservation 扣减 inventory、减少 reserved、删除 reservation。
超时或放弃时 releaseReservation 减少 reserved、删除 reservation。
why: reservation 不立即减少 physical inventory，但会减少可售库存；确认和释放是两条互斥的后续路径。
why_en: Reservation reserves available quantity first, then either confirms into real removal or releases the hold.
diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
[*] --> RESERVED : reserveStock
RESERVED --> CONFIRMED : payment success
RESERVED --> RELEASED : cancel or timeout
CONFIRMED --> [*]
RELEASED --> [*]

scenario: 用户关掉浏览器，没有主动调用 releaseReservation。
scenario_en: The user closes the browser and never calls releaseReservation.
q: 系统还需要补什么机制？
q_en: What mechanism is still needed for abandoned reservations?
options: 后台任务周期扫描并释放已过期的 reservation
永远保留 reserved 数量
等下一次 addStock 自动删除所有 reservation
让 AlertListener 负责清库存
options_en: A background job periodically scans and releases expired reservations.
Keep the reserved quantity locked forever.
Let the next addStock silently delete all reservations.
Let AlertListener clear the inventory.
why: 没有清理，reserved 库存会永久锁住；超时值是业务权衡，常见 5-15 分钟。
why_en: Expired reservation cleanup is needed so abandoned checkouts do not hold inventory forever.
whenOtherWins: 如果用外部 TTL 存储，过期可由存储层驱动，但仍要处理释放 reserved 的一致性。
tradeoff: 定期清理换来可售库存及时释放 vs 不清理实现更简单但库存被锁死

scenario: 仓库转移真实需要 3-5 天运输，库存不该在源和目标间瞬间移动。
scenario_en: A real warehouse transfer takes 3-5 days, so stock should not instantly jump from source to destination.
q: 更真实的建模方式是什么？
q_en: What is the more realistic model for warehouse transfers?
options: 仍然同时 remove source 和 add destination
把 Transfer 建成能持有库存的一等实体
把库存从系统总量中直接删除
把目标仓库提前加上库存
options_en: Still remove from source and add to destination at the same instant.
Model Transfer as a first-class entity that can hold in-transit inventory.
Delete the stock from the system total entirely.
Add the stock to the destination early, before it arrives.
why: 运输中库存不在任一仓库可售，但仍属于系统总量；Transfer 作为临时 holder 能准确表达在途状态。
why_en: A first-class Transfer entity can hold in-transit inventory without making it available at either warehouse.
whenOtherWins: 面试基础范围内可以用原子瞬移 transfer，简单满足需求即可。
tradeoff: 建模在途状态更真实 vs 原子瞬移实现更简单
diagram:
flowchart LR
S["source warehouse"] -->|ship| X["Transfer holder"]
X -->|arrive| T["target warehouse"]
X --> Q["in transit stock"]
Q --> N["not sellable but counted in system total"]

scenario: 把 Transfer 建成一个可以临时持有库存的实体，而不是让库存在两仓库间瞬移。
scenario_en: Transfer is modeled as an entity that can temporarily hold inventory instead of teleporting stock between warehouses.
q: Transfer as InventoryHolder 的“aha”是什么？
q_en: What is the key idea behind Transfer as an InventoryHolder?
options: Transfer 必须继承 Warehouse 所有行为
在途库存应该可以直接被售卖
库存可以暂时存在于仓库以外的持有者中，系统总量仍可核对
完成 transfer 不需要目标仓库
options_en: Transfer must inherit every behavior of Warehouse.
In-transit stock should be directly sellable.
Stock can temporarily live in a holder outside any warehouse while the system total still reconciles.
Completing a transfer needs no destination warehouse.
why: 把 Transfer 看作临时库存容器，能同时支持查询总库存和禁止在途库存履约。
why_en: Modeling Transfer as an inventory holder accounts for in-transit stock without making it available for orders.
tradeoff: 临时持有者建模更真实 vs 只用 Warehouse 更简单

termDefinitions.meaning: 任何能持有库存数量的实体的抽象，Warehouse 和 Transfer 都可以是一种 holder。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: InventoryHolder is an abstraction for anything that can hold a stock quantity; both Warehouse and Transfer can be one.

q: 在途 Transfer 实体通常保存哪些信息？（多选）
q_en: What information does an in-transit Transfer usually store?
options: id
productId 和 quantity
fromWarehouseId 和 toWarehouseId
createdAt 或状态
options_en: id
productId and quantity
fromWarehouseId and toWarehouseId
createdAt or a status field
why: 这些字段让系统知道哪批库存、从哪来、到哪去、是否完成；完成时再把库存加入目标仓库。
why_en: A transfer record identifies the in-transit product, quantity, endpoints, and lifecycle metadata.

scenario: 有人想在基础设计里再加入订单处理、支付、仓库服务范围和产品目录。
scenario_en: Someone asks to add order processing, payment, serviceability, and product catalog features to the base design.
q: 面对这个扩展请求应该怎么处理？
q_en: How should this scope-expansion request be handled?
options: 全部塞进 InventoryManager
让 Warehouse 负责支付
把 productId 替换成 Product 复杂对象
明确这些属于 out of scope，保持库存核心模型
options_en: Cram everything into InventoryManager.
Let Warehouse handle payment.
Replace productId with a full Product object.
State these are out of scope and keep the core inventory model focused.
why: 库存系统只管理数量和库存相关操作；订单、支付、产品目录是独立系统，会显著扩大设计。
why_en: Order processing, payment, serviceability, and catalog management are outside the scoped inventory model.
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官明确要求扩展到订单系统，再增加 Order/Reservation/Fulfillment 等实体。
tradeoff: 守住范围保持模型简单 vs 扩大范围覆盖更多需求

q: 原子转移 EAST -> WEST 5 件的正确状态变化是什么？
q_en: What are the correct state changes for an atomic EAST-to-WEST transfer of 5 units?
steps: 按稳定顺序锁住 EAST 和 WEST。
在锁内调用 EAST.removeStock，确认库存足够并扣到 2。
在仍持有两把锁时调用 WEST.addStock，加到 5。
释放两把锁并返回 true。
why: 锁持有期间外部线程不能看到缺失中间态；remove 失败则不 add，两个仓库保持原状。
why_en: Atomic transfer locks both warehouses, removes from source, adds to destination, and releases locks only after completion.

scenario: 低库存告警触发时，listener 需要知道具体是哪一个仓库缺货。
scenario_en: When a low-stock alert fires, the listener needs to know which warehouse is short on stock.
q: Warehouse 为什么需要自己的 id 字段？
q_en: Why does Warehouse need its own id field?
options: 把 warehouseId 传给 onLowStock 这个回调
用来决定这个产品当前对外的售价
用来在内部悄悄替代 productId 这个字段
用来生成保护这个仓库状态的锁对象
options_en: To pass warehouseId to the onLowStock callback.
To decide the product's current selling price.
To quietly replace the productId field internally.
To generate the lock object that protects this warehouse's state.
why: 告警没有 warehouseId 就无法判断哪处库存不足；Warehouse 自己持有 id 是最短路径。
why_en: Warehouse stores its own ID so low-stock notifications can identify which location is reporting.
whenOtherWins: 如果所有回调都统一经过 Manager 转发并由它补上下文，Warehouse 也能不存 id，但那样 Warehouse 要反过来依赖 Manager 传参。
tradeoff: 自持 id 传给回调 vs 让 Manager 补充上下文更绕

termDefinitions.meaning: 唯一标识一个实体（这里是仓库）的字符串或数字。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ID, short for identifier, is the string or number that uniquely names one entity, here a warehouse.

scenario: 低库存 alert 配置需要放在 Warehouse 还是 InventoryManager 里。
scenario_en: The low-stock alert configuration could live in Warehouse or InventoryManager.
q: 为什么低库存 alert 配置应放在 Warehouse？
q_en: Why should low-stock alert configuration live in Warehouse?
options: Manager 不能访问仓库
告警是某仓库某产品的库存状态规则，Warehouse 拥有相关数量变化
AlertConfig 需要所有仓库的总量
listener 只能在 Manager 中被调用
options_en: Manager cannot access any warehouse.
An alert is a per-warehouse per-product rule, and Warehouse owns the quantity changes that trigger it.
AlertConfig needs the total quantity across all warehouses.
A listener can only be invoked from Manager.
why: Warehouse 最懂自己产品数量的变化，能在 add/remove 后直接判断阈值穿越；Manager 只负责路由和跨仓协调。
why_en: Alert configuration belongs to Warehouse because it owns the per-product quantity changes that trigger alerts.
tradeoff: 配置贴近状态所有者 vs 集中放在 Manager 更容易全局管理

scenario: 需求明确仓库是固定集合，在系统初始化时一次性创建。
scenario_en: The requirements say warehouses are a fixed set created once during initialization.
q: InventoryManager 构造函数应如何处理 warehouseIds？
q_en: How should the InventoryManager constructor handle warehouseIds?
options: 每次 addStock 时懒创建任意 warehouseId
忽略传入的 ids
遍历 ids，创建 Warehouse(id) 并放入 map
要求调用方自己传 Warehouse map 且不做校验
options_en: Lazily create any warehouseId the first time addStock sees it.
Ignore the ids that are passed in.
Iterate the ids, create a Warehouse(id) for each, and store them in the map.
Require the caller to pass a pre-built Warehouse map with no validation.
why: 固定启动配置让 Manager 在构造时建立完整仓库集合；无效 warehouseId 后续应快速失败。
why_en: The manager eagerly creates every configured warehouse at startup because the warehouse set is fixed.
whenOtherWins: 如果仓库集合会动态增删，就需要额外的 addWarehouse/removeWarehouse 接口，而不是只在构造时建一次。
tradeoff: 启动时一次性创建 vs 运行时懒创建换灵活性

scenario: removeStock 把库存从 15 扣到 9，阈值是 10。
scenario_en: removeStock changes stock from 15 to 9, and the alert threshold is 10.
q: getAlertsToFire 这次应返回什么？
q_en: What should getAlertsToFire return for this update?
options: null，因为库存仍非零
立即调用 listener 并持锁等待
删除这个产品的 alert config
包含该阈值 listener 的 alert 列表
options_en: null, because the stock is still non-zero.
Call the listener immediately while still holding the lock.
Delete the alert config for this product.
A list of alerts containing the listener for that threshold.
why: 阈值从上方穿越到下方，应收集待触发的告警；真正的回调在释放锁后才执行。
why_en: Downward threshold crossing should collect the matching listeners so they can fire after the lock is released.
whenOtherWins: 如果 newQty 恰好等于 threshold，按 < threshold 的规则不触发；若业务定义为 <=，条件要相应调整。
tradeoff: 锁内只收集列表 vs 锁内直接触发换来更简单但危险的实现

q: Senior 级库存题回答应主动覆盖哪些点？（多选）
q_en: Which points should a senior-level inventory-system answer proactively cover?
options: transfer 的 TOCTOU race
同时锁两个仓库并按稳定顺序防死锁
reentrant lock 或 non-locking helper 的要求
告警回调放锁外触发
reservation/in-transit 等扩展
options_en: The TOCTOU race inside a naive transfer.
Locking both warehouses at once in a stable order to prevent deadlock.
The reentrant-lock requirement, or a non-locking internal helper as its alternative.
Firing alert callbacks outside the lock.
Extensions such as reservation or in-transit modeling.
why: 高级回答的重点是并发正确性和业务状态演进；单纯的 Map 加减不足以覆盖题目的风险点。
why_en: Senior inventory answers focus on transfer races, ordered locking, reentrancy, alert callbacks outside locks, and realistic extensions.

q: 按顺序排列库存系统主设计链路：
q_en: Put the main inventory-system design chain in order:
steps: Product 降级为 productId key，Warehouse 成为库存状态拥有者。
澄清多仓库库存、add/remove、availability、transfer、alerts、thread-safe。
InventoryManager 作为 facade 路由单仓操作并协调跨仓操作。
AlertConfig/AlertListener 解耦阈值和通知渠道。
Warehouse 方法用锁保护库存，transfer 额外按顺序锁两仓库。
why: 这条链路从范围和实体裁剪，到职责分层、通知解耦和并发正确性。
why_en: The design chain moves from scope to entity pruning, orchestration, alert abstraction, and concurrency correctness.

scenario: 面试最后让你总结库存系统最重要的不变量。
scenario_en: At the end of the interview, you are asked to summarize the most important inventory-system invariants.
q: 哪一个总结最准确？
q_en: Which summary best captures the core invariant?
options: 任何仓库任何产品库存都不能为负，transfer 要保持系统总量不变
低库存必须在每一次查询时都重新报警一次
所有仓库任何时候都必须持有完全相同的库存
transfer 执行过程中允许库存短暂凭空丢失
options_en: No warehouse's product quantity may go negative, and a transfer must keep the system total unchanged.
Low stock must trigger a fresh alert on every single query.
Every warehouse must hold identical stock at all times.
A transfer is allowed to briefly lose stock into thin air.
why: 非负库存和原子 transfer 是库存系统正确性的核心；告警只是附加通知，不应破坏库存不变量。
why_en: The core invariant is non-negative per-warehouse stock and atomic cross-warehouse transfers when strict consistency is required.
whenOtherWins: 如果建模了在途库存，transfer 不再是瞬移，但系统总库存仍应在 Warehouse 和 Transfer holder 间守恒。
tradeoff: 严格原子 transfer 保证不变量 vs 允许在途状态换取更真实的建模

q: Logging Service 基础需求包含哪些点？（多选）
q_en: Which base requirements does the Logging Service need? (Select all)
options: 五个级别 DEBUG < INFO < WARN < ERROR < FATAL
每条记录包含 timestamp、level、message、threadName
每个 destination 有自己的 minLevel 和 formatter
并发写同一 destination 时字节不能交错
why: 题目重点是同步日志库的核心模型和并发写安全。异步、热更新、远程目的地和层级 logger 是后续扩展。
why_en: The base logger has ordered levels, immutable records, per-destination thresholds and formats, and non-interleaved concurrent writes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 五值有序枚举 DEBUG<INFO<WARN<ERROR<FATAL，用于记录严重度和 destination 的阈值比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LogLevel is the five-value ordered enum from DEBUG to FATAL used for severity and threshold comparisons.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 destination 自己配置的最低级别阈值，记录级别低于它就被静默丢弃。

q: 这段伪代码的关键设计是什么？

write(record)
    if record.level < minLevel return      // filtered before lock
    formatted = formatter.format(record)    // pure fn, safe outside lock
    lock.acquire()
    try
        sink.write(formatted)                // only line under lock
    catch e
        stderr.write('logger: sink write failed')
    finally
        lock.release()

q: Destination.write 应如何处理？
q_en: How should Destination.write handle it?
options: 捕获异常，写 stderr 诊断并返回，不让异常逃到业务代码
让 sink.write 抛出的异常一路冒泡到调用 logger.error 的业务代码
一旦某个 destination 写入失败就立刻中止对其余 destination 的遍历

why_en: A sink failure should not crash the caller or stop other destinations, but should emit a diagnostic.
whenOtherWins: 极简实现可吞掉异常，但生产上最好有 stderr 或内部 status logger，并做限流。
tradeoff: 捕获+诊断保证隔离与可观测 vs 直接冒泡保证实现最简单

q: 异步 destination 的正确高层流程是什么？

options_en: Deriving occupancy makes it impossible to know which spot a ticket maps to.
The derived version is strictly faster than a maintained Set and has no downside.
Deriving occupancy automatically prevents all race conditions.
It has the least redundancy, but allocation must scan tickets and concurrent access needs to lock the whole map.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多线程同时读写共享状态，导致结果依赖执行顺序的错误。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A race condition happens when concurrent threads read and write shared state and the outcome depends on timing.

q: 补全状态归属心法：
q_en: Fill in the state-ownership rule of thumb:
text: 判断状态属于实体还是 orchestrator，可问它是实体的{{内在属性}}，还是系统管理的{{关系/分配}}。
why: 车位大小是内在属性，当前被哪个 ticket 占用是关系状态；这个判断能解释很多 LLD 设计里的状态归属取舍。
why_en: State ownership depends on whether the state is intrinsic to an entity or a relationship the system manages.

termDefinitions.meaning: 实体本身固有、不依赖外部关系的属性，比如车位的大小。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An intrinsic property belongs to the entity itself and does not depend on an external relationship, like a spot's size.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由系统在多个对象之间维护的关系，比如车位当前分配给哪张 ticket。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Relational state is a relationship the system maintains between objects, like which ticket a spot is currently assigned to.

scenario: 入场成功后，系统要在出场时识别停车会话、车位、车型和入场时间。
scenario_en: After entry succeeds, exit needs to identify the parking session, spot, vehicle type, and entry time.
q: Ticket 应保存哪些核心字段？
q_en: Which core fields should Ticket store?
options: id、spotId、vehicleType、entryTime
完整 ParkingSpot 引用、支付卡号、摄像头图片
只保存 vehicleType，其余现查
只保存 hourlyRate，不存时间
why: Ticket 是一次停车会话的不可变记录，出场计费和释放车位都依赖这四个字段，不多不少。
why_en: Ticket records the parking session with an ID, spot ID, vehicle type, and entry time, which is exactly what exit needs.
whenOtherWins: 如果要支持车牌识别或黑名单，需要新增专门实体，而不是把这些字段塞进 Ticket。
tradeoff: 只存最小必要字段 vs 塞进冗余引用和无关数据
options_en: id, spotId, vehicleType, and entryTime.
A full ParkingSpot reference, a payment card number, and a camera image.
Only vehicleType, looking everything else up later.
Only hourlyRate, without any timestamp.
diagram:
classDiagram
  class Ticket
  class Vehicle
  class ParkingSpot
  Ticket --> Vehicle
  Ticket --> ParkingSpot
  Ticket : spotId
  Ticket : entryTime

termDefinitions.meaning: 直接持有另一个对象的指针，可以调用它的方法或修改它的状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An object reference directly points to another object, letting you call its methods or change its state.

scenario: Ticket 需要在出场时告诉 ParkingLot 释放哪个车位，但不应该直接操作 ParkingSpot 对象。
scenario_en: Ticket must tell ParkingLot which spot to release at exit, but it should not mutate the ParkingSpot object directly.
q: Ticket 为什么存 spotId 字符串，而不是 ParkingSpot 对象引用？
q_en: Why should Ticket store a spotId string instead of a ParkingSpot object reference?
options: ParkingSpot 不能有 id 字段
Ticket 是记录，存 ID 更简单，避免它导航或修改 Spot
spotId 字符串无法用来释放车位
Ticket 必须自己负责定价计算
why: Ticket 不应该伸手修改领域对象。ParkingLot 用 spotId 更新 occupiedSpotIds 即可，符合 Law of Demeter。
why_en: Ticket stores a spot ID to remain a simple record rather than a navigational object that reaches into ParkingSpot.
tradeoff: 存 ID 的简单记录 vs 存对象引用带来的导航能力
options_en: ParkingSpot is not allowed to have an id field.
Ticket is a record, and storing an ID is simpler and keeps it from navigating into or mutating Spot.
A spotId string cannot be used to free the spot.
Ticket must own the fee-calculation logic itself.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对象只应该跟直接协作者通信，不应该链式访问别的对象内部结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Law of Demeter says an object should only talk to its immediate collaborators, not reach through them into other objects.

scenario: 需求只有一条定价规则：所有车型同一 hourly rate，按小时向上取整。
scenario_en: The only pricing rule is one hourly rate for all vehicle types, rounded up to whole hours.
q: 计费逻辑应放在哪个类里？
q_en: Which class should own the fee-calculation logic?
options: Ticket.calculateFee，并让 Ticket 自己保存 rate
ParkingLot.computeFee
ParkingSpot.getSpotType 顺带算价
VehicleType enum 内部计算
why: 计费是停车场业务政策，不是 ticket 记录本身的职责；简单需求下放在 ParkingLot 足够，也符合单一职责。
why_en: Fee calculation is a parking lot business policy, not behavior of the ticket record, so it belongs on ParkingLot.
whenOtherWins: 如果要支持多种复杂定价模型，可抽 PricingStrategy，而不是一开始就过度设计。
tradeoff: 定价放在业务编排者 vs 定价放在数据记录里
options_en: Ticket.calculateFee, with the ticket storing its own rate.
ParkingLot.computeFee.
ParkingSpot.getSpotType, computing price on the side.
Inside the VehicleType enum.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个类应该只有一个改变的理由。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Single Responsibility Principle says a class should have only one reason to change.

scenario: 系统要把 $5.47 这样的金额存成整数，并按小时向上取整计费。
scenario_en: The system stores amounts like $5.47 as integers and bills parking time by rounding up to whole hours.
q: 补全计费锚点：
q_en: Fill in the billing anchor:
text: 金额应以最小货币单位如 {{cents}} 的整数保存；时长按小时计费并 {{向上取整}}，所以 5 分钟也算 1 小时。
why: 金额用 cents 整数存储避免浮点误差（$5.47→547 cents）；时长向上取整这条规则直接决定 computeFee 的返回值。
why_en: Money is stored as integer cents to avoid floating-point error, and duration rounds up to whole hours, which directly drives computeFee's output.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用整数分表示金额，避免浮点小数误差累积。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Storing money as integer cents avoids the rounding errors that accumulate with floating-point fractions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不足一个整小时也按一整小时计费。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rounding up means any partial hour is still billed as a full hour.

scenario: 出场 API 收到 ticketId，需要快速验证票据并找到 entryTime 和 spotId。
scenario_en: The exit API receives a ticketId and must quickly validate the ticket and find entryTime and spotId.
q: activeTickets 应该用什么结构存储？
q_en: What data structure should store activeTickets?
options: List<Ticket>，每次线性扫描是唯一选择
Map<String, Ticket>，以 ticketId 为 key
Set<ParkingSpot>，按车位去重
单个 currentTicket 字段
why: map 让『按 ticketId 查票』的意图显式化；200 张票时 benchmark 显示 map 0.12μs、list 扫描 1.93μs，但这个差距在停车场规模下不重要，map 的价值主要在代码可读性。
why_en: A map makes lookup-by-ticket-ID explicit, and even though it benchmarks faster than a list scan, the real win at parking-lot scale is code clarity.
whenOtherWins: 极小系统用 list 扫描也能工作，但没有 map 语义清楚。
tradeoff: 查找语义清晰的 Map vs 实现简单但要线性扫描的 List
options_en: List<Ticket>, where a linear scan is the only option.
Map<String, Ticket>, keyed by ticket ID.
Set<ParkingSpot>, deduplicated by spot.
A single currentTicket field.

termDefinitions.meaning: 键值对集合，可以通过 key 直接查找 value。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Map stores key-value pairs and lets you look up a value directly by its key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 操作耗时不随数据规模增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(1) means an operation's cost does not grow with the size of the input.

scenario: 车辆入场，系统要找兼容空位并发票。
scenario_en: A vehicle enters, and the system must find a compatible free spot and issue a ticket.
q: 这段 enter 伪代码体现的状态变化顺序是什么？
q_en: What state-change order does this enter pseudocode show?
codeSample:
enter(vehicleType)
    spot = findAvailableSpot(vehicleType)
    if spot == null throw NoSpace
    occupiedSpotIds.add(spot.id)
    ticket = Ticket(generateId(), spot.id, vehicleType, now())
    activeTickets[ticket.id] = ticket
    return ticket
options: 先创建 ticket，稍后再决定占不占车位
只更新 ParkingSpot.occupied，不碰 ticket
先占用 spotId，再创建并保存 ticket，最后返回 ticket
把车位分配推迟到出场时才做
why: 入场成功要同时建立车位占用索引和票据索引；找不到兼容空位时不能改变任何状态。
why_en: Entry claims a compatible spot, creates a ticket, stores it, and returns it, keeping both indexes in sync.
whenOtherWins: 多入口并发下，这段 find+add 必须放在同一把锁内，否则两辆车可能拿到同一个车位。
tradeoff: 先占位后发票保证不变量 vs 反过来可能留下幽灵占用
options_en: Create the ticket first and decide whether to claim a spot later.
Only update ParkingSpot.occupied, without touching the ticket.
Claim the spot ID first, then create and store the ticket, then return it.
Defer spot assignment until exit time.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["vehicle arrives"] --> B["find spot"]
  B --> C["mark spot occupied"]
  C --> D["create ticket"]
  D --> E["store active ticket"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在任何时刻都必须保持成立的约束，例如 occupied 集合和 ticket 集合同步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An invariant is a condition the system must always keep true, such as keeping the occupied set and ticket map in sync.

scenario: 基础需求要求 exact compatible spot，不提『摩托可停汽车位』等 fallback。
scenario_en: The base requirement asks for an exact compatible spot and does not mention fallback rules like letting motorcycles use car spots.
q: findAvailableSpot 默认应如何查找空位？
q_en: How should findAvailableSpot look for a free spot by default?
options: 扫描 spots，找 spotType 匹配且不在 occupiedSpotIds 中的空位
任意空位都可以分配给任何车型，不检查 spotType 是否匹配
优先把停车场里最大的车位分配给所有车型，不管实际需要
按车辆到最近出口的实时距离做复杂路径排序后再分配
why: 基础规则是兼容类型精确匹配。没有需求提出 fallback 时不引入复杂分配策略。
why_en: The base allocation scans for an unoccupied spot with the required compatible type, nothing more.
whenOtherWins: 如果扩展允许 motorcycle 用 car spot，映射逻辑或分配策略需要支持 fallback 顺序。
tradeoff: 精确类型匹配的简单扫描 vs 提前引入的复杂分配策略
options_en: Scan spots for a matching spotType whose id is not in occupiedSpotIds.
Any free spot can be assigned to any vehicle type without checking spotType.
Always give the largest spot in the lot to every vehicle type.
Sort candidate spots by real-time distance to the nearest exit.

scenario: 用户出场提供 ticketId，ticket 存在且未使用过。
scenario_en: A user exits with a ticketId, and the ticket exists and has not been used before.
q: exit 的正确执行顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct execution order for exit?
options: 出场时先把 activeTickets 里的 ticket 删除，再用它算 fee
查 ticket → 计算 fee → 释放 spot → 删除 active ticket → 返回 fee
只计算 fee 返回给用户，不释放 spot，占用状态一直保留
把该车位所在楼层的所有同类型车位全部释放，而不是只放这一个
why: 出场完成后车位可再次分配，ticket 不能再次使用；顺序必须保证 ticket 数据还在时先完成计费。
why_en: Exit looks up the ticket, computes the fee, frees the spot, removes the active ticket, and returns the fee, in that order.
whenOtherWins: 如果计费失败需要重试，删除 ticket 这一步应该放到计费和释放都确认成功之后再做。
tradeoff: 先读数据再清理状态 vs 先清理导致计费数据丢失
options_en: Delete the ticket from activeTickets first, then use it to compute the fee.
Look up the ticket, compute the fee, free the spot, remove the active ticket, then return the fee.
Only compute the fee without freeing the spot, leaving occupancy untouched.
Free every same-type spot on that floor, not just this one.
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant V as Vehicle
  participant L as ParkingLot
  participant T as Ticket
  V->>L: exit(ticketId)
  L->>T: load active ticket
  L->>L: calculate fee
  L->>L: free spot
  L->>L: remove active ticket

scenario: 用户可能重复使用同一张 ticket 出场。
scenario_en: A user may try to exit more than once with the same ticket.
q: 这段 exit 伪代码如何防止 double exit？
q_en: How does this exit pseudocode prevent a double exit?
codeSample:
exit(ticketId)
    if ticketId == null || ticketId == '' throw InvalidTicket
    ticket = activeTickets[ticketId]
    if ticket == null throw InvalidTicket
    fee = computeFee(ticket.entryTime, now())
    occupiedSpotIds.remove(ticket.spotId)
    activeTickets.remove(ticketId)
    return fee
options: 在 Ticket 上增加 usedCount 字段计数
允许重复计费，只记录日志
成功出场后删除 activeTickets 项，下一次查不到同一 ticket
只删除 occupiedSpotIds，保留 ticket
why: activeTickets 是当前有效票据集合，移除后已使用票据和随机无效票据都表现为同一种 invalid。
why_en: Removing the ticket from activeTickets makes any repeated exit with the same ticket ID come back invalid.
whenOtherWins: 如果要区分『从未存在』和『已使用』这两种错误，需要额外维护 usedTickets 或历史记录。
tradeoff: 用集合成员资格表达有效性 vs 额外状态字段表达已用
options_en: Add a usedCount field on the Ticket to count exits.
Allow repeated billing and only log it.
Remove the entry from activeTickets on success, so the next lookup finds nothing.
Only remove occupiedSpotIds, keeping the ticket around.

scenario: 系统用 durationMillis 表示停车时长，按小时向上取整计费，hourlyRateCents=500。
scenario_en: The system represents parking duration as durationMillis, bills by rounding up to whole hours, and uses hourlyRateCents = 500.
q: computeFee 应该如何处理 2.5 小时这类不足整数小时的时长？
q_en: How should computeFee handle a partial-hour duration such as 2.5 hours?
options: 把算出来的小数 durationHours 四舍五入到最近整数小时
durationMillis 对 3600000 取模，余数 > 0 就 hours+1，再乘费率
忽略不足一小时的余量，只按整除后的小时数收费
用浮点数 durationMillis/3600000.0 直接乘以小时费率
why: 需求是不足一小时也按一小时收费，只有『余数>0则hours+1』能保证任何非零余量都进位；四舍五入和向下取整都会算错 2.5 小时的场景。
why_en: The rule is that any partial hour still bills a full hour, so only the remainder-then-increment check gets a 2.5-hour stay right.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品要求首小时免费或按分钟计费，这段取整逻辑要整体替换。
tradeoff: 余数判断的整数取整 vs 四舍五入或浮点近似
options_en: Round the fractional durationHours to the nearest whole hour.
Take durationMillis modulo 3600000; if the remainder is greater than 0, add one hour before multiplying by the rate.
Ignore the partial-hour remainder and bill only the floored whole hours.
Multiply the raw floating-point durationMillis/3600000.0 by the hourly rate.
codeSample:
computeFee(entryMs, exitMs)
    durationMs = exitMs - entryMs
    hours = durationMs / 3600000
    if durationMs % 3600000 > 0
        hours = hours + 1
    return hours * hourlyRateCents

termDefinitions.meaning: 两数相除后的余数运算，用 % 表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Modulo is the remainder operation after division, written with the % operator.

q: ParkingLot 应处理哪些基础错误？（多选）
q_en: Which base errors should ParkingLot handle? (Select all that apply.)
options: 无兼容空位时拒绝入场
ticketId 空或不存在时拒绝出场
已使用 ticket 再次出场时拒绝
金额用浮点数导致精度误差
why: 前三个是业务错误处理要求，最后一个是实现风险；金额用整数 cents 存储能避开浮点精度问题。
why_en: The design rejects full-lot entry, invalid or reused tickets, and uses integer money to avoid floating-point precision errors.
options_en: Reject entry when no compatible spot is available.
Reject exit when the ticket ID is empty or does not exist.
Reject exit when a used ticket is presented again.
Using floating-point money causes precision drift.

termDefinitions.meaning: 浮点数用二进制近似小数，反复运算会累积微小误差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Floating-point numbers approximate decimals in binary, so repeated arithmetic accumulates small errors.

scenario: VehicleType 和 SpotType 目前都只有 MOTORCYCLE/CAR/LARGE 三个值，取值完全相同。
scenario_en: VehicleType and SpotType currently both contain MOTORCYCLE, CAR, and LARGE, with identical values.
q: 为什么 VehicleType 和 SpotType 即使值相同也要分成两个 enum？
q_en: Why keep VehicleType and SpotType as separate enums even when their values match?
options: 车辆类型和车位类型是不同概念，未来兼容关系可能变化
编程语言不允许两个类复用同一组常量
只是为了增加类的数量，方便面试展示
因为 Ticket 类型上不能存 VehicleType 字段
why: 分开建模让『摩托可停汽车位』这类兼容逻辑更清晰；相同标签不代表两者是同一个领域概念。
why_en: Vehicle type and spot type are different concepts even though their current labels match, which keeps future compatibility rules clean.
tradeoff: 语义分离换未来兼容逻辑的清晰 vs 合并 enum 省一个类型定义
options_en: Vehicle type and spot type are different concepts, and their compatibility rules may diverge later.
The programming language forbids two classes from reusing the same constants.
It is only done to add more classes for the interview to look impressive.
Because Ticket cannot store a VehicleType field.

scenario: ParkingSpot 在当前设计中只表示物理车位的固有属性，不参与占用或计费逻辑。
scenario_en: In the current design, ParkingSpot only represents intrinsic physical spot properties and does not own occupancy or pricing logic.
q: ParkingSpot 需要哪些字段？
q_en: Which fields does ParkingSpot need?
options: occupied boolean、ticket map、hourlyRate
id 和 spotType
entryTime 和 fee
全部 activeTickets 的引用
why: ParkingSpot 是纯数据对象，只保存物理身份和兼容类型；占用和票据由 ParkingLot 管理。
why_en: ParkingSpot stores only intrinsic properties: its ID and spot type.
whenOtherWins: 如果选用实体自管物理占用的方案，可以在 ParkingSpot 上加 occupied/status 字段。
tradeoff: 只存内在属性的纯数据对象 vs 把关系状态也塞进实体
options_en: An occupied boolean, a ticket map, and an hourly rate.
id and spotType.
entryTime and fee.
A reference to every entry in activeTickets.

q: 按顺序排列一次停车会话的状态变化：
q_en: Put one parking session's state changes in order:
steps: findAvailableSpot 找到空车位 B。
occupiedSpotIds 加入 B。
创建 Ticket(T123,B,CAR,entryTime) 并放入 activeTickets。
exit(T123) 计算 fee。
occupiedSpotIds 删除 B，activeTickets 删除 T123。
why: 同一会话由 occupiedSpotIds 和 activeTickets 两个索引共同表达，出场必须同时清理两者。
why_en: A parking session claims a spot, stores a ticket, computes a fee on exit, and clears both indexes together.
tradeoff: 双索引同步表达一次会话 vs 单一来源每次动态推导
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Gate
  participant Lot
  participant Ticket
  Gate->>Lot: enter(CAR)
  Lot->>Lot: claim spot B
  Lot->>Ticket: create T123
  Gate->>Lot: exit(T123)
  Lot->>Lot: fee and release B

termDefinitions.meaning: 为了快速查找而额外维护的数据结构，需要和源数据保持同步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An index is extra data maintained purely to make lookups fast, and it must stay in sync with the source data.

scenario: Ticket 已经发给用户，后续会用来计费和释放车位。
scenario_en: The ticket has already been issued to the user and will later be used for billing and releasing the spot.
q: Ticket 字段应如何设计？
q_en: How should Ticket fields be designed?
options: 允许用户修改 entryTime
让 ParkingSpot 反过来修改 ticketId
构造后只读，不暴露任何修改方法
每次出场前随机重写 spotId
why: Ticket 是会话记录，应稳定反映入场事实；不可变让计费和验证更可靠，避免被意外篡改。
why_en: Ticket should be immutable because it records the facts of the parking session and must stay reliable for billing and validation.
whenOtherWins: 如果未来要支持改签停车时段，才需要给 Ticket 加受控的状态转换方法，而不是暴露 setter。
tradeoff: 不可变记录保证计费可靠 vs 可变字段带来的一致性风险
options_en: Allow the user to modify entryTime.
Let ParkingSpot modify the ticketId in return.
Read-only after construction, with no exposed mutation methods.
Randomly rewrite spotId before every exit.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对象创建后字段不能再被修改。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An immutable object cannot have its fields changed after it is created.

scenario: 后续要求 motorcycle 3 美元/小时，car 5 美元/小时，large 8 美元/小时。
scenario_en: A later requirement sets different hourly rates: motorcycle $3, car $5, and large vehicle $8.
q: 最简单合理的扩展方式是什么？
q_en: What is the simplest reasonable extension?
options: 立刻抽出 PricingStrategy 接口，为单一规则做多态扩展
让 Ticket 自己保存三档价格并在内部计算费用
为每个 SpotType 分别实例化一整个 ParkingLot 系统
ParkingLot 存 Map<VehicleType,rate>，computeFee 按车型查表
why: 只有按车型不同费率这一条规则时，一个 map 就足够简单；Strategy 模式留给更复杂、可动态替换的定价规则。
why_en: A map from vehicle type to hourly rate is enough for simple per-type pricing, without introducing a strategy interface.
whenOtherWins: 如果要支持动态定价、折扣、会员或节假日策略，PricingStrategy 才更合适。
tradeoff: 按车型查表的简单扩展 vs 提前上 Strategy 模式的过度设计
options_en: Introduce a PricingStrategy interface right away for a single rule.
Let the Ticket store all three price tiers and compute its own fee.
Instantiate a whole separate ParkingLot per SpotType.
ParkingLot stores a Map<VehicleType, rate> and computeFee looks it up.

termDefinitions.meaning: 键值对集合，这里键是 VehicleType，值是对应费率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Map<K,V> stores key-value pairs — here the key is a vehicle type and the value is its hourly rate.

scenario: 当前需求只有一条简单的『所有车型同一 hourly rate』定价规则，没有折扣或动态定价。
scenario_en: The current requirement has only one simple pricing rule: the same hourly rate for every vehicle type, with no discounts or dynamic pricing.
q: 为什么基础需求下不一开始就抽 PricingStrategy？
q_en: Why not introduce PricingStrategy at the start for the base requirement?
options: 只有一个简单 hourly rule，提前抽象违反 YAGNI
Strategy pattern 在任何场景下都不好用
Ticket 对象无法传给策略对象
费用计算逻辑不需要写测试
why: 抽象要为真实存在的变化付费；当前只有单一计费规则，直接在 ParkingLot.computeFee 里实现更直接。
why_en: A pricing strategy is premature when the only requirement is one simple hourly rule, which is exactly what YAGNI warns against.
tradeoff: 为当下唯一规则保持直接实现 vs 为假设的未来复杂度提前抽象
options_en: There is only one simple hourly rule, so abstracting early violates YAGNI.
The Strategy pattern is never useful in any scenario.
A Ticket object cannot be passed into a strategy object.
Fee-calculation logic does not need tests.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不要为还不存在的需求提前构建抽象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: YAGNI means you should not build abstraction for a requirement that does not exist yet.

scenario: 后续扩展为 10 层商场停车楼。
scenario_en: The design later expands to a ten-floor shopping-mall parking garage.
q: 最自然的新增实体是什么？
q_en: What is the most natural new entity?
options: 把 floorNumber 塞进 hourlyRate 字段里编码
每层建一个独立系统，且不能共享 ticket
ParkingFloor：ParkingLot 持有 floors，Floor 持有 spots
直接删除 ParkingSpot，改用坐标数组
why: ParkingFloor 是 ParkingLot 和 ParkingSpot 之间自然的容器层，spotId 可以顺便携带楼层信息，如 3-A15。
why_en: A multi-floor garage introduces ParkingFloor as a container between ParkingLot and ParkingSpot.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需显示楼层而没有楼层级别的逻辑，也可以把 floorNumber 直接放在 ParkingSpot 上。
tradeoff: 新增中间层容器 vs 把楼层信息硬塞进不相关字段
options_en: Encode floorNumber inside the hourlyRate field.
Build an independent system per floor that cannot share tickets.
ParkingFloor: ParkingLot holds floors, and each floor holds spots.
Delete ParkingSpot entirely and use a coordinate array instead.

q: 多层扩展后可采用哪些车位分配策略？（多选）
q_en: Which spot-allocation strategies can a multi-floor extension use? (Select all that apply.)
options: 低楼层优先分配
按各层可用车位数量做均衡分配
按目的地或入口距离选择楼层
永远随机选择离入口最远的楼层
why: 不同策略优化不同体验：靠近出口、避免单层拥堵、或靠近目的地；复杂到一定程度可以抽 AllocationStrategy。
why_en: Multi-floor allocation can prioritize lower floors, balance capacity across floors, or optimize for destination proximity.
options_en: Fill lower floors first.
Balance allocation by the number of available spots per floor.
Choose a floor by destination or entrance proximity.
Always randomly pick the floor farthest from the entrance.

scenario: 多个入口同时调用 enter(CAR)，两个线程都看到同一个 spot 空闲。
scenario_en: Multiple entrances call enter(CAR) at the same time, and two threads both see the same spot as free.
q: 这是哪类问题，最简单的修复方式是什么？
q_en: What kind of problem is this, and what is the simplest fix?
options: 内存泄漏问题；重启服务进程就能解决
check-then-act race；同步整个 enter 关键区
浮点精度误差问题；把金额改成整数 cents
路径解析错误；改用 resolvePath 工具函数
why: findAvailableSpot 和 occupiedSpotIds.add 必须原子化。同步整个 enter 足够简单，且停车场入场吞吐通常远低于锁能处理的量级。
why_en: Concurrent entries can race between finding and claiming a spot, so the critical section should be synchronized as a whole.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有单一入口，本来就不存在并发，加锁没有必要。
tradeoff: 简单的方法级锁 vs 更细粒度但更复杂的并发方案
options_en: A memory leak; restarting the service process fixes it.
A check-then-act race; synchronize the whole enter critical section.
A floating-point precision bug; switch money to integer cents.
A path-parsing error; switch to a resolvePath utility function.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先检查条件再执行动作，中间如果被其他线程插入就会产生竞态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Check-then-act means checking a condition and then acting on it, which races if another thread intervenes in between.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次只能被一个线程执行的代码区域。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A critical section is a block of code that only one thread may execute at a time.

scenario: 实现多入口并发下的入场分配。
scenario_en: The entry allocation must work correctly when multiple entrances operate concurrently.
q: 这段 synchronized 锁的作用是什么？
q_en: What does this synchronized lock do?
codeSample:
enter(vehicleType)
    synchronized(this)
        spot = findAvailableSpot(vehicleType)
        if spot == null throw NoSpace
        occupiedSpotIds.add(spot.id)
        ticket = Ticket(generateId(), spot.id, vehicleType, now())
        activeTickets[ticket.id] = ticket
        return ticket
options: 只保护 fee 计算这一步
故意让两个入口拿到同一个 spot
替代 ticketId 的生成逻辑
把查找空位、占用和保存 ticket 做成一个原子操作
why: 锁住整个关键区能防止两个线程分配同一车位；这个粒度在停车场规模下通常足够。
why_en: The lock makes spot search, claim, and ticket creation atomic across entrances, preventing two threads from claiming the same spot.
whenOtherWins: 如果持久化到数据库，应改用事务和唯一约束，或 SELECT FOR UPDATE，而不是内存锁。
tradeoff: 粗粒度互斥保证正确 vs 更高并发但更复杂的方案
options_en: It only protects the fee-calculation step.
It deliberately lets two entrances claim the same spot.
It replaces ticket ID generation logic.
It makes spot search, claim, and ticket save one atomic operation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 要么完整执行，要么完全不执行，不会被其他线程看到中间状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An atomic operation either completes fully or not at all, with no other thread able to observe a partial result.

termDefinitions.meaning: 互斥锁，同一时刻只允许一个线程进入被保护的代码块。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A mutex lock allows only one thread at a time to enter the protected section of code.

scenario: 想让多个入口并发搜索空位，只在真正占用车位时短暂互斥。
scenario_en: We want multiple entrances to search for free spots concurrently and only take a short exclusive lock when claiming a spot.
q: 支持并发搜索、只在占用时短暂独占的更细粒度方案是什么？
q_en: What finer-grained approach supports concurrent search and short exclusive claiming?
options: 读锁搜索，写锁内 double-check 后占用，冲突则重试
完全不加任何锁，读写都自由进行
只锁 activeTickets，不锁 occupiedSpotIds
给每个 ticket 单独分配一把锁
why: 读写锁允许多个搜索并行，但 read 和 write 之间可能被别的线程抢先，所以写锁内要二次检查后再占用。
why_en: A read-write approach searches concurrently, then double-checks and claims the spot under the write lock, retrying on conflict.
whenOtherWins: 对 3-5 个入口的普通停车场，方法级互斥更简单，性能也已经足够。
tradeoff: 读写锁提高并发但要 double-check vs 单一互斥锁简单但完全串行
options_en: Search under a read lock, then double-check and claim under a write lock, retrying on conflict.
Use no locking at all for reads or writes.
Lock only activeTickets and leave occupiedSpotIds unlocked.
Give every ticket its own separate lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 允许多个读操作并发进行，但写操作需要独占访问的锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read-write lock lets multiple readers run concurrently but gives a writer exclusive access.

q: 按顺序排列多入口 race 的发生过程：
q_en: Put the multi-entrance race in order:
steps: 入口 A 和 B 同时调用 findAvailableSpot。
二者都看到 spot B 不在 occupiedSpotIds 里。
A 创建 ticket 指向 spot B。
B 也创建 ticket 指向 spot B。
两辆车拿到了同一个车位。
why: 问题窗口在『检查空闲』和『写入占用』之间；必须把两步合并成同一个临界区才能消除这个 race。
why_en: The race occurs because two entrances observe the same free spot before either one claims it, so the check and the claim must become one critical section.
tradeoff: 分离的检查与占用步骤 vs 合并成一个原子临界区
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A as Gate A
  participant S as spot B
  participant B as Gate B
  A->>S: sees free
  B->>S: sees free
  A->>S: claim
  B->>S: claim

termDefinitions.meaning: 多线程同时读写共享状态导致结果依赖执行顺序的错误。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A race condition happens when concurrent threads read and write shared state and the outcome depends on timing.

scenario: 停车场有 3-5 个入口，单次 enter 处理约 100 毫秒；200 个车位平均每 2 小时周转一次。
scenario_en: The lot has 3 to 5 entrances, one enter call takes about 100 ms, and 200 spots turn over about once every 2 hours on average.
q: 为什么同步整个 enter() 方法在现实停车场规模下通常足够？
q_en: Why is synchronizing the whole enter() method usually enough at real parking-lot scale?
options: 因为加锁本身会让车位的物理数量凭空增加
因为这类题目里假设停车场永远只有一个车位
因为 ticket map 的按 ID 查找本身非常慢
入场频率远低于锁可处理的吞吐，车通过闸机/支付耗时远大于内存操作
why: 工程取舍要看数量级：停车场的真实入场频率很低，简单正确的方案应该优先于过早优化。
why_en: A coarse enter lock is usually fine because parking-lot arrival rates are tiny compared with in-memory critical-section throughput.
tradeoff: 按数量级判断是否需要优化 vs 不看数量级就上复杂并发方案
options_en: Because locking itself somehow makes the physical spot count grow.
Because this kind of problem always assumes only one spot exists.
Because ticket-map lookup by ID is itself extremely slow.
Arrival frequency is far below what the lock can handle, since gate and payment time dwarf in-memory work.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单位时间内系统能处理的请求数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Throughput is the number of requests a system can process per unit of time.

scenario: 有人说 Node.js 单线程就完全不会有 race condition。
scenario_en: Someone claims Node.js is single-threaded, so race conditions cannot happen at all.
q: 面对这个说法应该如何回应？
q_en: How should you respond to that claim?
options: 单线程模型下永远不会出现逻辑上的 race
异步 await 之间仍可能交错，持久化时要靠数据库事务或分布式锁保证原子性
Node.js 本身就不适合实现停车场系统
只要用 Set 存状态就自动获得事务保证
why: 单线程事件循环避免了同一时刻执行两段 JS，但异步 I/O 会在 await 点把请求流程切开，数据库层仍要保证 check-and-claim 原子。
why_en: Single-threaded event loops can still interleave async workflows at await points, so persistence still needs transactional protection.
whenOtherWins: 如果所有状态更新都在同一个不跨越 await 的同步代码块里，才真的不需要额外加锁。
tradeoff: 单线程避免同一时刻双执行 vs 异步交错仍需事务或分布式锁
options_en: A single-threaded model can never have a logical race.
Async await points can still interleave, so persistence needs database transactions or a distributed lock.
Node.js is simply unsuited for building a parking-lot system.
Storing state in a Set automatically gives you transaction guarantees.

termDefinitions.meaning: Node.js 单线程调度模型，在 I/O 等待点切换执行其他任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The event loop is Node.js's single-threaded scheduler that switches to other work while one task waits on I/O.

termDefinitions.meaning: 跨多个进程或服务器协调、只允许一个持有者继续执行的锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distributed lock coordinates across multiple processes or servers so only one holder can proceed at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库锁定被查询的行，防止其他事务并发修改它们。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SELECT FOR UPDATE locks the selected database rows so no other transaction can modify them concurrently.

scenario: ticketId 从未存在过，或者已经出场使用过一次。
scenario_en: The ticketId either never existed or was already used once at exit.
q: 基础 exit 应该对这两种情况返回什么语义？
q_en: What semantic result should base exit return for these two cases?
options: 必须区分成两个不同的复杂错误码
自动为用户重新发一张新 ticket
两种情况统一视为 invalid ticket
照常释放一个任意车位再报错
why: activeTickets 只表示当前有效票据集合，不存在和已使用对出场流程都是不可用，没必要区分。
why_en: A ticket not present in activeTickets is invalid whether it never existed or was already used, so exit treats them the same.
whenOtherWins: 如果客服或审计需要区分这两种情况，可以额外保存历史 used tickets 和状态。
tradeoff: 统一 invalid 语义换实现简单 vs 区分两种错误换更精确反馈
options_en: The two cases must be distinguished with two different complex error codes.
Automatically issue the user a brand-new ticket.
Treat both cases uniformly as an invalid ticket.
Free some arbitrary spot anyway before reporting an error.

scenario: 后续要支持车位维修或临时封闭。
scenario_en: A later requirement adds spot maintenance or temporary closure.
q: 在当前占用建模（occupiedSpotIds Set）下，新增维修状态最自然放在哪里？
q_en: With the current occupiedSpotIds Set model, where should maintenance state go?
options: ParkingSpot 加 status 字段，或 ParkingLot 加 disabledSpotIds 过滤
在 Ticket 记录上增加一个记录维修人员姓名和联系方式的字段
往 VehicleType 这个车辆分类 enum 里新增一个 BROKEN 取值
把这个车位的 hourlyRate 计费字段直接改成 0 表示不可用
why: 维修是车位自身或可用性约束，不是 ticket 会话的一部分；基础设计没有实现，但可以沿分配过滤自然扩展。
why_en: Maintenance can be modeled as spot status or a disabled-spot-ID set that allocation simply skips.
whenOtherWins: 如果车位物理状态很多，ParkingSpot.status enum 更适合；只是临时屏蔽少数车位，用 disabled set 更轻量。
tradeoff: 维护性状态放进车位可用性过滤 vs 混进车辆分类或计价字段
options_en: Add a status field to ParkingSpot, or a disabledSpotIds filter on ParkingLot.
Add a field on the Ticket record storing the maintenance worker's name and contact info.
Add a new BROKEN value into the VehicleType vehicle-classification enum.
Change that spot's hourlyRate billing field directly to zero to mark it unusable.

scenario: 监控或前端目前都没有提出『查询实时车位状态』的需求。
scenario_en: Neither monitoring nor the frontend currently requires querying real-time spot status.
q: 为什么基础 API 不主动加 getAvailableSpots 或 getParkingStatus？
q_en: Why should the base API not proactively add getAvailableSpots or getParkingStatus?
options: 这两个方法在技术上根本无法实现
需求没有要求，暴露内部状态会扩大 API；监控需求来了再加
加了这两个方法会破坏 ticketId 的唯一性
使用者必须提前知道全部车位信息
why: 接口应该围绕核心工作流最小化；过早暴露内部集合会增加耦合，等真正的监控需求出现再加不迟。
why_en: The base API stays focused on entry and exit until status queries are explicitly required, to avoid premature coupling.
tradeoff: 接口按需最小化 vs 提前暴露内部状态换『可能有用』
options_en: These two methods are technically impossible to implement.
There is no requirement for them, and exposing internal state widens the API; add them when monitoring is actually needed.
Adding them would break the uniqueness of ticketId.
Callers must already know the full spot inventory in advance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只暴露必要的公开接口，隐藏内部实现细节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Encapsulation means exposing only the necessary public interface while hiding internal implementation details.

q: 出场计费的正确执行顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct order for exit fee calculation?
steps: 从 activeTickets 取出 ticket。
计算 exitTime - entryTime。
按小时向上取整。
乘以 hourlyRateCents。
释放 spot 并删除 ticket。
why: 必须先有 ticket 才能知道 entryTime 和 spotId；删除 ticket 前要先取够计费和释放所需的数据。
why_en: Exit fee calculation uses the active ticket's entry time, rounds duration up, multiplies by the rate, and only then clears state.
tradeoff: 先读后清理保证数据完整 vs 先清理导致计费数据丢失

scenario: 所有 car spotId 都已经在 occupiedSpotIds 中，此时来了一辆车，车辆类型为 CAR。
scenario_en: All car spot IDs are already in occupiedSpotIds, and now a CAR arrives.
q: enter(CAR) 应该如何处理？
q_en: How should enter(CAR) behave?
options: 发一张 ticket，但 spotId 留空
拒绝入场，且不创建 ticket
临时占用一个 motorcycle spot
把最早入场的旧 ticket 强制删除
why: 没有兼容空位时不能创建停车会话；创建一张没有 spot 的 ticket 会破坏 exit 释放逻辑的不变量。
why_en: Entry must fail without creating a ticket when no compatible spot is available.
whenOtherWins: 如果支持候补排队，可以创建一个 WaitingRequest，但那不是基础 ticket 流程。
tradeoff: 无空位时拒绝并保持状态不变 vs 创建残缺 ticket 破坏不变量
options_en: Issue a ticket but leave spotId empty.
Reject entry and create no ticket at all.
Temporarily occupy a motorcycle spot instead.
Force-remove the oldest active ticket to make room.

scenario: 多层停车楼希望根据不同目标（靠近出口/均衡/靠近目的地）选择不同分配策略。
scenario_en: A multi-floor garage wants to switch allocation policies based on goals such as nearest exit, load balancing, or destination proximity.
q: 何时应该引入 AllocationStrategy？
q_en: When should AllocationStrategy be introduced?
options: 单层 exact-match 场景一开始就必须引入
当 Ticket 没有 entryTime 字段时
当金额改用 cents 存储时
当分配规则会在低楼层优先、均衡、目的地接近等策略间切换时
why: Strategy 模式适合真实存在、可能被替换的算法；基础单一规则下直接实现更简洁。
why_en: AllocationStrategy earns its complexity when spot-selection policy genuinely varies and needs to be swapped.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有单层、单一规则，不必引入 Strategy，直接 inline 实现更清楚。
tradeoff: 真实可替换算法才上 Strategy vs 单一规则直接内联实现
options_en: The single-floor exact-match case must introduce it right away.
When the Ticket has no entryTime field.
When money switches to storing cents.
When allocation policy genuinely switches among lowest-floor-first, balanced, and destination-proximity strategies.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["one simple allocation rule"] --> B["inline method"]
  C["multiple changing policies"] --> D["AllocationStrategy"]
  D --> E["nearest, cheapest, level aware"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把可替换的算法封装成独立类，运行时可以互换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Strategy pattern encapsulates interchangeable algorithms as separate classes that can be swapped at runtime.

q: 补全三类对象的职责：
q_en: Fill in the responsibilities of the three object types:
text: ParkingLot 管 {{分配、activeTickets、occupiedSpotIds、计费}}；ParkingSpot 管 {{id 和 spotType}}；Ticket 管 {{ticketId、spotId、vehicleType、entryTime}}。
why: 职责边界清晰后，入场和出场流程都变成 orchestrator 对简单记录和物理资源的协调。
why_en: ParkingLot owns workflows and indexes, ParkingSpot owns intrinsic spot properties, and Ticket records a session.

q: Senior 级 Parking Lot 回答应主动覆盖哪些技术要点？（多选）
q_en: Which technical points should a senior-level Parking Lot answer cover proactively? (Select all that apply.)
options: Vehicle 不建实体的理由
occupied flag / derived / Set 三种方案的权衡
Ticket 用 map 按 ID 查找的理由
金额用整数 cents 存储
多入口并发 race 的成因和加锁方案
why: 高级答案要能主动解释状态归属、数据结构选择和并发正确性，而不仅仅是列出类图。
why_en: Senior answers explain entity pruning, occupancy tradeoffs, ticket lookup, integer money, and multi-entrance races without being prompted.
options_en: Why Vehicle is not modeled as an entity.
The tradeoffs among flag, derived, and Set approaches to occupancy.
Why Ticket lookup uses a map keyed by ID.
Storing money as integer cents.
The cause of multi-entrance races and how to lock against them.

q: 按顺序排列 Parking Lot 的主设计链路：
q_en: Put the main Parking Lot design argument in order:
steps: ParkingLot 作为入口，持有 spots、occupiedSpotIds、activeTickets、hourlyRateCents。
澄清三类车、自动兼容分配、ticket、出场计费和释放。
Vehicle 降级为 enum，Ticket 建成不可变会话记录。
占用建模为 ParkingLot 维护的关系索引 Set。
enter/exit 分别原子维护 ticket 和 occupied spot 状态。
why: 从范围澄清到实体裁剪，再到状态归属和流程不变量，是这道题的主要论证路径。
why_en: The design chain moves from scoped requirements to entity pruning, orchestrator state, occupancy indexing, and lifecycle updates.
tradeoff: 范围裁剪先行再定状态归属 vs 一上来就画类图

scenario: 系统需要同时用 occupiedSpotIds 和 activeTickets 两个索引描述同一次停车会话，两者必须保持同步。
scenario_en: The system uses both occupiedSpotIds and activeTickets to describe the same parking session, and the two indexes must stay in sync.
q: 面试收尾时，哪一句最准确地总结这个不变量？
q_en: Which closing sentence best summarizes this invariant in an interview?
options: 系统里每一辆进出过的车，都必须对应一个持久化保存状态的 Vehicle 实体类
active ticket 指向的 spotId 必须在 occupiedSpotIds 中；成功 exit 后二者都要被删除
所有车位的编号命名必须在整个停车场范围内按楼层严格连续排序
所有发出的 ticket 只要生成成功就永久有效，理论上永远不会失效或过期
why: ParkingLot 用两个索引表达同一会话；入场同时创建两者，出场同时清理两者，才能避免重复出场或重复分配。
why_en: The key invariant is that active tickets and occupied spot IDs stay in sync for every parking session.
whenOtherWins: 如果从 activeTickets 推导 occupancy，就不需要维护 Set，但分配时要保护对 tickets 的读取和修改。
tradeoff: 双索引同步的不变量 vs 单一来源但需要每次重新推导
options_en: Every vehicle that has ever entered must have a persisted, stateful Vehicle entity class.
The spotId an active ticket points to must be in occupiedSpotIds, and a successful exit removes both.
Spot numbers must be strictly and continuously sorted by floor across the entire lot.
Every issued ticket stays valid forever once created, theoretically never expiring or timing out.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在任何时刻都必须保持成立的约束。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An invariant is a condition the system must always keep true.

scenario: 面试官按中级候选人的标准评估这道 Parking Lot 设计。
scenario_en: The interviewer evaluates this Parking Lot design at the mid-level candidate bar.
q: 中级候选人在本题应能稳定说明什么？
q_en: What should a mid-level candidate be able to explain reliably in this problem?
options: 必须一次性实现多层楼分配策略并处理跨楼层并发锁
必须使用数据库事务和 SELECT FOR UPDATE 来保证一致性
必须把 Vehicle 建成完整类并存车主、车牌信息
ParkingLot 编排、ParkingSpot 存属性、Ticket 是记录，能处理三类边界情况
why: 中级重点是职责清晰和关键边界情况；多层策略和并发多入口是高级候选人再深入的部分。
why_en: A mid-level answer should clearly separate ParkingLot, ParkingSpot, and Ticket and handle the key entry and exit edge cases.
tradeoff: 中级看职责分离与边界情况 vs 高级才要求的并发/多层深挖
options_en: Implement multi-floor allocation and cross-floor concurrency locking in one pass.
Use database transactions and SELECT FOR UPDATE to guarantee consistency.
Build Vehicle as a full class storing owner and license-plate information.
ParkingLot orchestrates, ParkingSpot stores properties, Ticket is a record, and it handles the three key edge cases.

scenario: entryTime 和 exitTime 相同，车辆几乎立刻出场。
scenario_en: entryTime and exitTime are the same because the vehicle exits almost immediately.
q: 按『hourly rounded up』规则，durationMillis 为 0 时应如何思考？
q_en: Under an hourly-rounded-up rule, how should you reason about durationMillis = 0?
options: 永远收 0，不追问产品是否需要设定最低消费门槛
永远收 24 小时，把这种情况当成整天处理
是否收 0 或 1 小时要先向产品澄清；非零但不足一小时仍向上收 1 小时
认为这种边界情况在数学上根本无法算出费用
why: 计费规则强调部分小时向上取整，但 0 分钟是否有最低收费属于产品语义，面试中应该主动澄清或明确定义，而不是自己假设。
why_en: Partial hours clearly round up, but the exact zero-duration minimum charge is a product rule that should be clarified rather than assumed.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务明确规定最低一小时收费，那么 duration 为 0 时也直接返回一小时的费用。
tradeoff: 边界语义需要产品澄清 vs 默认套用向上取整规则
options_en: Always charge 0 without asking product whether a minimum charge applies.
Always charge 24 hours, treating this edge case as a full day.
Clarify with product whether 0 or 1 hour applies; any nonzero partial hour still rounds up to 1.
Claim this edge case is mathematically impossible to bill at all.

termDefinitions.meaning: 无论实际使用多短，至少收取的费用下限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A minimum charge is the smallest fee charged regardless of how briefly the resource was used.

把无行为输入硬建成实体。
optionScenarioImpacts: 面试官能看到类边界、委派路径和状态所有者。
会漏掉 RateLimiter/Factory/Limiter 的职责拆分。
会偏离基础 LLD，且无法解释单机状态边界。
会增加空壳类，反而模糊状态归属。
optionDirectness: 适合中级目标：稳定讲出主设计而不是堆高级话题。
算法名只在解释具体取舍时有用。
Redis 脚本适合分布式扩展题，不是基础答案核心。
Client 有套餐、身份生命周期时才值得建实体。
optionMeanings_en: It explains entry point, creation, and algorithm state ownership.
This mistakes the goal for memorizing algorithm names.
This turns a single-node object design into a distributed scripting task.
This forces behavior-free input into an entity.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The interviewer sees class boundaries, delegation, and state ownership.
It misses the RateLimiter/Factory/Limiter responsibility split.
It drifts away from base LLD and still misses local state ownership.
It adds empty classes and blurs where state lives.
optionDirectness_en: Fits the mid-level goal: explain the main design without piling on advanced topics.
Algorithm names matter only when explaining a concrete tradeoff.
Redis scripts fit the distributed extension, not the base answer.
Client deserves an entity only when it has plan or identity lifecycle.

scenario: 一个小站点刚从单机变成几万用户，Web 请求和数据库查询互相抢 CPU、内存和连接数。
scenario_en: A small site has outgrown one machine, and web requests now compete with database queries for CPU, memory, and connections.
q: 第一步应该拆出哪一层？
q_en: Which layer should you split out first?
options: 把 Web 层和数据库层拆到不同机器
先把所有数据搬到 CDN
把每个请求都放进消息队列
把所有表立即分片
options_en: Move the web tier and database tier onto separate machines
Move all data to a CDN first
Put every request through a message queue
Shard every table immediately
why: 我会先拆 Web 和数据库，因为两层的瓶颈不同，拆开后才能分别扩容和排障。代价是多一次网络访问，也要开始管理跨机器连接。
why_en: I would split web and database first because they hit different bottlenecks and need to scale independently.
whenOtherWins: 如果瓶颈只是图片、JS、CSS 下载慢，CDN 会先赢；如果数据库单表已经放不下，分片才提前出现。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client[Client] --> Web[Web tier]
Web --> DB[(Database tier)]

termDefinitions.meaning: 处理 HTTP 请求、业务逻辑和 API 响应的一层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The web tier handles HTTP requests, business logic, and API responses.

termDefinitions.meaning: 负责持久化读写数据的一层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The database tier persists and serves application data.

termDefinitions.meaning: CDN 是把静态内容缓存到边缘节点的分发网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN is an edge network that caches and serves static content.

termDefinitions.meaning: 消息队列保存待处理消息，让生产者和消费者异步解耦。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A message queue stores work items so producers and consumers can run asynchronously.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分片把数据按 key 拆到多个存储节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sharding partitions data by key across multiple storage nodes.

optionMeanings: Web/DB 拆层是把请求处理和持久化资源隔离。
CDN 缓存静态资源，不承载数据库查询。
消息队列适合异步任务，不适合包住每个同步读请求。
分片把表按 key 拆开，是更晚的容量手段。
optionDirectness: 单机上 Web 和 DB 争 CPU、连接时先做。
图片、JS、CSS 下载慢或源站带宽贵时更合适。
照片处理、发通知这类可延迟任务更合适。
单表容量或写入吞吐已经到顶时才上。
optionScenarioImpacts: 两层可以分别扩容和排障，但多一次网络访问。
不会解决数据库和 Web 进程互抢资源。
会增加同步请求延迟，还没拆掉资源竞争。
过早引入跨片查询、迁移和路由复杂度。
tradeoff: 按层独立扩容 vs 跨机器网络和连接管理

scenario: 订单系统需要事务、表之间关联查询、报表 join，数据模型比较稳定。
scenario_en: An order system needs transactions, relational joins, reporting queries, and a fairly stable data model.
q: 这个场景优先选哪类数据库？
q_en: Which database family fits this scenario first?
options: 关系型数据库
文档数据库
图数据库
纯对象存储
options_en: Relational database
Document database
Graph database
Object storage only
why: 我会先选关系型数据库，因为事务和 join 是它的主场。NoSQL 可以后补到日志、画像或超大规模非关系数据上。
why_en: A relational database is the first fit because this workload depends on transactions and joins.
tradeoff: 事务和 join vs schema 弹性和横向扩展
whenOtherWins: 如果数据主要是无固定结构的 JSON 文档，且查询不依赖跨表 join，文档数据库会更顺。

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构化查询语言，用来查询和修改关系型数据库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SQL is the language used to query and modify relational databases.

termDefinitions.meaning: 泛指非传统关系模型的数据存储，如键值、文档、列族、图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NoSQL describes non-relational stores such as key-value, document, column-family, and graph databases.

scenario: 两个 Web 服务器都能处理同一类无状态请求。你希望一台挂掉时，用户还能访问服务。
scenario_en: Two web servers can handle the same stateless requests, and users should still reach the service if one server fails.
q: 入口层应该加什么？
q_en: What should you add at the entry point?
options: 负载均衡器
只加更大的数据库
客户端手动选择服务器
给每个用户固定一个独立域名
options_en: A load balancer
Only a larger database
Let clients pick servers manually
Give each user a dedicated domain
why: 负载均衡器把客户端从具体 Web 机器上解耦，健康检查失败后可以把流量切到其他机器。但它自己也要做冗余，否则入口会变成新单点。
