options: 帕累托分布：少数商品占大部分关注
商品访问量完全均匀分布
长尾商品反而最值得优先爬取
价格变化服从正态分布
why: 既然采集资源天然有限，就该把配额砸在少数高关注商品上；帕累托规律保证了这样做能用一小部分资源覆盖绝大部分用户价值。
why_en: Product popularity follows a Pareto distribution, so a small fraction of products deserves most of the limited crawl budget.
options_en: A Pareto distribution: a small share of products gets most attention.
Product traffic is perfectly uniform.
Long-tail products are actually the highest priority.
Price changes follow a normal distribution.

termDefinitions.meaning: 少数个体占据绝大多数份额的分布规律，俗称二八法则。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Pareto distribution is where a small fraction of items account for the large majority of the total, often called the 80/20 rule.

scenario: 爬取配额有限，要给 5 亿商品排出检查频率，先决定哪个信号权重最高。
scenario_en: With limited crawl budget, you must rank check frequency across 500 million products — start by deciding which signal should weigh the most.
q: 最高优先级应该给哪类商品？
q_en: Which category of products should get the highest priority?
options: 上架时间最早的商品
订阅数最高的商品，用户在主动等更新
价格最贵的商品
完全随机轮换保证公平
why: 订阅数是最强的用户意图信号：有人设了阈值等降价，更新价值最高；站内搜索频次次之，表示兴趣但还没订阅。
why_en: Products with many active price-drop subscriptions get top priority because users are literally waiting for those updates.
whenOtherWins: 对还没有任何兴趣信号的新品，订阅数信号失效，要靠插件上报和类目页爬取来补盲。
tradeoff: 用户主动意图信号 vs 无差别公平轮询
options_en: The oldest products by listing date.
Products with the most subscriptions; users are actively waiting.
The most expensive products.
Fully random rotation to keep things fair.

q: 优先级打分系统会采用哪些输入信号？（多选）
q_en: Which input signals does the priority scoring system use? (multi-select)
options: 商品的降价订阅数量
用户在本站的搜索频次
商品标题的长度
通知被点击/促成购买后的反馈加成
why: 订阅量和搜索频次代表当下的用户兴趣；通知点击/转化的反馈回路让「有效的更新」自我强化，把资源持续聚焦到最有价值的商品上。
why_en: Priority scores come from subscription counts, on-site search frequency, and a feedback loop that boosts products whose notifications drive clicks or purchases.
options_en: The number of price-drop subscriptions on a product.
How often users search for it on the site.
The length of the product title.
A feedback boost when notifications drive clicks or purchases.

scenario: 优先级打分把商品分成几档，各档配不同的检查频率。
scenario_en: Priority scoring buckets products into tiers, and each tier gets a different check frequency.
q: 补全分层爬取的节奏：
q_en: Fill in the tiered crawling cadence:
text: 分层爬取节奏：高关注商品每{{几小时}}检查一次，中等关注{{每天}}更新一次，低关注{{每周}}甚至更低频。
why: 这些频率是调度档位，不是精确公式：高关注几小时、中等每天、冷门每周。它们把有限请求预算从长尾挪到最影响通知价值的商品。
why_en: These cadences are scheduling tiers, moving limited crawl budget toward products that most affect alert value.

q: 纯优先级爬取方案的根本盲区是什么？
q_en: What is the fundamental blind spot of a pure priority-crawling design?
options: 老商品从此永远不再更新
数据库容量不足
爬虫成本反而比全量更高
新品/爆款还没兴趣信号，覆盖有空窗
why: 优先级依赖历史兴趣信号，而热门新品发布初期恰恰无人搜索、无人订阅——偏偏这时价格最波动、最需要跟踪，形成致命空窗。
why_en: Priority crawling misses new or suddenly trending products that have not yet built up interest signals, exactly when their prices are most volatile.
options_en: Old products stop being updated forever.
The database runs out of capacity.
Crawling ends up costing more than full coverage.
New or trending items have no interest signal yet, leaving a gap.

scenario: 5 亿商品 + 每 IP 每秒 1 请求的限流让自建爬虫农场经济上不可行；而你的 Chrome 插件装在 100 万个正在浏览 Amazon 的浏览器里。
scenario_en: 500 million products plus a one-request-per-second-per-IP limit makes a self-built crawler farm economically unworkable, while your Chrome extension is installed in one million browsers actively browsing Amazon.
q: 最优雅的数据采集方案是？
q_en: What is the most elegant data-collection design here?
options: 插件用户浏览商品页时自动解析并上报价格
租 10 万台代理服务器硬扛限流
请求 Amazon 开放官方价格 API
只跟踪销量前 1000 的商品
why: 用户浏览行为天然聚焦在最热门的商品页上，插件上报等于免费拿到「按真实关注度加权」的实时价格流，把最大的约束变成了竞争优势。
why_en: Turning one million extension users into a crowdsourced collection network delivers real-time prices for exactly the products people care about, without fighting Amazon's rate limits.
whenOtherWins: 没有浏览量的冷门类目仍要传统爬虫定期兜底；没有装机量的新产品也用不了这招。
tradeoff: 用户浏览行为的免费众包信号 vs 自建代理农场的基础设施成本
options_en: The extension auto-parses and reports prices as users browse pages.
Rent a hundred thousand proxy servers to power through the limit.
Ask Amazon to open up an official price API.
Only track the top 1,000 best-selling products.

q: Chrome 插件具体是怎么采集价格数据的？
q_en: Specifically, how does the Chrome extension collect price data?
options: 对页面截屏后用 OCR 识别价格
直接读取 Amazon 的内部数据库
解析页面 DOM，提取价格和元数据后上报
抓取用户的历史订单记录
why: 插件在用户浏览时透明运行：DOM 解析出结构化数据发给后端。上报流量天然偏向热门商品，正好符合优先级需求。
why_en: The extension parses the product page DOM to extract structured data like product ID and current price, then reports it to the backend API.
options_en: Screenshot the page and read the price with OCR.
Read directly from Amazon's internal database.
Parse the page DOM and report the extracted price and metadata.
Scrape the user's historical order records.

termDefinitions.meaning: 浏览器把网页解析成的结构化节点树，程序可以从中读取内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The DOM is the structured tree of nodes a browser builds from a page, which code can read to extract content.

q: 引入插件众包后，传统爬虫和新品发现的分工变成什么样？
q_en: After introducing extension crowdsourcing, how does the division of labor between traditional crawling and new-product discovery change?
options: 爬虫彻底下线，全靠插件
爬虫只兜底冷门商品，插件顺带发现新品
爬虫只负责抓商品图片
新品仍然只能人工录入
why: 插件覆盖热门商品并顺带发现新品（未知页面即新商品），爬虫的负担骤降为「补冷门缺口」，两条腿互补成完整方案。
why_en: Crawlers now only cover products the extension has not seen recently, while visits to unknown product pages automatically register new products.
diagram:
graph LR
    Browser[User browser plugin] --> Ingest[Price report API]
    Crawler[Traditional crawler] --> Ingest
    Ingest --> Verify[Trust and verify]
    Verify --> Prices[(Price history)]
    Crawler --> Discovery[New product discovery]
options_en: Crawlers are shut down entirely; rely only on the extension.
Crawlers only backfill cold products; the extension discovers new ones.
Crawlers only fetch product images.
New products are still entered manually.

q: 插件众包采集方案要付出哪些代价？（多选）
q_en: What costs does the extension-crowdsourcing collection design incur? (multi-select)
options: 强依赖用户装机量与浏览模式
完全无法发现新商品
冷门类目浏览稀少，更新稀疏、存在覆盖缺口
用户上报可能被伪造或出错，必须建立校验体系
why: 众包的三大代价：绑定用户规模、冷门覆盖差、数据可信度存疑——其中「上报可能是恶意的」严重到需要单独一个深挖来解决。
why_en: Crowdsourcing depends on user adoption, leaves gaps in niche categories, and above all requires validation because user-submitted prices can be wrong or malicious.
options_en: It strongly depends on the extension's install base and browsing patterns.
It can never discover new products at all.
Niche categories get sparse updates and coverage gaps.
Reports can be forged or wrong, so validation is required.

q: 把「用插件众包解决数据采集」这条 marquee 决策链排成正确顺序：
q_en: Put the marquee decision chain for "solving data collection with extension crowdsourcing" into the correct order:
steps: 缓解：trust-but-verify——可疑上报几分钟内由高优先级爬虫核实
需求：覆盖 5 亿商品，但 Amazon 限流每 IP 约 1 req/s
选型：插件众包上报为主，优先级爬虫兜底冷门商品
代价：用户上报的数据可能是恶意或错误的
洞察：100 万插件用户天然在浏览最热门的商品页
why: 需求（规模 vs 限流）→ 洞察（用户浏览即采集）→ 选型（众包 + 爬虫兜底）→ 代价（数据可信度）→ 缓解（快速核实）。这条链是本题从中级到高级的分水岭。
why_en: The marquee chain runs from the scale-versus-rate-limit requirement, through the insight that extension users already browse hot products, to crowdsourced collection, whose data-trust cost is mitigated by rapid verify crawls.
diagram:
flowchart LR R["需求：5 亿商品
限流 1 req/s/IP"] --> I["洞察：百万插件用户
正在浏览热门商品页"] I --> C["选型：插件众包 +
优先级爬虫兜底"] C --> K["代价：上报可能
恶意或出错"] K --> M["缓解：trust-but-verify
分钟级爬虫核实"]
tradeoff: 众包的免费覆盖 vs 数据可信度的校验成本
whenOtherWins: 如果插件装机量很小、用户浏览覆盖不足，自建优先级爬虫会重新成为主路径，众包只能做补充信号。

q: 有人恶意上报「最新款 iPhone 只卖 $0.01」，若系统直接采信会发生什么？
q_en: If someone maliciously reports "the latest iPhone costs $0.01" and the system trusts it outright, what happens?
options: 数据库因异常值崩溃
大量假通知群发，用户发现受骗，信任受损
Amazon 会立即封禁插件
用户真的能以 $0.01 买到 iPhone
why: 通知系统的价值完全建立在数据准确上：一次大规模假通知就能烧掉长期积累的信任，所以上报校验不是锦上添花而是生死问题。
why_en: A single malicious one-cent iPhone report would blast false alerts to thousands of subscribers and torch the service's credibility, since notification value depends entirely on data accuracy.
options_en: The database crashes because of the outlier value.
Mass false alerts go out; users discover the real price and lose trust.
Amazon immediately bans the extension.
Users can actually buy an iPhone for one cent.

q: 「共识校验」（validate by committee）方案的机制是？
q_en: How does the "consensus validation" (validate by committee) mechanism work?
options: 先挂起，多人报同价才生效
第一个上报立即生效
所有插件上报一律丢弃
只信管理员手动审核
why: 共识表统计时间窗（约 1 小时）内报同一价格的独立用户数，达到阈值才放行；单个坏人凑不齐人数，技术故障也几乎不会同时同样地影响多人。
why_en: Consensus validation holds a reported price as pending until enough independent users report the same change within a time window.
options_en: Hold it pending until multiple people report the same price.
The first report takes effect immediately.
All extension reports are discarded by default.
Only manual admin review is trusted.

termDefinitions.meaning: 需要多少个独立用户报出同一价格，系统才认定这次变价可信。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The consensus threshold is how many independent users must report the same price before the system trusts the change.

scenario: 共识校验方案里，热门商品约需 3 个独立确认、冷门商品约 2 个，统计时间窗约 1 小时；iPhone 降价 $500 这类高影响变价会提高到 5 个确认。
scenario_en: In consensus validation, popular products need roughly three independent confirmations and niche ones two, within about a one-hour window, rising to five confirmations for a high-impact change like a $500 iPhone price drop.
q: 补全共识阈值的设计原则：
q_en: Fill in the design principle behind the consensus threshold:
text: 确认门槛不是固定值，而要按{{商品影响力}}（订阅量、降价幅度）动态{{升高或降低}}，因为误报的代价和影响力{{成正比}}。
why: 阈值不是一刀切：订阅越多、降幅越大，误报的爆炸半径越大，就要求越多确认；小额变动放低门槛保时效。
why_en: The threshold scales with blast radius: larger drops and more subscribers need more confirmations, while low-impact changes keep a lower bar.

scenario: iPhone 突降 $500（高订阅、高影响）和一本书变动 $2，两者的共识门槛该不该一样？
scenario_en: An iPhone suddenly drops $500 (high subscriptions, high impact) versus a book changing by $2 — should the two require the same consensus threshold?
q: 正确的做法是？
q_en: What is the correct approach?
options: 所有商品统一 3 个确认，简单公平
高价商品的变价一律不生效
冷门商品反而要求更多确认
按影响自适应：订阅越多、降幅越大要求越多确认
why: 误报成本和商品影响力成正比，校验强度就该随之浮动；再叠加用户信誉加权（长期准确者权重更高），让门槛既安全又不过度拖慢小变价。
why_en: Consensus requirements scale with impact, so a five-hundred-dollar drop on a hot product needs five confirmations while a two-dollar book change needs only two.
whenOtherWins: 对时效极敏感的限时抢购，等共识会错过窗口，更适合 trust-but-verify 先放行再快速核查。
tradeoff: 误报代价随商品影响力浮动 vs 统一门槛的简单一致
options_en: Require the same 3 confirmations for every product; simple and fair.
Never accept price changes on expensive products.
Require even more confirmations for niche products.
Scale the threshold with impact: bigger drops need more confirmations.

q: 用户信誉在共识系统里怎么用？
q_en: How is user reputation used inside the consensus system?
options: 所有用户权重永远相同
注册越晚的用户权重越高
长期上报准确的用户，上报权重更大
付费用户的上报直接生效
why: 系统跟踪每个用户的历史准确率，可信用户的上报能更快凑满共识；这既加速了合法变价的确认，也让坏账号的影响力随失误衰减。
why_en: The system tracks reporter accuracy over time so consistently reliable users count more heavily toward the consensus threshold.
options_en: Every user always carries the same weight.
Users who registered more recently get more weight.
Consistently accurate reporters get more weight over time.
Paying users' reports take effect immediately.

q: 为什么共识机制能顺带过滤掉「技术性错误」（缓存问题、网络故障）？
q_en: Why does the consensus mechanism also filter out "technical glitches" like cache issues or network failures?
options: 故障很难同时同样影响多个独立用户
因为技术错误从不发生
因为共识系统会远程修复用户浏览器
因为时间窗无限长
why: 共识的本质是要求「独立来源的一致性」：恶意者缺同伙，故障缺巧合，两类脏数据都过不了 N 人同报这一关。
why_en: Technical glitches rarely hit multiple independent users in exactly the same way, so bogus reports naturally fail to reach consensus.
options_en: A glitch rarely hits multiple independent users the same way.
Because technical errors never happen.
Because the system remotely fixes users' browsers.
Because the time window is unlimited.

q: 共识校验方案有哪些弱点？（多选）
q_en: What are the weaknesses of the consensus-validation design? (multi-select)
options: 冷门商品凑不够确认人数，延迟可达数小时甚至数天
大促时海量待验证积压，连热门商品通知也被拖慢
有组织的坏人仍可能串通凑满共识
所有真实降价都会被判为假
why: 共识用延迟换安全：冷门商品等不来人、大促排不完队、串通者防不胜防。这三条正是文章转向 trust-but-verify 的理由。
why_en: Consensus delays niche products for hours or days, backs up during big sale events, and can still be gamed by coordinated bad actors.
options_en: Niche products can't gather enough confirmations for hours or days.
Sale events create a backlog that delays even hot-product alerts.
Organized bad actors can still collude to fake consensus.
Every real price drop gets rejected as false.

scenario: 既要满足 1 小时通知时限、抓住限时折扣，又要挡住假价格；共识方案对冷门商品的等待太久。
scenario_en: You must meet the one-hour notification deadline and catch flash deals, while still blocking fake prices; consensus validation makes niche products wait too long.
q: 更优的校验策略是？
q_en: What is a better validation strategy?
options: 所有上报一律等 24 小时人工审核
先信任立即发通知，可疑变价几分钟内核实
彻底弃用插件数据，只靠爬虫
只在夜间低峰批量核实
why: 绝大多数上报是真实的，先放行保时效；大降幅、低信誉用户、高订阅商品这类可疑信号触发分钟级核实爬取，错了再纠正——用小概率的纠错换全局的快。
why_en: Trust-but-verify accepts extension data immediately for fast notifications while suspicious changes trigger a high-priority verification crawl within one to five minutes.
whenOtherWins: 若核实爬虫容量吃紧、或某商品假报频发，可对这类商品退回共识等待模式，宁慢勿错。
tradeoff: 立即通知的时效 vs 校验完成后再通知的确定性
diagram:
flowchart TD A["插件上报变价"] --> B["立即接受并发通知"] A --> S{"可疑？大降幅 /
低信誉 / 高订阅"} S -->|是| V["高优先级核实爬取
（1-5 分钟）"] V -->|上报有误| F["发纠正通知 + 降低信誉"]
options_en: Hold every report for 24 hours of manual review.
Trust it immediately and verify suspicious changes within minutes.
Drop extension data entirely and rely only on crawlers.
Only verify in a nightly off-peak batch.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先接受上报并生效，同时对可疑部分快速核实，事后发现问题再纠正。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Trust-but-verify means accepting a report immediately while quickly checking suspicious cases and correcting them afterward if wrong.

q: 哪些信号会把一次价格上报标记为「可疑」、触发核实爬取？（多选）
q_en: Which signals mark a price report as "suspicious" and trigger a verification crawl? (multi-select)
options: 价格降幅异常巨大
上报发生在周末
上报者历史准确率低（曾经报错过）
高订阅量的热门商品发生变价
why: 大降幅、坏记录用户、高影响商品是三大可疑信号；此外不同用户上报互相冲突时，也会立即派爬虫裁决。上报时间本身不是信号。
why_en: A verification crawl is triggered by huge price drops, reporters with poor track records, or changes on heavily subscribed products, and also by conflicting reports.
options_en: An unusually large price drop.
The report happens on a weekend.
The reporter has a history of inaccurate reports.
A change on a heavily subscribed, popular product.

q: 核实爬取发现插件上报是错的，系统接下来做什么？
q_en: When a verification crawl finds the extension's report was wrong, what does the system do next?
options: 假装没发生，等数据自然过期
永久封禁所有插件用户
发纠正通知，调低信誉分
回滚整个价格数据库
why: 错误既已放行就要主动纠错：给收到假通知的用户发更正，同时降低肇事者信誉，让他未来的上报更难被直接采信。
why_en: If the crawler finds the report was wrong, the system sends correction notifications and marks that reporter as less trustworthy.
options_en: Pretend nothing happened and let the data expire.
Permanently ban every extension user.
Send a correction notice and lower the reporter's reputation.
Roll back the entire price database.

q: trust-but-verify 策略要付出什么代价？
q_en: What cost does the trust-but-verify strategy incur?
options: 核实爬取增加请求量，抬高限流封 IP 风险
通知延迟恶化到 24 小时
插件用户必须付费
数据库必须换成 NoSQL
why: 快速核实要求爬虫具备高优先级插队和分钟级响应能力，消耗额外服务器资源；额外爬取也在挑衅 Amazon 的反爬底线。
why_en: Verification crawling adds load on Amazon and raises the risk of rate limiting or IP blocks, while priority-queue management makes the crawler infrastructure more complex.
options_en: Verification crawls add request volume and raise IP-block risk.
Notification delay worsens to 24 hours.
Extension users must pay a fee.
The database must switch to a NoSQL store.

q: 在「通知延迟」这个维度上，共识校验与 trust-but-verify 的区别是？
q_en: On the "notification delay" dimension, how do consensus validation and trust-but-verify differ?
options: 两者的延迟完全一样
共识校验总是更快
trust-but-verify 必须等爬虫返回才能发通知
共识先验证再发（可能数小时）；TBV 先发后纠错
why: 共识把校验放在通知之前（安全但慢），TBV 把校验放在通知之后（快但偶尔要纠错）；本题 1 小时时限和限时折扣场景让天平倒向后者。
why_en: Consensus validates before notifying and can take hours for niche items, while trust-but-verify notifies immediately and corrects mistakes after the fact.
tradeoff: 先验证后通知的安全 vs 先通知后纠错的时效
options_en: The two approaches have exactly the same delay.
Consensus is always faster.
Trust-but-verify must wait for a crawl before notifying.
Consensus validates first (hours); trust-but-verify notifies then corrects.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先等多个独立用户报出同一价格，达到阈值再放行通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consensus validation waits for enough independent users to report the same price before releasing the notification.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先接受上报并立即通知，再对可疑部分快速核实。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Trust-but-verify accepts a report and notifies immediately, then quickly verifies suspicious cases afterward.

q: 轮询通知的根本问题在于「提问方式错了」，正确的重构是什么？
q_en: Polling's root problem is "asking the wrong question" — what is the correct reframe?
options: 轮询无法用 SQL 实现
变化发生时立刻问谁关心，而不是定期问变了什么
轮询只适用于写多读少的系统
cron 无法配置 2 小时间隔
why: 轮询在错误的时间问错误的问题，只能靠全量扫描补偿；事件驱动让每次变价主动找到关心它的订阅者，扫描开销归零、延迟降到秒级。
why_en: Instead of periodically asking what changed, an event-driven system asks who cares about this change the moment it happens.
options_en: Polling cannot be implemented in SQL.
Ask who cares the moment a change happens, not periodically.
Polling only works for write-heavy, read-light systems.
Cron cannot be configured for a two-hour interval.

q: 用数据库变更捕获（CDC）实现事件驱动通知的机制是？
q_en: How does change data capture (CDC) implement event-driven notifications?
options: 应用层手动写变更日志文件
每天全量导出数据库做 diff 比对
写入触发数据库自动发 Kafka 事件
让用户客户端轮询自己的订阅状态
why: CDC 把「发事件」下沉到数据库层：任何写入路径（爬虫或插件处理器）插入价格行都会自动出事件，应用代码零协调，数据流完全自动。
why_en: With change data capture, database triggers automatically publish price-change events to Kafka, and the notification service consumes them to find affected subscribers.
diagram:
flowchart LR
    W["爬虫 / 插件写入新价格"] --> DB[("价格库")]
    DB --> T["CDC 触发器发事件"]
    T --> K["Kafka：product_id + 新旧价"]
    K --> N["通知服务查订阅表"]
    N --> E["发送邮件"]
options_en: The application manually writes a change-log file.
A full database export is diffed every day.
A write triggers the database to auto-publish a Kafka event.
The client polls its own subscription status.
optionMeanings: 应用层手动写日志，容易被遗忘或写错。
全量导出比对，延迟大、开销高。
数据库自动发事件，应用零协调。
客户端轮询，浪费请求且延迟高。
optionMeanings_en: The app hand-writes a log, which is easy to forget or get wrong.
A full export diff is slow and expensive.
The database auto-publishes the event; the app coordinates nothing.
Client polling wastes requests and adds latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库变更捕获，数据库写入发生时自动把变化发布成事件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CDC, change data capture, automatically publishes an event whenever a row in the database changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个分布式消息队列，用来在服务之间可靠地传递事件流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed message queue used to reliably stream events between services.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在指定的写入操作发生时，由数据库自动执行的一段逻辑。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A database trigger is logic the database automatically runs when a specified write operation happens.

scenario: 上一题已经确认：写入新价格时，数据库触发器会自动发布事件到 Kafka。
scenario_en: The previous card established that writing a new price automatically fires a database trigger that publishes an event to Kafka.
q: CDC 方案最突出的优点是？
q_en: What is CDC's most standout advantage?
options: 价格一变自动出事件，应用代码不用管发布
CDC 不需要消息队列
CDC 能自动过滤微小价格波动
CDC 让写入速度更快
why: 事件发布由数据库兜底，任何新的写入路径接进来都自动带上通知能力，不存在「某段代码忘了发事件」这类漏洞。
why_en: CDC is clean because the database itself guarantees an event for every price change, with no application-level coordination to forget.
options_en: Every price change auto-emits an event; app code needn't publish it.
CDC does not need a message queue.
CDC automatically filters out tiny price fluctuations.
CDC makes writes faster.
optionMeanings: 数据库自动发布事件，应用代码无需感知。
描述 CDC 与消息队列之间的关系。
描述 CDC 是否会做业务过滤。
描述 CDC 对写入性能的影响。
optionMeanings_en: The database auto-publishes events; the app stays unaware.
Describes CDC's relationship to a message queue.
Describes whether CDC filters business data.
Describes CDC's effect on write performance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库变更捕获，数据库写入发生时自动把变化发布成事件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CDC, change data capture, automatically publishes an event whenever a row in the database changes.

q: 「双写」（dual write）方案的机制是？
q_en: How does the "dual write" mechanism work?
options: 两个数据库互相复制
只写 Kafka 不写数据库
由 DBA 每天手动同步
采集服务写库的同时自己发布 Kafka 事件
why: 同一个服务承担落库和发事件两件事：爬虫或插件数据进来后，写库 + 发 Kafka 同时进行，事件内容和时机由应用完全掌控。
why_en: In the dual-write approach, the same service that writes prices to the database also publishes structured events to Kafka.
options_en: Two databases replicate each other.
Only write to Kafka, skip the database.
A DBA manually syncs the data every day.
The ingest service writes the DB and publishes a Kafka event itself.
optionMeanings: 两个数据库间的复制关系描述。
跳过数据库、只发消息的做法。
靠人工而非自动化的同步方式。
同一次写入里既落库又发事件。
optionMeanings_en: Describes replication between two databases.
Skips the database and writes only to the queue.
Manual syncing instead of automation.
The same write both persists data and emits an event.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一个服务在一次操作里既写数据库又发布消息事件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dual write means the same service both writes to the database and publishes a message event in one operation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个分布式消息队列，用来在服务之间可靠地传递事件流。

q: 相比 CDC，双写方案能带来哪些好处？（多选）

why_en: Dual writes let the application filter tiny fluctuations, batch rapid changes, and skip trigger overhead, though they cannot inherently guarantee no event is ever lost.
options_en: It can filter out tiny fluctuations users don't care about.
It can batch rapid successive changes before publishing.
It skips the overhead of a database trigger on every write.
It fundamentally guarantees no event is ever lost.

options_en: Both are emitted by the database.

q: 为什么事件驱动的通知量在 5 亿商品规模下依然可控？

因为用户很少创建订阅

q: 为什么「Postgres 表 + (product_id, timestamp) 索引」满足不了 <500ms 的图表查询？
q_en: Why can't a "Postgres table with a (product_id, timestamp) index" meet the sub-500ms chart-query requirement?
options: 这种索引会导致写入失败
现场聚合数千价格点，扛不住查询负载
Postgres 不支持时间戳类型索引
问题出在前端渲染太慢
why: 索引能快速定位行，但聚合数千点成时间桶的计算发生在查询时；用户一多、区间一长，这种即时聚合就把延迟推过 500ms 红线。
why_en: Popular products accumulate thousands of price points, and aggregating them into time buckets at query time is what blows past the latency budget.
options_en: This kind of index causes writes to fail.
On-the-fly aggregation of thousands of points can't meet the budget.
Postgres doesn't support indexing timestamp columns.
The bottleneck is slow frontend rendering.

q: 预聚合方案的做法是？
q_en: How does the pre-aggregation design work?
options: 夜间批任务预计算汇总，图表只查聚合表
每次查询后把结果缓存到 Redis
让客户端下载原始数据自行聚合
每小时对全表重新计算一遍
why: 把聚合从查询时挪到夜间批处理：图表请求变成读几十行预计算结果，毫秒级返回；代价是数据滞后和额外存储。
why_en: A nightly batch job precomputes daily, weekly, and monthly summaries so chart queries read a few dozen precomputed rows instead of aggregating raw data.
options_en: A nightly batch job precomputes summaries; charts query only that table.
Cache each query's result in Redis afterward.
Let the client download raw data and aggregate it itself.
Recompute the entire table every hour.

q: 预聚合任务会为每个时间桶计算哪些统计量？（多选）
q_en: Which statistics does the pre-aggregation job compute for each time bucket? (multi-select)
options: 平均价
最低价和最高价
价格中位数
期初价与期末价（开盘/收盘）
why: 每桶存 avg、min、max、open、close 五个值，足够画出蜡烛图式的价格走势；中位数不在文章的统计清单里。
why_en: Each bucket stores the average, minimum, maximum, opening, and closing prices for that period.
options_en: Average price.
Minimum and maximum price.
Median price.
Opening and closing price for the period.

q: 预聚合结果的表结构怎么设计？
q_en: How should the pre-aggregation results table be structured?
options: 日/周/月各建一张独立表
导出成 JSON 文件放对象存储
单表 + granularity 列，联合索引三字段
只保留月度数据节省空间
why: 一张表加 granularity 列即可容纳三种粒度；(product_id, granularity, date) 索引让任意图表请求都命中连续几十行，毫秒级返回。
why_en: All granularities live in one aggregation table with a granularity column, indexed on product, granularity, and date for millisecond lookups.
options_en: Build a separate table for each of daily, weekly, and monthly.
Export everything to JSON files in object storage.
One table with a granularity column, indexed on three fields.
Keep only monthly data to save space.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据聚合的时间粒度，比如按天、按周还是按月汇总。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Granularity is the time resolution of the aggregation, such as daily, weekly, or monthly summaries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由多个字段组合而成的一个索引，加速按这几个字段一起查询的场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A composite index is built from multiple columns together to speed up queries that filter on all of them at once.

scenario: 聚合表里有日/周/月三种粒度，用户分别请求 30 天图表和 2 年图表。
scenario_en: The aggregation table stores daily, weekly, and monthly granularities, and users request both a 30-day chart and a 2-year chart.
q: 查询该怎么选粒度？
q_en: How should the query pick which granularity to use?
options: 两者都查小时级明细最精确
按周期选粒度：30天用日级，2年用月级
两者都用月级最省资源
让前端下载全部原始点自己算
why: 选粒度的原则是「图上一个点对应一行聚合」：30 天配日级约 30 行，2 年配月级约 24 行，替代了对数千原始点的现场聚合。
why_en: A thirty-day chart reads daily aggregations and a two-year chart reads monthly ones, returning dozens of precomputed rows instead of thousands of raw points.
whenOtherWins: 用户要任意自定义区间和粒度时，固定档位不够用，TimescaleDB 的实时聚合更合适。
tradeoff: 固定粒度档位的查询速度 vs 任意粒度的灵活性
options_en: Query hourly detail for both; it's the most precise.
Match granularity to range: daily for 30d, monthly for 2y.
Use monthly granularity for both to save resources.
Let the frontend download every raw point and aggregate it.

q: 预聚合方案的代价是什么？
q_en: What is the cost of the pre-aggregation design?
options: 查询延迟反而变慢
无法建立索引
写入路径被批任务阻塞
数据滞后最多 24 小时，且多存一份汇总
why: 夜间批处理意味着白天的变价明天才进图表；好在用户看的是历史趋势而非实时价，这种陈旧一般可接受，存储增长也只是线性。
why_en: Precomputed charts can be up to a day stale and the summaries cost extra storage, though staleness is acceptable for historical trend viewing.
options_en: Query latency actually gets worse.
Indexes can no longer be built.
The write path gets blocked by the batch job.
Data can lag up to 24 hours, plus extra storage for summaries.

scenario: 运营数据（用户/商品/订阅）已经在 PostgreSQL 上；希望不维护预聚合批任务、支持任意区间任意粒度实时出图，还要保持技术栈统一。
scenario_en: Operational data (users, products, subscriptions) already lives on PostgreSQL; you want to avoid maintaining pre-aggregation batch jobs, support any range or granularity in real time, and keep one unified stack.
q: 价格历史存储选什么？
q_en: What should you choose for price-history storage?
options: TimescaleDB：时序扩展免预聚合
迁移到 MongoDB
自研内存聚合服务
把价格塞进 Redis Sorted Set
why: TimescaleDB 为时序负载而生又长在 Postgres 上：一套数据库同时服务运营 CRUD 和十亿级价格聚合，架构最简单、运维成本最低。
why_en: TimescaleDB is a time-series extension for PostgreSQL that serves real-time aggregations in milliseconds while keeping the whole stack in one familiar ecosystem.
whenOtherWins: 若分析性能是压倒性需求、且能接受多运维一套系统，ClickHouse 的列式分析性能更高。
tradeoff: 统一技术栈的运维简单 vs 独立分析引擎的极致性能
options_en: TimescaleDB: a Postgres time-series extension, no pre-aggregation needed.
Migrate to MongoDB.
Build an in-house in-memory aggregation service.
Store prices in a Redis sorted set.

termDefinitions.meaning: PostgreSQL 的时序数据扩展，支持自动分区和实时聚合查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TimescaleDB is a time-series extension for PostgreSQL that adds automatic partitioning and fast real-time aggregation queries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种面向文档的 NoSQL 数据库，schema 灵活，但没有内建的时序聚合能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MongoDB is a document-oriented NoSQL database with flexible schemas but no built-in time-series aggregation.

scenario: 用 TimescaleDB 给某商品出 6 个月的「日均价」曲线，希望一条 SQL 实时算出结果。
scenario_en: Using TimescaleDB to render a product's 6-month daily-average price curve, computed live with a single SQL query.
q: 哪个查询是正确的？
q_en: Which query is correct?
options: SELECT date_trunc('year', timestamp), max(price) FROM prices WHERE product_id = $1 GROUP BY 1
SELECT * FROM prices WHERE product_id = $1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', timestamp), avg(price) FROM prices WHERE product_id = $1 GROUP BY 1
DELETE FROM prices WHERE product_id = $1 AND timestamp < now() - interval '6 months'
why: time_bucket 是 TimescaleDB 的招牌函数：把时间戳按天分桶再求均值，配合自动分区与压缩，十亿行上也能毫秒级返回。
why_en: TimescaleDB's time_bucket function groups timestamps into daily buckets and averages the price, returning chart-ready results in milliseconds even over billions of rows.
whenOtherWins: 没有 TimescaleDB、聚合档位固定时，查预聚合表更省；拉全量明细让前端聚合只适合数据点极少的冷门商品。
tradeoff: 实时按需聚合的灵活性 vs 预聚合表的查询开销
codeSample:
-- TimescaleDB：6 个月日均价，实时聚合
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', timestamp) AS bucket,
       avg(price)
FROM prices
WHERE product_id = $1
  AND timestamp > now() - interval '6 months'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
options_en: Group by year and take the max price for one product.
Fetch the 100 most recent raw rows for one product.
Bucket timestamps by day and average the price for one product.
Delete rows older than six months for one product.

termDefinitions.meaning: TimescaleDB 提供的函数，把时间戳归到固定长度的时间桶里再聚合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: time_bucket is a TimescaleDB function that rounds timestamps into fixed-length time buckets for aggregation.

q: TimescaleDB 靠什么让十亿级价格行的聚合依然飞快？
q_en: What lets TimescaleDB keep aggregation fast even over billions of price rows?
options: 把所有数据常驻内存
分区压缩，接口仍是 Postgres
牺牲 SQL 支持换取速度
限制每个商品最多存 1000 行
why: 按时间自动分区让查询只扫相关的分片，压缩降低 IO；对使用者而言它仍是 Postgres，运营与分析负载共存于一个生态。
why_en: Automatic time-based partitioning and compression keep aggregations fast while everything still speaks familiar PostgreSQL.
options_en: Keeping all data resident in memory.
Automatic partitioning and compression, still speaking Postgres.
Dropping SQL support in exchange for speed.
Capping every product to 1,000 stored rows.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一张大表按规则（如时间）拆成多个更小的物理块，查询时只扫相关的块。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Partitioning splits a large table into smaller physical chunks by a rule like time, so queries only scan the relevant chunks.

tradeoff: ClickHouse 的分析性能 vs TimescaleDB 的运维统一性
options_en: ClickHouse analyzes faster, but TimescaleDB keeps one unified stack.
TimescaleDB's analytics performance crushes ClickHouse.
The two are functionally equivalent.
ClickHouse is also just a PostgreSQL extension.

q: 预聚合批任务与 TimescaleDB 在「新鲜度与灵活性」上的区别是？
q_en: On "freshness versus flexibility," how do the pre-aggregation batch job and TimescaleDB differ?

Full-text search across chat history.

q: 哪些内容在本题里明确 below the line？（多选）
q_en: What is explicitly below the line for this design? (Choose all that apply.)
options: 保存最终 assistant message
逐 token 持久化每个流式 chunk
鉴权、滥用治理和内容审核细节
GDPR、数据驻留、隐私合规
why: 系统只需要持久化最终回复，不要求每个 token 都成为 durable record；安全、合规、监控等也不是主线。这样深挖可以集中在 serving 系统本身。
why_en: Per-token durability, moderation, compliance, and operations are scoped out so the design can focus on low-latency serving and GPU capacity.
options_en: Persist only the final assistant message.
Persist every streamed token chunk individually.
Authentication, abuse prevention, and moderation details.
GDPR, data residency, and privacy compliance.

q: 这个规模量级最直接支持下面哪个设计判断？
q_en: Which design call does this scale estimate support most directly?
options: GPU 调度和利用率必须被认真设计
并发流不多，同步阻塞调用完全够用
单实例 Postgres 就能撑住所有读写流量
这个规模下不需要考虑排队或降级
why: 200M DAU、约 20k prompts/sec 峰值、120k 并发流意味着 GPU 调度和利用率才是这题的核心难点，而不是常规 CRUD 扩展。
why_en: At roughly 200 million daily users and 120 thousand concurrent streams, GPU scheduling and utilization become the central design problem, not ordinary CRUD scaling.
scenario: 设计题设定 ChatGPT 服务约 200M DAU、峰值约 20k prompts/sec、约 120k 并发生成流。
scenario_en: The ChatGPT service is scoped at about 200M DAU, a peak of about 20k prompts per second, and about 120k concurrent generation streams.
options_en: GPU scheduling and cross-request utilization need serious design, this is not ordinary CRUD scale.
Concurrency is low enough that synchronous blocking calls are fine.
A single Postgres instance can handle all read/write traffic.
At this scale there is no need to think about queuing or degradation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 日活跃用户数，衡量每天有多少用户使用产品。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DAU is the number of unique users active on a given day.

q: 本题最关键的用户感知延迟指标是什么？
q_en: Which user-visible latency metric matters most in this design?
options: 数据库写入操作的 p99 延迟
首 token 延迟（TTFT）低于约 500ms
完整回复必须在 2 秒内结束
模型训练阶段的吞吐量指标
why: 用户按下回车后最怕看到空白，所以 TTFT 比完整生成耗时更影响体验；完整回复仍可持续到约 30 秒。
why_en: Time to first token under roughly 500 milliseconds matters more than total completion time because a blank screen feels broken.
scenario: 用户敲回车后期待立刻看到反应；产品目标是让首个 token 尽快出现，完整回复允许持续到约 30 秒。
scenario_en: After the user presses Enter, the product should show a first token quickly; the full answer may keep streaming for about 30 seconds.
options_en: Database write p99 latency.
Time to first token (TTFT) under about 500ms.
The full response must finish within 2 seconds.
Model training throughput.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从发送请求到第一枚 token 出现的时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTFT is the time from sending a request to the first token appearing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 99% 的请求都能在这个时间内完成的延迟阈值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: p99 latency is the threshold that 99 percent of requests complete within.

q: 对 conversation state，应该选择哪种 CAP 倾向？
q_en: Which CAP bias should conversation state use?
options: 强一致优先，宁可整体阻塞
完全不持久化聊天状态
可用性优先，接受短暂状态不一致或降级
所有地区同步提交后才响应
why: 聊天状态不是股票交易这类强一致场景，短暂降级或返回错误比让整个系统等完美同步更好。目标是约 99.9%+ 可用性。
why_en: Conversation state favors availability over strong consistency because temporary degradation is preferable to blocking the whole system.
tradeoff: 可用性 vs 强一致性（CAP）
options_en: Prioritize strong consistency, even if it blocks the whole system.
Do not persist conversation state at all.
Prioritize availability and accept brief state inconsistency or degradation.
Only respond after every region commits synchronously.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一致性、可用性、分区容忍性三者在网络分区下不可兼得的经典权衡。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CAP describes the trade-off among consistency, availability, and partition tolerance during a network partition.

scenario: ChatGPT 需要保存和展示会话历史，但它不是转账、下单这类必须强一致的系统。
scenario_en: ChatGPT needs to save and show conversation history, but it is not a money-transfer or order-placement system that requires strict consistency.

q: 补全 ChatGPT 的基础实体：
q_en: Fill in the base entities for ChatGPT:
text: 基础实体包括 {{User}}（带 free/paid tier）、{{Chat}}（单个对话线程）、{{Message}}（user 或 assistant 的一轮消息）；深挖后还会引入 {{Generation}} 表示一次推理运行。
why: User tier 后面影响公平调度，Chat 和 Message 支撑历史续聊。Generation 一开始不是必须实体，但当 runId、状态、取消、计费都出现后就值得建模。
why_en: The base entities are User, Chat, and Message, with Generation added later once an inference run needs its own lifecycle.

q: ChatGPT 的基础 API 需要覆盖哪些路径？（多选）
q_en: Which base API paths does ChatGPT need? (Choose all that apply.)
options: POST /chats 创建聊天
POST /chats/{chatId}/messages 发送 prompt 并流式返回
GET /chats 和 GET /chats/{chatId}/messages 分页读取历史
客户端在 body 里传 userId 让服务端信任
why: 创建、发送、历史列表和消息读取分别映射到 Chat 与 Message；userId 必须从 session/JWT 推导并做 ownership check。把 userId 放进请求体是可伪造的红旗。
why_en: The API covers creating chats, sending streamed messages, and paginated reads, while user identity must come from trusted auth context rather than the body.
options_en: POST /chats creates a new chat.
POST /chats/{chatId}/messages sends a prompt and streams the reply back.
GET /chats and GET /chats/{chatId}/messages paginate through history.
The client passes userId in the body and the server trusts it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务端签发的身份令牌，用来在请求间证明用户身份。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A JWT is a signed token issued by the server that proves user identity across requests.

scenario: 聊天状态的读写是普通行存储，推理层则依赖昂贵 GPU，并且两者的扩缩容节奏完全不同。
scenario_en: Chat state reads and writes are ordinary row storage, while inference depends on expensive GPUs, and the two tiers scale at very different rates.
q: 为什么要拆出 Chat Service 和 Inference Service？
q_en: Why split Chat Service from Inference Service?
options: 让每条消息都写两个数据库
让客户端直接接管 GPU worker 的调度
为了完全不保存任何聊天历史记录
让编排层和 GPU 推理层能各自独立扩缩容与调度
why: Chat Service 负责认证后的编排和消息持久化，Inference Service 拥有 GPU worker。拆分后可以独立扩容、排队、调度 GPU，而不让普通请求层被 GPU 约束绑死。
why_en: Separating chat orchestration from GPU inference lets the cheap stateless tier and expensive worker tier scale and schedule independently.
whenOtherWins: 很小的内部 demo 可以把调用写在一个服务里；一旦 GPU 成为瓶颈，边界就必须清晰。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client[Client] --> Chat[Chat Service]
Chat --> DB[(Chat DB)]
Chat --> Queue[Inference Queue]
Queue --> Worker[GPU Worker]
Worker --> Model[LLM Runtime]
tradeoff: 编排层与推理层独立扩缩容 vs 单服务实现简单
options_en: Route every message through two databases.
Let the client manage GPU workers directly.
Avoid persisting any chat history at all.
Let the cheap orchestration tier and the expensive GPU tier scale independently.

q: 把同步 MVP 的发送流程排成正确顺序：
q_en: Put the synchronous MVP send flow in the right order:
steps: Chat Service 同步调用 Inference Service 并等待完整 completion
API Gateway 鉴权后转发给 Chat Service
客户端 POST /chats/{chatId}/messages
Chat Service 写入用户消息
Chat Service 写入 assistant message 并返回
why: 这个流程满足功能需求，但用户会等到完整回复生成完才看到结果。它故意暴露出 TTFT 和 admission control 两个后续深挖点。
why_en: The synchronous MVP works functionally but exposes blank-screen latency and missing admission control as the core problems.

scenario: 要存储 chats 和 messages，查询主要按 userId、chatId、createdAt 读取，数据模型简单且关系明确。
scenario_en: The system stores chats and messages, mostly read by userId, chatId, and createdAt; the data model is simple and relational.
q: 系统记录最合适的默认存储是什么？
q_en: What is the best default store for system records?
options: Postgres
Elasticsearch
Redis Pub/Sub
本地文件系统
why: 聊天与消息是简单、可索引、需要持久化的行数据，Postgres 是稳妥默认选择。文章也强调这里不是数据库选型难点，几乎任何合理持久化数据库都能工作。
why_en: Postgres is a sensible system of record because chats and messages are simple durable rows keyed by user and chat.
whenOtherWins: 如果核心需求变成跨历史全文搜索，Elasticsearch 会作为搜索索引补上；Redis Pub/Sub 不是 durable source of truth。
tradeoff: 简单持久化行存储 vs 全文搜索能力
options_en: Postgres.
Elasticsearch.
Redis Pub/Sub.
The local filesystem.

q: 每轮都把完整历史拼进 prompt 的主要后果是什么？
q_en: What is the main consequence of putting full history into every prompt?
options: 模型处理请求永远不会超出上下文窗口限制
输入成本和延迟随对话增长，最终撞上上下文窗口上限
可以完全不保存任何历史消息记录
会自动大幅提升 GPU 利用率表现
why: 全量历史是最简单的“记住对话”，但每轮都重复付费读取旧内容。长对话会同时带来成本、延迟和上下文窗口上限问题。
why_en: Replaying full history makes memory simple but causes input cost and prefill latency to grow until the context window is exceeded.
options_en: The model will never exceed its context window.
Input cost and latency grow with the conversation and eventually hit the context window limit.
It is fine to persist no message history at all.
It automatically raises GPU utilization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型处理输入 prompt、生成第一枚输出 token 之前的计算阶段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prefill is the compute phase where the model processes the input prompt before producing the first output token.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型单次能处理的最大 token 数量上限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The context window is the maximum number of tokens a model can process in one call.

scenario: 浏览器只需要在生成期间持续接收 token，prompt 已经通过 POST 发出，中途只有取消请求需要单独处理。
scenario_en: The browser only needs to receive tokens during generation; the prompt was already sent by POST, and only cancellation needs a separate path.
q: 对浏览器侧 token 推送，最贴合的传输方案是？
q_en: Which transport best fits browser-side token delivery?
options: 短轮询 status endpoint
UDP 组播
Server-Sent Events
每个 token 一个独立 HTTP 请求
why: SSE 是一条普通 HTTP 响应上的单向 server-to-client 流，正好匹配 token 下发。它避免 WebSocket 的双向状态成本，同时比轮询更快更平滑。
why_en: SSE fits token streaming because the browser only needs a one-way server-to-client stream after the prompt is submitted.
whenOtherWins: 如果客户端需要在同一连接上频繁双向交互，WebSocket 会更合适；如果只是低频状态检查，轮询也能接受。
tradeoff: 单向 server-push 简单性 vs 双向连接开销
options_en: Short-poll a status endpoint.
UDP multicast.
Server-Sent Events.
One separate HTTP request per token.
optionDirectness: 轮询有间隔延迟，达不到低 TTFT 要求
不保证送达，也非浏览器标准 API
单向推送，天然匹配只发不收的 token 流
每 token 建连接，开销随速率线性爆炸
optionDirectness_en: Polling has interval delay, missing the low-TTFT target.
No delivery guarantee, and not a standard browser API.
One-way push, a natural fit for a send-only token stream.
One connection per token, overhead explodes with rate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务器向浏览器单向推送事件的 HTTP 流机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Server-Sent Events let a server push a one-way stream of events to the browser over plain HTTP.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不保证送达、无连接的传输层协议。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: UDP is a connectionless transport protocol that does not guarantee delivery.

q: 为什么几百毫秒轮询不适合 LLM token 流？
q_en: Why is polling every few hundred milliseconds a poor fit for LLM token streams?
options: 轮询请求完全无法穿过负载均衡器
轮询方式只能在移动端使用
它要求把每个 token 都写入 Postgres
TTFT 被轮询间隔卡住，且请求量暴增
why: 120k 并发流每 300ms 轮询约等于 400k RPS，且多数为空响应。第一 token 还要等下一次 poll，用户看到的是一坨一坨出现而不是平滑流。
why_en: Polling delays the first token by the poll interval, creates huge mostly-empty request volume, and makes the stream arrive in chunks.
options_en: Polling requests cannot pass through a load balancer at all.
Polling only works on mobile clients.
It requires writing every token to Postgres.
TTFT is capped by the poll interval and request volume explodes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从请求发出到第一个 token 出现的时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTFT is the time from a request being sent to the first token appearing on screen.

scenario: GPU worker 要把 token 一个个推给 Chat Service，两个都是内部服务，需要类型化契约和高效复用连接。
scenario_en: A GPU worker must push tokens one by one to Chat Service; both are internal services that need a typed contract and efficient connection reuse.
q: 内部 worker → Chat Service 流最合适的协议是什么？
q_en: Which protocol best fits the internal worker-to-Chat-Service stream?
options: gRPC server-streaming
浏览器 EventSource
每个 token 写一次数据库再轮询
电子邮件 webhook
why: gRPC over HTTP/2 提供二进制 framing、连接复用和 protobuf 契约，适合服务间 stream。SSE 更适合浏览器边界，不是内部 worker API 的首选。
why_en: gRPC server streaming is a good internal hop because it gives efficient HTTP/2 multiplexing and a typed service contract.
whenOtherWins: 如果目标是浏览器展示 token，SSE 更轻；如果 worker 只返回完整结果，普通 request/response 就够。
tradeoff: 服务间高效双工契约 vs 浏览器单向推送简单性
options_en: gRPC server-streaming.
Browser EventSource.
Write each token to the database and poll it.
Email webhook.
optionDirectness: HTTP/2 二进制流 + 多路复用，服务间效率最高
为浏览器边缘设计，不是内部服务契约
把流式请求硬拗成同步写库加轮询
邮件不是低延迟通道，也没有流式语义
optionDirectness_en: HTTP/2 binary streaming with multiplexing, most efficient between services.
Built for the browser edge, not an internal service contract.
Forces a streaming request into synchronous writes plus polling.
Email is not a low-latency channel and has no streaming semantics.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于 HTTP/2 的服务间 RPC 框架，支持二进制 framing 和流式调用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: gRPC is an HTTP/2-based RPC framework for service-to-service calls that supports streaming.

termDefinitions.meaning: 浏览器用来接收 SSE 推送的原生 API。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: EventSource is the browser API that receives a Server-Sent Events stream.

q: 补全浏览器与内部服务两段流的选择：
q_en: Fill in the two streaming choices for the browser and internal services:
text: 浏览器接收 token 用 {{SSE}}，因为它是单向 HTTP 推送；Inference Worker 到 Chat Service 用 {{gRPC server-streaming}}，因为它是服务间类型化流。
why: 两段流解决的是不同边界：用户边界追求简单兼容，内部边界追求高效契约。不要把一种协议硬套到所有连接上。
why_en: The browser edge uses SSE while the internal worker hop uses gRPC server streaming because each boundary has different protocol needs.

q: 让一个 Chat Service 实例同时持有 client SSE 和 worker gRPC 流的主要风险是什么？
q_en: What is the main risk of one Chat Service instance holding both the client SSE stream and the worker gRPC stream?
options: Postgres 无法写入 assistant 消息
部署/崩溃/扩缩容会切断长连接，还绑死 worker
浏览器无法正确显示中文字符
GPU 会自动进入空闲状态
why: 这个方案把无状态服务变成长连接中继，pod 替换会杀掉用户正在看的流。下一步需要让 worker 和持连接的 Chat Service 通过 runId 解耦。
why_en: Pinning a stream to one Chat Service instance makes deployments and crashes break long-lived generations and couples that instance to a worker.
scenario: Chat Service 是无状态、水平扩展的服务，会被频繁重新部署或自动扩缩容。
scenario_en: Chat Service is stateless and horizontally scaled, so instances may be redeployed or autoscaled frequently.
options_en: Postgres cannot write the assistant message.
Deploys, crashes, or autoscaling cut long connections and pin the instance to one worker.
The browser cannot render Chinese characters.
The GPU automatically goes idle.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务器向浏览器单向推送的 HTTP 流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SSE is a one-way HTTP push stream from server to browser.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于 HTTP/2 的服务间流式 RPC 框架。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: gRPC is an HTTP/2-based streaming RPC framework used between services.

scenario: worker 生成 token 的节点和持有浏览器 SSE 的 Chat Service 实例可能不是同一个，客户端重连后也可能落到新实例。
scenario_en: The worker generating tokens and the Chat Service instance holding the browser SSE stream may be different nodes, and reconnects may land on a new instance.
q: 第一步解耦 worker 和 Chat Service 可以用什么？
q_en: What can first decouple the worker from Chat Service?
options: 把每个 token 当新消息写入 Postgres
强制所有请求 sticky 到同一个 pod 上
按 runId 建 Redis Pub/Sub 频道解耦生成和连接
让浏览器直接连上 GPU worker
why: runId channel 让生成方和连接方只在逻辑 stream 上汇合，不关心彼此具体实例。这样重连后任意 Chat Service 都能订阅同一个 runId。
why_en: A runId-keyed pub/sub channel decouples token producers from whichever Chat Service instance holds the client connection.
whenOtherWins: 如果连接和 worker 生命周期很短且不会重连，直接中继更简单；如果需要 durable replay，纯 Pub/Sub 又不够。
tradeoff: 生成方与连接方解耦 vs 直接绑定的简单性
options_en: Write each token as a new Postgres message.
Force every request to stick to the same pod.
Create a runId-keyed Redis Pub/Sub channel to decouple generation from the connection.
Let the browser connect directly to the GPU worker.

termDefinitions.meaning: 发布-订阅消息模式，发布者广播消息给当前在线的订阅者。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pub/Sub is a publish-subscribe pattern where publishers broadcast to whichever subscribers are currently connected.

termDefinitions.meaning: 标识一次生成过程的唯一 ID，用来让生成方和连接方在逻辑上汇合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: runId is the unique identifier for one generation that lets producers and connections rendezvous logically.

q: Redis Pub/Sub 用在 token 流上的致命缺口是什么？
q_en: What is the fatal gap in using Redis Pub/Sub for token streaming?
options: 它会自动把 delta 变成全量文本
它只能存储永久消息
它不能按 runId 命名 channel
没有订阅者时消息不缓存，重连间隙发布的 token 会丢
why: Pub/Sub 是 fire-and-forget，只投递给当时在线的订阅者。部署或网络闪断期间丢的 delta 会让用户看到答案中间缺一段。
why_en: Redis Pub/Sub is fire-and-forget, so tokens published during a reconnect gap are lost to the live stream.
options_en: It automatically turns deltas into the full text.
It can only store permanent messages.
It cannot name a channel by runId.
Messages are not buffered, so tokens published during a reconnect gap are lost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 发布-订阅消息模式，只投递给当时在线的订阅者，不做持久化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pub/Sub delivers messages only to subscribers connected at publish time and does not persist them.

scenario: 需要保持 runId 解耦，但客户端断线重连后必须补上 missed token，而不是等最终消息完成后再整体 refetch。
scenario_en: The design still needs runId decoupling, but after a client reconnects it must replay missed tokens instead of waiting to refetch the final message.
q: 应该把 token delta 写到哪里？
q_en: Where should token deltas be written?
options: Redis Stream，按 last-seen ID 用 XREAD 续读
Redis Pub/Sub，完全不保留历史记录
把每个 token 写一行 Postgres 当主路径
存进浏览器本地的 localStorage 里
why: Redis Stream 是短期 append-only log，XADD 每个 delta，XREAD 可从 last-seen ID 继续。它只为直播恢复服务，最终消息仍由 Postgres 持久化。
why_en: Redis Streams preserve short-lived token deltas so reconnecting clients can resume from the last seen entry without gaps.
whenOtherWins: 如果允许流中间丢 token、只关心最终结果，Pub/Sub 更简单；如果每个 token 都是合规记录，才考虑 durable database path。
tradeoff: 可重放的短期日志 vs fire-and-forget 广播
options_en: Redis Streams; Chat Service resumes with XREAD from the last-seen entry ID.
Redis Pub/Sub, keeping no history.
Write each token as one Postgres row on the main path.
The browser's localStorage.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 的 append-only 日志结构，可按 ID 顺序重放。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Redis Stream is an append-only log that can be replayed in order by entry ID.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从 Redis Stream 按位置读取新条目的命令。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: XREAD is the Redis command that reads new stream entries from a given position.

scenario: worker 已经生成一个 token delta，需要把它追加到 runId 的短期流里，供任意 Chat Service 重放。
scenario_en: A worker has produced one token delta and needs to append it to the short-lived runId stream so any Chat Service can replay it.
q: 哪条 Redis 命令最贴合这个写入？
q_en: Which Redis command best fits this write?
options: PUBLISH gen:{runId} "hello"
XADD gen:{runId} * token "hello"
SET gen:{runId} "hello"
LPUSH gen:{runId} "hello"
codeSample:
XADD gen:{runId} * token "hello"
XREAD BLOCK 5000 STREAMS gen:{runId} {lastSeenId}
why: XADD 追加带 ID 的条目，XREAD 可以从 lastSeenId 继续读取，正好支持重连补洞。PUBLISH 更轻但不会保存错过的 token。
why_en: XADD plus XREAD gives each token a stream entry ID, which lets a reconnecting client replay exactly the missed deltas.
whenOtherWins: 只做实时广播且允许断线丢消息时，PUBLISH 更省；只保存最终回复时，SET/数据库写入是另一个层次。
tradeoff: 可重放的 append-only 日志 vs 更轻量但不持久的广播
options_en: PUBLISH gen:{runId} "hello".
XADD gen:{runId} * token "hello".
SET gen:{runId} "hello".
LPUSH gen:{runId} "hello".

termDefinitions.meaning: 向 Redis Stream 追加一条带 ID 的新条目。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: XADD appends a new ID-stamped entry to a Redis Stream.

q: 补全 token 负载选择的原因：
q_en: Fill in why the token payload should be a delta:
text: token stream 应发布 {{delta}} 而不是 message-so-far，因为重复发送不断增长的完整前缀会让带宽接近 {{quadratic}} 开销。
why: 4,000 token 回复如果每次都发完整文本，会反复发送旧前缀。delta 让每个 token 只跨网络一次。
why_en: Streaming deltas avoids repeatedly sending the growing prefix, which would make bandwidth scale roughly quadratically with answer length.

q: 把最终 token streaming 流程排成正确顺序：
q_en: Put the final token streaming flow in the right order:
steps: 客户端打开 runId 的 SSE 连接，落到任意 Chat Service
worker 生成 token 并 XADD 到 runId 的 Redis Stream
Chat Service 持久化用户消息并生成 runId
Chat Service XREAD 新条目并转发给浏览器
连接断开后新实例从 last-seen ID 继续读
why: 关键是 runId 把生成、读取和重连串起来，而 Redis Stream 提供短期 replay。这个流程同时满足低 TTFT 和不中断的 live stream。
why_en: The final streaming path uses runId plus Redis Streams so any Chat Service instance can forward live tokens and replay gaps after reconnects.
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client[Client] -->|prompt| Chat[Chat Service]
Chat --> Queue[Bounded Queue]
Queue --> GPU[GPU Worker]
GPU -->|XADD deltas| Stream[(Redis Stream)]
Chat -->|XREAD| Stream
Chat -->|SSE| Client

q: 补全 Generation 实体的生命周期字段：
q_en: Fill in the lifecycle fields for the Generation entity:
text: Generation 代表一次推理尝试，包含 {{runId}}、chatId/messageId、status（queued/streaming/{{done}}/{{cancelled}}/failed）、model、input/output token count。
why: 一旦需要排队、流式恢复、取消、计费和状态查询，run 就不再只是返回值，而是系统里的实体。它把后续深挖都挂在同一个抽象上。
why_en: Generation becomes a first-class entity once an inference attempt needs status, streaming identity, cancellation, and token accounting.

scenario: 一次生成可能占用昂贵 GPU 30 秒，前端流量有突刺，worker 处理能力固定且远低于峰值提交速率。
scenario_en: One generation can occupy an expensive GPU for 30 seconds, frontend traffic spikes, and worker capacity is fixed far below peak submissions.
q: Chat Service 和 GPU worker 之间应该加入什么？
q_en: What should sit between Chat Service and GPU workers?
options: 每个 prompt 新建一台 GPU 机器
客户端直接随机挑 GPU
请求队列，由 worker 有容量时 pull
把 prompt 存进浏览器等待
why: 队列把突刺前端和稳定后端隔开，worker pull 可以天然表达容量。它还给 admission control、tier priority 和 backpressure 留出位置。
why_en: A queue between chat and workers absorbs bursts and lets GPU workers pull only when they have capacity.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务极短且资源充裕，同步调用更简单；如果需要严格实时控制硬件，专用调度器可能取代普通队列。
tradeoff: 请求队列削峰 vs 直接同步调用的简单性
options_en: Spin up a new GPU machine per prompt.
The client randomly picks a GPU directly.
A request queue that workers pull from when they have capacity.
Hold the prompt in the browser and wait.

q: 只有一个无界队列但没有 backpressure 会导致什么？
q_en: What happens with one unbounded queue and no backpressure?
options: 所有用户马上得到 429
自动减少输入 token 数
GPU 利用率必然为 100% 且公平
持续过载时排队时间无限增长，用户不知道要等几秒还是几分钟
why: 队列只能吸收短暂突刺，不能创造 GPU 容量。队列深度不封顶时，延迟会无上限增长，产品体验变成永远转圈。
why_en: An unbounded queue turns sustained overload into unbounded wait time instead of a clear admission decision.
options_en: All users immediately get a 429.
Input token count is automatically reduced.
GPU utilization is automatically 100 percent and fair.
Under sustained overload, wait time grows unbounded and users cannot tell if it's seconds or minutes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在过载时主动限制或拒绝新请求，避免延迟无限增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure is a system deliberately limiting or rejecting new work under overload instead of letting latency grow unbounded.

scenario: GPU 每次前向都要把巨大模型权重流过计算单元，单序列 decode 会让昂贵硬件大部分时间等内存带宽。
scenario_en: Each GPU forward pass must move huge model weights through compute units, so single-sequence decoding leaves expensive hardware waiting on memory bandwidth.
q: 提升 LLM worker 利用率的核心 serving 技术是什么？
q_en: What core serving technique improves LLM worker utilization?
options: 连续批处理（continuous batching）
每个用户独占 worker
把完整回复先写 Postgres 再发
固定 sleep 让请求变平滑
why: continuous batching 让一个 forward pass 同时推进多条序列一 token，并在序列结束时立刻补入新请求。这样一次读取权重可以服务几十条生成。
why_en: Continuous batching keeps the GPU busy by advancing many sequences per forward pass and replacing finished ones immediately.
whenOtherWins: 如果模型很小、请求稀疏，简单单请求执行足够；高并发大模型 serving 才需要这套复杂调度。
tradeoff: 跨序列共享一次权重读取 vs 单序列独占 GPU
options_en: Continuous batching.
Give every user a dedicated worker.
Write the full reply to Postgres before sending it.
Add a fixed sleep to smooth requests.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让多条生成序列共享同一次前向计算，完成的序列立即被新请求替换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Continuous batching advances many generation sequences together in one forward pass and replaces finished ones immediately.

q: 补全 GPU batching 的直觉：
q_en: Fill in the intuition behind GPU batching:
text: LLM decode 常被说成 {{memory-bandwidth}} bound；batching 的收益是一次搬运模型权重，顺手为 {{many sequences}} 各生成一个 token。
why: 权重常驻高带宽显存，但每步仍要流过计算单元。批量越满，同一次权重读取摊到的 token 越多，利用率越高。
why_en: Decode is often memory-bandwidth bound, so batching makes one weight read produce tokens for many sequences.

q: 把带 backpressure 和 continuous batching 的生成调度排成正确顺序：
q_en: Put the generation scheduling flow with backpressure and continuous batching in the right order:
steps: worker 把请求加入正在运行的 batch
Chat Service 提交带 runId 和 token-cost estimate 的 generation
batch 每步生成 token 并写入 runId stream
admission control 根据队列深度决定接收、延后或拒绝
完成或取消后从 batch 移除并拉取下一项
why: admission control 先决定是否值得排队，worker 只在容量允许时拉取。continuous batching 则在 worker 内部提高每次 forward pass 的产出。
why_en: Admission control bounds waiting while continuous batching increases the amount of useful GPU work per decoding step.
diagram:
flowchart TD
Req[Generation Request] --> Budget[Check token budget]
Budget --> Queue[Tier queue]
Queue --> Batch[Continuous batch]
Batch --> GPU[GPU decode]
GPU --> Stream[Token stream]

q: 为什么普通 requests-per-minute 不是 ChatGPT 公平性的好指标？
q_en: Why is plain requests-per-minute a poor fairness metric for ChatGPT?
options: 限流器技术上无法用 Redis 实现
请求数不等于 GPU 成本，长 prompt 更贵
这种限流只能用于匿名用户
它会强制保存每一个 token
why: LLM 成本主要由输入输出 token 和模型大小决定，不是 HTTP 请求数。按请求限流会让巨大 prompt 低估成本，也会误伤许多短请求。
why_en: Request counts are the wrong fairness unit because GPU cost is driven by token and model compute, not by the number of HTTP calls.
tradeoff: 按 token/compute 计量 vs 按请求数计量
options_en: A limiter technically cannot be built on Redis.
Request count is not GPU cost; a long prompt can cost more than many short ones.
This limiting only applies to anonymous users.
It forces every token to be persisted.

scenario: 一个用户可能发很长 prompt 或要求很长输出，真正稀缺资源是 GPU token compute；同时系统有 free 和 paid tier。
scenario_en: One user may send a very long prompt or request a long output, the scarce resource is GPU token compute, and the product has free and paid tiers.
q: 公平与商业优先级的组合策略是什么？
q_en: What strategy combines fairness with business priority?
options: 全站共用一个全局 RPM 限流上限
所有用户完全随机排队处理
按用户 token 预算 + tier 优先队列
只按 IP 限流，不区分账号
why: per-user token budget 防止单个重用户吃光资源，tier-aware queue 在容量紧张时让付费用户体验更好。公平和 tier priority 是两件事，分别用不同机制处理。
why_en: Per-user token budgets prevent monopolization while tier-aware queues give paid users priority when capacity is tight.
whenOtherWins: 普通 REST API 的成本近似每请求相同，简单 RPM 或并发上限就可能足够。
tradeoff: 按用户 token 预算 + 分级优先级 vs 全局统一限流
options_en: One global RPM cap for the whole site.
Queue every user in fully random order.
Per-user token/compute budgets plus a tier-aware priority queue.
Rate-limit only by IP, ignoring the account.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户账号的等级（如 free/paid），影响调度优先级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tier is the account level, such as free or paid, that affects scheduling priority.

q: 容量紧张时，对不同 tier 的降级手段包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: When capacity is tight, which degradation moves can apply to different tiers? (Choose all that apply.)
options: 优先 throttle 或 defer free 用户
把部分 free 请求路由到更小更便宜的模型
付费和免费永远严格同等待遇
给 free 流量保留一个最低容量地板，避免长期饥饿
why: 文章强调付费优先但不能让 free 永久饿死。常见策略是限流、延后、降模型，同时保留最低份额。
why_en: Degradation can throttle, defer, or downgrade free traffic first while reserving a floor so it is not starved indefinitely.
options_en: Throttle or defer free-tier users first.
Route some free requests to a smaller, cheaper model.
Paid and free users always get strictly equal treatment.
Reserve a minimum capacity floor for free traffic so it is never starved.

q: 为什么 token budget 必须允许事后 reconcile？
q_en: Why must a token budget allow reconciliation after the request finishes?
options: SSE 协议无法携带 token 内容
Redis 数据库无法存储整数类型
付费用户完全不需要用量 quota
输出长度只能估计，真实值等完成才知道
why: 提交时只能根据 prompt 长度和 max output 估算成本，实际输出到结束才确定。软预算可以先 admission，完成后按真实用量校正。
why_en: Token budgets need reconciliation because output length is only estimated before generation and known after completion.
options_en: SSE cannot carry token content.
Redis cannot store integers.
Paid users need no usage quota at all.
Output length can only be estimated before completion, the real count is known afterward.
optionDirectness: 这里的 token 指用量单位，与 SSE 传输无关
Redis 原生支持整数计数，这不是限制
付费层同样有更宽松的用量上限
生成前只有估计值，完成后才有真实用量
optionDirectness_en: Here 'token' means a usage unit, unrelated to SSE transport.
Redis natively supports integer counters, this is not a real limit.
Paid tiers still have a wider usage cap, not zero quota.
Before generation only an estimate exists; the real count comes after.

scenario: 长对话每轮都发送完整历史，既贵又可能超出 context window，但用户仍希望模型记得早期内容。
scenario_en: Long chats become expensive and may exceed the context window if every turn sends full history, but users still expect the model to remember earlier details.
q: 最合理的组合方案是什么？
q_en: What is the most reasonable combined context strategy?
options: 摘要 + 最近原文 + prefix caching
只保留最近 N 轮，旧内容全部丢弃
每轮都发送全量历史，直到报错失败
把所有旧消息塞进 response header
why: summary 压缩旧上下文，最近原文保留高价值细节，prefix caching 让稳定前缀便宜。三者一起控制窗口、成本和记忆质量。
why_en: A rolling summary plus recent verbatim turns plus prefix caching balances memory quality, context-window limits, and input cost.
whenOtherWins: 短对话可以直接全量历史；一次性匿名问答可以只用当前 prompt；强事实检索场景还可加 retrieval。
diagram:
flowchart LR
History[Recent messages] --> Builder[Prompt builder]
Summary[Rolling summary] --> Builder
Docs[Retrieved context] --> Builder
Builder --> Model[LLM]
Model --> Reply[Assistant reply]
tradeoff: 分层记忆（摘要+原文+前缀缓存） vs 简单截断
options_en: A rolling summary plus recent verbatim turns plus prefix caching.
Keep only the last N turns and drop everything older.
Send the full history every turn until it fails.
Stuff all old messages into a response header.

termDefinitions.meaning: 复用稳定 prompt 前缀已算好的 KV cache，避免重复计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prefix caching reuses the already-computed KV cache for a stable prompt prefix instead of recomputing it.

scenario: 为了快速给一个长对话做成本上限，先只取最近 N 条消息，但仍要保持模型看到的顺序正确。
scenario_en: To cap cost for a long chat quickly, the system first fetches only the latest N messages, but the model must still see them in the correct order.
q: 这段查询后还必须做什么？
q_en: What must happen after this query?
options: 直接按 DESC 顺序喂给模型
把结果再翻回 createdAt 升序后拼 prompt
删除所有 assistant 消息
把 LIMIT 改成无穷大
codeSample:
SELECT * FROM messages
WHERE chatId = $1
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT $2;
why: DESC + LIMIT 是为了拿最新 N 条，拼 prompt 时必须恢复时间正序。否则模型会先看到未来回复再看到旧问题，语义会乱。
why_en: The newest rows are fetched descending for efficiency, but the prompt must be assembled in chronological order.
whenOtherWins: 如果数据库支持反向窗口后稳定排序，也可以在查询层直接返回正序；全量历史短小时不需要 LIMIT。
tradeoff: 恢复时间正序保证语义 vs 直接使用查询返回顺序
options_en: Feed the model the rows in DESC order as returned.
Flip the rows back to ascending createdAt order before building the prompt.
Delete all assistant messages.
Change LIMIT to unbounded.

q: 最近 N 轮截断相比 rolling summary 的主要问题是什么？
q_en: What is the main problem with keeping only the most recent N turns compared with a rolling summary?
options: 截断成本不固定
截断会增加输出 token 数
旧事实会突然消失，用户会感觉模型失忆
summary 不能和 prefix caching 共存
why: 只保留最近 N 轮能硬控成本，但第 N+1 轮外的信息直接丢失。summary 用有损压缩保留旧上下文的 gist，体验更连续。
why_en: Recent-turn truncation bounds cost but creates abrupt amnesia, while summaries preserve older context in compressed form.
tradeoff: 硬截断成本可控 vs 摘要保留记忆连续性
options_en: Truncation cost is not fixed.
Truncation increases output token count.
Old facts vanish abruptly and the model feels like it forgot.
Summaries cannot coexist with prefix caching.

q: prefix caching 对 TTFT 和成本的帮助来自哪里？
q_en: Where do prefix caching savings for TTFT and cost come from?
options: 让 Redis Stream 变成永久持久化存储
把所有输出 token 都缓存进 CDN 节点
减少数据库里存储的行数总量
复用稳定前缀的 KV cache，避免重算旧上下文
why: 同一对话的 system prompt、summary 和旧消息大多稳定，KV cache 可复用这些前缀。只处理新增尾部会降低 prefill 延迟和输入成本。
why_en: Prefix caching reuses KV state for stable prompt prefixes, reducing prefill latency and repeated input compute.
options_en: Turn Redis Streams into permanent durable storage.
Cache every output token inside a CDN node.
Reduce the number of database rows stored.
Reuse the KV cache for a stable prefix instead of recomputing old context.

termDefinitions.meaning: 推理时缓存已计算的 attention key/value，避免重复计算历史 token。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The KV cache stores already-computed attention keys and values so past tokens are not recomputed.

q: 为什么 rolling summary 不应每一轮都重写？
q_en: Why should the rolling summary not be rewritten on every turn?
options: 频繁改写 summary 会让 prompt 前缀失效
summary 一定会比原文更长更详细
Postgres 数据库无法存储 summary
SSE 协议不支持传输 summary 内容
why: prefix caching 依赖稳定前缀；summary 每轮重写会让缓存命中率下降。更好的做法是按较慢 cadence 折叠旧消息。
why_en: Rewriting the summary every turn changes the prefix and defeats prefix-cache reuse.
options_en: Rewriting the summary often changes the prompt prefix and invalidates the prefix cache.
A summary is always longer than the original text.
Postgres cannot store a summary.
SSE does not support summaries.
optionDirectness: 改写前缀会让已缓存的 KV 状态作废
摘要的目的正是比原文短，不是更长
Postgres 能存任意文本，不存在此限制
SSE 只负责传输，不关心内容是不是摘要
optionDirectness_en: Rewriting the prefix invalidates the already-cached KV state.
A summary is meant to be shorter than the original, not longer.
Postgres can store any text, so this is not a real limit.
SSE only transports bytes; it does not care about content.

scenario: 用户点击停止生成；token 下发走 SSE 单向流，不能把取消消息反向塞回同一条 EventSource。
scenario_en: The user clicks stop generation; token delivery uses a one-way SSE stream, so cancellation cannot be sent back through the same EventSource.
q: 取消一次 Generation 应该怎么做？
q_en: How should one Generation be cancelled?
options: 关闭浏览器标签页就自动触发取消
POST 一个 cancel 端点，标记状态并通知 worker
等完整 30 秒生成结束后再丢弃
只删除 Redis Stream 就足够了
why: SSE 是单向的，取消走单独 HTTP side-channel。worker 在 token batch 间检查 cancel 信号，看到后把 sequence 从 batch 中移除并释放 GPU。
why_en: Cancellation should be an explicit side-channel request that marks the Generation cancelled and tells the worker to drop the sequence.
whenOtherWins: 双向 WebSocket 可以在同一连接发 stop；但对纯 token 下发，SSE 加 HTTP cancel 更简单。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Cancel[Cancel request] --> Gen[Generation row canceled]
Gen --> Queue[Remove pending job]
Gen --> Worker[Stop active decode]
Worker --> Final[Persist final state]
tradeoff: 显式 side-channel 取消信号 vs 依赖连接关闭
options_en: Closing the browser tab automatically cancels it.
POST a cancel endpoint that marks the status and notifies the worker.
Wait for the full 30-second generation to finish, then discard it.
Just deleting the Redis Stream is enough.

q: 为什么“关闭 tab / 断线”不能等同于取消生成？
q_en: Why should closing the tab or losing the connection not count as cancelling generation?
options: 因为 Postgres 只在标签页打开时才写入
因为浏览器网络连接永远不会断开
系统支持断线重连和后台继续生成，用户可能回来
因为 Redis Stream 无法设置 TTL 过期
why: Redis Stream 和 SSE reconnect 的目的就是让临时断线不毁掉回答。取消必须是明确用户意图，否则网络抖动会浪费已经排队和生成的工作。
why_en: A dropped connection is not cancellation because the system intentionally supports reconnecting to an ongoing or completed generation.
tradeoff: 网络中断 vs 用户主动取消意图
options_en: Because Postgres only writes while the tab is open.
Because the browser connection never drops.
The system supports reconnecting and keeps generating in the background, so the user may come back.
Because Redis Streams cannot have a TTL.

q: 除了 serving 系统本身，还有哪些方向值得继续深挖？（多选）
q_en: Beyond the serving system itself, which topics are worth deeper follow-up? (Choose all that apply.)
options: prompt 与输出的 safety/moderation
模型并行与 GPU 间互联
speculative decoding
把聊天历史完全存在浏览器 cookie
why: 额外方向包括安全审核、模型如何跨多 GPU、speculative decoding、小模型路由/语义缓存、多模态和跨聊天记忆。cookie 不是合理的历史存储方案。
why_en: Additional deep dives include moderation, multi-GPU model serving, speculative decoding, cheaper routing and caching, multimodal input, and cross-chat memory.
options_en: Safety and moderation for prompts and outputs.
Model parallelism and inter-GPU interconnect.
Speculative decoding.
Storing chat history entirely in a browser cookie.

q: speculative decoding 的核心思想是什么？
q_en: What is the core idea behind speculative decoding?
options: 用 Redis Pub/Sub 直接代替 GPU 计算
把用户的 prompt 拆分给多个数据库处理
先把所有回复内容写进 CDN 节点
小 draft model 先猜 token，大模型一次验证多个
why: decode 是逐 token 的瓶颈，draft model 猜得准时，大模型一次 forward 能确认多个后续 token。它是高级 serving 优化，不是基础 CRUD 能力。
why_en: Speculative decoding lets a small draft model propose tokens that the large model verifies in one step, improving decode throughput when guesses are right.
options_en: Use Redis Pub/Sub instead of a GPU.
Split the user prompt across multiple databases.
Write every reply to a CDN first.
A small draft model guesses several tokens and the big model verifies them in one pass.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用小模型猜测多个 token，让大模型一次验证以减少逐 token 解码次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Speculative decoding uses a small model to guess multiple tokens that the large model verifies in a single pass.

scenario: 部分 prompt 很简单，不需要最大模型；免费用户在高峰期也可以接受轻微质量降级来换取可用性和成本控制。
scenario_en: Some prompts are simple enough not to need the largest model, and free users can accept slight quality degradation at peak times for availability and cost control.
q: 哪种策略可以降低成本且通常不被用户明显感知？
q_en: Which strategy can lower cost without usually being obvious to users?
options: 路由简单请求到小模型，并缓存相似 prompt
所有请求永远使用最大模型处理
把所有 prompt 都延迟到夜间处理
直接删除掉历史上下文内容
why: 模型路由和语义缓存能减少昂贵模型调用，尤其适合简单或重复问题。它还可以和 tier 策略结合，让 free 流量先降级。
why_en: Routing simple prompts to cheaper models and caching semantically similar answers can cut cost without obvious user impact.
whenOtherWins: 高风险、复杂、付费或需要最高质量的请求仍应走强模型；个性化强的回复不适合缓存。
tradeoff: 路由 + 语义缓存降成本 vs 统一走最大模型
options_en: Route simple requests to a smaller model and cache semantically similar prompts.
Always use the largest model for every request.
Delay every prompt to be processed overnight.
Delete the conversation's history context.

q: 单对话 rolling summary 和跨聊天记忆的本质区别是什么？
q_en: What is the core difference between single-chat rolling summary and cross-chat memory?
options: 两者都只依赖浏览器本地缓存
单聊压缩旧轮，跨聊天用 embedding 检索
前者只能用于图片，后者只能用于文本
两者都要求强一致的分布式事务
why: 单对话记忆是把本线程旧内容折叠进 prompt；跨聊天记忆要从许多历史对话中找相关事实。后者更接近检索系统，而不是简单 summary。
why_en: Single-chat summaries compress one thread, while cross-chat memory is a retrieval problem over facts from many conversations.
tradeoff: 单对话摘要压缩 vs 跨对话检索
options_en: Both rely only on browser-local cache.
Single-chat memory compresses old turns; cross-chat memory retrieves facts via embeddings.
The former only works for images, the latter only for text.
Both require strongly consistent distributed transactions.
optionDirectness: 跨聊天记忆需要服务端存储，本地缓存不够
一个是压缩，一个是跨会话检索，机制完全不同
两种记忆都只处理文本，与图片无关
两者都能接受最终一致，不需要分布式事务
optionDirectness_en: Cross-chat memory needs server-side storage, not just local cache.
One compresses a thread, the other retrieves across conversations.
Both kinds of memory operate on text, not images.
Both tolerate eventual consistency, no distributed transaction needed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把文本转成向量，用相似度检索相关内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding turns text into a vector so related content can be found by similarity.

q: 把“低延迟且不断流”这一 marquee 决策链排成正确顺序：
q_en: Put the marquee decision chain for low latency and uninterrupted streaming in the right order:
steps: 选择 SSE 作为浏览器的单向 token 流
Redis Stream 按 runId 保存短期 delta 供重连补洞
需求：TTFT < 500ms 且流式输出平滑
成本：SSE 单向，取消要走 side-channel
worker 通过 XADD 写 delta，Chat Service XREAD 并转发
why: 先由用户体验确定推送，再由部署和重连问题引出 Redis Stream。取消 side-channel 是选择 SSE 后的可接受成本。
why_en: The streaming decision starts from low TTFT, chooses SSE, adds Redis Streams for reconnect replay, and accepts a side-channel for cancellation.
diagram:
flowchart LR
Need[Low perceived latency] --> SSE[SSE to browser]
SSE --> Stream[Redis Stream resume]
Stream --> Decouple[Decouple workers]
Decouple --> Backpressure[Bounded queue]

q: 把“GPU 受限容量”这一 marquee 决策链排成正确顺序：
q_en: Put the marquee decision chain for GPU-limited capacity in the right order:
steps: 用 bounded queue 和 admission control 给等待时间封顶
需求：20k prompts/sec 峰值且 GPU 昂贵稀缺
用 continuous batching 提高每个 worker 的 GPU 利用率
成本：调度层更复杂，还要定义容量不足时谁被拒绝
在 Chat Service 和 worker 之间放 pull-based queue
why: 先用队列隔离突刺，再用 backpressure 防止无限等待，最后用 continuous batching 榨干 GPU。复杂性主要转移到 serving scheduler 和产品降级策略。
why_en: The GPU-capacity chain adds a pull queue, bounded admission, and continuous batching, paying for more serving complexity.

q: 这个成本量级最直接支持哪个设计判断？
q_en: Which design call does this cost estimate support most directly?
options: GPU 成本可以忽略
只要买一台 GPU 就能服务 120k streams
推理账单可能达到每年数十亿美金量级，所以利用率优化值得投入
成本主要来自 Postgres 存储
why: 文章用公开报道的十亿美金级推理成本做现实锚点，说明每个百分点的 GPU 利用率都是真钱。continuous batching、backpressure 和路由都因此有价值。
why_en: Billion-dollar-scale inference spend makes GPU utilization improvements financially meaningful rather than premature optimization.
scenario: 公开报道显示 OpenAI 2024 年推理算力开销约 18 亿美金，且逐年上升到数十亿美金级。
scenario_en: Public reporting put OpenAI 2024 inference compute spend around 1.8 billion dollars, rising toward multi-billion-dollar annual costs.
options_en: GPU cost can be ignored.
One GPU is enough to serve 120k concurrent streams.
Inference bills can reach billions of dollars a year, so utilization work is worth it.
Cost mainly comes from Postgres storage.

q: 中级候选人在这题里至少应主动识别什么问题？
q_en: What issue should a mid-level candidate at least identify in this design?
options: 必须能证明 Redis Stream 的内部源码实现
必须完整实现 speculative decoding 算法
必须设计完整的多模态 tokenization 方案
识别 30 秒空白屏问题，知道要 streaming 和排队
why: 中级期望是清楚 API、数据模型和同步 MVP，并能在提示下或主动看到 streaming 与队列。更深的 continuous batching、prefix cache 属于更高层级加分。
why_en: A mid-level answer should recognize that blank-screen synchronous generation needs streaming and that GPU work needs a queue.
options_en: Prove out the internal source of Redis Streams.
Fully implement speculative decoding.
Design a complete multimodal tokenization scheme.
Recognize the 30-second blank-screen problem and know it needs streaming plus a queue.

q: Senior 候选人的重点深度通常落在哪里？
q_en: Where should a senior candidate usually go deep in this design?
options: SSE vs WebSocket、GPU 调度与成本
只画一张 REST CRUD 流程图
只讨论前端 UI 文案细节
只讨论数据库范式设计
why: Senior 要快速过高层设计，把时间放在流式 fanout、GPU 调度、公平性和上下文成本。能讲清协议与调度取舍是关键。
why_en: Senior candidates should move quickly into streaming fanout, GPU scheduling, fairness, and context-cost trade-offs.
options_en: SSE vs WebSocket, GPU scheduling, and long-conversation cost control.
Draw only one REST CRUD diagram.
Discuss only frontend UI copy.
Discuss only database normalization.
optionDirectness: 覆盖协议取舍、调度和成本三个深挖点
只停在功能性设计，没碰非功能要求
文案不是这题的技术评分点
范式设计不是本题的核心难点
optionDirectness_en: Covers protocol trade-offs, scheduling, and cost in depth.
Stops at functional design, skips the non-functional asks.
Copy details are not what this question grades.
Normalization is not the core difficulty here.

q: Staff+ 答案区别于普通答案的标志是什么？
q_en: What marks a Staff+ answer as different from a standard answer?
options: 只是列出更多数据库产品名字
把 GPU 经济性、调度、公平和降级串成一个整体
刻意避免任何数字估算过程
把强一致性当成默认设计目标
why: Staff+ 需要带来超出模板的 serving 深度，尤其是 GPU 成本、推理内部优化和降级策略之间的连接。文章明确提到 speculative decoding 等知识也逐渐成为常识。
why_en: A staff-level answer connects GPU economics, batching, KV-cache reuse, tiered fairness, and graceful degradation into one serving architecture.
options_en: Just list more database product names.
Weave GPU economics, scheduling, fairness, and degradation into one coherent story.
Deliberately avoid any numeric estimation.
Treat strong consistency as the default goal.

q: 最终设计相比同步 MVP 增加了哪些关键组件？（多选）
q_en: Which key components does the final design add beyond the synchronous MVP? (Choose all that apply.)
options: SSE + Redis Stream 的 runId token 流
bounded queue、admission control 和 continuous batching worker
per-user token budgets 与 tier-aware priority queue
把每个 token 永久写入数据库作为唯一真相
why: 最终架构补上了 streaming、GPU 调度公平、上下文成本三块；每 token 落库仍不在范围内，只持久化最终 assistant message。
why_en: The final architecture adds resumable streaming, bounded GPU scheduling with batching, and cost-aware tiered fairness, not durable storage for every token.
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client[Client] -->|POST prompt| Chat[Chat Service]
Client -->|SSE runId| Chat
Chat --> DB[(Postgres)]
Chat --> Queue[Bounded Queue]
Worker[GPU Workers] -->|XADD deltas| Stream[(Redis Stream)]
Chat -->|XREAD| Stream
Queue --> Worker
options_en: An SSE plus Redis Stream token flow keyed by runId.
A bounded queue with admission control and continuous-batching workers.
Per-user token budgets plus a tier-aware priority queue.
Permanently writing every token to the database as the source of truth.
optionDirectness: 解决低 TTFT 和断线重连补洞
解决 GPU 调度、过载保护和利用率
解决公平性和付费优先级
违反「只持久化最终消息」的范围设定
optionDirectness_en: Solves low TTFT and gap-free reconnects.
Solves GPU scheduling, overload protection, and utilization.
Solves fairness and paid-tier priority.
Violates the scope of persisting only the final message.

q: 分布式缓存题的核心功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which core functional requirements belong in a distributed cache design? (multi-select)
options: set/get/delete key-value
为 key 配置过期时间 TTL
按 LRU 策略淘汰数据
支持复杂 SQL 查询和事务
options_en: Set, get, and delete key-value pairs.
Configure a TTL (expiration time) for each key.
Evict data using an LRU policy.
Support complex SQL queries and transactions.
why: 核心功能是 key-value 的增删查、TTL 过期和 LRU 淘汰；复杂查询、事务留给数据库，不是缓存的职责。
why_en: The core requirements are key-value set/get/delete, TTL expiration, and LRU eviction — not SQL queries or transactions.
optionExplanations: 对：这是缓存最基本的读写接口。
对：TTL 让条目按时间自动失效。
对：LRU 决定容量满时删哪条。
错：SQL 与事务是数据库职责，缓存不做。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: basic read/write is the minimum a cache must expose.
Correct: TTL lets entries expire automatically.
Correct: LRU decides what to evict when full.
Incorrect: complex SQL and transactions belong to a database, not a cache.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存条目的过期时间，过期后必须重新获取或重建。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is the expiration time after which a cached entry must be refreshed or rebuilt.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最近最少使用淘汰策略，容量满时优先删最久没访问的条目。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LRU evicts the entry that has gone the longest without being accessed.

q: 本题的核心非功能需求有哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which non-functional requirements matter most for this cache design? (multi-select)
options: 高可用，接受 eventual consistency
get/set 延迟低于约 10ms
支撑约 1TB 数据和 100k RPS
每次重启后必须恢复全部缓存数据
options_en: High availability, with eventual consistency accepted.
Get/set latency under about 10ms.
Scale to roughly 1TB of data and 100k requests per second.
All cached data must survive every restart.
why: 非功能需求是高可用、低延迟（<10ms）和规模（1TB/100k RPS）；跨重启持久化被明确排除在外。
why_en: The non-functional requirements are high availability, sub-10ms latency, and scale to about 1TB and 100k RPS — durability across restarts is out of scope.
optionExplanations: 对：缓存优先可用，弱一致换取始终能响应。
对：这是缓存存在的意义，要比数据库快一个数量级。
对：这是文章给的规模上限，后面容量估算都基于它。
错：durability 明确 below the line，重启丢失可接受。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: the cache favors availability over strict consistency.
Correct: sub-10ms latency is the whole point of using a cache.
Correct: this is the stated scale target the later capacity math is based on.
Incorrect: durability across restarts is explicitly out of scope.

termDefinitions.meaning: 副本可能短暂不同步，但最终会收敛到相同值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eventual consistency means replicas may briefly disagree but converge to the same value over time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒请求数，用来衡量系统吞吐量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RPS stands for requests per second, a measure of system throughput.

scenario: 面试官给出规模假设：最多要存约 1TB 数据，峰值约 100k 请求每秒。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives a scale target: about 1TB of cached data and roughly 100k requests per second at peak.
q: 这两个数量级最直接支持哪条设计判断？
q_en: What design decision do those two scale numbers most directly support?
options: 只要选对索引，单机 Postgres 就能扛住
这规模下不需要考虑复制或分片
单机内存和单机吞吐都不够，必须水平扩展到多节点
TTL 和 LRU 可以砍掉，专注加机器就够
options_en: With the right index, a single Postgres instance can handle it.
At this scale, replication or sharding is unnecessary.
Single-node memory and throughput are both insufficient — the cache must scale out across nodes.
TTL and LRU can be cut; just add more machines.
why: 1TB 超过单机可用内存，100k RPS 超过单机吞吐上限，两者都指向要把缓存拆成多节点集群。
why_en: Both the 1TB storage target and the 100k RPS throughput target exceed what one machine can hold, so the cache must scale out across many nodes.

q: 补全缓存题的核心实体：
q_en: Fill in the core entities for a distributed cache:
text: 分布式缓存最核心的实体就是 {{Key}} 和 {{Value}}，以及每个 entry 可能携带的 expiry timestamp 与 LRU node 指针。
why: 这题的领域模型很薄，难点不在实体丰富度，而在 TTL、LRU 和分布式扩展。面试里不要在实体阶段花太久。
why_en: The cache's core entities are simply keys and values, with metadata such as expiry timestamps and LRU pointers added for behavior.

q: 基础 API 应该暴露哪些操作？（多选）
q_en: Which operations should the basic cache API expose? (multi-select)
options: POST /:key 设置 value
GET /:key 读取 value
DELETE /:key 删除 key
JOIN /:key 做多表关联
options_en: POST /:key to set a value.
GET /:key to read a value.
DELETE /:key to remove a key.
JOIN /:key to perform a multi-table join.
why: API 直接映射 set/get/delete 三个操作；TTL 可作为 set 的参数，复杂关联查询不属于缓存接口。
why_en: The API maps directly to set, get, and delete; TTL rides along as a parameter on set, and joins are not a cache responsibility.
optionExplanations: 对：写入接口，可带 TTL 参数。
对：读取接口，未命中通常返回空。
对：删除接口，主动失效一个 key。
错：JOIN 是关系数据库能力，key-value 缓存没有多表概念。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: the write endpoint, optionally carrying a TTL.
Correct: the read endpoint, typically empty on a miss.
Correct: the delete endpoint actively invalidates a key.
Incorrect: joins are a relational-database feature; a key-value cache has no multi-table concept.

scenario: 先做一个单机 MVP，只需要支持 key-value 的 set/get/delete，并追求 O(1) 读写。
scenario_en: Start with a single-node MVP that only needs key-value set, get, and delete with O(1) reads and writes.
q: 最直接的数据结构是什么？
q_en: What is the most direct data structure for that MVP?
options: 哈希表 / map
B+ 树
倒排索引
优先队列
options_en: A hash table / map.
A B+ tree.
An inverted index.
A priority queue.
tradeoff: O(1) key 查找 vs 范围扫描/排序能力
why: 哈希表提供按 key 的 O(1) 平均查找、插入、删除，正好匹配单机 MVP 的需求。
why_en: A hash table gives O(1) average lookup, insert, and delete for exactly the key-based access this MVP needs.
whenOtherWins: 需要范围扫描或排序时 B+ 树更合适；需要全文检索时才轮到倒排索引。
optionExplanations: 对：按 key 存取，O(1) 平均复杂度。
错：B+ 树强在范围查询，这里没有范围需求。
错：倒排索引是搜索引擎结构，不解决 key-value 存取。
错：优先队列按优先级排序，不是通用查找结构。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: key-based access with O(1) average complexity.
Incorrect: B+ trees excel at range queries, which this MVP doesn't need.
Incorrect: inverted indexes power search engines, not key-value lookup.
Incorrect: a priority queue orders by priority, not a general lookup structure.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用哈希函数把 key 映射到存储位置的数据结构，平均 O(1) 存取。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash table maps keys to storage slots via a hash function, giving average O(1) access.

scenario: 缓存 entry 可以设置 TTL；访问时如果已过期，不能返回旧值，还应释放内存。
scenario_en: Cache entries can have a TTL; on access, expired values must not be returned and their memory should be freed.
