q: 微服务层面的吞吐扩展怎么做？
q_en: How should stateless microservices scale throughput?
options: 靠人工全天候盯着监控面板去手动添加机器
只做垂直扩展，一路不断买更大规格的单台机器
按 CPU/内存阈值自动水平扩缩容，每组服务前隐含负载均衡器分发流量
部署一台超大规格的单体 Redis 扛下全部业务流量
options_en: Have someone watch the dashboard around the clock to manually add machines.
Only scale vertically, continuously buying an ever-bigger single machine.
Auto-scale horizontally on CPU or memory thresholds, with a load balancer implicitly distributing traffic to each group.
Deploy one oversized monolithic Redis instance to absorb all business traffic.
why: 无状态微服务的标准打法：基于 CPU/内存指标自动水平扩缩，流量由每组服务前的负载均衡器分发。
why_en: Microservices scale horizontally and automatically based on CPU or memory thresholds, with an implicit load balancer in front of each scaled group.
diagram:
graph LR
    LB[Load balancer] --> Post[Post Service pool]
    LB --> Feed[Feed Service pool]
    LB --> Follow[Follow Service pool]
    Post --> DB1[(Post DB shards)]
    Feed --> Redis[(Feed cache shards)]
optionMeanings: 依赖人工判断和手动操作来响应流量变化。
把单机配置堆到硬件能买到的极限。
基于监控指标自动增减实例，负载均衡器分发流量。
让单个内存实例承担全部流量而不做分布式扩展。
optionScenarioImpacts: 响应速度慢，流量突增时容易来不及扩容。
扩容很快撞到单机硬件上限，且成本效率低。
流量增长时实例自动跟上，流量下降时自动收缩省钱。
单点故障和容量上限会让系统在高峰期直接崩溃。
optionDirectness: 效率低且响应慢，不是标准做法。
垂直扩展终会撞到硬件上限。
这是无状态微服务的行业标准做法。
不满足分布式、高可用的基本要求。
optionMeanings_en: Relies on manual judgment and action to react to traffic changes.
Pushes a single machine's spec to the hardware ceiling.
Auto-adjusts instance count on metrics, with a load balancer distributing traffic.
Puts all traffic on one memory instance with no distributed scaling.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Slow to react; traffic spikes can outrun manual scaling.
Scaling soon hits a hardware ceiling with poor cost efficiency.
Instances grow with traffic and shrink back down to save cost.
A single point of failure and capacity limit crashes under peak load.
optionDirectness_en: inefficient and slow, not the standard approach.
vertical scaling eventually hits a hardware ceiling.
the industry standard for stateless microservices.
fails basic distributed, high-availability requirements.

scenario: 面试官在 Instagram 系统设计面试里，对中级（mid-level）和高级（senior）候选人打分标准不同，主要看候选人在 feed 生成和媒体分发这两个深挖点上的表现。
scenario_en: In an Instagram system design interview, mid-level and senior candidates are judged differently, especially on feed generation and media delivery deep dives.
q: 中级和高级候选人的期望差异体现在哪？
q_en: How do expectations differ between mid-level and senior candidates?
options: 中级：给出可用高层设计，提示下能演进方案；高级：主动讲清 fan-out 权衡与选型论证
中级候选人必须在面试现场手写出可直接上线部署的生产级完整代码
系统设计面试对中级和高级候选人的期望标准完全一样，毫无区别
高级候选人完全不需要理解 feed 生成这个环节，只关注别的模块
options_en: Mid-level: a workable high-level design that evolves with hints; senior: independently explains fan-out trade-offs with justified choices.
Mid-level candidates must handwrite complete, deployable, production-ready code live in the interview.
The system design interview holds mid-level and senior candidates to exactly the same bar, with no distinction at all.
Senior candidates don't need to understand feed generation at all; only other modules matter to their evaluation.
why: 分水岭在「要不要提示」和深度：中级借提示改进即可；高级要自己驾驭 fan-out 权衡、名人混合方案、媒体上传与索引策略。
why_en: Mid-level candidates may need hints to evolve past fan-out on read, while seniors must independently master the fan-out trade-offs, the celebrity problem, and media handling.
optionMeanings: 准确刻画了两个级别在「是否需要提示」和「深度」上的差异。
混淆了系统设计面试和手写代码面试这两种不同的考察形式。
忽视了面试官对不同级别设定的真实差异化标准。
与实际情况相反，feed 生成恰恰是这道题的核心深挖点。
optionScenarioImpacts: 帮助候选人明确不同级别该展示到什么深度。
会让中级候选人误以为要当场手写可运行的生产代码。
会让候选人无法针对自己的级别调整表现策略。
会让高级候选人在最关键的深挖环节掉链子。
optionDirectness: 中级可以在提示下补方案，高级需要主动展开权衡。
只有代码轮才会要求可运行实现，系统设计轮看架构判断。
同一道题会按级别调深度，高级要少依赖提示。
feed 生成是核心深挖点，高级候选人必须能讲清。
optionMeanings_en: Accurately captures the gap in hint-dependence and depth between levels.
Conflates system design interviews with a separate hands-on coding interview.
Ignores that interviewers genuinely apply different bars per level.
Contradicts reality; feed generation is exactly the core deep-dive here.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Helps candidates calibrate the depth expected at their level.
Misleads mid-level candidates into thinking they must write runnable production code.
Leaves candidates unable to tailor their performance to their level.
Would trip up senior candidates at the exact deep-dive that matters most.
optionDirectness_en: Mid-level candidates may evolve with hints; seniors should lead the trade-off discussion.
Runnable implementation belongs in a coding round; this round evaluates design judgment.
The same prompt is calibrated by level, with seniors needing fewer hints.
Feed generation is a core deep dive, so senior candidates must explain it clearly.

scenario: 面试官对 Staff+ 候选人的评估重点，不是知识覆盖面，而是工程判断力：能不能在有限时间里抓住这道题真正的瓶颈。
scenario_en: For Staff+ candidates, the interviewer is testing engineering judgment, not breadth of memorized facts: can they find the real bottleneck under time pressure?
q: Staff+ 候选人在这道题上被考察什么？
q_en: What is a Staff+ candidate being evaluated on in this Instagram design question?
options: 要求候选人把所有 AWS 服务的具体名字都背得滚瓜烂熟
一开始就直接跳到设计最复杂、最重的分布式系统架构

快速锁定真正瓶颈、讲清规模演化路径、知道何时该升级，并预判故障与运维问题
options_en: Requiring the candidate to have every single AWS service name memorized cold.
Jumping straight into designing the heaviest, most complex distributed architecture from minute one.
Sketching just a few high-level boxes on the whiteboard is already enough.
Quickly locate the real bottlenecks, narrate the scale-evolution path, know when to upgrade, and anticipate failure and ops issues.
why: Staff 的信号是判断力：识别真瓶颈、按规模演化设计、复杂度只花在刀刃上，同时预判故障与运维成本。过早堆复杂度反而是减分项。
why_en: Staff candidates must quickly identify the real bottlenecks, articulate how the design evolves from one million to five hundred million users, and know when simpler solutions suffice.
optionMeanings: 考察的是知识记忆量，不是工程判断力。
一开始就堆最大复杂度，是常见的反模式。
只有框图缺少支撑细节，展现不出判断力的深度。
综合考察瓶颈识别、演化路径、复杂度取舍、故障预判四项判断力。
optionScenarioImpacts: 选它会让候选人误以为背知识点就能拿到 Staff 评价。
选它会让候选人从一开始就过度设计，反而暴露判断力不足。
选它会让候选人的设计缺少足够深度支撑评估。
准确展现候选人识别真正瓶颈、控制复杂度的能力。
optionDirectness: 背服务名只展示记忆，不展示如何取舍。
只有规模已经逼近瓶颈时，重架构才值得引入。
高层框图要配瓶颈、容量和故障分析才够 Staff 深度。
Staff 信号来自先找瓶颈，再按规模逐步升级设计。
optionMeanings_en: Tests rote knowledge, not engineering judgment.
Maxing out complexity from the start is a common anti-pattern.
Boxes alone without supporting detail don't show judgment depth.
Jointly tests bottleneck-spotting, evolution narrative, complexity trade-offs, and failure anticipation.

Leads candidates to over-engineer from the start, exposing weak judgment.
Leaves the design too shallow to demonstrate real judgment.
Accurately shows the candidate's ability to spot bottlenecks and control complexity.

Heavy architecture is justified only once scale creates the bottleneck.
High-level boxes need bottleneck, capacity, and failure analysis to feel Staff-level.
The Staff signal is finding bottlenecks first, then evolving the design with scale.

q: 在任务调度系统里，「Task（任务）」的准确定义是？
q_en: In a job scheduler, what's the precise definition of a Task?
options: 一次绑定了具体执行时间和参数的执行实例
抽象的、可复用的「要做的工作」，可被多个 Job 反复执行
用来触发周期性执行的 CRON 表达式规则
记录某次执行状态和结果的数据库行
why: Task 是抽象、可复用的工作定义（如「发邮件」），本身不含时间和收件人；它可以被不同 Job 反复调用。
why_en: A task is the abstract, reusable unit of work like send-email, which can be executed many times by different jobs.
options_en: A single execution instance bound to a concrete time and parameters.
The abstract, reusable unit of work that many jobs can execute.
A CRON expression rule used to trigger periodic execution.
A database row that records one execution's status and result.
optionDirectness: 这其实是 Job 的定义：Task 加上时间和参数才是 Job。
对；Task 本身不含时间和参数，可被多个 Job 复用。
这是 Schedule 承载的内容，不是 Task 本身。
这是 Execution 记录，是执行结果而非任务定义。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用固定语法表示周期性时间规则的表达式，如「每天 10 点」。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CRON expression is a fixed syntax for describing a recurring schedule, like every day at ten.

q: 在「抽象 vs 实例」这个维度上，Job 和 Task 的区别是？
q_en: On the abstract-versus-instance axis, what's the difference between a Job and a Task?
options: Job 才是抽象的工作定义，Task 只是它的一次具体执行
Job 是 Task 的一个实例：绑定了具体的 Task、调度时间和参数
两者在系统语义里完全等价，只是换了一种叫法而已
Task 本身携带执行时间和参数，而 Job 完全不携带
why: Job 是 Task 的实例，把「发邮件」这个 Task 加上「周五 10:00 发给 john」这样的时间与参数，才构成一个可调度的 Job。
why_en: A job is an instance of a task, pairing the task with a schedule and the parameters needed to run it.
tradeoff: Task（抽象定义） vs Job（绑定时间与参数的实例）
options_en: A job is actually the abstract work definition, and a task is just one concrete execution of it.
A job is an instance of a task, bound to a schedule and parameters.
The two terms are fully equivalent in the system's semantics, just a different name.
A task itself carries the execution time and parameters, while a job carries none at all.
optionDirectness: 说反了；抽象的是 Task，Job 才是一次实例。
对；Job = Task + 调度时间 + 参数，才能被执行。
两者职责不同：一个抽象、一个具体，并不等价。
又说反了；时间和参数在 Job 里，不在 Task 里。

q: 补全任务调度系统的两条核心功能需求：
q_en: Fill in the two core functional requirements for this job scheduler:
text: 用户可以调度 Job 在{{立即}}、{{未来某个时间}}或按{{周期性}}计划执行；用户可以{{监控}}自己 Job 的状态。
why: 两条功能需求：灵活调度（立即 / 未来 / 周期性）+ 状态监控。取消或重排 Job 属于范围外（below the line）。
why_en: The two core functional requirements are scheduling jobs immediately, at a future time, or recurring, and monitoring job status.

scenario: 面试官说系统要保证在调度失败时仍能对外服务，问在可用性和一致性之间怎么取舍。
scenario_en: The interviewer says the system must keep serving requests even when scheduling fails, and asks how you'd trade off availability against consistency.
q: 这个任务调度系统应优先保证哪一个？
q_en: Which should this job scheduler prioritize?
options: 应当优先保证强一致性，即使牺牲一部分可用性也在所不惜
高可用优先（availability > consistency）
可用性和一致性在这个场景里都同样无关紧要
只需要保证足够低的延迟，完全不用考虑系统可用性
why: 调度系统选择高可用优先于一致性：宁可偶尔重复或稍有不一致，也要保证 Job 能被接收和执行。这也是后面选 DynamoDB / Cassandra 的依据。
why_en: The scheduler prioritizes high availability over strong consistency, which justifies choosing an AP-style key-value store.
whenOtherWins: 如果是转账、库存扣减这类必须精确一次且强一致的核心账务系统，一致性才该压过可用性。
tradeoff: 高可用（宁可偶尔重复/不一致） vs 强一致性（保证唯一且最新）
options_en: Strong consistency should come first, even at the cost of some availability.
Prioritize high availability over consistency.
In this scenario, neither availability nor consistency really matters.
Only guarantee sufficiently low latency, without considering availability at all.
optionDirectness: 错；牺牲可用性换一致性不符合本题目标。
对；场景要求调度失败时仍能对外服务。
错；两者都很重要，只是有优先级取舍。
错；题目问的是可用性 vs 一致性，不是延迟。

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统始终能响应请求的能力，即使部分节点故障。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Availability is a system's ability to keep responding even when some nodes fail.

termDefinitions.meaning: 所有节点在同一时刻看到相同、最新的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistency means all nodes see the same up-to-date data at the same time.

scenario: 面试官报出该系统的三条硬性非功能指标，作为后续所有深潜的输入条件。
scenario_en: The interviewer states three hard non-functional targets for the system, which become the inputs for every deep dive that follows.
q: 补全本题的关键非功能指标：
q_en: Fill in the key non-functional requirements:
text: 系统要支持每秒 {{10k}} 个 Job，执行时间误差在调度时间的 {{2}} 秒内，并保证 {{at-least-once}}（至少一次）执行。
why: 三个硬指标锚点：吞吐 10k jobs/s、精度 2 秒内、至少一次执行。它们分别驱动了后面的分片、两层调度、重试三个深潜。
why_en: The system targets ten thousand jobs per second, execution within two seconds of schedule, and at-least-once execution.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保证消息或任务至少被处理一次，但可能重复处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: At-least-once delivery guarantees a message is processed at least once, but possibly more than once.

scenario: 非功能需求明确：Job 必须在其调度时间的 2 秒内被执行。
scenario_en: A non-functional requirement states jobs must execute within two seconds of their scheduled time.
q: 这条 2 秒精度指标，从设计角度直接排除了哪种朴素做法？
q_en: Which naive approach does this two-second precision requirement directly rule out?
options: 每隔几分钟轮询数据库一次找待执行 Job
用消息队列缓冲要执行的 Job
给 Executions 表按时间建索引
对新建 Job 的写请求做限流
why: 轮询间隔本身就是精度的天花板：几分钟一轮意味着最坏几分钟的偏差，2 秒精度必须换成别的机制。
why_en: A polling interval caps precision, so minute-level polling cannot meet a two-second requirement.
options_en: Poll the database every few minutes for due jobs.
Buffer due jobs in a message queue.
Add a time index on the Executions table.
Rate-limit write requests for new jobs.
optionDirectness: 对；轮询间隔就是精度上限，分钟级轮询天然打不到 2 秒。
队列本身不是精度瓶颈的对立面；轮询频率才是真正瓶颈。
索引只加快查询，不改变轮询频率这个根本上限。
限流管的是写入速率，与调度执行精度无关。

q: 本系统的核心实体（entities）包括以下哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which of the following are core entities in this system? (select all)
options: Task（任务定义）
Job（任务实例）

Job, an instance of a task.
Schedule, a CRON expression or a specific time.
User, who schedules and views jobs.

q_en: What does the Schedule entity represent?

Job 何时执行：一个 CRON 表达式或一个具体 DateTime
用户登录调度系统时使用的账号身份凭证信息
记录任务每一次具体执行结果的历史日志条目
why: Schedule 表示「何时执行」，用 CRON 表达式表示周期性，或用具体 DateTime 表示一次性。
why_en: The Schedule entity captures when a job runs, either a CRON expression or a specific datetime.
options_en: The actual business code logic the task runs once scheduled.
When a job runs: a CRON expression or a specific datetime.
The account credentials a user logs into the scheduling system with.
A historical log entry recording each concrete execution's result.

对；Schedule 只表示何时执行，用 CRON 或 DateTime。
错；登录凭证属于 User/认证范畴，与 Schedule 无关。

q: 创建 Job 的接口大致是怎样的？
q_en: Roughly what does the create-job API look like?
options: GET /jobs 不带任何过滤条件，直接返回系统里全部的 Job 记录
POST /jobs，携带 task_id、schedule（CRON）和 parameters
PUT /tasks/{task_id}，用来修改某个任务本身的执行代码

options_en: GET /jobs with no filters at all, returning every job record in the system.
POST /jobs carrying task_id, a schedule (CRON), and parameters.
PUT /tasks/{task_id}, used to modify a task's own executable code.

对；创建接口需要任务标识、时间规则和执行参数。
错；这是修改 Task 代码，不是创建 Job。
错；这是取消操作，且取消本就在范围外。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用固定语法表示周期性时间规则的表达式，如「每天 10 点」。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CRON expression is a fixed syntax for describing a recurring schedule, like every day at ten.

q: 查询某用户 Job 状态的接口，最合理的形态是？
q_en: What's the most sensible shape for the API that queries a user's job statuses?
options: POST /jobs/query 带一个 SQL 字符串
GET /jobs 按 user_id/status/时间区间过滤
GET /jobs/{job_id} 一次只能查一个
WebSocket 订阅所有 Job
why: 监控用 GET /jobs，按 user_id 过滤，并支持 status、时间范围过滤，返回 Job 列表。它对应「监控状态」这条功能需求。
why_en: Status monitoring is a GET on slash-jobs filtered by user id, status, and a time range, returning a list of jobs.
codeSample: GET /jobs?user_id={user_id}&status={status}&start_time={start_time}&end_time={end_time} -> Job[]
options_en: POST /jobs/query carrying a raw SQL string.
GET /jobs filtered by user_id, status, and a time range.
GET /jobs/{job_id}, only one job per call.
A WebSocket subscription to every job.
optionDirectness: 错；拼 SQL 字符串既不安全也不是 REST 风格。
对；GET /jobs 支持按用户、状态、时间区间过滤。
错；单条查询满足不了「查某用户所有 Job」的需求。
错；订阅所有 Job 既不精确也不符合监控需求。

q: 把 Job 从创建到完成的基本数据流排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the basic data flow of a job from creation to completion:
steps: Worker 在调度时间取走 Job 并执行（失败则指数退避重试）
用户提交 Job：任务、调度时间、参数
更新 Job 在系统中的状态
把 Job 持久化到系统里
why: 基础数据流：用户提交 → 持久化 → Worker 到点取走执行（失败退避重试）→ 更新状态。先建这条简单主线，再逐步增强。
why_en: The basic data flow is submit, persist, execute at scheduled time with backoff on failure, then update status.
diagram:
flowchart LR
    A["Create Job"] --> B[(Jobs table)]
    B --> C[(Executions table)]
    C --> D["Scheduler scan window"]
    D --> E["Delay queue"]
    E --> F["Worker executes"]
    F --> G["Update status"]

q: Job 刚被创建、写入数据库时，初始状态应是什么？
q_en: When a job is first created and written to the database, what should its initial status be?
options: COMPLETED
IN_PROGRESS
PENDING
FAILED
why: 新 Job 以 PENDING 落库，好处是有持久记录、崩溃可恢复、可全生命周期追踪状态。
why_en: A newly created job is persisted with status PENDING so it has a durable, recoverable record.
options_en: COMPLETED
IN_PROGRESS
PENDING
FAILED
optionDirectness: 错；Job 还没执行，不可能一落库就是已完成。
错；还没被 Worker 取走，谈不上执行中。
对；新 Job 落库即 PENDING，等待被取走执行。
错；失败要等真实执行后才会出现。

q: 把 Job 先持久化到数据库（而非只留在内存）带来了哪些好处？（多选）
q_en: What benefits come from persisting a job to the database instead of keeping it only in memory? (select all)
options: 拥有所有 Job 的持久记录
系统崩溃后能恢复未完成的 Job
能在整个生命周期追踪 Job 状态
无需任何 Worker 即可自动执行
why: 持久化换来记录、崩溃恢复和状态追踪三重好处；但执行仍需 Worker，持久化本身不会执行 Job。
why_en: Persisting jobs gives a durable record, crash recovery, and status tracking, but execution still needs workers.
options_en: It gives a durable record of every job.
The system can recover unfinished jobs after a crash.
Job status can be tracked across its whole lifecycle.
No worker is needed at all; jobs execute automatically.
optionDirectness: 对；持久化产生正式记录。
对；崩溃后未完成 Job 不会丢失。
对；状态可在整个生命周期被追踪。
错；落库只是留存记录，真正跑代码还得靠 Worker。

scenario: Job 数据关系少、不需要强一致、要方便日后水平扩展到 10k/s，面试官不限定技术栈。
scenario_en: Job data has few relationships, doesn't need strong consistency, and must scale horizontally to 10k/s later; the interviewer leaves the tech stack open.
q: 作者默认选用的数据库是？
q_en: Which database does the author default to?
options: 单实例部署的 Postgres 关系型主库
灵活的键值存储 DynamoDB（或 Cassandra）
专门存储节点和边关系的 Neo4j 图数据库
面向全文检索的 Elasticsearch 搜索引擎
why: 数据关系少、无强一致需求、要好扩展，因此选 DynamoDB 这类键值存储（开源偏好则 Cassandra）。Postgres/MySQL 也能用，只是后期扩展要多费心。
why_en: With few relationships, no strong-consistency need, and easy scaling, a key-value store like DynamoDB or Cassandra is the default.
whenOtherWins: 如果数据高度关系化、需要多表事务和强一致，或团队只用开源关系库，Postgres/MySQL 更合适（代价是扩展要额外下功夫）。
tradeoff: 易扩展的键值存储 vs 关系型数据库的强一致与多表能力
options_en: A single-instance, single-primary Postgres relational database.
A flexible key-value store like DynamoDB (or Cassandra).
The Neo4j graph database, built to store nodes and their relationships.
The Elasticsearch search engine, built for full-text search.
optionDirectness: 可行但要多费心扩展；这里的约束更偏好易扩展的键值存储。
对；符合弱关系、弱一致、易扩展这组约束。
错；图数据库为关系查询设计，这里没有那种需求。
错；搜索引擎面向全文检索，不是主存储的定位。

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 提供的托管键值/文档数据库，按分区键分散读写。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DynamoDB is a managed AWS key-value and document database that spreads reads and writes by partition key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 开源的分布式宽列存储数据库，强调高可用与横向扩展。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cassandra is an open-source distributed wide-column database built for high availability and horizontal scale.

termDefinitions.meaning: 专门存储节点和边关系的图数据库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Neo4j is a graph database built to store nodes and their relationships.

termDefinitions.meaning: 面向全文检索和聚合分析的搜索引擎。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Elasticsearch is a search engine built for full-text search and aggregation.

q: 把所有信息塞进单张 Jobs 表、直接存 CRON 表达式，会遇到什么根本问题？
q_en: What's the fundamental problem with cramming everything into one Jobs table and storing the raw CRON expression?
options: 这种单表设计根本无法把 parameters 参数存成 JSON 格式来使用
要找出「接下来几分钟该跑的 Job」，得扫描并求值每一条 CRON 表达式，无法扩展
这种设计里 user_id 这个字段完全没有办法被记录保存下来
一次性 Job（只用具体 DateTime 而非 CRON）在这种设计里也没法被存储
why: 单表存 CRON 时，找「即将执行的 Job」必须遍历求值所有 CRON 表达式，随数据量线性膨胀，不可扩展。这逼出「定义与执行实例分离」。
why_en: Storing CRON in one table forces evaluating every expression to find upcoming jobs, which does not scale.
options_en: This single-table design cannot store the parameters field as JSON at all.
Finding upcoming jobs means evaluating every CRON expression, which does not scale.
In this design, the user_id field has no way to be recorded at all.
One-time jobs, which use a specific DateTime instead of CRON, cannot be stored in this design either.
optionDirectness: 错；JSON 参数能存，这不是根本问题。
对；找即将执行的 Job 得遍历求值所有 CRON，线性膨胀。
错；user_id 只是普通字段，能正常存。
错；一次性 Job 本就能用具体 DateTime 存。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用固定语法表示周期性时间规则的表达式，如「每天 10 点」。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CRON expression is a fixed syntax for describing a recurring schedule, like every day at ten.

scenario: 需要支持周期性 Job（如每天 10 点），又要能高效查出「即将要跑的实例」。
scenario_en: The design must support recurring jobs (like every day at 10am) while still efficiently finding the instances that are about to run.
q: 关键设计洞见是什么？
q_en: What's the key design insight here?
options: 把 CRON 求值放到应用层缓存里
把 Job 的「定义」与它的「执行实例」拆成两张表
给 CRON 表达式建全文索引
改用关系数据库做多表 join
why: 核心洞见：分离「定义」与「执行实例」——像日历里「每周一重复的事件」会展开成一个个具体周一的实例。Jobs 表存定义，Executions 表存每次执行。
why_en: The key insight is separating the job definition from its execution instances, like a calendar expands a recurring event into individual occurrences.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有纯一次性 Job、永不周期，单表其实够用；分离主要是为周期性和高效查询服务。
diagram:
flowchart TD
    J["Job definition"] --> S["Schedule rule"]
    S --> E1["Execution 10:00"]
    S --> E2["Execution 10:05"]
    S --> E3["Execution 10:10"]
    E1 --> H["status history"]
    E2 --> H
    E3 --> H
tradeoff: 定义/实例分离（可扩展查询） vs 单表存储（简单但需遍历求值）
options_en: Cache CRON evaluation results at the application layer.
Split the job definition and its execution instances into two tables.
Build a full-text index on the CRON expressions.
Switch to a relational database with multi-table joins.
optionDirectness: 错；缓存求值结果治标不治本，扩展仍然受限。
对；像日历一样把定义和每次发生的实例分开。
错；全文索引服务不了「按时间窗口找到期项」。
错；换数据库不解决单表存 CRON 的根本设计问题。

q: Jobs 表（存 Job 定义）用什么作分区键（partition key）？
q_en: What's used as the partition key for the Jobs table (which stores job definitions)?
options: user_id（同一用户的 Job 会挤到同一个分区）
job_id（每个 Job 唯一，写入天然分散）
time_bucket（这其实是 Executions 表用的分区键）
task_id（同一个 Task 常被多个 Job 复用）
why: Jobs 表用 job_id 作分区键，每个 Job 唯一 → 写入均匀分散到各分区，天然避免热点。
why_en: The Jobs table is partitioned by job_id, whose uniqueness spreads writes evenly across partitions.
options_en: user_id, which would crowd one user's jobs onto a single partition.
job_id, unique per job, so writes spread evenly
time_bucket, which is actually the partition key used by the Executions table.
task_id, which the same task often reuses across many jobs.
optionDirectness: 错；同一用户的 Job 会挤到同一分区，容易热点。
对；job_id 天然唯一，写入均匀分散。
错；那是 Executions 表的分区键，不是 Jobs 表。
错；同一 Task 常被复用，会让写入集中。

q: Executions 表的复合主键设计是怎样的？
q_en: What is the composite primary key design for the Executions table?
options: 分区键选 job_id，排序键选 status 用来表示当前执行状态
分区键 time_bucket，排序键 execution_time+job_id
分区键选 user_id，排序键选 attempt 用来记录重试的次数
只用 job_id 一个字段作单一主键，完全不设置任何排序键
why: Executions 表用 time_bucket（按小时向下取整的时间戳）作分区键，execution_time + job_id 作排序键保证复合主键唯一，便于按时间窗口查询。
why_en: The Executions table uses an hourly time_bucket as partition key and execution_time plus job_id as the unique sort key.
codeSample:
{
  "time_bucket": 1715547600,
  "execution_time": "1715548800-123e4567-...",
  "job_id": "123e4567-...",
  "user_id": "user_123",
  "status": "PENDING",
  "attempt": 0
}
options_en: Partition key job_id, sort key status representing the current execution state.
Partition key time_bucket, sort key execution_time plus job_id.
Partition key user_id, sort key attempt recording the retry count.
A single primary key of just job_id, with no sort key set at all.
optionDirectness: 错；按 job_id 分区查不出「即将到期」的 Job。
对；time_bucket 分区 + execution_time#job_id 排序，能按时间窗口高效查询。
错；user_id 分区没法回答「这个时间桶该跑哪些」。
错；单一 job_id 主键查不出即将执行的一批 Job。

scenario: Executions 表用 time_bucket 做分区键，需要把任意一个执行时间戳映射到它所在的那个小时。
scenario_en: The Executions table partitions by time_bucket, so any execution timestamp must map to the hour it falls into.
q: 补全 time_bucket 的计算方式：
q_en: Fill in how time_bucket is computed:
text: time_bucket = (execution_time // {{3600}}) * {{3600}}，即把执行时间向下取整到最近的{{小时}}。
why: 按小时取整生成 time_bucket 作分区键，使得查「即将执行的 Job」只需扫当前小时（可能加下一小时）这 1-2 个分区。
why_en: The time bucket rounds the execution time down to the nearest hour by integer-dividing by 3600 and multiplying back.

q: 用「按小时取整的 time_bucket」作分区键，最大好处是什么？
q_en: What's the biggest benefit of using an hour-rounded time_bucket as the partition key?
options: 这种取整方式据说能够彻底消除任何形式的热点分区问题
查「即将执行的 Job」只需查 1-2 个分区（当前小时 + 可能下一小时）
这样的分区设计能够让 Job 的定义从此永远不会重复出现
这种分区键的设计方式能够自动实现 Job 失败后的重试逻辑
why: time_bucket 把同一小时的执行聚到一个分区，查即将执行的 Job 只需扫 1-2 个分区，读非常高效。代价是可能形成热分区，后面用写分片解决。
why_en: The hourly time bucket lets us query only one or two partitions to find all upcoming jobs, giving very efficient reads.
options_en: This rounding scheme supposedly eliminates any form of hot partition entirely.
Finding upcoming jobs needs only one or two partitions.
This partitioning design supposedly makes job definitions never repeat again.
This partition-key design supposedly automatically implements retry logic after a job fails.
optionDirectness: 错；分片才处理热点，光取整时间不会消除热点。
对；同一小时的执行聚在一个分区，读只需 1-2 个分区。
错；定义是否重复跟分区键取整无关。
错；分区键设计和自动重试机制是两回事。

q: 把某一小时的所有写入集中到同一个分区，潜在风险是什么？
q_en: What's the risk of concentrating an entire hour's writes into a single partition?
options: 会导致该时间桶下的读取查询明显变慢
重负载下可能形成热分区（hot partition）
会导致这套设计完全无法支持周期性 Job
会导致写入记录里的 job_id 字段丢失
why: 当前小时所有写入落到同一分区，高负载下会成热分区。作者在扩展深潜里用「写分片」（给分区键加随机后缀）来分摊。
why_en: Concentrating an hour's writes into one partition risks a hot partition under heavy load, addressed later with write sharding.
options_en: It would make read queries against that time bucket noticeably slower.
Under heavy load it can create a hot partition.
It would make this design completely unable to support recurring jobs.
It would cause the job_id field to be lost from written records.
optionDirectness: 错；这里的风险是写入集中，不是读取变慢。
对；同一小时的写入全部落在一个分区，高负载会撞热点。
错；周期性 Job 照常能靠新 Executions 行支持。
错；job_id 仍作为属性保留在记录里。

q: 在「定义 / 执行实例分离」下，周期性 Job 完成一次后如何安排下一次？
q_en: Under the definition-versus-execution-instance split, how is the next run of a recurring job scheduled after one completes?
options: 直接修改 Job 定义表里那个记录下一次调度时间的时间字段数值内容
保持 Job 定义不变，计算下一次执行时间并在 Executions 表插入一条新实例
把整张 Jobs 定义表原封不动地完整复制一份、再另存成一条新记录
先彻底删除这个旧的 Job 定义记录，然后再重新创建一个全新的 Job 出来
why: 周期性 Job 完成后，定义（Jobs 表）不动，只按计划算出下次时间、在 Executions 表插入新执行实例。不断生成新实例即可支持重复。
why_en: For recurring jobs the definition stays fixed while a new execution instance is inserted for the next computed run time.
options_en: Directly edit the time field in the job definition that records the next scheduled time.
Keep the definition unchanged and insert a new Executions row.
Copy the entire Jobs definition table as-is and save it as another new record.
First fully delete the old job definition, then create a brand-new job from scratch.
optionDirectness: 错；改定义会破坏「定义只描述规则」这个设计。
对；定义不动，只按计划插入下一次的执行实例。
错；复制整表既低效又没必要。
错；删除重建会丢掉 Job 的历史与身份。

q: 「把定义与实例分离」这一模式还常见于哪些系统？（多选）
q_en: Where else does the definition-versus-instance pattern commonly show up? (select all)
options: 日历系统：事件定义 vs 每次发生的实例
通知系统：模板 vs 单条通知
任务调度：Job 定义 vs 执行记录
负载均衡器分配请求
why: 定义 vs 实例是通用模式：日历（事件 vs 每次发生）、通知（模板 vs 单条）、调度（定义 vs 执行），处理重复 / 模板化行为很有力。
why_en: Separating template from instance appears in calendars, notifications, and schedulers alike.
options_en: Calendars: an event definition versus each occurrence.
Notifications: a template versus an individual notification.
Job scheduling: a job definition versus its execution records.
A load balancer distributing requests.
optionDirectness: 对；日历把「重复事件」拆成一个个具体发生实例。
对；通知系统把模板和单条通知分开。
对；调度系统把定义和执行记录分开，正是本题模式。
错；负载均衡分配请求，和「定义 vs 实例」模式无关。

q: 补全 Worker 拉取待执行 Job 的查询条件：
q_en: Fill in the query conditions a worker uses to pull due jobs:
text: Worker 查询 Executions 表：execution_time 落在接下来几分钟、且 status 为 {{PENDING}}；再去 {{Jobs}} 表按 job_id 查出完整定义后执行。
why: Worker 从 Executions 表按时间窗口 + PENDING 状态取出待跑实例，再回 Jobs 表取完整任务定义和参数来执行。
why_en: Workers query the Executions table for imminent PENDING entries, then look up full details in the Jobs table to execute.
diagram:
flowchart LR
    W["Worker"] --> Q["Query bucket"]
    Q --> F["scheduled_at <= now"]
    F --> P["status = pending"]
    P --> C["claim execution"]
    C --> R["run job"]

q: Job 执行过程中，Executions 表的 status 字段可能取哪些值？（多选）
q_en: During a job's execution, what values can the Executions table's status field take? (select all)
options: COMPLETED（完成）
FAILED（失败）
IN_PROGRESS / RETRYING（执行中 / 重试中）
PENDING（待执行）
why: 状态在生命周期内流转：PENDING → IN_PROGRESS →（RETRYING）→ COMPLETED / FAILED，供监控查询。
why_en: Execution status flows through PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, RETRYING, COMPLETED, and FAILED.
options_en: COMPLETED
FAILED
IN_PROGRESS / RETRYING
PENDING

q: 在只有 time_bucket 分区键的原设计下，「按 user_id 查某用户所有 Job」为什么低效？
q_en: In the original design keyed only by time_bucket, why is querying all of a user's jobs by user_id inefficient?
options: user_id 这个字段其实从一开始就根本没有被存储下来
需要先全表扫描 Jobs 找出该用户的所有 job_id，再逐个查 Executions 状态
DynamoDB 这类数据库天生就不支持按用户维度做查询
这种查询方式执行时会直接阻塞住系统里的所有写入操作
why: 主键按 time_bucket 组织，按用户查得先全表扫 Jobs 表找 job_id，再逐个查 Executions，两步都低效。需要为用户访问模式建索引。
why_en: Without a user-oriented index, querying by user needs a full scan of Jobs then per-job Executions lookups.
options_en: The user_id field was actually never stored in the first place.
It needs a full Jobs scan, then a per-job Executions lookup.
DynamoDB-style databases inherently cannot support querying by user at all.
Running this kind of query would directly block every write operation in the system.
optionDirectness: 错；user_id 本就存了，只是没建合适索引。
对；主键组织方式没有覆盖「按用户」这个访问路径。
错；DynamoDB 支持按用户查，只是需要加 GSI。
错；低效查询不会阻塞写入，只是慢和费资源。

scenario: 要高效支持「查某用户的所有执行、按时间排序、可分页、可按状态过滤」，同时不破坏主访问模式（找即将执行的 Job）。
scenario_en: The design must efficiently support querying all of a user's executions, sorted by time, paginated, and filterable by status, without disturbing the primary access pattern of finding upcoming jobs.
q: 最合适的做法是？
q_en: What's the best approach?
options: 在 Executions 表建 GSI：按 user_id 查询
把整张 Executions 表按 user_id 重新分区
每次查询都全表扫描
把用户数据复制到单独的 Postgres
why: 在 Executions 表加 GSI（分区键 user_id、排序键 execution_time+job_id），即可高效按用户查、按时间排序、分页、按状态过滤，且不动主访问模式。
why_en: A GSI keyed on user_id with an execution_time sort key efficiently serves user queries without disturbing the primary access pattern.
whenOtherWins: 如果按用户查是极低频的分析需求，也可离线导出到数仓再查，省下 GSI 的写开销和成本。
tradeoff: 加 GSI 服务用户维度查询 vs 保持主表只按 time_bucket 访问
options_en: Add a GSI on the Executions table keyed by user_id.
Re-partition the entire Executions table by user_id.
Do a full table scan on every query.
Copy user data into a separate Postgres instance.
optionDirectness: 对；GSI 让按用户查询高效，且不影响主访问模式。
错；重新分区会破坏「找即将执行 Job」这个主查询路径。
错；全表扫描在大表上代价太高，不可持续。
错；额外一套数据库带来同步和一致性负担。

termDefinitions.meaning: 全局二级索引，让 DynamoDB 表支持主键之外的额外查询模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A GSI, or global secondary index, lets a DynamoDB table serve queries beyond its primary key.

scenario: 已经在 Executions 表上加了一个按 user_id 查询的全局二级索引（GSI），用来服务用户查看自己 Job 的场景。
scenario_en: A global secondary index (GSI) keyed on user_id has been added to the Executions table to serve users viewing their own jobs.
q: 为用户查询加 GSI 的主要代价是什么？
q_en: What's the main cost of adding this GSI for user queries?
options: 加 GSI 会彻底破坏原来那条按 time_bucket 查询的主访问路径
增加一些写开销和成本，但换来高效的用户维度查询，值得
加了这个 GSI 之后会直接导致 Job 完全无法被执行
加了 GSI 会让读取变得不一致到几乎不可用的地步
why: GSI 会带来额外写入开销和成本，但相比在基表里冗余 user_id、让数据模型更复杂，用 GSI 维护多访问模式更划算。
why_en: The GSI adds some write overhead and cost, but it is a worthwhile trade-off for efficient user-side queries.
options_en: Adding the GSI would completely break the original time_bucket-based primary access path.
It adds some write overhead and cost, but the trade-off is worth it.
Adding this GSI would directly make jobs completely unable to execute.
Adding the GSI would make reads inconsistent to the point of being nearly unusable.
optionDirectness: 错；GSI 是额外索引，不会动主表的访问路径。
对；多写一份索引有成本，但换来高效用户查询很划算。
错；GSI 只影响索引维护，不影响 Job 是否执行。
错；GSI 是最终一致，不等于不可用。

termDefinitions.meaning: 全局二级索引，让 DynamoDB 表支持主键之外的额外查询模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A GSI, or global secondary index, lets a DynamoDB table serve queries beyond its primary key.

q: 「每隔几分钟轮询数据库找待执行 Job」为什么无法满足 2 秒精度？
q_en: Why can polling the database every few minutes for due jobs never meet a two-second precision target?
options: 是因为数据库本身根本不支持任何时间范围相关的查询
轮询周期本身就是执行精度的上界：每 2 分钟轮询，Job 就可能早/晚 2 分钟
是因为部署的 Worker 实例数量本身就完全不够用
是因为 CRON 表达式这种语法格式根本没办法被正确解析
why: 轮询频率天然是精度上界：每 2 分钟查一次，Job 最多可能偏差 2 分钟。要 2 秒精度就得每 2 秒查一次，但那样代价太大。
why_en: The polling interval is itself the upper bound on precision, so minute-level polling means minute-level error.
options_en: Because the database itself does not support any time-range queries at all.
The polling interval is itself the upper bound on precision.
Because the number of deployed worker instances is simply not enough.
Because CRON expressions as a syntax simply cannot be parsed correctly.
optionDirectness: 错；时间范围查询数据库完全支持。
对；多久轮询一次，就决定了最坏能偏差多久。
错；就算 Worker 再多，轮询间隔本身没变。
错；这里跟 CRON 解析能力无关。

q: 「干脆把轮询频率提到每 2 秒一次」为什么不可行？（多选）
q_en: Why is simply bumping the polling frequency to every two seconds not workable? (select all)
options: 10k/s 下每次要取处理约 2 万个 Job，负载巨大
即使有索引，查 2 万条也要几百毫秒，加网络和序列化可能 500ms
取回后还要初始化、分发给 Worker、启动执行，进一步吃掉精度窗口
每 2 秒的大查询给数据库巨大压力，影响其他操作和稳定性
why: 高频大查询四宗罪：单次约 2 万 Job 的大负载、查询本身几百 ms、分发执行的额外开销、以及持续压垮数据库。所以要换两层架构。
why_en: Polling every two seconds fails due to huge per-query payloads, hundreds of milliseconds of query time, distribution overhead, and heavy database load.
options_en: At ten thousand jobs per second, each query would fetch about twenty thousand due jobs, a huge payload.
Even with indexing, scanning twenty thousand rows plus network and serialization could take about 500ms.
After fetching, distributing jobs to workers and starting execution eats further into the precision window.
Running such large queries every two seconds would put heavy, destabilizing load on the database.

q: 把「两层调度架构」的完整流程排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the full flow of the two-layer scheduler architecture:
steps: Worker 持续轮询 SQS，消息到点变可见即被处理执行
用户创建 Job，写入数据库
Cron 把这批 Job 带上合适的 delay 发到 SQS
Cron 每 5 分钟查数据库，取出接下来约 5 分钟要执行的 Job
why: 两层架构：写库 → cron 每 5 分钟捞出未来 5 分钟的 Job → 带 delay 推入 SQS → Worker 持续拉取、到点执行。数据库低频查、队列保精度。
why_en: The two-layer scheduler writes to the database, a five-minute cron pulls upcoming jobs into SQS with delays, and workers poll SQS to execute on time.
diagram:
flowchart LR
    U["用户创建 Job"] --> DB[("数据库")]
    DB --> C["Cron 每 5 分钟查询"]
    C --> Q["SQS 延迟队列"]
    Q --> W["Worker 拉取执行"]

scenario: 要同时兼顾「数据库不被高频查询压垮」和「Job 能按秒级精度执行」。
scenario_en: The design must keep the database from being overwhelmed by high-frequency queries while still executing jobs with second-level precision.
q: 两层调度架构如何同时满足这两点？
q_en: How does the two-layer scheduler architecture satisfy both at once?
options: 让 Worker 直接每秒查数据库
查库低频（5 分钟一次），队列缓冲保证高吞吐执行
把所有 Job 缓存在应用内存里轮询
取消数据库，全部用 Redis
why: 两层解耦「查库」与「执行」：数据库每 5 分钟才查一次（低负载），消息队列高吞吐让 Worker 一到点就能拉取执行（保精度），去掉了执行频率的上界。
why_en: Splitting database querying from execution lets the database run infrequent queries while the queue delivers jobs at high throughput for precise execution.
whenOtherWins: 如果精度要求很松（比如分钟级即可）且规模很小，单层定期轮询更简单，无需引入队列。
tradeoff: 数据库低频查询 vs 队列保精度、高吞吐
options_en: Have workers query the database every second directly.
Query the database infrequently while a queue buffers jobs for high-throughput execution.
Cache every job in application memory and poll it.
Remove the database entirely and use only Redis.
optionDirectness: 错；每秒直接查库正是想避免的高频大查询。
对；查库低频、队列保证 Worker 能高吞吐及时拉取。
错；全放内存既不持久也无法跨实例共享。
错；去掉数据库会丢失持久记录和崩溃恢复能力。

scenario: 两层调度架构里，第一层负责定期把即将到期的 Job 从数据库捞出来，再送进延迟队列。
scenario_en: In the two-layer scheduler, the first layer periodically pulls soon-due jobs from the database and hands them to the delay queue.
q: 两层架构里，第一层 cron 每隔多久查一次数据库、取出未来多久内的 Job？
q_en: In the two-layer architecture, how often does the first-layer cron query the database, and how far ahead does it fetch jobs?
options: 每 2 秒查一次数据库，只取未来 2 秒内到期的 Job
每 5 分钟查一次，取未来约 5 分钟（留网络延迟缓冲）
每小时查一次数据库，取出未来整整 1 小时内的 Job
每天只查一次数据库，取出当天全部要执行的 Job
why: cron 每 5 分钟查一次，取出未来约 5 分钟内到期的 Job（留些缓冲应对网络延迟），大幅降低数据库负载。
why_en: The cron runs every five minutes, fetching jobs due within roughly the next five minutes.
options_en: Poll the database every two seconds, fetching only jobs due within the next two seconds.
Poll every five minutes, fetching jobs due in roughly the next five minutes as a latency buffer.
Poll the database once an hour, fetching jobs due within the entire next hour.
Poll the database only once a day, fetching every job due that entire day.
optionDirectness: 错；每 2 秒查一次又回到高频大查询的老问题。
对；5 分钟低频查询 + 留出网络延迟缓冲，兼顾负载与精度。
错；1 小时的窗口太粗，会让近期 Job 等太久才被发现。
错；一天一次连「未来 5 分钟」这个窗口都覆盖不到。

q: 新建的 Job 若安排在 5 分钟之内执行，为什么不能光靠「每 5 分钟的 cron」？
q_en: If a newly created job is due within five minutes, why can't the every-five-minutes cron alone handle it?
options: 是因为这个 cron 任务本身只负责处理周期性的 Job
cron 可能已经跑过、错过它，得等到下一轮（最多 5 分钟后）才被捞到
是因为数据库这时候会直接拒绝接受任何新的写入请求
是因为新创建的 Job 这时候其实还没有生成 job_id
why: 若 cron 刚跑完，5 分钟内到期的新 Job 会被漏掉，最坏要等下一轮（5 分钟后）才捞到，违反 2 秒精度。所以要给近期 Job 特殊通道。
why_en: A job due within five minutes can be missed by the periodic cron and wait up to five minutes for the next run.
options_en: Because this cron job is itself only responsible for handling recurring jobs.
The cron may have already run and miss it, delaying up to five minutes to the next run.
Because the database would directly refuse to accept any new write requests at that point.
Because a newly created job does not actually have a job_id generated yet at that point.
optionDirectness: 错；cron 的职责不分周期性还是一次性 Job。
对；cron 刚跑完的话，近期 Job 最坏要等下一轮才被捞到。
错；数据库正常接受新写入，这不是限制点。
错；job_id 在创建时就会生成。

scenario: 用户新建一个安排在 3 分钟后执行的 Job，需要绕过「每 5 分钟 cron」的漏检窗口。
scenario_en: A user creates a job due to run in three minutes, which needs to bypass the blind spot of the every-five-minutes cron.
q: 应该怎么处理？
q_en: How should this be handled?
options: 把它直接写进 Kafka 某个分区的末尾，排队等前面的消息处理完
写库的同时，直接带上对应 delay 发到 SQS，绕过 cron
把 cron 的轮询频率直接改成每秒执行一次来兜底
直接拒绝创建这个调度时间太近的 Job 请求
why: 调度时间 < 5 分钟的新 Job，除了写库还要直接带 delay 推入 SQS，绕过 cron 的漏检窗口，保证及时执行。
why_en: A job scheduled within five minutes is written directly to SQS with the right delay, bypassing the periodic cron.
whenOtherWins: 调度时间在 5 分钟以外的 Job 则不必直投，交给 cron 定期扫描即可，避免队列里堆积过多远期消息。
diagram:
flowchart LR
    N["New job"] --> T{"Due within 5 min?"}
    T -->|yes| Q["Send to delay queue now"]
    T -->|no| DB[("Persist only")]
    DB --> C["Cron later enqueues"]
tradeoff: 近期 Job 直投队列 vs 远期 Job 交给周期 cron
options_en: Write it directly to the tail of a Kafka partition and let it wait behind everything already queued.
Persist it and also send it to SQS with the right delay, bypassing the cron.
Change the cron's polling frequency to run every single second as a fallback.
Simply refuse to create this job request because its scheduled time is too soon.
optionDirectness: 错；Kafka 分区内严格 FIFO，晚到的近期 Job 只能排队等。
对；写库的同时直投 SQS 带 delay，绕开 cron 的漏检窗口。
错；每秒轮询又回到高频大查询的老问题。
错；拒绝创建不符合功能需求，且没必要。

scenario: 团队正在挑选支持「未来才执行」的延迟队列技术，有人提议直接复用现有的 Kafka 集群。
scenario_en: The team is choosing a delayed-delivery queue technology, and someone proposes just reusing the existing Kafka cluster.
q: 为什么不能简单地把「未来才执行的 Job」直接放进 Kafka 这类日志型队列？
q_en: Why can't jobs meant to run in the future simply be dropped into a log-based queue like Kafka?
options: Kafka 不支持持久化
Kafka 分区内严格有序，晚入队的排后面
Kafka 无法存 200 字节的小消息
Kafka 不支持多消费者
why: Kafka 分区内严格 FIFO，晚入队但该早执行的 Job 只能排在末尾等前面的跑完，无法按 execution_time 优先，破坏 2 秒精度。需要支持延迟投递的队列。
why_en: A log-based queue like Kafka delivers in order, so a job scheduled sooner still waits behind earlier-enqueued jobs.
options_en: Kafka does not support persistence.
Kafka delivers strictly in order per partition, so late arrivals queue behind it.
Kafka cannot store a 200-byte message.
Kafka does not support multiple consumers.
optionDirectness: 错；Kafka 本身是持久化日志，这不是它的短板。
对；分区内严格顺序消费，晚入队的早到 Job 只能排在后面。
错；200 字节的小消息 Kafka 完全能存。
错；Kafka 天生支持多个消费者组。

termDefinitions.meaning: 分区内严格有序的分布式日志型消息队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed log-based queue that delivers messages in strict order within each partition.

q: 第二层队列需要的关键能力是什么？
q_en: What key capability does the second-layer queue need?
options: 消息在同一个分区内部必须严格按照入队的先后顺序做全局有序投递
延迟投递（delayed delivery）：消息在接近执行时间时才对 Worker 可见
这一层队列需要原生支持复杂的关系型 SQL 查询和联表语法
这一层队列需要把系统里所有的消息都无限期地永久保留下来
why: 第二层需要延迟投递能力：让消息只在（接近）执行时间才对 Worker 可见，这样才能按 execution_time 精确触发，而非入队顺序。
why_en: The second layer needs delayed delivery so messages become visible to workers only near their scheduled time.
diagram:
flowchart TD
    D["Delay queue"] --> A["accept future timestamp"]
    D --> B["hide until due"]
    D --> C["deliver near due time"]
    D --> E["retry or DLQ on failure"]
options_en: Messages within the same partition must be delivered in strict, globally ordered enqueue sequence.
Delayed delivery: messages become visible to workers only near their execution time.
This queue layer needs to natively support complex relational SQL queries and joins.
This queue layer needs to retain every message in the system forever, with no expiration at all.
optionDirectness: 错；严格全局有序反而是这里要绕开的限制。
对；消息要在接近执行时间才对 Worker 可见。
错；SQL 查询能力和延迟投递无关。
错；无限期保留不是这里要解决的问题。

scenario: 想在中等规模上用 Redis 实现延迟优先队列。
scenario_en: The team wants to implement a delayed priority queue with Redis at moderate scale.
q: 该用 Redis 的什么结构，代价是什么？
q_en: Which Redis structure should be used, and what's the cost?
options: 用 Redis List 做 FIFO，无需额外代码
Sorted Set（ZSET）按 execution_time 排序
用 Redis String 存所有 Job
用 Redis Pub/Sub 广播所有 Job
why: Redis ZSET 以执行时间戳为 score 做优先队列，Worker 取 score < 当前时间的项。性能极佳（亚毫秒、原子操作），但要自己写重试、故障处理、管理副本避免单点。
why_en: Redis sorted sets score jobs by execution time for a priority queue, but you must build retries, failure handling, and replication yourself.
whenOtherWins: 在允许托管服务、追求零运维的场景，SQS 原生延迟投递更省心；Redis 适合禁用托管服务或已有 Redis 专长的团队。
tradeoff: 自建 Redis 优先队列（高性能，高运维） vs 托管队列（省运维）
options_en: Use a Redis List as a FIFO, no extra code needed.
A sorted set (ZSET) ordered by execution_time.
Store every job as a Redis String.
Broadcast every job over Redis Pub/Sub.
optionDirectness: 错；List 只能 FIFO，排不出「谁先到期」的优先级。
对；ZSET 用 execution_time 当 score 排序，但要自建重试和高可用。
错；String 存不出可排序、可范围查询的队列结构。
错；Pub/Sub 是广播语义，接收方错过就丢，不是队列。

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 的有序集合结构，按 score 排序存储成员。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A ZSET is a Redis sorted set that orders its members by a numeric score.

scenario: 考虑用 RabbitMQ 实现延迟投递。
scenario_en: The team is considering RabbitMQ for delayed message delivery.
q: RabbitMQ 实现延迟投递的典型方式及其难点是？
q_en: What's RabbitMQ's typical way of achieving delayed delivery, and what's the difficulty?
options: 原生 delay 字段，零配置
TTL + 死信交换机（DLX）模拟延迟投递
用 Kafka 分区偏移量实现
RabbitMQ 不支持任何延迟
why: RabbitMQ 靠 TTL + 死信交换机模拟延迟投递；高可用需要额外配置 quorum queues，否则集群只复制拓扑不复制队列内容。
why_en: RabbitMQ can delay via per-message TTL plus a dead-letter exchange, but high availability requires quorum queues.
whenOtherWins: 如果团队已重度使用 RabbitMQ 并接受其运维复杂度，它也能胜任；否则 SQS 的原生延迟更简单。
tradeoff: 自建 RabbitMQ 延迟（可控但复杂） vs 托管队列原生延迟（简单省心）
options_en: A native delay field with zero configuration.
Per-message TTL plus a dead-letter exchange (DLX) simulates delayed delivery.
Kafka-style partition offsets.
RabbitMQ supports no delay at all.
optionDirectness: 错；RabbitMQ 没有原生延迟字段，需要自己搭 TTL+DLX。
对；TTL+死信交换机能模拟延迟，但高可用要配 quorum queues。
错；这是 Kafka 的机制，RabbitMQ 不用分区偏移量。
错；RabbitMQ 能通过 TTL+DLX 组合实现延迟。

termDefinitions.meaning: 支持多种交换机路由模式的消息代理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RabbitMQ is a message broker that supports flexible exchange-based routing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 消息或缓存条目的存活时间，到期后过期或被路由走。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is the time-to-live after which a message or cache entry expires or gets rerouted.

termDefinitions.meaning: RabbitMQ 里接收过期或被拒消息、再转发到目标队列的交换机。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dead-letter exchange in RabbitMQ receives expired or rejected messages and reroutes them to a target queue.

termDefinitions.meaning: RabbitMQ 里基于多数派复制、保证队列内容高可用的队列类型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Quorum queues are a RabbitMQ queue type that replicates content across a majority of nodes for high availability.

scenario: 允许用托管服务、要求延迟投递 + 自动处理 Worker 失败 + 轻松扩到 10k/s，且尽量少运维。
scenario_en: Managed services are allowed, and the requirements are delayed delivery, automatic handling of worker failures, easy scaling to 10k/s, and minimal ops burden.
q: 作者最终为延迟队列选了哪个？
q_en: Which one does the author ultimately choose for the delay queue?
options: Amazon SQS（原生延迟投递 DelaySeconds + 可见性超时 + 死信队列）
自建的 Redis ZSET 优先队列，靠自己的代码管理重试和高可用
Kafka，一个分区内严格有序的分布式日志型消息队列
RabbitMQ 搭配死信交换机（DLX），并额外配置 quorum queues 保高可用
why: SQS 全托管、原生支持延迟投递（DelaySeconds）、用可见性超时自动处理 Worker 失败、死信队列兜底失败 Job、跨 AZ 高可用且自动扩展，最贴合需求。
why_en: Amazon SQS is chosen for native delayed delivery, visibility timeouts for worker failure, dead-letter queues, and automatic scaling.
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官或公司禁止用托管服务（要开源自建），就改用 Redis 等自建优先队列——务必先问清楚限制。
tradeoff: 全托管队列（省运维） vs 自建队列（更可控但运维重）

rows: 跨 AZ 自动高可用

options_en: Amazon SQS: native delayed delivery, visibility timeouts, and dead-letter queues.
A self-built Redis ZSET priority queue, managing its own retries and high availability with custom code.
Kafka, a distributed log-based queue that delivers strictly in order within each partition.
RabbitMQ paired with a dead-letter exchange, plus quorum queues configured separately for high availability.
optionDirectness: 对；原生延迟投递、可见性超时、死信队列、跨 AZ 高可用、自动扩展全部具备。
错；能做但要自建重试、故障处理和副本管理，运维重。
错；Kafka 严格有序，排不出「谁先到期」的优先级。
错；能延迟但高可用要额外配置，原生能力不如 SQS 完整。

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 的全托管消息队列服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SQS is Amazon's fully managed message queue service.

termDefinitions.meaning: SQS 消息的最小延迟投递参数，消息在这段时间内对消费者不可见。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DelaySeconds is an SQS parameter that keeps a message invisible to consumers for at least that many seconds.

termDefinitions.meaning: 超过重试上限的消息被转移进的兜底队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dead-letter queue catches messages that exceed the retry limit for later inspection.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分区内严格有序的分布式日志型消息队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed log-based queue that delivers messages in strict order within each partition.

scenario: 第一层 cron 只处理未来约 5 分钟内到期的 Job，随后把它们连同延迟时长送进 SQS。
scenario_en: The first-layer cron only handles jobs due within about the next five minutes, then sends them to SQS along with a delay value.
q: SQS 的 DelaySeconds（延迟投递）上限是多少，为什么这对本设计不成问题？
q_en: What's the cap on SQS's DelaySeconds, and why isn't it a problem for this design?
options: 上限只有 60 秒，覆盖不了我们需要的 5 分钟窗口
上限 15 分钟，而我们只需在 5 分钟窗口内投递，绰绰有余
上限是 1 小时，刚好能卡住我们需要的窗口边界
完全没有上限，可以设置任意长的延迟投递时间
why: DelaySeconds 上限 15 分钟；我们的 cron 只处理未来 5 分钟内的 Job，所以 5 分钟窗口完全落在 15 分钟限制内。
why_en: SQS caps DelaySeconds at fifteen minutes, comfortably covering the five-minute scheduling window.
options_en: A 60-second cap, which cannot cover the five-minute window we need.
A fifteen-minute cap, comfortably covering our five-minute window.
A one-hour cap, which just barely covers the window boundary we need.
There is no cap at all; any arbitrarily long delay can be set.
optionDirectness: 错；60 秒连覆盖我们 5 分钟窗口的零头都不够。
对；15 分钟上限远超我们只需要的 5 分钟窗口。
错；1 小时不是 SQS 的实际上限，认知有误。
错；DelaySeconds 是有硬上限的，不是无限。

termDefinitions.meaning: SQS 消息的最小延迟投递参数，消息在这段时间内对消费者不可见。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DelaySeconds is an SQS parameter that keeps a message invisible to consumers for at least that many seconds.

q: 关于 SQS 的 DelaySeconds，下面哪句最准确？
q_en: Which statement about SQS's DelaySeconds is most accurate?
options: 它是一个能保证精确执行时刻的严格承诺
它是最小延迟而非精度保证，但因为 Worker 持续轮询，额外延迟通常可忽略
超过 DelaySeconds 之后消息会永久对所有消费者不可见
这个延迟投递参数只对 FIFO 队列类型生效，Standard 队列不支持
why: DelaySeconds 是「至少延迟这么久」的下限，不是精确触发保证；但由于 Worker 一直在轮询队列，超出的那点延迟通常可忽略不计。
why_en: DelaySeconds is a minimum delay rather than a precision guarantee, but continuous worker polling makes extra latency negligible.
options_en: It is a strict guarantee of the precise moment a message will be delivered.
It is a minimum delay, not a precision guarantee, but continuous polling makes the gap negligible.
Past DelaySeconds, the message becomes permanently invisible to every consumer.
This delay parameter only works on FIFO queues; Standard queues do not support it.
optionDirectness: 错；它只是最小延迟，不是精确触发时刻。
对；是下限保证，Worker 持续轮询让额外延迟可忽略。
错；到期后消息会变可见，不是永久隐藏。
错；Standard 和 FIFO 队列都支持 DelaySeconds。

termDefinitions.meaning: SQS 消息的最小延迟投递参数，消息在这段时间内对消费者不可见。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DelaySeconds is an SQS parameter that keeps a message invisible to consumers for at least that many seconds.

q: 在扩展性深潜里，作者建议排查瓶颈的方法是？
q_en: In the scalability deep dive, what method does the author recommend for hunting down bottlenecks?
options: 先优化数据库，其他不管
从左到右沿数据流逐个组件排查瓶颈，逐一解决
一次性把所有组件都加缓存
只关注 Worker 层
why: 谈扩展时从左到右沿数据流走一遍，逐个组件找瓶颈并解决：Job 创建 → 数据库 → 消息队列 → Worker。
why_en: For scaling, walk left to right along the data flow and address each component's bottleneck one by one.
options_en: Only optimize the database and ignore the rest.
Walk left to right along the data flow, addressing each component's bottleneck.
Add caching to every component at once.
Only focus on the worker layer.
optionDirectness: 错；只盯数据库会漏掉队列和 Worker 层的瓶颈。
对；沿数据流从左到右逐个组件排查、逐一解决。
错；一次性全加缓存不看瓶颈在哪，容易做无用功。
错；只看 Worker 会漏掉更早环节的瓶颈。

scenario: 系统的执行吞吐上限是 10k Job/秒，其中相当一部分执行来自周期性 Job 的重复实例，而非新建请求。
scenario_en: The system's execution throughput cap is 10k jobs per second, and a good share of those executions come from recurring jobs' repeat instances rather than brand-new requests.
q: 为什么说「10k Job 创建/秒」只是 Job 创建量的上界、通常达不到？
q_en: Why is '10k job creations per second' only an upper bound on creation volume that's usually not actually reached?
options: 是因为数据库本身的写入能力根本达不到这个速度
因为支持周期性 Job，很多执行来自重复实例而非新建，实际新建量往往更低
是因为这套系统的注册用户数量本身就非常少
是因为 API 网关这一层对创建请求做了严格限流
why: 10k/s 是执行量。由于支持周期性 Job，很多执行来自复用的定义而非新建，所以创建量通常低于 10k/s——除非绝大多数是一次性 Job，那时创建服务才可能成瓶颈。
why_en: Because recurring jobs reuse definitions, actual job creation is usually below the 10k-per-second execution upper bound.
options_en: Because the database's own write capacity simply cannot reach that speed.
Because recurring jobs reuse definitions, so actual creation volume is usually lower than the 10k/s execution bound.
Because the number of registered users on this system is simply very small.
Because the API gateway layer applies strict rate limiting to creation requests.
optionDirectness: 错；写入能力不是这里讨论的限制点。
对；很多执行来自复用定义，新建量常低于 10k/s 上界。
错；用户数量和这个论证无关。
错；限流是保护手段，不是创建量偏低的原因。

scenario: 在扩展 Job 创建时，有人提议在 API 与 Job 创建服务之间加一层 Kafka 做缓冲。
scenario_en: While scaling job creation, someone proposes adding a Kafka buffering layer between the API and the job creation service.
q: 作者对此的立场是？
q_en: What's the author's stance on this?
options: 必须无条件加上这层队列，否则系统在高负载下一定会崩溃
多半是过度设计：数据库能直接扛写入、服务本可水平扩展，除非有昂贵业务逻辑要隔离，否则保持简单
应该在 API 和数据库之间再叠加两层不同的消息队列
消息队列这时候完全可以替代数据库承担持久化的职责
why: 加 Kafka 缓冲通常是过度设计：数据库能直接承接写入，前面的服务本就可水平扩展。除非创建服务里有昂贵业务逻辑要隔离，否则先把数据库和服务层扩好，保持架构简单。
why_en: Buffering job creation with a queue is usually overcomplication since the database and a horizontally scaled service suffice.
whenOtherWins: 如果创建路径里有昂贵、易失败的业务逻辑需要削峰和隔离，或写入确实突发到压垮数据库，加缓冲队列才划算。
tradeoff: 简单直接（服务+数据库） vs 额外缓冲队列（隔离但更复杂）
options_en: This queue layer must be added unconditionally, or the system will definitely crash under load.
Usually overcomplication: the database and a horizontally scaled service already suffice.
Two separate layers of message queues should be stacked between the API and the database.
A message queue could fully replace the database's job of persisting data at this point.
optionDirectness: 错；把「必须加」说绝对，忽视了简单方案够用的情况。
对；数据库能直接扛写入，服务本可水平扩展，无需额外队列。
错；两层队列会让本可以简单的创建路径更复杂。
错；队列不能替代持久化存储的角色。

scenario: Jobs 表按 job_id 分区，Executions 表按 time_bucket 分区；DynamoDB 单个分区的写容量存在上限（约 1,000 WCU）。
scenario_en: The Jobs table partitions by job_id and Executions by time_bucket; a single DynamoDB partition has a write-capacity cap of roughly 1,000 WCU.
q: 这个分区级写容量上限，对分区键设计提出了什么要求？
q_en: What does this per-partition write-capacity cap demand from the partition key design?
options: 分区键必须让写入天然分散到多个分区，否则会撞上限
只要提高读容量就能绕开这个限制
换成 SSD 存储就没有这个限制
分区键随便选，DynamoDB 会自动无限扩容单分区
why: 单分区写容量有限，所以分区键要能让写入自然打散——job_id 唯一天然分散，time_bucket 则可能集中，需要写分片来补。
why_en: Because a single partition's write capacity is capped, the partition key must spread writes naturally across many partitions.
options_en: The partition key must let writes spread naturally, or it will hit the limit.
Just raising read capacity works around it.
Switching to SSD storage removes the limit.
The partition key does not matter; DynamoDB auto-scales a single partition without limit.
optionDirectness: 对；唯一性强的键天然分散，容易集中的键则要靠分片补救。
错；读容量和写容量是两个独立维度，不能互相替代。
错；存储介质不是分区写容量上限的成因。
错；单分区写容量是硬上限，不会自动无限扩容。

termDefinitions.meaning: 写容量单位，衡量 DynamoDB 一个分区每秒能承受的写入量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A WCU, or write capacity unit, measures how much write throughput a DynamoDB partition can absorb per second.

scenario: Executions 表按 time_bucket 分区，当前小时的所有写入都砸向同一个分区，形成热分区。
scenario_en: The Executions table partitions by time_bucket, so every write in the current hour lands on the same partition, forming a hot partition.
q: 怎么缓解这个热分区？
q_en: How do you relieve this hot partition?
options: 改用 job_id 作 Executions 分区键
写分片：分区键加随机后缀，写入分散到多分区
把整表搬到内存
降低写入速率
why: 写分片：在 time_bucket 后加随机后缀（time_bucket#shard_3）把同一小时的写分散到多个分区；读取时 Worker 并行查该时间桶的所有分片再合并。
why_en: Write sharding appends a random suffix to the time_bucket so writes spread across partitions, with workers querying all shards in parallel.
whenOtherWins: 如果写入量本就均匀、单分区没到 1,000 WCU，就无需分片——分片会增加读放大（要查多个分片）。
diagram:
flowchart LR
    B["time_bucket"] --> H["hot partition"]
    H --> S1["bucket#0"]
    H --> S2["bucket#1"]
    H --> S3["bucket#N"]
    S1 --> P1[("partition")]
    S2 --> P2[("partition")]
    S3 --> P3[("partition")]
tradeoff: 写分片分散热点 vs 读取要并行查多个分片
options_en: Switch the Executions table to job_id as partition key.
Write sharding: append a random suffix to the partition key so writes spread out.
Move the entire table into memory.
Reduce the write rate.
optionDirectness: 错；job_id 分区解决不了「同一小时执行」这个查询模式。
对；给分区键加随机分片后缀，把写分散到多个分区。
错；搬到内存不解决持久化和一致性问题。
错；降低写入速率不是本设计能控制的杠杆。

q: 给 Executions 表做写分片后，Worker 读取时要相应做什么？
q_en: After write-sharding the Executions table, what must workers do differently when reading?
options: 只查一个分片即可
并行查询某个时间桶下的所有分片，再合并结果
改成全表扫描
不再需要查 Executions 表
why: 写分片把一个时间桶拆成多个分区，所以 Worker 要并行查该桶所有分片再合并，这是分片带来的读放大代价。
why_en: After write sharding, workers must query all shards of a time bucket in parallel and merge the results.
diagram:
flowchart LR
    W["Worker window"] --> R0["read shard 0"]
    W --> R1["read shard 1"]
    W --> RN["read shard N"]
    R0 --> M["merge due executions"]
    R1 --> M
    RN --> M
    M --> Q["enqueue"]
options_en: Query only a single shard.
Query all shards of a time bucket in parallel and merge the results.
Fall back to a full table scan.
The Executions table is no longer needed.
optionDirectness: 错；只查一个分片会漏掉其他分片里到期的 Job。
对；要并行查该时间桶下所有分片再合并结果。
错；全表扫描比查有限分片代价高得多。
错；Executions 表仍是找到期 Job 的唯一来源。

scenario: 已执行完的 Job 要保留供用户查询，但长期堆在主表里成本高。
scenario_en: Completed jobs must stay queryable for users, but leaving them in the main table long-term is costly.
q: 合理的数据生命周期策略是？
q_en: What's a sensible data lifecycle policy?
options: Job 一旦执行完毕就立刻把它的记录从数据库里删除
近期保留在主表；过了合理期限（如 1 年）迁到更便宜的存储如 S3
不论新旧，把所有 Job 记录永久留在 DynamoDB 主表里
只保留执行失败的 Job 记录，成功的 Job 记录直接丢弃
why: 执行完的 Job 短期留主表供查询，超过合理期限（如 1 年）后迁到 S3 这类廉价存储，兼顾可查询性与成本。
why_en: Keep recent executed jobs queryable, then archive older ones (after about a year) to cheaper storage like S3.
whenOtherWins: 若合规要求随时快速查询历史全量，或数据量小到成本可忽略，就没必要下沉冷存储。
tradeoff: 可查询性（主表） vs 存储成本（冷归档）
options_en: Delete a job's record from the database the instant it finishes executing.
Keep recent jobs queryable in the main table; archive older ones (say, after a year) to cheaper storage like S3.
Keep every job record, old or new, permanently in the DynamoDB main table forever.
Only keep records for jobs that failed, and discard the records of successful ones.
optionDirectness: 错；立刻删除会让用户无法查询历史执行记录。
对；近期留主表可查，超期迁到 S3 这类廉价存储。
错；永久留在 DynamoDB 成本会持续增长。
错；用户同样需要查已成功的 Job，不能只留失败的。

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 的对象存储服务，常用于低成本长期存档。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: S3 is AWS's object storage service, commonly used for low-cost long-term archiving.

scenario: 10k Job/秒执行，5 分钟窗口内约产生 300 万条消息，每条约 200 字节（只含 job_id、执行时间和少量元数据）。
scenario_en: At 10k jobs per second, a five-minute window produces about three million messages, each around 200 bytes containing just the job_id, execution time, and a bit of metadata.
q: 这个消息体大小和总量量级，对队列选型意味着什么？
q_en: What do this message size and total volume imply for choosing a queue?
options: 消息足够小、总量在托管队列吞吐范围内，无需分片或搬去对象存储
消息太大，必须把正文存到 S3、队列里只放指针
必须手动给 SQS 分区才能扛住
这个量级会超过任何托管队列的能力，只能自建
why: 约 600MB/5 分钟、每条约 200 字节，远低于 SQS 单消息 256KB 上限和 Standard 队列的吞吐能力，不需要额外分片或对象存储。
why_en: At roughly 200 bytes per message and 600 megabytes per five-minute window, this comfortably fits a standard managed queue with no extra sharding.
options_en: The messages are small enough and the total fits a managed queue's throughput without extra sharding.
Messages are too large, so payloads must live in S3 with only a pointer in the queue.
SQS must be manually partitioned to handle this.
This scale exceeds what any managed queue can handle.
optionDirectness: 对；量级远在托管队列吞吐范围内，不必额外处理。
错；200 字节远小于 SQS 单条 256KB 上限，不需要外置存储。
错；SQS Standard 队列自动分发，不需要手动分区。
错；这个量级对成熟托管队列来说很常规，并不极限。

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 的全托管消息队列服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SQS is Amazon's fully managed message queue service.

q: 关于用 SQS Standard 队列承接 10k 消息/秒，正确的是？
q_en: Which statement about using an SQS Standard queue to absorb 10k messages per second is correct?
options: 承接这个吞吐需要对 SQS 手动做分片和分区配置
Standard 队列吞吐几乎无限，10k/s 无需特殊配置就能满足，AWS 自动扩展与分发
这个吞吐量会直接超过 SQS 的上限，必须换成 Kafka
承接这个吞吐必须使用 FIFO 队列类型才行
why: SQS Standard 队列吞吐几乎无限、自动扩展和跨消费者分发，10k/s 轻松满足，无需手动分片/分区。
why_en: SQS Standard queues offer virtually unlimited throughput and auto-scaling, easily handling ten thousand messages per second.
options_en: Absorbing this throughput requires manually configuring sharding and partitions on SQS.
Standard queues have near-unlimited throughput and auto-scale, easily handling 10k/s.
This throughput would directly exceed SQS's limit, forcing a switch to Kafka.
Absorbing this throughput requires using the FIFO queue type specifically.
optionDirectness: 错；Standard 队列的扩展由 AWS 自动处理，不需要手动分片。
对；这个吞吐水位远低于 Standard 队列的承载能力。
错；不会超过上限，也不需要换 Kafka。
错；FIFO 队列反而吞吐更受限，这里不需要严格顺序。

scenario: 有人问既然 SQS 吞吐够用，那还需要多个队列吗？
scenario_en: Someone asks: if SQS throughput is already sufficient, do we still need multiple queues?
q: 什么情况下才用多个队列？
q_en: Under what circumstances would you actually use multiple queues?
options: 单纯为了把吞吐量拆分扩展开才使用多个队列
只为功能隔离（如不同优先级 / 不同类型 Job 各用一个队列），而非为扩展
给每一个 Worker 实例单独配一个专属的队列
这套架构里其实永远都不会需要用到多个队列
why: SQS 自动扩展，不必为吞吐分多队列；用多队列只为功能分离——比如按优先级或 Job 类型隔离。
why_en: Multiple queues are for functional separation like priorities or job types, not for scaling throughput.
whenOtherWins: 如果所有 Job 优先级和类型一致，单队列即可，多队列只会徒增运维复杂度。
tradeoff: 单队列（简单） vs 多队列（功能隔离，运维稍增）
options_en: Multiple queues are used purely to split and scale out throughput.
Only for functional separation, like different priorities or job types, not for scaling.
Give each individual worker instance its own dedicated queue.
This architecture would actually never need multiple queues at all.
optionDirectness: 错；SQS 本身自动扩展，不需要靠分队列扩吞吐。
对；多队列只为功能隔离，比如按优先级或类型分开。
错；每个 Worker 一个队列会让消费逻辑复杂又难维护。
错；功能隔离（如优先级）时多队列仍然有用。

scenario: Worker 层要处理 10k/s、2 秒精度的稳定可预测高负载，在容器（ECS/K8s）和 Lambda 之间选。
scenario_en: The worker layer must handle a steady, predictable 10k/s load at two-second precision, choosing between containers (ECS/K8s) and Lambda.
q: 作者更倾向哪种，为什么？
q_en: Which does the author lean toward, and why?
options: Lambda，因为它是完全无服务器、几乎零运维成本的方案
容器（ECS + 自动扩缩），因为稳定高负载下更省成本、无冷启动、可长运行任务
裸机物理服务器，自己采购硬件并手动运维整套集群
把整段执行逻辑下放到用户的客户端设备上去运行
why: 稳定可预测的高负载 + 2 秒精度，容器（ECS + auto-scaling）更省成本、无冷启动、支持长任务；Lambda 的冷启动会威胁精度，且稳定高负载下更贵。没有唯一正确答案。
why_en: For steady high-volume load with tight precision, containers on ECS are cheaper and avoid cold starts, unlike Lambda.
whenOtherWins: 如果是短时（<15 分钟）、突发、不可预测的负载，Lambda 的即时弹性和零运维反而更合适。
tradeoff: 容器（省成本，无冷启动） vs Lambda（弹性极强，有冷启动）
options_en: Lambda, because it is a fully serverless option with almost zero operational cost.
Containers on ECS with autoscaling, because steady high load is cheaper and avoids cold starts.
Bare-metal physical servers, procured and operated by hand as a self-managed cluster.
Push the entire execution logic down to run on the user's client device instead.
optionDirectness: 错；无服务器架构在这种稳定高负载下反而更贵更不稳。
对；稳定可预测的高负载下容器更省成本、无冷启动。
错；裸机运维成本极高，偏离了托管化的方向。
错；客户端设备不可控，无法保证可用性和精度。

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 的容器编排服务，管理和调度容器实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ECS is AWS's container orchestration service for running and scaling containers.

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 的无服务器计算服务，按调用自动扩缩、无需管理服务器。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Lambda is AWS's serverless compute service that scales automatically per invocation with no servers to manage.

q: 在「冷启动 vs 弹性」上，Lambda 相对容器的特点是？
q_en: On the cold-start-versus-elasticity axis, how does Lambda compare to containers?
options: Lambda 完全没有冷启动问题，但弹性伸缩能力很差
Lambda 弹性极强、可瞬间自动扩，但有冷启动、稳定高负载下更贵
Lambda 和容器两者都完全不存在冷启动问题
容器的弹性伸缩能力其实比 Lambda 更强、扩容更快
why: Lambda 弹性最好、可瞬时扩容、几乎零运维，适合 <15 分钟短任务；但冷启动可能拖累 2 秒精度，且稳定高吞吐时更贵。容器则相反：更省成本、无冷启动，但弹性和运维差些。
why_en: Lambda auto-scales instantly with minimal ops but suffers cold starts and higher cost for steady load, while containers trade elasticity for cost efficiency.
tradeoff: Lambda（弹性强，有冷启动） vs 容器（稳定省钱，扩缩较慢）
options_en: Lambda has no cold-start problem at all, but its elasticity is poor.
Lambda scales almost instantly but has cold starts and costs more under steady heavy load.
Neither Lambda nor containers have a cold-start problem at all.
Containers actually scale more elastically and faster than Lambda.
optionDirectness: 错；说反了，Lambda 恰恰有冷启动，容器才没有。
对；弹性最强但冷启动可能拖累精度，稳定负载下更贵。
错；Lambda 存在明显冷启动，这个说法不成立。
错；容器扩缩通常比 Lambda 慢，弹性不及它。

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 的容器编排服务，管理和调度容器实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ECS is AWS's container orchestration service for running and scaling containers.

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 的无服务器计算服务，按调用自动扩缩、无需管理服务器。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Lambda is AWS's serverless compute service that scales automatically per invocation with no servers to manage.

q: 用容器（ECS）做 Worker 层，可以怎样优化成本和弹性？（多选）
q_en: When running workers on containers (ECS), how can you optimize for cost and elasticity? (select all)
options: 用 spot 实例降低成本
按队列深度（queue depth）配置自动扩缩
预热容器池以承接基线负载
设置扩缩策略应对突发流量
why: 容器优化四招：spot 实例省钱、按队列深度自动扩缩、预热容器池扛基线、配扩缩策略应对突发峰值。
why_en: Optimize container workers with spot instances, queue-depth autoscaling, a pre-warmed pool, and spike-handling scaling policies.
tradeoff: 省成本的优化（spot 实例/预热池） vs 额外的调优与运维复杂度
options_en: Use spot instances to cut cost.
Autoscale based on queue depth.
Pre-warm the container pool for baseline load.
Set scaling policies to handle traffic spikes.

q: Worker 内 Job 失败可分为哪两类？
q_en: What are the two categories of job failure inside a worker?
options: 单纯的语法错误和更深层的业务逻辑错误这两大类代码缺陷
可见失败（代码 bug / 参数错，能捕获）vs 不可见失败（Worker 自身宕机）
底层数据库的读操作失败和写操作失败这两种存储故障
调用方式上的同步调用失败和异步调用失败这两种情形
why: 两类失败：可见失败（任务代码抛异常、参数错，能 try/catch 捕获）和不可见失败（Worker 直接崩溃，无从捕获）。二者处理机制不同。
why_en: Failures are either visible, like code bugs caught in try-catch, or invisible, like the worker crashing.
options_en: Plain syntax errors versus deeper business-logic errors, two broad categories of code defects.
Visible failures caught in try-catch versus invisible failures where the worker itself crashes.
Read failures versus write failures at the underlying database, two kinds of storage faults.
Synchronous call failures versus asynchronous call failures, two calling-style scenarios.
optionDirectness: 错；语法/逻辑错误的划分不是这里的分类维度。
对；可见失败能被 try/catch 捕获，不可见失败是 Worker 直接宕机。
错；读写失败不是这里讨论的失败分类。
错；同步异步不是这里的失败分类维度。

scenario: 任务代码因 bug 或参数错误抛出异常，属于可见失败。
scenario_en: Task code throws an exception because of a bug or bad parameters -- this is a visible failure.
q: 该如何处理这类可见失败？
q_en: How should this kind of visible failure be handled?
options: 直接丢弃该 Job
捕获异常、标记重试，超限转失败
立即无限重试
重启整个 Worker 集群
why: 可见失败：try/catch 捕获、记录错误、把状态更新为 RETRYING（记录 attempt 次数），带指数退避重新入队；重试满（如 3 次）仍失败则置 FAILED，不再重试。
why_en: Wrap task code in try-catch, mark RETRYING, re-enqueue with exponential backoff, and mark FAILED after the retry limit.
whenOtherWins: 如果失败明显是永久性、重试也没用（如参数根本非法），可直接进死信队列而不浪费退避重试。
tradeoff: 重试挽回临时故障 vs 无限重试浪费资源
options_en: Just discard the job.
Catch the error, mark it for retry, and fail it past the retry limit.
Retry immediately and indefinitely.
Restart the entire worker fleet.
optionDirectness: 错；直接丢弃违反至少一次执行的要求。
对；try/catch 捕获、状态转 RETRYING、带退避重入队，超限转 FAILED。
错；无限重试可能让一个坏 Job 无休止占用资源。
错；重启整个集群代价过大，且不解决单个 Job 的问题。

scenario: 可见失败后，Worker 要把 Job 重新放回队列重试，并且一次比一次等得更久。
scenario_en: After a visible failure, the worker re-enqueues the job for retry, waiting longer each time.
q: 补全指数退避重试的例子（以 5 为底）：
q_en: Fill in this exponential backoff retry example (base 5):
text: 第一次重试等 {{5}} 秒，第二次等 {{25}} 秒，第三次等 {{125}} 秒，通过设置 SQS 的 {{DelaySeconds}} 参数、按 attempt 次数计算退避时长。
why: 指数退避 5→25→125 秒，用 attempt 计算并写入 SQS 的 DelaySeconds。默认重试 3 次仍失败就置 FAILED。
why_en: Exponential backoff waits five, then twenty-five, then one-hundred-twenty-five seconds, set via the SQS DelaySeconds parameter.

termDefinitions.meaning: SQS 消息的最小延迟投递参数，消息在这段时间内对消费者不可见。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DelaySeconds is an SQS parameter that keeps a message invisible to consumers for at least that many seconds.

q: SQS 为实现重试提供了哪些现成机制？（多选）
q_en: What built-in mechanisms does SQS provide for implementing retries? (select all)
options: 可见性超时：失败 / 未删除的消息会重新出现
ApproximateReceiveCount 属性：追踪重试次数
死信队列：捕获超过重试上限的消息
内置的指数退避计时逻辑
why: SQS 提供可见性超时（失败消息重现）、ApproximateReceiveCount（记重试次数）、死信队列（兜底超限消息）；但退避的具体计时逻辑仍要在 Worker 代码里自己实现。
why_en: SQS gives visibility timeouts, a receive-count attribute, and dead-letter queues, but the backoff timing logic is your own code.
options_en: Visibility timeouts: failed or undeleted messages reappear.
ApproximateReceiveCount attribute tracks retry count.
Dead-letter queues catch messages past the retry limit.
Built-in exponential backoff timing logic.
optionDirectness: 对；可见性超时让失败/未删除消息重新出现。
对；有个消息属性能大致告诉你这条消息被取过几次。
对；死信队列兜底超过重试上限的消息。
错；具体退避计时逻辑要 Worker 自己实现，SQS 不内置。

termDefinitions.meaning: SQS 消息属性，记录该消息被取出的大致次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ApproximateReceiveCount is an SQS message attribute tracking roughly how many times it has been received.

scenario: 有几千个 Worker，想检测某个 Worker 是否宕机（不可见失败）。有人提议中心监控服务轮询每个 Worker 的 /health。
scenario_en: There are thousands of workers, and you need to detect whether one has gone down (an invisible failure). Someone proposes a central monitoring service polling each worker's /health endpoint.
q: 健康检查方案的主要问题是？
q_en: What's the main problem with this health-check approach?
options: 这种方案其实完全检测不出任何一种 Worker 故障
在成千上万 Worker 下轮询扩展性差、网络抖动易误报、要额外基建、监控服务本身也可能挂
健康检查轮询得太快，会把 Worker 本身的负载压垮
健康检查这种机制天生就不支持基于 HTTP 协议来实现
why: 健康检查要中心服务持续轮询每个 Worker，规模上千时扩展性差；网络问题会误报触发无谓重试；还要维护额外基建，且监控服务自身也可能成单点故障。
why_en: Health-check polling scales poorly across thousands of workers, causes false positives, and adds fragile monitoring infrastructure.
whenOtherWins: 在 Worker 数量少、且需要主动、细粒度健康信号的场景，中心健康检查才相对可行。
tradeoff: 主动轮询检测（额外基建） vs 被动机制如可见性超时（无额外基建）
options_en: This approach actually cannot detect any kind of worker failure at all.
Polling thousands of workers scales poorly, false-positives from network blips, and the monitor itself can become a single point of failure.
Polling health checks too fast would overload the workers themselves.
Health checks as a mechanism inherently cannot be implemented over HTTP.
optionDirectness: 错；健康检查确实能检测部分故障，只是代价大。
对；轮询上千 Worker 扩展性差、网络抖动误报、还要防监控自身单点。
错；健康检查快慢不是这里讨论的负载问题。
错；HTTP 端点本就是健康检查的常见实现方式。

scenario: 考虑用「Job 租约（leasing）」检测 Worker 宕机：Worker 取 Job 时在数据库写下自己的 ID 和租约过期时间，处理中定期续租。
scenario_en: Consider detecting worker crashes with job leasing: a worker writes its ID and a lease-expiration time to the database when it takes a job, then periodically renews the lease while processing.
q: 租约方案的主要难点是？
q_en: What's the main difficulty with the leasing approach?
options: 无法记录 Worker ID
续租写入压力大，可能重复执行
根本无法检测宕机
租约必须用内存实现
why: 租约靠数据库分布式锁：Worker 崩溃后无法续租，租约过期别人接管。难点是续租写入量巨大（10k/s、5 秒租约约 5 万次/秒更新）、Worker 间时钟不同步或网络分区会导致同一 Job 被重复执行。
why_en: Job leasing needs heavy lease-renewal writes and suffers clock-skew and partition risks that can cause duplicate execution.
whenOtherWins: 在不用消息队列、必须靠数据库自建协调的环境，租约是可行的宕机检测手段。
tradeoff: 数据库租约（可控但写压力大） vs 托管队列可见性超时（省运维）
options_en: It cannot record a worker ID.
Heavy lease-renewal write load, with a risk of duplicate execution.
It cannot detect a crash at all.
Leases must live only in memory.
optionDirectness: 错；Worker ID 本就是租约要写入的字段之一。
对；续租写入量巨大，且时钟偏斜/网络分区会导致重复执行。
错；租约机制本身是能检测宕机的，只是有难点。
错；租约信息通常写在数据库而非只存内存。

scenario: 要在不新增基建、不做复杂协调的前提下，检测并恢复宕机 Worker 的 Job（不可见失败）。
scenario_en: The goal is to detect and recover a crashed worker's job (an invisible failure) without adding infrastructure or complex coordination.
q: 作者推荐的方案是？
q_en: Which approach does the author recommend?
options: 中心健康检查服务
数据库租约
SQS 可见性超时：取走即隐藏，超时重现
让用户手动重试
why: SQS 可见性超时天然处理不可见失败：Worker 取消息后它暂不可见，处理成功就删除；若 Worker 崩溃没在超时内删除，消息自动重现给别的 Worker。无需额外基建和协调。
why_en: SQS visibility timeouts hide a consumed message and re-surface it if the worker crashes before deleting it, needing no extra infrastructure.
whenOtherWins: 如果不能用 SQS（禁托管服务），才回退到租约或健康检查等自建方案。
tradeoff: SQS 内建可见性超时（零基建） vs 自建健康检查/租约（更多控制，更多运维）
options_en: A central health-check service.
A database lease.
SQS visibility timeout: hide it once taken, resurface it after timeout.
Have the user manually retry.
optionDirectness: 错；需要额外监控基建和持续轮询开销。
错；续租写入压力大，还有时钟偏斜风险。
对；取走即隐藏，超时未删除就自动重现给别人，零额外基建。
错；手动重试不满足自动化和精度要求。

termDefinitions.meaning: 消息被取走后，SQS 让它在一段时间内对其他消费者不可见的机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A visibility timeout is the window during which SQS hides a received message from other consumers.

scenario: 有个 Job 要跑 5 分钟，但 SQS 可见性超时只设了 30 秒，以便快速检测宕机。
scenario_en: A job takes five minutes to run, but the SQS visibility timeout is set to only 30 seconds so crashes are detected quickly.
q: 怎样既保留快速故障恢复，又不让长任务被误判为失败？
q_en: How do you keep fast failure recovery without misclassifying a long-running job as failed?
options: 把可见性超时直接设成 10 分钟
短超时快速探测，靠心跳定期续期
取消可见性超时
把长任务拆成 30 秒小任务
why: 设短可见性超时（30 秒）以便崩溃后 30 秒内被别人接管；长任务靠周期心跳——每 15 秒调 ChangeMessageVisibility 续期——避免运行中被误重投。兼顾快速探测和长任务。
why_en: Use a short visibility timeout plus periodic ChangeMessageVisibility heartbeats so long jobs stay owned while crashes are detected fast.
whenOtherWins: 如果所有任务都很短、时长可预测，直接设一个略大于最长任务的固定超时就够，无需心跳。
tradeoff: 短超时快速探测 vs 心跳续期保护长任务
options_en: Set the visibility timeout directly to ten minutes.
A short timeout for fast detection, kept alive with periodic heartbeats.
Remove the visibility timeout entirely.
Split every long job into 30-second chunks.
optionDirectness: 错；10 分钟超时会让宕机检测慢很多，拖累恢复速度。
对；短超时快速探测崩溃，心跳续期保护正在跑的长任务。
错；取消超时会让宕机 Job 永远没人接管。
错；拆分任务改变了任务本身的语义，不是通用解法。

termDefinitions.meaning: SQS 的 API，用来延长某条消息当前的可见性超时。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ChangeMessageVisibility is the SQS API call that extends a message's current visibility timeout.

q: 「至少一次执行」带来的直接后果是什么，因此必须处理？
q_en: What's the direct consequence of 'at-least-once execution' that must be handled?
options: 会导致 Job 在极端情况下永远都不会被执行
同一 Job 可能被执行多次，因此任务代码必须幂等（idempotent）
会导致 Job 原本的执行顺序被彻底打乱
会导致底层数据库被长时间锁死、无法写入
why: 至少一次意味着可能重复执行，所以任务代码必须幂等——多次执行的结果要和执行一次相同，否则会重复发邮件、重复转账。
why_en: At-least-once execution can run a job multiple times, so task code must be idempotent.
options_en: It would cause a job to never execute at all under extreme conditions.
The same job may run more than once, so task code must be idempotent.
It would cause a job's original execution order to be completely scrambled.
It would cause the underlying database to be locked up and unable to write for a long time.
optionDirectness: 错；至少一次恰恰保证 Job 会被执行，不会永远不跑。
对；可能被执行多次，所以任务代码必须幂等。
错；顺序问题和至少一次语义不是一回事。
错；至少一次不涉及锁死数据库。

termDefinitions.meaning: 多次执行和执行一次效果相同的操作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An idempotent operation produces the same result whether it runs once or many times.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保证消息或任务至少被处理一次，但可能重复处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: At-least-once delivery guarantees a message is processed at least once, but possibly more than once.

q: 「收到就无脑执行、不做任何去重」这种最简做法的风险是？
q_en: What's the risk of the simplest approach -- just executing every delivery with no deduplication?
options: 只会让单次任务的执行速度变得更慢一些
重复执行引发数据不一致：转账可能转多次、计数器可能加多次
会导致这个 Job 永远都没办法执行完成
会导致系统完全没办法记录任何执行状态
why: 不做幂等直接执行最简单，但重复投递会造成严重不一致：多次转账、计数器多加、重复发邮件，绝大多数真实业务无法接受。
why_en: Executing every delivery blindly risks duplicates like double money transfers or over-counted increments.
options_en: It would only make each individual execution somewhat slower.
Duplicate delivery causes inconsistency, like double transfers or over-counted increments.
It would cause this job to never finish executing at all.
It would leave the system completely unable to record any execution status.
optionDirectness: 错；无脑执行反而是最快的路径，不是变慢。
对；重复投递会导致多次转账、计数器多加等不一致。
错；无脑执行的 Job 反而会被立刻处理完。
错；状态照常能记录，只是可能被记录了多次。

scenario: 用「去重表」实现幂等：执行前查该 job_id + 执行时间戳是否已处理，处理过就跳过。
scenario_en: Idempotency is implemented with a dedup table: before executing, check whether this job_id plus execution timestamp has already been processed, and skip it if so.
q: 这种去重表方案的代价是？
q_en: What's the cost of this dedup-table approach?
options: 这种去重表方案其实完全不需要付出任何额外代价
每次执行都多一次数据库读写、要额外维护并定期清理该表，且检查与写入之间存在小的竞态窗口
这种去重表方案会导致完全没办法支持周期性 Job
这种去重表方案会导致 Job 永远都没办法被执行
why: 去重表用 job_id + 执行时间戳唯一标识：给每次执行增加数据库操作、需维护并定期清理防止无限膨胀，且「检查—写入」之间有小竞态窗口。
why_en: A dedup table adds database ops per execution, needs cleanup to bound growth, and has a small check-then-write race window.
whenOtherWins: 当下游服务无法改造成天然幂等、只能在调度层拦重复时，去重表是可行的兜底。
tradeoff: 去重表兜底（调度层解决） vs 天然幂等（任务层解决）
options_en: This dedup-table approach actually costs nothing extra at all.
Every execution adds a database op, needs periodic cleanup, and has a small race window between check and write.
This dedup-table approach would make it impossible to support recurring jobs at all.
This dedup-table approach would cause jobs to never be executed at all.
optionDirectness: 错；额外读写、维护清理和竞态窗口都是真实代价。
对；每次执行多一次数据库操作，还要定期清理和防竞态。
错；去重表能正常配合周期性 Job 使用。
错；去重只是跳过重复执行，不会让 Job 永不执行。

scenario: 希望用最稳健的方式保证幂等，不想在调度层维护去重表。
scenario_en: The goal is the most robust way to guarantee idempotency, without maintaining a dedup table at the scheduling layer.
q: 作者认为最稳健的幂等做法是？
q_en: What does the author consider the most robust way to achieve idempotency?
options: 在调度器这一层额外加一套复杂的分布式锁机制来协调并发访问
把任务本身设计成天然幂等：用幂等键和条件操作（如「设为 X」而非「加 1」、发信前先查标志位）
干脆彻底放弃至少一次执行这个可靠性保证，接受偶尔丢失 Job
规定每一个 Job 从创建到完成都只允许固定的同一个 Worker 处理
why: 最稳健是让任务天然幂等：用幂等键 + 条件操作——「把计数器设为 X」而非「加 1」，发欢迎邮件前先查用户资料里的标志位。这把幂等责任下沉到任务实现本身。
why_en: The most robust approach makes tasks naturally idempotent using idempotency keys and conditional operations rather than blind mutations.
whenOtherWins: 若任务由第三方提供、无法改成天然幂等，才退回到去重表在调度层拦截重复。

Mandate that every job, from creation to completion, may only ever be handled by one fixed worker.

错；放弃至少一次会牺牲可靠性，不是本题目标。
错；限制单 Worker 会牺牲并发和可用性。

q: 把「可见失败后的重试流程」排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the retry flow after a visible failure:
steps: 带指数退避的 delay 重新入队 SQS（用 attempt 算 DelaySeconds）
try/catch 捕获异常并记录错误
attempt 已达上限（如 3 次）→ 状态置 FAILED，不再重试
状态更新为 RETRYING 并记录 attempt 次数
why: 重试流程：捕获异常 → 置 RETRYING 记 attempt → 带退避 delay 重入队 → 若达上限则置 FAILED 停止。是「至少一次 + 有限重试」的落地。
why_en: On a visible failure: catch the error, mark RETRYING with the attempt count, re-enqueue with backoff, and mark FAILED once the limit is hit.
diagram:
flowchart LR
    F["Job fails visibly"] --> U["mark failed attempt"]
    U --> B["compute backoff"]
    B --> R{"retry left?"}
    R -->|yes| Q["requeue with delay"]
    R -->|no| D["DLQ or terminal failed"]

scenario: 加入队列后提交变成异步，API 不能立刻返回完整判题结果。
scenario_en: After adding a queue, submission handling becomes asynchronous and the API cannot immediately return the final judging result.
q: 客户端应如何查询结果？
q_en: How should the client check for an asynchronous judging result?
options: 保持一个 HTTP 请求阻塞 10 分钟等结果
拿 submissionId，按秒轮询 /check/:id
要求用户手动刷新数据库
通过支付回调顺带拿到判题结果

why: 异步执行时，submissionId 是长任务句柄，客户端轮询状态端点即可拿到结果。
why_en: With asynchronous judging, the submissionId acts as a job handle that the client polls a status endpoint with.
whenOtherWins: 如果判题能稳定在几百毫秒内完成，直接同步返回结果的交互会更简单。

options_en: Hold one HTTP request open for ten minutes waiting for the result.
Get a submissionId back, then GET /check/:id once a second.
Ask the user to manually refresh the database.
Piggyback the judging result on a payment callback.

本场景不选它；用户不应该也不能直接操作数据库。

q: 用 1 秒轮询 /check/:id 和用 WebSocket 推送判题结果的取舍是什么？
q_en: What is the tradeoff between polling /check/:id every second and pushing judging results over WebSocket?

WebSocket 技术上不能传递判题结果

两者都不能用于异步任务的结果通知
why: 提交结果不是高频连续流，1 秒轮询通常体验已经够好，复杂度也更低。

WebSockets are technically unable to carry judging results.

q: 在 API Server 和容器 worker 之间加队列，除了削峰还有什么好处？

worker 或容器失败时可以重新入队重试，减少丢失提交
why: 持久队列给执行失败留出恢复路径，提交不会因为单个 worker 崩溃就永久丢失。

options_en: All submitted code would automatically become correct.
The database would no longer need to store any Submission records.
No security isolation would be needed anymore.
Failed workers or containers can be retried by re-queuing, reducing lost submissions.

本场景不选它；判题结果依然需要落库供查询和榜单使用。
本场景不选它；队列和沙箱隔离解决的是完全不同的问题。

scenario: 同一题支持多语言提交，但不想为每种语言维护一套完全独立测试用例。

Runner --> Compare[Compare output]
Compare --> Verdict[Verdict]

Only test Python and assume other languages automatically pass.

q: 二叉树类测试用例最适合用哪种表达方式？

q: 为什么“告警 1 分钟内触发”在监控系统里通常是合理目标？
options: 1 分钟只是行业惯例数字，没有技术原因
更快触发在技术上不可能，指标采集本身就要 1 分钟
通知渠道限制了告警最快只能 1 分钟发一次
很多告警基于滑动窗口或趋势，需要累积到足够数据才能判断
why: 生产告警常看一段时间的均值、p99 或持续违反，而不是单个瞬时点，所以需要先累积窗口内数据。
why_en: Many production alerts look at a moving average, p99, or a sustained breach rather than a single instant, so they need enough accumulated data first.
options_en: One minute is just a convention with no technical reason.
Faster firing is technically impossible because collection itself takes a minute.
Notification channels limit alerts to once per minute.
Many alerts evaluate moving windows or trends, so they need enough accumulated data first.
optionMeanings: 认为这只是约定俗成的数字。
把限制归到采集频率本身。
把限制归到通知渠道能力。
把限制归到窗口/趋势判断需要数据累积。
optionDirectness: 纯惯例说法忽略了窗口评估。
采集可做到秒级，瓶颈不在这里。
通知渠道通常能立即发单条消息。
窗口类告警要先攒够样本。
q_en: Why is firing an alert within one minute usually a reasonable monitoring target?
optionDirectness_en: Calling it a convention misses the evaluation window.
Collection can be seconds-level; this is not the usual bottleneck.
Notification channels can usually send one message immediately.
Window-based alerts need enough samples first.

why_en: A metric is one measurement at a point in time, while a series is the full time-ordered sequence of measurements for one metric-and-label combination.
tradeoff: 单点测量值 vs 随时间的完整序列

The two terms are identical, just different names.

只有不建模时序身份时才会混用。

q: 补全 cardinality explosion 的定义：
text: 每个唯一的 {{metric name + label values}} 组合都会形成一个 {{series}}；标签值组合失控时，series 数会爆炸。
why: series 数量决定索引、内存跟踪、写入吞吐和聚合查询成本，是监控系统的核心风险。
why_en: Cardinality explosion happens because each unique metric-name and label-value combination creates a separate series.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个 metric 下唯一 series 的数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cardinality is the number of unique series under one metric.

q: 把 metrics 平台的端到端数据流排好序：

服务产生指标点并发送给平台
Alert rules 周期性或流式评估指标

why: 主数据流从产生和存储开始，再被 dashboard 和 alert 两条读路径消费，最后进入通知。

options: GET /metrics/one-by-one 每个点一个请求

why: 高吞吐指标必须批量提交，减少每点一次请求的开销；线格式可从 JSON 换成 protobuf。
why_en: Metric ingestion should batch many points into one POST request instead of one request per point, since JSON can later be swapped for a binary format like protobuf.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是小型内部工具，简单 JSON HTTP 批量接口已经足够。
tradeoff: 批量吞吐 vs 单点请求的实现简单性
options_en: GET /metrics/one-by-one, one request per data point.
POST /metrics/ingest with a batched array of metrics.
DELETE /dashboards/all.
POST /alerts/notifyOnly.

一次 POST 提交一批指标数组。
删除所有 dashboard 的接口。
只发通知、不摄取指标的接口。

scenario: Dashboard 需要按 PromQL-like DSL 查询某个时间范围内的聚合指标。
q: 查询 API 最贴近哪种形态？
options: POST /metrics/ingest，用于写入而非查询
GET /alerts/sendNow，用于手动触发通知
GET /metrics/query，按 DSL 表达过滤/聚合/时间范围
DELETE /series，用于删除整条 series
codeSample:
GET /metrics/query?query=avg(cpu_usage{region="us-east"})&start=A&end=B&step=60
-> { "timestamps": [...], "values": [...] }
why: 查询接口要能表达 metric 选择、label 过滤、聚合函数、时间范围和采样步长这五要素。
why_en: A metrics query API needs to express metric selection, label filters, aggregation, time range, and step size.
whenOtherWins: 如果只服务固定 dashboard，可以用预定义 query id 简化客户端请求。
tradeoff: 表达力（过滤/聚合/时间范围） vs 查询语法复杂度
options_en: POST /metrics/ingest, used for writing, not querying.
GET /alerts/sendNow, used to manually trigger a notification.
GET /metrics/query, expressing filters, aggregation, and time range via the DSL.
DELETE /series, used to delete an entire series.
optionMeanings: 写入接口，不是查询。
触发告警发送的接口。
PromQL 风格的读查询，带过滤/聚合/时间范围。
删除 series 的管理接口。
