q_en: What is the reasonable judgment for the matchmaking pool here?
options: 必须立即按 rating band 分片
改用全量扫描 Postgres
单个 Redis 主节点加副本/故障转移足够，先不分片
把每个玩家放进独立队列
why: 单 Redis 节点对 sorted-set 操作有足够余量，分片会引入边界匹配错误和复杂度；先用数字证明不需要。
why_en: The workload fits comfortably on one Redis primary, while sharding adds rating-band edge cases and operational complexity.
whenOtherWins: 若单个 time control 增长到当前数倍、热点 key 接近节点上限，才应考虑拆分或更复杂的分区方案。
optionExplanations: 错误。数字证明单节点还有 4-5 倍余量，分片只会多出边界错误。
错误。全表扫描比 sorted set 查找慢得多，是倒退。
对。峰值算下来的 ops/s 远低于单节点上限，先不分片更简单。
错误。每人一个队列没法做范围匹配，反而更难找到对手。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the numbers show 4-5x headroom on one node; sharding only adds rating-band edge cases.
Wrong — a full-table scan is far slower than a sorted-set lookup; that is a step backward.
Correct — the computed peak ops/s sits well under a single node's ceiling, so staying unsharded is simpler.
Wrong — a queue per player breaks range-based matching, making it harder to find opponents.
options_en: Immediately shard by rating band.
Switch to a full-table scan on Postgres.
One Redis primary with replicas and failover is enough for now; do not shard yet.
Put every player into their own individual queue.
tradeoff: 先用数字证明单节点够用 vs 提前分片换运维复杂度

termDefinitions.meaning: 针对 Redis sorted set 的增删查命令，单线程 Redis 每秒能处理数十万次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sorted-set operations are the insert, remove, and lookup commands a single-threaded Redis node can serve at hundreds of thousands per second.

q: 匹配池 Redis 主节点故障时，为什么可以接受丢失少量 in-flight pending requests？
q_en: Why is it acceptable to lose a few in-flight pending requests when the Redis primary fails?
options: 因为它们不是棋局状态，客户端可以重试排队
因为 Redis 永远不会丢数据
因为排行榜会自动补偿
因为 move log 里保存了 pending pool
why: pending 匹配请求是短生命周期、可重建的数据；即使故障转移丢掉一小段队列，客户端重新提交即可。
why_en: Pending match requests are ephemeral and retryable, unlike live game state, so a small failover loss is acceptable.
optionExplanations: 对。等待请求短命且可重建，丢一小段队列客户端重新提交就好。
错误。故障转移确实可能丢一小段还没同步的数据，这是前提而非反驳。
错误。排行榜只和已完成对局的 rating 相关，与匹配池无关。
错误。move log 记录的是棋局走子，不是匹配请求。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — pending requests are short-lived and cheap to rebuild, so a client just re-submits after losing a bit of queue.
Wrong — failover can genuinely lose a bit of unreplicated data; that is the premise, not a rebuttal.
Wrong — the leaderboard only relates to completed-game ratings, unrelated to the matching pool.
Wrong — the move log records game moves, not match requests.
options_en: They are not game state, so the client can simply retry queueing.
Redis never loses data.
The leaderboard automatically compensates for it.
The move log stores the pending pool.

scenario: 有几十到上百台 Game Server，每盘棋的两名玩家必须连到同一台机器，且新增/移除机器时尽量少迁移现有对局。
scenario_en: There are dozens to hundreds of Game Servers; both players in a game must connect to the same machine, and adding or removing machines should move as few active games as possible.
q: 最合适的手写路由方案是什么？
q_en: What is the best hand-built routing scheme here?
options: 把每条 WebSocket 随机分给任意服务器
按 gameId 一致性哈希，配合 stateless router
按 playerId 分别路由白方和黑方到不同机器
所有对局都固定路由到同一台主服务器
why: 一致性哈希让两名玩家通过同一个 gameId 落到同一 owner，节点变更时只迁移 ring 上一小段 key。
why_en: Consistent hashing by gameId sends both players to the same owner while remapping only a small slice when membership changes.
whenOtherWins: 如果已有 Orleans/Akka 这类 virtual actor 运行时，可用框架目录服务取代手写 ring。
optionExplanations: 错误。随机分配无法保证两名玩家落到同一台机器。
对。同一 gameId 哈希到同一 owner，扩缩容只影响 ring 上一小段。
错误。分开路由两名玩家，他们大概率落在不同机器上。
错误。单台主服务器撑不住几十上百台机器才够的规模。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — random assignment cannot guarantee both players land on the same machine.
Correct — hashing the same gameId to the same owner remaps only a small ring slice on scale changes.
Wrong — routing the two players separately would likely put them on different machines.
Wrong — one fixed primary cannot hold a scale that needs dozens to hundreds of servers.
options_en: Randomly load-balance every WebSocket connection.
Consistent-hash by gameId behind a stateless session router.
Route the white and black players separately by playerId.
Pin every game onto one fixed primary server.
tradeoff: 一致性哈希换小范围重映射 vs 简单路由换全量迁移风险

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 key 和节点都映射到同一个哈希环上的路由算法，节点变化只影响环上一小段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing maps both keys and nodes onto the same hash ring so membership changes remap only a small slice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不持有对局状态、只负责把请求路由到正确 Game Server 的轻量组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stateless session router holds no game state itself; it only routes requests to the correct game server.

scenario: session router 需要知道哪些 Game Server 存活，并在服务器停止心跳时自动把它从路由环移除。
scenario_en: The session router needs to know which Game Servers are alive and automatically remove a server from the routing ring when its heartbeat stops.
q: 最适合保存成员关系的组件是什么？
q_en: What component best stores game-server membership?
options: 存一份 S3 上的静态配置文件
每台服务器各自写本地 JSON 文件
由客户端自行维护服务器列表
ZooKeeper/etcd 等注册中心的临时节点
why: ephemeral node 会随心跳消失而自动删除，router watch registry 后可重建一致性哈希环。
why_en: Ephemeral registry nodes disappear when heartbeats stop, letting routers watch membership and rebuild the ring.
whenOtherWins: 如果是少量固定机器且容忍手动运维，静态配置可以暂时够用，但不能自动处理故障。
optionExplanations: 错误。静态文件不会随服务器上下线自动更新，故障要靠人工改。
错误。本地文件不会跨机器同步，router 看不到全局成员变化。
错误。客户端不该背负发现服务端拓扑的职责，也不可信。
对。心跳一停临时节点自动消失，router watch 后立刻重建 ring。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a static file does not update automatically as servers join or leave; failures need manual edits.
Wrong — a local file does not sync across machines, so the router cannot see global membership changes.
Wrong — clients should not own topology discovery, and they cannot be trusted for it.
Correct — the ephemeral node vanishes automatically when heartbeats stop, letting the router rebuild the ring instantly.
options_en: A static configuration file in S3.
A local JSON file kept on each server.
A server list the client maintains itself.
An ephemeral node in a registry like ZooKeeper, etcd, or Consul.
tradeoff: 自动感知成员变化（注册中心） vs 手动运维简单（静态配置）

termDefinitions.meaning: 注册中心里随心跳存在的临时节点，心跳一停就自动删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ephemeral node is a registry entry that exists only while heartbeats continue and is auto-deleted when they stop.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的分布式协调服务，可用来做成员发现和临时节点注册。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZooKeeper is a distributed coordination service commonly used for membership discovery and ephemeral registration.

q: Game Server 崩溃后的恢复链路，正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct recovery chain after a Game Server crashes?
steps: 新 owner 读取 Game 行并 replay moves 重建棋盘
客户端 socket 断开后重连到 router
旧 server 的 ephemeral node 过期，router 重建 ring
新 owner bump generation 成为该 game 的写入者
router 把该 gameId 指到新的 successor server
why: 成员变更先让路由收敛，客户端重连后新 owner 才能通过读行和 replay 接管，并用 generation fence 排除旧 owner。
why_en: Failover starts with membership expiry and rerouting, then clients reconnect, the new owner replays state, and generation fencing establishes ownership.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  F[Server fails]
  D[Detect owner lost]
  N[Choose new server]
  R[Replay move log]
  C[Reconnect clients]
  F --> D --> N --> R --> C

scenario: 旧 Game Server 网络分区后仍活着，新 owner 已接管同一盘棋，必须阻止旧 owner 继续写入 move 和 clock。
scenario_en: An old Game Server is still alive after a network partition, while a new owner has taken over the same game; old-owner writes to moves and clocks must be blocked.
q: 下面 SQL 里最关键的防护字段是哪一个？
q_en: Which field in this SQL is the critical protection?
options: updated_at
turn
generation
white_ms
why: generation 是 fencing token，新 owner 接管时递增；旧 owner 带旧 generation 的事务无法通过条件写。
why_en: The generation is the fencing token that rejects writes from an old owner after a new owner takes over.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有单进程且不存在脑裂写入，generation 可省略；分布式 owner 切换时不能省。
codeSample:
UPDATE games
SET white_ms = :white_ms, black_ms = :black_ms, turn = :turn,
    generation = :gen, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE game_id = :id AND generation <= :gen;
optionExplanations: 错误。它只记录时间，挡不住一个旧 owner 的写入。
错误。turn 只是棋局状态字段，不带任何防护语义。
对。它是所有权变更时递增的计数器，旧值写入会被条件语句拦下。
错误。它是时钟数值，本身不参与哪次写该被接受的判断。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — it only records time and cannot block a write from an old owner.
Wrong — turn is just game state, carrying no protective meaning.
Correct — it is a counter bumped on every ownership change, and the conditional write blocks any stale value.
Wrong — it is a clock value and plays no role in deciding which write should be accepted.
options_en: updated_at.
turn.
generation.
white_ms.
tradeoff: generation fencing 挡旧 owner vs 无防护字段允许脑裂写入

termDefinitions.meaning: 每次所有权变更就递增的计数器，用来当作 fencing token。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Generation is a counter bumped on every ownership change, used as a fencing token.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用来拒绝旧持有者写入的递增令牌。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A fencing token is an increasing value used to reject writes from a stale owner.

q: 没有 generation fence 时，Game Server failover 最容易出现什么严重问题？
q_en: Without a generation fence, what severe failure can Game Server failover cause?
options: 两个owner同时写同一盘棋
Redis sorted set变慢
玩家无法查看历史棋谱
旁观直播连接数暴涨
why: 分区但未死的旧 server 可能继续接受走子并写库，与新 owner 同时推进棋局，导致状态分叉。
why_en: Without fencing, a partitioned old server can keep writing while the new owner also writes, causing split-brain game state.
optionExplanations: 对。故障转移换了 owner，但原服务器如果只是网络分区未必真的死，它可能仍在写，于是两份棋盘各自往前走。
错误。sorted set 是匹配池用的结构，和 Game Server failover 无关。
错误。历史棋谱来自 move log，不受 owner 切换影响。
错误。这是旁观扇出层的容量问题，和 failover 一致性无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — failover assigns a new owner, but a merely partitioned old server may not actually be dead and can keep writing, so the two boards advance separately.
Wrong — the sorted set belongs to the matchmaking pool, unrelated to game-server failover.
Wrong — game history comes from the move log and is unaffected by an owner switch.
Wrong — that is a spectator fanout capacity concern, unrelated to failover consistency.
options_en: Two owners write to the same game at once.
The Redis sorted set slows down.
Players cannot view their game history.
Spectator livestream connections spike.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用递增计数器拒绝旧 owner 写入的保护机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A generation fence uses an incrementing counter to reject writes from an old owner.

q: 玩家自身断线和 Game Server 故障，在时钟处理上的关键区别是什么？
q_en: What is the key clock-handling difference between a player disconnect and a Game Server failure?
options: 无论哪种断线都应该永远暂停时钟
玩家一断线就应立刻重开一局新的
玩家断线继续计时或给短宽限；服务器故障暂停等恢复
服务器故障时改由客户端时钟当权威
why: 玩家断线若暂停时钟会被滥用来逃避败局；服务器故障不是玩家责任，应暂停并恢复。
why_en: A player disconnect should not freely pause the clock because it can be abused, while server failure should pause for fairness.
optionExplanations: 错误。永远暂停会被恶意利用来逃避必败局面。
错误。重开一局丢弃了已经下出的所有棋步，代价过大。
对。玩家断线不是系统的错，不该白送暂停；服务器故障不是玩家的错，应该暂停等恢复。
错误。客户端时钟本就是被怀疑的一方，故障时更不能交给它。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — pausing forever can be abused to dodge a losing position.
Wrong — restarting the game throws away every move already played, which is too costly.
Correct — a player's own disconnect is not the system's fault, so it should not earn a free pause; a server failure is not the player's fault, so it should pause and resume.
Wrong — the client clock is the untrusted side to begin with, so a failure is the worst time to hand it authority.
options_en: Both cases should always pause the clock forever.
A player disconnect should immediately restart a new game.
A player disconnect keeps the clock running with a short grace window; a server failure pauses until recovery.
During a server failure, the client's clock becomes authoritative.
tradeoff: 断线责任在谁 vs 时钟该不该暂停

q: 纯一致性哈希路由在扩容 Game Server 时的一个固有瑕疵是什么？
q_en: What inherent flaw does pure consistent-hash routing have when scaling Game Servers?
options: 必须把棋盘存在客户端
无法让两名玩家落同一台机器
无法处理服务器死亡
会迁移一部分健康进行中的棋局
why: ring membership 改变会让一小段 gameId 重映射，即使原 owner 健康也可能触发重连迁移。
why_en: Changing the hash ring remaps a slice of healthy games, causing reconnects even when their original server did not fail.
optionExplanations: 错误。棋盘一直放在服务端内存，客户端从不是真相源。
错误。这正是一致性哈希擅长的事，两名玩家按同一 gameId 落同一台机器。
错误。ephemeral node 过期正是它处理服务器死亡的机制。
对。ring 成员一变，一小段 gameId 就会重映射到新 owner，即便原服务器还健康。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the board always lives in server memory; the client is never the source of truth.
Wrong — putting both players on the same machine is exactly what consistent hashing is good at.
Wrong — the ephemeral node expiring is precisely the mechanism that handles a dead server.
Correct — changing ring membership remaps a slice of gameIds to a new owner even when the original server is still healthy.
options_en: It requires storing the board on the client.
It cannot put both players on the same machine.
It cannot handle a server dying.
It remaps a slice of healthy in-progress games.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 key 和节点映射到同一哈希环的路由算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing maps keys and nodes onto the same hash ring for routing.

scenario: 团队已经在 Akka Cluster Sharding 或 Orleans 生态内，想避免扩容时迁移健康棋局，并让目录服务管理 gameId 到 owner 的映射。
scenario_en: The team already uses Akka Cluster Sharding or Orleans, wants to avoid moving healthy games during scale-out, and wants a directory service to manage gameId-to-owner placement.
q: 这时可以用什么替代手写一致性哈希 router？
q_en: What can replace a hand-built consistent-hash router here?
options: 虚拟 actor / stateful sharding 框架
把棋局状态整个存进客户端本地 localStorage
给每盘棋分配一个独立消息分区
让 CDN 边缘节点缓存这盘棋的实时状态
why: 这类框架把 placement 交给一致性目录或协调器，能只把新游戏分配到新增容量，并仍要求 move log 与 fencing 思路。
why_en: Virtual actor or stateful sharding frameworks provide managed placement while still needing replay-based recovery and fencing.
whenOtherWins: 如果团队没有该生态或需求较简单，手写 router 加一致性哈希足够且更透明。
optionExplanations: 对。这类系统由协调器统一决定每局落在哪台机器，加机器只影响新对局，不会挪动正在进行的健康棋局。
错误。客户端本地存储既不可信也不能被服务端读到，无法做权威状态。
错误。消息分区是顺序投递结构，不是可变棋局状态的存放地。
错误。CDN 面向静态可缓存内容，棋局是要写入的私有实时状态。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a coordinator decides which machine owns each game, so adding capacity only affects new games and never moves a healthy one in progress.
Wrong — client-side storage is untrusted and unreachable by the server, so it cannot hold authoritative state.
Wrong — a message partition is an ordered-delivery structure, not a place to hold mutable game state.
Wrong — a CDN is for static cacheable content, but game state is private and gets written constantly.
options_en: A virtual-actor or stateful-sharding framework.
Store the entire game state in the client's local localStorage.
Assign each game its own message-queue partition.
Let CDN edge nodes cache this game's live state.
tradeoff: 框架托管 placement 换迁移更少 vs 手写 router 换更透明简单

termDefinitions.meaning: 框架自动管理生命周期和位置的分布式对象模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A virtual actor is a distributed object whose lifecycle and placement the framework manages automatically.

scenario: 玩家分布在不同地区，棋钟必须防作弊，并尽量不惩罚高延迟玩家。
scenario_en: Players are in different regions, and the chess clock must resist cheating while avoiding unfair punishment for high-latency players.
q: 服务端和客户端在计时上的正确职责是什么？
q_en: What are the right timing responsibilities for the server and client?
options: 客户端报告剩余时间，服务端照单全收
服务端拥有权威剩余时间，客户端只做平滑显示
双方各算各的，赛后取平均
只按浏览器时间戳决定胜负
why: 棋钟是可作弊的关键状态，必须由服务端权威维护；客户端本地倒计时只是为了显示顺滑。
why_en: The clock is cheat-sensitive authoritative state, so the server owns it and clients only render a smooth local display.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是休闲计时器且无需对抗作弊，客户端本地计时会简单得多。
optionExplanations: 错误。客户端可以谎报，照单全收等于把计时权交给可能作弊的一方。
对。棋钟是可作弊状态，必须服务端权威维护，客户端只负责显示顺滑。
错误。赛后平均没法实时判断谁先超时，公平性也没保证。
错误。浏览器时间戳完全在客户端掌控，等于放弃权威计时。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a client can lie, so accepting it as-is hands timing authority to the potentially cheating side.
Correct — the clock is cheat-sensitive, so the server must own it authoritatively while the client just renders smoothly.
Wrong — averaging after the fact cannot decide in real time who ran out first, and it is not fair either.
Wrong — a browser timestamp is entirely under client control, giving up authoritative timing altogether.
options_en: The client reports remaining time and the server accepts it as-is.
The server owns the authoritative remaining time; the client only renders a smooth local display.
Each side computes its own time and they average it after the game.
The outcome is decided purely by browser timestamps.
tradeoff: 服务端权威计时防作弊 vs 客户端计时简单但不可信

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统认定为真相、其它副本都要对齐的那份数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Authoritative state is the copy of data the system treats as truth, which every other copy must match.

q: 这个延迟量级最支持哪个棋钟设计判断？
q_en: What clock-design judgment does this latency scale support?
options: 几秒钟的差异可以忽略，服务端不用做任何补偿
网络延迟能累积到接近 7 秒，足以左右胜负，权威计时必须做延迟补偿
只要客户端愿意上报延迟，服务端就该照单全收
这类延迟只影响界面显示，不影响真实计时
why: 170ms×40步≈6.8秒，在3分钟 blitz 里足以决定胜负；这说明服务端权威计时不能对延迟视而不见，需要做补偿而不是照单全收客户端数字。
why_en: One hundred seventy milliseconds over forty moves is close to seven seconds, enough to decide a blitz game, which is why the authoritative clock needs latency compensation rather than ignoring the gap.
scenario: 面试官给出这个数字：玩家 B 比玩家 A 多约 170ms 网络延迟，一局 blitz 双方各走约 40 步。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives this number: player B has about 170ms more network latency than player A, and a blitz game has about 40 moves per side.
options_en: A few seconds of difference is negligible, so the server needs no compensation.
Network latency can add up to nearly seven seconds, enough to decide the game, so the authoritative clock must compensate for it.
As long as the client reports its own delay, the server should just accept it.
This kind of delay only affects the visual display, not real elapsed time.

scenario: 服务端仍要权威计时，但希望给高延迟玩家返还部分网络传输时间，同时避免单次网络尖峰污染估计。
scenario_en: The server still owns authoritative timing, but it wants to credit high-latency players for part of network transit time without letting one spike poison the estimate.
q: 最合理的延迟补偿估计方式是什么？
q_en: What is the most reasonable way to estimate latency compensation?
options: 完全相信客户端上报的 playedAt 时间戳
只在玩家输棋后才补偿延迟时间
不管网络状况，给每人固定返还 5 秒
持续用 ping/pong 测 RTT，按中位数一半估算延迟
why: ping/pong 与走子解耦，rolling median 比平均值抗尖峰，用 RTT/2 近似单程传输时间。
why_en: Continuous ping-pong measurement with a rolling median estimates one-way latency while resisting spikes.
whenOtherWins: 若完全不在乎地域公平，可只做普通服务端权威时钟；若无对抗性，客户端本地时间戳更简单。
optionExplanations: 错误。客户端可以伪造时间戳，等于放弃反作弊。
错误。补偿是为了公平计时，不该看比赛结果才决定给不给。
错误。固定值不反映真实网络差异，快网玩家反而占便宜。
对。持续测量而不是靠客户端自报，中位数不怕单次抖动，折半估算能大致抵消传输时间。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a client can forge its timestamp, giving up anti-cheat protection entirely.
Wrong — compensation exists for fairness in timing, not something decided by who is losing.
Wrong — a flat credit ignores real network differences and overpays players on fast connections.
Correct — measuring continuously instead of trusting a self-report, the median resists single spikes, and halving it roughly cancels the transit time.
options_en: Fully trust the client-reported playedAt timestamp.
Only compensate latency after a player has lost.
Give every player a flat five-second credit regardless of network.
Continuously measure RTT via ping/pong and credit half the median as delay.
tradeoff: 度量并封顶补偿 vs 完全信任客户端或完全不补偿

termDefinitions.meaning: 往返时延，一个请求从发出到收到响应所花的总时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RTT, round-trip time, is the total time from sending a request to receiving its response.

termDefinitions.meaning: WebSocket 里用来探测连接和测网络延迟的心跳帧。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ping/pong are WebSocket heartbeat frames used to probe the connection and measure latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 取最近若干次采样的中位数，比平均值更抗单次尖峰干扰。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rolling median is the median of recent samples, which resists a single spike better than an average does.

q: 按 measured RTT 返还时间会引入什么滥用风险？
q_en: What abuse risk does crediting measured RTT introduce?
options: 排行榜无法分页
玩家可以修改服务端 monotonic clock
Redis 会丢掉所有 move log
客户端故意拖延 pong 来抬高 RTT
why: 客户端不能伪造服务端时间戳，但可以慢回 pong，让系统误以为网络很慢；因此补偿必须设置上限。
why_en: A client can inflate measured RTT by delaying pong responses, so latency credit must be capped.
optionExplanations: 错误。分页能力和棋钟补偿机制没有任何关联。
错误。monotonic clock 跑在服务端进程里，客户端根本碰不到。
错误。move log 是走子历史，和延迟补偿完全是两回事。
对。故意慢回 pong 会让系统误判网络慢，从而多拿补偿。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — pagination capability has no connection to the clock-compensation mechanism.
Wrong — the monotonic clock runs inside the server process; a client cannot touch it.
Wrong — the move log is move history, an entirely separate concern from latency compensation.
Correct — deliberately delaying the pong tricks the system into thinking the network is slow, earning extra credit.
options_en: The leaderboard can no longer paginate.
Players can modify the server's monotonic clock.
Redis loses all move logs.
The client deliberately delays its pong to inflate measured RTT.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只会前进、不受系统时间调整影响的计时源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A monotonic clock only moves forward and is unaffected by system time adjustments.

q: 补全服务端权威且补偿延迟的棋钟公式：
q_en: Fill in the server-authoritative, latency-compensated chess-clock formula:
text: 每步扣时约等于服务端 monotonic clock 的 elapsed 减去估计的 {{median_rtt / 2}}，并对单步返还设置约 {{100ms}} 的上限。
why: 这样在平均意义上减少地域延迟惩罚，同时限制故意抬高 RTT 带来的免费时间。
why_en: Subtracting about half the median RTT with a per-move cap reduces geographic latency bias without granting unlimited free time.

q: 公平棋钟的决策链，正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct decision chain for a fair chess clock?
steps: 对单步返还设置上限，避免慢 pong 套利
服务端维护权威 remaining_ms 和 last_start_timestamp
用 ping/pong 的 rolling median RTT 估计网络传输
识别普通服务端计时会把网络延迟算进玩家用时
why: 先承认服务端权威计时的公平缺口，再在不放弃权威的前提下估计并封顶补偿。
why_en: The clock design starts by identifying the latency tax, keeps server authority, estimates transit time, and caps abuse.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是非对抗性的休闲计时器，客户端本地时间戳和简单倒计时通常够用。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[Server is clock authority]
  B[Measure client latency]
  C[Cap compensation]
  D[Apply move time]
  A --> B --> C --> D

scenario: 全球排行榜只需要取 rating 最高的前 50 名，玩家总数约 1000 万。
scenario_en: The global leaderboard only needs the top 50 players by rating, with about 10 million total players.
q: 这个 top page 的合理基础方案是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable baseline design for this top page?
options: rating 建 btree 索引，DESC LIMIT 50
每次请求扫描全部玩家再重新排序一遍
让每个客户端各自缓存全量玩家列表
改用对象存储按 rating 命名文件再排序
why: btree 能按 rating 顺序走前几十个索引项，top-N 并不因为总玩家数大就必然慢。
why_en: A btree index can walk the first few highest-rating entries, making top-N cheap even with many players.
whenOtherWins: 若要精确个人排名或极高频 leaderboard reads，Redis sorted set 这样的外部 order-statistics view 更适合。
optionExplanations: 对。btree 按顺序走前几十个索引项就停，跟总玩家数无关。
错误。全表扫描排序是 O(n log n)，玩家越多越慢，白白浪费了索引。
错误。全量列表随时在变，客户端缓存马上过期还占内存。
错误。对象存储没有范围排序能力，文件名排序更是自造复杂度。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a btree walks the first few dozen ordered entries and stops, independent of total player count.
Wrong — scanning and sorting the whole table is O(n log n) and gets slower as players grow, wasting the index entirely.
Wrong — the full list keeps changing, so a client cache goes stale fast and wastes memory.
Wrong — object storage has no range-sort capability, and filename sorting just invents extra complexity.
options_en: A btree index on rating, DESC LIMIT 50.
Scan every player and re-sort on every single request.
Have every client cache the full player list.
Switch to object storage named by rating and sort by filename.
tradeoff: 索引顺序扫描换 O(1) 起步 vs 全表扫描换实现简单

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库常用的有序索引结构，能按顺序快速定位数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A btree is a common ordered database index that can quickly locate data in sorted order.

q: 为什么个人 rank 查询比排行榜首页更难？
q_en: Why is personal rank lookup harder than the leaderboard front page?
options: rank 查询要比 top-N 多渲染一次棋盘画面
top-N 查询完全用不上任何数据库索引
COUNT(*) 要数出排在你前面的所有人
个人 rank 只能靠全文搜索引擎才能实现
why: 普通 btree 提供有序遍历，但不直接给第几名；中位玩家可能要数百万条索引项。
why_en: A btree gives order but not ordinal position, so exact rank may require counting millions of higher-rated rows.
optionExplanations: 错误。rank 是纯数值计算，和渲染棋盘毫无关系。
错误。top-N 恰恰是最能用 btree 索引受益的查询。
对。btree 给顺序不给位置，中位玩家要数几百万条索引项。
错误。全文搜索解决的是文本相关性，不是数值排名。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — rank is a pure numeric computation, unrelated to rendering a board.
Wrong — top-N is exactly the query that benefits most from a btree index.
Correct — a btree gives order but not position, so a mid-pack player needs millions of counted entries.
Wrong — full-text search solves textual relevance, not numeric ranking.
options_en: Rank lookup renders one extra board frame compared to top-N.
Top-N cannot use any database index at all.
COUNT(*) has to count everyone ranked above you.
Personal rank can only be implemented with full-text search.
tradeoff: 有序遍历（btree） vs 位置查询（需要 order-statistics 结构）

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库常用的有序索引结构，能按顺序快速定位数据，但不直接给出位置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A btree is an ordered database index that can traverse in sorted order but does not directly return an item's position.

scenario: 产品只需要显示「大约第 4200 名」这类近似排名，低成本和简单运维比逐人精确更重要。
scenario_en: The product only needs approximate ranks such as "around 4,200th," so low cost and simple operations matter more than exact per-player rank.
q: 最务实的排名结构是什么？
q_en: What is the most pragmatic ranking structure here?
options: 把某个时刻的 rank 写死进客户端代码
给每个玩家单独开一个消息流通道
每次请求都跑一遍全表 group by
按 rating 分桶维护人数，求高档前缀和
why: 几百个 rating 桶即可常数时间估算排名，更新时把玩家从旧桶移到新桶，代价低但不精确。
why_en: Rating buckets make approximate rank cheap by summing counts in higher buckets, trading exactness for simplicity.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品明确要求精确名次、精确分页和实时 top-N，Redis sorted set 更合适。
optionExplanations: 错误。rank 随时在变，写死进客户端马上就是错的。
错误。消息流通道是顺序投递结构，不适合做计数维护，且每玩家一个也不现实。
错误。group by 全表这么频繁跑，代价比维护桶计数高得多。
对。几百个桶就能常数时间估算排名，代价是近似而非精确。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — rank keeps changing, so hard-coding it into the client is wrong almost immediately.
Wrong — a message stream is an ordered-delivery structure unsuited to maintaining counts, and one per player is unrealistic anyway.
Wrong — running a full-table group by this often costs far more than maintaining bucket counts.
Correct — a few hundred buckets make rank a constant-time estimate, at the cost of exactness.
options_en: Hard-code a rank value into the client.
Give every player their own message-stream channel.
Run a full-table group by on every request.
Keep a per-band player count bucketed by rating and sum the higher bands.
tradeoff: 近似排名换常数时间 vs 精确排名换更重的结构

scenario: 产品要求 1000 万玩家下精确个人 rank 和 top-N，都要在游戏结束后很快更新。
scenario_en: The product requires exact personal rank and top-N for 10 million players, and both should update soon after a game ends.
q: 最合适的外部索引是什么？
q_en: What external index best fits this requirement?
options: Redis sorted set，按 rating 记分排序
Redis list，按更新时间往后追加
Postgres 里存一个 JSONB 数组字段
S3 上给每个玩家存一个文件
why: Redis sorted set 支持 ZREVRANK 和 ZREVRANGE，以 log 级别工作量回答精确排名和 top-N。
why_en: A Redis sorted set answers exact rank and top-N efficiently with playerId members and rating scores.
whenOtherWins: 若只需近似名次，bucket counts 更便宜；若 Redis 只是派生视图，权威数据仍应留在 completed games/Players 中。
optionExplanations: 对。ZREVRANK/ZREVRANGE 都是 O(log n)，精确排名和 top-N 一起解决。
错误。list 只有插入顺序，取不到按 rating 排序的名次。
错误。JSONB 数组不带索引，算排名要整列扫描。
错误。按文件存没有排序能力，找名次要遍历全部文件。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — ZREVRANK and ZREVRANGE are both O(log n), solving exact rank and top-N together.
Wrong — a list only preserves insertion order and cannot give a rating-sorted position.
Wrong — a JSONB array carries no index, so computing rank means scanning the whole column.
Wrong — one file per player has no ordering, so finding rank means scanning every file.
options_en: A Redis sorted set scored by rating.
A Redis list appended in update-time order.
A JSONB array column in Postgres.
One file per player in S3.
tradeoff: sorted set 给精确排名 O(log n) vs 其他结构没有位置查询能力

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，按分数从高到低返回某个成员的名次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZREVRANK is a Redis command that returns a member's rank in descending score order.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，按分数从高到低取出一段成员列表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZREVRANGE is a Redis command that returns a range of members in descending score order.

scenario: 需要更新玩家 rating 并查询其 0-based 精确名次，排名按 rating 从高到低。
scenario_en: The system needs to update a player rating and query the player's exact 0-based rank, ordered from highest rating to lowest.
q: 哪组 Redis sorted set 命令符合这个需求？
q_en: Which Redis sorted-set commands match this requirement?
options: ZADD chess:ratings 1820 player42 + ZREVRANK chess:ratings player42
LPUSH chess:ratings player42 + LLEN chess:ratings
HSET chess:ratings player42 1820 + HLEN chess:ratings
SET player42 1820 + SCAN
why: ZADD 更新分数，ZREVRANK 按高分在前返回精确名次；list/hash 无法直接按 score 排名。
why_en: ZADD maintains the score and ZREVRANK returns exact descending rank, which list or hash structures cannot do directly.
whenOtherWins: 若只需要按 playerId 取当前 rating，hash 会更简单；这里需要按 rating 排名。
codeSample:
ZADD chess:ratings 1820 player42
ZREVRANK chess:ratings player42
ZREVRANGE chess:ratings 0 49 WITHSCORES
optionExplanations: 对。第一条命令更新该玩家的 rating 分数，第二条命令直接按降序返回它的名次。
错误。LLEN 只给列表长度，不是某个成员的名次。
错误。hash 能存分数但取不出「第几名」这个位置信息。
错误。SCAN 遍历 key 空间，既慢又给不出排名。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the first command updates the player's rating score, and the second reads back their descending-order rank directly.
Wrong — LLEN only gives list length, not any member's rank.
Wrong — a hash can store the score but cannot answer 'what position is this'.
Wrong — SCAN walks the keyspace, which is slow and gives no rank at all.
options_en: ZADD the score plus ZREVRANK for the exact rank.
LPUSH plus LLEN on a list.
HSET plus HLEN on a hash.
SET a value plus SCAN the keyspace.
tradeoff: sorted set 原生排名命令 vs 其他结构要自己算位置

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，按分数从高到低返回某个成员的名次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZREVRANK is a Redis command that returns a member's rank in descending score order.

q: 这个内存和写入量级支持什么架构判断？
q_en: What architecture judgment does this memory and write scale support?
options: 1000 万玩家必须单独拆成多个 Redis 集群才够用
GB 级内存和万级 ZADD/s 都在单 Redis 实例的舒适区，可直接复用
这个规模必须换成列式存储才能承载得住
写入量太大，只能靠离线批处理重新计算
why: 10M 成员约 GB 级内存、约 8k ZADD/s 都远低于单实例 Redis 的能力上限；这说明排行榜可以直接复用匹配系统已有的 Redis，不必新增基础设施或分片。
why_en: Ten million members at gigabyte-scale memory and about eight thousand ZADDs per second both sit well inside a single Redis instance's capacity, so the leaderboard can reuse the existing Redis rather than adding new infrastructure.
scenario: 面试官给出这些数字：1000 万玩家的 Redis sorted set 约占 GB 级内存，游戏结束速率约 4k 局/秒（两名玩家各更新一次，约 8k 次 ZADD/s）。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives these numbers: a Redis sorted set for 10 million players takes gigabytes of memory, and finished games arrive around 4k per second, causing about 8k ZADDs per second.
options_en: Ten million players must be split across multiple Redis clusters to keep up.
Gigabyte-scale memory and tens of thousands of ZADDs per second both fit a single Redis instance, so it can be reused directly.
This scale must switch to a columnar store to hold up.
The write volume is too high, so it can only be recomputed by offline batch jobs.

q: 用 Redis sorted set 做精确排行榜时，同 rating 玩家如果没有确定性 tie-break，会出现什么问题？
q_en: With a Redis sorted-set leaderboard, what happens if equal-rating players lack a deterministic tie-break?
options: Game Server 会丢连接
无法写入 Redis
不能查询 top 50
分页和名次可能抖动
why: 相同 score 的成员顺序若不稳定，翻页和个人名次会看起来跳动；可在 score 或成员排序中加入确定性 tie-break。
why_en: Equal scores need deterministic tie-breaking or pagination and rank can appear to wobble.
optionExplanations: 错误。这是排行榜问题，和 Game Server 连接毫无关系。
错误。写入照常成功，tie-break 只影响读的顺序。
错误。ZREVRANGE 0 49 依然能查，只是同分内部顺序不确定。
对。同分成员顺序不稳定，翻页时同一个人可能一会儿在这页一会儿在那页。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — this is a leaderboard issue, unrelated to Game Server connections.
Wrong — writes still succeed; tie-breaking only affects read ordering.
Wrong — ZREVRANGE 0 49 still works, only the order within a tie is uncertain.
Correct — unstable ordering among equal scores means the same player can appear on different pages between requests.
options_en: The Game Server drops connections.
Redis writes stop working.
You can no longer query the top 50.
Pagination and rank can appear to wobble.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同分时用来决定先后顺序的额外规则。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A tie-break is an extra rule that decides ordering when scores are equal.

q: 为什么 rating/leaderboard 可以设计成派生视图而不是唯一真相？（多选）
q_en: Why can rating and leaderboard be derived views rather than the only source of truth? (Select all that apply)
options: Game result 持久化后包含计算 ELO 所需信息
每局保存开局 rating 快照，delta 可重算
Players row 和 Redis set 都可以通过幂等 apply/reconcile 修复
rating 只存在内存里，重启后无法恢复
why: 真正不可丢的是已完成对局结果；Players.rating 和 Redis 排行榜是加速读的物化视图，能重放修复。
why_en: Completed game results are the durable source of truth, while player ratings and Redis rankings are materialized views that can be replayed.
optionExplanations: 对。结果一落库，delta 就能随时从这条记录推出来。
对。开局快照让每局的 delta 自包含，不用查别的记录。
对。用 gameId 去重重放，加周期性 reconciliation 就能修复漂移。
错。真正的权威值是已完成对局记录，rating 是可以重建的物化视图。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — once the result is durable, the delta can always be derived from that record.
Correct — the starting snapshot makes each game's delta self-contained, no other record needed.
Correct — idempotent replay keyed by gameId plus periodic reconciliation repairs any drift.
Wrong — the real source of truth is completed game records; ratings are a rebuildable materialized view.
options_en: The persisted game result carries everything needed to compute the ELO delta.
Each game stores a starting-rating snapshot, so its delta can be recomputed.
Both the Players row and the Redis set can be repaired via idempotent apply/reconcile.
Ratings only live in memory and cannot be recovered after a restart.

q: 游戏结束后可靠更新 rating 与排行榜的顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the reliable order for updating rating and leaderboard after a game ends?
steps: 幂等 apply step 更新 Players.rating 和 Redis sorted set
周期性 reconciliation 从 completed games 重算并覆盖派生视图
先把 Game result 持久化为唯一提交点
若 apply 中途失败，用 gameId 去重后重试
why: 提交点应是 Game result；后续物化更新失败也能用 gameId 幂等重试和周期重算修复。
why_en: The game result is the commit point, and materialized rating updates can be idempotently retried and reconciled.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  E[Game ends]
  R[Compute rating delta]
  P[Persist player ratings]
  L[Update leaderboard view]
  E --> R --> P --> L

scenario: 面试官追问 fair play：玩家可能把棋局喂给引擎，但这不是实时走子路径的核心需求。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks about fair play: a player may feed the position into a chess engine, but that is not part of the core real-time move path.
q: 合理的系统边界是什么？
q_en: What is the right system boundary here?
options: 把引擎检测放到实时 move validation 的同步热路径
完全依赖客户端声明没有作弊
把它作为离线 ML/行为分析和人工复核系统
每步都暂停让对手投票
why: 引擎作弊很难从单步实时判定，通常要跨局比较引擎吻合度、用时模式和 rating 历史，再进入复核流程。
why_en: Engine cheating is best handled by offline behavioral and ML analysis across games rather than the synchronous move path.
whenOtherWins: 非法走子和超时必须在实时路径同步校验；反作弊则适合异步分析。
optionExplanations: 错误。单步实时判断根本分不出引擎走法和人类走法，会拖慢热路径又不准。
错误。客户端完全不可信，声明式反作弊等于没有反作弊。
对。跨局比较用时模式、引擎吻合度和 rating 历史，属于异步分析问题。
错误。这会打断实时体验，也不是可靠的作弊判据。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a single move cannot reliably distinguish engine play from human play, and it would slow the hot path for no accuracy.
Wrong — the client cannot be trusted, so a self-declared claim is not anti-cheat at all.
Correct — comparing time patterns, engine-move agreement, and rating history across games is inherently an offline analysis problem.
Wrong — this breaks the real-time experience and is not a reliable cheat signal anyway.
options_en: Put engine detection on the synchronous real-time move-validation hot path.
Rely entirely on the client's own claim of no cheating.
Treat it as an offline ML and behavioral-analysis system with human review.
Pause every move so the opponent can vote.
tradeoff: 异步跨局分析 vs 同步单步实时判定

scenario: 一盘顶级棋手对局有上万旁观者，旁观者只读且几百毫秒延迟可接受。
scenario_en: A top-player game can have tens of thousands of spectators, and spectators are read-only with a few hundred milliseconds of acceptable delay.
q: 旁观流量应该如何接入？
q_en: How should spectator traffic connect?
options: 旁观流量全部直接连到权威 Game Server
用 pub/sub 或树状广播把只读走子分发给旁观者
允许旁观者也能提交 moveAck
每个旁观者都单独开一份对局副本
why: 旁观是读 fanout，不能拖累 1:1 权威对局服务器；validated moves 可异步广播给只读订阅层。
why_en: Spectating is a read fanout problem, so validated moves should be distributed through pub/sub or a fanout layer instead of burdening the authoritative game server.
whenOtherWins: 若只有两名玩家实时交互，权威 Game Server 直接推送即可，无需额外 fanout 层。
optionExplanations: 错误。上万旁观者直连会拖垮负责校验和计时的权威服务器。
对。旁观是只读扇出，走异步广播层，不占用 1:1 对局的资源。
错误。旁观者不是对局参与方，让他们提交走子确认没有意义还有安全风险。
错误。每人一份副本既浪费资源又没必要，旁观者只需要读同一份广播。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — tens of thousands of direct spectator connections would overwhelm the server that also validates moves and runs clocks.
Correct — spectating is a read fanout, so it belongs on an asynchronous broadcast layer, not the 1:1 game path.
Wrong — spectators are not game participants, so letting them submit move acks is meaningless and risky.
Wrong — a separate copy per spectator wastes resources; spectators only need to read the same broadcast.
options_en: Attach all spectator traffic directly to the authoritative Game Server.
Distribute read-only moves through pub/sub or a tree-shaped fanout.
Let spectators also submit a moveAck.
Give each spectator their own separate game copy.
tradeoff: 只读扇出层承载旁观 vs 权威对局服务器直接扛

termDefinitions.meaning: 把同一份数据广播分发给大量只读订阅者的模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fanout is the pattern of broadcasting the same data to many read-only subscribers.

q: 完成的棋局归档为什么通常比看起来容易？
q_en: Why is finished-game archiving usually easier than it first looks?
options: 归档必须放在 Redis 内存里永久保存
每盘棋都需要存储完整视频
必须每步保存整张棋盘图片
棋局可以主要表示为短 move sequence 字符串
why: 一盘棋的核心历史就是走子序列；按开局线路查找可先看作对这些序列做前缀范围扫描。
why_en: A finished chess game is mostly its move sequence, which makes archiving compact and prefix-based opening queries natural.
optionExplanations: 错误。归档数据量大且冷，Redis 内存不是合适的长期存储层。
错误。棋局没有视频概念，走子记录本身就足够重放。
错误。逐步截图既浪费存储又不是重放需要的数据形式。
对。走子序列就是几十个字符的字符串，查开局线路是对它做前缀扫描。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — archives are large and cold data, so Redis memory is the wrong long-term storage layer.
Wrong — chess games have no video concept; the move record alone is enough to replay.
Wrong — per-step screenshots waste storage and are not the data shape replay actually needs.
Correct — the move sequence is just a short string, and finding openings is a prefix scan over it.
options_en: Archives must live permanently in Redis memory.
Every game needs a full video recording stored.
Every step needs a full board image saved.
A finished game can mostly be represented as a short move-sequence string.

q: bullet 棋里的 premove 对服务端最关键的要求是什么？
q_en: What is the key server requirement for premove in bullet chess?
options: 对手走子一到就重新校验 premove，合法即用、非法即丢
直接相信客户端已经校验过合法性
把 premove 当成一条普通聊天消息处理
premove 期间禁止一切时钟更新
why: premove 是玩家在未知对手回复前预先提交的意图，服务端必须在真实局面出现后重新判定是否合法。
why_en: A premove is only valid after the opponent's actual move is known, so the server must validate it then and discard it if illegal.
optionExplanations: 对。真实局面出现前 premove 只是意图，必须在那一刻重新判定合法性。
错误。客户端可被修改，服务端不校验等于放弃权威规则。
错误。premove 是要改变棋盘状态的走子指令，不是展示性消息。
错误。premove 应用后仍要正常计时，禁止更新会破坏公平。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a premove is just intent until the real position appears, so it must be re-validated at that moment.
Wrong — a client can be modified, so skipping server validation abandons authoritative rules.
Wrong — a premove is a command that changes board state, not a display-only message.
Wrong — the clock still needs to run normally once a premove is applied; banning updates breaks fairness.
options_en: Re-validate the premove the instant the opponent's move lands, apply it if legal and discard it otherwise.
Trust that the client already validated it.
Treat the premove as an ordinary chat message.
Ban all clock updates while a premove is queued.

q: 补全实时走子延迟目标：
q_en: Fill in the latency target for real-time move propagation:
text: 在线棋局的走子传播目标是端到端低于 {{200ms}}，因为 bullet/blitz 中每步只有几秒，延迟会直接吃掉玩家棋钟。
why: 这个量级驱动了 WebSocket、内存状态和避免热路径共享存储的设计。
why_en: The sub-200-millisecond target drives the choices of WebSocket, in-memory state, and avoiding shared-store hops on the move path.

scenario: 玩家提交匹配请求后，系统可能要等待另一个合适玩家出现，希望不额外建通知通道也能把 gameId 返回给等待方。
scenario_en: After a player submits a matchmaking request, the system may wait for a suitable opponent and wants to return the gameId to the waiting player without a separate notification channel.
q: 匹配 POST 的合理交互方式是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable interaction model for the matchmaking POST?
options: 立即返回 pending，让客户端每 50ms 轮询一次
只靠发邮件把 gameId 通知给玩家
长轮询，匹配成功或超时才返回
让客户端自己去扫描等待池找对手
why: 长轮询让已等待的玩家在被配对时直接收到 gameId，避免高频轮询和额外实时通道。
why_en: Long-polling lets a waiting player receive the gameId as soon as a match is found without high-frequency polling or a separate realtime channel.
whenOtherWins: 如果平台已有通用通知 WebSocket，匹配结果也可以走该通道；若等待时间极短，普通请求返回也够用。
optionExplanations: 错误。高频轮询浪费大量请求，还是要额外通道通知配对结果。
错误。邮件延迟太高，完全不适合秒级匹配场景。
对。已等待方的长轮询就是被 claim 时完成的那次请求，不用额外通道。
错误。客户端不该也不能直接访问服务端的匹配池。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — high-frequency polling wastes requests and still needs a separate channel to announce the match.
Wrong — email latency is far too high for a matching flow measured in seconds.
Correct — the waiting side's held long-poll is exactly the request that completes when it gets claimed, no extra channel needed.
Wrong — the client should not and cannot access the server's matching pool directly.
options_en: Return pending immediately and have the client poll every 50ms.
Notify the player of the gameId only by email.
Long-poll and only return once matched or timed out.
Let the client scan the waiting pool itself.
tradeoff: 长轮询零额外通道 vs 高频轮询多请求

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端发起请求后服务端先不回应，等有结果或超时才返回的模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Long-polling holds a client's request open on the server until there is a result or it times out.

q: 匹配时使用客户端传来的 rating 和读取 Player 记录里的 rating，关键差异是什么？
q_en: What is the key difference between using client-sent rating and reading rating from the Player record?
options: 客户端 rating 快但不可信；服务端 rating 慢一点但可信
两种来源的 rating 完全等价
Player 记录只能给排行榜用，不能拿来匹配
客户端上报的 rating 天然能防作弊
why: rating 影响对手质量，属于可被滥用的数据；服务端可信来源比省一次读更重要。
why_en: Rating affects opponent selection and can be abused, so a trusted server-side rating is worth the lookup.

老数据应定期归档到低成本对象存储，主库只留近期数据
改用无限内存缓存替代磁盘存储
why: 日增约 500GB、年增约 180TB 意味着主库不能无限增长；老交易应归档到 S3 一类冷存储，主库只保留近期热数据。
why_en: At roughly 500GB a day and 180TB a year, the operational database cannot keep growing forever, so older transactions should move to cheap cold storage.
scenario: 按 10k TPS、每行约 500 bytes 估算，支付数据每天新增约 500GB，一年约 180TB。
options_en: Keep all historical data in the primary OLTP database forever.
The growth is negligible, so no archiving plan is needed.
Archive old data to low-cost object storage periodically and keep only recent data in the primary database.
Switch to unlimited in-memory caching instead of disk storage.
q_en: What storage strategy is best supported by this growth estimate?
scenario_en: With 10k TPS and roughly 500 bytes per row, payment data grows by about 500GB per day and about 180TB per year.

scenario: 支付 operational DB 中 3-6 个月前的交易很少被在线查询，但合规和审计要求长期可访问。
q: 合理的数据生命周期策略是什么？
options: 所有交易只保留最近 24 小时数据
把全部交易数据放进 Redis 内存
把超期的老交易直接随机删除
老交易归档到 S3 等冷存储，减轻主库压力
why: 冷热分层让近期在线查询保持快，长期合规数据进入低成本对象存储并可按需检索。
why_en: Tiering old transactions to object storage keeps operational queries fast while preserving long-term audit access.
whenOtherWins: 如果老数据仍被高频在线查询，应保留在 warm store 或专门分析库中，而不是直接归档到冷存储。
options_en: Keep only the last 24 hours of transaction data.
Put all transaction data in Redis memory.
Randomly delete old transactions once they age out.
Archive old transactions to cold storage such as S3, lightening the primary database.
optionMeanings: 保留窗口太短，无法满足多年审计要求。
内存成本极高，也不是长期持久存储。
删除会永久丢失合规所需的历史记录。
冷热分层保留可查历史又不拖累主库。
optionDirectness: 不适合这里；合规审计常要求追溯数年，24 小时远远不够。
不适合这里；Redis 是内存缓存，不适合长期海量归档。
不适合这里；随机删除会破坏审计完整性，属于不可接受的数据丢失。
适合这里；对象存储成本低、可长期保留，还能减轻主库负担。
tradeoff: 冷存储归档保留可查性 vs 主库无限增长
q_en: What is a reasonable data lifecycle strategy?
scenario_en: Transactions older than three to six months are rarely queried online in the operational database, but compliance and audits require long-term access.

scenario: 商户频繁查询近期支付状态和报表，写路径仍由主库保证一致提交。
q: 读扩展可以优先采用什么？
options: 只读副本和对近期状态的缓存
把所有读取发到主库且不加索引
让 Kafka 直接响应 HTTP GET
把支付状态写进浏览器 cookie
why: 状态查询和报表读多时可用 read replicas 分担，热点近期状态可缓存；权威写仍在主库。
why_en: Read replicas and short-lived caches can offload status reads while the primary database remains the write authority.
whenOtherWins: 若读取必须刚写后立即强一致，应路由到主库或实现 read-your-writes，而不是盲读副本。
options_en: Read replicas and caching for recent status.
Send all reads to the primary with no indexes.
Have Kafka respond directly to HTTP GET requests.
Store payment status in a browser cookie.
optionMeanings: 只读副本分担查询，缓存近期热点。
把读压力全堆在写路径的权威库上。
把事件日志误当成同步查询接口。
把服务端状态错放到客户端存储。
optionDirectness: 适合这里；只读副本和短期缓存能分担状态查询而不影响写路径。
不适合这里；这会让主库同时扛写和全部读，浪费扩展手段。
不适合这里；Kafka 是异步事件日志，不是同步查询数据库。
不适合这里；cookie 存在客户端，无法作为权威状态来源。
tradeoff: 只读副本+缓存分担读 vs 全部读写压在主库
q_en: What should be the first read-scaling approach?
scenario_en: Merchants frequently query recent payment status and reports, while the write path still commits through the primary database.

scenario: PaymentIntent、Transaction、Webhook 等服务大多不持有本地会话状态，峰值流量会随假日销售突增。
scenario_en: PaymentIntent, Transaction, and Webhook services usually avoid local session state, while holiday sales can create sudden traffic spikes.
q: 应用服务层的默认扩展方式是什么？
q_en: What is the default scaling approach for the application service layer?
options: 所有流量固定一台主机
无状态服务加负载均衡水平扩展
每个商户手动启动一台笔记本
只靠数据库触发器处理 HTTP
why: 无状态实例不记本地会话，LB 可把请求打到任意健康实例；流量高了就加实例。有状态服务要先设计状态放哪。
why_en: Stateless services behind load balancers can scale horizontally to absorb bursty payment traffic.
whenOtherWins: 若服务必须保留本地状态，就要先外置到 DB/Redis，或用粘性会话/分片路由固定相关请求。
options_en: Pin all traffic to a single host.
Stateless services behind a load balancer, scaled horizontally.
Manually spin up a laptop per merchant.
Handle HTTP entirely with database triggers.
optionMeanings: 单机上限低，也没有故障冗余。
无状态实例可按负载动态增减。
人工手动扩容完全不现实。
数据库触发器不是设计来处理 HTTP 流量的。
optionDirectness: 不适合这里；单主机既扛不住突发流量也没有容错。
适合这里；流量高就加实例，实例挂了 LB 摘掉即可。
不适合这里；这不是可自动化、可编排的扩展方式。
不适合这里；触发器运行在数据库内部，不适合处理外部 HTTP 请求。
optionScenarioImpacts: 假日流量会被一台机器卡住；机器挂了，支付入口也跟着挂。
应用层可随时加机器；PaymentIntent 等权威状态留在数据库或缓存里。
扩容依赖人工动作，跟促销突发流量完全对不上。
HTTP 入口被塞进数据库层，数据库会被业务流量和触发逻辑绑死。
tradeoff: 无状态水平扩展 vs 单实例纵向堆资源

termDefinitions.meaning: 实例本地不保存必须延续到下一次请求的会话状态，请求打到任意健康实例都能处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stateless service keeps no required session state on one instance, so any healthy instance can handle the next request.

termDefinitions.meaning: 实例本地保存会话或任务状态；扩容时要外置状态，或把相关请求固定路由到同一实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stateful service keeps session or task state locally, so scaling requires externalizing state or routing related requests to the same instance.

termDefinitions.meaning: Load Balancer（LB）：把请求分发给多台健康应用实例的入口组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A load balancer distributes incoming requests across healthy application instances.

scenario: Transaction processing 需要判断是数据库写已经成功但 completed event 丢了，还是外部超时导致写根本没完成。
q: 文章提到的生产级强化模式是什么？
options: 只发一个 best-effort 日志
每次都让商户人工确认
两阶段事件：created + completed 分别记录
删除所有 pending transaction
why: created 事件记录开始处理，completed 事件记录数据库写完成；重试时可比较事件和 DB 状态，避免重复执行副作用。
why_en: A created event and a completed event let retries distinguish a missing completion event from a transaction that never committed.
whenOtherWins: 普通非金融 workflow 可能不需要两阶段事件；支付一致性风险使它值得讨论。
options_en: Emit just one best-effort log line.
Have the merchant manually confirm every time.
A two-phase model: separate created and completed events.
Delete every pending transaction.
optionMeanings: 单一事件无法区分丢事件和没写库两种情况。
人工确认无法跟上高吞吐、异步的处理速度。
创建和完成两个事件让重试能比对真实数据库状态。
删除 pending 记录会丢掉正在处理的真实交易。
optionDirectness: 不适合这里；单条日志分不清是数据库没写还是事件没发出。
不适合这里；人工确认不具备可扩展性，也无法应对 10k TPS。
适合这里；两阶段事件能让重试精确判断该重发事件还是重跑整个流程。
不适合这里；pending 记录可能对应真实进行中的交易，删除会造成数据丢失。
tradeoff: 两阶段事件精确重试 vs 单阶段事件粗粒度重试
q_en: What production-grade hardening pattern is described here?
scenario_en: Transaction processing needs to tell whether the database write succeeded but the completed event was lost, or whether an external timeout meant the write never completed.

q: 两阶段 transaction event 中，如果关键事件发射失败，为什么要把 transaction 置为 locked/failed 等待修复？
options: 让客户多付一次款
减少所有数据库行数
替代 HMAC 签名
阻止后续更新在事件链不完整时继续推进
why: 事件链缺口会让下游审计、对账和 webhook 视图不一致，锁住可防止错误状态继续扩散。
why_en: Locking a transaction when event emission is incomplete prevents later updates from compounding inconsistent downstream views.
options_en: Make the customer pay twice.
Reduce the total number of database rows.
Replace HMAC signing.
Block later updates from proceeding while the event chain is incomplete.
optionMeanings: 锁定状态本身不会导致重复扣款，反而是防线。
锁定和数据库行数无关。
锁定机制和签名认证是两个不同的关注点。
锁定阻止下游在证据不完整时继续基于错误状态推进。
optionDirectness: 不适合这里；锁定是为了防止不一致扩散，不是制造重复扣款。
不适合这里；locked 只是状态标记，不删除任何行。
不适合这里；锁定处理的是事件完整性，不是身份认证。
适合这里；事件链有缺口时先锁住，等修复后再放行后续更新。
q_en: Why lock or fail a transaction when a critical two-phase event emission fails?

q: 支付系统的 financial integrity 需要防哪些问题？（多选）
options: 重复扣款
把状态查询做成分页
银行成功但商户看到失败
审计事件丢失
why: 核心风险是钱和记录不一致：双扣、漏履约、丢审计都会造成金融和合规事故。
why_en: Financial integrity is about preventing duplicate charges, mismatched outcomes, and missing audit records.
options_en: Duplicate charges.
Paginating the status-query API.
The bank succeeds but the merchant sees failure.
Missing audit events.
optionMeanings: 同一笔款被扣了不止一次。
分页是 API 设计细节，不是金融风险。
内外部记录对同一笔交易的结果不一致。
历史证据缺失导致无法举证。
optionDirectness: 适合这里；这是双花/双扣类风险，必须防止。
不适合这里；分页只是接口设计选择，不是金融完整性风险。
适合这里；结果不一致会导致漏履约或客户投诉。
适合这里；丢事件会让审计和对账都失去依据。
q_en: What problems must payment-system financial integrity prevent? (Select all that apply)

scenario: 商户需要低延迟 API 当前状态，审计/对账/通知需要完整历史和异步消费。
q: 这两类需求应如何分层？
options: Operational DB 管当前态，事件流管历史
只用 Kafka 响应所有同步 API
只用 Redis 保存所有审计
把当前状态和历史都放浏览器
why: OLTP 库优化同步读写，事件流优化追加历史和多消费者；分层后两边可独立扩展。
why_en: The operational database serves current synchronous state, while the event stream serves immutable history and asynchronous consumers.
whenOtherWins: 非常小的系统可以先合并在一个数据库中，但支付规模和审计要求会很快需要分离。
options_en: The operational DB owns current state; the event stream owns history.
Use Kafka alone to answer every synchronous API call.
Use Redis alone to store all audit history.
Store both current state and history in the browser.
optionMeanings: 同步读写和追加历史各自用最适合的存储。
把异步事件日志错当成低延迟同步查询接口。
把内存缓存错当成长期持久审计存储。
把服务端权威数据错放到客户端。
optionDirectness: 适合这里；两者职责分离后可以各自独立扩展。
不适合这里；Kafka 消费是异步的，不适合直接答复同步 API。
不适合这里；Redis 没有持久化和长期审计所需的保证。
不适合这里；浏览器既不可靠也不是权威数据源。
tradeoff: OLTP 服务当前态 vs 事件流服务历史与异步消费
q_en: How should these two requirement types be layered?
scenario_en: Merchants need a low-latency API for current status, while audit, reconciliation, and notification need full history and asynchronous consumption.

q: Audit Service 和 Analytics Consumer 消费同一 CDC（变更数据捕获）流时，目标差异是什么？
options: 二者都只负责发 webhook
Audit 存完整历史，Analytics 建业务聚合视图
Audit 删除历史，Analytics 处理认证
二者都替代 payment network
why: 同源事件可以被不同消费者按不同查询模式存储，审计重完整性，分析重聚合与查询便利。
why_en: Audit stores complete provable history, while analytics materializes business-friendly aggregate views from the same events.
options_en: Both are only responsible for sending webhooks.
Audit stores complete history; Analytics builds business aggregate views.
Audit deletes history; Analytics handles authentication.
Both replace the payment network.
optionMeanings: 把两个不同职责的消费者混为一谈。
同一事件流按不同查询模式物化出不同视图。
把两者的核心职责都说反或说错。
把内部消费者和外部支付网络混淆。
optionDirectness: 不适合这里；webhook 通知是另一个独立消费者的职责。
适合这里；这正是同源事件流分化出的两种不同物化目标。
不适合这里；Audit 恰恰是不删除、只追加；Analytics 不做认证。
不适合这里；两者都是内部消费者，都不对外连接银行网络。
tradeoff: 完整可证明历史 vs 面向查询的业务聚合视图
q_en: How do Audit Service and Analytics Consumer differ when consuming the same CDC stream?

q: 补全 webhook 基本模型：
text: 商户配置 {{callback URL}} 和订阅事件列表；支付系统在状态变化时向该 URL POST 带 {{event type}}、payment data 和签名的 payload。
why: 这让商户系统可以在不轮询的情况下收到 payment.succeeded 等事件并触发履约。
why_en: A callback URL and subscribed event types let merchant systems receive signed payment events without polling.
q_en: Fill in the basic webhook model:

q: Webhook（服务器间事件通知）投递失败时为什么不能紧密无限重试？
options: 会让签名更安全
会自动修复 PaymentIntent
会在商户故障时放大流量并拖垮对方系统
会减少 Kafka 分区需求
why: 商户 endpoint 可能正在故障，指数退避能避免雪上加霜，同时保留最终投递机会。
why_en: Exponential backoff avoids overwhelming a failing merchant endpoint while preserving eventual delivery attempts.
options_en: It makes signing more secure.
It automatically fixes the PaymentIntent.
It floods a struggling merchant with even more traffic and can take it further down.
It reduces how many Kafka partitions are needed.
optionMeanings: 重试频率和签名安全性是两回事。
重试策略不会修复业务对象本身的状态。
紧密重试在对方本就故障时是雪上加霜。
重试策略和分区数配置没有关系。
optionDirectness: 不适合这里；签名安全性和重试间隔无关。
不适合这里；重试改变不了 PaymentIntent 的业务状态。
适合这里；无退避的密集重试会在商户最脆弱时把流量集中砸过去。
不适合这里；这里讨论的是投递重试，不影响 Kafka 分区数。
q_en: Why should failed webhook delivery not retry tightly forever?

scenario: 商户收到一个 payment.succeeded HTTP POST，需要确认它确实来自支付平台且内容未被篡改。
q: Webhook payload 应该包含什么安全机制？
options: 只靠请求来源的 IP 地址做判断
把卡号明文直接写进 payload 里
发短信让客户手动确认这笔通知
用共享 secret 给 payload 和时间戳签名
why: 签名让商户能验证来源和完整性，timestamp 还能限制重放窗口；仅靠 IP 很脆弱。
why_en: A webhook signature over payload and timestamp lets merchants verify origin and integrity and limit replay.
whenOtherWins: 私有专线内的固定集成可以叠加 IP allowlist，但不应替代 payload 签名。
options_en: Judge authenticity by source IP address alone.
Put the raw card number directly in the payload.
Text the customer to manually confirm this notification.
Sign the payload and timestamp with a shared secret.
optionMeanings: IP 容易被伪造或经过代理改变。
webhook payload 完全不该携带原始卡号。
客户不是接收 webhook 的一方，无法确认。
签名同时证明来源和内容完整性。
optionDirectness: 不适合这里；仅凭 IP 很容易被绕过或伪装。
不适合这里；卡号是高度敏感数据，绝不该出现在通知载荷里。
不适合这里；webhook 是系统间通信，客户根本看不到这次请求。
适合这里；签名让商户能验证来源和内容未被篡改。
tradeoff: 共享密钥签名验证 vs 仅信任来源 IP
q_en: What security mechanism should a webhook payload include?
scenario_en: A merchant receives a payment.succeeded HTTP POST and needs to confirm it really came from the payment platform and was not tampered with.

scenario: 商户后台只是偶尔查看某个 PaymentIntent 当前状态，不需要秒级业务触发。
q: 最简单的状态读取方式是什么？
options: GET 查询 /payment-intents/{id}
等待 webhook 才能看状态
直接查询 Visa 内部数据库
重新提交 charge
why: 当前状态查询是普通读路径，由 PaymentIntent Service 从 operational DB 返回即可。
why_en: Occasional current-state lookup is a normal read path served by GET from the operational database.
whenOtherWins: 需要自动触发履约时 webhook 更合适；需要历史审计时查 audit/event store。
options_en: GET /payment-intents/{id}.
Wait for a webhook to see the status.
Query Visa's internal database directly.
Resubmit the charge.
optionMeanings: 标准只读查询，直接返回当前状态。
webhook 是推送机制，不该被当成唯一查询手段。
商户系统没有也不该有银行内部数据库的访问权限。
重新发起扣款会制造新的交易，不是查询。
optionDirectness: 适合这里；偶尔查看当前状态就是标准的读路径。
不适合这里；只是偶尔查看时，等 webhook 是不必要的耦合。
不适合这里；银行内部系统对外部商户完全不可见。
不适合这里；重新 charge 会产生新的资金移动，不是状态查询。
tradeoff: 按需 GET 查询 vs 被动等待 webhook 推送
q_en: What is the simplest way to read current payment status?
scenario_en: A merchant dashboard only occasionally checks the current status of one PaymentIntent and does not need second-level business triggers.

q: 让原始卡号经过商户服务器，除了技术风险外还会带来什么后果？
options: 支付系统吞吐自动提升
商户 PCI 合规范围和泄露责任大幅增加
Kafka 不再需要分区
webhook 可以省略签名
why: 敏感卡数据触达商户基础设施会扩大审计、合规和攻击面，平台支付通常要帮商户避开这一点。
why_en: Letting raw card data touch merchant servers expands PCI scope, liability, and attack surface.
options_en: Payment system throughput automatically improves.
The merchant's PCI compliance scope and breach liability grow sharply.
Kafka no longer needs partitions.
Webhooks can skip signing.
optionMeanings: 卡数据路径和系统吞吐没有因果关系。
商户系统一旦接触明文卡号，合规和攻击面都会变大。
分区需求由吞吐和有序性决定，与卡数据路径无关。
webhook 签名的必要性不取决于卡数据怎么收集。
optionDirectness: 不适合这里；卡数据经过商户服务器和吞吐提升毫无关系。
适合这里；商户基础设施一旦接触卡号就进入更重的合规范围。

先发价格 SSE
why: 先持久化 pending 能记录客户端请求意图；否则 exchange 已收单但系统崩溃时内部完全不知道有这笔订单。
why_en: Persisting a pending order first records the client's intent before any external side effect occurs.
whenOtherWins: 纯只读查询不需要先写 pending；任何有外部副作用的金融操作都应先保留意图。
options_en: First write a pending order in the Order DB
Call the exchange first, and only then consider persisting it
Only write to the client-side cache
First send the price SSE update
optionMeanings: 先落库记录意图
先调用外部副作用
只写客户端
无关的价格推送步骤
optionDirectness: 最直接；先记录意图，才能在崩溃后知道有这笔请求。
不选；先调用 exchange 若随后崩溃，意图完全丢失。
不选；客户端存储不可靠，不能作为订单真相源。
不选；这一步和创建订单流程无关。
optionMeanings_en: Persist intent first
External side effect first
Client-only write
Unrelated price-push step
optionDirectness_en: Most direct; recording intent first means a crash afterward still leaves a trace.
Not selected; calling the exchange first and then crashing loses the intent entirely.
Not selected; client storage is unreliable and cannot be the source of truth for orders.
Not selected; this step is unrelated to order creation.
tradeoff: 先写意图（pending）再有副作用 vs 先有副作用再记录

termDefinitions.meaning: 订单已被系统记录但尚未提交给 exchange 的中间状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pending is the intermediate state recorded before the order has been submitted to the exchange.

q: 订单创建成功路径的正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct order for the successful order-creation path?
steps: 返回客户端下单成功
把 externalOrderId 写入 KV，并把 Order DB 状态更新为 submitted
Order DB 先写 pending 订单
同步提交订单给 exchange 并拿到 externalOrderId
why: 先记录意图，再执行外部提交，随后建立 externalOrderId 映射和内部 submitted 状态，最后响应用户。
why_en: The order flow records intent first, submits to the exchange, stores the external mapping and submitted state, then responds to the user.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  V[Validate order]
  P[Persist pending order]
  X[Submit to exchange]
  E[Store external order id]
  U[Update status]
  V --> P --> X --> E --> U
tradeoff: 意图先持久化 vs 外部副作用先发生

q: 订单已提交 exchange，但写 externalOrderId/KV 或更新 Order DB 时失败，系统会出现什么不确定性？
q_en: What uncertainty appears if the exchange submission succeeds but writing externalOrderId, KV, or Order DB state fails?
options: exchange 那边可能已有有效订单，内部却仍显示 pending
价格 cache 会自动把这个不确定性修复好
系统可以确定用户这笔订单一定没有下成
所有相关订单都会被自动改写成 cancelled
why: 外部副作用已发生但内部提交后步骤失败，必须靠 cleanup job 用 clientOrderId 查询 exchange 来修复。
why_en: The external order may exist while internal state remains pending, so cleanup must reconcile using a client order identifier.
options_en: The exchange side may already have a valid order while our internal state still shows pending
The price cache would automatically fix this uncertainty
The system can be sure the user's order definitely did not go through
All related orders get automatically rewritten to cancelled
optionMeanings: 内外部状态分叉
误判为价格问题
误判为订单未发生
误判为统一变成取消
optionDirectness: 最直接；这正是「已有外部副作用、内部未确认」的不确定状态。
不选；这里讨论订单一致性，跟价格 cache 无关。
不选；exchange 很可能已经真的收到了这笔订单。
不选；失败并不会把订单自动改写成 cancelled。
optionMeanings_en: Internal/external state diverge
Wrongly blames price cache
Wrongly assumes no order happened
Wrongly assumes auto-cancel
optionDirectness_en: Most direct; this is exactly the uncertain state where an external side effect happened but internal confirmation did not.
Not selected; this is about order consistency, unrelated to the price cache.
Not selected; the exchange likely did receive the order.
Not selected; a failure does not automatically rewrite the order as cancelled.

scenario: 提交 exchange 后系统崩溃，后续 cleanup 需要确认这笔内部订单是否真的被 exchange 接受。
scenario_en: The system crashes after submitting to the exchange, and later cleanup must confirm whether this internal order was actually accepted.
q: 提交给 exchange 时应带什么元数据？
q_en: What metadata should be sent when submitting an order to the exchange?
options: clientOrderId，用内部订单 ID 或幂等键标识这次请求
用户当前使用的手机型号信息
客户端当前设置的 UI 主题颜色
这条 SSE 长连接自身的 connection id
why: clientOrderId 让后台可用内部标识向 exchange 查询或去重，把 pending 订单修复为 submitted 或 failed。
why_en: A clientOrderId lets cleanup query or deduplicate the exchange submission and repair pending internal state.
whenOtherWins: 如果 exchange 原生返回前已强事务性写入我们的 DB，就不需要额外查询标识；现实里通常要带。
options_en: clientOrderId, an internal order id or idempotency key identifying this request
The user's current phone model information
The client's currently selected UI theme color
The connection id of this particular SSE connection
optionMeanings: 幂等标识
无关的设备信息
无关的UI状态
无关的连接标识
optionDirectness: 最直接；后台可拿它去交易所核对，把订单修复到正确状态。
不选；手机型号和订单核对完全无关。
不选；UI 主题色不是可用于对账的标识。
不选；SSE 连接 id 属于价格推送通道，不是订单提交标识。
optionMeanings_en: Idempotency key
Unrelated device info
Unrelated UI state
Unrelated connection id
optionDirectness_en: Most direct; cleanup can use it to query or dedupe against the exchange and repair pending state.
Not selected; phone model has nothing to do with order reconciliation.
Not selected; a UI theme color is not an identifier usable for reconciliation.
Not selected; the SSE connection id belongs to the price channel, not order submission.
tradeoff: 带幂等键可对账 vs 无标识则失联

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端/我们系统提交订单时带的幂等标识，用来后续查询或去重。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: clientOrderId is an idempotency key we attach when submitting an order, used later to query or deduplicate it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一操作重复执行多次，结果和执行一次一样。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotent means repeating the same operation multiple times produces the same result as doing it once.

scenario: 有一批 pending 订单停留太久，可能是 exchange 提交后内部更新失败，也可能是提交根本没成功。
scenario_en: A batch of pending orders has been stuck too long; exchange submission may have succeeded but internal updates failed, or submission may never have succeeded.
q: cleanup job 应该如何处理？
q_en: How should the cleanup job handle stuck pending orders?
options: 按 clientOrderId 查询 exchange，有则补状态，无则标 failed
不做任何查证，直接把这一整批订单全标记为 succeeded
不做任何查证，直接把这一整批订单全部删除且不留痕迹
不做任何查证，随机挑选其中一半订单标记为取消
why: cleanup 的任务是把未知状态向外部权威结果收敛，而不是猜测或丢弃金融状态。
why_en: Cleanup should reconcile pending orders against the exchange and repair them based on the authoritative external result.
whenOtherWins: 如果失败发生在写 pending 之前，系统可直接向客户端返回失败，因为没有外部副作用。
options_en: Query the exchange by clientOrderId: fill in status if found, mark failed if not
Without any verification, mark this entire batch of orders as succeeded
Without any verification, delete this entire batch of orders without a trace
Without any verification, randomly pick half of these orders and mark them cancelled
optionMeanings: 向外部权威结果收敛
无依据地乐观处理
丢弃金融记录
随机臆断处理
optionDirectness: 最直接；用外部真实结果决定这批订单的最终状态。
不选；没有查证就假设成功，可能虚报交易结果。
不选；删除会抹掉审计所需的金融记录。
不选；随机处理和订单真实结果毫无关系。
optionMeanings_en: Reconcile against the external authority
Optimistically assume success
Discard financial records
Randomly guess
optionDirectness_en: Most direct; it resolves each order's final state using the real external result.
Not selected; assuming success without checking can misreport a trade.
Not selected; deleting erases records needed for audit.
Not selected; random handling has nothing to do with the order's real outcome.
tradeoff: 对账收敛到外部真相 vs 猜测/丢弃内部状态

termDefinitions.meaning: 周期性把内部状态与外部权威结果核对并修复的后台任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cleanup job periodically reconciles internal state against the external authoritative result and repairs it.

scenario: 用户取消一个 outstanding limit order；系统可能在调用 exchange 前后失败，但不能丢掉取消意图。
scenario_en: A user cancels an outstanding limit order; the system may fail before or after calling the exchange, but it must not lose the cancel intent.
q: 取消流程第一步应该是什么？
q_en: What should be the first step in the cancel flow?
options: 把内部订单状态更新为 pending_cancel
直接调用 exchange 后再看是否要记录
删除订单行
只从 UI 隐藏订单
why: pending_cancel 持久化了用户取消意图，后续失败时 cleanup 可以继续查询/补偿。
why_en: Persisting pending_cancel first records the user's cancellation intent so cleanup can resolve failures later.
whenOtherWins: 若订单已 filled，取消应被拒绝或转为 no-op，而不是进入 pending_cancel。
options_en: Update the internal order status to pending_cancel
Call the exchange directly first and decide whether to record it afterward
Delete the order row
Only hide the order from the UI
optionMeanings: 先记录取消意图
先有外部副作用
误判为删除记录
误判为仅前端处理
optionDirectness: 最直接；先持久化取消意图，失败后 cleanup 才有据可查。
不选；先调用 exchange 若之后失败，取消意图没有留痕。
不选；删除行会让后续对账无从查起。
不选；只改 UI 不改变订单在系统里的真实状态。
optionMeanings_en: Persist cancel intent first
External side effect first
Wrongly deletes the row
Wrongly UI-only
optionDirectness_en: Most direct; persisting cancel intent first gives cleanup something to reconcile against if it fails.
Not selected; calling the exchange first and failing afterward leaves no trace of the intent.
Not selected; deleting the row leaves nothing for reconciliation to work from.
Not selected; hiding it in the UI does not change the order's real system state.
tradeoff: 先写取消意图 vs 先发生外部取消副作用

termDefinitions.meaning: 取消请求已记录但尚未确认成功的中间状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pending_cancel is the intermediate state recorded once a cancel is requested but not yet confirmed.

q: 订单取消成功路径的正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct order for the successful order-cancel path?
steps: 调用 exchange cancel API
把 Order DB 状态更新为 cancelled
先把订单状态写为 pending_cancel
向客户端返回取消成功
why: 先记录取消意图，再执行外部取消并落内部最终状态，最后响应客户端。
why_en: The cancel flow records intent first, calls the exchange, stores the final cancelled state, and then responds.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  L[Load order]
  C[Check cancellable]
  X[Send cancel to exchange]
  D[Mark cancelled]
  L --> C --> X --> D
tradeoff: 意图先持久化 vs 外部取消副作用先发生

q: 取消请求已发给 exchange，但写内部 cancelled 状态失败时，应依赖什么修复？
q_en: What repair path is needed if the cancel request reaches the exchange but writing internal cancelled state fails?
options: cleanup 查 exchange，已取消补状态，未取消继续处理
不查证，直接把这笔订单从数据库删除
不查证，直接要求用户重新注册一个账号
不查证，让价格 processor 顺手改掉这笔订单
why: pending_cancel 是可恢复状态，cleanup 用外部结果把内部状态推进到 cancelled 或其他明确结果。
why_en: The pending_cancel state lets cleanup query the exchange and advance the internal order to a clear final state.
options_en: Cleanup queries the exchange: repair status if cancelled, keep handling it if not
Without checking, delete this order from the database
Without checking, ask the user to re-register a new account
Without checking, let the price processor edit this order instead
optionMeanings: 扫描并对账取消中订单
误判为删除记录
无关的账户操作
误用价格组件改订单
optionDirectness: 最直接；用外部结果把这批取消中订单推进到明确终态。
不选；删除会丢失这笔取消请求的审计痕迹。
不选；重新注册和这笔订单的状态毫无关系。
不选；价格 processor 不拥有订单写权限。
optionMeanings_en: Scan and reconcile pending_cancel
Wrongly deletes the row
Unrelated account action
Wrong component edits the order
optionDirectness_en: Most direct; it advances pending_cancel to a definite final state using the external result.
Not selected; deleting loses the audit trail for this cancellation.
Not selected; re-registering the account has nothing to do with this order's state.
Not selected; the price processor has no write authority over orders.
tradeoff: pending_cancel 可恢复 vs 直接丢弃不确定状态

termDefinitions.meaning: 取消请求已记录但尚未确认成功的中间状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pending_cancel is the intermediate state recorded once a cancel is requested but not yet confirmed.

q: 订单创建流程中哪些失败处理是合理的？（多选）
q_en: Which failure-handling choices are reasonable in the order-creation flow? (Choose all that apply)
options: 写 pending 失败：直接向客户端返回失败并停止
提交 exchange 失败：标记订单 failed 并返回失败
提交 exchange 后内部更新失败：交给 cleanup 通过 clientOrderId 对账
任何失败都立即返回成功
why: 是否已经产生外部副作用决定处理方式；外部提交前失败可直接失败，提交后失败必须对账修复。
why_en: Failure handling depends on whether the external side effect occurred, with post-submission uncertainty requiring reconciliation.
options_en: Pending write fails: return failure to the client and stop
Exchange submission fails: mark the order failed and return failure
Internal update fails after exchange submission: hand off to cleanup to reconcile by clientOrderId
Any failure should immediately return success
optionMeanings: 写库前失败直接报错
提交失败标记failed
提交后失败交给对账
把失败伪装成成功
optionDirectness: 正确；还没有外部副作用，可以直接安全失败。
正确；提交失败没有产生持久的外部状态歧义。
正确；外部副作用已发生，必须靠对账收敛而不是猜。
错误；向用户谎报成功会制造更严重的信任和资金问题。
optionMeanings_en: Fail fast before any write
Mark failed on submission failure
Hand off to reconciliation
Fakes success on any failure
optionDirectness_en: Correct; no external side effect has happened yet, so it is safe to fail immediately.
Correct; a submission failure leaves no lasting external state ambiguity.
Correct; an external side effect already happened, so reconciliation must resolve it, not a guess.
Incorrect; falsely reporting success to the user creates a much worse trust and money problem.

scenario: 用户准备继续交易时必须看到最新订单状态，尤其是已提交、已取消、已成交这些状态。
scenario_en: Before continuing to trade, the user must see the latest order status, especially submitted, cancelled, and filled states.
q: 订单读取应该优先从哪里来？
q_en: Where should order reads primarily come from?
options: 强一致 Order DB 主分片，或能保证 read-your-writes 的路径
只用来展示行情、可以短暂落后的价格 SSE cache
客户端设备上早前保存下来的旧缓存副本
外部 exchange 面向所有交易者公开的公共价格 feed
why: 订单是用户资金相关状态，读取必须围绕内部权威订单库，必要时避免读到落后的副本。
why_en: Order reads are financial state and should come from the authoritative order store with read-your-writes guarantees when needed.
whenOtherWins: 股票价格展示可读缓存或 SSE 最新值；订单管理不能仅依赖弱一致缓存。
options_en: A strongly consistent Order DB primary shard, or a path guaranteeing read-your-writes
The price SSE cache, meant only for display and allowed to lag briefly
An old cache copy saved earlier on the client device
The exchange's public price feed, published to all traders
optionMeanings: 强一致订单主分片
价格推送缓存
客户端旧缓存
外部公开价格流
optionDirectness: 最直接；订单是资金状态，读取必须保证看到自己刚写入的结果。
不选；价格缓存服务的是行情展示，不是订单一致性。
不选；客户端旧缓存正是造成陈旧读的来源。
不选；exchange 的公开 feed 不携带我们的内部订单状态。
optionMeanings_en: Strongly consistent order primary
Price push cache
Stale client cache
External public price feed
optionDirectness_en: Most direct; orders are financial state, so reads must guarantee seeing your own latest write.
Not selected; the price cache serves market display, not order consistency.
Not selected; a stale client cache is exactly the source of stale reads.
Not selected; the exchange's public feed carries no knowledge of our internal order state.
tradeoff: 强一致订单读 vs 弱一致价格缓存读

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户自己刚写入的数据，随后自己读一定能读到最新值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Read-your-writes guarantees that a user who just wrote data will see that same write on their next read.

q: live price 数据和 order 状态在一致性要求上的区别是什么？
q_en: How do consistency requirements differ between live prices and order state?
options: 价格可短暂落后但要低延迟；订单必须高度一致且可恢复
价格必须强事务保证，订单反而可以随便丢弃
两者的数据其实都只存在于客户端设备上
两者的设计都完全不需要用到任何数据库
why: 行情是市场快照，短暂滞后可接受；订单代表用户金融意图和外部副作用，必须可靠持久。
why_en: Prices can tolerate slight staleness, while orders represent financial intent and external side effects that require strong consistency and recovery.
options_en: Prices can lag briefly but need low latency; orders must be highly consistent and recoverable
Prices must have strong transactional guarantees while orders can be dropped freely
Both kinds of data actually only live on the client device
Neither design needs any database at all
optionMeanings: 新鲜度优先 vs 一致性优先
把两者要求完全说反
误判两者都只在客户端
误判两者都不需要数据库
optionDirectness: 最直接；这正是两条数据在一致性目标上的核心区别。
不选；把「价格能容忍滞后」和「订单不能丢」完全颠倒了。
不选；两者都需要服务端持久状态，不止存在客户端。
不选；订单尤其必须落库，否则无法恢复和审计。
optionMeanings_en: Freshness-first vs consistency-first
Reverses both requirements
Wrongly claims client-only
Wrongly claims no database needed
optionDirectness_en: Most direct; this is exactly the core difference in consistency goals between the two.
Not selected; it flips "prices can lag" and "orders cannot be lost" backwards.
Not selected; both need durable server-side state, not just the client.
Not selected; orders in particular must be persisted or they cannot be recovered or audited.
tradeoff: 价格：新鲜度优先展示 vs 订单：强一致可恢复状态

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户自己刚写入的数据，随后自己读一定能读到最新值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Read-your-writes guarantees that a user who just wrote data will see that same write on their next read.

termDefinitions.meaning: 副本之间短暂不一致，但过一段时间会收敛到同一个值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eventually consistent means replicas can briefly disagree but converge to the same value over time.

scenario: Order DB 按 userId 分区，订单创建时先写 pending，exchange 返回后再填 externalOrderId 和 submitted。
scenario_en: The Order DB is partitioned by userId; order creation first writes pending, then fills externalOrderId and submitted after the exchange responds.
q: 哪段 schema 最贴合这个状态机？
q_en: Which schema best fits this order state machine?
options: orders(user_id, order_id, symbol, side, status, client_order_id, external_order_id)
一张纯价格缓存表 prices(symbol, last_price)，完全没有任何订单字段
一张极简账户表 users(last_login_only)，只记录最后登录时间
一张投递日志表 webhook_deliveries(payload_only)，只存原始报文
why: 订单表需要用户分区键、内部订单 ID、业务字段、状态、clientOrderId 和 externalOrderId 来支持恢复和 trade feed 映射。
why_en: The order schema needs user partitioning, internal and external identifiers, business fields, and status for recovery and feed updates.
whenOtherWins: 价格 cache 只需要 symbol/last_price；它不能替代订单状态机。
codeSample:
CREATE TABLE orders (
  user_id UUID,
  order_id UUID,
  symbol TEXT,
  side TEXT,
  status TEXT,
  client_order_id TEXT,
  external_order_id TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, order_id)
);
options_en: orders(user_id, order_id, symbol, side, status, client_order_id, external_order_id)
A bare price-cache table, prices(symbol, last_price), with absolutely no order fields at all
A minimal account table, users(last_login_only), recording only the last login time
A delivery-log table, webhook_deliveries(payload_only), storing only the raw payload
optionMeanings: 完整订单状态机字段
价格表结构
账户表结构
webhook日志结构
optionDirectness: 最直接；覆盖分区键、内外部标识和状态，支撑整套恢复流程。
不选；这是价格缓存表，不携带订单状态机字段。
不选；这是账户表，没有订单相关字段。
不选；这是投递日志表，不是订单真相源。
optionMeanings_en: Full order state-machine fields
Price table shape
Account table shape
Webhook log shape
optionDirectness_en: Most direct; it covers the partition key, both identifiers, and status needed for full recovery.
Not selected; this is the price cache table and has no order state-machine fields.
Not selected; this is the account table with no order-related fields.
Not selected; this is a delivery log, not the source of truth for orders.
tradeoff: 完整状态机字段可恢复 vs 精简字段丢信息

scenario: Trade Processor 收到 externalOrderId=ex_123，需要 O(1) 找到内部 orderId 和 userId。
scenario_en: The Trade Processor receives externalOrderId=ex_123 and needs O(1) lookup of the internal orderId and userId.
q: 哪种 KV 记录最合适？

options_en: ex_123 -> { orderId, userId }
userId -> allPrices
symbol -> allUsers
price -> password

毫无意义的字段组合

Nonsensical field pairing

Not selected; that solves price lookup, not order location.

Not selected; price and password have no business relationship.
tradeoff: O(1) KV 查找 vs 线性扫描订单表定位

scenario: 用户停留在订单页面，希望未成交订单被部分成交或取消后能实时看到更新。
scenario_en: A user is on the orders page and wants to see real-time updates when an open order is partially filled or cancelled.

q_en: Which natural extension does this requirement point to?
options: 把 order update 也做成实时推送流发给相关用户
干脆把价格更新这条通路彻底停掉
只在第二天用邮件统一通知用户
直接把整个 Order DB 数据表删掉
why: live order updates 是订单状态的用户级 fanout，可复用 SSE/WebSocket 或移动推送等机制，但必须以 Order DB 更新为准。

whenOtherWins: 如果产品允许用户手动刷新订单页，GET /orders 加强一致读即可先满足需求。

Simply shut down the price-update channel entirely
Only notify users the next day via a single email
Directly delete the entire Order DB table

误判为延迟到次日
误判为删除数据源
optionDirectness: 最直接；这是价格 fanout 模式在订单状态上的自然复用。
不选；这和「实时看到订单更新」的需求方向相反。
不选；次日通知完全达不到「停留页面时实时看到」的要求。
不选；Order DB 仍是权威来源，推送只是额外通路。
optionMeanings_en: Push order state in real time too
Wrongly stops the price channel
Wrongly delays to next day
Wrongly deletes the source of truth
optionDirectness_en: Most direct; it naturally reuses the price-fanout pattern for order state.
Not selected; this runs opposite to wanting real-time visibility into order updates.
Not selected; next-day notification cannot satisfy "see it live while on the page".
Not selected; the order DB remains authoritative — push is just an added channel.
tradeoff: 订单状态实时推送 vs 依赖用户手动刷新

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一条更新同时分发给多个订阅者/连接。

q: 让手机客户端直接向 exchange 提交订单的主要问题是什么？
q_en: What is the main problem with letting the mobile client submit orders directly to the exchange?
options: 外部客户端数量爆炸、状态不可控，客户端存储也不可靠
可以显著提高一致性
能自动降低 exchange 成本
不需要任何订单数据库
why: brokerage 需要控制 exchange 连接、记录订单状态并处理失败；手机不是可靠的金融状态源。
why_en: Direct mobile-to-exchange submission explodes external clients and leaves order state in an unreliable client.
options_en: External client count explodes and state becomes uncontrolled; client storage is also unreliable
It can noticeably improve consistency
It automatically lowers exchange costs
No order database would be needed at all
optionMeanings: 连接爆炸且状态不可靠
误判为提升一致性
误判为降低成本
误判为不需要数据库
optionDirectness: 最直接；这正是要用 brokerage 代理层规避的两个问题。

不选；连接数暴涨通常意味着 exchange 成本上升，不是下降。

Wrongly claims lower cost
Wrongly claims no database needed

Not selected; direct connections make consistency harder to guarantee, not better.
Not selected; an explosion of connections usually raises exchange cost, not lowers it.

scenario: 新用户订阅多个 symbols 时，SSE 连接建立后希望立即看到当前价格，而不是等下一笔 trade。

外部 exchange，对每个用户都单独查一次
只记录投递结果的 webhook delivery log
why: 内部 cache 保存最新已知价格，能在订阅时快速返回初始快照，后续再用推送增量更新。
why_en: The internal price cache provides an immediate initial snapshot before incremental SSE updates arrive.
whenOtherWins: 如果 symbol 很少且连接成本不敏感，可直接查 exchange；大规模用户不应这么做。
options_en: The internal price cache, kept continuously updated by the price processor
The user's order table, which stores order data
The external exchange, queried individually per user
The webhook delivery log, which only records delivery results
optionMeanings: 内部持续更新的cache
误用为订单表
误判为逐用户查exchange
误用为日志存储
optionDirectness: 最直接；cache 已有最新已知价格，能立即返回初始快照。
不选；订单表和 symbol 初始价格无关。
不选；这会让 exchange 连接数随订阅用户数暴涨。
不选；投递日志不是可查询的实时价格来源。
optionMeanings_en: Continuously updated internal cache
Wrongly uses the order table
Wrongly queries the exchange per user
Wrongly uses a delivery log
optionDirectness_en: Most direct; the cache already holds the latest known price and can return it instantly.
Not selected; the order table has nothing to do with a symbol's starting price.
Not selected; this would make exchange connections scale with subscriber count.
Not selected; a delivery log is not a queryable live-price source.
tradeoff: 内部cache即时快照 vs 等待首个trade事件

q: 一个用户订阅/取消订阅价格的生命周期，正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct lifecycle for a user subscribing to and unsubscribing from prices?
steps: 若某 symbol 在本实例没有剩余用户，取消 Redis channel 订阅
用户通过 Symbol Service 订阅 symbols
实例为每个 symbol 添加 user connection 映射，并确保订阅 Redis channel
用户断开或取消订阅时，从相关 symbol set 移除 connection
why: 实例只订阅有本地用户关心的 symbol，断开后清理映射并释放不再需要的 Redis 订阅。
why_en: A symbol service subscribes only to channels with local interested users and cleans those subscriptions up on disconnect.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  C[Open SSE]
  S[Add symbol mapping]
  R[Subscribe Redis channel]
  U[Fan out updates]

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 提供的发布订阅机制，发布者广播消息给所有订阅该 channel 的客户端。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis pub/sub lets a publisher broadcast a message to every client subscribed to that channel.

q: 为什么不能简单把每个价格更新广播给所有 Symbol Service 实例？
q_en: Why should every price update not be broadcast to every Symbol Service instance?
options: 大量实例根本没有该 symbol 的用户，白白浪费网络和 CPU
因为 Redis 这个组件根本无法发布消息
因为 SSE 这个协议根本不支持传输文本
因为订单数据库会因此自动被锁死
why: 按 symbol 订阅能让只有关心该股票的实例接收更新，避免无用 fanout。
why_en: Symbol-based subscriptions avoid sending updates to service instances with no interested users.
options_en: Most instances have no users for that symbol at all, wasting network and CPU for nothing
Because the Redis component is fundamentally unable to publish messages
Because the SSE protocol fundamentally cannot transmit text
Because the order database would automatically deadlock as a result
optionMeanings: 无关实例的无效开销
误判为Redis能力限制
误判为SSE协议限制
误判为订单库连带故障
optionDirectness: 最直接；按 symbol 订阅正是为了避免这种无谓 fanout。

不选；价格广播和 Order DB 锁机制毫无关联。

Wrongly blames Redis capability
Wrongly blames SSE protocol
Wrongly implicates the order database

scenario: 面试官把需求扩展到历史价格和用户组合市值曲线，这不是当前实时价格/订单主线。

options: 说明这是另一条时间序列/分析数据路径，可另行设计
把它混进实时 Order DB 热路径
让 SSE 连接永久保存所有历史
忽略用户资产历史
why: 历史价格/组合价值是时序存储与聚合问题，和实时 order consistency 的主路径不同，应单独建模。
why_en: Historical prices and portfolio value are time-series analytics problems, separate from the live order-management path.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品核心就是历史图表，应把时序存储提前纳入高层设计；本题范围主要是 live price 和 order management。
options_en: State that this is a separate time-series/analytics data path that can be designed independently
Mix it into the real-time Order DB hot path
Have the SSE connection permanently store all history
Ignore the user's asset history

误塞进实时热路径
误用推送通道当存储
误判为直接忽略

不选；历史聚合查询会拖慢对延迟敏感的订单热路径。
不选；SSE 是短生命周期推送通道，不是历史存储。
不选；忽略需求不是候选人该有的应对方式。
