Wrongly crams into the hot path
Wrongly uses SSE as storage
Wrongly ignores the ask
optionDirectness_en: Most direct; first frame it as new scope rather than forcing it into the existing main path.

Not selected; SSE is a short-lived push channel, not historical storage.

scenario: 外部 exchange 对连接数量和请求成本敏感，部分订单类型可被打包，但用户下单仍要求很低延迟。
scenario_en: The external exchange is sensitive to connection count and request cost, and some order types can be batched, but user order placement still needs very low latency.

q_en: How should batching order submissions be treated?

所有订单都要攒够一分钟才发送
任何金融系统都绝不能批量提交订单
批量提交只能用在价格订阅上

whenOtherWins: 非紧急批处理、报表或某些后台清算任务更适合 batching。
options_en: It can optimize exchange interaction cost, but must not sacrifice main-path latency
Every order must wait a full minute before sending
No financial system can ever batch order submission
Batch submission only applies to price subscriptions
optionMeanings: 有条件的优化手段
把批量绝对化成固定延迟
把批量当成绝对禁忌
把批量错配到价格通路

不选；批量提交讨论的是订单路径，不是价格订阅。
optionMeanings_en: Conditional optimization
Turns batching into a fixed delay
Treats batching as an absolute taboo
Misapplies batching to price subscriptions

Not selected; batch submission is a discussion about the order path, not price subscriptions.
tradeoff: 降低exchange交互成本 vs 交易下单主路径延迟

q: 补全订单状态机中的关键过渡状态：

text: 创建订单先写 {{pending}}，exchange 接受后变为 {{submitted}}；取消时先写 {{pending_cancel}}，exchange 确认后变为 {{cancelled}}。

q: 队列式 order dispatcher 虽不适合低延迟主路径，但它的一个有用工程信号是什么？

Queue depth proves the order has already been filled
The deeper the queue, the lower the latency
The queue can replace the Order DB

q_en: Why should rides use a denser GPS sampling interval than runs?
options: 速度越快，同样时间间隔移动的距离越大，采样太稀会让路线和距离失真
骑行时手机 GPS 硬件精度会自动变高
两种运动理论上用同一个间隔效果一样，无需区分
跑步的电池消耗天生比骑行更高，所以要降频
options_en: At higher speed the same time gap covers more distance, so a coarse interval distorts the route and distance
GPS hardware precision automatically improves during a ride
Both activities would work fine with the exact same interval
Running drains the battery faster than riding by nature
why: 骑行更快，相同采样间隔会让路线在地图上更稀疏、距离误差更大，所以间隔要按速度缩短，而不是全局统一。
why_en: Because riding is faster, the same sampling interval leaves sparser points and larger distance error, so the interval should scale with speed.

scenario: 用户在山里骑行没有网络，仍要准确记录路线、距离和时间，并在本地实时查看。
scenario_en: A cyclist has no network in the mountains but still needs accurate route, distance, and time locally in real time.
q: 核心设计转折是什么？
q_en: What is the key design shift for offline workout tracking?
options: 每个 GPS 点都必须同步到服务器后才显示
无网络时禁止开始活动
让好友手机代替记录
客户端本地记录和计算，完成或恢复网络后再同步
options_en: Every GPS point must sync to the server before it can display
Block starting an activity when there is no network
Have a friend's phone record the activity instead
Record and compute locally on the client, syncing once online
optionMeanings: 把服务器同步当成显示前提
用禁止开始规避离线场景
把记录职责转移给别人手机
客户端本地记录，网络恢复后同步
optionDirectness: 实时依赖服务器会让无网络活动卡住
禁止开始活动会放弃核心离线需求
好友手机不是可信的记录设备
本地记录能同时保可用性和本人体验
why: 活动统计可以完全在设备上完成，本地记录既保证无网络仍可用，也减少了服务端流量。
why_en: The client can fully compute activity stats locally, keeping the app usable offline while cutting backend traffic.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品要求好友实时跟随活动，仍需周期性上传；但用户自己运动中不需要服务端实时参与。
tradeoff: 客户端可用性优先 vs 服务端实时可见性

termDefinitions.meaning: 先假设网络不可用来设计功能，再把网络当成同步的加分项。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Offline-first means designing a feature to work without network first, then treating connectivity as a bonus for syncing.

q: 为什么 Strava 题强调客户端是系统设计的一部分？（多选）
q_en: Why does this Strava design treat the client as part of the system? (Choose all that apply)
options: 所有系统设计都必须把服务端删掉
现代手机有 GPS 传感器
手机有本地存储和可观计算能力
本地计算能在无网络时继续工作
options_en: All system designs must eliminate the backend entirely
Modern phones have GPS sensors
Phones have meaningful local storage and compute power
Local computation keeps working without network
optionMeanings: 把客户端能力等同于取消服务端
内置定位硬件
本地存储与处理能力
离线仍可运行的本地逻辑
optionDirectness: 不成立；服务端仍负责保存和分享
支撑客户端承担记录职责
支撑客户端承担记录职责
支撑客户端承担记录职责
why: 手机的传感器、存储和算力让它能承担核心记录职责；服务端仍负责持久化、同步和好友读取。
why_en: Phone sensors, storage, and compute let the client own live tracking while the backend still handles persistence and sharing.

q: 离线活动记录的正确流程是什么？
q_en: What is the correct flow for recording an activity offline?
steps: 网络可用且活动完成后，批量或分块上传服务端
GPS 点先进入内存 buffer 并更新本地统计
每约 10 秒把 buffer 持久化到本地存储
App 重启/恢复时先从本地存储加载未上传数据
why: 活动进行时本地 buffer 提供即时统计，周期性本地持久化降低掉电损失，之后再可靠同步服务端。
why_en: The offline flow buffers GPS locally, persists periodically, reloads after restart, and syncs once the activity can be uploaded.
tradeoff: 掉电丢失窗口 vs 本地写入和电池开销
diagram:
flowchart TD
  G[GPS point]
  B[Memory buffer]
  L[Local storage]
  R[Reload after restart]
  S[Sync when online]
  G --> B --> L --> R --> S

termDefinitions.meaning: 先把最新数据暂存在内存里，再周期性落盘的缓冲区。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An in-memory buffer temporarily holds recent data before it is periodically flushed to disk.

scenario: 活动记录在内存 buffer 里累积，设备随时可能没电或被强制关闭；产品要求丢失数据不超过一个短窗口。
scenario_en: Workout data accumulates in an in-memory buffer, but the device may lose power or be killed; data loss must stay within a short window.
q: 为什么把内存 buffer 刷到本地存储的频率定在约 10 秒，而不是 1 秒或 1 小时？
q_en: Why flush the in-memory buffer to local storage about every 10 seconds instead of every second or every hour?
options: 10 秒能控制掉电丢失窗口，又不过度耗电和 I/O
只有刚好 10 秒才能触发 iOS 和 Android 的系统权限
频率设置得越低，掉电时反而丢失数据越少
持久化频率高低和电池、I/O 消耗完全无关
options_en: Ten seconds bounds the shutdown data-loss window without excess battery or I/O cost
Only exactly ten seconds triggers iOS and Android system permissions
A lower frequency actually loses less data on shutdown
Persistence frequency has nothing to do with battery or I/O cost
why: 更短的间隔丢失数据更少但更费电和 I/O；更长的间隔省资源但掉电损失更大，10 秒左右是常见折中点。
why_en: A shorter interval loses less data but costs more battery and I/O, while a longer one saves resources but risks losing more, so about ten seconds is a common middle ground.

scenario: 一次长距离骑行产生大量 GPS 坐标和 timestamp，需要可靠保存在手机上直到上传。
scenario_en: A long ride generates many GPS coordinates and timestamps that must stay reliably on the phone until upload.
q: 本地存储更合适用什么类型？
q_en: What type of local storage fits long route data best?
options: 只放进内存数组
SQLite/Room/Core Data 这类结构化本地数据库
UserDefaults/SharedPreferences 存完整大路线
写到系统剪贴板
options_en: Keep it only in an in-memory array
A structured local database such as SQLite, Room, or Core Data
UserDefaults or SharedPreferences holding the full large route
Write it to the system clipboard
optionMeanings: 重启即丢，无持久性
结构化本地数据库，支持查询
简单键值存储，不适合大数据
非持久的系统剪贴板
optionDirectness: 纯内存适合临时 buffer，重启后不能恢复
本地数据库适合大而结构化的路线数据
键值存储适合小配置，不适合完整路线
剪贴板不是活动数据的持久层
why: 长路线是结构化且体量较大的数据，本地数据库比简单键值存储或纯内存更稳妥可靠。
why_en: A long route is structured and sizeable, so a local database is more reliable than simple key-value storage or memory alone.
whenOtherWins: 少量简单配置或 feature flag 可用 UserDefaults/SharedPreferences；路线数据更适合本地数据库。
tradeoff: 结构化数据库的可靠性 vs 键值存储的轻量

termDefinitions.meaning: 移动端结构化本地数据库方案（Android 用 Room，iOS 用 Core Data，底层常基于 SQLite）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SQLite, Room, and Core Data are structured local database options on mobile, with Room on Android and Core Data on iOS.

termDefinitions.meaning: 移动端简单键值本地存储，用于少量配置而非大数据集。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: UserDefaults and SharedPreferences are simple mobile key-value stores meant for small settings, not large datasets.

q: GPS 采样和本地持久化频率设置过高的主要代价是什么？
q_en: What is the main cost of setting GPS sampling and local persistence frequency too high?
options: 好友关系一定重复
数据库无法分片
电池和 I/O 消耗增加
路线无法画在地图上
options_en: Friend relationships are guaranteed to duplicate
The database can no longer be sharded
Battery and I/O consumption increase
The route can no longer be drawn on a map
optionMeanings: 与好友表无关的说法
与分片能力无关的说法
更频繁采样和写入的直接代价
与地图渲染无关的说法
optionDirectness: 采样频率不会决定好友边是否重复
数据库分片能力和本地采样频率无关
高频采样和写入会增加电池与 I/O 成本
地图展示依赖坐标数据，不因高频而失效
why: 更高频率的采样和持久化能提高精度和耐久性，但会更耗电、更耗本地 I/O，需要在体验和成本间折中。
why_en: Higher sampling and persistence frequency improves precision and durability but costs more battery and local I/O.

scenario: 活动时间很长，路线点很多，一次上传可能 payload 太大或网络不稳定。
scenario_en: A long activity has many route points, so one upload may have a large payload or hit an unstable network.
q: 上传策略应如何处理？
q_en: How should the upload strategy handle long activities and weak networks?
options: 必须一次性上传，失败就丢弃
每个点单独建立一个账号
按 chunk 分块上传并支持重试
只上传第一和最后一个点
options_en: Upload everything in one shot; discard it on failure
Create a separate account for every GPS point
Upload in chunks with retry support
Upload only the first and last point
optionMeanings: 单次大请求，失败即丢弃
把账号和数据点混为一谈
分块传输，可断点重试
只保留两端点，丢失中间路线
optionDirectness: 单次大请求在弱网下失败代价太高
账号不是 route point 的传输单元
chunk 上传适合长活动和弱网重试
只传端点会丢失路线形状和距离精度
why: 分块上传降低单次请求体积，网络恢复时能断点重试，适合长活动和弱网环境。
why_en: Chunked uploads shrink each request and allow retrying from where it left off, which suits long activities on weak networks.
whenOtherWins: 短活动、网络稳定且 payload 小时，单次上传更简单。
tradeoff: 分块重试的可靠性 vs 单次上传的简单
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[Activity complete]
  Q[Upload chunks]
  B[Backoff on failure]
  D[Deduplicate by activity id]
  V[Visible in feed]
  A --> Q --> D --> V
  Q -->|fail| B --> Q

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大文件或大量数据切成多个小块分批传输。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Chunking splits a large payload into smaller pieces that are transferred in batches.

q: 本地记录、完成后同步同时解决了哪些问题？（多选）
q_en: Which problems are solved by local recording followed by sync after completion? (Choose all that apply)
options: 无网络也能记录
服务端永远不需要保存活动
大幅减少服务端每几秒一次的位置写入
运动中统计可本地同步更新
options_en: Recording still works without network
The server never needs to save activities
Backend position-write traffic drops sharply
In-workout stats update locally in sync
optionMeanings: 离线仍可记录活动
误以为完成后也不必持久化
写请求量级下降
本地实时反馈
optionDirectness: 离线优先的核心收益
不成立；完成后仍要上传保存
离线优先的核心收益
离线优先的核心收益
why: 离线优先把写负载和实时统计留在设备上，但完成后的活动仍要上传服务端以便保存和分享。
why_en: Offline-first keeps write load and live stats on the device, but completed activities still upload to the server for persistence and sharing.

scenario: 改成本地记录、完成后才上传之前，客户端原本每几秒就要 POST 一次 GPS 坐标给服务端。
scenario_en: Before switching to local recording and post-completion upload, the client would POST GPS coordinates to the server every few seconds.
q: 把上报方式换成完成后批量同步，对后端写请求量级的影响是什么？
q_en: How does switching to batch sync after completion change backend write request volume?
options: 大幅下降，量级上少了大约两个数量级（约百倍）
略微下降，只少了几成
基本不变，因为总数据量没变
反而上升，因为要多传一次完整活动
options_en: It drops sharply, roughly two orders of magnitude (about 100x) fewer requests
It drops only slightly, by a fraction
It stays about the same because total data volume is unchanged
It actually increases because the full activity is sent as well
why: 从每几秒一次位置上报改成完成时批量同步，后端写请求从每活动上千次降到一次，量级上减少约百倍。
why_en: Moving from per-second position updates to a single batch upload after completion cuts backend write requests by roughly two orders of magnitude.

scenario: 离线优先后，服务端主要处理活动创建/完成上传/活动读取，没有明显读写路径需要独立扩展。
scenario_en: After offline-first tracking, the backend mostly handles activity creation, completed uploads, and reads; no path clearly needs independent scaling.
q: 后端服务拆分的合理判断是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable backend service-splitting decision here?
options: 必须为每一个 API endpoint 单独建一个微服务
把所有业务逻辑都放进数据库触发器里执行
认为可以直接取消整个服务端
保持简单 Activity Service，水平扩展即可
options_en: Build a separate microservice for every single API endpoint
Put all business logic inside database triggers
Assume the entire backend can simply be removed
Keep a simple Activity Service and just scale it horizontally
optionMeanings: 按端点强行拆微服务
把业务逻辑塞进触发器
误以为客户端能替代服务端
简单服务加水平扩容
optionDirectness: 按 endpoint 拆服务适合边界清楚且压力不同的路径
触发器适合少量数据约束，不适合承载业务流程
服务端仍负责持久化、同步和好友读取
简单 Activity Service 匹配当前职责集中度
why: 客户端已承担高频记录逻辑，服务端读写压力和职责相对集中，简单服务加水平扩展更贴合当前规模。
why_en: Since the client owns high-frequency tracking, backend load stays modest and centralized, so a simple horizontally scaled service fits.
whenOtherWins: 如果后续出现明显读写 skew、独立团队边界或实时分享高压路径，再拆服务更合理。
tradeoff: 简单集中服务 vs 提前拆分微服务

scenario: 产品约有 1 亿 DAU，假设每人每天完成一次活动，这样一年新增的 Activity 记录约是 365 亿条。
scenario_en: With about 100 million DAU and one completed activity per user per day, the system adds about 36.5 billion Activity records per year.
q: 这个年增量级最支持下面哪个数据库设计判断？
q_en: Which database design judgment does this yearly growth estimate support most?
options: 单表单机很快撑不住，需要分片和归档策略
数据量小到可以整年放进内存缓存
说明必须放弃关系型数据库
这个规模下不需要再考虑存储成本
options_en: A single table on one machine cannot hold this; it needs sharding and archiving
The volume is small enough to keep an entire year in memory cache
This means relational databases must be abandoned
At this scale, storage cost is not worth worrying about
why: 百亿级年增量在单机单表上很快会遇到容量和索引瓶颈，需要按时间分片并对旧数据分层归档。
why_en: Tens of billions of new rows per year quickly outgrow a single table and machine, so sharding by time and tiering older data becomes necessary.

termDefinitions.meaning: 日活跃用户数，每天至少使用一次产品的用户数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DAU is the number of unique users who use the product at least once per day.

scenario: 一次平均 30 分钟的活动，按约每 3 秒采集一个 GPS 坐标，会产生约 600 个 route point。
scenario_en: An average 30-minute activity sampled about every 3 seconds produces roughly 600 route points.
q: 600 个点这个量级最支持哪个 route 数据的设计判断？
q_en: What route-data design judgment does the 600-point estimate support?
options: 适合作为结构化的多行数据存进数据库，而不是塞进一个巨大字段
点数太少，不需要任何存储优化
点数太多，必须改用视频编码压缩路线
应该只保留起点和终点，中间点可以丢弃
options_en: It fits as structured multi-row data in the database, not one giant blob field
The count is too small to need any storage optimization
The count is too large; the route must be video-encoded instead
Only the start and end point should be kept; drop the middle points
why: 约 600 个带经纬度和时间戳的点是常规结构化数据规模，适合按行存储和索引，不需要极端压缩，也不该丢弃中间点。
why_en: About 600 timestamped coordinate points is a normal structured-data volume that fits row storage and indexing without extreme compression.

scenario: 每条活动的路线数据约 15KB，一年约 365 亿条活动，算下来路线存储总量约 547.5TB/年。
scenario_en: Each activity's route data is about 15KB, and 36.5 billion activities per year produce roughly 547.5TB of route storage annually.

options: 数据量大但可管理，适合分片加冷热分层，而不是放弃持久化
数据量小到可以只用单机 Redis 全量保存
数据量已经大到必须放弃关系型建模
这个量级下缓存能完全替代持久化存储
options_en: It's large but manageable with sharding and tiered storage, not a reason to skip persistence
It's small enough to keep entirely in a single Redis instance
It's so large that relational modeling must be abandoned
At this scale, caching can fully replace persistent storage
why: 547.5TB/年是大但可管理的规模，用分片和冷热分层就能控制成本，不需要放弃关系建模或指望缓存顶替持久化。
why_en: 547.5TB per year is large but manageable with sharding and tiered storage, without abandoning relational modeling or relying on cache alone.

q: 补全路线存储估算：
q_en: Complete the route storage estimate:

scenario: 活动数据每年数百 TB，查询大多看最近活动或近期好友动态。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一张大表的数据水平拆分到多个数据库实例上。

让客户端反复重传历史数据

冷热分层用访问频率换存储成本
只留一天会破坏用户查看历史的需求
why: 冷热分层按访问频率换存储成本：近期活动留在快速层，老活动挪到归档层仍可按需读取。
why_en: Tiered storage trades access frequency for cost, keeping recent activities fast while older ones move to cheaper archival tiers.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品承诺所有历史秒开且访问频繁，warm/hot 保留时间要更长。
tradeoff: 分层节省成本 vs 全量高速存储的简单一致
diagram:
flowchart TD
  H[Hot activity metadata]
  C[Cached summaries]
  O[Cold route blobs]
  H --> C
  H --> O

termDefinitions.meaning: 给很少访问的旧数据用的低成本、慢速存储层，如 S3 归档。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold storage is a low-cost, slower storage tier for rarely accessed old data, such as S3 archival.

scenario: 活动读取吞吐目前不高，主要压力是长期数据量；只有少数热门活动详情被反复查看。
scenario_en: Activity read throughput is not high yet; long-term data growth is the main pressure, with only a few hot activity details repeatedly viewed.
q: 缓存应该如何优先级排序？
q_en: How should caching be prioritized in this Strava design?
options: 一开始就把所有路线数据都缓存进 Redis
不是首要优先级，等热点变慢再加缓存
任何情况下都完全不允许使用缓存
缓存能够完全替代数据库分片和归档策略
options_en: Cache all route data into Redis from the very start
Not the first priority; add caching once hotspots slow down
Never allow caching under any circumstances
Caching can fully replace database sharding and archiving
optionMeanings: 过早把全部路线塞进缓存
按需加缓存，先解决存储增长
完全排斥缓存
误把缓存当存储策略替代品
optionDirectness: 全量缓存适合极高读热点，本题读吞吐还不高
先解决存储增长，热点出现后再加缓存
完全禁用缓存会丢掉后续优化手段
缓存只能加速读取，不能替代持久存储规划
why: 当前读吞吐不是主要压力，存储增长才是；缓存适合在具体热点和延迟问题出现后再补上。
why_en: Read throughput isn't the current pressure, storage growth is, so caching is best added later once specific hotspots appear.
whenOtherWins: 若某些明星活动或活动 feed 被频繁访问，缓存会更快成为必要组件。
tradeoff: 先解决存储增长 vs 提前引入缓存复杂度

scenario: 用户打开列表页，需要看自己的已完成活动或好友已完成活动，每项只展示距离、时间、日期等摘要。
scenario_en: A user opens a list of their own or friends' completed activities, and each row only shows summary fields like distance, time, and date.
q: 列表接口应该返回什么形态？
q_en: What shape should the activity-list API return?
options: 把完整路线的所有 GPS 点都返回
把所有好友关系和全部历史一起返回
分页返回 Partial<Activity>，只含摘要字段
直接返回地图瓦片的原始图片
options_en: Return the full route with every GPS point
Return all friend relationships and full history together
Return a paginated Partial<Activity> with only summary fields
Return raw map tile images directly
optionMeanings: 把详情页数据搬进列表
无关的好友关系全量
轻量分页摘要
跟活动列表无关的资源
optionDirectness: 完整 route 适合详情页，不适合列表滚动
好友关系全量不属于活动列表行数据
分页摘要满足列表页的轻量读取
地图瓦片由地图服务处理，不是活动列表响应
why: 列表页只需距离、时间等摘要字段，返回完整 route 会让 payload 过大、滚动变慢；详情页再单独请求完整数据。
why_en: The list view only needs summary fields like distance and time; returning the full route would bloat the payload and slow scrolling.
whenOtherWins: 如果是导出 GPX 或打开详情页，才需要完整 route 数据。
tradeoff: 列表轻量摘要 vs 详情完整数据

termDefinitions.meaning: 把长列表拆成一页页返回，避免一次传输过多数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pagination splits a long list into pages so the server doesn't return too much data at once.

scenario: 好友关系用 friends(userId, friendId) 存双向边，活动列表要查询当前用户好友的已完成活动。
scenario_en: Friend edges are stored as friends(userId, friendId) in both directions, and the feed needs completed activities from the current user's friends.
q: 哪类查询最贴合这个需求？
q_en: Which query pattern best fits this friend-activity feed?
options: 把所有活动拉到客户端本地再逐条过滤
只查询当前登录用户自己的活动
用 IN 子查询按 friends 表过滤好友的已完成活动
按 activityId 做完全随机的抽样查询
options_en: Pull all activities to the client and filter them one by one
Only query the currently logged-in user's own activities
Use an IN subquery against the friends table to filter completed friend activities
Randomly sample activities by activityId
optionMeanings: 拉全量数据再本地过滤
忽略好友，只看自己
数据库端过滤好友的已完成活动
结果不可预测的随机抽样
optionDirectness: 客户端拉全量会浪费网络并放大延迟
只查自己活动不能构成好友 feed
索引加数据库端过滤适合基础好友 feed
随机抽样不能保证返回好友已完成活动
why: friends 表在 userId 上建了索引，用 IN 子查询直接在数据库端过滤已完成活动并分页，网络传输最少。
why_en: With an index on userId, an IN subquery filters completed friend activities inside the database and keeps network transfer minimal.
whenOtherWins: 超大好友图和高频 feed 可用预计算 feed 或 fanout；基础设计用查询即可。
tradeoff: 数据库端过滤 vs 客户端拉全量再过滤
codeSample:
SELECT * FROM activities
WHERE state = 'COMPLETE'
AND user_id IN (SELECT friend_id FROM friends WHERE user_id = :user_id)
LIMIT :page_size OFFSET :offset;

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库里加速查询的辅助结构，避免全表扫描。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An index is a database structure that speeds up lookups without scanning the whole table.

q: friends 表用 (userId, friendId) 双向各存一行，并在 userId 上建索引，主要好处是什么？
q_en: Why store both directions in friends(userId, friendId) and index userId?
options: 让 GPS 更精确
自动完成活动上传
替代 Activity 表
快速查某个用户的好友并避免重复边
options_en: Makes GPS more accurate
Automatically completes activity uploads
Replaces the Activity table
Fast friend lookup while preventing duplicate edges
optionMeanings: 与好友表无关的说法
与好友表无关的说法
混淆了两张表的用途
索引查友加复合主键去重
optionDirectness: GPS 精度由定位硬件和环境决定
活动上传不是 friends 表的职责
Activity 表仍保存活动本身
双向边加索引让好友查询和去重更直接
why: 双向各存一行让查某人的好友变成单向索引查找，复合主键 (userId, friendId) 防止同一条边被重复插入。
why_en: Storing both directions turns friend lookup into a simple indexed query, and the composite key prevents duplicate edges.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由多个字段共同组成的主键，用于唯一标识一行并防止重复。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A composite primary key combines multiple columns to uniquely identify a row and prevent duplicates.

scenario: 用户点进活动详情页，需要在地图上显示跑步路线。
scenario_en: A user opens an activity detail page and needs to see the running route on a map.
q: 路线地图展示需要后端提供什么？
q_en: What should the backend provide so the route can be shown on a map?
options: 把运动过程录成完整视频的每一帧
GPS 坐标数组，交给地图 API 画 polyline
服务端截图好的静态图片唯一版本
把好友的登录密码返回给前端
options_en: Record the entire workout as video, frame by frame
A GPS coordinate array that a map API renders as a polyline
A single server-rendered static map image
Return a friend's login password to the frontend
optionMeanings: 数据量过大的视频帧
坐标数组交给前端渲染
服务端预渲染的静态图
与地图渲染无关
optionDirectness: 视频帧会把路线展示变成巨大媒体存储问题
坐标数组交给地图 API 可画可缩放路线
静态图适合分享缩略图，不适合详情交互
登录密码和路线渲染没有关系
why: 详情页拿到坐标数组后，用地图 API（如 Google Maps）把点连成 polyline，用户还能交互缩放。
why_en: The detail page takes the coordinate array and lets a map API draw a polyline that users can pan and zoom.
whenOtherWins: 若目标是缩略图或分享卡片，服务端预渲染静态地图图像也可能更高效。
tradeoff: 坐标数组的前端灵活渲染 vs 服务端预渲染静态图的省算力

termDefinitions.meaning: 地图上连接一串坐标点的折线，用来画出运动路线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A polyline is a line connecting a sequence of coordinates, used to draw a route on a map.

scenario: 新增需求：好友可以在你跑步时近实时看到路线和数据，但几秒延迟可接受。
scenario_en: New requirement: friends can watch your route and stats while you run, with a few seconds of delay acceptable.
q: 活动中的设备应如何对服务端上报？
q_en: How should the active device report data to the backend during live sharing?
options: 完全停止客户端本地计算和统计
本地继续算给本人看，同时每 2-5 秒上传位置供好友查看
只在活动结束后才允许好友看到任何内容
每隔一毫秒就发送一次位置更新
options_en: Stop all local client computation and stats entirely
Keep computing locally for the athlete while uploading location every 2-5 seconds for friends
Only let friends see anything after the activity ends
Send a location update every single millisecond
optionMeanings: 放弃本地计算能力
双轨：本地体验加周期上传
取消实时分享需求
过度频繁的上报
optionDirectness: 停止本地计算会让本人体验依赖网络
本地计算加周期上传兼顾本人和好友
完成后才可见不满足 live sharing
毫秒级上报会浪费网络、电池和服务端资源
why: 实时分享需要重新引入周期性上传，但本人的体验仍应由本地数据驱动，不受网络波动影响。
why_en: Realtime sharing reintroduces periodic uploads for friends while the athlete's own experience stays driven by local data.
whenOtherWins: 若没有实时分享需求，完成后一次性同步更简单、更省电、更省服务端资源。
tradeoff: 好友近实时可见 vs 本人体验对网络的独立性

scenario: 好友看 live activity 时，位置更新可预测每 2-5 秒一次，几秒滞后可接受，主要是只读查看。
scenario_en: For live activity viewing, position updates arrive predictably every 2-5 seconds, a few seconds of lag is fine, and friends only read the stream.
q: 更新节奏可预测、几秒延迟可接受时，最简单可行的方案是什么？
q_en: When updates are predictable and a few seconds of delay is acceptable, what is the simplest viable approach?
options: 一定要 WebSocket/Redis pubsub 全套实时架构
让好友直接连运动者手机
好友客户端按相同节奏轮询最新活动点，略作延迟缓冲
只发短信
options_en: Require a full realtime stack with WebSocket or Redis pub/sub
Have friends connect directly to the athlete's phone
Friend clients poll at a similar cadence with a small delay buffer
Send updates only by SMS
optionMeanings: 持久连接的完整实时基础设施
点对点直连，不经过服务端
按固定节奏轮询加缓冲
用短信充当实时通道
optionDirectness: 长连接适合低延迟或不可预测事件，本题需求更宽松
直连运动者手机会碰到网络穿透和安全问题
轮询加小缓冲在固定节奏下简单够用
短信适合通知，不适合地图位置流
why: 更新频率可预测且允许几秒延迟，轮询比维护长连接更简单；WebSocket/SSE 在这里是过度设计。
why_en: Because updates are predictable and a few seconds of lag is fine, polling is simpler than maintaining persistent realtime connections.
whenOtherWins: 如果需要大量观众、不可预测事件或亚秒互动，WebSocket/SSE/pubsub 会更有价值。
tradeoff: 轮询的简单性 vs 长连接的低延迟

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端按固定节奏主动向服务端请求最新数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Polling means the client periodically requests fresh data from the server on a fixed interval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在客户端和服务端之间维持一条持久双向连接的协议。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WebSocket is a protocol that keeps a persistent two-way connection between client and server.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务端向客户端单向推送事件流的协议（Server-Sent Events）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SSE, or Server-Sent Events, lets a server push a one-way stream of updates to the client.

termDefinitions.meaning: 发布订阅模式，发布者广播消息，多个订阅者各自接收。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pub/sub is a pattern where a publisher broadcasts messages that multiple subscribers receive.

q: 好友实时观看活动时，故意显示慢 1-2 个更新间隔的好处是什么？
q_en: Why intentionally show live activity data one or two update intervals behind to friends?
options: 让活动数据永久丢失
用 5-10 秒缓冲平滑动画，减少位置跳变
阻止运动者保存活动
减少 GPS 精度到 0
options_en: Permanently lose activity data
Use a 5-10 second buffer to smooth the animation and reduce jumps
Prevent the athlete from saving the activity
Reduce GPS precision to zero
optionMeanings: 与缓冲目的无关的说法
延迟换取动画连贯
与缓冲目的无关的说法
与缓冲目的无关的说法
optionDirectness: 缓冲不应该造成永久数据丢失
5-10 秒缓冲能平滑位置跳变
保存活动和观看缓冲是两条路径
GPS 精度不应被缓冲降为不可用
why: 故意展示慢 1-2 个更新间隔的数据，能让前端插值出连贯动画，代价是牺牲几秒绝对实时性。
why_en: Intentionally showing data delayed by one or two intervals lets the client interpolate smooth motion, at the cost of a few seconds of freshness.

q: 好友实时跟随活动的简单轮询链路，正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct order for a simple polling-based live-follow flow?
steps: 好友客户端延迟 1-2 个 interval 后平滑播放路线
运动者客户端每 2-5 秒上传最新位置
服务端持久化最新 activity updates
好友客户端按类似节奏轮询最新点
why: 运动端周期性上传，服务端保存，好友端按节奏拉取并缓冲播放，避免维护复杂长连接。
why_en: The live-follow flow uploads periodically, stores updates, polls them from friends' clients, and buffers playback for smoothness.
tradeoff: 轮询的运维简单 vs 长连接的更低延迟
diagram:
flowchart TD
  P[Phone uploads latest point]
  S[Server stores latest view]
  F[Friend polls]
  M[Map shows slight delay]
  P --> S --> F --> M

scenario: 产品要按活动类型和距离展示 top athletes，初版想直接从 activities 表 group by user 并 sum(distance)。
scenario_en: The product wants top athletes by activity type and distance, and the naive version groups activities by user and sums distance on demand.
q: 这个朴素 leaderboard 查询的问题是什么？
q_en: What is the problem with this naive leaderboard query?
options: SQL 引擎完全无法计算 SUM 聚合
每次请求都要扫描聚合海量活动，负载很高
这样的查询会让手机 GPS 停止工作
这个查询只能用来查一个用户
options_en: The SQL engine cannot compute a SUM aggregate at all
Every request scans and aggregates huge volumes, driving up load
A query like this would make the phone's GPS stop working
This query can only ever look up a single user
optionMeanings: 错误的技术假设
全表聚合的可扩展性问题
与查询无关的说法
与查询无关的说法
optionDirectness: SQL 可以算 SUM，瓶颈在每次请求都全量算
请求时扫描聚合海量活动会压垮热路径
数据库查询不会影响手机 GPS 工作
group by user 本来就是多用户聚合
why: 随着活动数增长到亿级，每次请求都全表聚合排序不能放在用户请求的热路径上。
why_en: As activity volume grows into the billions, aggregating the full table on every request cannot sit on the hot request path.
whenOtherWins: 小数据量、离线分析或后台临时报表可以先用 SQL 聚合。
tradeoff: 实时准确 vs 查询延迟和数据库负载

scenario: 排行榜不要求实时更新，用户接受每天刷新一次。
scenario_en: The leaderboard does not need realtime updates, and users accept a daily refresh.
q: 比每次全表聚合更简单的方案是什么？
q_en: What is simpler than aggregating the full table on every request?
options: 每次查询仍然扫描全部 activities 表
周期性预聚合到 leaderboard 表，直接读取排序
把排行榜排序逻辑放进前端客户端代码里
排行榜上只随机展示几个用户
options_en: Every query still scans the entire activities table
Periodically pre-aggregate into a leaderboard table and read it sorted
Put leaderboard sorting logic inside the frontend client code
Show only a few random users on the leaderboard
optionMeanings: 问题依旧未解决
后台预聚合，读时直接查表
把服务端职责搬到客户端
无排名意义
optionDirectness: 继续全表扫描没有移走热路径开销
周期性预聚合适合允许每日滞后的榜单
前端排序拿不到完整可信的数据源
随机展示不能表达按距离排名
why: 预聚合把昂贵计算从请求路径搬到后台作业，代价是排行榜会有可接受的滞后。
why_en: Periodic aggregation moves expensive computation off the request path at the cost of some staleness.
whenOtherWins: 如果活动完成后必须立刻反映排名，Redis sorted set 或流式增量更新更合适。
tradeoff: 读取速度 vs 排名新鲜度

scenario: 排行榜希望在新活动保存后快速更新，按跑步总距离取前 N 名。
scenario_en: The leaderboard should update quickly after a new activity is saved and rank users by total running distance.
q: 最合适的 Redis 结构是什么？
q_en: Which Redis data structure best fits this leaderboard?
options: List：每次活动都 LPUSH 一个 activityId
Sorted Set，member 是 userId，score 是距离
String：只能保存最后一个用户的记录
Pub/Sub channel：假设它能永久保存排行榜状态
options_en: List: LPUSH an activityId on every activity
Sorted Set, with userId as member and distance as score
String: can only store the record of the last user
Pub/Sub channel: assuming it can permanently store leaderboard state
optionMeanings: 无法按分数排序
分数增量更新加高效取 top-N
只能存单个值
不持久保存状态
optionDirectness: List 适合按插入顺序存元素，不适合按分数排名
Sorted Set 适合 member-score 排行榜
String 适合单值，不适合多用户排名
pub/sub 适合消息广播，不保存排行榜状态
why: Sorted Set 支持按 distance score 增量更新和高效 top-N 查询，是排行榜的典型结构。
why_en: A sorted set supports incremental score updates and efficient top-N queries, the standard structure for leaderboards.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需每日榜且不实时，预聚合数据库表更便宜、更简单。
tradeoff: 实时增量排名 vs 额外的 Redis 内存和一致性成本

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 的有序集合，每个成员带一个 score，天然支持按分数排序取 top N。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Redis sorted set stores members with scores and supports fast ranked top-N queries.

scenario: 用户完成一场 8.2km 跑步，需要更新全球跑步总距离榜并查询 top users。
scenario_en: A user completes an 8.2km run, and the system needs to update the global running-distance leaderboard and read top users.
q: 哪组 Redis 命令最贴合？
q_en: Which Redis command pair best fits this update-and-read path?
options: LPUSH 加 GET 的命令组合
SET 命令直接覆盖一个值
ZINCRBY 累加距离，ZREVRANGE 取排名前列
PUBLISH 广播一条消息
options_en: The LPUSH plus GET command combination
A SET command that directly overwrites one value
ZINCRBY to add distance, then ZREVRANGE to read the top ranks
PUBLISH to broadcast a message
optionMeanings: List 命令组合，无法排名
单值覆盖，无法存多用户
增量分数加取 top 50
只是消息通知，不持久化
optionDirectness: LPUSH 只能追加元素，GET 不能读排名
SET 覆盖单值会丢掉多用户分数
ZINCRBY/ZREVRANGE 正好覆盖加分和读榜
PUBLISH 只通知事件，不保存排名状态
why: ZINCRBY 给用户总距离加分，ZREVRANGE 按分数从高到低取前 N 名，两条命令就够。
why_en: ZINCRBY adds to the user's total distance and ZREVRANGE returns the top ranked members by score.
whenOtherWins: 只通知前端有新活动时可用 pub/sub；存排行榜状态要用 sorted set。

scenario: 面试官已经确认查看/搜索优先可用性、订票优先一致性；你量化出热门活动 1000 万用户抢票、搜索低于 500ms、读写比约 100:1。

q: 这些非功能数字最支持哪些设计判断？

why_en: These three numbers drive every later design choice: concurrency sets up queuing, the latency cap sets up search indexing, and the read ratio sets up caching.

scenario: Ticketmaster 是读多写少系统，读写比约 100:1（每 100 次查看/搜索对应 1 次订票）。

why_en: A 100-to-1 read-write ratio means almost all load sits on the read path, so caching and horizontal scaling should target reads first.

The system is read-heavy and must lean on caching and horizontal read scaling.
Reads and writes are balanced, so no special handling is needed.
The system should drop the search feature.

why: 选座 → 抢 Redis 锁+写 in-progress 订单 → 返回 bookingId 进支付页 → Stripe.js 支付 → webhook 确认后落库；10 分钟内不完成，锁自动释放。
why_en: After picking a seat, the service grabs a ten-minute Redis lock and writes an in-progress booking, returns the bookingId to the payment page, then Stripe.js pays and the webhook finalizes the booking.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A PaymentIntent is Stripe's object that tracks one payment's full lifecycle from pending through success or failure.

q: 为什么用 Stripe.js 在客户端做卡号 token 化？
q_en: Why use Stripe.js on the client to tokenize card numbers?
options: 为了绕过 Redis 分布式锁的校验流程
为了让 Stripe 支付处理速度更快
为了减少客户端到服务器的一次网络请求
服务器永不接触原始卡号——这是 PCI 合规的标准做法
options_en: To bypass the Redis distributed lock's checks.
To make Stripe's payment processing faster.
To save one network request between client and server.
The server never touches raw card numbers — this is the standard PCI-compliance pattern.
optionMeanings: 把 token 化的目的归到锁校验
把目的归到处理速度
把目的归到网络请求数量
把目的归到卡号不落地
optionScenarioImpacts: Token 化和 Redis 锁是两套完全无关的机制
Token 化不改变 Stripe 内部处理速度
Token 化其实多了一次浏览器到 Stripe 的请求
原始卡号只在浏览器和 Stripe 之间流转，服务器合规范围大幅缩小
optionMeanings_en: Attributes tokenization to bypassing lock checks.
Attributes it to processing speed.
Attributes it to request count.
Attributes it to keeping raw cards off the server.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Tokenization and the Redis lock are unrelated mechanisms.
Tokenization doesn't change Stripe's internal processing speed.
Tokenization actually adds a browser-to-Stripe request.
The raw card only ever flows between the browser and Stripe, shrinking the server's compliance scope.
why: Stripe.js 在浏览器端把卡信息换成 token，原始卡号不经过我们的服务器，这是 PCI 合规的标准路径；服务器只拿 token 创建 PaymentIntent。
why_en: Stripe.js tokenizes the card in the browser so the raw number never reaches our server, which is the standard PCI-compliance pattern, and the server just uses the token to create a PaymentIntent.

termDefinitions.meaning: Stripe 提供的前端 SDK，在浏览器里把银行卡信息换成一次性 token。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stripe.js is Stripe's browser SDK that tokenizes card details on the client side.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支付卡行业对处理银行卡信息系统的安全标准，核心是尽量少接触原始卡号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PCI compliance is the payment-card industry's security standard, whose core principle is minimizing systems that touch raw card data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把敏感的原始数据换成一个无意义的一次性标识符，原始数据本身不被传输或存储。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tokenization replaces sensitive raw data with a meaningless one-time identifier so the raw data itself is never transmitted or stored.

termDefinitions.meaning: Stripe 用来跟踪一次支付全生命周期的对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A PaymentIntent is Stripe's object tracking one payment's full lifecycle.

scenario: Stripe 处理完支付后会调用我们的 webhook 通知结果；网络失败或超时时，Stripe 会对同一个事件重试投递。
scenario_en: After payment, Stripe calls our webhook, and it may retry the same event after a timeout or network failure.
q: 为什么 webhook 处理器必须幂等，怎么实现？
q_en: Why must the webhook handler be idempotent, and how do you implement that?
options: 因为 webhook 走明文 HTTP 传输，要靠 TLS 加密解决
Stripe 重试会导致同一事件被处理两次；用 bookingId 做幂等键，更新前先查状态
因为 Redis 锁服务会重复广播过期事件
幂等只是锦上添花的可选优化，不做也不影响正确性
options_en: Because webhooks travel as plaintext HTTP, so TLS encryption is the fix.
Stripe's retries can process the same event twice; use bookingId as the idempotency key and check status before updating.
Because the Redis lock service rebroadcasts expiry events repeatedly.
Idempotency is just a nice-to-have optimization that correctness doesn't depend on.
optionMeanings: 把问题归到传输层加密
把问题归到重复投递+用幂等键防重
把问题归到 Redis 广播
把幂等当成非必需项
optionScenarioImpacts: TLS 解决的是窃听问题，不是重复处理问题
重试时先查当前状态，重复投递就不会二次改状态
过期事件与 webhook 重试完全是两套机制
不做幂等时，重试会把同一笔支付的状态改两次
optionMeanings_en: Attributes it to transport-layer encryption.
Attributes it to retried delivery, fixed with an idempotency key.
Attributes it to Redis rebroadcasting.
Treats idempotency as unnecessary.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: TLS solves eavesdropping, not duplicate processing.
Checking status before updating means a retried delivery changes nothing twice.
Lock expiry and webhook retries are two unrelated mechanisms.
Skipping idempotency lets a retry change the same payment's state twice.
why: Stripe 对失败的 webhook 会重试；不幂等的处理器可能让同一笔支付触发两次状态变更。用 bookingId 做幂等键、更新前先查当前状态，让重试变安全。
why_en: Stripe retries webhooks on failure, so a non-idempotent handler could apply the same payment's state change twice, which is why bookingId is used as the idempotency key with a status check before updating.

termDefinitions.meaning: 第三方系统（这里是 Stripe）在事件发生后主动回调通知我方服务器的 HTTP 请求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A webhook is an HTTP callback a third party like Stripe sends to notify our server when an event occurs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一个操作重复执行多次，结果和只执行一次完全一样。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An idempotent operation produces the same result whether it runs once or is retried multiple times.

termDefinitions.meaning: 加密网络传输的协议，防止数据被窃听或篡改。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TLS is a protocol that encrypts network traffic to prevent eavesdropping or tampering.

termDefinitions.meaning: 标识一次操作唯一性的键，用它检查该操作是否已经执行过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An idempotency key uniquely identifies one operation so you can check whether it has already been applied.

scenario: 结账要填写支付信息通常需要几分钟；热门演唱会里，同一座位常有大量用户同时排队抢同一把锁。
scenario_en: Checkout takes several minutes, while many users may compete for the same seat at a hot concert.
q: 预留锁的 TTL 时长该由什么权衡决定？
q_en: What tradeoff should set the reservation-lock TTL?
options: 设得很长（如 1 小时），给填卡慢的用户留足余量
设在大约 10 分钟量级：够用户完成支付，又不会让热门票被占太久
设为 1 秒，尽量让票快速回到可售
永不过期，靠人工手动释放
options_en: Set it very long, like an hour, to give slow typers plenty of margin.
Set it around ten minutes: enough time to pay, without holding hot inventory too long.
Set it to one second so tickets return to sale as fast as possible.
Never expire it, and release it manually instead.
why: TTL 太短会让正常用户来不及付款就掉单；太长会让热门场次的票被一个人攥住太久，拉低所有人的可用性——10 分钟左右是两者的折中，支付发起时还能续锁。
why_en: Too short a TTL drops honest buyers mid-checkout, while too long a TTL locks popular seats away from everyone else, so something around ten minutes balances the two, with the option to extend it once payment starts.

termDefinitions.meaning: key 的存活时间，这里指预留锁自动释放前能持有多久。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is how long a key is held before it automatically expires, here the reservation lock's hold time.

scenario: 抢票开售时活动页被打爆：成千上万用户反复刷新同一个活动页等票放出，读流量是写的百倍。
scenario_en: During a ticket drop, thousands of users keep refreshing the same event page, and reads outnumber writes by about 100 to 1.
q: 最该激进缓存的数据是？
q_en: Which data should be cached most aggressively?
options: 实时座位预留状态
支付交易流水
活动详情与场馆信息
用户会话令牌
why: 决定性约束是读多改少：活动和场馆信息几乎不变，能放心猛缓存；座位状态秒级变化，不适合久缓存。
why_en: Cache the event and venue data hard because it is read constantly but almost never changes, while seat status shifts by the second and cannot be cached for long.
whenOtherWins: 冷门场次座位变化慢、能容忍秒级陈旧时，给座位状态加短 TTL 缓存也可接受；爆款场次必须走实时推送。
tradeoff: 静态活动信息的缓存命中率 vs 座位状态缓存带来的陈旧风险
options_en: Cache real-time seat reservation status.
Cache payment transaction records.
Cache event and venue details.
Cache user session tokens.
optionMeanings: 座位是否被占用/预留的实时状态。
支付网关产生的交易记录。
活动名称、日期、场馆位置等基本信息。
用户登录后用于鉴权的会话令牌。
optionScenarioImpacts: 秒级变化，缓存了也很快过期，还容易读到旧座位。
跟这次读风暴无关，缓存它不解决读压力。
读多改少，正是刷新流量的真正瓶颈，缓存收益最大。
跟活动读取压力无关，不是本次热点数据。
optionMeanings_en: Whether a seat is currently held or reserved.
Records generated by the payment gateway.
Basic facts like event name, date, and venue location.
The auth token issued after a user logs in.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It changes second by second, so a cached copy goes stale fast.
It has nothing to do with this read storm.
It is read constantly and changes rarely, the real bottleneck here.
It is unrelated to event-page read pressure.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存条目的存活时间，到期后必须重新获取。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is how long a cached entry stays valid before it must be refreshed.

termDefinitions.meaning: Server-Sent Events，服务器通过一条持久连接单向推送数据给客户端。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SSE lets a server push updates to a client over one persistent, one-way connection.

q: 给 Ticketmaster 活动详情做读路径缓存，键值设计和读取策略该怎么定？
q_en: For Ticketmaster event-detail caching, how should you choose the key and read strategy?
options: SQL 语句本身当 key
eventId 当 key
整份数据库快照当缓存
只缓存静态图片
why: 以 eventId 为 key 缓存整个活动对象，命中直接返回；read-through 保证未命中时自动查库回填，靠内存速度扛住大量读。
why_en: Key the cache by eventId so a hit returns the whole event object directly, and use a read-through strategy so a miss automatically queries the database and backfills the cache.
options_en: Use the raw SQL statement as the key.
Use eventId as the key.
Cache a full snapshot of the database.
Cache only static images.
optionMeanings: 把可变的查询语句字符串当作缓存 key。
按业务实体 ID 缓存整份对象，未命中时自动查库回填。
把整份数据库内容都塞进缓存层。
只缓存静态图片，不缓存结构化数据。
optionScenarioImpacts: 同一活动的等价查询写法不同就会各自占一份缓存，命中率很差。
同一 eventId 的所有读请求都能复用同一份缓存，命中率高。
内存占用和数据库体量绑死，规模一大就扛不住。
没有覆盖活动详情这类结构化高频读数据。
optionMeanings_en: Use the variable query string itself as the cache key.
Cache the whole object by business ID, auto-filling on a miss.
Push the entire database content into the cache layer.
Cache only static image assets, not structured data.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Equivalent queries written differently each get their own cache entry, hurting hit rate.
Every request for the same eventId reuses one cache entry, so hit rate stays high.
Cache size stays tied to database size, which does not scale.
It does not address the hot structured reads on event details.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存未命中时由缓存层自动查库并回填，业务代码不用单独处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In a read-through cache, a miss automatically triggers a database read and fills the cache, with no extra code in the application.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常见的内存型 key-value 缓存服务，读写速度远快于磁盘数据库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis and Memcached are in-memory key-value stores that read and write far faster than a disk-backed database.

q: Ticketmaster 活动详情缓存，怎么保证失效和一致性？
q_en: How should Ticketmaster keep event-detail cache invalidation and consistency under control?
options: 数据库触发器通知失效，配合分层 TTL
只靠人工手动清缓存
永不失效，只有重启才清
每次写入清空整个缓存
why: 双保险保证一致性：DB 触发器在改期、换阵容时精确失效对应条目；分层 TTL 兜底——静态数据长 TTL，余票类数据短 TTL。
why_en: Consistency comes from two layers: a database trigger precisely invalidates the affected entry on changes like a date or lineup update, while tiered TTLs act as a backstop with long TTLs for static data and short TTLs for fast-changing data.
options_en: A database trigger fires invalidation, backed by tiered TTLs.
Rely only on manually clearing the cache.
Never expire entries; only a restart clears them.
Wipe the entire cache on every single write.
optionMeanings: DB 触发器精确失效 + TTL 兜底刷新的组合策略。
没有自动机制，全靠人工介入清理。
缓存条目永久有效，只在服务重启时清空。
每次写库都把整份缓存清光重建。
optionScenarioImpacts: 改期或换阵容能被精确失效，静态数据长 TTL、余票数据短 TTL 分层兜底。
人工响应慢，抢票期间数据变了也不会被及时发现。
活动改期后用户会一直看到旧信息，直到下次重启才刷新。
热门活动写操作一多，缓存被反复打空，等于失去缓存的意义。
optionMeanings_en: Trigger-based precise invalidation plus TTL as a backstop.
No automation at all, entirely manual cleanup.
Entries live forever and only clear on a service restart.
Every single write flushes and rebuilds the whole cache.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: A date or lineup change gets precisely invalidated, with tiered TTLs covering the rest.
Manual response is slow, so changes during an on-sale get missed.
Users keep seeing stale info after a reschedule until the next restart.
Heavy write volume during a hot sale keeps emptying the cache, defeating its purpose.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存条目的存活时间，到期后必须重新获取。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is how long a cached entry stays valid before it must be refreshed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据变更时数据库自动触发的回调，可用来通知缓存失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A database trigger fires automatically on a data change and can be used to notify the cache to invalidate an entry.

q: Ticketmaster 把 Event Service、Search Service 都横向扩展后，负载均衡该怎么用？
q_en: How should load balancing be used after horizontally scaling Event Service and Search Service?
options: 只在数据库前需要
用一致性哈希是唯一选择
所有横向扩展的组件前都配负载均衡
负载均衡会破坏一致性
why: 所有横向扩展的组件（服务和数据库）前都要有负载均衡；Round Robin 或 Least Connections 把流量摊匀到各实例，面试图里常省略但值得口头提。
why_en: Every horizontally scaled component, service or database, needs a load balancer in front of it, typically using round robin or least connections to spread traffic evenly across instances.
options_en: Only the database needs one.
Consistent hashing is the only valid algorithm.
Every horizontally scaled component gets a load balancer.
Load balancing breaks consistency.
optionMeanings: 认为只有存储层需要分流。
把负载均衡算法和分片路由算法搞混。
轮询或按连接数挑最闲实例的分流算法。
把负载均衡和一致性保证混为一谈。
optionScenarioImpacts: Event/Search/Booking 这些服务实例前没有 LB，流量会堆到某几个实例上。
一致性哈希是分片或缓存路由的工具，不是唯一的负载均衡算法。
轮询或按连接数分流，把请求摊匀到每个实例，图上常省略但要口头说明。
负载均衡只管流量分发，不影响数据库事务的一致性保证。
optionMeanings_en: Assumes only the storage layer needs traffic distribution.
Confuses load-balancing algorithms with sharding/routing algorithms.
Round robin or least connections spread traffic across instances.
Conflates load balancing with transactional consistency.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Without an LB in front of Event/Search/Booking instances, traffic piles onto a few of them.
Consistent hashing is a sharding or cache-routing tool, not the only load-balancing option.
It spreads requests evenly across instances, often left off the diagram but worth saying out loud.
Load balancing only routes traffic and does not affect database transaction guarantees.

termDefinitions.meaning: 轮询算法，按顺序把请求依次分给每台实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Round robin sends each new request to the next server in a fixed rotation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把新请求分给当前连接数最少的实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Least connections routes each new request to the server currently handling the fewest active connections.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按哈希环分配请求或数据的算法，常用于分片或缓存路由，不是通用负载均衡算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing maps requests or data onto a hash ring and is mainly used for sharding or cache routing, not general load balancing.

q: Ticketmaster 的 Event Service 为什么可以随意横向扩展？
q_en: Why can Ticketmaster's Event Service scale horizontally so easily?
options: 因为它用了最快的编程语言
因为它不需要连数据库
因为它跑在 Kubernetes 上
因为它是无状态服务
why: 决定性原因是无状态：实例不保存本地会话或数据，任何请求可以落到任何实例，所以加机器加负载均衡就能线性扩容。
why_en: Event Service can scale horizontally at will because it is stateless, so any instance can serve any request once you add more machines behind a load balancer.
options_en: Because it is written in the fastest programming language.
Because it never needs to query a database.
Because it runs on Kubernetes.
Because it is a stateless service.
optionMeanings: 把扩展能力错误地归因到实现语言的快慢。
错误地假设它不需要查数据库。
把水平扩展能力错误地归因到具体编排平台。
服务实例不在本地保存任何用户或会话状态。
optionScenarioImpacts: 语言快慢不影响能不能开多个实例分流量。
它其实要查 Events DB 拿事件、场馆、表演者数据，这个前提是错的。
换成裸机或别的编排方式一样能横向扩展，跟 K8s 无关。
任何实例都能处理任何请求，加机器就能线性分担流量。
optionMeanings_en: Wrongly credits scalability to language speed.
Wrongly assumes it never queries a database.
Wrongly credits scalability to a specific orchestration platform.
The service keeps no local user or session state.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Language speed has no bearing on whether you can add instances to spread load.
It actually queries the Events DB for event, venue, and performer data, so this premise is false.
It would scale the same on bare metal or another orchestrator, unrelated to Kubernetes.
Any instance can serve any request, so adding machines scales throughput linearly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务实例不在本地保存会话或业务状态，任何实例都能处理任何请求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stateless service keeps no local session or business state, so any instance can handle any request.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过增加更多实例（而不是升级单机配置）来承接更多流量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Horizontal scaling means adding more instances, rather than upgrading a single machine, to handle more traffic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种容器编排平台，负责部署和管理服务实例，本身不是扩展能力的来源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kubernetes is a container orchestration platform that deploys and manages service instances, but it is not itself the source of scalability.

q: Ticketmaster 用「缓存 + 横向扩展」应对读风暴，这套方案真实存在的挑战有哪些？（多选）
q_en: What real challenges remain with caching plus horizontal scaling for read storms?
options: 缓存与数据库一致性维护，活动详情频繁变更时更棘手
大量服务实例的部署与回滚运维复杂度
引入缓存后系统自动获得强一致性，不用再处理
无状态服务本身没法通过加实例来扩容
why: 两大真实挑战：缓存与数据库的一致性维护、实例膨胀后的部署与回滚运维复杂度。缓存不会自动带来强一致，无状态服务也不会因扩容变差。
why_en: The two real challenges are keeping the cache consistent with the database and managing the operational complexity of deploying and rolling back many instances, since caching never grants automatic strong consistency and statelessness is what makes scaling safe.
options_en: Cache-database consistency gets harder if event details change often.
Deploying and rolling back many instances adds operational complexity.
Adding a cache automatically gives the system strong consistency.
A stateless service cannot actually be scaled by adding instances.
optionMeanings: 缓存内容和数据库真实值可能出现短暂不一致。
实例数一多，发布新版本和出问题回滚都变复杂。
把「有缓存」和「强一致」划等号的常见误解。
把无状态和扩容能力关系搞反的误解。
optionScenarioImpacts: 活动详情很少变，这个风险不大，但理论上仍然存在。
抢票期间实例数量会很多，出故障时回滚更麻烦。
缓存本身不解决一致性，写库和失效之间总有窗口期。
无状态恰恰是能任意加实例的原因，见前一张卡。
optionMeanings_en: The cached copy and the database truth can briefly diverge.
More instances make releases and rollbacks harder to manage.
A common misconception equating "has a cache" with "is strongly consistent."
A misconception that reverses the relationship between statelessness and scaling.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Event details rarely change, so the risk is small but still real.
Instance count grows large during a sale, making failure rollback harder.
Caching alone never fixes consistency; a write-invalidation gap always exists.
Statelessness is exactly what lets you add instances freely, as in the prior card.

termDefinitions.meaning: 任何时刻读到的数据都和最近一次写入完全一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Strong consistency means every read reflects the most recent write immediately.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务实例不在本地保存会话或业务状态，任何实例都能处理任何请求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stateless service keeps no local session or business state, so any instance can handle any request.

scenario: 热门活动的座位图很快过时：用户反复点到已被订走的座位而沮丧，需要不刷新页面就同步座位状态。
scenario_en: Hot-event seat maps go stale quickly; users need seat status updates without refreshing the page.
q: 推荐的实时更新方案是？
q_en: What real-time update approach should the seat map use?
options: 客户端每 30 秒整页刷新
SSE 服务器单向推送
客户端定时轮询
让用户手动点刷新按钮
why: 只需要服务器把座位变化推给客户端，不需要客户端上行。SSE 用一条持久连接做到这点，比轮询省资源、比 WebSocket 简单。
why_en: Since seat updates only need to flow from server to client, SSE delivers that over one persistent connection more simply than polling and with less overhead than WebSocket.
whenOtherWins: 未来若需要客户端主动上行（比如实时协同选座），才该换成双向的 WebSocket。
tradeoff: 服务器推送的实时性 vs 轮询/整页刷新的实现简单度
options_en: The client does a full page refresh every 30 seconds.
SSE: one-way server-to-client push.
The client polls on a fixed interval.
Rely on the user manually clicking refresh.
optionMeanings: 客户端定时发起整页刷新请求。
SSE：服务器到客户端的单向持久连接推送。
客户端按固定间隔主动发请求查询状态。
完全依赖用户主动点击刷新。

座位一被订走服务器立刻推送，UI 几乎实时更新。
间隔越短服务器压力越大，越长越不实时，两头难兼顾。
把同步责任推给用户，大部分人根本不会主动点。
optionMeanings_en: The client repeatedly triggers a full page reload.
SSE pushes data from server to client over one persistent connection.
The client actively re-queries state on a fixed schedule.
Syncing depends entirely on the user clicking refresh.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Seat status can still be wrong within the 30-second window, so the experience barely improves.
The moment a seat is booked, the server pushes it out and the UI updates almost instantly.
Shorter intervals stress the server, longer intervals hurt freshness; you cannot win both.
It hands syncing responsibility to the user, and most people never click it.

termDefinitions.meaning: Server-Sent Events，服务器通过一条长连接单向推送数据给客户端。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SSE lets a server push data to a client over one long-lived, one-way connection.

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端按固定间隔主动发请求查询最新状态。

termDefinitions.meaningEn: WebSocket is a protocol that supports two-way message exchange between client and server over a single connection.

q: SSE（服务器单向推送）座位图，在「Taylor Swift 级」活动会出什么问题？
q_en: What goes wrong with an SSE seat map during a Taylor Swift-scale event?
options: SSE 连接数有硬上限 100
SSE 会导致双重预订
浏览器不支持 SSE
座位秒光，用户体验混乱失控
why: SSE 技术上完全正确地推送了座位变化，但千万人抢一场时座位几秒内被抢光，实时更新反而放大了混乱——这是业务问题，不是技术故障。
why_en: SSE technically pushes every seat update correctly, but when millions compete for the same show, seats vanish within seconds and the real-time updates just amplify the chaos instead of fixing it.
options_en: SSE has a hard cap of 100 connections.
SSE causes double bookings.
Browsers do not support SSE.
Seats vanish in seconds, and the UX spirals into chaos.

把双重预订的成因错误归到 SSE 头上。
把 SSE 说成主流浏览器不支持的技术。
座位图瞬间清空，用户看着能选的座位一秒变没。
optionScenarioImpacts: SSE 连接数受限于服务器资源和配置，不是协议本身钉死 100。
双重预订由数据库事务和锁保证，SSE 只负责推送通知。
主流浏览器都原生支持 SSE，兼容性不是这里的瓶颈。
技术上推送没错，但业务体验依然崩溃，加快推送速度也救不了。
optionMeanings_en: Claims SSE has a specific hardcoded connection ceiling.
Misattributes double booking to SSE itself.
Claims mainstream browsers do not support SSE.
The seat map empties instantly, and selectable seats vanish before your eyes.

Double booking is prevented by database transactions and locking, not by SSE.
Mainstream browsers all support SSE natively, so compatibility is not the bottleneck.

scenario: 千万用户同时抢同一场演出，直接放所有人进选座页会压垮系统且体验混乱。
scenario_en: Tens of millions of users hitting one concert at once would overload seat selection and create a chaotic experience.
q: 该用什么机制控制用户涌入选座页的节奏？
q_en: What mechanism should control how users enter the seat-selection page?
options: 无限加服务器硬扛
临时关闭座位图
管理员启用的虚拟等待队列
随机丢弃部分请求
why: 虚拟等待室在用户看到选座页之前就把人排队，按节奏放行，把不可控的瞬时峰值拉平成可控流量。这是「最好的解法不一定更难」的例子。
why_en: A virtual waiting room queues users before they ever reach the seat map, admitting them at a controlled pace instead of absorbing an uncontrollable spike all at once.
whenOtherWins: 热度没到「秒光」级别时，SSE 实时推送座位图就够用，不必启用排队。
tradeoff: 可控节奏放行 vs 直接放全部人进导致系统过载
options_en: Keep adding servers to brute-force the load.
Temporarily disable the seat map.
An admin-enabled virtual waiting queue.
Randomly drop some incoming requests.

直接把核心功能下线来避免压垮系统。
先排队、再按节奏放行用户进入选座页的机制。
对请求做无差别随机丢弃。
optionScenarioImpacts: 千万级瞬时并发下加多少机器都可能被打穿，还很烧钱。
功能不可用等于放弃这单生意，用户体验反而更差。
把瞬时峰值拉平成可控节奏，系统不过载，用户也有明确预期。
谁被丢、谁能进全凭运气，公平性和体验都很差。
optionMeanings_en: Trying to survive the spike purely by adding more machines.
Taking the core feature offline to avoid a system crash.
Queue users first, then admit them into the seat map at a controlled pace.
Drop incoming requests indiscriminately.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: At tens-of-millions concurrency, no amount of extra hardware is guaranteed to hold, and it is expensive.
An unavailable feature means giving up the sale entirely, which is worse for users.
It flattens an uncontrollable spike into a controllable pace, keeping the system stable with clear user expectations.
Who gets through becomes pure luck, hurting both fairness and experience.

termDefinitions.meaning: Server-Sent Events，服务器主动向客户端单向推送更新。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SSE is a mechanism where the server pushes updates to the client over a one-way connection.

q: Ticketmaster 抢票用的虚拟等待队列，技术实现该怎么做？
q_en: How should the virtual waiting queue be implemented for Ticketmaster?
options: Redis sorted set + 持久连接
Kafka 存队列 + 邮件通知
数据库表轮询
客户端本地倒计时放行
why: sorted set 用进入时间当分数天然维持先来后到；持久连接（SSE 或 WebSocket）把排位变化实时推给用户，不用轮询查库。
why_en: A Redis sorted set keeps first-come-first-served order by using the enqueue timestamp as the score, while a persistent connection pushes position updates without repeated polling.
options_en: Redis sorted set plus a persistent connection.
Kafka for the queue plus email notification.
Poll a database table.
Client-side local countdown admits users.
optionMeanings: 用有序集合按时间戳排序维护队列，用长连接把排位变化推给用户。
把消息队列平台当作排队系统，用邮件做通知渠道。
用普通表存队列状态，客户端定时查询进度。
把放行逻辑交给客户端本地计时器决定。
optionScenarioImpacts: 先来后到自然维护，持久连接让排位实时更新，不用用户反复刷新。

轮询查表在千万级排队场景下会把数据库打垮。
客户端本地状态不可信，谁都能改本地代码插队。
optionMeanings_en: A score-ordered set maintains the queue while a long-lived connection pushes position changes.
Treats a message-streaming platform as a queue and email as the notification channel.
Stores queue state in a plain table that the client repeatedly re-queries.
Leaves the admission decision to a timer running on the client.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: First-come-first-served falls out naturally, and the open connection updates position without user refreshes.
Kafka is not built for score-ranked lookups, and email is far too slow for second-by-second position changes.

Client-side state cannot be trusted; anyone could edit local code to cut the line.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 的有序集合数据结构，每个成员带一个分数并按分数自动排序。

q: 在虚拟等待队列前提下，怎么防止用户绕过排队直接调 Booking 接口？
q_en: With a virtual waiting queue, how do you stop users from bypassing it and calling Booking directly?
options: 只在前端隐藏按钮
写入带 TTL 的准入集合
发一次性链接给用户
技术上无法防止
why: 放行是服务端状态：dequeue 时把用户会话 ID 写进带 TTL 的 admitted:{eventId} 集合，Booking Service 受理请求前先查这个集合，绕过前端也没用。
why_en: Admission is server-side state: when a user is dequeued, their session ID is added to a TTL-bound admitted set, and the Booking Service checks that set before accepting any request, so skipping the front end does not help.
options_en: Only hide the button in the front end.
Write to a TTL-bound admitted set.
Send users a one-time link.
It technically cannot be prevented.

服务端维护一个记录「谁被放行」的集合，接口自己查这个集合。

认为绕过排队这件事无法阻止。

订票接口每次请求都会核对这个集合，没被标记的一律拒绝，TTL 到期自动失效。
链接一旦泄露或被转发，一次性也变成人人可用。
服务端状态完全能做到准入控制，这个判断是错的。
optionMeanings_en: Hopes the front-end UI layer alone stops users.
The server keeps a set recording who has been admitted, and the API checks it.
Hopes the one-time nature of a link is enough to limit access.
Assumes bypassing the queue simply cannot be stopped.

The Booking Service checks the admitted set on every request; anyone not marked is rejected, and the TTL expires access automatically.
Once a link leaks or gets forwarded, its one-time property stops meaning anything.
Server-side state can absolutely provide admission control, so this claim is false.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Here TTL is how long an admission record stays valid before it automatically expires.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务端维护的、记录哪些用户已被放行可以订票的集合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The admitted set is server-side state that records which users have been let through the queue and may book.

q: 「通信方向」维度上，SSE（服务器推送）和 WebSocket（双向）有什么区别？

SSE is two-way and WebSocket is one-way.
Both only go from client to server.
The two are completely equivalent.

两者其实都支持服务器主动推送，这个前提是错的。

This reverses the actual directionality of the two.
Wrongly treats both SSE and WebSocket as upload-only protocols.
Claims there is no directional difference between the two.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: For a pure downstream feed like queue-position pushes, SSE is already enough and lighter.
Choosing based on this understanding picks the wrong protocol outright.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在单个连接上支持客户端和服务器双向收发消息的协议。

q: 虚拟等待队列上线后，最大的体验风险和缓解手段是什么？
q_en: What is the biggest UX risk after launching a virtual waiting queue, and how do you reduce it?
options: 队列会丢数据，靠 Kafka 持久化解决
用户会拿到重复座位，靠加锁解决
队列耗尽内存，靠换数据库解决
等待过久引发沮丧，靠持续推送排位与预计等待时间缓解
why: 等待室的风险不在技术在心理：不透明或不准的等待最伤体验。持久连接本来就开着，用它持续推排位和预计等待时间，把不确定感降到最低。
why_en: The waiting room's real risk is psychological, not technical: inaccurate or opaque wait times hurt the experience most, so the same persistent connection is used to keep pushing position and ETA updates.
options_en: The queue loses data, fixed by persisting it in Kafka.
Users get duplicate seats, fixed by adding locks.
The queue exhausts memory, fixed by switching databases.
Long waits cause frustration, mitigated by pushing live position and ETA.
optionMeanings: 把风险错误定位成消息丢失问题。
把风险错误定位成并发或加锁问题。
把风险错误定位成存储容量问题。
风险其实是心理层面：等待不透明引发的沮丧感。
optionScenarioImpacts: sorted set 加持久化本来就不易丢数据，这不是本题的真实风险。
重复座位由 Booking Service 的数据库事务和锁保证，不归排队机制管。
sorted set 存的是排队记录，量级远达不到耗尽内存。
预计等待不准或队伍变慢时，用户会觉得被晾在一边，体验骤降。
optionMeanings_en: Misdiagnoses the risk as message loss.
Misdiagnoses the risk as a concurrency or locking problem.
Misdiagnoses the risk as a storage capacity problem.
The real risk is psychological: frustration from an opaque wait.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: A persisted sorted set is not prone to data loss, so this is not the real risk here.
Duplicate seats are prevented by the Booking Service's database transactions and locks, unrelated to the queue.
The sorted set only stores queue entries, nowhere near enough to exhaust memory.
When ETA is inaccurate or the line moves slower than expected, users feel abandoned and the experience craters.

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端和服务器之间保持打开、可持续推送数据的连接。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A persistent connection stays open between client and server so updates can keep streaming.

scenario: Ticketmaster 要求搜索延迟 <500ms，且活动数量还在持续增长，这条关键字过滤 SQL 是当前实现。
scenario_en: Ticketmaster needs search under 500ms, event count keeps growing, and this SQL keyword filter is the current implementation.
q: 这条搜索查询为什么慢？
q_en: Why is this search query slow?
options: 前导 %通配符% 让 B-tree 索引失效，只能整表扫描，活动越多越慢
OR 条件天生比 AND 慢，应尽量避免
问题出在 SELECT *，只要少选字段就快
Events 表缺主键，索引根本没生效
why: 前导 %Taylor% 让普通 B-tree 索引用不上，只能整表扫描；活动数量越涨，这条路径越撑不住 <500ms 的延迟要求。
why_en: A leading wildcard defeats a standard B-tree index and forces a full table scan that only gets slower as the event catalog grows.
codeSample:
-- 慢查询：前置通配符无法走 B-tree 索引
SELECT *
FROM Events
WHERE name LIKE '%Taylor%'
   OR description LIKE '%Taylor%';
options_en: The leading wildcard defeats the B-tree index, forcing a full table scan that gets slower as events grow.
OR is inherently slower than AND, so it should be avoided.
The real problem is SELECT star; selecting fewer columns would fix it.
The Events table has no primary key, so the index never kicks in.
optionMeanings: 前导通配符让索引查不到起点。
把 OR 当成性能杀手的常见误解。
把返回列数当成主要瓶颈。
把主键缺失当成索引失效原因。
optionScenarioImpacts: 查询退化成整表扫描，活动越多越慢。
OR 本身不是这条查询慢的原因。
去掉 * 省一点带宽，扫描方式没变。
本例主键与索引失效无关。

termDefinitions.meaning: 按排序结构组织的数据库索引，擅长等值和前缀匹配查找。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A B-tree index is a sorted index structure that is efficient for equality and prefix lookups.

termDefinitions.meaning: 像 %Taylor% 这样把 % 放在开头的匹配模式，数据库无法用索引定位起点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A leading wildcard, like %Taylor%, puts the % at the start of the pattern, so the database cannot use an index to find a starting point.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库逐行检查整张表来找匹配行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A full table scan checks every row in a table one by one to find matches.

scenario: 搜索延迟要求 <500ms，第一步先在现有 Postgres 上做基础优化，暂不引入新组件。
scenario_en: Search must stay under 500ms; first optimize the existing Postgres path without adding a new component.
q: Good 级方案是？
q_en: What is the Good-level search optimization?
options: 直接引入 Elasticsearch 集群
给常用搜索列建索引，并优化查询语句
把数据库整体换成 NoSQL
把搜索过滤逻辑放到前端做
why: 先给常用搜索列建索引减少扫描行数，再用 EXPLAIN、避免 SELECT *、LIMIT、UNION 替代 OR 做查询优化——这是不引入新组件的第一步。
why_en: The first step is indexing the frequently searched columns and tuning queries with EXPLAIN, narrower SELECTs, LIMIT, and UNION instead of OR.
whenOtherWins: 需要部分匹配、错别字容忍或复杂排序时，普通索引不够，该升级到全文索引或 Elasticsearch。
tradeoff: 索引+查询优化 vs 引入 Elasticsearch 这类新搜索组件
options_en: Stand up an Elasticsearch cluster right away.
Index the common search columns and tune the queries.
Replace the whole database with a NoSQL store.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据变化后主动使相关缓存条目过期或删除，避免返回陈旧结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cache invalidation expires or removes cache entries when the underlying data changes so stale results are not served.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给缓存条目打标签，数据变化时可以按标签批量失效相关条目。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cache tags label cache entries so a batch of related entries can be invalidated together when data changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 大量缓存同时失效或过期，瞬间涌入后端的请求压垮系统。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A miss storm happens when many cache entries expire at once and the resulting flood of requests overwhelms the backend.

termDefinitions.meaning: 允许拼写差异的搜索方式，会让结果集合更难与固定 key 对应。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fuzzy search tolerates spelling differences, which makes its result sets harder to map to a fixed cache key.

q: Elasticsearch 自带哪些缓存能力？
q_en: What caching capabilities does Elasticsearch provide by default?
options: 分片级 query+request 两层缓存
只有客户端浏览器缓存
ES 完全不做任何缓存
只缓存写请求，不缓存查询
why: ES 在分片级内建两层缓存：filter 结果的 query cache 和完整响应的 request cache，无需自建缓存层就能降低重复查询开销。
why_en: Elasticsearch keeps a shard-level query cache for filter results and a shard-level request cache for full responses, cutting repeat-query cost without a separate cache layer.
options_en: A shard-level query cache plus a shard-level request cache.
Only client-side browser caching.
Elasticsearch does no caching at all.
Only write requests get cached, never queries.
optionMeanings: ES 内建的两层分片缓存。
把缓存责任完全推给客户端。
否认 ES 有任何内建缓存。
把缓存和写路径搞反。
optionScenarioImpacts: query cache 缓存过滤结果，request cache 缓存完整响应，对聚合查询尤其有用，还能支撑自适应缓存最高频查询。
客户端缓存不能被其他用户共享。
与事实相反，ES 内建两层缓存。
查询恰恰是最需要缓存的路径。

termDefinitions.meaning: Elasticsearch 把一个索引切分成的更小单元，便于分布式存储和并行查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shard is a smaller unit Elasticsearch splits an index into, enabling distributed storage and parallel querying.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分片级缓存，专门保存过滤（filter）条件的结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The query cache is a shard-level cache that stores the results of filter clauses.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分片级缓存，保存完整搜索响应，对聚合类查询效果明显。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The request cache is a shard-level cache that stores full search responses, which helps a lot for aggregation-heavy queries.

scenario: 搜索结果不做个性化（同一查询对所有用户返回相同结果），想让全球用户的重复查询延迟更低。
scenario_en: Search results are not personalized, so the same query returns the same results for every user worldwide.
q: 还可以再加哪一层缓存？
q_en: What extra cache layer can you add?
options: 给每个用户配专属服务器
在每个国家部署一套 ES
用 CDN 就近缓存搜索结果
取消搜索缓存
why: 结果对所有用户一致是前提；CDN 把搜索结果缓存到离用户近的边缘节点，重复查询就近返回，全球延迟更低。
why_en: As long as results are not personalized, a CDN like CloudFront can cache them at edge nodes near users so repeated queries return faster worldwide.
whenOtherWins: 一旦搜索结果个性化（因人而异），CDN 共享缓存就不适用，只能退回服务端/用户级缓存。
tradeoff: 全球边缘就近命中 vs 结果必须对所有用户一致
options_en: Give every user a dedicated server.
Deploy a full Elasticsearch cluster in every country.
Use a CDN, like CloudFront, to cache results near each query.
Remove search caching altogether.
optionMeanings: 把专属资源当成扩展手段。
把地理扩展理解成多套搜索集群。
用 CloudFront 这类 CDN 按查询串缓存到边缘节点。
放弃已有的查询缓存层。
optionScenarioImpacts: 成本不现实，也没解决地理延迟。
多套 ES 带来数据同步和一致性新问题。
结果对所有用户一致，边缘节点就近返回，重复查询延迟更低。
退回每次都打搜索后端，负载和延迟都变差。

termDefinitions.meaning: 内容分发网络，把内容缓存在靠近用户的边缘节点上。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN, or content delivery network, caches content on edge servers close to users.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一查询对不同用户返回不同结果，这类结果无法被共享缓存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Personalized results mean the same query returns different results per user, which a shared cache cannot serve.

q: CDN/自适应缓存搜索结果的一致性难点在哪？
q_en: Where is the consistency problem in CDN or adaptive caching for search results?
options: CDN 边缘节点数量太少
查询串和结果之间没有直接映射，难精确失效
CDN 天生不支持 HTTPS
缓存后搜索结果顺序会打乱
why: 同一个新活动可能影响无数种查询的结果，而缓存 key 只是查询串——找不到该失效哪些 key 的精确映射，这是一致性的本质难题。
why_en: A single data change can affect countless possible queries, but the cache key is just a query string, so there is no precise mapping telling you which keys to invalidate.
options_en: There are too few CDN edge nodes.
Query strings have no direct mapping to the results they affect, so precise invalidation is hard.
CDNs inherently do not support HTTPS.
Caching scrambles the order of search results.
optionMeanings: 把难点归咎于节点数量。
查询与结果间缺乏映射的一致性难题。
把 CDN 的能力说错。
把缓存和排序问题混为一谈。
optionScenarioImpacts: 节点数量不是这里的核心问题。
新活动上线后没人说得清该让哪些历史查询过期，还要多背 CDN 集成和自适应缓存这套基础设施。
CDN 早已普遍支持 HTTPS。
缓存不会改变结果内部的排序逻辑。

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统自动学习并缓存最高频查询的策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Adaptive caching automatically learns and caches the most frequently requested queries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从「数据变化」到「该失效哪些缓存 key」之间的对应关系；查询缓存里这层映射通常不存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Invalidation mapping is the link from a data change to the cache keys it affects, which query-result caches typically lack.

q: Ticketmaster 这题主要体现了哪些系统设计模式？（多选）
q_en: Which system-design patterns does the Ticketmaster problem mainly show?
options: 处理竞争（Dealing with Contention）——高并发抢同一张票
读扩展（Scaling Reads）——开售时活动页被打爆
实时更新（Real-time Updates）——座位图与队列排位推送
地理空间索引（Geospatial Index）
why: 三个可迁移的模式：竞争处理（防双订）、读扩展（缓存+横向扩展）、实时更新（SSE/WebSocket）。地理索引是 Uber/Yelp 类题的模式，本题没用到。
why_en: This problem showcases dealing with contention, scaling reads, and real-time updates, while geospatial indexing belongs to problems like Uber or Yelp instead.
options_en: Dealing with Contention — many users racing for the same ticket.
Scaling Reads — event pages get hammered when tickets go on sale.
Real-time Updates — seat map and queue position pushed live.
Geospatial Index.
optionMeanings: 同一资源被高并发抢占的模式。
读流量远超写流量时的扩展模式。
服务器主动推送变化给客户端的模式。
按地理位置检索最近结果的模式。
optionScenarioImpacts: 对应票务的防双订设计：事务/OCC/分布式锁。
对应活动页缓存 + 横向扩展设计。
对应 SSE/WebSocket 推送座位状态和排队进度。
本题不涉及“附近的活动”这类地理查询。

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个请求同时抢占同一资源时如何保证正确性的设计模式（如防止双重下单）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dealing with Contention is the design pattern for keeping correctness when many requests race for the same resource, such as preventing double booking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 读流量远大于写流量时，用缓存和横向扩展来支撑高并发读取的模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scaling Reads is the pattern of using caching and horizontal scaling to support very high read traffic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务器主动把状态变化推送给客户端的模式，如 SSE 或 WebSocket。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Real-time Updates is the pattern of pushing state changes from server to client live, using mechanisms like SSE or WebSocket.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按地理位置快速检索附近结果的索引结构，常见于打车、点评类应用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A geospatial index is a structure for quickly finding nearby results by location, common in ride-hailing or review apps.

q: Tinder 设计题的核心功能需求包括哪些？（多选）

滑动 + 互滑匹配是这道题真正的核心交互。
私信聊天发生在匹配之后，不属于本题范围。

题目第二条明确列出的需求。
题目第三、四条合并考察的核心交互。

scenario: 两人互相右滑构成匹配；系统要决定滑动的一致性等级。
q: 关于滑动的核心非功能需求是什么？
options: 滑动可以最终一致，匹配慢慢补齐即可

题目要求的是一致性而非单纯可用性。

feed 是生成式推荐，不是分页浏览固定列表。

年龄已存服务端，不需要作为必传参数。

因为 URL 太长会报错
因为年龄过滤放在客户端做

Because preferences are already stored server-side.
Because the URL would be too long and error out.
Because age filtering happens on the client.

过滤逻辑在服务端查询时执行，不是客户端。

scenario: 设计 GET /feed 时要决定：位置（lat/long）与半径 distance 是随每次请求由客户端传入，还是持久化在服务端偏好里。
q: 更合理的做法是？
options: 全部持久化在服务端，客户端不传
放在 cookie 里
写死在服务配置里
由客户端随请求传入（位置常变）
options_en: Persist everything server-side; the client sends nothing.
Store it in a cookie.
Hard-code it in the service configuration.
Have the client send it on every request, since location keeps changing.

cookie 是浏览器机制，不适合原生 app 的定位数据。
写死配置无法反映每个用户的实时位置。
每次请求带最新坐标，天然反映当前所在地。
optionDirectness: 位置随时在变，持久化会导致数据陈旧。

配置是全局的，无法表达用户个体位置。

scenario_en: For GET /feed, decide whether latitude/longitude and distance are sent on each request or persisted in server-side preferences.

因为分页必须配合游标数据库

Because mobile clients cannot implement pagination.

Because pagination requires a cursor-based database.

why_en: Pagination is superfluous because the feed generates recommendations, so the app simply hits the endpoint again when the current stack runs out.
optionMeanings: 每次调用都能生成一批新推荐，天然替代翻页。
移动端完全能做分页，只是这里没必要。
响应大小与是否需要分页无关。
游标数据库解决的是列表稳定性，不是本题的原因。

feed 端点本身不依赖游标机制。

q: 滑动接口的形态是？
options: GET /swipe?target=
PUT /match/{userId}
POST /swipe/{userId}，body 携带 decision

POST 提交一次滑动动作，服务端据此判断是否成对匹配。
DELETE /profile 是删资料，与滑动无关。
optionDirectness: 滑动是写操作，不该用 GET。
匹配应由服务端根据反向滑动判定，不是客户端直接 PUT。

与滑动语义完全不符。
q_en: What should the swipe API look like?

q: 为什么用户身份要放在请求头（session token）而不是请求体里？
options: 请求头传输更快
请求体可被客户端篡改，头部认证更安全
请求体不支持字符串
因为 GET 请求没有请求体
options_en: Because headers transmit faster.
Because a request body can be tampered with, and header auth is safer.
Because request bodies do not support strings.
Because GET requests have no body.
why: 把用户信息放 body 会被客户端轻易伪造；经由头部的 session token 才能可靠地做认证与授权。本题所有端点都需要认证。
why_en: User identity goes in the headers via a session token because a request body can be manipulated by the client, and every endpoint here requires authentication.
optionMeanings: 传输速度不是这里的决定性因素。
服务端签发的令牌，无法被篡改。
请求体完全支持字符串字段。
本题的写接口（POST /swipe）本就带请求体。
optionDirectness: 这不是本题给出的理由。
本题采用的理由。
这不是真实的技术限制。
POST /swipe 等写接口本就有请求体，问题不在此。

termDefinitions.meaning: 放在请求头里证明身份的令牌，服务端据此认证。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A session token is an identity credential carried in the request header for server-side authentication.

q_en: Why should user identity live in a session token header instead of the body?

q: 补全创建资料的请求路径：
text: 客户端发 POST /profile → {{API Gateway}} 负责路由 → {{Profile Service}} 更新用户偏好 → 持久化到{{数据库}}，结果沿原路返回客户端。
why: 最基础的 client-server-database 三层：网关路由、Profile Service 处理、数据库持久化，覆盖第一条功能需求。
why_en: Profile creation flows from the client through the API gateway to the profile service, which persists the preferences in the database.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统入口组件，负责把请求路由到对应后端服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An API gateway is the entry-point component that routes requests to backend services.

q_en: Fill in the request path for creating a profile.

options: 存储用户偏好
路由请求到对应后端服务
计算推荐相似度
检测互滑并生成匹配
options_en: Storing user preferences.
Routing requests to the right backend service.
Computing recommendation similarity.
Detecting mutual swipes and creating matches.
why: 网关只做入口路由：/profile、/feed 走 Profile Service，/swipe 走 Swipe Service，业务逻辑都在后端服务里。
why_en: The API gateway routes incoming requests to the appropriate backend service such as the profile or swipe service.
optionMeanings: 存储偏好是 Profile Service + 数据库的职责。
网关是无状态的路由层，不含业务逻辑。
相似度计算属于推荐/feed 服务的职责。
匹配检测属于 Swipe Service 的职责。
optionDirectness: 这是后端服务的职责，不是网关的。
本题采用的职责划分。
网关不计算推荐相似度。
网关不检测匹配状态。
q_en: What is the API Gateway responsible for in this design?

q: 高层设计里直接用一条 SQL 按偏好 + 经纬度范围查用户表，最大的问题是？
options: SQL 不支持 BETWEEN
返回字段太多
地理位置扫描慢，基础索引救不了
用户表不能建索引
options_en: SQL does not support BETWEEN.
Too many fields are returned.
Geo range scans stay slow even with a basic index.
The users table cannot be indexed.
why: 这条朴素查询极其低效，其中地理位置过滤是重灾区——基础索引救不了它，深挖阶段要换更专业的索引与查询手段。
why_en: The naive SQL filter is far too slow because searching by location is extremely inefficient even with basic indexing.
codeSample:
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE age BETWEEN 18 AND 35
  AND interestedIn = 'female'
  AND lat BETWEEN userLat - maxDistance AND userLat + maxDistance
  AND long BETWEEN userLong - maxDistance AND userLong + maxDistance;
optionMeanings: BETWEEN 是标准 SQL 语法，问题不在这里。
字段数量不影响查询能否命中索引。
经纬度区间扫描对索引不友好，命中率低、代价大。
用户表当然可以建索引，问题在索引类型不对。
optionDirectness: 这不是真实的技术限制。
这不是本题讨论的瓶颈。
本题要处理的核心问题。
能建索引，只是普通索引救不了地理范围查询。
q_en: What is the biggest problem with one SQL query over preferences and lat/long?

scenario: 资料的查看与创建频率远低于滑动写入。要决定：滑动功能并入 Profile Service，还是拆出独立的 Swipe Service？
q: 更合理的选择及理由是？
options: 并入 Profile Service，减少服务数量
用无服务器函数处理滑动
把资料功能合并进滑动服务
拆独立 Swipe Service：写入频率高，需独立扩容
options_en: Merge it into the profile service to keep fewer services.
Handle swipes with serverless functions.
Merge profile features into the swipe service.
Split out a swipe service, since write volume needs independent scaling.
why: 滑动写入量远超资料操作，拆出独立服务和独立库让滑动路径能单独扩容、单独优化；对这个系统而言利大于弊。
why_en: Swipes happen far more often than profile operations, so a separate swipe service and database can scale and be optimized independently.
whenOtherWins: 拆分不是所有系统的正解：流量小、团队小时，单一服务更简单、运维成本更低。
tradeoff: 独立扩容与专属优化 vs 单服务的运维简单
optionMeanings: 合并会让高频滑动写入拖累低频的资料读写路径。
无服务器函数不解决“是否独立服务”这个架构问题。
反向合并同样让两种负载模式互相干扰。
独立服务和独立库让滑动可单独扩容、单独做缓存策略。
optionDirectness: 会让两种截然不同的负载模式互相拖累。
这是部署形态问题，不是本题要决定的服务边界问题。
合并方向反了，问题依然存在。
本题采用的设计理由。
q_en: Which service boundary is better, and why?
scenario_en: Profile reads and writes are much less frequent than swipe writes, so decide whether swiping belongs in Profile Service or a separate Swipe Service.

scenario: 滑动数据每天约 200GB（20M 日活 × 100 滑/天 × 100 字节/条），写入吞吐极高，需要为滑动单独选一个数据库。
q: 在这个写密集滑动场景里，推荐用哪个滑动库？
options: Cassandra：写优化引擎，可按键分区
单机 MySQL
内存 SQLite
把 CSV 存进 S3
options_en: Cassandra, a write-optimized engine that partitions by key.
A single-node MySQL instance.
An in-memory SQLite database.
Storing raw CSV files in S3.
why: Cassandra 的写优化引擎能吞下海量滑动写入，并按 swiping_user_id 分区让“A 是否滑过 B”可预期地打到单分区。
why_en: Cassandra fits the swipe store because its write-optimized engine absorbs massive write volume and partitioning keeps lookups predictable.
whenOtherWins: 读多写少、需要灵活查询的 Profile 数据未必适合 Cassandra——不同数据要按各自的访问模式选库。
tradeoff: 写吞吐与水平扩展 vs 强一致与灵活查询
optionMeanings: 写优化存储引擎（CommitLog+Memtable+SSTable）天生适合这种写密集负载。
单机关系库很快在这个写入量下达到瓶颈。
内存数据库无法承载 200GB/天的持久化需求。
对象存储不支持这种高频、结构化的点查询。
optionDirectness: 本题采用的推荐。
单机写吞吐远撑不住每天 20 亿次写入。
容量和持久化都不满足要求。
查询与写入模式都不匹配。

termDefinitions.meaning: 面向海量写入优化的宽列分布式数据库，靠分区实现水平扩展。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cassandra is a wide-column distributed database optimized for massive write throughput, scaling horizontally through partitioning.

q_en: Which database fits this write-heavy swipe store?
scenario_en: Swipe data adds about 200GB per day, with very high write throughput, so the swipe path needs its own database.

scenario: 20M 日活 × 100 次滑动/天 × 100 字节/条，滑动数据每天新增约 200GB。
q: 这个数据增长量级最直接支持哪个设计判断？
options: 滑动应该单独建库，用写优化引擎并按键分区
可以把滑动直接写进 Profile 表
200GB/天不足以引入分区，单机数据库即可
应该放弃持久化滑动记录
options_en: Swipes need their own write-optimized, partitioned database.
Swipes can simply be written into the profile table.
200GB a day is small enough for a single-node database.
Swipe records should not be persisted at all.
why: 200GB/天的写入量论证了滑动要独立建库、用写优化的 Cassandra 并按键分区，而不是塞进资料表或单机库。
why_en: Roughly two hundred gigabytes of swipe data a day is the argument for a separate, write-optimized, partitioned swipe store.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数据按键切分到不同节点存储的单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A partition is the unit of data split across nodes by key.

q_en: What design decision does this data growth estimate support?
scenario_en: With 20M daily actives, 100 swipes per user per day, and 100 bytes per swipe, swipe data grows by about 200GB per day.

scenario: 20M 日活、人均 100 次滑动/天，全站每天约产生 20 亿次滑动。
q: 全站每天约 20 亿次滑动，这个规模最直接支持哪个设计判断？
options: 事务必须设计成单分区内完成，跨分区事务扛不住
可以放心用跨分区分布式事务
轮询对账已经足够快，能替代原子操作
应该关闭分区功能，改用单一大表
options_en: Transactions must stay single-partition; cross-partition ones won't hold up.
Cross-partition distributed transactions are fine at this volume.
Polling reconciliation is already fast enough to replace atomic ops.
Partitioning should be turned off in favor of one big table.
why: 20 亿次/天的规模无法塞进单一分区；这直接排除了跨分区事务方案，逼出“把互滑两条记录设计到同一分区”的思路。
why_en: Twenty million daily actives at a hundred swipes each produce about two billion swipes per day, far too many for any single partition.

termDefinitions.meaning: 决定一行数据落到哪个分区的字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A partition key is the field that determines which partition a row lands on.

q_en: What design decision follows from about two billion swipes per day?
scenario_en: With 20M daily actives and 100 swipes per user per day, the system sees about two billion swipes per day.

q: 补全 Cassandra 写优化引擎的三个组件：
text: Cassandra 的写路径：先追加 {{CommitLog}}，再写内存中的 {{Memtable}}，随后刷成磁盘上的 {{SSTable}}——这套结构让它极擅长海量写入。
why: CommitLog + Memtable + SSTable 是 Cassandra 写吞吐强悍的根源，也是选它承接每天 20 亿滑动的技术论据。
why_en: Cassandra's write path of commit log, memtable, and SSTable is what makes it exceptionally good at massive write volume.
q_en: Fill in the three pieces of Cassandra’s write-optimized engine.

q: 高层设计中滑动表按 swiping_user_id 分区，直接好处是什么？
options: 写入速度翻倍
不再需要复制
节省一半存储
路由到单一分区，查询快且可预期
options_en: It doubles write speed.
It removes the need for replication.
It halves storage usage.
It routes queries to a single, predictable partition.
why: 分区键决定路由：按 swiping_user_id 分区后，查某人的滑动记录只打一个分区，访问模式又快又稳定。
why_en: Partitioning by the swiping user's id makes checking whether A swiped on B a fast, predictable single-partition query.
diagram:
graph LR
    Swipe[Swipe by user A] --> Partition[Partition swiping_user_id=A]
    Partition --> Rows[Rows by target_user_id]
    Rows --> Query[Fast history for A]
    Query --> Filter[Remove seen profiles]
optionMeanings: 分区键本身不改变单节点的写入速度。
分区和复制因子是两个独立的配置。
分区不会改变数据总量，也不做压缩。
路由到确定分区是分区键设计的直接收益。
optionDirectness: 写入速度取决于存储引擎，不是分区键。
复制仍然需要，分区只影响路由。
分区键不影响存储总量或压缩。
本题采用的理由。
q_en: What is the direct benefit of partitioning swipes by swiping_user_id?

scenario: 滑动数据已经选定用 Cassandra（写优化的分布式数据库）存储。
q: 选 Cassandra 存滑动数据，要接受的主要代价是？
options: 滑动数据最终一致，可能读到未同步状态
不支持分区
无法存储时间戳
写入吞吐太低
options_en: Swipe data is eventually consistent and may be read before it's synced.
It doesn't support partitioning.
It cannot store timestamps.
Its write throughput is too low.
why: Cassandra 换来写吞吐的同时带来最终一致性：刚写入的滑动可能没同步到所有副本，这正是后续深挖要补的洞。
why_en: The cost of Cassandra is eventual consistency of swipe data, which the later deep dive has to work around.
optionMeanings: 副本同步有延迟窗口，读操作可能读到旧状态。
分区正是 Cassandra 的核心能力，不是短板。
时间戳是 Cassandra 完全支持的常规列类型。
写吞吐恰恰是 Cassandra 被选中的原因，不是代价。
optionDirectness: 本题要处理的代价。
这不是真实限制，且方向相反。
这不是真实限制。
这与选择 Cassandra 的初衷相反。

termDefinitions.meaning: 写入后副本会在一段时间内逐步同步，短期内可能读到旧值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eventual consistency means replicas converge over time, so a read shortly after a write may see a stale value.

q_en: What main cost do you accept by storing swipes in Cassandra?
scenario_en: Swipe data has already been placed in Cassandra, a write-optimized distributed database.

q: 互滑场景中，哪一方会在滑动后立刻在屏幕上看到 “You Matched!”？
options: 先滑的一方（Person A）
后滑的一方（Person B）
双方同时收到推送
由客服人工通知
options_en: The person who swiped first (Person A).
The person who swiped second (Person B).

q: Cassandra 的轻量级事务（LWT）与真正的 ACID 事务相比，本质差异是？
options: LWT 更快而且功能更全
LWT 不需要共识协议

LWTs need no consensus protocol at all.

why: LWT 靠 Paxos 共识在单分区内做线性一致的条件更新；它不是完整 ACID——没有跨分区原子性、隔离级别或回滚。
why_en: Lightweight transactions use Paxos to give linearizable conditional updates within one partition, but they are far weaker than true ACID transactions.
